BlueFS will raise the default WAL volume size to 1GB to reduce the risk of ENOSPC failures caused by insufficient WAL space. (architecture-related: BlueFS storage backend capacity configuration)

Fixed the use of bluestore_volume_selection_reserved_factor in the BlueStore/BlueFS volume selection logic, and improved the hierarchical naming and space determination of RocksDBBlueFSVolumeSelector. (architecture-related: BlueFS volume selection logic)
The Monitor information structure adds a new time_added field to prevent newly added monitor from being prematurely judged as MON_DOWN. (architecture-related: Monitor health status determination)

Fix the issue where monmaptool did not correctly apply the configured feature when adding an address, ensuring that the monitor address feature configuration takes effect as expected. (architecture-related: Monitor address feature configuration)

Fix the issue in the RADOS Python binding where the WriteOp.zero() call to the underlying C API had the offset and length parameters in reverse order. (architecture-related: Python client API behavior)
mgr now clears health metrics when handling down/out OSD, instead of removing the OSD from the daemon state, to preserve daemon state consistency. (architecture-related: Manager daemon health state)
Fix the pg_autoscale_mode output logic so that both standard output and JSON output correctly reflect the no_autoscale flag. (architecture-related: PG autoscaler management interface output)

Fix the issue in the RGW notification queue where 2pc_queue's reserved_size drifted and resources were not deducted on commit/abort paths, avoiding false ENOSPC reports. (architecture-related: RGW notification queue resource counting)
Fix the issue where RGW objects created via multipart upload could not correctly read tags. (architecture-related: S3 multipart upload object tag behavior)
Update the RGW Kafka test/integration Kafka version support to 3.9.2. (architecture-related: RGW notification dependency compatibility)

Simplify frag_t printing logic and fix byte order conversion for frag_t in network transmission and storage to improve cross-platform consistency. (architecture-related: frag_t serialization compatibility)

Update the Ceph FUSE client documentation to clarify that fallocate disk space reservation is only supported under specific flag combinations. (architecture-related: CephFS FUSE client usage constraints)
MDS status and metadata output now includes system information and dumps frag_t as objects to improve diagnostic readability. (architecture-related: MDS status and metadata output)
Fix the issue where Dashboard incorrectly created a new MDS service when changing MDS placement to label. (architecture-related: Dashboard service orchestration behavior)
Fix the Dashboard role-based access control permission issue and add missing type information for the mgr-module list. (architecture-related: Dashboard permissions and mgr module interface)

librbd adds a new RBD_LOCK_MODE_EXCLUSIVE_TRANSIENT lock mode that allows other peer to wait when an exclusive lock is manually held briefly, instead of immediately interrupting I/O. (architecture-related: librbd exclusive lock API behavior)

Added Generic MAC Feeder (GMF) module, providing the capability to feed data directly from FPGA to the MAC module. (architectural event: added GMF module)
Added RPF (receive port FIFO) module, used to control packet storage FIFO in FPGA. (architectural event: added RPF module)
Added TSM (timestamp module), providing physical NIC timer operations, time synchronization, timestamp formats, and PTP protocol control. (architectural event: added TSM module)
Added STA module support for FPGA mapping, enabling statistics functionality. (architectural event: added STA module)

Added meter module for the ntnic NIC driver, supporting configuration of meter profile, meter policy, creation/destruction of flows, and reading/updating statistics. (architectural event: added meter module)

Added Tx Packet Editor (TPE) FPGA module and its software abstraction layer, providing software abstraction management for multiple FPGA modules, and implementing initialization and refresh of related RCP configurations. (architectural event: ntnic FPGA hardware abstraction layer changes)

Added Categorizer (CAT) FPGA module, used to select the behavior of other modules in the FPGA pipeline based on protocol inspection. (architectural event: ntnic FPGA hardware abstraction layer changes)
Added Key Matcher (KM) FPGA module, supporting exact matching based on CAM and wildcard matching based on TCAM. (architectural event: ntnic FPGA hardware abstraction layer changes)

Added Flow Matcher (FLM) FPGA module, providing a high-performance stateful SDRAM lookup and programming engine, supporting exact-match lookup and module present detection, allocation, release, reset, control, and state management. (architectural event: added FLM FPGA module)
Added HSH (Hasher) FPGA module, used to compute configurable hash values, supporting Toeplitz and NT-hash hash algorithms. (architectural event: added HSH FPGA module)
Added queue selector (QSL) FPGA module, used to direct packets to host queues, physical ports, exception paths, or drop. (architectural event: added QSL FPGA module)

Added SLC LR (Slicer for Local Retransmit) FPGA module, used to truncate packet headers before packets leave the RX pipeline, to cooperate with the TX pipeline adding new headers. (architectural event: added SLC LR FPGA module)
Added Packet Descriptor Builder (PDB) FPGA module, used to create packet metadata (such as virtio-net headers). (architectural event: added PDB FPGA module)

Added Realtek R8169 NIC DPDK driver skeleton, including basic functions such as Meson build support, device initialization, configuration, and interrupt control. (architectural event: cnxk_ethernet_driver module added cn20k variant support)

Introduced GDTC rawdev driver skeleton, used to connect two independent hosts, including basic methods such as configure/start/stop. (architectural event: cnxk_ethernet_driver module added cn20k variant support)
Added info flow module, used to track FPGA hardcoded parameters and provide an abstraction of whether parameters are supported. (architecture-related: added flow module)
Added Categorizer (CAT) flow module, selecting the behavior of other modules in the FPGA pipeline based on protocol inspection. (architecture-related: added flow module)
Added Key Match (KM) flow module, supporting exact matching based on CAM and wildcard matching based on TCAM. (architecture-related: added flow module)

Added Flow Matcher (FLM) flow module, a high-performance stateful SDRAM lookup and programming engine, supporting line-rate exact-match lookup, capable of handling hundreds of millions of flows. (architecture-related: added flow module)
Added IP fragmenter (IFR) flow module, supporting fragmentation of outbound packets based on programmable MTU. (architecture-related: added flow module)
Added Hasher (HSH) hash module, supporting Toeplitz and NT-hash configurable hash algorithms, used to compute hash values internally in FPGA. (architecture-related: added flow module)
Added queue selection (QSL) flow module, used to direct packets to host queues, physical ports, exception paths, or drop. (architecture-related: added flow module)
Added Slicer for Local Retransmit (SLC LR) flow module, supporting truncation of packet headers in the FPGA RX pipeline. (architecture-related: added flow module)

Added uncore power management driver support for AMD EPYC processors, providing functions such as getting, setting, and initialization/exit of uncore frequency. (architecture-related: added AMD EPYC uncore driver)
Added CNXK RVU LF raw device driver, supporting mailbox communication between PF/VF and interrupt handling. (architecture-related: added CNXK RVU LF raw device driver)
Added zxdh NIC driver basic framework, including ethdev initialization and PCI probe functions. (architecture-related: added zxdh NIC driver framework)
Added rte_telemetry_register_cmd_arg function, supporting callback registration with private parameters. (architecture-related: public API)
Added Packet Descriptor Builder (PDB) flow module for creating packet metadata (such as virtio-net headers).
Added Header Field Update (HFU) flow module, providing hardware abstraction layer functions for initialization, destruction, and setting debug mode.
Added RPP local retransmission (RPP LR) flow processing module, implementing initialization, destruction, debug mode setting, and other functions.
Added TX Copy (Tx CPY) flow module, which writes data to packet fields based on FLM lookup results, for operations such as NAT.
Added Checksum Update (CSU) flow module for updating checksums of modified packets.
Added Tx INS (transmit inserter) flow module, which injects zeros at specified offsets in packets to extend packet length.
Added TX Replacer flow module, supporting replacement of bytes in a specified range within packets.
Added receive MAC converter (RMC) core module, providing basic functions such as module initialization and status query.

net/mlx5 fixed an issue in mlx5_txpp_read_clock() when reading the 64-bit real-time counter from PCI BAR: removed the behavior of dynamically mapping PCI BAR on each call, and ensured the 64-bit counter is read in a single atomic transaction.
net/ice/base re-enabled PHY port timer bypass mode for E822, restoring related code that was previously incorrectly removed.

net/nfp fixed the inner RSS issue in VXLAN: removed the incorrect restriction on RTE_ETH_TX_OFFLOAD_VXLAN_TNL_TSO, moved the enabling logic of NFP_NET_CFG_CTRL_VXLAN to udp_tunnel_port_add(), and added disabling logic in udp_tunnel_port_del().
net/ntnic added definitions for MAC Tx module registers and MAC Rx module registers.

net/ice/base added support for an optional flags field in the signature segment header: if the valid bit is not set, it is assumed to be the last segment; if the valid bit is set, the last segment flag is used to determine whether it is the last segment.

Migrated the IPv6 address representation in IPsec-related code from uint8_t[16] arrays to the rte_ipv6_addr structure, and updated initialization, assignment, and printing methods. (architecture-related: public API)
Changed the IPv6 address field in the flow API from uint8_t[16] arrays to the rte_ipv6_addr structure, and updated access methods in related drivers and test code. (architecture-related: public API)
Unified the identical algorithm enums from the 9k and 10k platforms into a common namespace. (architecture-related: public API)
Moved the cn10k security PMD function definitions to cn9k/cn10k common code, and removed references to struct rte_security_session. (architecture-related: public API)

Cleaned up all unnecessary conditional compilation tags in i40e base code, removed VF support-related code, because the VF functionality has been taken over by the IAVF driver. (architecture-related: driver responsibility adjustment)
Added high-bit definitions for Rx error registers, and migrated the receive error counter from the PF private structure to the base driver statistics structure. (architecture-related: public API)
Changed the DPAA2 device creation function to directly receive the device object instead of the object ID, and allocated its container for each device. (architecture-related: public API)

Refactored core power management, moving driver implementations from lib/power to the drivers/power directory, with each driver providing an independent ops structure, and the core library managing driver initialization and unload uniformly through ops pointers. (architecture-related: driver architecture refactoring)

Refactored uncore power management, creating independent directories for each driver, and introduced a driver registration mechanism based on ops to support selective activation. (architecture-related: driver registration mechanism)

Migrated the QDMA header file from the dpaa2 driver to the common dpaax driver, unified macro naming, removed conditional compilation BMT settings, and changed to offset-based IOVA calculation. (architecture-related: common header file migration)

Unified IPv6 address representation as the rte_ipv6_addr structure, split IPv4/IPv6-related symbols from header file rte_ip.h into independent header files rte_ip4.h and rte_ip6.h, and split checksum functions into rte_cksum.h, maintaining backward compatibility. (architecture-related: public API)

Refactored syslog handling from EAL to the lib/log layer, unified Linux and FreeBSD implementations, and added syslog support for FreeBSD; only when the --syslog option is specified is it logged to syslog, otherwise it is only output to standard error. (architecture-related: logging layer refactoring)

Cleaned up deprecated external EM support in the bnxt driver, removed related functions; changed TCAM entries from static allocation to dynamic allocation using abstract entry ID; removed code related to allocating memory for the no-longer-supported AFM; unified use of the driver's built-in TCAM manager, removing selection logic based on rx/tx_tcam_supported. (architecture-related: TCAM manager refactoring)

Refactored the MC VFIO driver, introducing a management model based on group/container, supporting multi-process communication, and allowing multiple MC groups to be connected to the same VFIO container. (architecture-related: VFIO management model)

Made the fslmc bus IOVA mode configuration dynamic, removed compile-time CFLAGS configuration, switched to runtime API to determine VA/PA mode, and refactored memory and I/O IOMMU mapping and DMA mapping management. (architecture-related: IOVA mode dynamization)
Fixed the rte_fib_rcu_qsbr_add() function to return a negative error code during rule reclamation to comply with the API specification. (architecture-related: public API)
Added independent version, traffic class, and flow label fields to the IPv6 header structure, and retained the original vtc_flow field for backward compatibility. (architecture-related: public API)

eal/arm added WFET (wait for event with timeout) support in power management built-in functions, selectively enabled by checking FEAT_WFxT, falling back to WFE when unavailable; also extended the availability of WFE/SEV/SEVL and related macros to not depend on RTE_WAIT_UNTIL_EQUAL_ARCH_DEFINED.
net/sfc added support for using indirect counters in SWITCH rules for tunnel offload, replacing inline counters or following them when the inline counter is a conntrack auxiliary counter.
Added an API for obtaining the number of queue pairs for ML devices. (architecture-related: public API)

baseband/acc extended FFT support for VRB2 PRQ devices to adapt to the latest stepping, and fixed some unused VRB2 register definitions; also introduced a common queue statistics update function between acc PMD.
mbuf added transport mode ESP packet types: added RTE_PTYPE_L4_ESP for regular transport mode, and RTE_PTYPE_INNER_L4_ESP for ESP packets over UDP.
Increased the maximum number of IPC file descriptors from 8 to 253, removing the queue number limit for TAP and XDP drivers. (architecture-related: public API)
Added support for symmetric algorithm SM4-XTS in cryptodev and updated tests. (architecture-related: public API)
Added strict priority configuration support for dmadev; devices must declare the RTE_DMA_CAPA_PRI_POLICY_SP flag. (architecture-related: public API)
Added network byte order IPv4 address lookup support for the FIB library, with a new RTE_FIB_F_NETWORK_ORDER flag. (architecture-related: public API)
Added xstat counter support for graph nodes, with new related API for retrieving and incrementing node-specific counters. (architecture-related: public API)
common/cnxk implements SSO HW info mailbox to obtain hardware capabilities, replacing hardcoded values, and removes redundant header file includes.

Added basic control path support for CN20K Ethernet devices, including receive/transmit offload flags, packet type setting, queue management, PTP time synchronization, and more. (architectural event: added CN20K Ethernet driver)
Added offload flag-based receive function and transmit function selection for CN20K NICs. (architectural event: added cn20k hardware support)
Added Rx burst support for CN20K NICs, including scalar and vectorized bulk receive. (architectural event: added cn20k hardware support)
Added scalar Tx burst support for CN20K NICs, including basic transmit and multi-segment transmit. (architectural event: added cn20k hardware support)
Added vectorized Tx burst support for CN20K NICs, including basic vector transmit, multi-segment transmit, and TSO functionality. (architectural event: added cn20k hardware support)

Added initialization and deinitialization support for the flow API of the ntnic driver, including flow filters, high-level interface registration and retrieval for flow backend, and resource management functions. (architectural event: ntnic flow API module change)

Added complete virtual queue management functionality for the ntnic driver, including availability monitoring, used writer data processing, descriptor readers, packed ring support, queue release, and packet receive/transmit. (architectural event: ntnic FPGA hardware abstraction layer module change)
Added support for IPV4, ICMP, PORT_ID, VOID, UDP, TCP flow items for the ntnic driver. (architectural event: ntnic FPGA hardware abstraction layer module change)
Added flow aging support for the ntnic driver, including retrieving aged flows and inline profile aging implementation. (architectural event: ntnic FPGA hardware abstraction layer module change)
Added support for VLAN flow items for the ntnic driver. (architectural event: ntnic FPGA hardware abstraction layer module change)
Added support for SCTP flow items for the ntnic driver. (architectural event: ntnic FPGA hardware abstraction layer module change)
Added support for IPv6 and ICMPv6 flow items for the flow API. (architectural event: ntnic FPGA hardware abstraction layer module change)
Added support for the MODIFY_FIELD flow action for the ntnic driver. (architectural event: ntnic FPGA hardware abstraction layer module change)
Added support for GTP and GTP-PSC flow items and raw encapsulation/decapsulation actions for the net/ntnic driver. (architectural event: ntnic FPGA hardware abstraction layer module change)

Refactored unicast DMAC control flow rules, added dedicated types and recorded DMAC and VLAN ID in flow information; separated creation logic from port startup, supporting creation of unicast DMAC and unicast DMAC+VLAN flow rules after port startup, and added corresponding creation and destruction interfaces; also added dynamic management functionality, supporting adding, removing, and destroying unicast DMAC and DMAC+VLAN control flow rules. (architecture-related: public API)

Added flow scale query functionality for the bnxt driver, supporting tracking of resource usage such as WC TCAM, EM, Action, queryable via niccli; this feature is disabled by default and must be enabled via build flag TF_FLOW_SCALE_QUERY. (architecture-related: build configuration: TF_FLOW_SCALE_QUERY)

Added an optional k0 parameter to the LDPC decoder API, allowing direct specification of the circular buffer start position, replacing the derivation from redundant version index; the baseband/acc driver already supports this parameter. (architecture-related: public API)

Added asymmetric/affine quantization support for ML devices, adding scale and zero point fields to the I/O information structure, and supporting user-defined scaling factors and zero points in data type conversion functions. (architecture-related: public API)

Added software live migration support for NFP vDPA devices, including refactoring data path update logic, adding relay vring, interrupt settings, vring index recovery, relay threads, and VHOST_F_LOG_ALL feature bits. (architecture-related: live migration support)
Added RTE bitset type, providing functions and macros for operating on large bitsets, and added atomic operation functions and corresponding unit tests. (architecture-related: public API)
Added crypto device queue pair reset API, allowing reset of specified queue pairs without stopping the entire device; cnxk platform has implemented support. (architecture-related: public API)

Completed missing VF support definitions and code paths for E610 devices, adding ACI capability definitions, VF device and function capability parsing, and SRIOV capability support. (architecture-related: VF/SRIOV support)

The ixgbe driver added support for new variants of the E610 series, adding sub-device ID macros, PCI device ID, and VF MAC type detection to correctly identify and initialize devices; also disabled thermal sensor operations for E610. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)
Added XXV710 N3000 device ID (0x0D58) for the i40e driver, identifying it as a 25G device. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)
Added API for reading LED blinking settings. (architecture-related: public API)

Added a function for NVM get operations supporting custom timeout, to address the issue of the adapter being disabled for a long time due to locks during NVM updates; also added the definition of the pointer to the 5th free supply area in Shadow RAM in the i40e driver base layer. (architecture-related: public API)
Support Ethernet type flow item matching, allowing matching of Ethernet type alone when using flower firmware. (architecture-related: public API)
Support different configuration BAR sizes, dynamically setting BAR size based on firmware version class, and adding version class validity checks. (architecture-related: configuration behavior)
Support obtaining flow rule count limits from firmware, dynamically allocating flow position arrays, and adjusting flow rule retrieval logic accordingly. (architecture-related: public API)

Added CN20K platform support for the common/cnxk driver, including model detection, PF/VF bit encoding, mailbox communication, and mailbox register configuration. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)
Added multiple PMD API for cnxk crypto devices, including CPTR get, refresh, read/write, and queue pair statistics, and improved type safety. (architecture-related: public API)
Extended the virtchnl interface in the IAVF common driver, adding virtual channel command support for managing PTP, SyncE, GNSS, and HQOS. (architecture-related: public API)
Promoted multiple EAL core API from experimental to stable, including power inline functions, lcore usage, and memzone segment configuration API. (architecture-related: public API)

Added loading storage firmware and reading module EEPROM's API for the NSP module, and support loading firmware from flash memory, refactoring the firmware loading logic. (architecture-related: public API)

Added RefSync support, QGRPS and FLOW_STEER_TO_QGRP unload capability definitions, and RSS hash function configuration in virtchnl.h, extending the public API and configuration options of the iavf driver. (architecture-related: public API)

Added atomic bit operation API, including test, set, clear, assign, flip, and test-and-set/clear/assign/flip functions, supporting specified memory order and volatile pointers, and added corresponding unit tests. (architecture-related: public API)

Added reconnection support for vhost backend and VDUSE devices, including reconnection log mechanism and state recovery, supporting reconnection without frontend cooperation. (architecture-related: public API)

Added priority field in crypto device queue pair configuration, defining priority range from highest to lowest; crypto performance test app added --low-prio-qp-mask option to support setting low priority queues. (architecture-related: public API)
Added index match mode for flow table rules, asynchronous creation API, and action to jump to flow table index, extending ethdev flow rule functionality. (architecture-related: public API)

Added link speed channel get, capability query, and set API, and implemented support in Broadcom Thor2 NIC driver; testpmd added corresponding display and configuration commands. (architecture-related: public API)

Added bbdev queue debug dump functionality, providing API to output detailed status of specified queues, and supporting PMD level operations to print more low-level information; bbdev-test application has integrated this feature. (architecture-related: public API)

Support reporting register names and filtering by module, added rte_eth_dev_get_reg_info_ext API, and implemented in hns3 driver; also adjusted register dump functionality. (architecture-related: public API)
Added telemetry command for ethdev, supporting dumping registers of specified modules; also fixed race condition caused by concurrent port add/remove. (architecture-related: telemetry interface)
Support configuring device packet type via Rx packet offload flag, and added set interface for applications to control this flag. (architecture-related: public API)
Added anonymous union in node context, supporting direct storage of opaque pointers, and adjusted structure layout to maintain ABI/API compatibility. (architecture-related: ABI/API compatibility)
Added Inline IPsec hardware SA refresh and base address get PMD API, and changed existing API input parameter from device pointer to port ID. (architecture-related: public API)
Added PMD API for CNXK platform, supporting submission of CPT instructions to Inline Device, and added flow control check mechanism. (architecture-related: public API)
Added PMD API to get encryption/decryption byte and packet statistics for CPT queues. (architecture-related: public API)

Added custom_inb_sa device parameter for CNXK NIC, supporting applications to use custom inbound SA and directly process inline IPsec inbound packets, and added RTE PMD API to configure inline inbound parameters. (architecture-related: public API)
Added PMD API to get hardware model string. (architecture-related: public API)
Added port buffer manager (BMI) statistics for DPAA bus, including enable, disable, get, and reset interfaces, and extended xstats to include BMI statistics. (architecture-related: public API)
Support TX confirmation queues to enable PTP, and control IEEE1588 functionality via devargs parameter. (architecture-related: device parameters)
Separated Tx confirmation queues for DPAA network driver, supporting VSP scenarios, and fixed VSP initialization logic, unified handling of 1G and 10G ports. (architecture-related: public API)

Added IEEE 1588 PTP timestamp support for DPAA platform, including Rx/Tx timestamp read for DPAA1 platform and generic enable/disable, read/write/adjust timestamp ethdev API. (architecture-related: public API)
Added offline (OH) port mode for DPAA bus driver, allowing hardware ports not connected to actual MAC, enabling inter-application IPC communication via QMan queues. (architecture-related: public API)
Added ONIC port mode for OH ports of dpaa-eth, supporting two applications on the same SoC communicating via dpaa-eth. (architecture-related: public API)

Added dedicated NPA AQ enq mailbox for CN20K platform, and in NPA initialization, configuration, and cleanup operations, select new mailbox based on platform type, handling bit width changes and NDC synchronization differences. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)

Added NIX register definitions for CN20K platform, modified nix_get_blkaddr function to support address get logic for new platform, and added debug dump support for NIX queue structure. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)

Introduced stateless packet preparation API for IPsec processing, allowing outbound processing without updating IPsec session internal state, and supporting user-provided sequence numbers. (architecture-related: public API)
Added EdDSA asymmetric algorithm support, including API definitions, OpenSSL PMD and CNXK crypto device driver implementation. (architecture-related: public API)
Added independent enqueue functionality for event devices, added capability flag and port configuration option, and implemented in DLB2 PMD and DSW drivers. (architecture-related: public API)

Added pre-scheduling mechanism for event devices, including capability flag, configuration type, runtime modification API, pre-scheduling hint API, and implemented in cnxk event device. (architecture-related: public API)
Introduced kvargs processing API supporting key-only parameters, and applied in sfc and TAP drivers. (architecture-related: public API)
Added node query API for ethdev traffic manager, and added corresponding command in testpmd. (architecture-related: public API)
Added compile-time configuration option to disable trace and runtime detection function rte_trace_feature_is_enabled. (architecture-related: public API)
Added internal API for rawdev PMD, supporting obtaining raw device structure pointer via device ID. (architecture-related: public API)
Added asymmetric operation capability check function for cryptodev, and updated SM2 test cases. (architecture-related: public API)
Added total memory size output in memory segment and memory area dump API. (architecture-related: public API)
Added PTP clock frequency adjustment API for ethernet devices and ice driver, and integrated PI servo controller in ptpclient example. (architecture-related: PTP clock frequency adjustment API)

Introduced on-demand restore configuration mechanism: added get_restore_flags driver callback, modified rte_eth_dev_start behavior, and provided implementation for mlx5 driver. (architecture-related: driver callback interface)
Added burst capacity API for DPAA QDMA driver, optimized initialization flow, and added scatter-gather copy support. (architecture-related: public API)
Added silent mode support for DPAA DMA driver, can be enabled at configuration, and checked in dequeue operations. (architecture-related: public API)
Added support for scatter-gather copy operations for DPAA DMA driver. (architecture-related: public API)
Added user-configurable hardware error checking options for the DPAA DMA driver, and enabled corresponding error handling in the dequeue and initialization flows. (architecture-related: public API)
Added more RFC 792-based ICMP types and codes, and renamed the macro prefix from RTE_IP_ICMP_ to RTE_ICMP_ to distinguish types from codes. (architecture-related: public API)
Added support for outer VLAN flow matching, enabled via runtime configuration fdir_tuple_config, which can replace the inner tuple to enable outer VLAN matching. (architecture-related: public API)

Added IPv6 address structures and related utility functions, including multicast scope, link-local address, solicited-node address, and Ethernet multicast address conversion, as well as IPv6 version number checking functions, and added corresponding unit tests. (architecture-related: public API)
Added a device option for the ice driver, allowing users to specify the path of the DDP package file to load. (architecture-related: public API)

Added PTP single-step timestamp support and endpoint name retrieval API for the DPAA2 network driver, and optimized the creation of the send scatter-gather memory pool. (architecture-related: public API)

Added a DPDMUX counter dump feature to identify packet drop reasons; also refactored the flow creation interface, changing the return value from a structure pointer to an integer. (architecture-related: public API)

Added a close operation for the fslmc bus, added rte_fslmc_close API and multiple device close functions, supporting the release of DPAA2 device resources when the application closes. (architecture-related: public API)
Added DPDMUX method support based on C-VLAN and MAC addresses for the dpaa2 driver, and added device close and counter dump features. (architecture-related: public API)
Upgraded MC firmware compatibility to 10.37, and added/updated multiple MC driver APIs. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)
Added API for the DPAA2 network device driver, to check whether a port belongs to the DPAA2 platform. (architecture-related: public API)
Declared public API for VFIO DMA mapping and unmapping in bus_fslmc_driver.h. (architecture-related: public API)

Refactored the DPAA2 NIC flow engine, introduced the key_profile structure, and added support for matching multiple protocol flows such as VXLAN, ECPRI, GTP, IPsec AH/ESP. (architecture-related: public API)
Enhanced RAW flow extraction, supporting a combination of RAW extraction and header extraction, and allowing starting from any absolute offset. (architecture-related: public API)

Added the rte_thash_gen_key function and introduced dynamic polynomial computation to generate higher-entropy Toeplitz hash keys, improving packet distribution in small-flow scenarios. (architecture-related: public API)

Introduced STE array matchers (only as isolated matchers under a parent table) and a jump-to-matcher action, supporting jumping by index to STE array matchers and matchers of size 1. (architecture-related: public API)

Added the rte_flow_async_create_by_index_with_pattern function and support for the jump-to-flow-table-index action, implementing creation, validation, construction, and resource management of hardware steering jump to matcher actions. (architecture-related: public API)
Added an endpoint name retrieval API for the DPAA2 network device, and exported this interface in the public header file. (architecture-related: public API)
Added support for extracting multiple flow rules, added hardware descriptors for IP fragmented frames, and refactored the flow rule creation interface. (architecture-related: public API)
Added RSS action support for flows on single-queue port representors, enabling multi-queue representor applications to utilize RSS functionality. (architecture-related: public API)
Added support for configuring DPI DMA queue priority via mailbox requests, and exposed priority capabilities in device information. (architecture-related: public API)
Enhanced IPsec extended sequence number support, initializing the sequence number and setting the high 32 bits, and declared ESN support in security capabilities. (architecture-related: IPsec ESN)
Added support for DiffServ, ECN, and copy DF/DSCP, decrement TTL options in IPsec tunnel mode for the DPAA_SEC crypto device. (architecture-related: public API)
Added support for the ESP protocol encapsulated in UDP, implementing IPsec NAT-T traversal. (architecture-related: IPsec NAT-T)

In IPSEC ESP protocol offload mode, added UDP encapsulation (NAT-T traversal) support for IPv6 tunnels, and fixed a resource release issue in related session initialization. (architecture-related: IPsec NAT-T)

Added a static memory allocation mechanism for lcore variables, providing per-lcore variable storage, and integrated resource release in the EAL cleanup flow. Also migrated per-lcore state storage in modules such as PRNG, power management, and service library to lcore variables to improve cache friendliness and performance. (architecture-related: public API)
Added __rte_unreachable and __rte_assume macros to mark unreachable code and provide precondition information, aiding compiler optimization. (architecture-related: public API)
Added the rte_ipv4_cksum_simple function to simplify IPv4 header checksum calculation, and replaced duplicate implementations in multiple applications. (architecture-related: public API)

Added a hw.contigmem.coredump_enable tunable parameter in the contigmem driver of the FreeBSD kernel, to control whether mapped contiguous memory buffers are included in core dumps. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)

Added a timestamp option to the logging system, supporting multiple time formats (such as relative boot time, ISO 8601, etc.), and added the --log-timestamp command-line parameter; also added a localtime_r replacement function for the Windows platform. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)

Added support for the systemd journal logging protocol, automatically detecting and using it when the DPDK application runs as a systemd service, to record more log information such as priority. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)
Added roc_npa_pf_func_get API to obtain NPA PF functionality, for use by external drivers. (architecture-related: public API)
Added interrupt callback registration and deregistration API for RVU LF raw devices, and added a self-test feature to verify PMD API. (architecture-related: public API)

Added mailbox message handler registration and deregistration APIs, message ID range setting API, and message handling API for RVU LF devices, implementing complete mailbox message handling functionality. (architecture-related: public API)
Added API rte_pmd_rvu_lf_pf_func_get to get the pffunc of a RVU LF device, and API rte_pmd_rvu_lf_bar_get to get the BAR address. (architecture-related: public API)
Added event device probing, configuration, and port link, unlink, and release functionality for the CN20K platform. (architecture-related: CN20K platform support)

Added configuration, setup, and release functionality for event queues (SSO HWGRP) of the CN20k event device, and support for adjusting queue buffer count and quality of service via device parameters. (architecture-related: configuration interface)

Added complete SSO event port, enqueue/dequeue fast path, port quiet, profile switching, pre-scheduling, start/stop/close, Ethernet Rx/Tx adapter, event aggregator configuration, event vector support, and event timer adapter functionality for the CN20K event device. (architecture-related: CN20K platform support)

Updated the event timer base code to support hardware-accelerated timer start and cancel, and added a hardware work queue configuration interface. (architecture-related: hardware-accelerated timer interface)

Added scheduler topology loading for the ice NIC driver, enhanced Tx scheduler hierarchy flexibility, and added a devarg parameter to limit the number of visible layers of the TM scheduler. (architecture-related: scheduler topology and devarg parameter)

Promoted the rte_eth_bond_member_add, rte_eth_bond_member_remove, rte_eth_bond_members_get, rte_eth_bond_active_members_get, and rte_eth_bond_8023ad_member_info interfaces in the bonding driver from experimental to stable API. (architecture-related: public API stabilization)

Add flow rule priority support to the hns3 NIC driver, selecting the index strategy (hash or priority) via runtime configuration fdir_index_config. (architecture-related: flow rule priority configuration)

Added infrastructure support for the flow feature to the ntnic driver, including configuration API, flow operation registration, create/destroy, configuration file management, flow group handles, etc. (architecture-related: flow API infrastructure)
Added flow create/destroy functionality to the ntnic driver, supporting item any and action port id. (architecture-related: flow create/destroy)
Added support for QUEUE, MARK, JUMP, and DROP flow actions to the ntnic driver. (architecture-related: flow action extension)
Added support for ETH flow items to the ntnic driver, and extended handling of MODIFY_FIELD, RAW_ENCAP, RSS, etc. flow actions. (architecture-related: ETH flow item and action extension)
Add register definitions and registration for the ntnic driver's TX Copy, Tx INS, and Tx RPL modules. (architecture-related: public header register definitions)

Implemented the processing thread for the flow learning queue in the ntnic driver, and added related buffer control, statistics update, and queue management functions. (architecture-related: ntnic driver core module)
Added match and action database attributes to the net/ntnic driver, implementing match/action reference dereferencing. (architecture-related: ntnic driver core module)
Added the ability to export flow rules (flow dump) in a human-readable format to the ntnic driver. (architecture-related: public API)
Added flow flush support to the net/ntnic driver. (architecture-related: public API)

Enabled receive-side scaling (RSS) for the ntnic NIC driver, including adding the RSS configuration structure, hash update and get interfaces, and RSS action handling in flow rules. (architecture-related: public API)
Added statistics functionality to the ntnic driver, including initialization, set, get, and reset of statistics, and added related FPGA definitions. (architecture-related: public API)

Added a statistics polling mechanism to the ntnic driver, adding a statistics thread and a series of functions to poll the statistics module and update data via DMA. (architecture-related: public API)
Added the FLM statistics interface, implemented the flow_get_flm_stats function, and registered it in the operation table. (architecture-related: public API)
Added extended statistics (xstats) support to the ntnic NIC driver, including get, get by ID, reset, and get names, and initialized related operation interfaces. (architecture-related: public API)
Extended the xstats statistics functionality for the ntnic driver, adding support for collecting and reporting counters such as FLM learning, unlearning, and load. (architecture-related: public API)
Extended inline profile with flow info get and flow configure functionality, and added create and free operations for the age queue module. (architecture-related: public API)

Added flow aging event support to the ntnic driver, extended the aging event callback of the port thread, and added read/write interfaces for the LRN, INF, and STA registers. (architecture-related: public API)

Added traffic metering (flow meter) support to the inline configuration file, including meter flow management, queue operations, flow programming, initialization cleanup, statistics reading, and API registration. (architecture-related: public API)

Added flow action update functionality to the ntnic driver, extending the rte_flow_ops interface and internal flow_filter_ops, and implementing specific functions in inline profile. (architecture-related: public API)

Added asynchronous flow create/destroy and flow template support to the ntnic driver, extending public interfaces and internal implementations, including flow pattern templates, action templates, and template table operations. (architecture-related: public API)
Added MTU configuration functionality to the ntnic driver, supporting setting MTU via the rte_eth_dev_set_mtu API. (architecture-related: public API)
Added the --hairpin-map parameter to testpmd, supporting explicit specification of port and queue mapping relationships for Rx and Tx in hairpin forwarding. (architecture-related: public API)
Added EEPROM read/write and module EEPROM information retrieval functionality to the nfp NIC. (architecture-related: public API)

Added PCI initialization implementation for the zxdh network device, including PCI capability retrieval, configuration read/write, state management, feature negotiation, interrupt setup, and queue management operations. (architecture-related: new driver module)

Added device information retrieval functionality to the zxdh NIC driver, including defining the device operation structure and registering the device information retrieval callback. (architecture-related: public API)

Introduced a log option parser, added the eal_option_is_log helper function, extended log option handling, and supported the --log-timestamp and --log-color options. (architecture-related: public API)

Added tf-core (TruFlow) support for the Thor2 chip to the bnxt driver, adding session management, table scope management, hardware resource allocation, etc. API and HWRM message handling. (architecture-related: Thor2 chip support)
Added VXLAN-GPE tunnel support at the ULP layer and updated the template infrastructure. (architecture-related: VXLAN-GPE tunnel support)

Added hooks at the hwrm and ulp layers to support custom L2 etype tunnels, including allocation, release, and retrieval of tunnel ports and handling of UPAR ID. (architecture-related: custom L2 etype tunnel support)

Added VF-to-VF flow offload support for the Whitney platform, changing the pipeline from using VLAN tags to using custom L2 encapsulation and decapsulation. (architecture-related: Whitney platform VF flow offload)

Add Thor2 ULP layer support for the bnxt network driver, including ULP initialization, MPC memory access, VF support, inter-VF traffic offload, Geneve header parsing, set TTL actions, MPC batching, and update related template files. (architecture-related: new Thor2 platform support)

Add feature bit support for ingress flows, used to set the default destination MAC when no destination MAC address is specified; also add function operand size support and update template files. (architecture-related: behavior change: default destination MAC)

Update VFR code to support Thor 2: add endpoint identifier (efid) to sessions, modify common tables to write L2 context ID, and allow simultaneous release of rfid and efid from AFM. (architecture-related: new Thor2 VFR support)

Support dynamic tunnel UDP ports, allowing tunnel UDP destination port to be configured at runtime based on flows; also fix context access segfault, set default VxLAN tunnel port, and improve multi-flow support. (architecture-related: behavior change: dynamic tunnel UDP port)

Add metering support for Thor2, implement Thor2 meter template table, make rte_mtr API implementation device-independent to adapt to hardware changes, and fix rounding issues in xir calculation. (architecture-related: public API)
Add CPU-granularity PM QoS API and provide command-line configuration in the l3fwd-power example. (architecture-related: public API)
Add MTU update support for the r8169 NIC driver, add MTU setting function and firmware version retrieval function, and add DASH stop handling on device close. (architecture-related: public API)

Add queue initialization and release interfaces for GDTC raw device, support queue setting operations, and add enqueue operation support, including enqueue_bufs interface and related helper functions. (architecture-related: public API)
Add Rx rate profile selection feature for the bnxt NIC driver, setting polling mode in Rx and AGG ring allocation when firmware supports it. (architecture-related: public API)

Add opposite macros corresponding to existing switch macros in the flow API configuration header file, to support enabling fragmentation, forwarding IPv4 DF packets, and IPv6 fragmentation. (architecture-related: public API)

Increase the maximum number of queues for the TAP driver from 16 to 64, remove redundant queue count checks, and add compile-time assertions to ensure the multi-process file descriptor limit is not exceeded. (architecture-related: build and installation methods)

net/mlx5 supports BlueField firmware configuration with NUM_OF_PF=0 (disabling x86 host-side PF), allowing probing of PF devices without associated switch ports to handle representor devargs such as pf[0-1]vf[...].

net/mlx5 adds metadata split compatibility support: during the split phase, only generate required items/actions/attributes without implicitly creating flow rules; when mark is specified in FDB rules, create rules in NIC Rx that match REG_C_x and copy metadata to REG_B; when no mark is present, create default metadata copy rules.

net/enic adds PF-VF management channel support for the VF driver: use dedicated Tx/Rx queues to transmit control messages, handle Rx control messages via LSC interrupts, use wrapper functions for devcmd that must go through the management channel, and implement soft Rx statistics and backward-compatible mode detection for older VIC models.
Add an available enqueue depth counter for bbdev, helping applications monitor the available depth for enqueue batching on queues. (architecture-related: public API)
net/mana enables Linux arm64 build support and adds the missing arm64 header file.
Add shift and mask definitions for the VLAN source field in the i40e base driver, for input sets used in flow-directed programming.
Add macro definitions related to DDP packet types for the i40e driver.
Add input set mask macro definitions for RSS and flow director for the X722 series NICs.
Add register macro definitions related to FLU (MAC source pruning feature) for the i40e NIC driver.
Support configuring multiple Rx and Tx queues for NFP flower representor ports, remove hardcoded limits, and adjust related data transmission/reception and resource release logic.
Add SA information telemetry commands for the cnxk NIC driver, supporting query of inbound and outbound SA information via port ID and SA index.
Implement detailed packet parsing based on hardware annotations, supporting identification of IPSec ESP, GRE, and SCTP packets, and update the supported packet type list.
Add PCI ID for CN20K devices in the mempool/cnxk driver (including PF and VF).
Add configuration support for NIX receive queues, transmit queues, and completion queues for the CN20K chip in the common/cnxk driver.
Add bandwidth profile support for the CN20K platform, used for receive-side policers.
Add RSS configuration support for CN20K, fix format issues in nix_cn9k_rss_reta_set, and rename nix_rss_reta_set to nix_cn10k_rss_reta_set.
Add SM3, HMAC SM3, and SM4 (CBC/ECB/CTR) algorithm support for the AESNI_MB PMD.

Add complete queue operation support for the ntnic driver, including queue configuration, start, stop, release, packet processing, scatter-gather hardware release, DBS virtqueue initialization, and split-queue functionality.
Add the ability to set device EEPROM via command line in testpmd.
Add the set port <port-id> led on/off command in testpmd to control the LED switch of Ethernet device ports.
Add SM2 operation capability for the OpenSSL crypto device driver, supporting signing, verification, encryption, and decryption.
Add an alarm mechanism for the NFP NIC driver to support running flower services via timer polling when no service cores are available.
Expand the supported range of scheduler child node count in the ice driver from 8 bits to 16 bits, and remove the flag check before topology upload to support more levels of topology configuration.
Add xstat counters for LPM lookup failures for the IPv4 lookup node, and add xstat counters for reassembly failures for the IPv4 reassembly node.
Add link status update functionality for the af_packet network PMD, setting link status via the IFF_RUNNING flag obtained from the socket using ioctl.
Support matching generic tunnel packets via PTYPE, simplifying tunnel flow rule configuration.
Add multi-PF firmware support for the NFP driver, add PF stop operation, update PF start function, update Tx/Rx function to support multiple physical functions, and simplify Rx function.
Add matching support for IPsec ESP transport mode packet types in the MLX5 driver.
Add software tail drop functionality for the DPAA2 network driver, automatically releasing pending packets when hardware is congested.
Support for traffic splitting based on VLAN ID.
Added support for link state events in representor port message processing, and optimized the lookup logic for representor ports in MTU message processing.
Support updating RSS rules for representee via PF port, and validate whether representee belongs to the PF port before updating.

The ixgbe driver now supports per-queue statistics for fewer queues than the driver's maximum supported number, and no longer requires the number of configured statistics queues to equal the driver's maximum supported value.
Added hook functions for log output, supporting custom printing behavior, facilitating formatted output to console or log systems.

Added color support for log output, with timestamps, subsystems, and message levels colored separately, disabled by default, and added necessary file descriptor and terminal detection functions for Windows.
Increased the maximum number of supported DV subflows from 32 to 64.
Added configuration support for the CN20K event device, including initialization of SSO hardware ports and queue resources.
Added LED blinking functionality for the NFP network device, used to identify physical ports.
Added message channel support for the zxdh NIC driver, including initialization, enabling, and obtaining backend device information through the message channel.
Added interrupt configuration functionality for the zxdh NIC driver, supporting RISC and DTB interrupt settings and interrupt release.
Implemented device configuration operations for the zxdh NIC driver, supporting queue checking, resetting, allocation, and resource management.
Added device shutdown operation for the zxdh NIC driver, implementing resource release.
Improved flow scalability, returning appropriate error codes when exact match table space is insufficient, and added EM usage update logic.
Added mirroring support for the Wh+ platform, including multi-port handling, ingress and egress mirror template updates, and related parser adjustments.

Support overlapping flows, including flow scale improvements, conditional list handling, Thor2 platform overlapping flow functionality, merging of VFREP and non-VFREP template capabilities, compilation error fixes, and build warning fixes.
Added VXLAN tunnel flow statistics support for the Thor2 platform, and updated related template files.
Support jump action, allowing chained matching using group attributes in flow rules, and added allocator table management functionality.
Support application flow priority, placing flows in the corresponding position in TCAM when priority is specified, and updated related template files.
Added RSS flow query support at the ULP layer, added RSS query information filling and retrieval functions, and adjusted related log macros.
Added port table write operations, socket direct generic templates, promiscuous mode, profile TCAM entry metadata setting, and group missing action support.
Added track type fields to the mapper table, merged Thor/Thor2 action templates, and fixed GPE flow creation and deletion.
Added jump action, dynamic tunnel, and flow priority support for Thor2, and fixed common application template issues.
Added flow statistics caching for Thor2, supporting background collection and counter read-and-clear.
Added hardware register access routines (MMIO, MAC OCP, CSI) for the r8169 NIC driver.

Added core logic for the transmit and receive data path for the r8169 NIC driver, including initialization functions and transmit/receive function prototypes, integrated into device startup and initialization.
Added hardware configuration functionality for the r8169 NIC driver, implementing the rtl_hw_config function and related helper functions to initialize registers at startup.
Added PHY configuration support for the r8169 NIC driver, including PHY power up/down, EPHY configuration, PHY reset, MCU firmware version check, and EEE disable.
Added hardware initialization support for the r8169 NIC driver, including software variable initialization, NIC reset, DASH feature detection, MAC address reading, and link settings.
Added link state management and interrupt management for the r8169 NIC driver, including device start/stop, link up/down switching, promiscuous mode, and statistics retrieval and reset.
Added complete receive (Rx) data path support for the r8169 NIC driver, including receive queue setup, initialization, packet reception, and hardware configuration.

Added complete TX data path implementation for the r8169 NIC driver, including transmit queue management, packet transmission, checksum offload, TSO segmentation, VLAN tagging, and transmit completion cleanup.
Added statistics functionality for the r8169 NIC driver, supporting retrieval, clearing, and initialization of statistics counters.
Added promiscuous mode and multicast mode configuration support for the r8169 NIC driver.
Added driver start and stop functionality for the rtl8125ap and rtl8125bp NICs, which must be executed regardless of whether DASH is enabled.
Allow vport action in Rx flows to be sent directly to uplink, no longer dropped.
Added transmit descriptor error statistics functionality for the ngbe NIC driver, accumulating descriptor error counts for each transmit queue when retrieving and resetting statistics.
net/enic removed the unicast address check in enic_set_mac_address(), allowing multicast addresses to be accepted in the MAC address add callback.
In lib/ip_frag/rte_ipv4_reassembly.c, replaced the unaligned uint64_t variable used to copy 8 bytes from ip_hdr to key with an equivalent 8-byte constant size memcpy.
In app/test-dma-perf, added support for independent configuration parameters for each DMA device in test cases, including fields such as lcore, dev, dir, raddr, coreid, pfid, and vfid.

In examples/flow_filtering, introduced reusable code snippets (snippets), demonstrating flow rule creation based on template API and non-template API respectively, covering matching features such as GRE, IPv4, and MPLS.
In drivers/net/bnxt, added buffer split Rx offload support for header and data for the bnxt NIC, where IPv4 or IPv6 packets are split at fixed offsets.
In drivers/net/gve/gve_tx_dqo.c, added TSO (TCP Segmentation Offload) support for the DQO RDA format of the GVE driver.

In drivers/net/dpaa2 and drivers/bus/fslmc, enabled FLC (Flow Context) stashing for flow steering (flow steering) action configuration, making it consistent with the stashing settings configured by RSS.

In app/test-pmd/cmdline.c, changed the implementation for reading the initial command of --cmdline-file from cmdline_file_new to cmdline_new, so that the output of each command is displayed to stdout.
Add a series of new tag definitions for E830_GLTCLAN_TSYN_REG_RANGE_ENFORCE* in drivers/net/ice/base/ice_hw_autogen.h.
In drivers/net/hns3/hns3_dump.c, add head and tail pointer information for the dump output of the Rx queue and Tx queue, including sw_head, sw_hold/sw_tail, hw_head, and hw_tail.
Enable extended packet number (XPN) mode in examples/l2fwd-macsec/main.c to avoid frequent rekeying due to PN threshold interrupts.
In drivers/net/cnxk/cnxk_flow.c, add dump support for a single flow for the cnxk driver.

Introduce the rtl_hw_ops hardware operation function pointer structure in drivers/net/r8169, add corresponding hardware operations and MCU firmware support for chip models such as rtl8125a, rtl8125b, rtl8125bp, rtl8125d, and rtl8126a, and add PHY register access routines.
Add stop and close callback functions for the CN20K event device.

Update the Thor2 generic template, fixing issues with WC match failure, L2 flow ethertype check, L3 protocol configuration errors, and non-default priority flow table entry allocation. (Architectural event: new Thor2 template added to bnxt_ulp_template_db)
Register and handle RSS change events, fixing the bug where old flags were not cleared in PMD QCAPS updates. (architecture-related: public API)

Replace flag enums in the argparse library with macro definitions to resolve enum value type mismatch issues, correct the flags type from uint32_t to uint64_t, introduce bitmask macros, and update test cases. (architecture-related: public API)

Fix the issue where device event callback unregistration incorrectly removed all callbacks without a specified device name; now only callbacks matching both the callback function and arguments are removed. (architecture-related: public API)

Fix the inaccurate detection of send queue full status during polling in the mlx5/hws driver, using actual queue status for judgment to avoid rule movement failure during matcher rehashing. (architecture-related: public API)

Fix the use of incorrect control words and configuration functions during vDPA reconfiguration, switching to the extended configuration function and the correct virtio control macros. (architecture-related: public API)

Fix the reported Rx/Tx descriptor limit in the mlx5 NIC driver, setting the actual maximum descriptor count based on hardware capabilities and adding upper bound checks during queue setup. (architecture-related: public API)

In the ice NIC driver, when time synchronization is enabled, initialize the PHC master timer to the current system time to avoid timestamp errors. (Architecture-related: time synchronization behavior)

Fix the PTP initialization for the E825C device, correcting hardcoded clock source and frequency values, and adjust sideband access to support the second PHY and CGU devices. (Architecture-related: PTP initialization behavior)

Fix the issue where the 200G link speed was not correctly advertised during PHY configuration initialization, extending the link speed mask to include the 200G rate bit. (architecture-related: public API)
Fix the X710TL device check in the i40e driver, adding the missing ID for the 1G NIC device. (architecture-related: public API)
Fix the hardware semaphore timeout variable type and timeout judgment logic in the i40e driver to correctly handle 32-bit value wraparound. (architecture-related: public API)
Ensure the CPTR pointer is 128-byte aligned, otherwise return an error. (architecture-related: public API)
Fix the REX prefix issue for write-combining store instructions in 32-bit mode, removing unnecessary bytes to ensure compatibility. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)
Fix the issue of generating corrupted files when processing chained mbuf in pcapng, correcting the EPB block length calculation. (Architecture-related: pcapng file generation behavior)
Fix the VFIO hotplug issue in multi-process scenarios, enhance automatic retry support, and remove redundant functions. (Architecture-related: VFIO multi-process synchronization)

Fix multiple issues with flex item in the mlx5 driver, including tunnel mode handling, protocol validation, sample field matching, header length translation, and the maximum parser count limit. (Architecture-related: mlx5 flex item behavior)

Fix issues with the PTP timestamp feature in the cnxk driver, including mbuf_addr being corrupted in VF and Rx offload flags not being set correctly. (Architecture-related: cnxk PTP timestamp behavior)

Fix the strict aliasing violation warning caused by type-punned pointers in the rte_mbuf_raw_alloc function, using an inline union variable to avoid incorrect type casting. (architecture-related: public API)

Fix the issue in rte_eal_alarm_cancel where another thread starves due to lock contention, adding sched_yield() (SwitchToThread() on Windows) after releasing the lock to yield CPU control. (architecture-related: public API)
Fix the failure of inbound out-of-order processing in event mode due to unupdated reassembly flags, and add a receive offload callback registration function. (architecture-related: public API)
Adjust the aura field width for the cn20k chip, modifying bit offsets in related register read/write operations. (architecture-related: public API)
Restrict the rte_vhost_driver_set_max_queue_num API to only take effect for the VDUSE backend, avoiding impact on Vhost-user live migration. (architecture-related: public API)

Add runtime checks in the AVX512 lookup function for whether the CPU supports AVX512DQ and AVX512BW instruction sets, ensuring vector functions are used only when conditions are met. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)

Integrate the RCU QSBR mechanism for the DIR24-8 algorithm set to prevent tbl8 groups from being freed while readers are still using them, thereby preventing lookup errors. (architecture-related: public API)

Fix the potential null pointer access in the rte_dma_vchan_status function when the status parameter is NULL, adding a null pointer check and adjusting the variable assignment order. (architecture-related: public API)

Fix the mapping error between lcore ID and CPU ID in the power library, now correctly obtaining the CPU ID based on the mapping relationship between lcore and CPU, and restricting support to lcore mapped to a single physical core. (architecture-related: public API)

Fix the spelling error in the VLAN flow matching pattern macro definition in the hns3 driver, and add this parameter to the driver parameter registration string. (Architecture-related: driver parameter configuration)
Add validation support for malformed Rx descriptor errors in the ENA NIC driver, improving reset logic and statistics tracking. (architecture-related: public API)
Before sending commands to MC, convert VA to IOVA and check its validity to prevent invalid IOVA from causing system hangs. (architecture-related: core module behavior)
Improve the DPDMUX error behavior setting to be compatible with MC v10.36 and later versions. (architecture-related: MC version compatibility)

Fixed an array index overflow issue in the IPv6 address comparison and mask functions caused by type conversion, by modifying variable types and constants to avoid potential security risks. (architecture-related: public API)
Fixed an array out-of-bounds read issue in the rte_ipv6_addr_mask function caused by memset, and changed to clearing the remaining bytes in a loop. (architecture-related: public API)

Fixed the issue where some symbols in the ethdev header file were not included in the extern "C" block, causing C++ link failures, and adjusted the tracking calls of rte_eth_rx_burst to distinguish between empty and non-empty reception. (architecture-related: public API)
Removed the packed attribute from struct rte_afu_device; this structure does not require compact alignment. (architecture-related: public API)
Removed support for ROH devices and reverted the related device additions. (architecture-related: public API)
Added the const qualifier to the parameters of the getopt series functions on the Windows platform to align with the FreeBSD version. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)

Moved log initialization to the very beginning of rte_eal_init() to ensure that all log messages (including CPU mismatches, etc.) can be output through the logging library. (architecture-related: initialization flow)

Fixed the error handling issue for the 128-byte CQE in the mlx5 driver, unified the error CQE structure into mlx5_error_cqe, and corrected the related size calculation. (architecture-related: public API)
Allows users to configure the number of STC allocated per context, avoiding hardware resource exhaustion due to excessive default allocation. (architecture-related: public API)

Fixed the dangling pointer warning in the mlx5 driver caused by moving the flow parameter structure from the stack to the queue private data structure, and added error code setting. (architecture-related: public API)
Added functions to release the aging event queue and status event queue during the de-initialization process of the ntnic driver to ensure thread-safe termination. (architecture-related: public API)
Fixed the bit definition error for the VF-PF mailbox interrupt in the txgbe driver to ensure the interrupt is handled correctly. (architecture-related: public API)

Added Tx descriptor error statistics functionality to the txgbe NIC driver, counting the number of packets not sent due to descriptor errors. (architecture-related: public API: Tx descriptor error statistics)

Fixed the compilation warning in the IPv4 checksum simple function caused by unaligned structures, by aligning the rte_ipv4_hdr structure to 2 bytes and adjusting the pointer conversion method. (architecture-related: public API)
Added a 2-byte alignment attribute to the IPv6 header structure to reflect its actual alignment requirements. (architecture-related: public API)

This commit contains multiple fixes and feature enhancements, covering template compiler modifications, VxLAN-GPE support, default parif handling for single-port cards, hot upgrade API, custom VxLAN flow support, asynchronous event synchronization, log level adjustments, memory release fixes, null pointer checks, crash fixes, and VF representative support, etc. (architecture-related: public API)

Fixed the issue of using the default mask when no mask is specified in protocol header parsing, updated the flow database to support 64-bit handles and more resource types, and fixed the shared session statistics and template rejection logic. (architecture-related: 64-bit handle support)

Fixed heap corruption caused by mismatched memory release of lcore variables on Windows, and limited the maximum size of each lcore variable to 128k to avoid memory exhaustion. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)
Fixed the scan failure of the fslmc bus on non-DPAA2 platforms and removed debug logs. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)
Fixed the default RSS flow creation order to ensure rules are created in the correct priority order in SWS and HWS modes. (architecture-related: packet processing priority)

Fixed the issue where the Rx queue reference count was not correctly decremented when stopping the port and flushing flow rules, and introduced a device-level flush flag. (architecture-related: resource management)

Fixed the miniCQEs count calculation by obtaining the number of miniCQEs in the compressed CQE array from CQE instead of the header packet, avoiding a segmentation fault when mbuf is corrupted. (architecture-related: data path behavior)

Fixed the MSVC compiler warning in the RCU QSBR library caused by the implicit conversion of the 32-bit shift to 64 bits, and fixed the defect where bit operations could be incorrect when the thread ID is greater than 0x1f. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)
Fixed the issue of an incomplete log message list, added the missing error messages, and added static assertions to ensure list completeness. (architecture-related: public API)

Fixed the reference count and condition checks for the shared Rx queue control structure during port stop and device close, ensuring the control structure is correctly released and avoiding crashes on port restart. (architecture-related: public API)
Fixed the missing validation of the number of packet segments in the send path of the bnxt driver, preventing the hardware from sending invalid descriptors due to incorrect segment counts.
Added an invalid mbuf check in the send path of the bnxt driver to prevent hardware resets caused by invalid mbuf, and adjusted the return types of related functions and logging.
Fixed the issue where invalid mbuf was not released during transmission in the bnxt driver; it is now released and the oerrors statistics counter is updated.

Fixed the issue of incorrectly setting the high bits of the action table entry offset in the Tx BD of the bnxt driver, preventing PDCU from aborting the fetch due to incorrect values and causing pipeline stalls.
Explicitly set the TCP and UDP checksum flags for the LSO capability packet, fixing checksum calculation for tunneled and non-tunneled packets on certain older chip variants.
Fixed the export condition for the LRO offload capability in the bnxt driver, exporting this capability to applications only when compressed Rx CQE mode is not enabled.
Optimized the error log messages of the argparse module to make them clearer and more accurate, and adjusted some parameter validation logic.
Fixed a buffer overflow in the zero-copy reception of the memif driver caused by unhandled index wraparound, by allocating double buffer space and copying excess entries on overflow.
Fixed the incorrect session size calculation in the crypto scheduler, which now correctly includes the scheduler's own session context size.
Fixed the issue of passing the wrong offset parameter when mapping the log base address in vhost.
Fixed the crash when updating link status in the secondary process for the e1000 NIC driver, by adding a process type check.
Fixed the issue where the flags of the used ring in the vDPA device was not correctly updated, ensuring flags such as VRING_USED_F_NO_NOTIFY are synchronized.
Fixed a use-after-free issue caused by the release order of the compatibility matcher in the mlx5 driver, ensuring group information is saved before releasing group resources.
Fixed the issue where mlx5 driver did not pass group information when translating the mask of the non-template API flow matcher, avoiding layer recognition anomalies caused by incorrect flag passing.
Fixed a memory access issue caused by the hairpin Rx queue control block being repeatedly removed from the linked list when shared and non-shared Rx queues are configured simultaneously.
Updated the default mask for the NVGRE item in the template API and fixed its validation logic.
Added validity checks for flow action types in CPFL PMD to prevent incorrect use of port_representor and represented_port action.
Fixed I/O handling for a single MRVL layer in the TVM model, set the I/O layout to packed, and corrected the calculation of quantization and dequantization data buffer addresses.
Fixed the queue start and stop logic in the GVE driver so that the corresponding queue operation functions are correctly invoked in DQO format as well.
Fixed the issue in the GVE driver DQO transmit path where the EOP and checksum offload flags of chained mbuf were not correctly set, avoiding transmit stalls caused by missing flags.
Fixed the issue where the used index counter of the packed ring was not reset when virtio-user was reinitialized.
Fixed the reconfiguration failure caused by missing queue configuration pointer initialization logic during vdpa/nfp hardware initialization, and added the correct initialization step.
Fixed a crash caused by dereferencing a null pointer when VF resources were not allocated due to unstable physical links.
Fixed a memory leak caused by invalid data when creating a PDCP session.
Fixed the PDCP SNOW-ZUC watchdog issue by adding a conditional jump instruction in the relevant processing flow to ensure preceding processing completes.
Enhanced RFLC handling for IPsec and PDCP, adjusted Response FLC pointing, enabled data stashing, and fixed the array size definition.
Added parameter validity checks for the rte_eal_alarm_set function in Windows EAL, and fixed test cases so they also run correctly on Windows.
Fixed the issue where the bnxt driver did not correctly obtain DDM information when reading SFF-8436 SFP EEPROM.
Fixed undefined behavior in the net/tap driver where memcpy could be passed a null pointer, by adding a length check before the call.
Fixed incorrect parameter formatting during log type registration in the net/sfc driver.
In the crypto event vector scenario, fixed the logic for releasing the actual mbuf pointer by extracting and releasing the correct mbuf from the crypto operation structure.
Enabled FEC auto-detection support for E830 NICs, adding adapter model determination before the firmware version check.
Fixed the issue where the CPFL parser incorrectly parsed the mask value of the next_proto_id field as a string, changing it to unsigned integer parsing.
Set the PCAP live interface to non-blocking mode to comply with the non-blocking polling requirements of DPDK PMD.
Added the missing legacy mailbox clear function for the ixgbe driver and registered this operation in the mailbox parameter initialization of VF and PF.
Fixed the issue where the return value of ixgbe_read_eeprom was not checked in the ixgbe_stop_mac_link_on_d3_82599 function, adding a return value check.
Fixed the issue where the media type of E610 NICs was incorrectly set to unknown when the link was down, moving the media type update logic to ixgbe_get_media_type_E610.

Fixed the issue where changing advertised speed settings on E610 NICs could not enable all supported speeds when the link was already up, by obtaining all hardware-supported speeds to allow enabling any supported speed.

Fixed ACK handling in ixgbe mailbox, checking whether other threads already hold the lock when acquiring it to avoid deadlock, and waiting for ACK only when the CTS bit is set when sending messages to prevent timeouts.
Fixed incorrect NVM access permissions in E610 devices, ensuring write access type is used instead of read-only access type when writing to EEPROM.
Added the missing MAC type setting for specific X722 device variants.
Fixed the LED blinking issue of X722 with X557 PHY, removing the check for LED active state and always triggering the blink.
Fixed the issue where another reserved track ID was not checked during DDP package loading, now filtering both reserved IDs simultaneously.
Fixed the issue in the i40e driver where repeated dump registers caused data changes, by making the register list read-only to avoid data modification during repeated dump.
Fixed the issue of unchecked return values in the i40e driver, checking the return value of debug register reads when parsing capabilities, and adding type casts.
Fixed the PXE startup issue for NFP NICs by reserving and locking the BAR 2.0 mapping of the extended ROM during initialization.
Fixed a potential error in the NFP driver caused by not checking BSP command support, ensuring support is confirmed before sending commands.
Fixed the blocking issue in the pcap driver receive function by replacing pcap_next with pcap_next_ex.
Fixed the variable type declaration in the link speed conversion function of the NFP driver and added a new check function.
Fixed the link speed update issue for NFP representor ports by adding a function to obtain the correct device index.
Fixed the link status update for NFP representor ports, removing the operation that incorrectly read status from the control BAR and using the stored correct link status value instead.
Fixed the pointer copy issue for AVX-512 Tx released buffers on 32-bit platforms in the i40e driver.
Fixed the AVX-512 pointer copy issue on 32-bit systems in the ice driver.
Fixed the AVX-512 pointer copy issue on 32-bit systems in the iavf driver.
Fixed the bug of AVX-512 pointer copying on 32-bit systems in the idpf driver.
Fixed the error in polynomial reversal during hash LFSR initialization, implementing the correct reversal function.
Fixed the out-of-bounds access at the end of the tbl24 table caused by gather instructions in AVX512 lookup, adding an extra 4 bytes of space when allocating memory.
Fixed the VF reset timing issue in the iavf device close function, delaying execution and reusing the common reset function.
Fixed the issue where the otx_ep_dev_mtu_set function had an uninitialized variable compilation warning due to a GCC optimization bug, adding memset initialization for the devinfo structure.
Fix the cryptodev dequeue count issue by limiting the number of dequeued packets to MAX_PKT_BURST to prevent stack corruption.
Fix the segment fault in the eventdev pipeline example caused by mbuf txq being pre-written.
Fix the issue in the mlx5 driver where ipool allocation failure did not set rte_errno.
Add logging output of syndrome and more information on CQE errors in the mlx5 driver, and correct the error CQE structure type.
Fix the calculation error of the register dump counter in the hns3 driver to keep it consistent with the number of queue interrupt registers.
Fix the uint16_t descriptor count overflow issue in the eth_dev_adjust_nb_desc function by promoting intermediate calculations to uint32_t to avoid value wraparound caused by alignment macros.

Fix the issue of losing the MAC address of the iavf port under the i40e PF driver by setting the VIRTCHNL_VF_OFFLOAD_USO flag and removing the operation of deleting all MAC addresses when the device is stopped.
Fix the next pointer and rearm data update logic of mbuf in Rx inject packets of the cnxk driver to avoid incorrectly clearing the next pointer when injecting packets.
Fix the issue where the MAC address could not be set or added when there is an active VF on the PF, and now allow modifying the MAC address when there is an active VF.
