Add a device removal event callback during driver probing, move global register configuration to dev_configure, and add validation for invalid values read from hardware registers.
Fix the incorrect parenthesis position in the fman status statistics calculation in the dpaa bus, correcting (a | b) << 32 to a | (b << 32).
Fix the segment fault during device close and destruction in DPAA driver in FMCLESS mode, improve port cleanup logic to ensure correct release of queue resources and avoid accessing freed memory.
Optimize errata A010022 handling for the LS1043A platform, add a mbuf reallocation function to resolve FMAN stalls caused by data offset misalignment.
Fix the issue in the dpaa driver where the reallocate_mbuf function copies data from the wrong source location.
Always attempt to refill Rx buffers in memory-constrained scenarios to avoid driver lockup due to not receiving data packets.
Fix the memory leak of mbuf allocated in the DQ Rx queue, ensuring that a buffer is no longer leaked on each queue stop/start.
Fix the IRQ reconfiguration issue by unregistering the SSO device and NPA's IRQ before resizing IRQ to clean up stale IRQ handles.
Fix the crash in dumpcap when processing jumbo frames in legacy pcap mode due to rte_pktmbuf_read() returning NULL.
Fix the boundary condition error in the RX refill logic of the GVE driver to avoid memory corruption due to invalid tail pointer, and simplify the refill flow.
Add read memory barriers to the TX and RX completion handling of the GVE driver to ensure that NIC has completed ownership transfer before reading descriptor data, avoiding stale data reads.
Fix the memory leak in app/procinfo when exiting in specific modes due to not calling rte_eal_cleanup().
Check the return values of rte_eth_dev_info_get and other API in the ethdev_show function, and return directly on error to avoid using undefined data.
Fix the issue of using freed memory for tracing after memzone release, moving the trace call before the release operation.
Fix the mismatch of memory release functions in the BCMFS crypto driver device structure, changing the incorrect free() to rte_free().
Fix the mismatch of memory release functions during device probing in the dma/idxd driver, replacing free with rte_free.
Fix the free function mismatch caused by dereferencing a null pointer during error cleanup in event/cnxk port configuration.
Fix the mismatch of memory release functions in the vhost example, replacing the incorrectly used free() with rte_free() to avoid memory pool corruption.
Fixed the release order issue when creating mempool in the cnxk NIC driver to prevent use-after-free caused by accessing its configuration after releasing mempool.
Fix the mismatch of release functions when cBPF to eBPF conversion fails, replacing free() with rte_free().
Fix the use-after-free issue when clearing filters in the e1000 driver, moving the release operation after all filter member accesses.
Fix the use-after-free issue caused by accessing debug logs after object release in the net/sfc driver, moving the debug log before the release operation.
Fix the invalid free call caused by incorrectly freeing non-heap allocated memory in the JSON parser of the cpfl driver.
Fix the double free issue during flow destruction in the net/nfp driver, avoiding heap corruption due to repeated rte_free calls.
Fix the use-after-free issue in raw/ifpga/base when traversing the sensor linked list and accessing after freeing a node, switching to a safe traversal macro.
Fix the potential use-after-free issue in QAT device probing caused by checking the return value of rte_memzone_free.
Fix the mismatch of memory allocation and release for interrupt configuration in the ifpga driver, using rte_calloc and rte_free instead of calloc and free.
Fix the use-after-free issue in the baseband/la12xx driver by setting the pointer to NULL after freeing it to avoid double free.
Fix the use after free issue in mailbox initialization caused by incorrect macro definitions.

Fix the return value check errors in functions such as link status setting, port up/down, pause frame setting, and FEC mode setting in the NFP driver, ensuring correct judgment of the three-way return values.

Fix the issue of accessing freed memory in the ACC baseband driver, remove the soft output bypass rate matching feature, and automatically reset the data_len of the HARQ output buffer to avoid errors when the application does not explicitly reset it.
Update the FPGA version, fix code style issues, and resolve multiple issues found by Coverity including null pointer dereference, resource leaks, and array out-of-bounds.
Fix the initialization check of the CPPC driver in the power management library to correctly identify and initialize CPPC mode.
Fix the use after free issue when releasing queues in the net/nfb driver, moving the rte_free call after the nulling operation.

Limit the number of queues allowed in TAP device multi-process messages to not exceed the maximum number of queues supported by the device, fixing the queue count overrun issue that may occur due to the increase in the maximum file descriptor count of MP.
Fixed the memory leak issue in NFP VF initialization, corrected the memory allocation method and error handling path.
Added queue ID validation in debug mode in the rte_eth_tx_done_cleanup function.
Fixed the issue where PF speed was not notified in flower firmware causing VF speed to be unavailable, added logic to notify firmware of PF speed.
Fixed the issue where the NFP IPsec driver no longer sets the IPv6 flag in transmit mode.
Added workarounds for hardware errata ERR050757 and ERR050265 for the DPAA QDMA driver, preventing QDMA hangs or stalls by setting stride mode and prefetch reads.
When sending packets, force VLAN offload for 802.1Q packets, strip VLAN tags and pass VLAN information via the VSP protocol.
Fixed the issue in the hns3 driver where tunnel flow rules supported multiple tunnel headers, now returns an error when multiple tunnel headers are passed.
Under multiple PF firmware, ignore useless PF representative port control messages to avoid incorrect handling.
Fixed the latency issue in link status query for ixgbe NICs on FreeBSD, removed the forced wait logic so that no-wait requests return immediately.
Fixed the integer overflow issue caused by the register offset variable type in the hns3 driver, avoiding data truncation.
Fixed the issue in the hns3 driver where register values were incorrect due to a data pointer offset error when fetching multiple module register values at once.
Fixed the error caused by repeated stopping of flow director queues in the ice driver, checks if already stopped when stopping queues to avoid failure on second stop.
Added an additional upper limit constraint on the number of queues for the ice driver by querying scheduling tree node limits, avoiding exceeding hardware scheduling capabilities.
Update getwork write data during device reconfiguration to avoid using stale configuration.
Fixed the memory leak of meter profile table when meter is not enabled, only allocate the table when meter is enabled.

Fixed the DPNI link status retrieval method, switched to using dpni_get_link_cfg API to obtain static configuration data, resolving the issue where link status displayed as DOWN after SFP module connection due to flow control configuration.
Release the VFIO group file descriptor when adding a VFIO group fails, avoiding resource leaks.
Fixed the Coverity warning in the QBMAN debug function, introduced a temporary variable to check return values to avoid null pointer dereference, and added type casts to prevent integer overflow.
Fixed the conflict between miss flow ID macro names and enums, set the default miss flow ID to 0.
Fixed the memory corruption issue in the traffic management module of the net/dpaa2 driver, changed the queue configuration array size from a fixed value to the actual number of queues.
Fixed the double-free issue of flow aging resources in the NPC teardown process.
Fixed the data corruption issue in eswitch caused by incorrect handling of segment data in multi-segment VxLAN packet processing.
Fixed the issue where the reconnection log mapping was not correctly unmapped in the error path during VDUSE device creation.

Fixed the TOCTOU vulnerability during VDUSE device creation, changed the file existence check to directly open the device file, and adjusted the parameters and error handling path of the reconnection log check function.
Fixed the file descriptor leak caused by startup failure during VDUSE device reconnection, and refactored the reconnection startup logic into a standalone function.
Fixed the missing error handling in the VDUSE reconnection log version check, and extracted the related check logic into a standalone function to simplify device creation code.
Fixed the issue where packets not matching rules in a template table inserted by index with pattern matching incorrectly went to a lower-priority table, now they go to the default miss path.
Fixed the byte order handling issue of 3DES-CTR on big-endian CPU, removed unconditional byte swapping and switched to explicit big-endian conversion, and deleted the unused ctr_inc helper function.
Fixed the crash in the vmxnet3 driver when calling the close function after configuration failure due to incorrect initialization of the adapter_stopped state.
Fixed the validation of raw encap actions in the mlx5 driver, separated the validation logic for SWS and HWS, checking different parameters respectively.
Added a check on the return value of rte_pcapng_add_interface in the dumpcap application, exiting with an error message on failure.
Fixed the issue where item mask was not initialized when translating GRE flow item in root table.
Fixed range definer error recovery: when an invalid matcher range definition is detected, correctly set rte_errno to EINVAL, ensuring calling functions can learn about the error state.
Fixed the issue of using an integer return value during counter initialization, switched to using the rte_flow_error structure to provide more detailed error information.
Fixed the non-template flow action validation logic, only perform action template validation in template mode.
Fixed SWS meter object state initialization, ensuring ASO object availability is correctly tracked.
Fixed the mapping error from Traffic Class fields to Type of Service fields in NAT64 IPv6 to IPv4 translation, ensuring QoS information is correctly preserved.
Fixed the issue of passing incorrect parameters when calling indirect list flow action callbacks, ensuring a single flow action is passed instead of an action list.
Fixed the CQE index error when obtaining the shared Rx queue port number in the mlx5 vectorized Rx routine.
Allow automatically stopping and restarting the port when it is already started to apply TM topology, instead of directly returning an error.
Fixed the issue where the MLX5 counter query loop could get stuck, removed the internal loop in __mlx5_hws_cnt_svc(), and added debug logs and documentation.
Corrected the alignment of the virtual queue structure in the ntnic driver, changed __rte_aligned(8) to __rte_packed.
Fixed the issue where the result length of modular exponentiation and modular inverse operations was not set in QAT asymmetric encryption PMD.

Fixed the receive data length calculation error when hardware timestamping is enabled in the igc driver: subtract the timestamp header length in non-scattered mode, and adjust the data offset of subsequent mbuf in scattered mode, avoiding abnormal packet lengths and data loss between segments.
Fixed the issue where the port index was not correctly assigned in the NFP network driver.
Fix the issue in the txgbe driver where SWFW mbox could not write registers when compiled with a high version of GCC, resolved by adding a register refresh operation.
Fix the issue in the txgbe driver where the outer UDP checksum offload capability was incorrectly declared, removing the offload flag that this hardware does not support.

Fix the issue in the txgbe driver where the driver loaded bit was lost after a hardware reset, re-setting the bit after reset to notify the firmware that the driver is loaded, and clearing it when the device is closed.

Enable the Tx descriptor error interrupt in the txgbe driver, handling non-fatal and fatal errors; also fix the issue where the packet layer length does not match the packet type, preventing excessive hardware checking.

Add a length check for Tx packets in the txgbe driver, setting invalid packet lengths to a default value in the simple Tx path and directly dropping invalid packets in the feature Tx path to avoid TDM fatal errors.

Add a length check for transmitted packets in the ngbe NIC driver, setting illegal packet lengths to a default value in the simple transmit path and directly dropping illegal packets with an increased error count in the full transmit path.
Fix the driver loaded bit in the ngbe driver, reconfiguring it after a hardware LAN reset to notify the firmware that the driver is loaded, and clearing the bit when the device is closed.
Fix the issue in the ngbe driver where packets may not be received after a link state change, by reconfiguring the MAC Rx related registers.

Fix the issue in the ngbe driver where a shared interrupt in legacy or MSI mode prevents the interrupt from being re-enabled, by reading the shared interrupt status and ensuring the interrupt is re-enabled.
Fix the issue where the ngbe NIC could not configure VLAN stripping offload after device startup; this configuration is now only performed when the device is stopped.

Fix the statistics array out-of-bounds issue in the vmxnet3 driver caused by the increased queue count in virtual hardware version 6, by enlarging the statistics array and limiting the access range of per-queue counters.

Fix the issue in the vmxnet3 driver where device information did not correctly reflect that virtual hardware version 6 supports a larger MTU, now dynamically setting the maximum MTU based on the hardware version.
Fix the use of the wrong template macro in the CN9K dual work slot function.
Fix the issue where the driver incorrectly searched for DDP packages in the root directory when the DDP search path was empty, now correctly checking that the path value length is greater than zero.

Add reference count management for the shared Rx queue control structure to avoid use-after-free issues, and migrate the management of the queue control structure from device private data to the shared context.
Fix the issue in ICE PMD where reading the PHY timestamp without checking the ready bit caused incorrect Tx timestamps, now reading the timestamp only after the ready bit is set.
Fix the issue in the QAT driver where the key was not correctly set during ECDSA session initialization, adding key memory allocation and error returns in session_set_ec.
Fix the interrupt mode of the E610 device, adding support for E610 devices in the queue interrupt mapping.

Fix the array out-of-bounds read issue in ACL mode caused by send_packets_multi() being unable to handle invalid port numbers, checking that all destination ports are valid before calling, otherwise falling back to send_packets_single().
Fix the issue in the baseband/acc driver where the end address calculation for ring memory allocation was offset by 1, ensuring alignment with 64MB.

Fix the issue in WC TCAM multi slice deletion caused by the read-only HWRM request buffer, forcing the use of the DMA channel to send setup messages; also add error logging for tunnel port API allocation.
Fix the data corruption issue in the TCAM manager caused by not resetting the maximum entry counter when a session is closed, clearing the counter during session initialization.
Fix the Thor TF EM key size check, correcting the EM insertion record size from 80 bytes to 96 bytes to support key insertion larger than 601 bits.
Fix the issue where incorrect entries were written during HA entry movement due to incorrect slice number calculation, ensuring correct slice number by copying entry_size before moving.
Support action read and clear, implementing flow query count read and reset in ULP, and fix the bnxt_mpc_xmit() message padding to a multiple of 16 bytes.
Update the template file to enable recipe ID generation, and fix a segmentation fault in wildcard recipe handling.
Fix the segmentation fault for wildcard recipe in the bnxt driver, add recipe ID generation support, port the default_non_ha resource code, and adjust the debug log level.
Fix the lock scope issue for parent-child flow counters in the bnxt driver, add reference count maintenance, and correct the hash table name conflict.
Update the Thor and Thor2 template databases, change the VF representor mode to dynamic, and fix the L2 TCAM record priority issue for Thor2.
Fix the issue where the hardware flow table in the hns3 driver could not be fully utilized, by enabling the rte_hash extensible bucket table feature.
Fix the issue in CPFL PMD of forwarding traffic to physical ports, removing the incorrect check for the represented_port action.
Add a check in the transmit preparation function of the IAVF driver for the data length of single-buffer packets, ensuring it matches the packet length.
Fix the logic error in the bnx2x driver where the single interrupt mode enable condition was always true.
Fix a possible infinite loop during startup of the bnx2x driver, by correctly initializing the loop condition variable based on the chip type.
Fix the memory access error in the mlx5 driver caused by unaligned structures, adding alignment and packing attributes.
Fix the fallthrough issue of the switch statement in the base code of the e1000 NIC driver, avoiding potential logic errors.
Add a null pointer check in the Tx scheduler node setup, avoiding null pointer dereference issues caused by invalid node ID.
Fix the out-of-bounds write issue in the eventdev Rx adapter caused by array index underflow when the interrupt count is zero.
Fix the issue in the dpaa bus where the FQ lock was not released during error handling, avoiding abnormal resource locking.
Fix the issue of excessive interrupts caused by the GPIO tx_fault interrupt not being cleared.
Fix the shift bucket selection logic when adding hash table members, correcting the issue where the primary bucket was always used due to misuse of the logical AND operator.

Fix the issue in the i40e driver where i40e_get_outer_vlan() did not check the register read return value, changing its return type to int and returning VLAN TPID via an output parameter, updating call sites to add error handling; also fix the parameter passing method for IPv6 address comparison and copy.
Fix the deadlock issue in the vhost Rx asynchronous path caused by incorrectly using a read lock to release a write lock.
Fix the issue in testpmd where the flow update command did not correctly update the age action context, now the flow aged destroy command can execute normally.
Fix the issue in the cleanup flow where the first flow was incorrectly deleted when asynchronous flow creation failed, and ensure that the freed flow ID is not accessed after the flow is destroyed.
Fixed the issue in the bnxt driver where the offload flags of mbuf were not reset, changing it to direct assignment to avoid application anomalies caused by residual flag bits.

Fix the issue of cumulative counting of parent-child flow counters on the Thor2 F1F2 VXLAN platform, and add device status checks in the TF tunnel release API to skip resource release for completed devices.
Fix the issue where the VFR cleanup did not delete the representative flow, and fix the deadlock in the statistics counter thread.
Fix the issue in the pcapng module where using a uint8_t buffer could cause unaligned access, and change the buffer declaration to the uint32_t type.
Fix the issue where modifying the IPv4 and IPv6 DSCP fields did not correctly copy values to the flow handler.

Fix the PTP initialization issue for the E610 device in the ixgbe driver, and add the missing E610 branch handling in the functions that read system time, receive/transmit timestamps, and start time counters.
Fix the issue of abnormal RSS hash values caused by byte order reversal when programming the Toeplitz key in FPGA, and correct the byte order handling of the mask.
Fix the issue in the ixgbe driver where timestamps are initialized to system time instead of zero when PTP is enabled, and fix the issue of calling mailbox read operations during MinGW compilation.
Fix the RSS redirection table configuration for the E610 device in the ixgbe driver, adding the correct table size and register addresses.
Fix the issue that the E610 device in the ixgbe driver does not support loopback mode, and add a check for E610 in the loopback support check.

Revert the commit that removed the frequency adjustment function (PI servo controller) from the example program ptpclient because it contained GPL licensed code; after the revert, clock synchronization accuracy drops to microsecond level.
Add the PCI ID for the E610 virtual function in the ixgbe driver, fixing the omission of previously only adding the physical function ID.

In drivers/net/mlx5/mlx5_flow_hw.c, remove the error checks for non-zero return values of hlist unregister when releasing encap, decap, modify header, and matcher resources, to avoid false positive logs during non-template flow destruction.
In drivers/common/cnxk/roc_nix_inl.c, read the CPT_LF_CTX_ERR CSR to ensure the FLUSH write operation is complete, and determine whether flush is complete.
In drivers/common/cnxk/roc_ie_ot.c, correct the CPT HW word size initialized by the outbound SA to two words.
In drivers/event/cnxk/cn10k_eventdev.c, update the event device configuration for SKUs that do not support reassembly, and add the NIX_RX_REAS_F flag to handle out-of-place (OOP) processing.

In drivers/net/dpaa/dpaa_ethdev.c, fix the type conversion issue of ch_id: avoid directly converting ch_id to u32 and passing it to API, instead create a new u32 variable, and after the API update, convert it back to u16.
In drivers/net/ntnic/ntnic_ethdev.c, remove the redundant rte_eth_dev_release_port call from the eth_dev_close function.

In drivers/net/mlx5, unify the timestamps of Tx tracing (trace) to use the NIC HW clock instead of the mixed TSC clock, add the NIC HW clock parameter for trace_tx_entry, trace_tx_exit, and trace_tx_wqe, and update the mlx5_trace.py analysis script.

In drivers/net/ice/base/ice_switch.c, fix the issue where multiple iterations of clearing the vsi_map bitmap during VLAN replay cause all VLANs except the last VLAN to fail to pass traffic, and cancel the bit clearing operation on the old bitmap during the replay process.
In ice_sched_add_node, set the VSI index field from the parent node for each newly created scheduling node, and verify the correctness of the VSI information when searching for qgroup nodes.

When there is no TC node in the scheduling tree, allow the root node to be used as a virtual TC0 node to support initialization without TC-class scheduling nodes after DCB is disabled through the DDP image.
Force the default 6-bit LLR saturation value for the LDPC decoder input of the VRB decoder.
Remove the incorrectly added return statement after the goto statement in otx_ep_ethdev.c, and fix the initialization failure handling flow.

Create a corresponding Rx queue for each Tx queue to allocate event buffers for handling Tx completion messages, preventing out-of-bounds access to the rx_queues[] array when the Tx queue index is greater than the number of Rx queues.
Change `&&` to `&` in the error log of the hns3 register module, correcting the log accuracy when the register number does not match the list held by the driver.
Change the log format specifier for the time_left variable in i40e_nvm.c from PRIu64 to PRIu32 to match its 32-bit type.
In the FIPS validation example, add pre-hash input processing for RSA asymmetric encryption.
Extract the empty element parsing test into a separate test case, and fix the issue of not releasing kvlist in the failure branch.
When the same counter ID is repeatedly used to create a counter, change the returned error code from ENOSPC to EINVAL.
Fix the spinlock handling in the l2fwd-event example, fixing the synchronization issue where resources may remain blocked.

When configuring DCB in testpmd, use the RSS configuration from the software instead of reading from hardware registers, to avoid losing the RSS configuration due to hardware reset when the port is stopped.
Fix the comparison order in cmdline_flow.c to avoid potential out-of-bounds array references.
Add validation of the reset-type obtained from firmware in hns3_intr.c.

Add flow scale query functionality for bnxt TF, tracking resource usage of WC TCAM, EM, Action, etc., support enabling via the -DTF_FLOW_SCALE_QUERY compilation flag, and optimize bidirectional resource updates, status updates only for regular flows, and adding buffer dirty state to avoid unnecessary firmware synchronization.
Remove the deprecation notice for the cryptodev callback function prototype update, as an alternative API has been provided.
In i40e_adminq.c, verify that the next_to_clean variable value does not exceed the 10-bit maximum value 2^10, and refactor the loop to read the head value only once and validate the head validity.
Fix the potential out-of-bounds write to the ifnames array in the mvneta_ifnames_get() function when multiple sets of iface parameters are passed.
Change the last parameter of ssovf_parsekv() to be accessed by char, and use strtol instead of atoi to prevent integer overflow.
In the verbose output of testpmd, add L4 port number printing for all packets to make packet metadata more uniform.
Remove the extra newline characters triggered by the RTE_LOG_LINE check in the net/mvpp2 and ml/cnxk drivers, fixing build errors.

Fix the build issues of the cnxk driver on Ubuntu 24.04: correct the write exceeding the target space size in roc_irq.c, and fix the value wraparound caused by implicit conversion from unsigned to signed integer in cnxk_ethdev_devargs.c.
app/testpmd prints the parameters of each command after executing the commands for adding TM nodes and shaper.
net/ice/base fixes the log format specifiers for unsigned integers and changes the bitmask values to hexadecimal output.
net/i40e/base removes the setting of hw->flags by X722 in the initialization function.
net/i40e/base added dump definitions for some PHY registers to assist in debugging link issues on site.
app/testpmd removed residual code for the debug "flow flex init" command.
common/cnxk removed the restriction on clearing RPM statistics on the cn10k platform.
Added memory pool debug support for the dpaa driver, adding memory pool cookie checks in the receive and transmit paths.
net/memif added error checking for the return value of rte_eth_dev_info_get.
examples/ethtool added error handling for the return value of rte_eth_dev_get_reg_info.
examples/ntb, examples/qos_sched, and examples/pipeline added error checking for the return values of rte_eth_dev_info_get and rte_eth_link_get, respectively.

net/ntnic extended and fixed logging functionality, including adding suffix logs, fixing configuration log levels for specific modules, changing the initialization log level for functional operations from INFO to DEBUG, and replacing the NIM module log name with NTNIC.
net/bnx2x removed an impossible dead condition check and fixed the issue of duplicate code in conditional branches.
Replaced the IPv6 address representation from a uint8_t[16] array with a rte_ipv6_addr structure, and synchronously updated the related API. (architecture-related: public API)
Merged three independent devarg in the ena driver into a unified llq_policy devarg. (architecture-related: public API)
Replaced legacy zero-length arrays in the event device driver and library with flexible array members. (architecture-related: ABI compatibility)
Removed experimental markers from multiple inline functions in the bbdev library. (architecture-related: public API)
Changed the timeout parameter type of the i40e_aq_request_resource function from 64 bits to 32 bits. (architecture-related: public API)
Refactored firmware version management logic, migrating version information from the NIC hardware structure to the PF device structure. (architecture-related: core module responsibilities)
Rearranged structure fields to eliminate memory holes. (architecture-related: ABI compatibility)
Changed the behavior when CTX flush fails from calling abort() to returning an error code. (architecture-related: error handling behavior)
Added the __rte_warn_unused_result attribute to multiple query functions in the ethdev API. (architecture-related: public API)
Updated the RSA transform structure, changing the private exponent and quintuple from a union to a structure. (architecture-related: public API)
Moved the RSA padding information from the crypto operation to the xform structure. (architecture-related: public API)
Marked the node parameter pointer in the rte_tm_node_add function and its driver implementations as const. (architecture-related: public API)
Declared the parameters of the TM profile addition-related functions as const. (architecture-related: public API)
Marked the parameters of the TM shaper profile configuration addition function as const. (architecture-related: public API)
Refactored the kvargs handling API, adding the rte_kvargs_process_opt function to support both key=value and key-only key parameter formats. (architecture-related: public API)
Refactored FMC scheme and CC parsing for the DPAA shared MAC scenario, supporting allocation of RX queues from VSP scheme and CC rules. (architecture-related: public API)

Refactored queue memory management for VRB devices, handling allocation and release of queue configuration, DMA rings, tail pointers, and software rings separately based on device variants. (architecture-related: public API)
Removed unused enum end markers RTE_CRYPTO_ASYM_XFORM_TYPE_LIST_END and RTE_CRYPTO_RSA_PADDING_TYPE_LIST_END from the cryptodev library. (architecture-related: public API)

Cleaned up parameter validation logic in the DMA device API, ensuring the device pointer is used after validating the dev_id parameter, and added legality checks for parameters such as priority. (architecture-related: public API)
Optimized alignment of Ethernet headers and VLAN headers, removed unnecessary alignment and packing attributes, and added compile-time assertions. (architecture-related: public API)

Refactored the DPAA2 QDMA driver, introducing routing configuration based on PCIe port parameters, and added helper functions for multi-queue enqueue and FD operations. (architecture-related: public API)

Refactored the DPAA2 qDMA driver to support multiple hardware queues, single-copy and SG copy, and silent mode, and introduced new internal functions to manage FLE/SDD/SG entries. (architecture-related: public API)
Refactored the DPAA DMA driver, updating hardware descriptors and queue structures, and using rte_ring API to implement enqueue and dequeue operations. (architecture-related: public API)
Removed the internal symbol rte_vdpa_relay_vring_used from the vDPA public header file. (architecture-related: public API)
Removed single-event enqueue and dequeue interfaces, retaining only bulk enqueue and dequeue functionality. (architecture-related: public API)
Renamed structures and enums related to HWS control flow rules, removing the hw prefix, to enable reuse in Verbs and DV flow engines. (architecture-related: public API)
Marked the dpcon_close API as an internal symbol, restricting its external visibility. (architecture-related: public API)
Extracted log level parsing logic from various platform EAL implementations into a common option parsing module for unified handling. (architecture-related: public API)
Optimized the log output format of rte_exit(), using a unified prefix and changing to a single line to avoid confusion with timestamp and color options. (architecture-related: public API)
Renamed the TAP device internal structure struct nlmsg to struct tap_nlmsg to avoid confusion with nlmsghdr in the netlink header file. (architecture-related: public API)
Renamed the core power library source file from rte_power.* to rte_power_cpufreq.*, and updated all related header file references. (architecture-related: public API)
Renamed the IPv4 lookup configuration flag RTE_FIB_F_NETWORK_ORDER to RTE_FIB_F_LOOKUP_NETWORK_ORDER to clarify that it is only used for lookup operations. (architecture-related: public API)
Removed single-event enqueue and dequeue interfaces from multiple event drivers, retaining only bulk operations. (architecture-related: public API)
In drivers, multiple drivers replaced __builtin_ bit operations, prefetch, and branch prediction builtins with the corresponding macros/API provided by DPDK EAL.
net/ice/base changed the ice_alloc_lan_q_ctx function from static to non-static so that driver code can call it.
Registered an independent dynamic log type for the DSW event driver. (architecture-related: dynamic log type)
event/cnxk replaced the __atomic_xxx atomic operations built into gcc with the rte_atomic_xxx API.
Removed the interrupt capability of the VRB1 device and updated the related capability flags.
Removed the check logic based on the firmware API version in the ixgbe driver.
Changed the definitions of four PF power management registers in the i40e NIC driver to be indexed by PF offset.
Read the scheduler layer information directly from the VSI node and added a VSI handle matching check to support runtime layer changes.
Refactored DQ storage management, removed the independent single storage structure per queue, changed to multi-core shared storage allocation, and fixed a memory leak during multi-storage allocation.
When supporting multiple PF firmware, no longer create PF representor ports, and correspondingly adjust the calculation logic for the number of representor ports.

For the FSL MC bus, directly obtain the VFIO group FD through the file system to avoid conflicts with PCIe VFIO, and refactored the VFIO setting logic, adding DMA mapping and extended check functionality.

Changed the protocol identification method from being based on the previous protocol type to being based on frame attribute flags (FAF), added a FAF parser, and refactored the related extraction and configuration functions.
When EAL initialization fails, it no longer outputs to both stderr and the log, but only records via the log, and raised the log level from ERR to ALERT.
Extracted a helper function for determining physical representor ports and refactored the related initialization logic.
net/bnxt removed the VNIC asynchronous event handler.
ml/cnxk renamed the cnxk error codes to cn10k error codes and added support for model-specific op_error_get routines.
crypto/dpaa2_sec refactored the debug logging, moved duplicate code to a common function, removed unnecessary newlines, and outputs debug information according to different modes.
event/dsw changed the bitset representing the association between event ports and event queues from a single-word bitset to using rte_bitset.h to support more than 64 ports.
In drivers, the log wrapper header file of the Intel base driver removed the _RAW macro and changed to directly calling RTE_LOG().
In drivers, the SFC driver reused the default logtype provided by the build framework, replacing the fixed string value.
In the ice driver's ice_ddp.c, for E825C devices, the Get Tx Topology AQ command clears the RD bit of the Tx scheduler, making it consistent with E830 behavior rather than E810.

Refactored the flow item calculation functions in the nfp driver's nfp_flower_flow.c, unified the parameters of the item check and calculation functions, and made the Ethernet item calculation functions more readable.
In the i40e driver's i40e_type.h, added i40e_16b_rx_wb_qw0 and raw structures for i40e_16byte_rx_desc to support access both as 16-byte descriptors and as raw data.

In the nfp driver's nfp_net_common.c, renamed the PF speed update function nfp_net_speed_aneg_update() to nfp_net_pf_speed_update(), added a helper function to update the VF link speed, and added a helper function to check the link speed.
In the nfp driver's nfp_ethdev.c and nfp_net_common.c, standardized the use of the 'idx' port index in some functions so that it can apply to both flower and coreNIC firmware.
Moved the BP_LOG() wrapper, which is only used by the base driver in the txgbe driver, from txgbe_logs.h to txgbe_osdep.h.
Simplified the implementations of rte_rcu_qsbr_thread_register() and rte_rcu_thread_unregister() in lib/rcu/rte_rcu_qsbr.c.
In the acc baseband driver's rte_vrb_pmd.c, configured max_queues based on the number of queue groups and the number of AQS for each device variant.

In the acc baseband driver's rte_acc100_pmd.c and rte_vrb_pmd.c, refactored the resource release logic, explicitly setting pointers to NULL after free to avoid double release, and made code appearance adjustments.
Refactored the configuration recovery logic, extracting promiscuous mode and multicast recovery into independent functions.
In the nfp driver's nfp_flower_representor.c, extracted helper functions for allocating PHY representor ports, PF representor ports, and VF representor ports, respectively.
In the nfp driver's nfp_ethdev.c, nfp_net_common.c, and nfp_net_common.h, refactored the initialization logic to simplify some function parameters, applicable to both primary and secondary processes.

In the nfp driver's nfp_ethdev.c, nfp_net_common.c, and nfp_net_common.h, by adding helper functions and renaming functions, made the secondary process logic consistent with the primary process and improved readability.
In lib/hash/rte_cuckoo_hash.c's rte_hash_create(), separated the checks for name, number of entries, and key_len parameters, and made the error messages more detailed to aid debugging.
In the fslmc bus driver's qbman_portal.c, ignored the reserved bits in the BMan get response count.
In the fslmc bus driver's qbman_portal.c, renamed the qbman_eq_desc variable to avoid defining a variable with the same name twice.
In the dpaa2 network driver's dpaa2_rxtx.c and related header files, stored the drop priority from fd into mbuf.

In the cnxk common driver's roc_dev.c, roc_eswitch.h, and roc_mbox.h, added a generic mbox that can handle multiple representor events through the same mbox ID, supporting different event types such as representee state changes and MTU changes.
In the tap network driver's rte_eth_tap.c, used rte_ether_addr_copy() instead of rte_memcpy to copy Ethernet MAC addresses.

In the tap network driver's tap_flow.c, the function that converts the internal representation to netlink no longer uses a void pointer parameter, but instead uses a concrete structure shared by both the caller and the callee.
In multiple files of the ntnic network driver, migrated the pthread spinlocks to DPDK's rte_spinlock.
Changed the recipe table of bnxt/tf_ulp from static allocation to dynamic memory allocation.
Enabled the clang thread safety check annotate_locks for the FQ lock of the dpaa bus, so that FQLOCK/FQUNLOCK is recognized as a lock function.
Removed the redundant conditional check on flow end action after the policy action loop in testpmd.
Use RTE_LOG_LINE in the log macros of multiple drivers to replace the original log macros that append a newline character.
In multiple drivers, split multi-line log messages into single lines, in preparation for the RTE_LOG_LINE conversion.
In the cxgbe driver, replace direct use of __attribute__((__may_alias__)) with the __rte_may_alias macro.
Remove the dead code check for obj->callback == NULL in argparse.
Remove some unnecessary log messages when buffer allocation fails in the bnxt driver.
Remove redundant type casts of the result of the rte_pktmbuf_mtod_offset macro in fpga_5gnr_fec.
In the mlx5 common driver, reduce the type of multiple log_max_* fields from larger types to uint8_t.
Remove broken debug macros in the dpaa network driver that never worked properly.
In multiple drivers, replace log helper macros, moving newline handling from the caller into the macro, in preparation for the RTE_LOG_LINE conversion.
In the power library, enable the cast qualifier warning and remove the const qualifier by first casting to uintptr_t.
Explicitly set multiple baseband PMD queue initialization variables to zero for code consistency.
Remove unnecessary type casts in the built-in cmdline command list of testpmd.
In the ice base driver's PTP initialization, add a Bit macro for the PHY 1 of the E825C device.
Remove unused variables and register macro definitions in the i40e_validate_filter_settings function and related header files in the i40e base driver.
In app/graph, replace strtok with the thread-safe reentrant version strtok_r.
Remove unnecessary compile-time condition macros for IEEE 1588 in the bnxt driver.
In the cryptodev asymmetric encryption header file rte_crypto_asym.h, move the sm2-op structure to the location of other algorithm op structures to reorder structures by logical grouping.
In the nfp flower service code, rename flower service flag to improve logical readability.
In the ULP utility function of bnxt tf_ulp, modify the return value to use the EXIT_SUCCESS and EXIT_FAILURE macros to comply with the C coding standard.
In the crypto/openssl, net/ntnic, and bus/fslmc drivers, remove unnecessary NULL pointer checks before free calls.
Add log macros for debugging purposes in the r8169 NIC driver.

Add a random seed setting feature to the DTS test framework, supporting specification of the pseudo-random generation seed via command-line arguments or configuration files to ensure reproducible test results.
Remove the use of the word master in the test_red.c test.
Remove duplicate definitions of TRUE/FALSE and unused macros in the cryptodev test.
Refactor test cases in the argparse test, including adding comments, fixing argv[0] settings, adjusting val_set to NULL, and enabling index validation.
In the dma-perf benchmark test, fix the prompt message when NUMA configuration is incorrect, change wording to incorrect, and use the PRINT_ERR macro instead of printf.
Add the cksum performance test to the perf test suite to resolve the warning that this test is not defined in any suite.
Fix the issue where the event scheduling type is not correctly assigned in the test.
Refactor the alarm test to add positive tests, adjust intervals to avoid timeout expiration, use standard TEST macros, and restore running the test on FreeBSD.
Remove the unused resource API and related files from the test framework; this API has not been built since the meson conversion.
Restore the cfgfile test, change embedded resources to use include files and temporary files, and adjust meson.build to handle auto-generated files.
In the event DMA adapter test, fix the target event queue to TEST_APP_EV_QUEUE_ID when supporting internal ports in OP_FWD mode.
Add an error recovery callback for cryptodev and add new unit tests.
Add assertions in the cryptodev test to verify the maximum length set.
Enable larger packet sizes in the cryptodev TLS test, and add a wrapper function for create_segmented_mbuf to support allocation from two memory pools.
In the cryptodev test's teardown, release the memory pool allocated by testsuite_setup.
In the eventdev performance test, change the DMA operation to use mempool to avoid the operation being reused before completion, thereby supporting measurement of forwarding latency.
Add a retry mechanism in the IPsec statistics validation test.

In the mempool performance test, increase the maximum test burst size from 32 to 256, increase the maximum number of held objects from 512 to 32768, reduce the single iteration time from 5 seconds to 1 second, and improve rate calculation precision.
Reintroduce a short delay in the service core test, eliminate unreachable code, and restore the previous service core test behavior.
test/security skips calling test_ipsec_post_process for negative inline IPsec tests because received packets may be invalid in negative scenarios.
test/bonding removes a duplicate call to rte_eth_dev_info_get.
dts adds a new VLAN test suite to verify VLAN filtering, stripping, and insertion of Poll Mode Driver.
Fix the issue of uninitialized structure fields in the FIB RCU test.
Add a test case for RSS key generation in the hash test.
Add interrupt disable API calls in the bbdev test application to improve test coverage.
Skip tests related to enqueue/dequeue burst functions in test/crypto when calling the synchronous API.
test/fib adds additional negative tests for rte_fib_rcu_qsbr_add() and explicitly checks return codes, while also adding checks for the passed fib parameter in rte_fib_rcu_qsbr_add().
test/cfgfile adds a check for the return value of the temporary file remove step.
test/bonding fixes the issue where the outer and inner loops use the same variable, and changes the release of the result burst to batch release.
test/bonding fixes the issue where comparing MAC addresses with memcmp uses the same two parameters, causing the assertion to always be true.
test/security fixes a loop issue in IPv6 extension header processing where incorrect parenthesis placement causes comparison to take precedence over assignment.
test/event changes the initialization of event_dev_config to struct initialization, avoiding repeated assignment to the same element.
test/crypto fixes the issue of repeating the same condition in the TLS zero-length record check, to correctly distinguish zero-length packet handling for application data versus other content types.

test/eal fixes a coverage issue where the MAX_NUM macro lacks parentheses, causing division to take precedence over shift, making the test loop too short, and adjusts some tests to avoid running in the full N^2 space.
test/eal fixes the issue where the expression checking whether lcore numbers 0-7 are enabled is missing case 6.

Improve TSC frequency estimation accuracy by adjusting the rounding granularity from 10MHz to 100KHz, and allow using the frequency provided by the operating system to override the CPU value. (architecture-related: core timer behavior)
Split the receive callback tracepoint into empty and non-empty versions to avoid quickly filling the trace buffer. (architecture-related: public API)
Add compiler attribute annotations to memory allocation functions, optimize alignment hints, and help detect allocation and deallocation mismatches. (architecture-related: public API)

Cache CPU feature query results on x86 platforms to avoid repeated hardware queries, improving performance and fixing errors in non-AVX virtual machines. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)
Support short FD format to improve single-transfer performance, and refactor related functions to identify FD types and save index context. (architecture-related: public API)
Optimize MAC address and VLAN filtering handling, only adding or removing necessary control flow rules, improving related API performance. (architecture-related: public API)
Store each lcore's power internal state into a lcore variable, reducing cache working set size and avoiding false sharing. (architecture-related: core module)
Increase the maximum number of Rx/Tx descriptors in the ixgbe driver from 4096 to 8192 to support applications requiring larger buffer capabilities. (architecture-related: public API)
Increase the maximum number of Rx/Tx descriptors in the ice driver to 8160 to support applications requiring larger buffer capabilities. (architecture-related: core module)
Enable 200G link speed support for E830 devices. (architecture-related: public API)
Apply minimal cache line alignment to the dispatch and xstat_off members of the rte_node structure to optimize performance and reserve space for future extensions. (architecture-related: public API)

Optimize Thor2 statistics cache performance by changing the act get API to directly receive the physical address of host memory, avoiding virtual address translation, and adjusting mutex locks and main loop delays. (architecture-related: public API)
Optimize testpmd's SSE MAC swap handling by moving the offload flag update to the beginning of the loop and interleaving SIMD operations, improving packet receive and transmit performance.
Optimize virtio statistics counter update performance by reducing branches and sorting packet size comparisons by typical traffic probability.
Remove the per-session 1 millisecond delay when obtaining IPsec statistics information, avoiding cumulative delays in scenarios with a large number of sessions.
Adjust LDPC decoder algorithm parameters, reverting to the MS1 version to improve performance under MU1 fading conditions.
Change the protocol parameter when creating AF_PACKET socket from ETH_P_ALL to 0, avoiding implicit binding, which is safer and more efficient.
Optimize scheduler subtree search by changing the search direction from downward to upward, avoiding traversal of unrelated branches and improving processing speed.
Optimize thread creation performance by using pthread_attr_setaffinity_np to set CPU affinity before creating the thread, avoiding synchronous waiting.
Replace CRC32 hash calculation with a DPDK-optimized CRC32 implementation and enable SSE4.2 hardware acceleration.
bus/dpaa immediately consumes FQRNI messages in MR by calling drain_mr_fqrni() after qman_retire_fq(), fixing the PFDR resource leak caused by FQRNI accumulation.
net/nfp clears the error status recorded in the PCIE AER registers after soft reset completes.
net/dpaa2 supports updating duplex value, link status, and link rate after setting link UP.
graph releases allocated node memory when node xstats memory allocation fails, fixing a memory leak.

service uses a multi-word bit set instead of a byte array to represent the service's current active flag, and changes the mapping from services to lcore to use a bit set for tracking to support RTE_SERVICE_NUM_MAX greater than 64.
Add speed capability support for new NIC models for the enic driver.
app/procinfo adds malloc heap dump support in the memory dump option.

examples/l3fwd adds the --burst option to explicitly set the Rx burst size (default 32, maximum 512), and adds the --mbcache option to configure the mbuf memory pool cache size (upper limit RTE_MEMPOOL_CACHE_MAX_SIZE).
The net/ena driver reverts the modification that redefined memcpy as rte_memcpy, restoring the use of standard memcpy.
The dma/idxd driver sets the GRPCFG traffic class to 1 to improve performance of the current generation accelerator.
vhost-user optimizes statistics counter update performance by reducing the number of branches and sorting packet size comparisons by typical internet traffic probability.
net/netvsc optimizes statistics counter update performance by reducing the number of branches and sorting packet size comparisons by typical internet traffic probability.
net/bnxt/tf_ulp optimizes performance by inlining common utility functions and adding likely/unlikely branch prediction hints.

Fixed the memory alignment issue of the SQ flow item structure in the mlx5 driver on 64-bit systems, preventing buffer overflow during DPDK copy; also added a context existence check for meter operations in HWS mode, rejecting related operations before port configuration. (architecture-related: public API)
Fixed a possible out-of-bounds read when parsing Preserved Fields Area in the ice driver, and added a boundary check for the head value in the ice_clean_sq function to prevent out-of-bounds access.
Fixed the out-of-bounds read of the dst_port array in the send_packets_multi function in the l3fwd example, and the integer overflow issue in option parsing in the l3fwd-power example.
Added compiler hints for network drivers such as bnxt, e1000, failsafe, hns3, and mana, fixing the array out-of-bounds compilation error when RTE_MAX_QUEUES_PER_PORT is configured as 1.
The net/bnxt driver adds a minimum segment size check for TSO, discarding packets when the segment size requested by TSO is less than 4.
The bus/fslmc driver replaces the system() system call with standard file I/O operations.
The net/hns3 driver removes some address register dump content that is not suitable for exposure.
The crypto/openssl driver changes the rte_memcpy copy of the algorithm name to strlcpy, fixing a potential string overflow.
net/ixgbe/base removes the function and related code that reads the NVM minimum secure version number.

Updated the Windows build guide, updating the minimum version requirement for Meson to 1.5.2, and added instructions for specifying 64-bit builds in the Visual Studio developer command prompt. (architecture-related: build and installation methods)
Added a list of tested Intel platforms in the v24.11 release notes. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)
Added the lcore variables programming guide, and fixed the documentation for experimental marking and default buffer size (changed from 1 MB to 128 kB). (architecture-related: public API)

Updated the contributor guide, removing the misleading note that new patches do not need to be copied to maintainers, and added a new driver development guide providing best practices and upstream submission suggestions for contributors creating DPDK drivers.
Added a missing newline at the end of the README file in common/idpf.
Reorganized the index structure of the programmer's guide, created ethdev and eventdev subdirectories, and unified the chapter title format.
Added API documentation source files for the DTS framework, including handwritten RST documentation for multiple modules and index configuration.
Fixed the double hyphen display issue in the argparse library documentation, unifying all parameter formats to be wrapped in backticks.
The ptpclient example program and related documentation replace the master/slave terminology with timeTransmitter/timeReceiver.
Updated the dependency version documentation for the Arm IPsec-MB library to SECLIB-IPSEC-2024.07.08, and synchronized the related descriptions in the snow3g and zuc documentation.
The DTS documentation updates the external DPDK build option description, and removes the git ref configuration option and related code.
net/ice/base updates the version release date and supported device information in README.
The cpfl NIC documentation updates the supported firmware version to 1.6.
Performed grammar and formatting rewrites on multiple example application user guides to unify documentation style.
The mlx5 Tx trace script mlx5_trace.py adds two optional parameters, -v [level] and -a, for outputting raw records at a specified level and dumps containing incomplete burst.
Removed the outdated normal_llq_hdr devarg documentation, whose functionality has been replaced by the new llq_policy devarg.
The Linux general getting started documentation adds instructions on how to include hugepages in core dump, and notes that only mapped hugepages will be included.
Added and enabled the autodoc-pydantic Sphinx extension in the DTS documentation build configuration to correctly recognize and format Pydantic models.
DPDK adds a standalone document doc/guides/howto/security.rst, specifically describing the security protocols implemented in DPDK.
The i40e and ice NIC documentation respectively update the recommended firmware and DDP version lists.

Fixed the compilation compatibility issue of the bitset header file under GCC and MSVC, hiding experimental API dependencies through conditional compilation, and replacing __builtin_ffsll with rte_bsf64. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)
Unified the IPv6 address structure, replacing in6_addr with rte_ipv6_addr, and fixed compilation errors caused by the structure change. (architecture-related: public API)
Fixed the compilation error caused by type conflicts on the Fedora Rawhide platform, changing typedef to a macro definition with conditional protection. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)

Enhanced the header file check build, adding compilation tests for stable, experimental, and internal API levels, and extended to driver-specific header files, fixing the vmbus driver header file dependency issue. (architecture-related: build and installation methods)
Added Neoverse N3 SoC support in the Arm build configuration, including its part number and compilation options. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)
Started a new release cycle, cleared the release notes, updated the ABI version to 25.0, and removed the temporary ABI compatibility exception. (architecture-related: ABI version)
Added compile-time platform configuration in the cnxk driver, setting the SOC type macro based on the build environment to distinguish different chips. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)

Changed the 32-bit x86 build to use a cross-compilation configuration file, avoiding reconfiguration failures caused by lost environment variables. (architecture-related: build and installation methods)

Adjusted the usage order of extern "C" in header files, moving it after all #include, and removed extern "C" from header files that do not declare symbols, deleting the mandatory check. (architecture-related: public API)
Raised the minimum version requirement for the Meson build system from 0.53.2 to 0.57, and updated the related documentation accordingly. (architecture-related: build requirements)
Replaced the deprecated get_cross_property in cross-compilation with get_external_property, adapting to Meson 0.58 and above. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)

Fixed the build failure of the net/mana driver when using a custom rdma-core via pkg-config, updating meson.build to ensure that header file symbol detection correctly includes dependent libraries. (architecture-related: pkg-config configuration)

Support specifying an external DPDK source directory, tarball, or precompiled build directory via configuration file, command-line arguments, or environment variables, and allow these resources to be stored on SUT nodes or execution hosts. (architecture-related: build and installation methods)
Added a unified AVX512 support check in the build system for reuse by all drivers and libraries. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)

Raised the minimum version requirement for the Intel IPsec MB library to 1.4, removed compatibility code for old versions, and added support for the SM4 and SM3 algorithms. (architecture-related: version and compatibility)
Fixed the use of the deprecated get_cross_property function during cross-compilation, changing it to get_external_property. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)
Set the maximum lcore count to 768 for AMD EPYC Zen5 processors in the x86 configuration. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)
Fixed the deprecation warning for meson >= 0.55 in ARM native builds, using files() to directly reference scripts instead. (architecture-related: build and installation methods)
Allow enabling the IOVA field in mbuf on CNXK platforms, and added a warning message, while updating build configuration and documentation. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)
Introduced the import mechanism for Linux kernel uAPI header files, adding import scripts, documentation, and build configuration support. (architecture-related: build and installation methods)

Imported VDUSE kernel uAPI header files (based on Linux kernel v6.10), and removed conditional compilation so that VDUSE support is always built on Linux systems. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)
Added a feature bit Meson compile configuration parameter for the TruFlow feature, to enable optional capability features of applications. (architecture-related: build and installation methods)
Fixed compilation issues of the argparse library under the MSVC compiler, now supporting compilation with the Visual Studio toolset. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)
Removed the build exclusion of the mempool library under the MSVC compiler, now supporting compilation under MSVC. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)

Reverted the import of VDUSE uAPI header files, restoring the use of system header files, and added conditional compilation to handle compilation errors when VDUSE support is disabled. (architecture-related: public API)
Moved the API header file rte_pmd_ntnic.h to the driver directory, and registered it as a public header file in meson.build. (architecture-related: public API)
checkpatches.sh extended to prohibit detection of __builtin_ffs and __builtin_ffsll usage, and further prohibit all __builtin helper functions (except EAL and some driver base code).
In the meson.build of lib/net and multiple drivers (common/idpf, event/dlb2, net/cpfl/i40e/iavf/ice/idpf/virtio), replaced their respective AVX-512 detection with standard variables in config/x86.
Fixed compilation errors caused by header file moves, added header file includes in the vm_power_manager example, and cleaned up redundant references in lib/power.
Fixed build failures caused by using the file() function in the Meson subproject.
Fixed the issue of the symbolic link script error when the driver installation subdirectory is empty or '.', by skipping the execution of that script.
Added a helper script to convert text files into initialization strings in C header files.
Fixed the issue where the forbidden token check could be bypassed, and cleaned up unused arrays.
The build system switched to using Meson's built-in version file support to obtain the DPDK version number.
Moved the disabling of the -Wno-address-of-packed-member warning from the global build configuration to the drivers subfolder, and retained the flag for the vhost library and the ipsec-secgw example.
Removed the disabling of the fallthrough warning for GCC 7, re-enabling the warning to catch potential bugs.
git-log-fixes.sh fixed to check the original commit hash in all Fixes tags, not just the first one; and deduplicated the duplicate functions marked stable and Fixes into a single function.

DTS added API documentation generation based on Sphinx, using Google format docstrings and napoleon, intersphinx extensions, supporting automatic mock of missing dependencies from pyproject.toml; subsequent fixes adjusted the configuration data scope of the DTS documentation directory and Doxygen links correctly, and made DTS documentation depend on the main documentation build and installation.
Added the package-mode = false configuration in pyproject.toml of DTS to replace the --no-root installation method.
Added independent tasks in CI workflows build.yml and linux-build.sh to run more checks in private repositories (such as other checks in devtools).
check-forbidden-tokens.awk supports skipping multiple file patterns, and changed to report all warnings instead of stopping at the first file with warnings.

build-dict.sh excludes stdio from the codespell dictionary to avoid checkpatch false positives, and added parameter validation; checkpatches.sh excludes false positives for attribute wrappers of rte_common.h through SKIP_FILES.
The build configuration re-enables the zero-length array warning, restoring the gcc 10 zero-length-bounds warning previously disabled due to the mbuf marker field.
meson.build outputs the source directory and build directory at the end of the configuration run, so that in multi-build scripts one can directly see the current ninja run location.
Removed unnecessary compilation warning disable flags in the meson.build files of multiple network drivers (iavf, i40e/base, idpf/base, fm10k/base, e1000/base, ice/base).
Installed libvirt in the CI workflow configuration file .github/workflows/build.yml to test the compilation of the vm_power_manager example.
Removed the setting that treats Sphinx warnings as errors in doc/api/dts/meson.build, to allow warnings caused by missing optional dependencies during DTS documentation generation.
Modified buildtools/call-sphinx-build.py and doc/api/meson.build to remove the nested html directory level in the API documentation.
Updated template files for the Thor2 platform, added statistics cache support, and adjusted enum definitions, table entries, and conditional lists. (architectural event: bnxt Thor2 template update)
Updated the firmware API version of the ixgbe driver to 1.7 to maintain compatibility with the firmware. (architecture-related: firmware API version compatibility)
Removed checks for Meson build system versions 0.60 and 0.57, simplifying the build script and relaxing version requirements. (architecture-related: build requirements)
Initialized mempool operations for the CN20K platform, making it reuse the mempool ops of CN10K. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)
rte_vhost_driver_set_max_queue_num API has been promoted from experimental to stable. (architecture-related: public API)

Added definitions of standard file descriptor macros STDIN_FILENO, STDOUT_FILENO, and STDERR_FILENO for the Windows platform, enhancing platform compatibility. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)

The build target field in the DTS configuration has been renamed from build_target to dpdk_build to more accurately reflect its purpose; meanwhile, the configuration mode has been simplified, using only one DPDK build per test run.
Removed redundant newline characters at the end of log messages in multiple drivers, fixing log format issues.
Adjusted the base log level of the CNXK driver from NOTICE to INFO to display logs normally when running applications.
Moved the C language linkage declaration in the driver header file to after the included header files, to maintain consistency with other header files in the project.
Removed redundant newline characters at the end of multiple debug logs in the fmlib base driver.
Uniformly added periods at the end of log messages, standardizing the log format.
Added register definitions and initialization support for multiple modules to the FPGA support file of the ntnic driver, and performed sorting and cleanup.
Fixed GCC 15 compilation errors by changing the string initialization of MAC addresses and VXLAN VNI to array initialization.
Initialized the PTP timestamps of the i40e and e1000 drivers to system time to align with kernel driver behavior.
Unified the use of log macros in the DLB2 base driver and corrected newline characters in log messages.
Extracted PF initialization helper functions in flower/nfp_flower_representor.c and nfp_net_common.c of the nfp driver, and replaced some snprintf() with strlcpy().
Modified dpaa2_qdma.c of the dpaa2 DMA driver to change the success return value of DMA copy/sg copy to the index of the copied descriptor.
Replaced compiler built-in functions with DPDK bitops API in app/dumpcap/main.c.
In cnxk_flow.c of the cnxk driver, appended flow mark ID actions for represented port action corresponding to representee.
Removed the workaround for ASan in Ubuntu GHA images in .github/workflows/build.yml.
Removed prefetch operations for mbuf and crypto_op not accessed by hardware in event mode in dpaa2_sec_dpseci.c of the dpaa2_sec driver.

Replaced warlock with Pydantic in the DTS configuration framework, refactored the configuration class structure and added cross-reference validation, while removing old configuration mode files such as conf_yaml_schema.json.
Avoided implicit type conversions of 32→16 or 16→8 bits in ice_ptp_hw.c of the ice/base driver to support compilation with the Visual Studio C++ compiler.
Updated the brand string of the E830 50G network card in the ice driver from "E830-XXV" to "E830-L".
In the graphviz export function of lib/graph/graph.c, changed the arrow color pointing to sink nodes to dark orange, removed the oval border of sink nodes and set their text to dark orange.
Added macro definitions related to trace buffer reading in the i40e/base driver, improved type conversions to avoid compiler warnings, and replaced the term "master" with "primary".
Defined the maximum MSIX interrupt index VFINT_DYN_MAX_INDEX as 63 in iavf_register.h of common/iavf, and added field bit definition enums for flex descriptor in iavf_type.h.
Added log messages for the reasons of flow rule creation failures in mlx5dr_rule.c of the mlx5/hws driver.
Supported a new queue debug information export device operation in rte_vrb_pmd.c of the acc baseband driver.
Enhanced the debug display of received frames in the dpaa driver to show complete packet parsing output.
Added checks for the return value of rte_eth_dev_info_get in lib/ethdev/rte_class_eth.c and l3fwd example code.
Removed the unused abort macro in drivers/net/ena/base/ena_plat_dpdk.h.
Changed the bbdev structure size calculation from a hardcoded constant to using sizeof.
In drivers/baseband/acc/rte_vrb_pmd.c, only reset the valid bit of info ring data to preserve data for dump use.
Added more debug logs during probing in drivers/net/nfp and modified some log levels.
In drivers/dma/dpaa2/dpaa2_qdma.h, limited the maximum number of descriptors in non-SG format based on the bit width of DPAA2_QDMA_FD_ATT_TYPE_OFFSET(13) of FD.
Modified the levels of speed update logs and some feature enable failure logs in drivers/net/nfp/nfp_net_common.c.
Added node information print content to the node_dump function of lib/graph/graph_debug.c.
Added debug information about max-pkt-len and configuration parameters in drivers/net/dpaa2/dpaa2_ethdev.c, and stored MTU.
In drivers/net/dpaa2, when DPAA2_PRINT_RX_PARSER_RESULT=1 is set, supported dump RX parser results and frame attribute flags generated by hardware/soft parser.
In drivers/net/dpaa2, checked whether soft parser is loaded by accessing the sp instruction area.
Added soft parser supported flows to the validation list in drivers/net/dpaa2/dpaa2_flow.c.
Removed unnecessary packed attributes in lib/efd/rte_efd.c and lib/pipeline/rte_table_action.c.
Removed power library function pointer checks in app/test/test_power.c, test_power_cpufreq.c, test_power_kvm_vm.c, and examples/l3fwd-power/main.c.
Removed unnecessary type conversions and FLOW_DEBUG conditional macros in drivers/net/ntnic, switching to dynamic logging.
Removed the unused callbacks(rx_cb) array in struct interface in app/dumpcap/main.c to save memory.
drivers/net/octeon_ep extended the mailbox functionality to handle messages from PF to VF, and updated the mailbox version to v3; PF FLR notification events trigger device removal callbacks.
Added two counters for idle call counts and error call counts to service function call statistics. (architecture-related: public API)

drivers/net/nfp modified the Rx buffer size setting logic; after the first initialization, the hardware Rx buffer size is only modified when the queue buffer size is greater than the current hardware setting.
Fixed the issue of missing event device stop in test cases.
Added Ethernet device clock frequency adjustment. Added the function rte_eth_timesync_adjust_freq to adjust the clock frequency for Ethernet devices. (architecture-related: DPDK official new feature)
Added per-CPU power management QoS interface. Added per-CPU PM QoS interface to lower the resume latency when waking up from idle state. (architecture-related: DPDK official new feature)
usertools/devbind: fix NUMA node display
usertools/devbind: restore active marker
usertools/devbind: print device NUMA node
usertools/hugepages: update coding style
usertools/cpu_layout: print CPU NUMA node
usertools/cpu_layout: update coding style
dts: remove redundant test suite
dts: add blocklist test suite
dts: add blocked ports to EAL parameters
dts: add l2fwd test suite
dts: remove warlock dependency
dts: refactor build and node info classes
dts: add test suite specification and discovery
dts: add Pydantic dependency
usertools/devbind: support all VFIO no-IOMMU sysfs values
maintainers: update for DLB driver
maintainers: update for log library

maintainers: update for Intel NIC drivers

Introduced the Staged-Ordered-Ring (SORING) software abstraction, supporting ordered queues and multiple processing stages, providing enqueue/dequeue and acquire/release data path API. (architecture-related: public API)
Added the xsc NIC driver, supporting PCI probing, device initialization, RSS configuration, and MAC address management. (architecture-related: new NIC driver)
Removed the igc driver; its functionality has been merged into the e1000 driver, constituting an architecture-level reorganization. (architectural event: Intel ICE driver module removal)

Unified the Intel NIC driver Tx path, including defining a generic Tx entry structure, merging the Tx queue structure, introducing a generic mbuf cleanup function, and unifying field naming and release logic. (architecture-related: Intel NIC driver Tx path unification)

Created a common packet reassembly function, unifying the duplicated packet reassembly logic in multiple Intel NIC drivers into a single implementation. (architecture-related: common packet reassembly function)

Moved the deferred start support check from individual drivers to the ethdev layer, and removed redundant check code in the drivers. (architecture-related: deferred start check moved to the ethdev layer)
Renamed the ROH_MAC module to HIMAC to avoid naming misunderstandings. (architecture-related: module rename)

Removed weak symbols in the Nitrox driver, and instead managed compression and encryption drivers through a unified driver registration mechanism. (architecture-related: unification of driver registration mechanism)

Merged the IGC NIC driver into the e1000 driver directory, and disabled the independent build of the IGC driver; also copied the i225 driver code to the e1000 directory and unified the symbol prefix. (architecture-related: IGC driver merged into e1000)

Introduced a unified FDB_UNIFIED subdomain in the FDB table type, updated table initialization and type determination logic, and added helper functions to improve code readability. (architecture-related: introduction of unified subdomain in FDB table)

Refactored the virtio crypto device queue operations, extracting control queue-related logic into a common module, and added support for packed virtqueue. (architecture-related: refactoring of virtio crypto device queues)

Moved the Intel NIC driver from drivers/net to the drivers/net/intel subdirectory, merged the common/idpf and common/iavf drivers into the corresponding net/intel drivers, and updated the build system and documentation. (architecture-related: module reorganization and build updates)
The iavf driver switched to the common Tx queue structure, and correspondingly adjusted related fields and release logic. (architecture-related: public API)
The iavf driver's AVX-512 path switched to the common Tx release function, and adjusted the function signature to support context descriptor scenarios. (architecture-related: public API)

Refactored the RSS implementation, extracting the conversion logic from RTE_ETH_RSS fields to HSH registers into a separate file, removed the profile wrapper, and replaced the original hasher configuration functions with the unified hsh_set interface. (architecture-related: public API)
The ixgbe driver migrated to the common Tx queue structure, and updated related functions to use the new queue type. (architecture-related: public API)
Migrated the CPT context macro definitions from dedicated header files to common header files, making them common to all modules using CPT CTX. (architecture-related: public API)
Enabled the IE engine only on CN9K and CN10K platforms; other platforms no longer include the IE engine group. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)
Moved interrupt handling logic from common code to platform-specific implementations to improve code clarity and maintainability. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)
drivers/common/mlx5 added a device duplication function that creates additional CTX for the same device based on the existing CTX.
Added attribute annotations to the compression operation allocation function in lib/compressdev/rte_comp.h to catch cases where allocations are not properly released.
Added attribute annotations to the telemetry data allocation function in lib/telemetry/rte_telemetry.h to catch cases where allocations are not properly released.
Created common mbuf initialization functions in the drivers/net/intel drivers to replace the original *_rxq_vec_setup_default functions, for initializing the mbuf_initializer of rx queue.

Centralized the common Rx vector enablement conditions of the Intel NIC drivers into intel/common/rx.h, and made drivers such as i40e, iavf, ice, and ixgbe use this common condition check, while supplementing necessary conditions previously unchecked for drivers such as ixgbe.
Adjusted the mlx5 driver's matcher creation logic to no longer allocate mirror resources for the FDB_UNIFIED table type, and added helper functions to distinguish different FDB table types.
Adjusted the CPT queue reset logic; the CN9K model uses a dedicated processing path, while other models (CN10K/20K) use the common path.
Added the eventdev telemetry device information query command, and added /eventdev/list and /eventdev/info as standard aliases. (architecture-related: public API)
Added enhanced lock annotation macros for the EAL library, supporting Clang shared and exclusive capability annotations. (architecture-related: public API)
The eventdev port property query function added support for independent enqueue properties. (architecture-related: public API)
The NFP NIC driver added burst mode query support for Rx and Tx. (architecture-related: public API)
The MLX5 NIC driver added the probe_opt_en device parameter to control probe optimization behavior. (architecture-related: public API)

RDMA monitor added backward compatibility support, falling back to the old method of updating port information when the kernel driver does not support it. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)
Updated the virtio_crypto_config structure, replacing reserved fields with the AKCIPHER algorithm field to comply with the VirtIO standard. (architecture-related: public API)
Introduced the __rte_packed_begin and __rte_packed_end macros, and deprecated the old __rte_packed macro, achieving cross-compiler struct packing compatibility. (architecture-related: public API)

Add complete VF device support to the ngbe NIC driver, including driver foundation, PF-VF communication, hardware configuration, network functions, data path, interrupts, statistics, and link management. (architecture-related: VF device support)

Add basic functional support to the zxdh network processor driver, including resource initialization, queue configuration, start/stop, data transmission and reception, and link state management. (architecture-related: new driver support)

Add IPv4 fragmentation handling support to the ice driver, including fragment flags, offset fields, offset mask matching, and fragment mode support in ACL filters. (architecture-related: public API extension)
Add MAC filtering support to the zxdh NIC driver, providing operations to set, add, and remove MAC addresses. (architecture-related: public API extension)
Add promiscuous mode and all-multicast mode support to the zxdh network device driver. (architecture-related: public API extension)
Add VLAN filtering and offload operation support to the zxdh network device driver. (architecture-related: public API extension)
The zxdh NIC driver supports RSS configuration, adding hash configuration and RETA update functionality. (architecture-related: public API extension)
