The zxdh NIC driver supports MTU update operations and sets maximum and minimum MTU values in device information. (architecture-related: public API extension)
Add MSVC compiler support for the x86 EAL write-merge storage function. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)
Add experimental rte_ffs32 and rte_ffs64 API for finding the first set bit starting from the least significant bit. (architecture-related: public API)
Add an API for dynamically enabling or disabling xstat counters for ethdev, and add an interface for querying counter status. (architecture-related: public API)
Add hairpin drop counters for the mlx5 PMD, including port-level and queue-level counters. (architecture-related: public API)
Add a MACsec ROC API to check MACsec hardware capabilities. (architecture-related: public API)
Add hash report functionality to the virtio NIC, supporting reporting of RSS hash values in packed ring queues in scalar mode. (architecture-related: public API)

Add initialization functionality to the XSC device, including interfaces for device operation registration, link management, queue creation and destruction, and RSS key modification. (architecture-related: public API)
Add a mailbox mechanism to the XSC NIC driver for interaction between PMD and firmware. (architecture-related: mailbox mechanism)

Add VFIO driver support for the XSC network PMD, including operations such as device initialization, open, close, BAR initialization, MTU setting, and MAC retrieval. (architecture-related: public API)

Add a packet classification table (PCT) interface to the xsc NIC driver, supporting creation, destruction, management of PCT entries, and related IPAT/EPAT operations. (architecture-related: public API)

Add representor initialization support for the xsc PMD, including basic functions such as parameter parsing, queue release, MAC address addition, and device enabling. (architecture-related: public API)
Add RSS configuration support to the xsc NIC driver, including modifying RSS hash keys, retrieving and updating hash configuration, and other functions. (architecture-related: RSS configuration)
Implement the start functionality for the xsc NIC device, including initialization, start, and stop of receive and transmit queues. (architecture-related: device start)
Add device stop and close functionality to the xsc NIC driver, resetting transmit/receive burst functions and releasing transmit queue resources on stop. (architecture-related: device stop/close)
Add Rx receive packet functionality to the xsc NIC driver, and add a helper function to check ownership of completion queue elements. (architecture-related: Rx reception)
Implement transmit burst functionality for the xsc NIC driver. (architecture-related: transmit burst)
Add link state and MTU setting operations to the xsc NIC driver, and fix comparison logic in MAC address addition. (architecture-related: public API)
Enhanced assertion checks during mbuf release, and added APIs for batch allocation and release of mbufs. (architecture-related: public API)

Added NPC flow handling and rte flow support for the CN20K platform, including MCAM entry operations, KEX configuration, and refactoring of common flow logic. (architecture-related: platform compatibility: CN20K)

Refactor the FPGA initialization function, remove unnecessary checks and logs, add support for the NT400D13 adapter, and switch to RTE_ASSERT for assertions. (architecture-related: hardware support: NT400D13)
Add drop counters to the IP fragmenter (IFR) to count packets discarded because their size exceeds MTU. (architecture-related: public API: drop statistics)
Add driver support for the RTL8168KB NIC, including hardware initialization and configuration functions. (architecture-related: hardware support: RTL8168KB)
Add missing i225 series devices (including i226) to the IGC driver, and sort the device list. (architecture-related: hardware support: i225/i226)

Added support for more I219 series network devices to the e1000 driver, added multiple hardware IDs, and updated the corresponding initialization and configuration logic. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)
Added generic API functions to enable/disable EEE (Energy Efficient Ethernet) in the e1000 base code. (architecture-related: public API)
Added device configuration profile information fields to the e1000 hardware structure to meet tool requirements. (architecture-related: public API)
Added LPI counters in the e1000 base driver to count EEE LPI events on the Tx and Rx paths. (architecture-related: public API)
Added definitions and related bit masks for the extended firmware semaphore (EXFWSM) register to the e1000 NIC driver. (architecture-related: public API)
Extended the ULP exit timeout on more hardware models, and added macro definitions and structure fields related to ULP WoL. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)
Added constant definitions related to WoL (Wake-on-LAN) for the i210 NIC. (architecture-related: public API)
Added a base driver in common/zsda, implementing initialization, registration, probe, and removal functions for PCI devices. (architecture-related: new driver module)
Added hardware queue operation functions in the ZSDA common driver, supporting queue start, stop, and clear. (architecture-related: public API)
Added message channel functionality in the zsda common driver, including queue management, register access, and management message send and receive. (architecture-related: public API)

Added the ZSDA compression device driver, including device interface skeleton, queue management, statistics, xform, enqueue/dequeue data paths, and capabilities support. (architecture-related: new driver module)
Added 100G link operation support for NT400D13 (Intel Agilex FPGA), including link initialization, state machine, reset, and loopback. (architecture-related: link operation interface)

Added unified FDB subdomain support in the mlx5 driver, including capability flags and dedicated action flags, allowing users to specify the FDB_UNIFIED domain to handle packets from any port. (architecture-related: FDB_UNIFIED domain support)
Support direct pointer dereference in trace points, and updated dmadev's trace points to use the new mechanism. (architecture-related: trace API extension)
Added thread-safe CRC API (with _v26 suffix), and updated the QAT driver and test cases to adapt to the new interface. (architecture-related: thread-safe CRC API)
Allow adding DROP target in mirror clone action. (architecture-related: mirror clone action extension)
Added type parsing support for VXLAN, VXLAN-GPE, GTP, and Geneve tunnel protocols, extending network packet processing capabilities. (architecture-related: parsing behavior)
Added initialization functions for the RPF and GFG modules, including configuration and stop interfaces. (architecture-related: public API)
Initialize NIM and PHY settings for Agilex FPGA ports, adding loopback, reset, and low-power control functions. (architecture-related: public API)
Added PHY line loopback configuration for Agilex FPGA, and initialized host loopback support. (architecture-related: public API)
Implemented PHY host loopback configuration for Agilex FPGA, added line loopback functionality, and optimized NIM I2C read/write and low-power control. (architecture-related: public API)
Initialize NIM and 100G ports for Agilex FPGA, adding link management, polarity swap, timestamp injection, and I/O expander driver. (architecture-related: public API)
Added post-initialization functions for 100G NIM on Agilex FPGA, including configuring FEC and TX equalization. (architecture-related: public API)
Added NIM reset and low-power control functions, and added NIM presence check. (architecture-related: public API)

Added link state management functionality to the ntnic driver, including NIM module hot-plug handling, port disable, and link state reporting, and added PCA9532 LED controller initialization and LED control functions. (architecture-related: public API)

Added minimal initialization support for the NT400D13 NIC, including clock synthesizer initialization, AVR probe, adapter ID mapping, and operation registration framework. (architecture-related: public API)
Added FPGA reset functionality to the NTNIC driver, defined and registered reset operation interfaces, supporting DDR4 reset and calibration completion handling. (architecture-related: public API)

Added FPGA module and register definitions for the NT400DXX card, including module initialization code, register header files, and updated module instance list and mapping. (architecture-related: public API)
Added reset wait functions and reset flow for the PHY FTILE module, and added DDR4 calibration and PHY FTILE reset wait functionality in the FPGA reset phase. (architecture-related: public API)
Added clock subsystem initialization support to the ntnic network driver. (architecture-related: public API)
Initialize and create PCM support for the FPGA and HIF modules of NT400D13. (architecture-related: public API)
Added read/write test register functions for the HIF clock, and replaced some assertions with RTE_ASSERT. (architecture-related: public API)

Added hardware initialization support for the NT400D13 platform, including creation and initialization of modules such as PRM, SPI v3, I2CM, PHY Tile, IGAM, as well as peripheral reset and PLL configuration. (architecture-related: core module)
Support dynamic adjustment of the RSS indirect table size in the ENA driver, no longer relying on a fixed 128 entries based on device capabilities. (architecture-related: RSS configuration)

Added rte_event_eth_rx_adapter_queues_add API, supporting batch addition of Rx queues with individual configurations; the Rx adapter of the cnxk event device PMD also added support for batch queue addition. (architecture-related: public API)

Added IPsec and CPT support for the CN20K platform, including device enumeration, SA initialization, session management, parse header structures, inline SA synchronization, and feature flag updates. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)

Added inline IPsec receive support for the CN20K platform, modifying WQE to mbuf conversion, vector processing, and post-processing functions to handle security offload flags and metadata buffers. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)
Added reassembly profile configuration support for the NIX inline path, and updated the mailbox interface to support new fields added by CN20K. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)

Add support for multiple inline inbound queues for the CN20k platform, allowing applications to directly attach inline inbound queues instead of through CPT PF. (architecture-related: public API: inline inbound queue)
Add a ROC API for Inline devices to obtain IPsec and reassembly profile IDs. (architecture-related: public API: ROC API)

Add inline IPsec rule support for the CN20K platform, replacing UCAST_CPT with the UCAST_IPSEC action, and refactor the related decision logic to be compatible with both platforms. (architecture-related: behavior change: UCAST_CPT)

Add creation and destruction support for inline IPsec sessions on the CN20K platform, and register the corresponding security operation callbacks. (architecture-related: public API: security operation callbacks)

Enable all-multicast mode on CGX/RPM VF devices, and adjust the promiscuous mode configuration logic to enable promiscuous mode only on non-VF devices. (architecture-related: behavior change: multicast and promiscuous modes)
Add support for SM4 GCM symmetric algorithm in cryptodev and AESNI_MB PMD, requiring Intel IPsec MB library v2.0 or later. (architecture-related: public API)

Optimize NP DTB channel initialization, change global DTB data to a per-device structure, and add support for RSS, VLAN, promiscuous mode, and MAC address configuration. (architecture-related: driver core refactoring)

Update the Rx/Tx implementation, add functions for offload detection, packet statistics, and descriptor management, and refactor related data structures. (architecture-related: driver core refactoring)

Provide zxdh message interrupt callbacks for the PF/VF NIC driver, adding message receive callback registration, VF promiscuous mode control, and VF MAC table addition. (architecture-related: internal interface)
Add RSS hash configuration, enabling, and RSS table set and get functions for VF. (architecture-related: driver feature enhancement)
Optimize basic statistics functionality, refactor statistic field naming, and add multiple statistic retrieval and reset interfaces. (architecture-related: public API)
Add checksum, TSO, LRO, extended statistics, firmware version retrieval, module EEPROM reading, and ingress metering to the zxdh NIC driver. (architecture-related: public API)

Add support for eCPRI item matching in mlx5 HWS, while also supporting template API and backward-compatible API; and support MPLSoGRE matching, removing related validation restrictions, defaulting to MPLSoUDP in non-loose mode, and setting the MPLS destination port only for UDP protocol. (architecture-related: public API)

Add performance test support for the RSA asymmetric encryption algorithm in the crypto-perf application; add support for asymmetric RSA operations (sign, verify, encrypt, and decrypt) in the vhost-user and virtio crypto PMDs, and refactor session management to support both symmetric and asymmetric operation types; also add related test cases for CNXK PMD and Virtio PMD. (architecture-related: public API)

Add support for packed ring in the virtio crypto driver, including initialization, data send/receive, and interrupt control; and add vDPA backend support for virtio_user crypto. (architecture-related: public API)
Add support for atomic 128-bit compare-and-swap for the MSVC compiler, enabling the stack library to build in a MSVC environment. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)
Add --uid and --gid options to dpdk-devbind.py, supporting specification of user and group ID when binding devices to VFIO.
Add an interface for setting port identification LED via the ACI command for E610 NICs.
Add PTP timestamping by PHY functionality for E610 NICs, and enhance clock drift threshold configuration.
Add support for OROM recovery updates to the ixgbe base driver.
Add Tx timestamp descriptor and queue context configuration support to the ice NIC driver.
testpmd supports updating port information via event callbacks in multi-process scenarios, enabling port attach and detach.
AF_PACKET PMD adds configurable fanout mode support, defaulting to PACKET_FANOUT_HASH.
The maximum number of virtual channels per queue for cnxk dmadev is increased from 4 to 128.
The af_packet driver adds drop statistics functionality, including querying socket drop counters and mbuf allocation failure counters.
Add firmware loading support for NICs without DDR.
Add trace points to the bbdev library, covering device configuration, queue operations, and enqueue/dequeue flows for various codec operations.
Add trace points in the baseband/acc driver, replacing the original error log with the acc_error_log function.
Add TSO support for axgbe PMD, including configuration, device information advertisement, and send path implementation.
Add initialization functions for Rx and Tx queues to the xsc NIC driver, and add related data structure definitions and header files.
Add basic statistics functionality to the xsc NIC driver, implementing statistic retrieval, device start/stop, and queue release operations.
Add device information query operations to the xsc NIC driver, and implement auxiliary functions such as link control, queue offload, and statistics.
Add hide_zero option to the --xstats parameter of the dpdk-proc-info tool, supporting hiding extended statistics with zero values.
Add missing i210 and i219 series hardware device IDs for the EM and IGB drivers.
Add functionality to read PCIe bus information for i225 NICs.
Add power management control for e1000 PHY, shortening post-reset delay by reading the PHPM register and polling the reset completion flag.
Add LED blinking functionality support for the i225 NIC.
Added PHY reset support for the i225 NIC, using a generic reset implementation.
Added address selection mask and queue selection related macro definitions for the e1000 NIC driver, for address filtering and specifying the receive queue that matches the MAC address.
Changed the pending count from per virtual channel to per hardware DMA channel, thereby allowing ringing the doorbell for the exact number of DMA commands in the queue.
Supported DROP operation in the multi-destination action, setting the NOP target type when DROP is specified.
Added support for the ESP protocol in the non-template RSS extension, enhancing receive-side scaling functionality.
Added ConnectX-8 device ID support for MLX5 PMD.
Added mailbox message support for inline IPsec configuration, to support global inline profile allocation.
Added NPC action2 configuration support for IPsec rules, extended related data structures, and adjusted channel masks.
Added inline device statistics reset functionality.
Optimized MTU setting operations, added port attribute setting functionality to support multiple offload flags and statistics updates.

Added unified FDB capability query in the mlx5 driver, supporting three subdomains: FDB_RX, FDB_TX, and FDB_UNIFIED, and supporting FDB Rx jumps, allowing flows to jump from FDB Tx to FDB Rx; when the JUMP_FDB_RX action is supported, allowing the use of RSS in FDB Rx rules.
Added basic statistics functionality for the zxdh network device driver, including RSS hash configuration, VQM statistics, NP statistics, and statistics updates on the transmit and receive paths.

Added the init_color flow rule specific configuration capability for meter_mark in the indirect flow action list of testpmd, allowing setting the initial color for meter_mark when referencing an indirect list via the meter_mark_conf action.
Added opcode and event structure definitions for FW temperature events for the E610 adapter, to handle overheating firmware events.
Added PCI device ID for two future hardware versions in the idxd DMA driver, and added corresponding support in dpdk-devbind.py.
Removed the deprecated asynchronous event notification handling mechanism from the ena NIC driver.
Implemented the rxq/txq information retrieval interface for the zxdh NIC driver.
Renamed the clock register header file in the ntnic driver to lowercase format, and completed the missing SPDX tags.
In the dynamic polynomial calculation of the hash library, replaced variable-length arrays (VLA) not supported by MSVC with standard C arrays.
In testpmd, replaced manual packet parsing with rte_net_get_ptype(), and added support for TSO of IPv6 extension headers.
In the multicast address list configuration of the cnxk NIC, when there is insufficient space to fully update the list, return -ENOSPC and no longer clear existing addresses.
Fixed a double-free issue during log cleanup: added an internal file flag, only closing log files allocated by DPDK, avoiding fclose on user-provided files. (architecture-related: log file ownership)

Fixed the atomic load memory ordering issue in the batch allocation wait in the cnxk driver, changing the memory order from relaxed to acquire to avoid potential out-of-order load issues. (architecture-related: public API)
Changed variadic macros in driver code from GCC extension syntax to standard C99 form, to fix MSVC compilation errors. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)

Added the sfc_get_restore_flags function, returning 0 to indicate that sfc PMD does not require configuration recovery, avoiding repeated recovery of MAC addresses, promiscuous mode, and all-multicast mode by the ethdev layer. (architecture-related: external behavior)

Unified Rx/Tx queue threshold queries for the NFP NIC, making the thresholds returned by rte_eth_rx_queue_info_get() and rte_eth_tx_queue_info_get() consistent with the device default configuration. (architecture-related: public API)
Fixed the C++ inclusion issue in the cryptodev header file, ensuring that related functions are correctly wrapped in the extern "C" block. (architecture-related: public API)

Fixed the issue of hardcoded dedicated hardware queue size in bonding PMD, changing to initialize dedicated queues using the minimum hardware queue size of member ports, avoiding port startup failures due to insufficient descriptors required by some NIC. (architecture-related: public API)

Fixed errors caused by type conversion during MSVC compilation, using intrinsic functions to access __m128i content, ensuring compatibility with GCC, Clang, and MSVC on 64-bit architectures. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)

Fixed the timing of logging and parameter checking in the rte_vhost_driver_set_max_queue_num function, ensuring it is only executed when the VDUSE backend is used, avoiding misleading information for Vhost-user devices. (architecture-related: public API)
Fixed Windows compilation errors by removing the AVX conditional check in the immintrin.h header file. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)

Corrected the value of the IXGBE_SUBDEV_ID_E610_VF_HV macro to avoid conflict with the real device ID, resolving the driver hang issue in virtual machines. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)
Fixed the DPI mailbox structure, adjusting field bit widths to ensure correct alignment of mailbox fields. (architecture-related: public API)
Fixed the issue where vhost devices return error packet counts when calling rte_vhost_dequeue_burst when the virtqueue is not ready. (architecture-related: public API)
Fixed the issue where the rte_eth_dev_socket_id() and rte_eth_dev_owner_get() functions were unavailable during device probing, relaxing the port validity check. (architecture-related: public API)
Fixed the issue where rte_mempool_create_empty did not correctly set rte_errno when creating an empty memory pool failed. (architecture-related: public API)

Added complete start, stop, reset, and close operations for the ngbe VF device, and added device operation functions such as VLAN filtering and queue settings. (architecture-related: device operations)

Supported arbitrary expressions in trace blob length, using internal intermediate variables to avoid side effects, and updated ethdev trace points to remove unnecessary intermediate variables. (architecture-related: public API)
Added memory allocation and deallocation attribute annotations to the creation functions of FIB and FIB6, to help detect memory leaks. (architecture-related: public API)

Added __rte_malloc and __rte_dealloc attributes to RIB allocation functions, and adjusted the declaration positions of rte_rib_free and rte_rib6_free, to assist in detecting issues where memory is not correctly freed after allocation. (architecture-related: public API)
Added allocation and deallocation annotations to hash table creation functions, to assist in detecting memory leaks. (architecture-related: public API)
Added __rte_malloc and __rte_dealloc attribute annotations to LPM allocation functions, to help detect memory that is not correctly freed. (architecture-related: public API)

Added memory allocation and deallocation attribute annotations to the ACL context allocation function to help the compiler detect memory leak issues where memory is not properly released. (architecture-related: public API)

Added __rte_malloc and __rte_dealloc attribute annotations to the allocation function of bitrate statistics to help detect issues where memory is not properly released after allocation. (architecture-related: public API)

Added __rte_malloc and __rte_dealloc attribute annotations to the rte_member_create function and adjusted the declaration position of rte_member_free to support compiler detection of memory leaks. (architecture-related: public API)
Add function attribute annotations to the mempool allocation function to detect at compile time cases where memory allocated by mempool is not properly released. (architecture-related: public API)

Add a deallocation function declaration to the event ring allocation function and annotate it with __rte_malloc and __rte_dealloc attributes to support memory leak detection. (architecture-related: public API)

Add attribute annotations to the allocation functions of the reorder library and expose the rte_reorder_free interface to help detect issues where memory is not properly released after allocation. (architecture-related: public API)
Adjust the maximum number of actions for the mlx5 driver HWS rule from 16 to 32 for compatibility with SWS. (architecture-related: public API)
Fix a compilation issue under Arm SVE caused by const conversion. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)

Fix undefined behavior during tracepoint registration by adding an inline _register() handler for each tracepoint and adjusting macro definitions, while removing related workaround code in dmadev tracepoints. (architecture-related: public API)

Fix the issue where flow processing in ICE PMD violated the rte_flow API, removing the dependency on the group attribute and instead evaluating each engine parser in sequence according to the hardware pipeline order. (architecture-related: public API)
Fix the registration failure issue for VDUSE devices caused by the return value not being correctly updated. (architecture-related: public API)
Fix a potential crash in the C11 atomic implementation caused by an uninitialized variable in the stack pop operation. (architecture-related: public API)
Fix the display of group jumps in flow dump, now outputting the original group number instead of the internal encoding. (architecture-related: public API)
Fix the ordering issue of file descriptor cleanup in vhost, now removing FD from the set before closing to avoid epoll errors. (architecture-related: vhost core module)

Fix the read/write logic of the PHY register in the e1000 driver, add a write function for the GPY PHY register, and add a PHY read/write retry mechanism to resolve occasional MDI errors. (architecture-related: public API)
Add an assertion in the rte_lcore_var_lcore function to ensure the passed handle pointer is non-null, to catch initialization or allocation issues early. (architecture-related: public API)

Delay the initialization of the random number generator from the constructor to the EAL initialization phase, explicitly calling eal_rand_init() in rte_eal_init(), and add assertions to ensure initialization order. (architecture-related: EAL initialization order)

Fix crashes in the e1000, igb, igc, and ixgbe NIC drivers in secondary processes by prohibiting calls to base driver function pointers or adding process type checks. (architecture-related: multi-process compatibility)

Update the default crypto engine group for the CN20K platform because it does not support the IE engine, and retain the legacy engine group for CN10K and earlier versions. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)
Fix the minimum receive/transmit ring descriptor count for the ixgbe driver, adjusting the default minimum from 32 to 64. (architecture-related: public API)

Fix the issue where NUMA nodes were not detected when the number of socket cores exceeded RTE_MAX_LCORE, by extending the core-to-socket mapping array and iterating over all possible lcore IDs to record all NUMA nodes. (architecture-related: NUMA node detection)
Fix the issue in the nfp driver where the PF ID was not passed to BSP when loading firmware, causing incorrect DMA mapping in multi-PF scenarios. (architecture-related: nfp multi-PF DMA mapping)
Fix the mbuf release issue in the Arm multi-process environment, extending the x86 fix to the Arm architecture. (architecture-related: Arm platform compatibility)

Add an interrupt registration success check in the iavf driver initialization, falling back to polling mode on registration failure, fixing the management queue message loss issue on FreeBSD caused by interrupt registration failure. (architecture-related: FreeBSD platform compatibility)
Adjust the flow engine evaluation order, prioritizing the ACL engine over the switch engine, to resolve wildcard flow rule scalability issues. (architecture-related: flow engine evaluation order)

Fix the port close failure caused by context inconsistency during GENEVE parser cleanup, now creating an independent context from the physical device to ensure consistent context for parser creation and cleanup. (architecture-related: GENEVE parser context)
Add the missing PCI ID check for E610 virtual function devices in the ixgbe driver. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)
Add attribute annotations to the allocation functions of the ring library to help detect memory leaks. (architecture-related: public API)
Add function attribute annotations to the port configuration allocation functions of the sched library to detect cases where memory is not properly released after allocation.
Fix the issue where the representor port link status was not correctly switched according to the representee status: set the link status to up when representee starts, and to down when it stops.
Fix the action data memory leak in the mlx5 non-template API, separating the release of action data from the destruction of DR action.
Fix the issue where the ring address was not cleared when vhost obtained the vring base, causing the device to be incorrectly ready after virtual machine restart.
Fix the issue of duplicate queue release in the virtio crypto driver, setting the queue pointer to null after release and removing redundant control queue release calls.
Fix the issue where a 32-bit left shift in cryptodev was implicitly converted to 64 bits, using the RTE_BIT64 macro instead to avoid MSVC warnings.
Fix the segmentation fault in the virtio NIC Rx path caused by the checksum start position exceeding the packet length.
Fix unnecessary context cleanup in the CMAC authentication function to avoid subsequent call failures.
Fix the issue of incorrect order of cryptodev and eventdev IDs in the ipsec-secgw example.
Fix the integer overflow issue in the alloc_link_pbl function of the net/bnxt driver by converting the multiplication operands to uint64_t type to avoid overflow.
Fix the integer underflow issue that may occur in the block index calculation in the cfa_mm_open function.
Fix the uninitialized variable issue in two functions of the bnxt driver to avoid errors reported by Coverity scanning.
Fix the dead code issue in the bnxt driver when checking feature, change the conditional judgment to else if to avoid logic conflicts.
Add support for E610 device type in the ixgbe flow engine, fixing the issue that it cannot use the FDIR feature.
Fix the issue in the mlx5 driver where polling CQEs may access unallocated mbuf, by limiting the processing batch to not exceed the number of supplemented mbuf.
Fix the variadic macro definitions in multiple applications, using standard C99 syntax to eliminate MSVC compilation warnings.
Fix the issue in the net/ena driver where the default LLQ policy is not set, ensuring that LLQ is correctly enabled when the user does not specify it via devarg.
Remove the invalid reset operation of the Tx preparation function pointer in the iavf driver, fixing the Tx path selection issue caused by the pointer being set to null and not reassigned.

Fix the VF link speed issue: correctly update rte_eth_device and notify the firmware when the port link state changes, and add speed notification for physical representor ports under multiple PF firmware.
Fix the initialization of Rx and Tx burst handler in the bnxt driver, no longer defaulting to static mode, but dynamically selecting the correct handler through function calls.
Fix the undefined behavior caused by left-shifting a 32-bit integer in the bnx2x driver, using the RTE_BIT32 macro to define interrupt and error flag bits.
Fix the issue that pdump statistics are not cleared at the beginning of each capture, avoiding count accumulation when dumpcap is called multiple times.
Fix the crash when re-attaching a representor port in the bnxt driver, modifying the cleanup logic to correctly release the ethdev of all sub-representor ports.
Fix the issue that fragmented packet types cannot be correctly matched when the L2/L3 mask is specified simultaneously.
Fix the validity check of GSO size in vhost, preventing errors when gso_size is 0.
Fix the error in obtaining service idle call and error call statistics caused by the introduction of the lcore variable.
Add a check on the descriptor chain length in the vhost asynchronous packed ring dequeue path, preventing the issue of no packets when the length is less than the Virtio-net header.
Fix the Netlink socket leak issue by closing the corresponding socket file descriptor when unloading the shared interrupt handler.
Fix the issue in the hns3 driver's simple Tx path where mbuf is not released correctly when fast release offload is not set, using rte_pktmbuf_free_seg() to release mbuf.
In the hns3 driver, remove the PVID information printing of VF to avoid misunderstandings caused by inconsistent PVID status obtained by kernels on different platforms.
Fix the issue that the length field is not reset when releasing unused memory segment lists, avoiding subsequent memory being misjudged as DPDK memory and incorrectly released.
Fix the issue of incorrectly closing the crypto device when the secondary process exits, only performing the device close operation in the primary process.
Fix the data queue iteration to use the number of queue pairs in the device data instead of the maximum number of data queues.
Fix the issue in the crypto/virtio driver that returns a fixed error code -1 when session configuration fails, now returning the correct error code.
Change the QPL allocation method for the RX queue from memzone to malloc to avoid allocation failure due to insufficient contiguous IOVA memory; the TX queue still uses memzone.
Fix the IPv4 matching fragment: correct the target IP address mask, add the missing queue action in the action template, and replace the misused rte_flow_item_tcp with the correct rte_flow_item_ipv4.
Fix the issue that the ixgbe_get_fw_tsam_mode function returns an error integer value when not implemented, changing it to return false.
Exclude 2.5G and 5G link speed auto-negotiation for E610 devices to avoid compatibility issues with certain switches, while retaining support for E610 2.5G SKU devices.
Fix the defect in the ixgbe_aci_send_cmd function where the original command buffer is not copied when retrying the AQ command.
Fix the issue in the SRAM manager allocation status indication where false is incorrectly assigned to a pointer instead of the boolean value pointed to by the pointer.
Fix the memory leak in the ice driver's scalar receive path caused by payload mbuf allocation failure in the buffer splitting scenario, ensuring that the allocated header mbuf is correctly released.
Fix the missing event weight handling in the DLB2 driver's SSE code path, making it consistent with the AVX512 path.
Fix the logic error when checking multiple PF from NSP in the NFP driver, changing the function return type to integer and adding an output parameter to correctly pass the flag.
Fix the logic judgment error in the NFP driver's conntrack caused by assigning the negative return value of nfp_ct_offload_add to a boolean variable.
Fix the issue in the NFP driver that does not set the NFP_NET_CFG_CTRL_MULTI_PF control flag in the multi-PF firmware scenario.

Fix the firmware loading priority logic in the NFP driver, adjusting the priority order between the file system and flash loading, ensuring that after file system loading fails, it correctly falls back to flash loading.
Add a null pointer check before calling the rte_vhost_device_ops callback to avoid null pointer dereference caused by an unregistered callback.
Fix the memory leak when creating the HWS flow counter action in the mlx5 driver, ensuring that mp_name is correctly released when initialization fails.
Fix the issue in the bnxt driver that automatically disables TruFlow when compressed CQE mode is enabled to avoid anomalies.

Fix the crash in the mlx5 driver when using mark action splitting in switch dev mode: correct the error of using queue[0] index in the hairpin RX queue check, and replace the unsupported set tag action with modify field action.
Fix the memory leak in the mlx5 driver caused by early return without releasing the non-template flow list when flushing non-template flows.
Fix the degradation issue of GRE flow matching in SWS mode in the mlx5 driver, adjusting the translation logic of GRE items to distinguish the handling of SWS and HWS.
Fix the ppc64le compilation error in the mlx5 driver on the AltiVec Rx path caused by missing volatile qualifier and type alias.

Fixed the issue where the CNXK NIC incorrectly set the default L3 type to IPv6 in vector send processing, causing erroneous interrupts for small packets SQ; changed the default L3 type to none and correctly set the L3 type in TSO processing.
Fixed a crash in the AVX512 receive function caused by passing by value instead of by pointer.
Fixed the bnxt driver's compressed CQE Rx data path in scalar mode by moving the compressed CQE handling code out of the normal CQE branch.
Fixed the issue where af_packet PMD closed the socket when calling rte_eth_dev_stop(), preventing the port from restarting; moved the socket close operation into eth_dev_close().
Fixed the error path in systemd journal socket opening to avoid calling close(-1) when socket creation fails, which triggered a Coverity warning.
Fixed a log printing error in the cpfl driver's representor parsing, replacing the incorrect NULL variable in the log with the correct input parameter.
Fixed an array out-of-bounds issue in devargs layer parsing by changing the boundary check from greater than to greater than or equal.
Fixed an error in clock ID comparison during message parsing in the PTP client example, avoiding the issue of always returning true.
Fixed a 64-bit type mask truncation issue in the net/hinic driver caused by using a 32-bit integer literal for shift operations.
Fixed a shift truncation issue in the dpaa2_sec driver's 64-bit bitmask caused by using a int type constant.
Fixed an update error in the dpaa_sec driver's 64-bit bitmask caused by integer type truncation.
Fixed a truncation issue in bitmask calculation in the event/dpaa driver, ensuring correct operation in a 64-bit environment.
Fixed an issue in the dpaa driver where the 64-bit bitmask had the high 32 bits truncated due to shifting with an int type.
Fixed an issue in the dpaa2 driver where the 64-bit mask's shift result was truncated due to using a int type.
Fixed a nested loop variable error in the qede driver's LLDP update event handler, avoiding logic defects caused by using the same loop variable.
Fixed an operator precedence error in the l3fwd example's socket ID check, ensuring socketid is correctly assigned rather than being assigned a boolean value.
Fixed the order of null pointer checks in the roc_bphy_cgx_set_link_mode function by moving the null check for mode to the beginning of the function, avoiding null pointer dereference.
Fixed the boundary condition for index validation in the statistics feature to prevent array out-of-bounds access.
Fixed the defect of not checking the return value when creating a thread; if creation fails, log an error and return.
Fixed an unchecked return value of memcmp, resolving the Coverity defect reported by BAD_COMPARE.
Fixed a memory leak in flow_configure_profile_inline caused by not updating the pointer when realloc succeeds, and corrected a function call name.
Fixed an array index out-of-bounds issue in the clear_pdrv function by changing the out-of-bounds check condition from greater than to greater than or equal.
Fixed a use-after-free issue in the net/ntnic driver caused by not setting eth_base to NULL after releasing the port.
Fixed a resource leak caused by not releasing p_fpga_mgr when FPGA initialization fails.
Fixed a potential overflow issue in modify_field_use_flag assignment caused by integer left shift.
Fixed a possible overflow in bit shift operations by limiting the maximum shift value.
Fixed a mismatch between the return type of the dbs_qsize_log2 function and the variable size, adjusting the return type and internal variables from uint16_t/uint32_t to uint8_t.
Fixed a possible integer overflow when allocating hardware queues in the ntnic driver by explicitly casting to uint64_t before multiplying buf_size and num_descr.
Fixed an array boundary check to prevent out-of-bounds access of word_off.
Fixed a memory leak in the ntnic driver by releasing kvlist before returning on error.
Fixed an unnecessary null pointer check in xstats retrieval, ensuring port load statistics values are always valid.
Fixed a conversion error from age timeout to FPGA internal time units, and updated the timeout decoding function to support longer timeout ranges.
Added range checks for action modify and checks for unsupported modification types in group 0, and modified related functions to handle error returns on validation failure.
Fixed the issue of unprocessed GRO packets in IPv4, ensuring the start position and remaining count of unprocessed packets are correctly passed when flushing the VXLAN TCP table.
Fixed a deadlock issue in the i225 NIC driver caused by not releasing the semaphore when register write fails, ensuring the semaphore is always released.

Fixed an infinite loop in the igc driver when releasing software/firmware synchronization resources due to inability to acquire the hardware semaphore, changing it to log an error and return directly.
Increased the delay time after power-up of the i225 PHY to 300 microseconds to comply with chip specification requirements.
Fixed bit offset errors and data type issues in the igc driver's MAC address hash calculation, avoiding incorrect hash values and overflow.
Fixed the semaphore timeout values in the e1000 and igc NIC drivers, correcting the wait time from a maximum of 1.5 seconds to 100 milliseconds as required by the datasheet, avoiding DPC timeouts.
Fixed bit offset errors and data type issues in the e1000 and igc NIC drivers' MAC address hash calculation, ensuring correct hash generation.
Fixed power state switching and clock gating issues for specific PHY and MAC types in the e1000 driver, avoiding packet loss.
Fixed hardware synchronization and PCIe configuration issues for ICH8 devices in the e1000 driver, removing invalid calls and optimizing code.

Fixed a read failure in the I225 NIC's PHY initialization by introducing a PHY ID read retry mechanism (up to 10 times, 100 ms apart), and corrected the call to the PCI-E master/slave disable function in the reset flow.
Improved error handling when the matcher disconnects, avoiding a segmentation fault caused by firmware failure.
Fixed an issue where the L4 protocol type in IP fragments was not correctly recognized on the ConnectX-8 NIC, updating the hardware packet type translation table.
Added a retry mechanism for copper port initialization, fixing the issue where driver initialization failed due to incomplete asynchronous tasks in early firmware versions.
Fixed the issue where the hns3 driver could time out during reset by dynamically setting the timeout based on command type, adjusting the reset command timeout to 100 milliseconds.
Fixed the issue of inconsistent device names during PCI device registration; device names now uniformly use the parsed canonical PCI address.
Fixed the scanning issue for multiple Ethernet devices under PCI devices in the netvsc driver; it now traverses all network devices instead of only handling the first one.
Fixed the netvsc driver to ensure all Ethernet devices are shut down before removing the RTE device during hot removal.
Added error logging when switching data paths fails in the netvsc driver to facilitate troubleshooting.
Fixed the segmentation fault caused by selecting an empty driver operation when creating an empty flow list, and added the corresponding empty operation implementation.
Fixed the asymmetric operation status code, and now returns an error status when known conditions are not met.
Fixed the issue where the width and offset parameters were not correctly passed in Ethernet device register information requests.

Fixed the issue where error messages were overwritten during flow action translation; introduced a local error variable and refactored the error handling logic for SEND_TO_KERNEL, AGE, and COUNT actions.

Fixed the out-of-bounds reference and segmentation fault caused by missing port ID validation in testpmd, including the segmentation fault in the DCB configuration command when an invalid port number is input.
Fixed a race condition during device removal in the mana driver by moving the multi-process usage count from shared data to local data.
Reverted the modification of untrusted loop bounds in VLAN handling to fix the abnormal VLAN handling issue.
Fixed the ACL filter cleanup logic so it is no longer limited to DCF mode; PF can also be cleaned up properly.

Fixed the issue of incorrect call timing for the mbuf cleanup function in the ice driver; the selection of the Rx and Tx functions is now moved before queue startup to avoid memory leaks and segmentation faults caused by incorrect flag setting timing.
Added error checking for port enable failure in the xsc NIC startup process.

Fixed multiple null pointer dereferences, logic errors, and initialization issues in the xsc driver, including null pointer operations after memory allocation failure, duplicate data length calculation in mbuf initialization, and incorrect memcmp comparison logic.
Fixed the inbound IPsec SA configuration error in the cnxk driver, ensuring the L3 header writeback is correctly set when an error occurs in inline IPsec.

Fixed the judgment logic for WOL and NCSI capabilities in the ngbe driver; changed the inclusion match of subsystem ID to exact match to avoid misjudgment causing PHY configuration to be skipped and leading to link failure.

Fixed the inaccurate packet count results caused by concurrent multi-queue calculation in the representative port statistics of the nfp driver; changed to aggregate queue data when obtaining statistics.
Fixed the error check when queue counter allocation fails in the mlx5 driver; now checks the firmware syndrome code to determine whether the maximum queue counter limit is reached.
Fixed the issue where the show port dcb_tc command in testpmd only displayed the TC count mapping; changed to display the TC mapping for all priorities.
Fixed the incorrect state size setting for the SM3 hash algorithm in QAT PMD.
Fixed the issue in default miss table jump validation that allowed jumps between FDB_UNIFIED and FDB_RX/FDB_TX types.
Fixed two errors in the PF initialization failure handling logic of nfp and improved resource cleanup on the error path.
Fixed the issue of premature epoch bit flip in the vector path of the bnxt NIC driver; improved ring wrap-around recognition and correctly calculated the epoch bit.
Added IPv4 and UDP checksum offload flags in txonly forwarding mode, fixing the issue of missing corresponding mbuf offload flags when hardware supports them.
Fixed the assertion failure caused by improper handling of shared Rx queues during hairpin queue release.
Fixed the incorrect handling of LACP packets in isolated mode by adjusting the position of the isolation mode check to ensure it executes correctly.
Fixed the crash caused by not setting ethdev_port_id when using represented port items in non-template API; added a null pointer check and default to eswitch manager ID.
Fixed a potential crash when setting VLAN VID in non-template mode and updated the error handling of related functions.
Fixed GTP flag matching to support all v_pt_rsv_flags bits, not just extended flags.

Fixed the thread safety check of vhost crypto by changing function parameters from vhost_crypto_data_req to explicit virtio_net and vhost_virtqueue, and updated the thread safety attribute macro; also added asymmetric encryption session creation and related functions, and added the --asym command-line option in the example to support asymmetric operations.

Fixed the memory error caused by worker threads attempting to obtain crypto operations when the virtio ring is not initialized; added a check for the vring initialization state and adjusted the lock acquisition method.

Fixed the issue where non-template flows on HWS could still be created successfully despite validation failure; added rule validation during flow creation and adjusted the method for obtaining match item flags; also added a dedicated validation function for non-template flow rules based on HWS.
Fixed the issue where the actual group ID was not correctly set during flow action translation in non-template API, avoiding misuse of root table actions.
Fixed the failure to match GENEVE options on HWS in non-template API; added a GENEVE option parser and updated related documentation.

Fixed the thread safety issue caused by repeated lock acquisition in the same thread in vhost/crypto; changed the lock reference from vc_req->vq to directly using vq, and split the session cache ID to distinguish symmetric and asymmetric sessions.
Fixed incomplete cleanup when queue setup fails for the VRB2 variant, ensuring the queue index is correctly decremented.
Fixed the issue where the table type was not correctly converted when creating root type actions, and added target conversion for non-root FDB actions.
Added return value checks for malloc calls in multiple functions to avoid null pointer dereferences.
Fixed the crash on FreeBSD caused by interrupt handlers accessing invalid pointers when the application exits; added null pointer checks.

Fixed the IP-in-IP tunnel validation logic in MLX5 PMD, correcting the issue where the inner IP protocol under VXLAN encapsulation was incorrectly identified as the same layer, causing flow validation failure.
Fixed the issue of insufficient memory allocation in QAT device parameter parsing due to not considering the string terminator.
Fixed the validation logic for mark flow action in FDB mode in the mlx5 driver; now supports both SWS and HWS modes.
In the ice PF VSI settings, enabled local loopback and source pruning flags, fixing the issue of dropped packets at VRRP MAC addresses.
Fixed the NAT64 register selection issue: during initialization, check whether REG_C_6 is supported by the firmware; if the register is insufficient, the NAT64 action is no longer created.

Fixed the issue of incorrect default protocol mask when matching GRE on the root table, changing the default protocol mask from 0xffff to 0, so that empty GRE matching no longer forces matching the protocol field.
Fixed the infinite loop issue when processing VLAN and QinQ packets in the checksum engine, updating the get_ethertype_by_ptype function to correctly parse the VLAN header.
Added function return value checks in ulp_mapper.c and ulp_rte_parser.c of the bnxt NIC driver, fixing the CID 449056 error handling issue reported by Coverity.
Removed the duplicate assignment of the last action in the template in snippet_match_ipv4.c of the flow_filtering example, fixing Coverity 451221.
Removed the duplicate assignment to the same field in sfc_repr.c of the sfc NIC driver, fixing Coverity 384444.
Fixed the MSVC compilation warning caused by the return value of the void function in the Intel NIC driver.
Fixed the file descriptor leak when fscanf fails in the cnxk_gpio self-test code.
Added the missing enum value elements to the debug message array in the qede NIC driver, and added static assertions to ensure the array exactly matches the enum values.

Added or moved null pointer checks in multiple files of the ntnic driver: moved the null check before use in ntnic_dbsconfig.c, added a null check for the fpga variable in nt4ga_link_100g.c, and added a null check for p->m_rpp_lr in flow_nthw_rpp_lr.c to prevent null pointer dereference.
Replaced the while statement with a if statement in ntnic_filter.c of the ntnic driver to avoid an infinite loop when ther_type is modified externally, fixing Coverity 448917.

Fixed multiple issues in igc_i225.c of the igc base driver: reset the loop variable for Shadow RAM writes to avoid false success; corrected the LTR calculation in i225 to subtract 1 microsecond; fixed bit operation type mismatch; removed useless assignments when there are no get link status callbacks; corrected a typo in the LTR maximum value calculation that mistakenly used the minimum value scale.
In e1000_reset_hw_82580() of the e1000 base driver, read the register value before setting the device reset status bit, fixing the reset issue of 82580.
Added return value checks for unchecked write operations in e1000_ich8lan.c of the e1000 base driver, fixing the issue of ignored error return values detected by static analysis.
Skipped the management control check on the 82575 NIC and unconditionally flushed the Rx FIFO.
testpmd uses the user-set VXLAN flow flag; if not specified by the user, it defaults to 0x8.
testpmd moved setup_attached_port() to execute 100ms after receiving a new event, to fix the queue number configuration issue after device attachment.
Fixed the uninitialized return variable in test/ring (Coverity 455328).
net/mlx5 added updating the error structure information in the actions construction.
bbdev added the missing header file inclusion to fix the MSVC compilation error (TAILQ_ENTRY syntax error).
net/ntnic fixed the initialization error and incorrect assertion condition when RTE_ASSERT compilation is disabled.
net/octeon_ep removed the useless assignment (Coverity 385414).
net/enetfec removed the useless assignment (Coverity 374016).
eventdev fixed the data type of the format string in log messages, using the correct macro.
eal/linux removed the useless assignments in dev_uev_socket_fd_create() and dev_uev_parse().
Removed the pthread_mutex_init return value checks in the hinic, vhost, failsafe, cnxk, bnxt, and ifpga drivers.
DTS split the configuration file into two separate files, node configuration and test run configuration, and added corresponding command-line parameters.
The hash library avoids the implicit conversion of the 32-bit shift result to 64 bits, eliminating the MSVC warning C4334.
net/i40e removed the branch in the FDIR code where the condition and code are duplicated.
net/ntnic removed the unused code in flow_api_profile_inline.c (Coverity 448981).
net/ntnic removed the unreachable unused code path where irq_vector >= 0 in ntnic_dbsconfig.c (Coverity 446745).
ethdev, ipc, and hash (cuckoo hash and Toeplitz hash) removed variable-length arrays (VLA), replacing them with heap allocation or fixed-size arrays.
In the igc base driver's NVM read data shift operation, fixed the static analysis warning caused by the wrong data type through explicit type conversion.
In e1000_phy.c of the e1000 base driver, fixed the comparison issue with incompatible iterator type widths, which could cause an infinite loop due to overflow.
In e1000_vf.c of the e1000 base driver, fixed the potential use of uninitialized value warning detected by static analysis by initializing the array.
In e1000_80003es2lan.c of the e1000 base driver, fixed the static analysis warning caused by the wrong data type in the SW/FW semaphore mask operation through explicit type conversion.
In e1000_nvm.c of the e1000 base driver, fixed the static analysis warning caused by the wrong data type in the NVM read data shift operation through explicit type conversion.

In vmxnet3_ethdev.h of the vmxnet3 driver, fixed the signed/unsigned type mismatch comparison warning by adding the U suffix to mark the value as unsigned, and renamed the variable to comply with the DPDK coding standard.

In multiple Intel NIC drivers (i40e, iavf, ice, ixgbe), replaced the 32-bit shift with the 64-bit shift macro, fixing the warning issued by MSVC about the implicit conversion of the 32-bit shift result to 64 bits.
In ice_dcf_sched.c of the ice driver, fixed the signed/unsigned type mismatch MSVC warning by explicitly casting the variables in the comparison.
In the mlx5 HWS debug module mlx5dr_debug.c, added support for debug information for a new specific domain.
In xsc_np.c of the xsc driver, removed the useless free call reported by Coverity scanning (USELESS_CALL).
In multiple files of the xsc driver (xsc_dev.c, xsc_rx.c, xsc_tx.c, xsc_vfio.c, xsc_vfio_mbox.c), fixed the numeric format warnings in logs reported by PVS-Studio.
In xsc_ethdev.c of the xsc driver, removed the useless conditional judgment reported by PVS-Studio.
In xsc_rx.c of the xsc driver, removed the useless conditional check reported by PVS-Studio.
In xsc_np.c and xsc_tx.c of the xsc driver, removed the useless assignment operations reported by PVS-Studio.
In roc_nix_inl_dev.c of the cnxk common driver, lowered the unnecessary error log level to debug log.
In flow_api_profile_inline.c of the ntnic driver, restricted aging event generation to physical ports only.
In rte_power_pmd_mgmt.c of the power library, deferred the unconditional assignment to the lcore variable until the call to the rte_power_ethdev_pmgmt_queue_*() public symbol.
In txgbe_phy.c of the txgbe base driver, removed the redundant if/else conditional check in SW-FW synchronization.

Fixed the build compatibility issue with GCC 15 in nicvf_mbox.c of the thunderx base driver and snippet_match_mpls.c of the flow_filtering example: the former uses an empty initializer to force full initialization of the union, the latter uses an array initializer instead of a string to initialize the unsigned char array.
In main.c of the vhost_crypto example, use new_connection and destroy_connection callbacks to handle new vhost user connections.

Improved the rte_ring_dump function to provide independent head/tail dump logic for each synchronization type, to correctly output head/tail values and additional metadata under different synchronization modes. (architecture-related: public API)

Replaced the struct packing macro, using __rte_packed_begin and __rte_packed_end instead of __rte_packed, to resolve the compatibility issue between MSVC and GCC. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)
Added diagnostic control macros and pointer type conversion macros in public header files, and added support for MSVC inline hint macros. (architecture-related: public API)
Changed the context cache field in the ixgbe Tx queue structure from an array to a pointer, and dynamically allocate memory during queue setup. (architecture-related: public API)
Removed the deprecated error conversion function in the ntnic driver and simplified the related error handling logic. (architecture-related: public API)

Removed variable-length arrays in the ice driver, replacing runtime dynamic arrays by pre-allocating extra space during queue setup, eliminating compilation warnings. (architecture-related: public API)
Removed weak symbols in the fm10k driver, instead providing stub functions on non-x86 architectures, improving platform compatibility. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)
Removed weak symbols and deprecated the __rte_weak macro, using conditional compilation to provide stub implementations for non-ARM64 architectures. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)
Removed iNVM support for i225 devices, and changed the e1000_set_ltr_i225 and e1000_access_phy_wakeup_reg_bm functions to non-static, expanding visibility. (architecture-related: public API)
Upgraded the ena-com module, removed the obsolete ena_com_get_offload_settings function, and renamed interrupt register related functions to unify naming. (architecture-related: public API)
Updated the session parameter structure of vhost/crypto to be compatible with QEMU v9, replacing VhostUserCryptoSessionParam with VhostUserCryptoSymSessionParam. (architecture-related: public API)
Added the nthw prefix to functions with abstract names in the ntnic driver to avoid exposing global symbols. (architecture-related: public API)
Consolidated the common logic for post-send buffer release in the i40e, iavf, and ice drivers into the intel common driver. (architecture-related: consolidation of common logic for Intel NIC drivers)
Deferred the allocation of the power monitoring related lcore variable, allocating it only when the related API is called, avoiding early allocation.
Allow outbound IPsec sessions to use duplicate SPI, and changed the session lookup method from SPI to SA index.

Removed variable-length arrays (VLA) in the i40e, ixgbe drivers and the GRO library, replacing them with standard C arrays, alloca(), macro substitutions, or fixed-size arrays, and in GRO, copied unprocessed packets directly to the processed position in the input array to eliminate temporary VLA.

In the eventdev, ethdev, cryptodev, compressdev, dmadev, regexdev, rawdev, mldev libraries and the ixgbe, ipn3ke, bonding, memif, nfp, enic, auxiliary drivers, removed redundant asterisks and parentheses in function pointer dereferences, unifying the *dev->dev_ops->foo and dev->dev_ops->foo forms.

In the e1000 base code, renamed VLAN PQF related macros to unify naming conventions and fix spelling errors, and renamed the variable version to nvm_version to avoid shadowing global variables on some systems.
Removed dead code for weak symbols (weak symbols) in app/test-compress-perf and drivers/common/qat, and unused variables in drivers/common/idpf and sfc_efx.
In tfc_tbl_scope.c, ulp_mapper.c, ulp_sc_mgr.c of the bnxt driver, removed null pointer checks for the rte_free() input parameter, because rte_free() itself treats NULL as a no-op.
In otx_ep_ethdev.c of the octeon_ep driver, removed identical duplicate code on both sides of the if branch in the uninit function.
Removed unused NIM_TRIGGER related code in the nt4ga_stat_setup function, and added memory allocation for the ifr_counters structure.
In ntnic_ethdev.c of the ntnic driver, removed thread shutdown and SIGINT signal handling at the PMD level.
In rte_eth_memif.c of the memif driver, changed the queue release operation from dereferencing through the dev_ops table to directly calling the driver-local function.
In the dmadev, regexdev, rawdev, compressdev, mldev libraries, removed redundant asterisks and parentheses in function pointer dereferences, unifying to the dev->dev_ops->foo form.
Removed weak symbols in the virtio, nfp, enic drivers and the auxiliary bus, instead exposing or linking stub functions (stub symbols) when needed.

In the ring library, merged the nearly identical move_prod_head() and move_cons_head() across synchronization modes into common functions, and changed enqueue_elems()/dequeue_elems() to receive only the element buffer pointer instead of the entire rte_ring structure pointer, to improve code reuse.
vhost simplified RARP packet injection handling in the synchronous and asynchronous dequeue paths, and refactored error handling in the dequeue path to improve maintainability and readability.
net/bnxt renamed the ASSERT_RETURN macro and replaced the log macro with PMD_DRV_LOG_LINE to fix the dead code issue, and simplified the CQE mode check logic.

The zxdh driver optimized queue allocation/release and port table deletion: separated rx/tx queue count management, supporting asymmetric configurations, reading queue pool information from BAR for dynamic allocation, refactored interrupt binding and mbuf release logic; added zxdh_port_attr_uninit and ZXDH_VF_PORT_UNINIT messages, PF directly deletes ERAM table entries, VF notifies PF for cleanup, and added the DTB table entry deletion helper function.
In the ptpclient example, replaced rte_memcpy() with struct assignment.
net/e1000/base rearranged ICH8LAN code to reduce indentation levels.
net/intel removed unused copies of the reassembly function in the i40e, iavf, and ice drivers.
net/ntnic replaced directly called assert with the RTE_ASSERT macro.
test/crypto returns the correct error code in create_auth_session() to avoid a segmentation fault.
test/ring fixed the issue where ring_stress_autotest initialization fails when RTE_MAX_LCORE is not a power of 2, aligning the number of elements to the next power of 2.
Add functional and stress test cases for test/ring soring API.
test adds a stress test suite, including two test cases: ring_stress_autotest and soring_stress_autotest.
test/bonding fixes the incorrect assumption about handling non-primary ports in the active backup receive test.
test/crypto fixes the incorrect assignment of plaintext.len in the AES-ECB test vector aes_test_data_19 (should be 192 instead of 64), and corrects the comment description of aes_test_data_20.
test/security adds a MACsec offload capability check before configuring Ethernet inline devices.
Skip non-C11 atomic tests under the MSVC compiler.
test replaces VLA with standard C arrays or alloca() in multiple test files for MSVC compatibility.
test/event updates the event queue configuration count from 1 to the maximum available queue count to meet adapter_pollq_instance_get test requirements.
test/crypto removes the unused session_priv_mpool member from the crypto_testsuite_params structure.
test/crypto adds validation of out-of-place header data in the GCM OOP function.
test/dma converts pointers to IOVA in IOVA physical address mode to complete API tests.
Introduce atomic test support for the eventdev application.
Add a test based on atomic queues in the test-eventdev application.
Add atomic ATQ tests for the test-eventdev application.
test/crypto skips asymmetric tests when the virtio PMD is not loaded.

In lib/eal/linux/eal_interrupts.c, change eal_epoll_wait() to use a fixed-size array and process up to @maxevents events through multiple iterations to remove variable-length arrays (VLA); also use alloca() to allocate memory on the stack for another VLA.

Optimize the mlx5 device probing process by introducing a device information cache mechanism to avoid repeated netlink communication, and change port information updates to RDMA Netlink monitor events, improving performance.
Add AVX2 vector path support for the idpf driver, including single-queue receive and transmit paths, automatically enabled on CPUs that do not support AVX512, improving performance.
Optimize rule creation performance for non-template flow API by pre-allocating thread work areas instead of heap memory allocation, reducing overhead.

Optimize the Tx queue structure layout of the i40e and ice drivers to improve cache efficiency, uniformly use a streamlined software ring structure containing only mbuf pointers, and switch to default thresholds for queue information queries, improving performance.

Unify all vector paths of the iavf driver to use a smaller and faster software ring structure, remove the AVX-512-specific setup function, and update the transmit function interface, improving performance.
Optimize receive performance of the mana NIC driver on 32-bit architectures by changing the short doorbell trigger method from immediately after each mbuf allocation to batch triggering.
Configure pool attributes based on table type, setting corresponding optimization strategies for the FDB subdomain, improving performance.
Dynamically adjust the Rx burst threshold of the bnxt driver based on link speed, configuring higher burst values for high-speed ports such as 400G, optimizing performance.

Add the cmdline-file-noecho command in app/testpmd, allowing execution of preset startup commands without echoing; also fix the file descriptor leak of the existing cmdline-file flag, and add both commands to the testpmd documentation.
Replace non-standard bit definition macros with the RTE_BIT macro in drivers/raw/gdtc.
Remove invalid loop dead code for updating speed in drivers/net/ntnic/ntnic_ethdev.c, because num_port_speeds is always zero and the pls_mbps array is only used within that loop but never set.

Optimize the link update process in the zxdh NIC driver: add an assignment to obtain link auto-negotiation status (link_autoneg); refactor the zxdh_dev_link_update function to handle link-down by jumping to a unified processing label via goto, and only call zxdh_config_port_status to configure port status when the link state changes, avoiding unnecessary port status configuration operations.

zxdh driver optimizes MAC operations: rename and extend parameters of the MAC table add/delete functions, add table lookup validation before add/delete to prevent cross-VF conflicts; adjust the MAC setting process to add-then-delete, add short-circuit return for duplicate addresses; add the vfinfo structure to maintain VF MAC information, clean up MAC table entries during VF deinitialization, and add PF-side VF MAC request handling functions and reply structures.

zxdh driver optimizes promiscuous mode operations: add VF promiscuous mode initialization/deinitialization functions, calling broadcast table settings on port start/stop; add zxdh_vf_promisc_set message handling function registered to ZXDH_PORT_PROMISC_SET; add zxdh_dev_broadcast_set to operate the broadcast table bitmap, update the port attribute table promisc_enable bitfield, replacing the original rsv3 reserved field.

zxdh driver optimizes VLAN filtering and offload: remove the VLAN filtering startup check, encapsulate the zxdh_set_vlan_filter/offload function, unify VLAN type macro naming; add the port_vlan table to independently manage VLAN stripping, QinQ stripping, and filtering status, with linked updates to the business_vlan_enable flag; adjust the port_attr table bitfield layout, add VF-side VLAN filtering table operations and offload setting message handling callbacks, and register related message types.
Replace the rte_smp_rmb memory barrier with an atomic load operation in drivers/net/r8169/r8169_rxtx.c.
Remove cache line alignment of each lcore state structure in lib/power/rte_power_pmd_mgmt.c to reduce memory usage.
Store the pool buffer size in lookup memory in drivers/net/cnxk to calculate the mbuf start address in reassembly scenarios on the fast path, and reorganize lookup memory data structures by port.
Fix array out-of-bounds issues in the hash classifier and packet descriptor modules by adding index boundary checks.
Fix the redundant address-of operator in macro DO_COMPARE_INDEXS to avoid array out-of-bounds due to pointer misuse.
Fix integer overflow issues in the XSC network driver.
Fix the issue where invalid signatures in OpenSSL RSA verification operations return an error status.
Fix the iterator type in drivers/net/intel/igc/base/igc_phy.c to eliminate static analysis warnings from comparisons of different width types, which could cause infinite loops due to overflow.
Use 64-bit macros in hash algorithm initialization in drivers/crypto/cnxk/cnxk_cryptodev_capabilities.c and drivers/crypto/openssl/rte_openssl_pmd_ops.c.
Remove redundant conditions in the if statement in drivers/common/cnxk/cnxk_security.c that are checked repeatedly.
Remove explicit dereference of function pointers in lib/security/rte_security.c, changing *instance->ops->set_pkt_metadata to the equivalent instance->ops->set_pkt_metadata form.
Remove unnecessary delays when reading security statistics in drivers/net/cnxk/cn10k_ethdev_sec.c, letting the application poll itself when statistics are not updated as expected.
Replace strncpy with strlcpy in lib/vhost/socket.c to avoid warnings about missing null terminators when fully filling strings with gcc address sanitizer.

Clarify the semantics of the RTE_ETH_EVENT_NEW event: the port is being probed but not yet available, so it is inappropriate to check validity, query information, or configure the port at this time. (architecture-related: public API)

In the mlx5 driver documentation, the restrictions for the unified FDB domain were added: template tables with the wire_orig or vport_orig flags cannot be created on group 0, and the FDB_TX domain does not support rte_flow_action_mark ID. (architecture-related: external behavior)
Announced that the vmbus API will become an internal API in the DPDK 25.11 release, and added the corresponding deprecation notice. (architecture-related: public API)
Added a list of tested Intel platforms and Intel NIC combinations in the 25.03 release notes. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)
Corrected the description of the operation scope supported by bbdev in doc/guides/prog_guide/bbdev.rst.
Updated the ionic driver guide, fixed broken links, and added a link to the DSC3-400 product brief.
Fixed syntax, spelling, and formatting issues in the DPDK 25.03 release notes, and cleaned up template comments.
Added API documentation files for multiple test suites in doc/api/dts, and added the tests package to the API documentation index to supplement missing test suite documentation.
Added documentation for the --noiommu-mode flag in doc/guides/tools/devbind.rst.
dts removed the old linter and formatter, as Ruff has been added as a replacement.
Fixed inconsistencies between the queue start/stop function flags and documentation in multiple NIC drivers (gve, mana, netvsc, virtio, vmxnet3).
Added missing 'client' devarg documentation in the vhost guide and improved other devarg descriptions.

In the mlx5 documentation, it is stated that RSS hash is fully supported only when the Hash RSS format is selected; under other CQE compression formats, some packets lack the RTE_MBUF_F_RX_RSS_HASH flag.
Updated the ZXDH network driver documentation, fixed link formatting, and added feature support descriptions.
Updated the ODM dmadev guide, removed steps related to the kernel PF driver module, and added details on the ODM PF driver application.
In the 5.3.1 section of the idxd DMA device documentation, added a naming constraint that DSA wq names must include DPDK.
Updated the version information of the e1000 base code, and synchronized the related descriptions in the release notes and README.

dts refactored the runtime internals: introduced the TestRun class to isolate test runs, changed the runtime internal state to be managed by a finite state machine (FSM), and removed TestSuiteWithCases.

dts removed the configuration distinction between SUT and TG nodes, split the DPDK configuration into DPDKBuildConfiguration and DPDKRuntimeConfiguration, and added the DPDKRuntimeEnvironment class to encapsulate DPDK runtime features.
In the mlx5 documentation, added the requirement that the P bit of VXLAN-GPE and the G bit of VXLAN-GBP must be set when matching protocols.

dts added the ability to configure per test suite, added a command-line parameter for users to pass a YAML configuration file, and this parameter becomes mandatory only when the selected test suite configuration does not provide all field defaults.
Fixed the error in the stable version documentation where the final LTS release year was not updated to 3 years with the LTS maintenance period.
In the NVIDIA BlueField guide, updated the detailed comparison between BlueField-3 and BlueField-2, compiler requirements, and fixed broken BlueField-3 documentation links.
Added platform information tested with NVIDIA NIC in the 25.03 release notes.
Updated the recommended versions in the i40e and ice NIC documentation.
dts limited each execution to running only one test run.
Fixed a build error under MSVC caused by including x86intrin.h, and now include that header only in non-MSVC environments. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)

Fixed an AVX512 compilation error under MSVC caused by __rte_aligned not supporting sizeof expressions, changed RTE_X86_ZMM_SIZE to a constant value, and added a static assertion to ensure correctness. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)

Opened a new 25.03 release cycle, updated the version number and ABI minor version, upgraded libabigail from 2.4 to 2.6 and enabled ABI checks, and added a new libxxhash dependency. (architecture-related: version and compatibility)

The Arm build system was changed to prefer -mcpu, and for SoC without a corresponding -mcpu, introduced pseudo CPU names and corresponding march and march_extensions definitions, while removing the silent fallback behavior and erroring if the compiler does not support the specified configuration. (architecture-related: build and installation methods)

Allowed disabling AVX512 instruction set support via the compiler flag -mno-avx512f, and the build system now checks user-specified c_args parameters first when detecting AVX512 capabilities. (architecture-related: build and installation methods)

Added the -fzero-init-padding-bits=all compilation option in the build configuration to force zeroing padding bits in initialized structures/unions for GCC 15, fixing potential issues caused by changes in the compiler's default behavior. (architecture-related: build and installation methods)
Added the necessary header includes for the alloca() function to the EAL header files for the FreeBSD, Linux, and Windows platforms. (architecture-related: public API)

Globally enabled the -Wvla compilation warning in the build system, defined the no_wvla_cflag variable, temporarily disabled the warning for submodules that have not yet eliminated variable-length arrays, and added compilation flags to disable the VLA warning for three drivers (nfb, mvpp2, mvsam). (architecture-related: build and installation methods)

Allowed the ice driver to compile independently when the iavf driver is not built, using conditional compilation to avoid unnecessary symbol exports. (architecture-related: build and installation methods)

Remove support for the Intel C++ compiler (icc), switch to the Intel oneAPI DPC++/C++ compiler based on clang (icx), and clean up related code comments and build configuration. (architecture-related: build and installation methods)

Fixed build warnings in the Intel NIC driver under the icx compiler caused by overriding the -march flag, by adding the -Wno-overriding-option compilation option to allow normal builds when -Werror is enabled. (architecture-related: build and installation methods)
Added a build target for using the MSVC compiler on Windows 2022 in GitHub Actions. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)
Added support for the Phytium TengYun S5000c processor in the ARM configuration. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)
Fixed the ARM configuration for NVIDIA BlueField-3, adding missing mcpu and flags definitions to resolve build errors. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)

Added AVX2 build flags for the MSVC compiler, defined the cc_avx2_flags variable in the top-level meson.build, and replaced hardcoded -mavx2 options in the builds of multiple drivers and the ACL library. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)

Separated the common flags in the x86 build configuration from the AVX512 flags, and moved the common configuration code earlier in preparation for adding MSVC-specific support later. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)

Added the -mavx512cd option to the public AVX512 flag set, and updated the ACL library build script to reuse the common variable, simplifying conditional checks and compilation parameters. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)
Allowed the dmadev library to compile under the MSVC compiler. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)
Fixed the issue in the ARM build configuration where the extra -march features of SoC were not correctly added to the -mcpu flag. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)
Fixed compilation warnings in vhost/crypto caused by signed and unsigned integer comparisons.
