Optimize the license check script, reformat the exception file list, and add display for files that do not conform to the BSD-3 license.
Change the Python string to raw string notation to avoid invalid escape sequences causing warnings or errors in Python 3.12 and future versions.
Fix warnings generated during GCC 15 compilation due to uninitialized variables, and zero-initialize the fc_params structure in fill_pdcp_chain_params.
Fix the bug in the dts-check-format script where the linter return value is not captured, ensuring errors that cannot be automatically fixed are correctly detected.
Add crypto as an additional march feature for the CN9K SoC.
Fix the Arm native build failure by adding a global definition for extra_features.
Arrange SOC configurations and names in alphabetical order in config/arm/meson.build.

In the e1000 base code, change empty unused parameter macros to use the RTE_SET_USED macro, remove the compiler warning suppression option in meson.build, and fix related warnings in osdep.c as well as trailing whitespace and redundant FreeBSD license header tags.
Fix the regular expression for SKIP_FILES in devtools/checkpatches.sh so it matches full file paths rather than just file names.
Replace the existing linter and formatter in the dts-check-format tool with Ruff.
Add flags to ignore unused variable warnings for the MSVC compiler in the meson.build of net/qede/base, common/idpf/base, and common/sfc_efx/base.
Merge multiple .gitignore files into a single top-level .gitignore, while adjusting ignore rules for DTS generated files and Linux uAPI files.
Add validity checks in CI for generated trace that can be parsed by tracing tools.
Re-enable unused variable warnings in the base code directory of the idpf driver.
Fix the failure of ccache under Ubuntu 22.04 caused by a default directory change, and explicitly set CCACHE_DIR.
Use the common variable cc_avx512_flags in the meson.build of the member library to replace duplicated AVX512 compiler flag configurations.
Switch the Git repository source in CI from dpdk.org to the GitHub mirror.
Remove the unnecessary compiler flag -fno-asynchronous-unwind-tables for MinGW from the meson.build of multiple Intel NIC drivers (i40e, iavf, ice, ixgbe).
Migrate thread safety annotations for spinlock and its derived seqlock from legacy lock function macros to clang capability annotations. (architecture-related: public API annotation migration)
Convert lock annotations for read-write locks to clang capability annotations. (architecture-related: public API annotation migration)

Remove variable-length arrays in testpmd, idpf drivers, mlx5 common library, and net/mlx5 drivers, replacing them with standard arrays or alloca() to support the MSVC compiler. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)
Replace GCC diagnostic ignored pragmas with type casts in multiple driver files to eliminate compiler warnings and improve MSVC compatibility.
Fix format differences between the e1000 driver and internal shared code, including comments, indentation, whitespace, parentheses, definitions, and redundant fall-through comments.
Remove non-inclusive language in e1000 shared code, replacing terms such as master/slave with primary/secondary.
Add error logging and hex dump functionality to the zsda driver to enhance internal debugging capabilities.
Adjust debug print formats in the e1000 base PHY code, changing PHY page and register numbers to decimal representation, and moving print positions to after value retrieval.
Improve NVM validation and handling in e1000 ich8lan, skipping update attempts when NVM is read-only and the checksum is invalid.
Add checks for the return values of rte_eth_promiscuous_enable and rte_eth_promiscuous_disable in the bonding driver.
Removed the packed attribute from the IPv6 multicast scope enumeration and adjusted the storage size. (architecture-related: public API)
dts: enable build-less DPDK driver binding
dts: decouple DPDK runtime from build
dts: fix SPDX tag
maintainers: update for some Intel FPGA drivers
dts: add SUT cleanup
dts: add port topology configuration
net/ntnic: remove experimental tag
dts: remove use of field validators
dts: simplify build options config
dts: add missing type stubs
dts: add Ruff as linter and formatter

Add a zsda crypto device driver framework supporting device configuration, start, stop, close, information retrieval, queue pair management, and statistics functions. (architecture-related: new driver framework)

Introduce an event vector adapter, providing API for creating and managing event vector adapters, supporting aggregation of objects into event vectors and offloading CPU overhead. (architecture-related: new event vector adapter API)

Refactor the ixgbe driver, centralizing common Rx/Tx queue setup functions into ixgbe_rxtx_vec_common.c, migrating Rx queue data structures to the common ci_rx_queue, and extracting duplicated Rx mbuf reclamation implementations into a common header file. (architectural event: IXGBE driver core module change)

Refactor symbol versioning macros, introduce new macros such as RTE_VERSION_SYMBOL and RTE_DEFAULT_SYMBOL, unify symbol versioning handling for GCC and MSVC, and add export macros for a large number of functions to explicitly mark exported symbols. (architecture-related: public API)

The i40e driver switches to the common Rx queue structure, unifies descriptor formats and macro definitions, and creates a common Rx queue rearm header file to support ARM Neon and PowerPC AltiVec instruction sets, replacing vectorized implementations. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)

The ice driver migrates to the common Rx queue structure, adds common definitions for flex descriptor, and generalizes the vectorized Rx ring refill implementation into a common file, unifying constants such as burst size and rearm threshold. (architecture-related: common API)

Migrate the transmit queue structures in the idpf and cpfl drivers from idpf_tx_queue to the common ci_tx_queue, synchronously updating related function type references and field names. (architecture-related: common API)
Wrap the virtq_desc structure with __rte_packed_begin and __rte_packed_end macros to avoid memory padding within the structure. (architecture-related: ABI compatibility)
Move driver export macros from the common header file to driver-specific header files to hide internal implementation details. (architecture-related: public API)

The iavf driver switches to the common Rx queue structure, replacing iavf-specific descriptors with the common format, and enforcing the use of only 32-byte descriptors. (architecture-related: common API)
Rename the --socket-mem and --socket-limit flags of EAL to --numa-mem and --numa-limit, while retaining the old names for backward compatibility.
For the MSVC compiler, redefine the __rte_constant macro via _Generic expressions, replacing __builtin_constant_p to implement compile-time constant detection.
In the cnxk common driver, add a opaque mode enable flag for NPA that overrides the default natural alignment mode.

The argparse library now records parsed arguments in an internal array, no longer modifying the user-provided argument structure, and supports reuse of the argument structure. (architecture-related: external behavior)
Remove the num_tc field, which is duplicated with hns3_hw.dcb_info, from the hns3_hw structure of the hns3 driver.
In the dlb2 event driver, enhance credit management to support threads releasing unused credits to avoid deadlocks, and add a compile-time option to control the credit check switch.

Added Rx/Tx burst mode information retrieval functionality for the ixgbe driver, along with the corresponding API and internal data structures. (architectural event: IXGBE driver adds Rx/Tx burst mode API)

Added Rx/Tx burst mode information retrieval functionality for the IAVF driver, and refactored the burst function array to support returning corresponding mode information based on the selected burst function name. (architectural event: IAVF driver adds Rx/Tx burst mode API)
Added the rte_node_free API for releasing nodes that do not belong to any graph and their memory. (architectural event: added rte_node_free API)
Exposed the next nodes enumeration definitions of the packet classification node, and added IPv4 and IPv6 FIB lookups as next-hop options. (architectural event: NFP_Common module change)
Added the IPv6 lookup FIB node, and provided the IPv6 FIB route addition common function. (architectural event: NFP_Common module change)

Added comprehensive security feature support for the CN20K crypto device, including secure session management, IPsec and TLS data path operations, TLS base framework, and raw API support. (architectural event: platform_bus_driver module change)

Added a feature arc registration mechanism and related API for the graph library, including node handler override, feature arc initialization, creation, destruction, and node addition functionality. (architectural event: NFP_Common module change)

Added the PMU event reading library, supporting direct programming and reading of PMU counters at runtime without going through the kernel, suitable for CPU core isolation scenarios; also added runtime event reading support for ARM64 and Intel x86_64 platforms. (architecture-related: added PMU library)

Migrated the cnxk_gpio driver from the deprecated sysfs GPIO interface to the character device-based GPIO v2 interface, and removed the interrupt mechanism that directly bypassed the kernel. (architecture-related: GPIO v2 interface migration)

Added the CC bit setting for the ixgbe VF driver to ensure that all VF Tx paths (including simple, offload, and vectorized paths) set the context descriptor, for compatibility with the hardware malicious driver detection (MDD) feature. (architecture-related: hardware compatibility: MDD)
Added basic PCIe ethdev probe and remove functionality for the net/rnp driver. (architecture-related: PCIe ethdev probe/remove)
Added basic mailbox operations for the rnp PMD driver, supporting communication between PF and firmware and the VF driver. (architecture-related: mailbox communication)

Added device initialization and deinitialization functionality for the RNP NIC, including firmware communication, hardware reset, MAC initialization, TX/RX queue control, interrupt handling, and resource release. (architecture-related: driver core module)

Added functionality to retrieve device hardware capabilities, including obtaining channel status, link synchronization initialization, and PF link event enabling. (architecture-related: driver core module)
Added MAC promiscuous mode support for the RNP network driver, including unicast, multicast, and broadcast promiscuous modes. (architecture-related: driver core module)
Support setting and releasing TX/RX queues, and added hardware BD queue reset and software queue reset functionality. (architecture-related: driver core module)
Added start and stop functionality for receive and transmit queues for the rnp NIC driver. (architecture-related: driver core module)
Added basic device start and stop support for the rnp network device driver, with new functions for setting common operations and clock validity checks. (architecture-related: driver core module)

Added RSS support for the rnp NIC driver, including RETA update/query, hash configuration get/update, and added RSS configuration checks in device configuration. (architecture-related: driver core module)
Added link update support for the rnp NIC driver, implementing both polling and interrupt link retrieval modes. (architecture-related: driver core module)
Added support for setting link up and down for the rnp NIC driver. (architecture-related: public API)
Added simple receive burst functionality for the rnp NIC driver, supporting checksum parsing, VLAN stripping, and receive ring filling. (architecture-related: public API)
Added simple packet transmission functionality for the rnp NIC driver, with support for VLAN insertion offload, receive ring filling, and transmit ring cleanup. (architecture-related: public API)
Support MTU setting, and in multi-port mode, receive using each port's maximum MTU limit. (architecture-related: public API)

Added support for receiving scattered multi-segment packets for the RNP NIC driver, with new receive, transmit, and cleanup functions, and updated statistics and parsing logic. (architecture-related: public API)
Added multi-segment mbuf transmission support for the rnp NIC driver. (architecture-related: public API)
Added basic statistics functionality for the rnp NIC driver, supporting hardware packet drops, TX/RX byte and packet counts. (architecture-related: public API)

Added hardware extended statistics (xstats) support for the rnp NIC driver, including MAC, Ethernet, receive, and transmit statistics, and added MTU setting functionality. (architecture-related: public API)
Added queue information retrieval functionality for the rnp NIC driver, allowing users to view TX/RX queue configuration details during debugging. (architecture-related: public API)
Added net/rnp burst mode information retrieval capability for the Rx/Tx driver. (architecture-related: public API)
Updated the CN20K model number, added cnf205 support, and added the API for identifying the corresponding models. (architecture-related: public API)

Extended the rte_str_to_size function to support larger storage units (E, P, T), and added the rte_size_to_str function to format uint64_t values into human-readable size strings. (architecture-related: public API)

Added standard PCI register offset definitions in rte_pci.h, including subsystem ID, revision ID, device status, etc., and updated the corresponding read calls in multiple drivers. (architecture-related: public API)

Introduced a process-private data area in the netvsc driver and added the get_vmbus_device function to support setting hyperv event from a secondary process. (architecture-related: secondary process support)
Added support for the Medford4 NIC family, including NIC family discovery, minimal probing, X4522 and X4542 model support, and PCI ID addition. (architecture-related: new hardware support: Medford4)

Updated the MCDI header file, adding definitions for new port directions, PCIe interfaces, event codes, MAC statistics, resource limits, and queue handling for X4 network ports. (architecture-related: public API: MCDI header file)

Enhanced the netport probing path for the Medford4 NIC, adding netport attach/detach stub functions, network port handle acquisition, hardware capability to software capability mapping, link state decoding, and loopback mode support. (architecture-related: public API: netport probing)

Implemented PHY link state acquisition and control for Medford4, refactored link mode decoding helper functions, supported 200G link modes and FEC types, and added loopback, rate, and flow control configuration. (architecture-related: public API: PHY link control)
Imported the VDUSE header file from the v6.14 kernel for the Vhost library. (architecture-related: public API)

Added link event handling to support new NICs, including handling new link change events and ignoring legacy events, while setting a flag to instruct client drivers to query link status themselves. (architecture-related: driver behavior)
Added physical port lane count control support, allowing client drivers to set and query possible values of lane count. (architecture-related: public API)
Added flow template matching support for IPv6 fragmentation extension headers in the mlx5 driver, supporting matching of the next_header field. (architecture-related: flow template matching)

In the virtio crypto device driver, increased the maximum signature size and maximum control data size to 1024 bytes and 4096 bytes, respectively, to support RSA 8K modular arithmetic. (architecture-related: public API constant changes)
Added getline and getdelim function implementations for the Windows platform to support POSIX compatibility. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)

During auxiliary process initialization, by forcing address mapping of PCI resources and using the EAL base address as a mmap hint, device resources are prevented from mapping into memory allocation areas, reducing mapping conflicts. (architecture-related: PCI resource mapping strategy)

Added complete device operations, statistics, queue pair configuration, session configuration, enqueue/dequeue data paths, and capabilities support for the zsda crypto device. (architecture-related: public API)
Added support for result address offsets in the CPT result address configuration, allowing offsets to be set relative to the WQE address. (architecture-related: public API)
Enabled the application-provided IV as the default option for CN9k, removing the conditional restriction in debug mode. (architecture-related: driver behavior)
Added the ice_add_mac_with_fltr_flag function, supporting the specification of custom flag bits when adding MAC filter rules. (architecture-related: public API)
Added support for 12-bit sequence number sizes in PDCP user-plane processing. (architecture-related: public API)
Adjusted the headroom of the buffer layout in the dpaa2 driver to provide sufficient headroom for IPSec and TX dynamic acknowledgment functionality. (architecture-related: cross-module behavior)
Added an operation index retrieval interface for the DPAA2 memory pool, and validated the uniqueness of operation indices when creating the pool. (architecture-related: public API)
Merged the -l option with --lcores, and exported the rte_vect_set_max_simd_bitwidth symbol. (architecture-related: public API)
Added the force_tail_drop device parameter for NIX devices, which when enabled forces tail drop and doubles the CQ descriptors. (architecture-related: configuration interface)
Added the disable_xqe_drop device parameter to disable XQE drop in the RQ context. (architecture-related: configuration interface)
Added RSS support based on the RoCEv2 header for cnxk devices, adding new flow key types and extending RSS offload capabilities. (architecture-related: RSS extension)
Added a default software vector adapter for event devices, falling back to a service-core-based software implementation when hardware does not support it. (architecture-related: public API)
Moved constant definitions in the FIB library to header files, and exported the rte_fib6_create and rte_fib6_find_existing functions. (architecture-related: public API)
Added the IPv4 lookup FIB node, and provided the rte_node_ip4_fib_route_add public function for route addition. (architecture-related: public API)
Added IPv4 and IPv6 lookup mode commands, supporting switching between LPM and FIB modes, and updated the routing table logic. (architecture-related: public API)
Added PCI probing and removal support for the CN20K crypto device. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)
Added the enqueue path for the CN20K crypto device, including the lmtst dual-submission routine and IPsec/TLS secure session instruction filling. (architecture-related: public API)
Added RSS functionality based on the RoCE v2 header, including corresponding RSS type macros and test command options. (architecture-related: public API)
Added graph library support for feature arc, including IPv4 output direction feature arc and example programs. (architecture-related: public API)
Improved the latency statistics library, added a sample count metric, and optimized logging and API export. (architecture-related: API export)
Added a feature to switch the VF transmit queue for the ixgbe driver to work around a hardware defect. (architecture-related: public API)
Added a check for the maximum number of gather entries in CNXK CPT PMD. (architecture-related: public API)
Added a metadata field in the CNXK CPT driver to pass custom metadata to the firmware. (architecture-related: public API)
Added driver support for the RTL8168EP/FP/G/H/M NIC and refactored the DASH code. (architecture-related: new driver support)
Added support for parsing string and boolean parameter types for the argparse library. (architecture-related: public API)
Added 5-tuple flow filtering support to the txgbe VF driver. (architecture-related: public API)
Added IPv4/IPv6 SCTP protocol RSS offload support to the txgbe NIC driver. (architecture-related: public API)
Added IPv4/IPv6 SCTP protocol RSS offload support to the ngbe NIC driver. (architecture-related: public API)
Added support for pre-allocating contiguous memory for Tx queues in the mlx5 driver, with memory alignment controlled via the device parameter txq_mem_algn. (architecture-related: public API)
Added SAMPLE action support for mlx5 non-template flow API. (architecture-related: public API)
Added event vector adapter support for the CN20K event device, including creation, destruction, and enqueue functions for the vector adapter. (architecture-related: public API)
Added support for the event/dlb2 driver to perform data path operations in secondary processes. (architecture-related: secondary process support)
Added crypto adapter support for the CN20K platform, implementing adaptation between event devices and crypto devices. (architecture-related: crypto adapter)
Added support for managing the historical list resources of DLB2 event device ports via command-line parameters, and added a runtime API to set port parameters. (architecture-related: public API)
Added global mbuf dynamic field support to the node library, providing API for registering and retrieving dynamic fields. (architecture-related: public API)
Synchronized ethtool link modes to Linux 6.15, adding rate modes such as 200G, 400G, and 800G. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)
Added PF mode support for the MANA NIC. (architecture-related: driver compatibility)
Added cross-NUMA node memory allocation support to the mlx5 driver, automatically falling back to other nodes when the local NUMA node has no available memory. (architecture-related: NUMA support)
Added a standalone mirror creation function, splitting the HWS mirror functionality into two steps: mirror action creation and indirect list handle creation. (architecture-related: public API)
Added a correct implementation of queue start/stop functionality for the net/ntnic driver, and support for delayed queue start. (architecture-related: public API)

The hns3 VF driver added support for multiple TC capabilities; VF can obtain the maximum TC count from mailbox, and supports configuring multiple TC via the DCB interface; the configuration must be consistent with PF and does not support PFC. (architecture-related: public API)
The ENA NIC driver added segmented bypass mode support, controllable via devarg enable_frag_bypass, disabled by default. (architecture-related: devarg configuration)
In EAL Linux VFIO detection, added a check for container scenarios; when /dev/vfio is not mapped, skip invalid VFIO container detection to avoid error logs and process delays.

Added multiple features to the zxdh network processor driver: register read/write interface, software and firmware compatibility check, agent channel, DTB queue configuration, eram table read/write and delete, flow table resource acquisition, hash resource configuration and table operations, ACL table entry operations, and added related initialization functions.
Added basic PMD library and documentation build infrastructure for the rnp NIC driver, and updated the maintainers file.
Added log macros and log type registration for the rnp driver, supporting debug and trace log output.
Added unicast MAC address filtering to the RNP NIC driver, supporting MAC address setting and clearing in single-port and multi-port modes.
Added supported hardware packet type parsing to the rnp NIC driver, and registered MAC address filtering operations.
Added checksum offload support for receive-direction L3/L4 and tunnel inner L3/L4 to the rnp NIC driver.
Added Tx TSO offload support to the rnp NIC driver, including support for VXLAN and GRE tunnel TSO.
Added VLAN offload support to the rnp NIC driver, including receive VLAN stripping and filtering, transmit VLAN, and QinQ insertion.
Added VLAN filter support to the rnp NIC driver, including VLAN ID update functionality.
Added multicast MAC filtering support to the RNP network driver, including MAC filtering for single-port and multi-port modes.
Added RSS hashing support for ESP and RoCEv2 protocols to the cnxk network device driver.
Added RSS algorithm configuration query functionality to the NFP NIC driver, and refactored related functions to support getting and setting RSS hash types.
Added RSS algorithm capability query functionality in the NFP NIC driver, invoked during device information retrieval and initialization, and added logging of related capabilities.
Added support for the E31X series devices to the ZXDH NIC driver, adding device ID for E312S, E316, E310_RDMA, and E312_RDMA, and extracted the PF determination logic into a separate function.
Support gVNIC PCI revision 1 and later, use full address to set up the management queue, and introduce a new device/driver reset mechanism.
Added Rx/Tx burst mode information retrieval functionality to the e1000 NIC driver, which returns the corresponding mode based on the selected burst function name.
Added support for multiple port modes to the Medford4 NIC, including 8 port mode, X4 port mode, and an extended port mode list.
Added Rx/Tx burst mode information retrieval functionality to the virtio NIC driver; the new function returns the corresponding mode name based on the currently selected burst function.
Enabled ethertype filtering support for the E610 NIC.
Added MAC operations, reconfiguration, and PDU control functionality to the Medford4 NIC.
Added MAC statistics functionality to the Medford4 NIC, including clearing, uploading, updating, and periodic DMA updates.
Added 200G link speed support to the sfc driver, including physical capability mapping, FEC capability query, and link information reporting.
Added optional parameters prio-tc and keep-qnum to the DCB configuration command of testpmd, and support for disabling the DCB feature.
Enabled FEC auto-disable functionality for the E825C device to support PHY FEC error log configuration.
Moved the mbuf timestamp dynamic field and flag into the ice_rx_queue structure so that the timestamp offload feature works correctly in secondary processes.
Added dequeue path support to the CN20K crypto device, including post-dequeue processing, TLS MAC trimming, and event metadata setting.
Supported asymmetric sessionless operations in CNXK CPT PMD.
Added support for the RTL8127 10GbE controller and refactored the MAC MCU patch version check.
Removed the CMAC feature from the RTL8125AP NIC and added IPC2 support.
Added support for the RTL8125CP NIC chip.
Added serdes interface support to the RTL8127ATF NIC.
Added IP-in-IP tunnel support to the mlx5 driver.
Added clock reading functionality to the ice driver, supporting retrieval of the current system time (in nanoseconds) for send-time-based packet scheduling.
Added timestamp-based transmission (Tx packet pacing) support to the E830 NIC.
Supported cross-NUMA memory allocation in testpmd, using arbitrary socket memory allocation when GRO is disabled or the --no-numa flag is set.
The AF_XDP driver added Rx/Tx queue configuration support, preferring rx/tx queue counts over combined queue configuration when the device supports it.
Introduced a stub implementation of the PHY method for Medford4 in the sfc_efx generic driver, providing an initial no-op method framework.
Added process callback functions for the IPv4 FIB and IPv6 FIB lookup nodes, respectively.
Added support for the GRE protocol as a L4 layer participating in entropy calculation in the flow hardware offload code of the mlx5 driver.
Registered the fanout mode parameter for af_packet and printed configuration information during initialization.
The crypto/dpaa2_sec driver added NULL algorithm capability and updated the corresponding configuration in documentation and private header files.

The crypto/dpaa2_sec driver supports simple IPsec FD; for IVP mode, it stores the op context point aligned to 8 bytes before expansion; otherwise, it stores them at the mbuf offset after registration via rte_mbuf_dynfield.
The crypto/cnxk driver added global CPT LF statistics for lookaside IPsec.
The crypto/cnxk driver added dev info get implementation for the CN20K device.
The net/r8169 driver supports RTL8127AP dash functionality.
Added sessionless asynchronous operation support for CN20K.

Converted locks and memory allocation functions to macros and removed the ixgbe_osdep.c file to fix thread safety analysis errors reported by lock checker on FreeBSD. (architectural event: IXGBE_Driver_Core module change)
Fixed the issue where mlx5 PMD incorrectly triggered VLAN workaround on non-x86 architectures due to the unknown hypervisor type. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)
Added extern "C" protection in the cryptodev header file to ensure exported global variables can be used correctly in C++ code. (architecture-related: public API)
Fixed errors caused by non-static constant initialization during MSVC compilation by replacing in-function static arrays with macro calls. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)

Fixed the check logic for IPv4 compatible addresses and mapped addresses, correcting the prefix comparison length from 32 bits to 96 bits, and added corresponding unit tests. (architecture-related: public API)
Fixed a potential null pointer dereference in the rte_pcapng_close function and added symbol export for that function. (architecture-related: public API)
Removed variable-length arrays incompatible with MSVC from the RCU library, using alloca as a temporary solution. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)

Supported multi-host LAG probing, extending the LAG port array and allowing holes in the middle to avoid array out-of-bounds access caused by discontinuous port identifiers. (architecture-related: public API)
Fixed the issue in the QAT driver where AEAD raw API overwrote destination header bytes in out-of-place mode. (architecture-related: public API)

Triggered defragmentation and retry when MCAM allocation fails, adjusted allocation parameters based on KEX configuration type, and supported MCAM reading for CN20K. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)
Optimized message handling for compatibility with older firmware versions and fixed related issues. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)

Adjusted the setting of the aura offset in the NPA_LF_POOL_OP_INT register according to the platform to accommodate changes in the aura field width on cn20k. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)

Fixed an issue where mmap failure due to insufficient process address space caused an infinite loop; retries are now stopped when the request size cannot be reduced. (architecture-related: core module: memory allocation behavior)

Reverted the automatic port attach/detach feature, restoring manual port management, and fixed compatibility issues with auxiliary processes such as pdump. (architecture-related: external behavior: port management method)
Standardized the byte order of Rx descriptors, ensuring all read and write operations correctly use little-endian byte order. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)
Fixed the byte order issue in NFD3 transmit descriptors by converting the relevant fields to little-endian format. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)

Corrected the MAC PDU calculation for Medford4 network cards, added a generic helper function, and switched the net/sfc driver to use it, avoiding the legacy bug fix macro. (architecture-related: public API)
Standardized the byte order of NFDk transmit descriptors to little-endian and modified the relevant field types. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)
Fixed the address calculation for the vmbus ring buffer data area, using the system page size instead of a fixed 4k. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)
Fixed the Hyper-V page size issue in the vmbus driver, using the 4k page size from Hyper-V instead of the system page size. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)

Fixed the issue where the netvsc driver used the system page size instead of the Hyper-V page size, ensuring RNDIS implementation and PFN calculations communicate correctly with Hyper-V VSP. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)
Modified the MCDI structure access macros to add uintptr_t casts to support buffers with the const qualifier, avoiding compilation warnings. (architecture-related: public API)
Fixed an overflow issue in per-core trace buffers by aligning the offset before checking for sufficient write space. (architecture-related: public API)
Fixed an issue where chained, encrypted, and authenticated operations in QAT RAW API overwrote the data header in OOP mode. (architecture-related: public API)

Removed unsupported METER flow actions in MLX5 HWS mode; applications should use METER_MARK actions instead. Also fixed the HWS large flow mode error notification to ensure the E2BIG error value is correctly propagated in flow error notifications. (architecture-related: behavior change)
Fixed a potential deadlock caused by queues and mutexes in high-traffic learning scenarios, and made the learn_ignored flag read/write atomic to avoid thread races. (architecture-related: public API)

Fixed a race condition in the PCI UIO device existence check under FreeBSD by using open(2) instead of access(2) to avoid the device file being removed after the check. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)

Fixed out-of-bounds access and uninitialized variable issues in SM2 signature verification preprocessing in the cnxk crypto driver, added upper bound checks for private key length and public key coordinate length, and fixed an uninitialized local variable in the cnxk_ae_fill_ec_params function. (architecture-related: public API)

Fixed CRC data release and KEEP_CRC offload issues during multi-segment mbuf reception in the hns3 driver, ensuring that the last segment containing only CRC data is not incorrectly released, recalculating CRC for specific short packets when KEEP_CRC is enabled, and prohibiting the use of KEEP_CRC under NEON or SVE algorithms. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)

Fixed a race condition in the PDCP key command by adding a CALM instruction in the 12-bit SN scenario and falling back to the legacy descriptor in the 18-bit SN scenario. (architecture-related: public API)

Fixed an issue where the driver might skip disable operations when promiscuous mode and all-multicast are disabled due to early variable reset; also added symbol exports for rte_eth_allmulticast_disable and rte_eth_allmulticast_get. (architecture-related: public API)
Fixed the setting order of the last segment length during scatter list filling and added a check for the number of segments exceeding the maximum supported count. (architecture-related: public API)

In the cnxk crypto driver, added checks for the maximum gather entries for outbound and inbound SA processing and TLS read operations, returning an error when the number of segments exceeds the limit. (architecture-related: public API)

Added a time_t type alias definition based on the _TIME_BITS macro in trace metadata to support Y2038 issues, fixing compilation failures on 32-bit systems. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)
Fixed the CQ tail drop feature to correctly enable when inline IPsec is disabled, and added control options for forced tail drop and disabling XQE drop. (architecture-related: public API)
Fixed a crash caused by the rte_flow_configure function not filling the error structure on the error path. (architecture-related: public API)
Moved the crypto instruction debug dump function for CN10K to common code for use by CN20K, and fixed a field error in queue pair statistics. (architecture-related: public API)

Fixed a protocol type conversion error in GTP packet parsing, ensuring that GTP protocol types are correctly converted to Ethernet protocol types to support subsequent parsing; also added filling of the tunnel length field in UDP tunnel parsing, fixed the protocol type judgment logic for GTP packets, and exported the rte_net_skip_ip6_ext symbol. (architecture-related: public API)
Fixed MSVC compilation errors by replacing inline assembly with compiler builtins __cpuid and _InterlockedCompareExchange128. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)

Fixed the link status mismatch issue on E610 adapters by adding a mailbox operation for the VF driver to request actual link data from PF, and updated the mailbox API to v1.6. (architecture-related: mailbox API)
Fixed a compilation failure by adding the necessary include in the header file. (architecture-related: public API)

Added a 64-byte alignment check for the hardware GRO feature, ensuring that DMA addresses meet alignment requirements on HIP08 platforms, otherwise disabling the GRO feature. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)

The argparse library now supports the -- parameter termination parsing and returns the actual number of parsed parameters to be compatible with EAL parameter behavior. (architecture-related: public API)

Fixed the unhandled case where sysconf(_SC_PAGESIZE) returns a negative value, updated rte_mem_page_size() to add error checking, and replaced all library functions that directly call sysconf(_SC_PAGESIZE) with calls to rte_mem_page_size(). (architecture-related: public API)

Fixed a C++ compilation error on x86 platforms when using RTE_FORCE_INTRINSICS, caused by a missing closing brace for the extern "C" in rte_atomic.h and rte_byteorder.h. (architecture-related: public API)
Changed the eventdev-related flag macros from 64-bit constants to 32-bit bit operation macros to be consistent with the corresponding structure field types. (architecture-related: public API)

Extended the mailbox timeout from 1200 milliseconds to 2500 milliseconds to avoid failures of control network API requests due to too short a timeout, improving reliability. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)
Fixed C++ compatibility issues by using conditional compilation to avoid compilation errors caused by zero-size unions. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)

Fixed an issue where the device might be falsely reported as unresponsive when the control path polling interval is too low; the lower bound of the valid interval range was adjusted from 1 milliseconds to 500 milliseconds. (architecture-related: public API)
Fixed the unmapping of DMA during queue release and handled the multiple mapping issue when IOMMU is not optimized. (architecture-related: public API)

Fixed the configuration method for queue and TC mapping in the hns3 network card VF scenario, using firmware commands instead of directly writing registers. (architecture-related: driver behavior change)
Fixed MSVC compilation errors by replacing sizeof(rte_v128u32_t) with the macro MLX5_SIZE_MOV16 to eliminate the undeclared identifier issue. (architecture-related: build compatibility)

Fixed the out-of-order issue caused by Rx CQEs arriving out of order in the shared CQE queue, introduced a sliding window mechanism to track WQE processing progress, and added a new Rx burst function that supports out-of-order processing. (architecture-related: public API)
Fixed the crypto/virtio driver's RSA public key DER encoding, which now includes only the modulus and exponent values per the RFC 8017 standard, and added a separate encoding function.
Fixed the net/mlx5 driver's maximum queue size query, added support for Verbs mode, and updated the corresponding limit checks so that older NICs that do not support DevX work correctly.
eal fixed rte_lcore_has_role()'s return value for invalid lcore ID, changing it from a negative value to false, without requiring callers to pre-validate ID.

Fixed the event/dlb2 driver: set the maximum available credits before device probing based on the hardware version; fixed the issue where the number of ports for a single link on DLB2.5 was returned as 64 instead of 96; fixed a credit release race condition caused by concurrency between the main thread and worker threads during port unbinding.

Removed incorrect export symbol declarations in multiple lib files in drivers and version.map, including inline helper functions, eal_log_journal and roc_se_ctx_swap without implementations, and the enum marker rte_dpaa2_dev_type.
The crypto/openssl driver now includes the private exponent in the RSA session, following RFC 8017 (A.1.2), so that OpenSSL 1.1.1 can implicitly reject invalid ciphertext.
Updated the common/cnxk CN20K CPT parse header hardware structure.
Removed support for the ZUC-256 algorithm in the QAT driver.
Fixed the memset size calculation issue for SHA3 hashing in the QAT driver, ensuring correct zeroing.
In the bus cleanup function, when removing a device object, it is now removed from the device list to maintain programming practice compliance.
Fixed a use-after-free issue in the zero-copy transmit path caused by incorrect timing of tx_bytes calculation.
Refactored the AF_XDP zero-copy transmit path, extracted the common logic for descriptor retention and filling into an inline function, and fixed the transmit byte count position.
Improved the ASLR check by adding detection of whether the current process has address randomization disabled via the setarch command, to supplement the sysfs file check.
Fixed the order of cleanup operations on startup failure to avoid assertions caused by incorrect ordering.
Adjusted the flag bits of the IPv6 fragment extension header for the CN20K device to fit the low 4-bit available space.
Fixed the buffer refill logic error for the SDP output queue in the octeon_ep driver.
Fixed a crash in the ipsec-secgw example caused by accessing the val_eth array out of bounds when an LPM lookup fails due to an unconfigured IPv6 rule.
Fixed the E610 register selection error for VF devices, and added the missing E610 VF branch in the RSS hash configuration related functions.
Corrected the definition of the IXGBE_LE32_TO_CPUS macro, removed the unnecessary uintptr_t cast, and eliminated the related compilation warning.
Fixed compilation warnings by improving macro definitions and adding two lines of code to eliminate unused parameter and unused variable warnings.
Reduced compilation warnings by removing unused variables and fixing an incorrect pointer reference in a memory allocation.
Fixed the RSS hash key length get and set logic to avoid issues caused by incorrectly reading and writing the MAC address register.
Fixed the issue in port_rss_hash_key_update() where the user-input RSS hash type was overwritten by rte_eth_dev_rss_hash_conf_get(), ensuring that the RSS hash key update takes effect as expected.
Fixed a crash in the NFP NIC driver caused by a null pointer when getting the RSS hash configuration.
Fixed the issue in the null driver where copying during transmission could copy extra data, and changed it to copy only the data of the current mbuf segment.
Fixed a crash or system lockup caused by an unmasked control virtqueue ring index, and corrected the assignment of the used ring element length.

Fixed the issue where CN20K hardware cannot automatically correct the IP header of reassembled packets; software now updates the IPv4 length, MF bit, and checksum of reassembled packets, as well as the IPv6 length and fragment extension header removal, and also corrected the data length of the last segment of multi-segment decrypted packets.
Fixed the issue in the ice NIC driver where statistics counter overflow caused abnormal data, and extended the counter limit to the full 64 bits.
Fixed the cipher data length calculation error in chained encryption in vhost/crypto, and directly used the passed correct length value.
Fixed the ciphertext data source length calculation in chained processing of symmetric algorithms, now considering both cipher and authentication data lengths.
Fixed an integer overflow issue during interrupt unmapping in the hns3 driver, and expanded the interrupt vector variable type from uint8_t to uint16_t.
Fixed a memory leak of indirect flow actions in the hns3 driver, and changed the storage of indirect actions from dynamically allocated pointers to uint64_t values.
Fixed the missing interrupt rollback after Tx queue startup failure during port startup.
Fixed a divide-by-zero error in the hns3 driver caused by the hardware returning a total queue count of zero, and added validation of the total queue count.
Fixed the issue where dev_stop did not release resources such as Rx interrupt mappings during device reset, and added a reset state check to prevent erroneous operations.

Fixed the issue of receiving large packets in the ice driver: moved the selection of the Rx function from before queue startup to after queue startup, ensuring the correct Rx function is selected based on the actual buffer size and MTU relationship.
Removed the unused enum constant VIRTCHNL2_CAP_OEM to fix the compiler truncation warning caused by initializing a 32-bit enum member with a 64-bit value.
Fixed the missing hardware state check in the event/cnxk timer arm routine, ensuring that when a thread holding the bucket lock is scheduled out, it correctly waits for the hardware state.
Fixed the index calculation error when releasing flow rules, avoiding memory access out of bounds caused by using a fixed limit.
Fixed an overflow issue when sending control messages in the nfp driver, and adjusted the number of write operations to match 32-bit data transfer.
Fixed the issue in the igb driver where the Tx queue offload capability incorrectly returned the port offload capability, and changed it to return zero to indicate no queue-specific capability.
Fixed the EEPROM dump failure in the e1000 driver, corrected the boundary condition check, and allowed the legal case where first + offset equals word_size.
Fixed a use-after-free issue during dpio device cleanup in the fslmc bus, and switched to a safe traversal macro to avoid accessing freed memory.
Fixed the default port mask value of the fdir filter in the ixgbe driver, changing it from 0xFF to 0 to support processing raw IP packets.
Fixed a resource leak caused by an early return on a null pointer in the xsc_rss_qp_create function, changing it to jump to the error handling path.
Optimized the release path and fixed resource leaks during device close and unload.
Changed the per-queue and rx_nombuf statistics counters to accumulation mode to correctly aggregate data from VF.
Added default port information filling on the netport attach path, including the legacy Siena field.
Relaxed the limit on the number of traffic classes in the DCB command, now supporting 2 to 8 TC.

Corrected the calculation of the required number of WQE in inline data scenarios to be more precise; when the requested queue capacity cannot be met due to inline adjustments, it no longer returns an error but issues a warning and creates the queue with the maximum available size.
Fixed flow/table creation failures caused by unnecessary insertion of NOP when using modify field action on group 0 flow rules.
Added missing validation for the GTP PSC QFI flow field width to support modify field flow actions.
Fixed the issue where error codes were not correctly propagated during counter pool initialization, ensuring the correct error code is returned on allocation failure.

Fixed the issue where the mlx5 counter service did not clean up the background service thread on initialization failure; moved service thread creation to the end of pool initialization to ensure proper resource release.
Fixed a segmentation fault caused by passing an incorrect object handle when configuring VLAN stripping on Rx hairpin queues.
Fixed the validation logic for the GENEVE option in non-template API, validating only for template rules, with the parser deferred until rule creation.
Fixed a potential null pointer dereference in GRE flow item validation by adding a null check for the gre_item pointer.
Fixed the issue where send queue synchronization was skipped when destroying FW WQE rules, avoiding permanent blocking of queue operations.
Fixed the flex tunnel flow pattern validation issue, ensuring that packet items after the flex item in the template are correctly recognized as inner headers.
Fixed a potential dereference issue in rte_bbdev_queue_configure caused by conf being a null pointer; added a null check before calling the trace function.

Fixed the issue where the statistics sum in the net/ntnic driver did not include all queues; now transmit and receive data from all queues are included in the total, while per-queue detailed statistics are still kept only for the first RTE_ETHDEV_QUEUE_STAT_CNTRS.
Explicitly used 64-bit unsigned integers in shift operations to avoid precision issues caused by implicit type conversion.

Fixed the issue in the net/ntnic driver where memory allocation failures were not handled correctly; added a check on the calloc return value to ensure an error is returned or resources are released on allocation failure.
Fixed the host-side FEC enable logic by removing redundant initialization and correcting the loop boundary condition.
Added return value checks for IIC scan calls, logging an error and returning an error code on failure.
Fixed a potential division-by-zero error in the statistics initialization function by adding a zero-value check for the RPP parameter.
Fixed the issue of missing completion steps in ring queue operations and redesigned the queue read operation.
Fixed the issue of incorrect VSI node placement when only 3 scheduler levels are used in the ice driver; added logic to move VSI nodes down to the correct level.
Fixed the SEC error caused by invalid key commands in the PDCP AES 12-bit SN scenario, adjusting the generation logic for control-plane encryption operations and user-plane encapsulation descriptors.
Fixed the uninitialized variable issue in the dpaa2_sec driver by explicitly setting the authentication algorithm type during PDCP session setup.
Fixed a segmentation fault caused by using the wrong length during E-tag pattern parsing; changed to use the correct pattern item length.
In the virtio crypto driver, added parameter checks for encryption and chained requests on the request side and corrected the calculation of source data length.
Configured the CPT result address offset for the CN20K platform and fixed the logic for obtaining the CPT queue ID.
On non-cn10k platforms, return an error if spb_ena is set when inline RQ is enabled, to fix configuration issues with inbound CPT LF ID.
Updated the buffer size in lookup-mem by default to maintain data ordering.
Added a support check for the CPT05 microcode version in the Rx inject configuration function, returning an error if not supported.
Fixed a type conversion warning in the ice_sched_move_vsi_to_agg function by changing the loop variable type from u16 to u8 to avoid data loss, and added a memory barrier instruction.
Fixed a typo in the fiber media type check in ice_set_media_type, changing the incorrect C2C type to the correct C2M to prevent some AOC devices from being incorrectly identified as AUI media type.
Fixed a potential integer overflow when calculating powers of 2 in the ice_is_pow2 function.
Increased the reset timeout of the ice driver from 5 seconds to 20 seconds to support the longer reset time required by E830 hardware due to the secure key feature.
Fixed the driver ID setting location for the virtio and virtio_user crypto PMD, ensuring the driver ID is correctly assigned during device initialization.

Optimized MTU configuration by skipping the setting when the kernel MTU already matches the requested value, avoiding the need for NET_ADMIN privileges; also updated the supported packet type list to include the out-of-order receive function.

Fixed the issue of residual invalid entries in the MAC address table when reconfiguring the device; by initializing the MAC address index mapping and maintaining address copies, the index state is correct during add, delete, and flush operations.
Fixed the issue of incorrect descriptor count updates during Rx queue reconfiguration in the cnxk NIC driver, ensuring the initial input descriptor count is used.
Fixed a segmentation fault caused by improper cleanup when using multiple devices; changed device release to call rte_cryptodev_pmd_release_device.
Fixed the flow rule identification issue for template API creation, ensuring its nt_rule flag is correctly set to false.
Fixed the used length of the vhost control virtqueue to correctly represent the number of bytes written rather than the number of descriptors.
Changed the memory access permission of the virtqueue driver region from read-write to read-only to be compatible with all backend configurations.
Fixed the virtio driver's Tx release threshold check logic so that buffer release is correctly triggered when the number of free descriptors falls below the threshold.
Reconfigured the K1 exit timeout, optimized the workaround for clock synchronization, and reduced power consumption.
Disabled support for PTP capability based on PHY.
Fixed the setting of the salt value in the AES-CTR algorithm, ensuring correct copying and byte order conversion, and added test cases and test vectors for AES-CTR encryption mode.
Fixed the issue where the queue size was not reconfigured when the CPT instruction queue was enabled, ensuring that NQ_PTR and DQ_PTR are correctly reset each time it is enabled.

Fixed the compatibility issue between the vector algorithm and the offload/filtering functionality in the hns3 driver, allowing the vector algorithm to be used when Tx offload is not enabled, and allowing the Rx vector algorithm to be used when VLAN filtering is enabled.
Fixed the issue where MAC control frame forwarding configuration became invalid after port stop/start on txgbe and ngbe NICs, ensuring that flow control functionality still works after port restart.
Fixed the read errors of rx_undersize_errors and tx_broadcast_packets in the statistics of txgbe and ngbe devices, corrected the register addresses, and switched to rd64() to obtain complete counts.

Fixed the calculation issue when the TSC frequency is a non-integer number of nanoseconds in the latencystats library, switching to floating-point numbers and precomputing the number of cycles per nanosecond.
Excluded MACsec statistics for E610 devices to avoid displaying meaningless xstats.
Updated the PHY configuration and MCU patches for RTL8125B, 8125D, and 8126A, and introduced a MCU patch version check logic.
Fixed the out-of-place chain/encryption/authentication header issues for gen3 and gen4 in the QAT driver.
Fixed the ntuple filter parsing error so that specific patterns (such as ipv4/udp/raw) can be correctly parsed as FDIR rules rather than ntuple filters.
Fixed the matching of raw pattern in FDIR rules, converting strings to hexadecimal bytes and supporting relative offsets.
Fixed the packet type matching of the FDIR filter on the txgbe NIC, adding a packet type mask to support more flexible type matching under the default pattern.
Fixed the support for IPv6 in the FDIR perfect mode of the txgbe driver, removing the previous restriction that prohibited IPv6 and adding the corresponding hardware configuration.
Fixed the logic for creating FDIR filters for tunnel packets in the txgbe driver, now supporting inner matching for VXLAN, GRE, NVGRE, and GENEVE protocols.
Removed the duplicate reservation of FDIR header space, fixing the issue where the RX packet buffer size was 256KB less than the theoretical value.
Fixed the hardware limitation of VLAN stripping configuration on VF, allowing VLAN stripping offload to be configured only when the device is started.

Fixed issues related to RSS hash configuration in the ice DCF driver, including obtaining the currently configured hash type and extracting the logic for setting the RSS key, making its behavior consistent with PF and other drivers.
Added a check for invalid socket ID during memory allocation initialization to avoid potential issues.
Fixed the issue where the VLAN stripping flag was not synchronized after setting VLAN filtering in the iavf driver, explicitly disabling stripping to maintain consistency with the DPDK side.

Handled the failure of sysconf to query page size, added the mem_page_size() function in the PMU library, and modified the cleanup_events function to use this function, avoiding unhandled negative return values.
Fixed a null pointer crash caused by an uninitialized pointer when destroying the HWS counter pool.
Fixed the issue in the mlx5 driver where accessing auxiliary flow data might access stale memory, separating the auxiliary data acquisition paths for template and non-template flows.

Fixed the out-of-bounds access issue in the cnxk_gpio driver caused by ioctl returning an invalid flags when the underlying GPIO device is removed, by adding boundary checks and returning error codes to avoid it.
Fixed the segmentation fault caused when querying the AGE action of flow rules using indirect connection tracking, by adding a check to prevent AGE queries on indirect CT actions.
Fixed the descriptor flag error in the virtio encryption device and updated the virtqueue metadata management.
Fixed the issue in the mlx5 driver where the mirror action under the unified FDB domain caused abnormal STC resource allocation due to incorrect group identifier settings.

Fixed the issue of incorrect WQE size calculation for the Tx queue in the mlx5 driver, ensuring that the calculated WQE size is not less than 64 bytes, avoiding incorrect total WQE count calculation when the descriptor count is 512.
Fixed the inconsistent placement of the VLAN tag in the Rx queue of the ice driver, using the queue's register index instead of the queue ID when updating the l2tsel field.
Fixed the handling of interrupt registration or enable failure during device initialization in control path interrupt mode, adding error checking and cleanup logic.
Fixed the segmentation fault caused by missing validation when using masked indirect age actions in action templates, and removed redundant debug assertions.
Fixed the adjustment logic for the maximum inline data size when creating queues using Verbs, ensuring it conforms to the accepted range of the rdma_core library.
Fixed the issue of calling the wrong virtchnl operation when disabling VLAN stripping on NICs supporting ADQ v2.
Fixed the resource leak issue in the mlx5 driver caused by the reference count not being correctly decremented when the Tx queue is started.
In bonding PMD, when the device is configured with flow isolation mode, skip the RSS RETA update operation to avoid errors caused by calling the unsupported API.
Fixed the missing flag for RSS support of pure IPv4 traffic in the i40e driver, adding the corresponding pctype mapping.
Fixed the crash issue during auxiliary bus device cleanup caused by not verifying the driver's existence.
Reverted the fix for the Tx release threshold check, which caused a performance regression.

Fixed the mismatch in Tx queue length calculation across different modes, by adding a boolean parameter to the txq_calc_wqebb_cnt function to distinguish Devx mode, and switching to a more accurate WQ size acquisition method.
Fixed the parameter mismatch issue when calling the cryptodevs_init function in the ipsec-secgw example, which caused incorrect queue pair initialization.
Fixed the include order of vector code in the IAVF driver, avoiding compilation errors caused by incorrectly enabling 16 byte descriptors.
Reverted the change of cleaning up ports on exit in the multi-process example to avoid the error where the primary process closing the port causes the secondary process to crash.

Fixed build issues for multiple tests and applications under MSVC compilation: test_ipfrag removed zero-length arrays; test_per_lcore fixed atomic qualifier warnings; testpmd fixed void function return values, bitmask truncation, and the use of preprocessor directives in the dump command list macro; test_ring_perf marked lcore_count as an atomic variable.
app/testpmd fix integer format warnings under MSVC compilation, correcting the format corresponding to uint64_t in printf from %d.
net/mlx5 fix the assignment of mark_flag in shared Rx queue settings, so that flow mark action behaves correctly when configuring shared Rx queues.
net/ice remove the priority field check in ice_fdir_parse, fixing the issue where valid flow creation fails in non-pipeline mode.
vhost/crypto fix uninitialized variable issue (Coverity issue 457449).
power/intel_uncore fix crash when driver is closed without initialization, checking that the file handle is non-null before writing and closing.
net/mlx5 align MAC address handling between PF and VF/SF, adding only unicast MAC address flows, fixing the issue where PF not syncing with the kernel causes IFF_ALLMULTI ioctl to fail.

app/testpmd fix out-of-bounds access caused by reading 32 bits when the source buffer is only 3 bytes during initialization of the mask value of flow random item, and correct the source buffer size to 4 bytes.
net/tap fix erroneous false positive caused by errno being assigned a positive value yet compared with -EEXIST in qdisc add failure handling.
lib/net fix the issue where offset is overwritten rather than accumulated during GENEVE packet parsing, and add setting of inner_l2_len.
app/testpmd clear stale tunnel_len values in hdr_lens before processing each packet, avoiding incorrect header pointer calculation when receiving mixed tunnel types.
crypto/cnxk fix the implementation of queue pair statistics PMD API.
net/txgbe fix the issue where the mask check for SCTP packet FDIR filter items is duplicated and incorrect; and set the LRO flag in mbuf ol_flags for received aggregated packets when LRO is enabled.
net/i40e/base fix unused value warnings and remove corresponding warning disable flags, also fix compiler warnings to remove the remaining two warning disable flags.
net/ngbe restrict VF VLAN strip offload configuration to be allowed only at device startup, avoiding ring stall when modifying configuration registers while the Rx ring is enabled.

common/mlx5 fix the issue where closing the directory context early when reading auxiliary device names from Linux sysfs results in indeterminate filename copy results, changing to close the directory after copying is complete.
app/testpmd fix incorrect offset calculation for inner Ethernet header of tunnel packets, and correct the duplicate accumulation issue where l2_len already includes tunnel_len.
net/ice update Tx Time Queue Context structure to align with hardware specification.

examples/ipsec-secgw fix segfault when starting the application after traffic begins in event vector mode due to attempting to decrypt IPSec packets with lookaside protocol, changing to release IPSec packets and process only plaintext packets.
net/mlx5 use vport metadata registers exposed by rdma-core when flow rules match E-Switch manager port.
common/cnxk add null pointer check before executing CPT instruction.
examples/multi_process add port stop and close operations on exit signal, fixing the issue of exiting without stopping after device startup.

lib/acl fix possible uninitialized warning for GCC 15 on aarch64 due to cmplt.count initialization method, changing to uniformly reset cmpl[].count in acl_set_flow and cleaning up redundant resets in vectorized implementations.
net/e1000 correct xstats name tx_size_1023_to_max_packets to tx_size_1024_to_max_packets for igb and igc.
net/mlx5 and crypto/mlx5 fix warning during MSVC compilation where 32-bit shift result is implicitly converted to 64 bits, by explicit 64-bit shift or adding type cast.
net/ntnic add variable null pointer validation before memset usage in multiple files.
lib/eal add clear warning message when system CPU count exceeds RTE_MAX_LCORE and no lcore is available, replacing the original vague error log.
net/ice driver updates log error message when DDP package loading fails.
lib/fib/trie.c replace pointer arithmetic with EAL macro, fixing C4334 warning during MSVC build.

ixgbe driver switches to common Rx reorder code, and uniformly uses definitions such as descriptor size, burst size, and reorder threshold from the common header; also removes unused read head register address field in Rx queue structure, and unifies variable names to match other drivers. (architectural event: IXGBE driver core module change)

Simplify x86 platform CRC processor build logic, replacing conditional compilation macros for SSE42 path with architecture macros, and simplify build-time checks for AVX512 path. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)
Remove global node ID counter, change to dynamically allocate free ID, and ensure node list is sorted by increasing ID. (architecture-related: public API)
Remove redundant and unused fields in common Tx queue structure, and clean up related function implementations to reduce memory footprint. (architecture-related: public API)
Replace #pragma pack with __rte_packed_begin and __rte_packed_end macros to unify compact memory layout for structures/unions. (architecture-related: public API)

Change argparse parameter attributes from bitmask macros to enums, respectively indicating whether the parameter takes a value, the value type, and extra flags, and update related validation logic and test cases. (architecture-related: public API)
Mark argparse parameter structure as const, ensuring the library no longer modifies user-passed parameters. (architecture-related: public API)
Switch to shared mbuf dynamic field in ip4/ip6 lookup and rewrite nodes, and remove old private field access functions. (architecture-related: public API)

Deprecate EAL parameter based on coremask, add deprecation warning in function parsing coremask, and export related internal symbols; also update documentation to use core list (-l) instead of core mask (-c) in application and example guides, and use service core list (-S) instead of service core mask (-s). (architecture-related: public API (deprecated)
Refactor DCB module, concentrating scattered DCB-related fields into hns3_dcb_info structure. (architecture-related: core module refactoring)
crypto/cnxk driver moves code shared between CN10K and CN20K to common header file.
net/iavf driver changes IPsec statistics structure from directly embedded in queue structure to dynamic pointer allocation.
net/ixgbe driver decouples vector Rx queue release mbuf function from scalar variant, and provides common function to select as needed.
net/intel driver moves duplicate Tx mbuf reclamation implementation in ixgbe and i40e to common header file.
Refactor DTB driver queue operation interface, reimplement queue request and release functions, and add queue initialization function.
Replace GCC built-in atomic operations in cnxk driver with DPDK's rte_atomic_xxx API.

In the dpaa2_sec and dpaa_sec encryption drivers, the original device allocation and release logic is replaced with rte_cryptodev_pmd_create and rte_cryptodev_pmd_destroy API, simplifying the driver initialization and teardown process.
Updated the calculation method for the segment offset.

Changed the internal storage of delay statistics from floating-point to integer cycle counts, and converted to nanoseconds upon reading; also adopted an exponentially weighted moving average (EWMA) fixed-point scaling algorithm, and initialized the average delay at the first sample according to RFC 6298.
Removed all 16-byte descriptor-related code from the iavf driver, because no physical function supports the use of this descriptor by VF.
Replaced memcpy with structure assignment in multiple drivers, libraries, and example code, and added a new struct_assign.cocci check script.
The find_next_n() function of fbarray flattens the nested loop, removes the lookahead and bit-ignore functionality, and changes to state machine behavior.
Removed unnecessary dereferences of function pointers in regexdev, vhost, raw/ifpga, and crypto/ionic (changed *dev->func to dev->func).
lib/fib removed the custom build logic for the AVX2 and AVX-512 files and switched to standard macro definitions.
The net/ixgbe driver uses existing functions in some code paths instead of explicit MAC type comparisons to detect VF.
The net/idpf driver adopts a common Tx entry structure, common Tx mbuf ring replenishment functions, and a common Tx release function, and aligns the field names of the Tx queue structure.
The net/ntnic driver renames the variable if_index, which represents the PHY index, to avoid confusion with the OS interface index.
The net/ntnic driver simplifies conditional expressions, removes redundant checks, and deletes unused code and duplicate branches.
The net/ntnic driver changes the array usage to a more explicit array indexing form, avoiding pointer arithmetic.
Cleaned up the code style of the zsda compression driver and renamed multiple internal functions to remove the comp_ prefix.
The crypto/cnxk driver copies 8 bytes of IV in the AES-CTR session.
In drivers/common/sfc_efx/base/efx_mae.c and drivers/net/zxdh/zxdh_ethdev_ops.c, memcpy is replaced with structure assignment.
The net/ixgbe driver simplifies the packet type support check and removes the difference judgment between scalar and vector paths.
The net/ixgbe driver renames the vector Tx mbuf release function to avoid name conflicts with the scalar implementation.
Moved the vectorized receive/transmit code fragments scattered in ixgbe_rxtx.c of the ixgbe driver to ixgbe_rxtx_vec_common.c and the corresponding header file.
Added a descriptor completion function for the ixgbe driver that checks the state of the DD bit, and used this function at all locations where this check is performed.

The iavf driver switched to the common vectorized mbuf rearm code and used the common definitions of burst size, rearm threshold, and descriptors per loop instead of separate definitions in each driver.
Split the doorbell write logic of the ena driver into two independent processing functions, Rx and Tx, eliminating the LLQ mode check in the Rx path that only applies to Tx queues.
Removed the use of variable-length arrays related to queue refill in the zxdh driver, using the existing burst size limit logic instead.
Removed the forced inlining and loop unrolling optimizations in the BPF program of the tap device to adapt to modern BPF verifiers.
Removed the redundant memset call inside the dpdk_stats_collect function of the ntnic driver, because rte_eth_stats_get already zeroes the structure before the call.
Removed redundant code in the ice/base PTP code that does not modify the values of clk_freq and clk_src.
In the devx command code of the mlx5 driver, explicit casts are performed on mixed enum types to eliminate the MSVC compilation warning C5287.
Renamed the rx_using_sse variable in the i40e driver to vector_rx to be consistent with the naming in other drivers.
Renamed the rx_ring_dma variable in the ice driver to rx_ring_phys_addr to be consistent with the naming in other drivers.
Renamed the RTE_LIBRTE_ICE_16BYTE_RX_DESC macro in the ice driver to RTE_NET_INTEL_USE_16BYTE_DESC, in preparation for unifying the definitions of 16-byte and 32-byte Rx descriptors.
Cleaned up internal definitions in the ixgbe driver: removed the RTE_ and RTE_PMD_ prefixes, and added the IXGBE_VPMD_ prefix to vectorized PMD-related definitions.

Performed definition name cleanup for the iavf, ice, and i40e drivers: added the IAVF_VPMD_ / ICE_VPMD_ / I40E_VPMD_ prefixes to vectorized PMD-related definitions, removed unused definitions, and created descriptors per loop definitions for different vector implementations (SSE/Neon/AltiVec regular, AVX2/AVX512 wide).

Fixed issues in multiple test files under MSVC compilation: the hash test uses the size format specifier provided by EAL; the memcpy_perf test replaces GCC __builtin_constant_p extensions with macros; the alarm test adds explicit casts to eliminate _Atomic qualifier warnings; the fib6_perf test moves stack data to the heap to avoid stack overflow.

Added a pseudo-random batch size request test sequence for the mempool_perf test, and added tests for the default mempool with caching, skipping duplicate tests that are the same as already tested drivers.
Added test vectors with larger RSA modulus for the crypto-perf tool, and added test cases for modex group 24 for the cryptodev test.

Renamed the fbarray test to be more descriptive, avoiding references to internal implementation details, and added a test case that exactly fills one mask; changed the malloc test to use a table-driven unit test runner to improve readability.
In app/test-crypto-perf/cperf_ops.c, corrected the AAD offset calculation for the AES-GCM algorithm, removing the 16-byte IV post-alignment that was only needed for AES-CCM.
In app/test/test_per_lcore.c, fixed a race condition between the main thread of the per-lcore test and the execution of the lcore callback.

In app/test-eventdev/test_atomic_common.h and related atomic test files, made atomic_init_locks return immediately on memory allocation failure, and handled the case where atomic locks is NULL in the atomic queue and ATQ tests.
In the graph autotest cleanup phase of app/test/test_graph.c, nodes are released to fix the failure on the second run due to node names already existing.
In the RSA negative test scenario of app/test/test_cryptodev_asym.c, corrected the wrong return value.
In app/test/test_power_intel_uncore.c, if Intel uncore power management initialization fails, the test is marked as skipped rather than failed.
In app/test/test_cryptodev_asym.c, increased the dequeue timeout to allow implementations that take longer to complete processing.

In the test_multi_alloc_statistics test case of app/test/test_malloc.c, switched to running with a new malloc heap to eliminate the interference of prior allocation/release state on statistics checks.

In app/test-crypto-perf/cperf_test_latency.c and cperf_test_throughput.c, add a check within the enqueue/dequeue loop for whether PMD can handle a single op, to avoid an infinite loop when the driver returns zero.

Port the port_control test suite from the legacy framework to the new dts framework, adding files such as dts/tests/TestSuite_port_control.py, to verify basic control functions like port start, stop, and close, excluding QEMU-related and reset port test cases.
Disabled the PMU test reported due to platform failure, pending a fix.
In app/test/test_event_vector_adapter.c, disable the event_vector_adapter_autotest test because it triggers a failure in CI.

In app/test/test_event_vector_adapter.c, change the waiting mechanism for the event vector adapter test to rely on the service core cycle instead of the system cycle, and adjust the event_type check order to ensure the vector event is confirmed received before dereferencing the vector structure.
In files such as app/test/test_cryptodev_ecdh_test_vectors.h, add test vectors for ECDH groups 19, 20, and 21.
In app/test-crypto-perf/configs/, remove all unsupported test cases from crypto-perf-aesni-gcm.json, crypto-perf-aesni-mb.json, and crypto-perf-qat.json.
In app/test-crypto-perf/, add support for RSA decrypt and verify operations, and add corresponding cipher and sign test vectors.
In app/test/test_argparse.c, add test cases to verify that duplicate parameters report an error without the SUPPORT_MULTI flag, and that multiple parameters are handled correctly with the flag.
In app/test/test_cryptodev.h, set the maximum IV length for the auth and cipher test cases to 32 bytes, to accommodate both auth IV and cipher IV.
In app/test/test_cryptodev.c, set the pointer to NULL after rte_crypto_op_free.
In files such as app/test/test_cryptodev_rsa_test_vectors.h, per RFC 8017 (A.1.2) requirements, make the RSA private key contain both exponent and CRT forms of data.

In the RSA decrypt verification in app/test/test_cryptodev_asym.c, use a separate local buffer as the output buffer for the crypto op, to avoid the decryption result being compared with the same plaintext buffer pointer, which would invalidate the verification.
app/eventdev, during the cleanup phase, releases only events that failed to enqueue, rather than releasing the entire dequeue burst.

Optimize the graph search logic in mcore dispatch scheduling by caching the first search result to avoid repeated slow traversals, and export relevant function symbols to improve performance. (architecture-related: public API)
Enable the AVX2 vector instruction set for CPU that do not support AVX512, to improve per-core performance for single-queue Rx/Tx. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)

Add support for the AVX2 and AVX512 instruction sets for the Rx rearm operation of the Intel NIC, so that the 32-byte descriptor format can also use wider x86 vectors. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)
Switch the UADK compression PMD from synchronous mode to asynchronous mode to improve performance. (architecture-related: external behavior)

Change the UADK crypto driver from synchronous mode to asynchronous mode to improve performance; the first operation in a chain remains synchronous, and adjust the digest handling for the VERIFY operation. (architecture-related: external behavior)
malloc_heap adds handling for invalid socket ID when socket ID is -1, to avoid false positives from static analysis.
Refactor the find_prev_n function, flattening the nested loop into state machine logic, removing the lookbehind and bit-ignore features, simplifying the code and improving performance.

Optimize comparison operations and compiler hints in the memory pool (mempool), replace some validations with assertions, add likely/unlikely and __rte_assume to optimize the hot path, and refactor the cache write function to improve performance.
Optimize the Tx queue creation process for the mlx5 NIC, passing DevX object information to the creation function, and adjust the iteration order to improve memory allocation and performance.
net/intel removes the empty cache check when releasing sent mbuf, checking only whether the cache pointer is NULL.
net/ntnic removes the use of variable-length arrays, replacing VLA with known upper bounds with fixed-length arrays, and using alloca dynamic allocation for those with unknown upper bounds.
examples/ntb adds a NULL pointer check before accessing heap-allocated memory.
event/dlb2 uses the CQ depth calculated by PMD rather than the application-configured CQ depth to compute cq_depth_mask when CQ depth <= 16.
event/dlb2 updates the QID depth xstats counters in the vector dequeue path.
latencystats adds a lock to the receive callback to protect sampling and TSC atomic updates in multi-queue scenarios, optimizes the sampling condition check, and handles TSC wraparound.
app/crypto-perf removes all decryption test cases from the aesni-mb throughput performance test.
Add an event vector adapter performance test for the eventdev application.
net/null removes parameter checks for Rx and Tx, uses non-atomic operations for Rx statistics and adds byte counting, and marks Tx as lockless and uses rte_pktmbuf_free_bulk.
net/mlx5 batches the generated flow counter ID into the ring, first storing them in an array and then placing them into the ring at once to optimize cache access.
latencystats skips locking and TSC access in the send callback if no packets in the burst have timestamps set.
