Add secure memory zeroing function rte_memzero_explicit and secure free function rte_free_sensitive, and replace key zeroing operations in the QAT crypto driver to prevent compiler optimizations from leaving sensitive data behind. Also provide the Coccinelle script to assist migration. (architecture-related: public API)
Configure independent drop and backpressure thresholds for the CQ of the cnxk driver, and optimize the secure packet drop threshold. (architecture-related: public API)

Add lock protection for the creation, destruction, update, and hardware SA read/write operations of the cnxk driver's security sessions, to prevent data corruption from concurrent access. (architecture-related: public API)
Fix a use-after-free vulnerability when cleaning up flowdir resources in the qede driver, using safe traversal to avoid accessing freed nodes.
Fix a potential buffer overflow in rte_pci_write_config() in the FreeBSD PCI bus driver, avoiding out-of-bounds reads by limiting the copy length.
In the virtio crypto driver, add a check for invalid IOVA addresses to avoid using overflow constants.
Add memory barriers in the scheduling and configuration functions of the ice driver to fix speculative execution data leakage issues.
Fix the use-after-free issue in EAL caused by freeing memory before unregistering the alarm callback; on both Linux and FreeBSD, unregister the callback before freeing the interrupt handle.
event/dlb2 adds a check when validating LDB port COS ID parameters, ensuring that the port_cos parameter is provided in the order of all ports (LDB and DIR).
net/ntnic, compress/octeontx, and bus/uacce remove unnecessary memset calls before free.
net/ntnic issues a warning if string truncation occurs when using strlcpy.

Updated the documentation for API related to socket ID in EAL, correcting "physical socket" to "NUMA node" to match actual semantics. Meanwhile, the socket ID fields in the internal lcore and configuration structures have been renamed to NUMA ID, and the user API is unaffected. (architecture-related: public API)
Updated the Linux kernel version requirement to 5.4 and removed guarantees for specific distributions. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)
Updated documentation to add descriptions of the kernel options CONFIG_NET_TC_SKB_EXT and CONFIG_MLX5_CLS_ACT required by the MLX5 driver. (architecture-related: MLX5 driver kernel options)
Updated the recommended compiler versions in the Linux guide to recommend GCC 8.0+ and Clang 7+. (architecture-related: compiler version requirements)
Announced in deprecation.rst that the SSE vector paths of the i40e, iavf, and ice drivers will be removed in DPDK 25.11. (architecture-related: SSE vector path deprecation)

Announced in deprecation.rst that due to unaligned accesses detected by UBSan, plans are to update the alignment of some structures in the 25.11 version, involving rte_stack_lf_head and rte_mp_msg, etc., which is an ABI break. (architecture-related: ABI compatibility)
Updated the documentation for compiling mlx5 on Windows, clearly distinguishing the linker parameters for the MSVC and Clang compilers. (architecture-related: build and installation methods)
Marked the repr_matching_en device parameter of mlx5 PMD as deprecated in the documentation, with plans to remove it in DPDK 25.11. (architecture-related: public API)
doc updated the Fedora 41 development tool installation command syntax and removed instructions about the old version of pkg-config from the Linux guide.
doc added build configuration instructions for new Arm SoC and a guide for adding new SoC build configurations.
doc added test platforms using NVIDIA NIC to the 25.07 release notes.
The documentation announced support for the AMD Solarflare X45xx series of devices, including the two NICs X4522 and X4542.
Updated the version date information in the ixgbe base driver's README.
Added virtual function support instructions in the DTS documentation, including enabling SR-IOV mode and virtual function configuration steps.
Added a list of tested Intel platforms and Intel NIC combinations to the v25.07 release notes.
Reorganized and refactored the Intel VF driver documentation, added a chapter on hypervisor usage of VF, and supplemented large VF configuration instructions.
doc simplified the mlx5 device list to a family list, reorganized the mlx5 documentation by feature, and added testpmd command examples.

doc supplemented per-test-suite configuration instructions for DTS; DTS improved port handling with a lazy binding strategy and added a port statistics test suite to verify testpmd port statistics accuracy.
Updated the cnxk crypto driver documentation to add support for CN20K SoC.
Added an entry to the release notes for the EAL -l parameter supporting full core-to-cpu mapping.
Added reference links and definitions for multiple terms in the glossary in doc/guides/prog_guide/glossary.rst.
Added a new dts/tests/TestSuite_packet_capture.py test suite that captures frames via the dpdk-dumpcap test package.
Limited the directory depth of the indexes for multiple driver and tool guides to only show first-level headings.
Added code snippets and related configuration support in the examples/flow_filtering example for using the RTE_FLOW_ACTION_TYPE_SEND_TO_KERNEL action to directly reroute packets to the kernel.
Added usage examples for the --lcores EAL option in the documentation.
Noted in the cryptoperf documentation: when the segment-sz parameter is passed, buffer-sz must be used in descending order.
Added function matrix tables for the DMA adapter and event vector adapter in the documentation.
Added a description of the -S service core list option in the EAL help information (lib/eal/common/eal_common_options.c) and documentation (doc/guides/linux_gsg/eal_args.include.rst).
Added a new dts/tests/TestSuite_rte_flow.py test suite covering some basic synchronization RTE Flow API rules that should be supported across each PMD.
Added instructions in the Linux guide advising users to avoid polling on CPU 0 because that CPU cannot be fully isolated and bears kernel functions such as timer interrupts.
Removed the no-longer-needed -n 4 memory channel count setting option from many documentation examples.
Removed references to the deprecated --use-device option from the build example documentation for Linux and FreeBSD.
In the example application documentation, replaced the detailed enumeration of some EAL parameters with a general description, referring to the full list.
Updated the recommended version information in the i40e and ice NIC documentation.

Used the imported VDUSE uAPI header file, removed the build dependency on the system VDUSE header file, and simplified function declarations. (architectural event: NFP_Common module added VDUSE uAPI header file)
The build system added symbol map generation functionality, automatically generating the linker-required map file by marking RTE_EXPORT_*SYMBOL. (architecture-related: build and installation methods)

Version mapping is now dynamically generated, removing scripts and checks related to static version mapping, and updating build configuration and documentation. (architecture-related: version and compatibility)
Opened a new release cycle, updated the version number to 25.07-rc0, and added an empty release notes document. (architecture-related: version and compatibility)

Simplified the build of the base code in the Intel NIC driver, no longer using precompiled static libraries but directly including the source file list. (architecture-related: build and installation methods)
Enabled the FIB application on Windows, removed unnecessary header files, and added rte_os_shim.h to be compatible with the strtok_r function. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)
Allow building the app directory under the MSVC compiler, and remove the no-longer-needed -Wno-deprecated-declarations compilation flag. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)
Enabled compilation of the mbuf library under the MSVC compiler, and adjusted the net library compilation options to enhance compatibility. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)
The mldev library now supports building with the MSVC compiler. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)
Added a license exception for the Linux kernel uAPI header file, and updated the SPDX tag checking script to support dual-licensed files. (architecture-related: public API license)
Removed the Windows build restriction, enabling the regexdev library and its test application to compile under MSVC. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)

Added a script to automatically obtain the minimum Meson version defined in meson.build, and use that version in CI and the build process, while updating the minimum Meson version requirement from 0.57 to 0.57.2. (architecture-related: build requirements)
Removed the build disable condition for the LPM library in the MSVC compiler, so it now supports compilation with the Visual Studio toolset. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)
Enabled build support for the fib library in the MSVC compilation environment. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)
Updated the Arm Neoverse N3 build configuration to use mcpu to adapt to the latest GCC, and added this platform to the support list. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)
Added build configuration support for Arm Neoverse V3. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)

In multiple NIC driver files, changed the pick_rx_func and pick_tx_func functions to conditional compilation, avoiding the use of the __rte_used macro, to improve MSVC compatibility. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)

Added the RTE_PMD_EXPORT_SYMBOL macro to support the MSVC compiler, and refactored related macro definitions and variable declarations to ensure driver information is correctly embedded in the binary in MSVC builds. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)
In the MSVC compiler environment, the build tool uses lib.exe instead of ar to handle archive operations. (architecture-related: build and installation methods)
Added the __builtin_add_overflow macro definition for the MSVC compiler in the ice base driver to support MSVC compilation. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)

Removed the __COUNTER__ parameter from the RTE_PMD_EXPORT_NAME macro, and instead directly use the driver name to generate a unique symbol, to support the MSVC compiler. (architecture-related: public API)

Optimized the build configuration so that when the target already supports the AVX2 or AVX-512 instruction sets, the corresponding compiler flags are not added again, and simplified the handling logic of the AVX512 compilation flags. (architecture-related: build and installation methods)

Renamed the macro RTE_LIBRTE_I40E_16BYTE_RX_DESC for the 16-byte Rx descriptor in the i40e driver to RTE_NET_INTEL_USE_16BYTE_DESC, and updated the related function parameter types. (architecture-related: public API)

Introduced the compile flag IXGBE_VPMD_SUPPORTED to control vector PMD support, removed the platform-related stub function, and used macro aliases to map vector functions to scalar implementations or NULL, simplifying compilation and code maintenance. (architecture-related: build configuration)

Changed the prefetch control in the ixgbe driver from unconditional enablement to using the RTE_PMD_PACKET_PREFETCH configuration option, allowing prefetch to be disabled at build time. (architecture-related: build configuration)
Fixed the failure of mlx5 dependency detection on Windows, and no longer requires the mlx5devx library to be present. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)

Enabled the gve driver to build on the FreeBSD host operating system, removed the Linux environment condition, and added the FreeBSD kernel module dependency. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)

Added a check for the Python elftools module in the build configuration, and if missing, directly report an error and terminate the configuration to avoid errors during subsequent builds. (architecture-related: build dependency)

Fixed the issue where old compilers (such as GCC 8.5) could not correctly override -march=native, by detecting and explicitly adding the AVX512 compilation flag to avoid build warnings. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)

Introduced generic base code compilation support in drivers/meson.build, and replaced the custom base code build logic in drivers such as net/qede, raw/ifpga, common/sfc_efx, net/txgbe, net/octeontx, net/thunderx, and net/hinic with generic handling.
Removed the check code for the static linking defect of the old pkg-config of RHEL 7 from all example Makefile files.

Replaced __atomic_store() in lib/lpm with atomic_store_explicit() from stdatomic, to resolve the issues of __atomic_store being undefined and __ATOMIC_RELAXED being undeclared reported by the MSVC compiler.
The build system now forces assertion expressions to be checked at compile time, even if the assertion feature is disabled, to catch compilation warnings early.
Added generic AVX2 and AVX512 source file handling support for driver builds, simplifying driver build logic.
Added generic AVX2 and AVX512 build handling logic in the top-level library build file, supporting separate compilation for specific source files, simplifying library builds.
Removed the custom AVX2 and AVX-512 compilation logic in the ACL library build, and replaced it with the generic AVX build handling method.
Unified the AVX512 build logic of the member library to use the common build handling method.
Skipped the atomic operation check for the drivers/common/cnxk directory in the check script, to allow the use of GCC built-in atomic functions.
Fixed the build failure on Linux in dlopen link mode due to the missing internal EAL include directory.
Fixed the compilation and linking errors of the mlx5 driver on Windows, included mlx5_flow_geneve.c in compilation on all platforms, and organized the order of meson.build files.
Fixed the issue where the pmdinfogen temporary directory on Windows could not be cleaned due to sharing conflicts, and adjusted the parameter passing method of the pmdinfo command.
Fixed the build error caused by variable scope issues when developer mode is disabled, by moving the import of the fs module before the conditional check.

Removed the CC_AVX2_SUPPORT macro definition when building AVX2 on the x86 platform, and instead use #ifdef RTE_ARCH_x86; also switched to the generic AVX/AVX512 build handling mechanism in lib/net and event/dlb2.
Installed the API documentation and guides of the DPDK documentation into different directories, to avoid them overwriting each other when both are installed to /usr/share/doc/dpdk/html/.
Added a prohibition check in devtools/checkpatches.sh for the use of compiler pragma, but allows rte_common.h to use pragma.
Deleted all committed static version.map files, because all version map files are now generated.
Fixed the Makefile of examples/flow_filtering so that make clean can correctly delete *.o files in the build directory.
Treat compilation warnings as errors in the MSVC build workflow of GitHub Actions.

Implemented a mechanism in buildtools/get-min-meson-version.py and meson.build to specify an independent minimum Meson version for Windows, to address path handling issues with 0.57.x versions on Windows.
Replaced __builtin_ffsl in the mlx5 driver with rte_ffs32 provided by EAL to support MSVC compilation. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)
Added the RTE_PMD_DLB2_ prefix to the token pop mode enumeration in the dlb2 driver to avoid namespace conflicts. (architecture-related: public API)
Updated the PHY configuration and MAC MCU settings for RTL8127.
Fixed indentation issues in ixgbe_set_tx_function.
Added a missing newline at the end of the meson.build file to comply with text file conventions.
Added new log components and debug logs at different verbosity levels for ipool in net/mlx5, and added bitmap checks in debug mode to prevent double allocation and double free.
Enhanced null pointer checks in multiple source files of net/ntnic to avoid using pointers before checking them.

Fixed compilation warnings in net/fm10k/base: defined the UNREFERENCED_PARAMETER macro, corrected the fallthrough spelling, defined FM10K_READ_PCI_WORD in os_dep.h to mark parameters as used, and removed warning-disabling flags.
Modified the net/null driver to count packets on all queues (not limited by RTE_ETHDEV_QUEUE_STAT_CNTRS), added byte counters, and removed the igb_ prefix inherited from other drivers.
Added error logging for HSH RCP preset failures in the hw_db_inline_hsh_deref function of net/ntnic.
Fixed incorrect error reason logging in eal_mem_set_dump() in eal/unix when madvise() fails.
Invoked check-spdx-tag.sh in the GitHub Actions build workflow to check licenses of all committed files.
Removed the unused ipv6_buf variable in common/cnxk to eliminate PVS studio warnings about memset possibly being ignored.
Updated mbox npc_cn20k_read_base_steer_rule handling for CN20K in common/cnxk.
Updated log format specifiers in multiple source files of net/ntnic to match expected data types and maintain consistency.
Added detailed print output for ACI (Admin Command Interface) in debug mode in net/ixgbe/base.
Removed unnecessary platform definition checks in net/ixgbe and provided function stubs where needed to make compilation pass.
net/ena/base reuses the precomputed desc_per_entry from ena_com_config_llq_info() in ena_eth_com.c to avoid recomputation on the fast path.
net/ena upgraded the driver version to 2.13.0 in ena_ethdev.c.
graph: Added graph field to the rte_node.dispatch structure. (architecture-related: public API)
mailmap: fix entries with many aliases
maintainers: update for dlb2 driver
maintainers: update for ethdev library
dts: add generic blocking app class
dts: remove function to build example
dts: fix deterministic doc
usertools: enable pmdinfo with MSVC
maintainers: update for GVE driver
maintainers: update for ngbe and txgbe drivers
maintainers: update for iavf and i40e drivers
dts: remove multi-inheritance classes
dts: add blocking app class
dts: add Scapy asynchronous sniffer
buildtools: display symbols version from map
Imported the VFIO header file from Linux v6.16 for use by various DPDK modules. (architectural event: added VFIO UAPI module)

Added the Nebulamatrix NIC driver, including base PMD code, hardware layer, channel layer, resource layer, dispatch layer, device layer, and device initialization and deinitialization support. (architecture-related: added Nebulamatrix NIC driver)
net/dpaa switched to timesync API to support IEEE 1588, and removed PTP packet identification code from the driver RX callback.

Moved internal header files of multiple driver modules from the public API header list to only the driver SDK header list, thereby narrowing the public API exposure scope. (architectural event: driver module internal headers removed from public API)

Cleaned up VFIO public header dependencies, removing includes of Linux VFIO headers, local uAPI wrappers, VFIO_PRESENT macro dependencies, and old kernel compatibility wrappers, and instead explicitly including or directly using kernel headers in source files. (architectural event: VFIO public header dependency cleanup)

Refactored the DPAA bus driver, added FMan node support, provided SoC version identification internal API, migrated push queue configuration from PMD to the bus driver, and added bus-level interfaces. (architecture-related: DPAA bus driver refactoring)
Added detection of AVX512DQ CPU flags in the x86 vector capability check to meet the Rx path selection requirements of the idpf and cpfl drivers. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)

Cleaned up the fslmc bus driver, removed cryptodev and dmadev pointers, moved device deinitialization logic from the remove function to the close function, and changed to obtaining device objects via functions. (architecture-related: fslmc bus driver interface cleanup)
Adjusted DMA adapter header dependencies, replacing driver internal headers with public headers. (architecture-related: public API)
The ICE driver unified the Rx path in the main process, with all processes using the same receive path. (architecture-related: ICE driver Rx path unification)
Moved internal hash macros of the member library from public headers to internal headers, hiding internal implementation. (architecture-related: public API)
Adjusted CPTR alignment from 128 bytes to 256 bytes on the CN20K platform, and dynamically allocated security contexts and IPsec SA structures. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)
Added CPT completion queue (CQ) support for the CN20K platform, enabled/disabled CQ on device start/stop, and adapted queue pair related logic. (architecture-related: added CQ support)

Migrated the port event thread, adapter flm update thread, and adapter monitoring thread to DPDK services, and refactored related functions to fit the new service model. (architecture-related: thread model migration)
Added UIO/VFIO support for NBL devices, adding PCI device mapping and unmapping operations in the initialization and removal flows. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)
Added coexistence mode support for NBL devices, implementing user device DMA mapping, VFIO container management, and channel initialization. (architecture-related: coexistence mode support)
Added basic NBL configuration support for ethdev network devices, implementing device state management and configuration flow. (architecture-related: added ethdev support)
Integrated RCU QSBR support into rte_fib6, implementing secure tbl8 group reclamation. (architecture-related: RCU QSBR integration)
Removed the repr_matching_en device parameter from the mlx5 driver and cleaned up related code logic. (architecture-related: public API change)
Hidden internal ethtool symbols, removed exports, renamed to static functions, and updated internal calls.

Added vCPF PMD support, including registration, queue configuration, retrieval of absolute queue ID and VSI information, and updated the PCI ID table. (architectural event: ACPI_CPUFreq_Power module removal)
Introduced the ENETC4 PMD driver, supporting PF and VF hardware initialization and basic network operations for multiple SoCs from NXP. (architectural event: BBDev_Main module removal)

Added hot upgrade support for the bnxt driver, including global ID dynamic allocation, TCAM priority updates, multi-instance coexistence, dynamic UPAR support, meter statistics, and global index table handling functions. (architectural event: BNXT driver core module extension)

Added a DMA enqueue/dequeue operation API based on struct rte_dma_op, which must be enabled at configuration time via the RTE_DMA_CFG_FLAG_ENQ_DEQ flag, and implemented this operation in the cnxk driver. (architecture-related: public API)
Added trace points for each operation type of bbdev, and added an experimental API rte_bbdev_ops_trace to record input parameters for different operation types. (architecture-related: public API)

Implemented rx/tx queue information retrieval callbacks for the virtio NIC, enabling applications to obtain the queue size set by the vhost backend to correctly configure memory pools. (architecture-related: public API)

Added V extension detection support for the RISC-V architecture, and conditionally included riscv_vector.h in the vector header file based on this feature. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)
Added a vector-extension-based implementation of the LPM lookupx4 function for the RISC-V architecture. (architecture-related: public API)
Obtained and stored the DPNI API version during DPNI device initialization, so that available API can be selected based on the version later. (architecture-related: public API)
Supported VLAN TPID settings, added corresponding API and message handling callbacks, and fixed a logic error in the VLAN offload settings. (architecture-related: public API)
Supported I510/511 PF devices, added device ID identification, and adjusted the initialization flow. (architecture-related: public API)

Added a callback notification mechanism for graphs in scheduling mode, triggering callbacks when packets are enqueued to the work queue, so applications can implement sleep/wakeup. (architecture-related: public API)

In the vmbus bus, saved the UIO file descriptor for the secondary process, enabling it to access vmbus devices and use that fd to send signals to the Hyper-V host. (architecture-related: multi-process support)

Added the struct rte_vmbus_device *dev parameter to all relevant functions in the vmbus bus and the netvsc network driver, so that the secondary process can access vmbus devices through the device private area. (architecture-related: public API)
Added a configurable XDP program attachment mode for the AF_XDP PMD, added the vdev parameter mode, and supported three modes: drv, skb, and hw. (architecture-related: PMD configuration interface)
Added a cross-platform rte_basename function to safely extract the base name of a file path, and added corresponding unit tests. (architecture-related: public API)
Added a load_echo command with explicit echo control for the load command of testpmd, and removed the global echo setting. (architecture-related: testpmd command-line interface)

The cmdline-file and cmdline-file-noecho parameters of testpmd now support being specified multiple times, allowing up to 16 command files to be passed. (architecture-related: testpmd command-line interface)

Added conflicting configuration checks in the ethdev library, prohibiting the simultaneous enabling of fast mbuf release and multi-segment transmission Tx offload configuration. (architecture-related: external behavior)
Added support for 800G link speed in the ethdev library, tests, drivers, and command-line tools. (architecture-related: public API)

Added a generic function in the Intel NIC driver to select the SSE, AVX2, or AVX-512 code path based on user configuration and CPU features, and added checks for the AVX512DQ flag. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)

Introduced infrastructure for Rx path selection in the Intel NIC driver, adding structures describing Rx path characteristics and path selection functions. (architecture-related: Rx path selection API)

Added SM2 elliptic curve asymmetric encryption support: added elliptic curve point fields and capability enums in the cryptodev public header file, and implemented encryption and decryption operations in the QAT PMD. (architecture-related: SM2 encryption API)

Promoted the raw free and raw alloc bulk functions of mbuf from experimental to stable, and updated the packet mbuf alloc bulk functions to use the stable raw alloc bulk functions. (architecture-related: mbuf raw function stabilization)

Added an optimized reset function for reinitialized mbuf batches, which uses mempool information to perform write-only operations, avoiding reading mbuf's own fields, thereby improving performance. (architecture-related: mbuf batch reset function)
Added a driver event callback API for the mlx5 PMD, supporting external callback registration to listen for Rx/Tx queue creation and destruction events. (architecture-related: public API)

Added rte_pmd_mlx5_driver_disable_steering() and rte_pmd_mlx5_driver_enable_steering() private API for the mlx5 PMD, allowing applications to enable or disable flow rule processing. (architecture-related: public API)
Added NUMA-aware configuration for netvsc, added the device parameter numa_aware to control whether it is enabled, and it is disabled by default. (architecture-related: configuration interface)

Added the link_type parameter to the rte_pcapng_add_interface function, allowing users to specify the protocol link type, and updated all call sites to be compatible with this change. (architecture-related: public API)

Added rte_flow API support to the zxdh NIC driver, implementing matching for ETH, VLAN, IPv4/IPv6, TCP/UDP, VXLAN, etc., as well as drop/count/mark/queue/rss and VXLAN encapsulation/decapsulation actions. (architecture-related: public API)

Added the link_state_on_close device parameter to the ice driver, supporting configuration of the link state as down, up, or restoration to the initial state when the device is closed, and changed the default behavior from restoring the initial state to setting the link to down. (architecture-related: configuration interface)

Added TCP segmentation offload (TSO) support to the xsc PMD, and the transmit queue creation function has been adjusted accordingly to pass the offload flags and socket ID. (architecture-related: public API)
Support for querying and reading EEPROM data of the SFP/QSFP module. (architecture-related: public API)
Added link state retrieval and setting functionality to the XSC NIC driver, and added interrupt handling to support link state change notifications. (architecture-related: public API)
Added VFIO MSI-X interrupt support to the xsc network device, implementing handling of link state change events. (architecture-related: public API)

Added FEC mode retrieval and setting functionality to the xsc PMD, and added support for interrupt event retrieval and interrupt handler installation/uninstallation. (architecture-related: public API)
The PCT manager now supports independent resource management per port, allowing different ports to run in separate DPDK processes. (architecture-related: module responsibility)
Added 40G port speed option support to the ice driver. (architecture-related: public API)

Added mbuf operation history recording functionality, tracking operations in the mbuf lifecycle through dynamic fields, and providing marking and querying API; this feature is disabled by default and automatically initialized when creating a mbuf pool. Additionally, added dump mbuf history commands in testpmd, supporting output of operation history for all mbuf, a single mbuf, or a specified mbuf pool to the console or a file. (architecture-related: public API)
Added a link connector type parameter for Ethernet devices, and added an API to convert the connector enumeration to a readable string. (architecture-related: public API)

Added the hinic3 NIC driver, supporting the SP series of NICs, including complete functionality such as basic header files, hardware interfaces, command queues, event modules, AEQ, management modules, hardware operations, NIC configuration, work queue, mailbox, device initialization, ethdev operations, and packet reception/transmission. (architecture-related: new driver: hinic3)
Updated the event device queue weight mapping for the CN20K platform, mapping the 0-255 weight range of DPDK to the hardware-supported 1-255. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)
Added RSS hash update, configuration retrieval, RETA update and query, and multicast address list setting functionality to the hinic3 NIC driver. (architecture-related: public API)

Added flow control and filter support to the hinic3 driver, including rte_flow, ethertype, IPv4, IPv6, and VXLAN tunnel filtering, and supports user addition or deletion of filters. (architecture-related: public API)
Support for configuring the CPT context length via the devarg parameter ctx_ilen, and using this value when creating IPsec and TLS sessions. (architecture-related: public API)
Added API rte_pmd_cnxk_ae_fpm_table_get for obtaining the AE FPM table address. (architecture-related: public API)
Added API to obtain the AE EC group table address, and added compile-time enumeration value consistency checks. (architecture-related: public API)
Aligned the PDCP API with the latest firmware, adding metadata support in multiple cryptographic operation functions and adding null pointer checks. (architecture-related: public API)
Added support for custom metadata in the cn20k PMD, modifying related cryptographic preprocessing functions to pass metadata parameters. (architecture-related: public API)
Added mbuf history marking in the Rx/Tx burst functions for debugging, with no performance impact when disabled by default. (architecture-related: public API)

Added DCB enhancement functionality to the ice NIC driver, including utility functions, per-traffic-class flow control parameter configuration, and asymmetric PFC support. (architecture-related: public API)
Added packet vector support in the CN20K crypto adapter, refactoring enqueue and dequeue logic to use the new vector processing approach. (architecture-related: public API)
Added PQC ML-KEM and ML-DSA algorithm support to the cryptodev library and the OpenSSL driver. (architecture-related: public API)

The compressdev library added PDCP checksum definitions and supports dictionary parameters in deflate/inflate operations; the zlib PMD implemented corresponding support. (architecture-related: public API)
The argparse library added custom help printing functionality, including exposing the rte_argparse_print_help function and the print_help callback. (architecture-related: public API)
The argparse library added support for parsing core list type parameters. (architecture-related: public API)

The argparse library added the ignore_non_flag_args option, which, when enabled, moves non-flag arguments to the end, simulating getopt behavior, while prohibiting positional arguments. (architecture-related: public API)
The argparse library supports arguments directly following short options (e.g., -xarg) without requiring an equals sign separator. (architecture-related: external behavior)
EAL added corresponding long options for each short option, unifying the option format. (architecture-related: public API)
EAL added parameter definitions based on the argparse format, and provided a parameter list callback function and a usage printing function. (architecture-related: public API)
EAL merged command-line parameter combination validation checks into the parsing process, and added validity checks for some parameters. (architecture-related: external behavior)

EAL added the --remap-lcore-ids option, supporting mapping of lcore ID to a low range; it also supports using core ID greater than RTE_MAX_LCORE in core list, and restricts automatic remapping groups. (architecture-related: public API)
The ice NIC driver added priority flow control (PFC) support and statistics functionality, with related counters exposed via xstats. (architecture-related: public API)
The IAVF driver added VF-initiated reset functionality, adding the experimental API rte_pmd_iavf_reinit and the corresponding testpmd command. (architecture-related: public API)
Added the HiSilicon SoC accelerator DMA driver, including device probing, removal, control path operations, and data path operations. (architecture-related: new driver module)

Added complete support for the Wangxun Amber-Lite series of NICs (10G/25G/40G), including device identification, mailbox interface, optical module identification, link configuration, PHY configuration, Rx/Tx support, hardware reset, FEC support, and GPIO configuration. (architecture-related: new NIC driver series)
The ENA NIC driver added Rx hardware timestamping support with nanosecond precision, which can be enabled by configuring the Rx offload flag. (architecture-related: new hardware timestamping support)

The MC firmware API compatibility was upgraded to 10.39.0, adding dpbp notification setting and retrieval, dprtc clock offset reading, and other API, and adjusted the dpdmux device creation reset flags and the dpkg key configuration function parameter types. (architecture-related: API compatibility upgrade)
Added support for xstats counters in DPMAC, including functions to obtain MAC statistics and corresponding statistics setting logic. (architecture-related: added xstats statistics interface)
Added the devargs parameter to the DPAA2 NIC, supporting the dropping of packets with parsing errors in hardware. (architecture-related: devargs parameter)

Added configuration, start, stop, and release API for Rx/Tx queues for ENETC4 devices, and implemented auxiliary functions such as statistics, RSS, and promiscuous mode. (architecture-related: public API)
Added TX checksum offload for L3 (IPv4, IPv6) and L4 (TCP, UDP), and RX checksum verification support for the enetc4 NIC driver. (architecture-related: public API)
Added basic statistics functionality for the ENETC4 PMD, supporting transmit and receive packet and byte counting as well as error statistics. (architecture-related: public API)

Added packet type parsing support for the ENETC4 PMD, and added multiple functions including link update, promiscuous mode, queue start/stop, statistics retrieval, and control BDR management. (architecture-related: public API)

Added a message passing mechanism between virtual functions (VF) and physical functions (PF) for the enetc NIC driver, and supports VF configuration of the primary MAC address. (architecture-related: public API)
Added multicast and promiscuous mode support for the ENETC4 PMD, including corresponding callbacks and message handling for PF and VF. (architecture-related: public API)
Added link status retrieval, link speed retrieval, and link update operations for the ENETC4 VF driver, and added VLAN promiscuous mode support. (architecture-related: public API)
Added link status notification support for the ENETC4 PMD, including link up/down and speed change events. (architecture-related: public API)

Added cross-process and cross-operating-system DMA transfer support, including capability flags, domain type validation, and cross-domain control plane API (create, destroy, and leave access groups). (architecture-related: public API: cross-domain DMA transfer)
Added a service management API for the NTNIC PMD, supporting service addition, deletion, information query, and lcore mapping functions. (architecture-related: public API: NTNIC service management)
Unified the prefix of the Napatech hardware flow API functions from flow_ to nthw_flow_, and added the nthw_flow_pull_profile_inline function. (architecture-related: public API)
Unified the prefix of the key matcher functions in the flow_api module from km_ to nthw_km_, and added support for tunnel traffic in interpret_flow_elements. (architecture-related: public API)
Added support for pattern matching of inner Ethernet headers, with flow dump output displaying both outer and inner L2 masks. (architecture-related: public API)

Added support for the NT400D11 NIC, including register descriptions, reset initialization (phases 0/1/3/4), initialization stub functions, and unified naming of get operation functions. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)
Added support for matching single-layer or multi-layer nested inner VLAN headers, with flow dump output printing both outer and inner VLAN masks. (architecture-related: public API)
Added flow pull support for the ntnic driver, implementing eth_flow_pull and related auxiliary functions. (architecture-related: public API)
Added probe/remove functions and a log module for the NBL NIC driver, and implemented device information query functionality. (architecture-related: NBL driver module)

Added link status detection and notification functionality for the Amber-Lite VF, supporting correct reporting of link rate and notification of VF link status changes via PF mailbox. (architecture-related: PF-VF mailbox communication)

The txgbe driver added pkt-filter-size and pkt-filter-drop-queue device parameters to replace the deprecated FDIR configuration; automatically switches to the FDIR filter when the ntuple filter is full; the VF driver supports requesting PF configuration of FDIR rules through the new mailbox API. (architecture-related: public configuration interface and mailbox API)

The tap driver replaced interface control from ioctl with Netlink, added auxiliary functions based on netlink, removed ioctl-related code, and mandated that Netlink socket be available. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)
Added support for the MPLS protocol, implementing MPLS packet parsing and drop, forward, or queue actions. (architecture-related: MPLS protocol support)

Added global table scope support for the socket direct application, with table scopes divided into global, shared application, and non-shared; also fixed the issue of duplicate firmware deconfiguration when DPDK is closed. (architecture-related: global table scope)
Added support for GRE Key to the bnxt driver, adding GRE Key header parsing handler functions. (architecture-related: GRE Key support)

Removed the early return for non-P5 chips in the promiscuous mode setting in the bnxt/tf_ulp driver, thereby supporting the unicast-only feature, so that application ports no longer receive broadcast, multicast, and unknown MAC addresses. (architecture-related: external behavior)
Added support for passing flow metadata between E-Switch and VM, allowing VM applications to process inbound and outbound flow metadata. (architecture-related: public API)

Added the domain_id parameter to the dmadev join access group API, and adjusted the parameter order to be consistent with the create API, while updating related documentation. (architecture-related: public API)

Added callback parameters to the IRQ registration and deregistration functions of the CPT LF, and added initialization, enable, disable, and cleanup routines for the completion queue, supporting conditional skipping of IRQ operations. (architecture-related: public API)
Added an outbound soft expiration handling mechanism based on CPT CQ for the CNXK NIC, and added devargs support to enable this feature. (architecture-related: public API)

Added support for ConnectX-9 SuperNIC devices in the mlx5 driver, including defining their PCI device ID and registering the device in the crypto and network drivers, while updating related documentation. (architecture-related: new hardware support)
Added support for using DevX bulk counters in root table rules, and allowed specifying an offset. (architecture-related: public API)
Under the HW Steering engine, added support for using count and age flow actions in the root table (group 0). (architecture-related: public API)

Improved representor parameter parsing, supporting bracket syntax (e.g., (pfX)vfY) to explicitly specify probing only VF representative ports, and suppressing automatic addition of PF representor ports in multi-port E-Switch scenarios. (architecture-related: public API)

Added a function to read the software steering capability bit in the MLX5 common driver, used to detect whether the hardware supports software forwarding, in preparation for disabling SWS in the future. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)

Added a source-prune device parameter to the ice NIC driver, with source MAC address pruning disabled by default to support VRRP broadcast packets; users can enable source pruning via this parameter. (architecture-related: public API)

Support for link mode configuration, including auto-negotiation, duplex mode, and speed settings; users can configure the port's working mode and rate via the link_speeds field in rte_eth_conf. (architecture-related: public API)
Obtained port type, connector type, and FEC statistics from firmware, enhancing port information reporting, and reporting connector type in link status. (architecture-related: public API)
Added allocation annotations to the BPF load function to support compiler detection of misuse of memory allocation and release. (architecture-related: public API)
Added IOVA mode checking in Linux coexistence scenarios, mandating IOVA=PA mode when IOMMU is in passthrough mode. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)

Added a traffic management tree for the SDP interface on the CNXK platform, creating independent trees when multiple Tx queues are requested to support independent backpressure for each queue. (architecture-related: public API)
Extended the LSO offload feature on the CN20K platform, adding mailbox configuration alt flags and supporting IPv4 fragmentation. (architecture-related: public API)
Added per-packet update of SQ counts and SQ resizing functionality for the CNXK platform, extending the SQ context to support dynamic expansion and contraction. (architecture-related: public API)
Supplemented the mlx5.rst documentation with limitations when using the flow API with hardware steering (HWS).
common/mlx5 added the BlueField-4 DPU device ID to the list of NVIDIA devices supported by the mlx5 driver.
common/cnxk raised the maximum number of Tx scheduler to 2K in roc_nix_priv.h to match CN10K platform capabilities.
The IAVF driver's scalar Tx path and AVX-512 path added QinQ insertion offload support, and dynamically reports this offload capability based on VF capabilities.
Added a trace point for operation parameters in the acc_error_log function, recording operation details when the operation is rejected by PMD.

Added RISC-V vector extension support for the FIB lookup function, adding judgment for the RISC-V Vector Extension instruction set and dispatch of corresponding lookup functions in the vector function selection logic.
Added the --enable-rss option to testpmd, allowing forced enabling of RSS in single-queue mode, mutually exclusive with --disable-rss.
Added display of the minimum and maximum MTU values supported by the port in the show port info command.

Support for unmonitored Hyper-V channels, using UINT8_MAX marker and skipping delay settings when reading the monitor ID fails, and added support for sending events via interrupt pages and UIO interface for vmbus channels that do not support monitor.
Added the ice_get_max_simd_bitwidth function in the ice driver to obtain the maximum SIMD bit width, unifying the use of the common vector capability function.
The iavf driver added a function to obtain the maximum SIMD bit width, using the common vector capability function.
Support for out-of-order completion of GVE DQ Tx, introducing a new packet ring and idle completion tag stack to resolve performance degradation and memory leaks caused by out-of-order completion.
Cached all PCI driver parameters so that the same parameters can be reused after device hot-removal and re-hotplug, while cleaning up related memory allocation and release logic.
Added functions for writing, deleting, and getting flow steering table entries via the DTB channel.
Added firmware version query, promiscuous mode setting, and module information retrieval functions for the xsc NIC driver.
The XSC NIC port added support for enabling and disabling promiscuous mode.
Added device ID for the Intel E835 series Ethernet controllers, mapping them to the E830 series MAC type.
Improved the AESNI-MB crypto driver CPU code path, adding support for output-to-place (OOP), and fixed several minor issues.
Added a warning at testpmd startup for missing offload flags related to multi-segment packets.
Updated link speed capabilities to support 200G and 400G, and renamed internal functions.
Support for devices with compressed PCI BAR, added a register address initialization function and adjusted command queue configuration and device deinitialization logic.
Updated the common Rx path selection infrastructure to support single-queue features, and replaced the original complex logic in the idpf driver with this common function.
Support for multiple PF processes sharing flow tables, refactoring device management data structures to distinguish different PF.
Added scattered receive support for the idpf driver's split Rx queues, enabling functions to handle jumbo packets and multi-mbuf receive scenarios.
Support for reading and setting the MAC address from hardware, replacing the original fixed default MAC address.
Added software packet type parsing in the enetfec driver, temporarily supporting identification of IPv4 and IPv6 packets.
The testpmd dump command changed from underscore-separated to space-separated, merged parsing functions, and added mbuf history related dump commands.
The ice NIC driver added Data Center Bridging (DCB) support, including DCB configuration checks, initialization and deinitialization, and priority flow control settings.
The IDPF driver supports device discovery via PCI class ID, and added a helper function to determine PF/VF.
The CPFL driver added MMG hardware device ID, renamed macros, and dynamically configures the number of queues based on PCI function number.
The ENA driver added extended completion descriptor support for the TX path, allowing selection of descriptor type, unified the RX path to use extended descriptors, and added timestamp processing.
The ENA NIC driver added interrupt loss detection support, adding a lost interrupt indication parameter in the interrupt update register.
The DPAA2 network driver now queries actual MAC speed capabilities via the new MC command at probe time, and sets the device's speed capability field accordingly.
Added policer statistics support for each TC, and supports dpmac statistics when the MC version is higher than 10.39.0.
Added TX laser enable/disable support for the Amber-Lite NIC, and adjusted GPIO and LED control logic based on hardware type.
Added TX queue rate limiting functionality for the Amber-Lite NIC, and adjusted related configuration logic.
Added thermal sensor support for the Amber-Lite NIC, including configuration for initialization and data reading.
Enabled RSS functionality for the Amber-Lite NIC, supporting Amber-Lite series MAC types by extending the RSS update function.
Added support for up to 4 MAC address filters and up to 4 VLAN filters for the ENETC4 driver, and added a new MTU setting function.
Added queue information query and link update support for the ENETC4 driver, and added receive/send queue information retrieval functions and supported packet type query functions.
Added delayed queue start/stop functionality for the ENETC4 driver, supporting skipping transmit/receive queues marked for delayed start during device startup.
Added a global configuration section for the dma-perf application, supporting specification of EAL parameters for all test cases via eal_args entries in the configuration file.
Added the --list-dma option to the dpdk-test-dma-perf tool, and refactored the parameter parsing and CSV output modules.
Migrated the cache_flush and test_seconds parameters of the DMA performance test application from the test case level to the global configuration.
Added the exception_path device parameter for the NTNIC network card driver, supporting forwarding of unmatched packets through queue 0.
Added the eth_flow_query function for the ntnic driver, supporting flow queries with count actions, and adjusted the flow operation registration interface.
Extended the flow dump feature to support output of MBR initialization configuration and rule information.

Added support for configuration and release of Rx and Tx queues for NBL devices, implemented stopping the transmit ring, releasing the receive ring, and allocating receive buffers, and corrected related function names.
Added device start and stop functions for the NBL network device.
Implemented send and receive burst functionality for the NBL device, and added functions for packet processing, statistics, and link status query.
Added statistics and extended statistics (xstats) functionality for the NBL network device, supporting retrieval, reset of statistics, and retrieval of xstats counts, names, and values.
Added MTU update support for the NBL network device driver, implementing the MTU setting function.
Added promiscuous mode support for the NBL network device driver, implementing the promiscuous mode setting and related channel request functions.
Added recognition support for Centec SK21101 PHY in the ngbe driver.
Added three Amber-Lite 25G virtual function device IDs for the txgbe driver, supporting recognition and driver matching of the corresponding devices.
Added the flush operation for the Amber-Lite network card, ensuring configuration takes effect immediately.
Added RSS register mapping support for Amber-Lite 25G VF, extending the mapping function to correctly access RSS-related registers.
Added BME reset configuration for Amber-Lite 25G VF, reconfiguring the PCIE bus master enable register during VF reset.

Added new action bits and adjusted field mappings for the Broadcom TruFlow ULP template database, and added application data definitions for Wh+ products to adapt to the Wh+, P5, and P7 product families.

Enhanced the pdump tool to support multi-process scenarios, adding pdump initialization and cleanup logic in the dumpcap and pdump applications, and forwarding callback enable notifications to the secondary process.

Removed the dependency of the socket direct feature on multi-root configuration, always enabling the global table scope for Thor2, and removed the global table scope feature bit; also added support for the unicast only feature.
Added non-VFR mode support in the initialization function, controlled by a compile-time feature bit, enabling testpmd port-to-port forwarding mode.
In no-hugepage mode, replaced the memory physical address retrieval function from rte_mem_virt2phy with rte_mem_virt2iova to support running as a non-privileged user.
Added support for using the parent PF vnic for the PF action handler.
Added a feature bit for Rx miss transmission to the parent PF for the bnxt/tf_ulp driver, and added corresponding processing logic.
Added promiscuous mode support for the TruFlow application in the bnxt driver, enabling or disabling reception of packets with unknown destination MAC addresses.

Added network namespace change detection and handling for the tap driver, automatically rebuilding the netlink and LSC interrupt socket and maintaining control when the interface is moved to another namespace.

Added link carrier configuration for the net/tap interface, enabling its use in Linux bonding; after configuring at least one RX queue and when switching network namespaces, the carrier is forcibly enabled via ioctl.
Added support for the E610 network card in the ixgbe driver, enabling correct setting of all supported link speeds.

Added register definitions, control structures, and queue descriptor structures related to CQ (completion queue) configuration for the CPT hardware unit, to support initialization, enabling, and disabling of CPT CQ.

Updated mlx5 flow device parameter handling, automatically selecting default values based on whether the hardware supports software or hardware flow control, and forcibly disabling duplicate mode with a log message when incompatible.
Simulated support for sending and receiving VLAN offload in software, implementing insertion and stripping of VLAN tags.
Added support for hardware dropped RX packet counting (imissed) for the NBL network device driver, including statistics start, update, reset, and resource management.
Added the DCB forwarding command in the testpmd application, supporting specification of traffic classes and configuration of the number of cores used by each traffic class.
common/sfc_efx/base enables parallel detect in efx_np.c when autoneg is enabled, to attempt to discover technologies/FEC settings that bring the link up.

The three drivers net/i40e, net/cpfl, and net/idpf switched to the common vector capability function to determine the maximum simd bitwidth, and removed unused AVX-related structure members in cpfl/idpf.
Removed the unsupported SCTP receive offload feature from the ice network card driver.
net/gve added datapath-specific log control in gve_rx_dqo.c and gve_tx_dqo.c to separate datapath and non-datapath logs.
net/mlx5 moved mlx5_flex_parser_ecpri_release() from mlx5.c to mlx5_flow_flex.c and changed it to non-static for subsequent flow steering cleanup.
app/testpmd changed the parameters of jump to matcher action in cmdline_flow.c from table pointers to using standard table ID.
app/flow-perf added test support for flow table query rate in main.c.
app/crypto-perf added support for SIGN and VERIFY operations on ECDSA SECP384R1, SECP192R1, SECP224R1, and SECP521R1 curves.
Added partial encryption and decryption test cases for SM2 elliptic curve point computation, and added key generation, encapsulation, and decapsulation test functions for ML-KEM.
test/crypto adds ECDH, ECPM, and ECDSA test cases for QAT in test_cryptodev_asym.c.
test/crypto adds blockcipher test coverage for the crypto CPU mode code path in test_cryptodev_blockcipher.c and related files.
test/dma adds test support for SVA copy in test_dmadev.c.
test/bpf adds ELF loading tests: generate ELF files via clang, repackage them as arrays using xdd, and test the loading and execution of BPF; if libelf is unavailable, the test is skipped.
test/bpf adds Rx and Tx filtering tests using null devices; if libelf is unavailable, the test is skipped.

examples/flow_filtering adds a jump flow feature to jump to a specified group, adding three snippets: NSH matching, RoCE IB BTH opcode/dest_qp matching, and Switch Granularity matching; it also adds a port affinity snippet for ingress affinity of bound ports and moves NR_QUEUES to common.h.
doc/guides/nics/mlx5.rst documentation adds instructions for querying non-contiguous PF index via sysfs phys_port_name under ConnectX-7 Multi-Host Setup to configure multi-host LAG representor.
Update the mlx5 vDPA guide, adjust supported devices, and reformat the title layout.
In the ice driver guide, add documentation for the protocol-independent filtering feature, making the original implicit assumptions explicit.
In the ionic guide, add support documentation for Pollara 400 AI NIC devices and add a product introduction link.
Update the recommended firmware and version information in the ice and i40e driver guides, and remove version information for the deprecated DPDK version.
In the net/null driver, add the fast mbuf release send offload feature, reusing the existing mbuf pool pointer in the queue structure.
In ethdev register telemetry, support the hide_zero parameter, support controlling whether to hide zero values via hide_zero=true/false, and adjust the usage of the filter parameter.
In the ethdev telemetry feature, add dump output for the RSS algorithm.
In the net/r8169 driver, add multi-queue support for 8126 and 8127 chips, supporting 4 RX queues and 2 TX queues.
In common/cnxk, add a function to check whether the board supports 16B alignment.
In common/cnxk, add backpressure configuration RoC API for the NPA pool of CN20K SoC, supporting per-pool threshold and BPID configuration for eight different traffic classes.
In bus/fslmc, implement plug and unplug functions for DPNI hotplug, supporting attach/detach of the dpni interface.

In app/testpmd, improve output prompts for command file processing: display the current file name when processing multiple files and print a EOF message at the end, changing "Read CLI commands" to "Finished reading" to eliminate ambiguity.
In net/ice/base, add missing definitions for commands related to health status.

In net/dpaa2, add a dump function for eCPRI packet headers and message contents, supporting output of ECPRI packet headers on Ethernet/VLAN/UDP and message contents of various types in the parsing result area via softparser.

Fix exported header files so they can be included individually without compilation warnings, for example, adding conditional compilation protection for experimental API in rte_pmd_iavf.h. (architecture-related: public API)

Fix the issue in the rte_cfgfile_num_sections function where passing an empty section name causes a NULL pointer to be passed; now, when sectionname is NULL, it directly returns the count of all sections. (architecture-related: public API)
Fix the integer overflow issue when shifting the highest bit left in the IPv4 address macro RTE_IPV4, avoiding undefined behavior through explicit type casting. (architecture-related: public API)
Fix the undefined behavior in the RTE_TAILQ_LOOKUP macro caused by arithmetic operations on a NULL pointer. (architecture-related: public API)
Fix the alignment issue of the param array in multi-process messages, aligning it to 8 bytes to avoid runtime errors caused by unaligned access. (architecture-related: public API)

Fix the issue in the vmxnet3 driver where the memory region mapping bitmask type is too small; change the index bitmask variable from uint8_t to uint16_t, and correct the queue count check logic so that both RX and TX queues support up to 16 queues. (architecture-related: public API)

Fix the RSS feature in the ZXDH driver, extending the hash factor type from 32 bits to 64 bits, and improve the RSS enable/disable logic and configuration initialization flow. (architecture-related: public API)

Fix the reporting of minimum and maximum MTU and maximum receive packet length in the mlx5 PMD, changing it to query the actual allowed MTU range from the operating system, with fallback values on the Windows platform. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)

Add a devarg parameter to the DPAA NIC to control error packet reception, fix the crash caused by error queues in VSP mode, and adjust the timestamp enable logic and RX queue count check. (architecture-related: devarg parameter)

Fix the VLAN tag handling logic in the Intel NIC drivers (i40e, iavf, ice), no longer assuming the outer tag always exists, but correctly setting the QinQ or single VLAN flag based on actual flags, resolving the double-tag stripping issue under different VLAN protocol types. (architecture-related: VLAN tag handling)

Fix the issue in the GVE driver where not all resources are released when the device is closed; move the resource release logic from device removal to the device close function and refactor the related steps. (architecture-related: device close flow)

Fix the error log issue caused by improper MP channel cleanup order when the secondary process exits; move the rte_mp_channel_cleanup call to after eal_bus_cleanup. (architecture-related: EAL cleanup order)
Fix the L2 length calculation issue in GRE tunnel packets, so that the L2_len returned by rte_net_get_ptype() correctly includes the tunnel protocol header. (architecture-related: public API)
Fix the issue in pipeline mode where non-EAL threads cannot bind lcore; use rte_lcore_has_role to check lcore validity, and add error handling for invalid graph ID. (architecture-related: public API)

Add a mechanism for the secondary process of testpmd to monitor the primary process, automatically exiting the secondary when the primary exits, avoiding crashes caused by accessing invalid devices. (architecture-related: secondary process monitoring)

When using the port ID action in dv_flow_en=2 mode, an error is now returned with a prompt to use the representor port action instead, avoiding the action being silently ignored. (architecture-related: external behavior)

Fix the lock inconsistency issue in the hns3 driver rte_flow API, replacing pthread mutex with spin lock, and remove the no longer needed pthread mutex attribute and redundant functions. (architecture-related: public API)
Fix the validation of connection tracking state items, ensuring only valid RTE_FLOW_CONNTRACK_PKT_STATE_* flag combinations are allowed. (architecture-related: public API)

Fix the flow mark creation issue: use NOP to replace the unsupported flow tag action in the FDB TX direction, and prohibit the use of mark in transfer templates and the creation of flow tag when FW is not supported. (architecture-related: public API)

Fixed a crash caused by indirect AGE actions created using the synchronous API, changed to use the current queue index to allocate counters; also added validation for synchronous and asynchronous AGE action creation, and updated documentation; synchronous query aging flows are rejected in strict queue mode. (architecture-related: external behavior)
Fixed mbuf debug flag support in the Intel NIC driver, unified to use the original allocation/free functions rte_mbuf_raw_free_bulk and rte_mbuf_raw_alloc_bulk. (architecture-related: public API)
Fixed the GVE driver DQ Rx to support out-of-order completion, by introducing buf_id and a completion list to correctly match returned buffers. (architecture-related: public API)

Added direction metadata to all switching rules to avoid rules accidentally matching Tx traffic; for rules that are close to capacity, metadata is not added because they are already specific enough. (architecture-related: public API)

Fixed the issue where AVX2 support was broken due to the Meson build, removed obsolete compile-time checks and restored necessary header file inclusions. (architecture-related: build and platform compatibility)

Fixed the issue in the mlx5 driver where rte_eth_dev_get_mtu() returned the default MTU instead of the actual set value, now correctly synchronizing the MTU field during device initialization. (architecture-related: public API)

Fixed the include guard in the VDUSE imported header file to avoid conflicts with system header files, adjusted the header file inclusion order, and updated related documentation. (architecture-related: public API)

Fixed LTO build issues, updated the netlink attribute addition function and related macros in the tap driver to pass a pointer to the message structure. (architecture-related: build and installation methods)

Fixed handling of rawdev device ID retrieval failure, changed the return type of rte_rawdev_get_dev_id() from uint16_t to int to support negative error values, and added error checks in callers. (architecture-related: public API)
Fixed compatibility of the gpudev driver header file on Windows. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)
Fixed syntax errors in the ARM 32-bit memcpy header file when compiled with C++. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)
Fixed a potential overflow in NVM initialization due to the shadow RAM size being defined as 16-bit, changed it to 32-bit. (architecture-related: public API)
Fixed the calculation of the used ring address in the virtio-user driver to avoid failures in address translation by Vhost-vDPA backends (such as VDUSE). (architecture-related: virtio-user driver)

Fixed the issue where vmxnet3 v4 RSS writes to BAR registers failed on ESX 8.0+ with single-queue configuration, automatically disabling RSS in single-queue scenarios. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)
Perform proper cleanup of frame queues when the DPAA bus is closed, adding a timeout mechanism and debug logs to prevent resource leaks and abnormal states. (architecture-related: public API)

Added an interrupt control function in QMan global initialization, allowing users to disable invalid enqueue state interrupts via environment variables to avoid system hangs. (architecture-related: runtime behavior)
Fixed the issue where VDUSE device creation did not enable external buffer and linear buffer features, causing abnormal TSO support. (architecture-related: public API)

Fix clang 21 compilation errors by replacing RTE_TRACE_POINT_ARGS(void) with a direct (void) to avoid applying the __rte_unused attribute to void parameters. (architecture-related: build compatibility)

Correct the maximum VF count per PF on Thor2 to 128, and fix the issue where the hash table entry count is calculated incorrectly when the maximum VNIC count is less than 8. (architecture-related: public API: maximum VF count)

Fix the boundary check in flow action parsing used to determine whether an action type is valid, correcting the upper limit from RTE_FLOW_ACTION_TYPE_INDIRECT to RTE_FLOW_ACTION_TYPE_REPRESENTED_PORT. (architecture-related: public API)

Fix the external SQ control flow leak by adding the rte_pmd_mlx5_external_sq_disable() API, allowing applications to notify the PMD to release related implicit flows, avoiding flow table overflow after multiple device start/stop cycles. (architecture-related: public API)

In the DV flow engine, when the source field type is not VALUE or POINTER, reject the add and sub types of modify field operations, and update the related documentation. (architecture-related: external behavior: modify field operation restrictions)
Enable the CPT completion queue (CQ) in outbound security processing, supporting reading error packets from the CQ. (architecture-related: public API: CPT completion queue)
Prohibit ring size from being 0 to prevent runtime crashes, and add corresponding test cases. (architecture-related: public API: ring size validation)

Fix the memory ordering issue in the MCS lock by adding correct synchronization edges in lock, unlock, and trylock to establish a happens-before relationship between threads, and remove invalid memory barriers. (architecture-related: public API: MCS lock memory ordering fix)

Fix the data race issue in the ring library under weak memory models by adjusting memory ordering to ensure a safe partial order relationship. (architecture-related: ring library concurrency behavior)

Fix the memory ordering issue in HTS ring mode by adjusting the release/acquire semantics of CAS and head load to establish a happens-before relationship between threads of the same role. (architecture-related: ring library HTS mode concurrency behavior)

Fix the memory ordering issue in RTS mode by using release and acquire semantics for CAS and the preceding head load respectively, establishing a safe partial order relationship between threads. (architecture-related: ring library RTS mode concurrency behavior)

Fix the Rx path selection logic: only prefer the path with fewer offload features when two candidate paths have the same SIMD width; otherwise, prefer the path with a larger SIMD width. (architecture-related: Rx path selection logic)
Fix the bit offset handling of the IPv6 DSCP field in the HWS engine to ensure the synchronous stream API correctly sets this field. (architecture-related: public API behavior)
Fix the issue of cross-GVMI metadata matching in E-Switch settings, and add a cross-GVMI support check in metadata flow entry processing. (architecture-related: core module: E-Switch metadata)

Downgrade the MTU setting check from an error to a warning when hash offload is not enabled on the SDP interface, to support scenarios where the host application knows the maximum buffer size. (architecture-related: MTU setting behavior change)

Fix support for root table flow tag index registers REG_C_8 through REG_C_11 in the mlx5 driver, and change the assertion for invalid tag index to return an error message. (architecture-related: public API)

Fix the issue of hardcoded matching conditions during flow creation in the mlx5 driver on the Windows platform, change to use the match_criteria_enable attribute, and add support for the NVGRE packet type. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)

Fix flex flow item header length, support new firmware capability bits, and correspondingly adjust the calculation and configuration of the length field offset. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)
Fix IPv6 link-local address generation to comply with the RFC 4291 specification, inverting the u bit of the EUI-64 interface identifier. (architecture-related: public API)
Add virtual VLAN offload configuration operations for the nbl driver to avoid returning errors when software handles VLAN stripping. (architecture-related: public API)
Fix the Rx offload flag to use the device-configured Rx offload instead of a hardcoded value when draining event ports. (architecture-related: external behavior)
Fix the ID validation logic for compressdev devices to ensure that releasing a device does not cause other valid devices to become inaccessible.

Ensure proper cleanup when EAL initialization fails: release saved EAL parameters and reset the run_once flag to zero, handle error paths through a unified err_out label, and move the multiple-call check before parameter saving and parsing.

Fix the PCI BAR mapping error in the ena NIC driver on systems with 64K page size by adding a helper function to calculate the correct virtual address offset. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)

Fix issues with VFIO custom containers in multi-process scenarios: clarify that rte_vfio_get_container_fd() only returns the default container, avoid calling multi-process communication in rte_vfio_container_create() and non-regular group binding code, remove SOCKET_REQ_DEFAULT_CONTAINER and merge it into SOCKET_REQ_CONTAINER.
Add __rte_packed_end to the TruFlow HSI structure definition in net/bnxt.
Fix the include guard namespace in multiple library headers, add the "RTE" prefix, and supplement the missing include guard for rte_eal_paging.h.
Fix undefined behavior in port list parsing caused by arithmetic on NULL pointers and integer left shifts, use the RTE_BIT32 macro instead of direct shifting.
Fix the left shift overflow issue in rte_rib6_insert caused by ip_xor being implicitly promoted to int, explicitly cast to uint32_t to avoid undefined behavior.
Fix the error path release issue in the net/bnxt driver discovered by LTO compilation, change to jump to cleanup logic.
Fix UBSan errors in predictable RSS caused by unaligned memory access.
Fix the 128-bit unaligned access issue in the stack implementation by adding alignment constraints to the structure.
Fix the Tx vector path selection logic in the iavf driver to ensure that this path is preferred when AVX-512 is available, avoiding incorrect fallback to the scalar path.
Fix undefined behavior caused by calling memset on a NULL pointer in the graph statistics module, UBSan errors caused by unaligned memory access, and memory leaks.
Fix the size and initialization of extract buffer in the dpaa2 driver, use rte_zmalloc to ensure zeroing, and adjust the maximum size to the correct structure size.
Fix the traffic shaping rate configuration in the dpaa2 NIC driver to correctly convert the user-provided byte rate to the bit rate required by the hardware.
Enable software tail drop for ordered queues in the DPAA2 driver and enable congestion notification on traffic management queues by default.
Fix a crash caused by NULL pointer dereference when listing timer adapters via telemetry.

Fix multiple issues in the DQO transmit path of GVE: when a single mbuf exceeds the maximum buffer size, write multiple descriptors to send the entire packet; drop packets and increment counters when descriptors are insufficient; avoid writing zero-length descriptors that cause hardware rejection.
Fix the validity check before sending Tx packets in the GVE driver to avoid hardware disabling transmission due to mbuf errors.
Enforce a descriptor count limit in the DQO Tx path of the GVE driver, setting the maximum number of data descriptors per MTU segment to GVE_TX_MAX_DATA_DESCS.
Fix the TSO segment descriptor count limit issue in the DQO queue of the GVE driver, add a validation function to ensure that each segment of MTU size uses at most 10 data descriptors.
Fix the issue in the GVE driver where DQO transmit descriptors were not zeroed, causing hardware misinterpretation, zero-initialize descriptors before writing.
Fix the string length limit for the set core list command in testpmd, replace fixed-length strings with variable-length strings to support more cores.
Fix UDP tunnel tag support for GTP tunnel type in the i40e driver, correct the L3 header offset calculation error when sending GTP packets with checksum offload.
Fix error handling when MAC configuration fails in the ZXDH driver, optimize resource release during device shutdown and error code judgment in MAC address operations.
Fix VLAN filtering and port VLAN attribute setting issues in the ZXDH driver, add support for VF VLAN table initialization.
Fix the issue where short PCI device names in testpmd cannot be correctly recognized, normalize them to the long format during attach_port before device lookup.
Fix the issue in the octeon_ep driver where the return value was not correctly handled when interrupt enable failed, return gracefully when the file handle is unavailable.
Fix mbuf data offset update in the octeon_ep driver, use rearm data instead of directly modifying data_off, and remove redundant refill count updates.
Fix TX and RX doorbell handling logic during device startup in the octeon_ep driver, ensure pending packets in the RX queue are drained and refilled before startup.

Adapt the DPAA memory pool for the LS1043A erratum, adjust each element through the populate callback to ensure the starting DMA address is aligned to 16B, and aligned to 256B when crossing 4KB boundaries.
Fix SCTP port filtering on E610 devices in the ixgbe driver, add it to the device list supporting SCTP ports.

Fix the issue in PMD of ipsec_mb where a secondary process releasing a queue pair may incorrectly release a queue pair that does not belong to it, add a process ID check to ensure only its own queue pairs are released.
Fix a memory leak in ipool destruction caused by not releasing internal cache memory in debug mode.
Fix the issue where heap memory allocation in the fallback path did not enforce 8-byte alignment, use posix_memalign to ensure alignment requirements.
Fix asynchronous event handling, when an unexpected asynchronous event is received, acknowledge it and continue waiting until the expected event is received.

Fix the issue where default flow rule creation failure when the proxy port is not started in HWS mode causes port representor startup failure, change to ignore the failure and log a debug message, and add an early return check when flow control is disabled.
Fix the issue where after the shared Rx queue's transmit proxy port is closed, the representor port cannot traverse its shared Rx queues, store shared and non-shared Rx queues in separate lists.
Fixed the ESP header matching issue in strict mode, adding implicit matching for IP.proto value 50, as well as implicit matching for UDP.dport value 4500 when ESP over UDP.
Fixed the issue of incorrectly writing the interrupt mask bit when starting the Rx queue in DQ queue format, and changed it to correctly set no-interrupt mode.

Fixed the ASan error caused by accessing freed stack memory due to compound literals during RSS flow creation in the MLX5 driver, and changed the jump action configuration to persistent stack allocation at the beginning of the function.

Fixed the setting of the VLAN offload flag in the Rx vector path of the ice NIC, replacing the generic VLAN offload flag with separately supported VLAN stripping and filtering flags to address the issue of not supporting QinQ.

Fixed the double free issue in non-template flow destruction, avoiding use-after-free caused by repeatedly freeing the matcher when rule creation fails due to insufficient memory, and clearing freed pointers in the destruction function to prevent potential double-free.
Fixed the issue in the ice driver where the VLAN tag was not correctly reported upon reception due to incorrect modification of the l2tsel field.
Fixed the race condition when refreshing non-template age rules, avoiding assertion failures caused by the age sampling callback accessing freed resources during age or counter release.
Fixed the definition of the ifname parameter in the mlx5_get_ifname function, changing it from a pointer to a character buffer, and updated related calls.

Fixed the issue of conntrack action query failure in testpmd, added handling for RTE_FLOW_ACTION_TYPE_CONNTRACK in the switch branch of action type filtering, and added instructions for the command to query conntrack status in the user guide.

Fixed the fallback behavior of the sfc driver when the firmware does not support the new netport API, falling back to the EF10 generic PHY and MAC methods on Medford4 devices to maintain old behavior.
