Fixed the issue where the FDB domain in the HW Steering engine did not allow the TIR action, thereby supporting the use of the RSS action in transfer flow rules.
Fixed the issue in Direct Verbs counter offset detection where the egress flag was incorrectly passed into the type field, avoiding false positive results on older rdma-core.
Fixed the issue of not releasing VLAN resources when hns3 driver initialization fails, and encapsulated the hns3_uninit_hardware() function to uniformly release hardware resources.
Fixed the issue of mbuf being incorrectly overwritten in the vector path, pointing mbuf to fake_mbuf when mbuf cannot be allocated to prevent subsequent operations from modifying it.
Fixed the memory leak issue in the GVE driver when creating the RX ring, where if some mbuf allocations failed, the successfully allocated buffers were not released.
Fixed the input setting and result collection logic of the ECDH implementation in the QAT driver, corrected the data source reference, and added branch handling for key exchange types.
Fixed the parameter reading issue for ECDH key exchange in the QAT driver, changing it to obtain EC parameters from xform to avoid the case where they may not be set in asym_op.
Added validation for the number of DSCP and VLAN table entries for meter creation in testpmd, limiting the maximum number of entries.

Fixed the race condition in mlx5 driver device probing, introduced an asynchronous monitor ready flag to ensure port information updates are only handled by the monitor thread after it is ready, and removed the old direct update function.
Fixed the issue where multicast MAC address traffic was incorrectly disabled in the mlx5 driver, and now correctly creates default rules for multicast MAC addresses when traffic is enabled.
Fixed the issue of using an uninitialized MAC address variable when initializing representor ports in the xsc driver.
Fixed the issue in testpmd where the IPv6 extension header was not correctly handled when obtaining the L4 protocol from the L3 header.
Fixed the payload corruption issue caused by incorrectly updating the TCP flag of the tail packet when merging packets in GRO.
Fixed the duplicate or incorrect setting issue of the vector Rx queue in the i40e driver, removing redundant setting logic before path selection.
Fixed the incorrect call order in the ice_add_adv_recipe function, moving ice_get_sw_fv_list after ice_add_special_words to ensure special words can be correctly parsed.
Fixed the issue in the ice driver where MAC VLAN filter rules matched the inner VLAN in dual VLAN mode, introducing a recipe ID override mechanism to correctly match the outer VLAN.

Fixed the issue in the ice driver where core reset was not triggered when the ice_cfg_tx_topo function configuration failed, ensuring core reset is performed regardless of success or failure to release the global configuration lock, avoiding subsequent DDP loading failures.
Fixed the issue in the ice driver where dropped packets in the receive direction were not counted in statistics, and adjusted the source of byte counting.
Fixed the auto-negotiation detection logic in the sfc_efx driver, no longer relying on the dynamic AN state of the link partner.
Enabled auto-negotiation flow control by default in the sfc_efx driver to speed up link establishment.
Fixed the issue in the sfc_efx driver where the automatic FEC selection of netport MCDI was ignored.
Preserved the last FEC configuration by default during port initialization in the sfc_efx driver to avoid link interruption.
Fixed the possible use-after-free issue during Rx queue cleanup in the xsc driver.
Fixed the ESP matching issue in strict mode, adding implicit matching for IP.proto value 50 and for UDP.dport value 4500 when ESP over UDP.
Fixed ESP item validation, allowing the hardware steering engine to match ESP sequence numbers.
Fixed the issue of matching the ESP header after UDP packets in group 0, ensuring that when the UDP header exists, the IP protocol is no longer forced to be ESP.

Fixed the crash in the af_packet driver in the secondary process caused by using strdup to allocate the interface name, changing to use rte_malloc for memory allocation and adjusting the free method accordingly.
Fixed the issue of repeatedly freeing mbuf when releasing the Rx queue in the net/ark driver, and renamed related functions to maintain naming consistency.
Fixed the issue where the IPv4/6 protocol field was not correctly copied in flow encapsulation hash calculation, ensuring the hash calculation includes the correct next protocol field.
Added a workaround to poll the virtqueue ready state for VDUSE device startup to address timing issues.
Fixed the issue of the vduse_vq_info structure not being initialized in VDUSE virtual ring setup, ensuring all fields start from known values.

Switched to synchronous callback unregistration in the interrupt unload process, ensuring no callbacks are running after interrupt unload, improving stability during device removal and avoiding use-after-free issues.
Fixed the memory leak of indirect flow actions, releasing unreleased handles when destroying asynchronous action list handles.

Fixed the crash of the secondary process when the primary process exits due to forwarding not being stopped, by adding a multi-process communication mechanism to notify the secondary to stop forwarding before the primary exits.
Fixed the WRR token data type, changing the wrr_tokens array from uint8_t to uint16_t to avoid token truncation.
Fix the security vulnerabilities (buffer overflow and type errors) when parsing tail drop and XQE drop parameters in the cnxk driver.
Fix the build issue of GFNI on x86: add the missing rte_cpuflags.h header include in rte_thash.c to resolve compilation errors caused by implicit function declarations.
Refactor the RSA verification operation to avoid copying the decrypted message to the signature buffer, preventing overwriting the input buffer.
Fix the issue where short tunnel frames lose the VLAN tag when VLAN insertion is enabled, padding the tunnel frame length to 65 bytes.
Fix the issue where ACL configuration fails during 8-port device initialization; when the number of PFs exceeds 4, halve the TCAM depth to avoid out-of-memory.
Fix the crash caused by premature release of shared memory when running debug_autotest on mlx5 devices due to fork subprocess calling rte_exit().
Fix the memory leak of the flow index pool not being released, and add a function to release all flow index pools.
Fix the resource leak in the enetfec driver where the file descriptor is not closed when reading the UIO device file fails.
Fix the receive queue descriptor ring size configuration in the enetfec driver, forcing a fixed size to ensure correct buffer allocation.
Fix the issue in the enet_free_queue function where releasing the TX queue incorrectly releases the RX queue pointer.
Fix the condition check for TX checksum offload in the enetfec driver, and correct the data cache operation instruction.
The enetfec driver now rejects configuring multiple TX queues, supporting only single-queue mode.
Fix the memory leak in the enetfec driver where the Rx buffer is released without checking if mbuf is NULL.
In enetfec PMD, reject unsupported Tx deferred start and multi-queue configurations, and fix the issue of incorrectly releasing rx_queues when freeing queues.
Change the cache operation for forwarded packets from write-back only to write-back and invalidate, to ensure data consistency.
Fix the memory leak in the IPv6 FIB trie module and the tbl8 entry allocation check logic, allowing the use of all pre-allocated tbl8 entries.
Fix the incorrect function and offload definitions in the Rx path of the iavf driver, and add support for the flexible descriptor path.

Fix TSO segmentation handling in the net/rnp driver, performing multi-descriptor fragmentation for TSO packets exceeding 64KB to avoid segmentation anomalies; also fix the VLAN header boundary check and protocol header type validation for tunnel TSO.

Fix the parameter validity checks for firmware capability acquisition and speed capability acquisition functions in the net/rnp driver to avoid logic anomalies due to invalid firmware information; fix the crash caused by memory overflow when using the --no-lsc-interrupt option for link updates.

Remove the hardcoded memory channel parameter -n4 from the pdump tool, optimize parameter handling to avoid duplicate proc-type flags, and add a check for the main process liveness on exit; fix the integer type of the intermediate bursts, using unsigned integers to avoid wrap-around warnings.

Fix multiple stability issues in the DMA performance test tool: fix a use-after-free issue caused by using the pointer after cfgfile is closed; add configuration error messages to output specific error information and exit when required entries are missing from the configuration file; fix the issue where DMA may still be in flight when worker threads exit, adding a wait phase for DMA completion before exit; fix two issues that may occur when stopping the device.
Fix the resource leak in the PCI bus secondary process where the VFIO device file descriptor is not released when obtaining region information fails.
Fix the device name display issue in the CDX bus probe error message, replacing the unused variable with the correct device name.
Fix the incorrect device address release during probing in the CDX bus secondary process, using the correct device name.
Fix the cleanup order of PCD and FMan handles in the dpaa_fm_init function to prevent resource leaks.
Fix the memory leak in the zlib compression driver's inflate checksum function, releasing the dictionary memory before the function ends.
Fix the checksum error count in the receive path of the txgbe driver so that the rx_l3_l4_xsum_error statistics accumulate correctly.
Fix the issue where the rx_l3_l4_xsum_error statistic is always 0 in the ngbe NIC driver, correctly counting checksum errors in the receive path.
In the receive queue setup, change the memory allocation for ring descriptors from the maximum ring size to the actual ring size, and fix the virtual function detection logic.
Change the memory allocation for ring descriptors from the maximum ring size to the actual queue size to reduce memory usage; also fix the return type of the receive queue count function.
Fix the receive buffer size configuration register issue in the txgbe VF driver, changing rounding up to rounding down to avoid segmentation faults when receiving oversized packets in LRO mode.
Fix the receive buffer size configuration for VF devices, changing rounding up to rounding down to avoid segmentation faults when the hardware receives oversized packets in scatter mode.

Fix the mismatch between the maximum number of FDIR filters and the hardware's actual limit, dynamically calculating the hash table size based on the memory space allocated by the hardware to avoid creating rules beyond hardware allowance.
Fix the issue where FDIR stream rules were not reset to FDIR mode after all were cleared, preventing failures when creating new rules; also distinguish the FDIR programming paths for PF and VF.
Fix the restriction of the FDIR drop action on L4 matched packets in the txgbe driver, removing redundant hardware type and port checks.
Fix the issue in the txgbe driver where the SCTP tunnel packet FDIR filter creation fails due to duplicate and incorrect mask checks.
Fix the support for RAW mode matching in the FDIR filter for tunnel packets in the txgbe driver, and correct the related check logic.
Fix the FDIR input mask setting in the net/txgbe driver to meet hardware requirements (IPv4 mask little-endian, IPv6 mask bit-reversed), and correctly apply the mask instead of manually clearing.
Fix the issue in the txgbe NIC where the VF-PF message box only clears the first 4 bytes when adding an ntuple flow filter via the VF.
Fix the incorrect memory allocation size for the node extension statistics description, replacing the wrong sizeof macro with the correct macro value.
Fix the compilation error of the iavf driver under clang 21, initializing the uninitialized variable notify_byte to 0.
Fix the clang compilation warning in the mlx4 driver caused by an extra comma.
Fix the clang compilation warning caused by an unnecessary comma expression.

Fix the null pointer dereference in the bnxt driver when a representor port accesses the parent device after the upstream library releases the port and data is set to null, by adding a parent device existence check.
Fix the lookup table pool size calculation to include static buckets and starting offset in the pool capacity, avoiding crashes during large-scale flow offloading.
Fix Thor2 TF table scope sizing pool size calculation error, ensure flow counts and max_pools are powers of 2 to avoid rounding errors.
Fix the issue where VFR cleanup did not delete the representor flow, and fix the statistics counter thread deadlock issue.
Add a null pointer check when destroying the meter to avoid a crash when Thor does not support meter stats; fix the format of the bit allocator error message.
Fix the packet count error for OVS traffic by always accumulating full counts instead of read-clear, avoiding count loss due to rapid statistics counter resets.

Fix the default RSS configuration failure in the bnxt NIC driver caused by the mutual exclusivity of IPV6 and IPV6_FLOW_LABEL hash types; set only IPV6_FLOW_LABEL during hardware configuration, and ensure both types are reported when getting the configuration.
Fix the table scope close ordering issue during abnormal exit of Thor2 hot upgrade; remove the function identifier first, then release memory, to avoid the firmware deleting the scope repeatedly.
Fix the completion out-of-order issue in MPC by associating requests with completions via the opaque field, supporting out-of-order completions in batch processing.
Fix the UDP tunnel port count issue in the bnxt NIC driver, avoiding incorrect count increments when the same port is added repeatedly.
Fix the crash during VFR handling in the bnxt driver, enhance representor port parameter validation, and prevent duplicate port attachment.
Fix the configuration failure in the bnxt driver when the RSS hash type is none, allowing the RSS configuration to be correctly applied when the hash type is none.
Fix the issue where queue state was incorrectly overwritten during port restart, ensuring that stopped queues remain stopped after a driver reset to avoid packet loss.
Fix the crash on memory allocation failure caused by not checking the backing store allocation result.
Remove debug logs that may flood the screen when creating a large number of flows.
Fix the invalid maximum VF check for fid during table scope release in PF initialization when SR-IOV is disabled.
Fix the default rule conflict in multi-process scenarios for Tx by changing the default rule from global match-all to match by send queue (SQ), avoiding EEXIST errors caused by duplicate creation.
Fix the issue of incorrect default action settings for port ID by adding a kernel mbox interface to obtain the default rule action for the port, and use that action when creating flow rules.

Save the MTU value during Rx queue allocation, and use the saved value instead of the current device MTU when matching shared queues, fixing the failure of shared queue join checks due to subsequent MTU modifications.
Fix the issue in the mlx5 driver where external queue access did not correctly return NULL, avoiding null pointer dereference due to invalid queue indices.

Fix the hash adjustment bug in the mlx5 PMD when creating indirect RSS actions; this bug caused adjustments for certain hash type combinations to be skipped, resulting in flow rule creation failures in HW Steering mode.
Fix the issue where PCI device devargs were dropped during port attachment in testpmd, restoring the handling of application-provided PCI port devargs.
Fix the use-after-free issue when updating edges in the activity graph; switch to malloc+memcpy and add a function to replace all references to old node memory.
Fix the net/nbl driver by replacing random MAC addresses with hardware MAC addresses obtained from the network device.
Fix the use-after-free issue during cache list cleanup in the net/netvsc driver by switching to a safe traversal macro.
Fix the use-after-free of objects during meter cleanup in the net/nfp driver by switching to a safe traversal macro to avoid accessing freed memory.
In the dumpcap application, fix the exit behavior by exiting directly when the main process exits without attempting to clean up resources.
Fix the race condition between the pdump callback function and other CPU in the data path by introducing a reference count and wait mechanism to ensure callback safety.
Fix the issue of releasing a job with an invalid queue index when meter hardware resource allocation fails.
Fix the index leak issue caused by not reclaiming ipool resources when destroying meter_mark indirect actions.

Fix the issue in mlx5 PMD where masked indirect actions were incorrectly reported as missing in HWS mode; return specific errors via rte_flow_error, raise the log level, and add port and action handle information.
Fix the issue where MAC address changes of the bonded device in 802.3ad mode were not synchronized to the hardware MAC of the physical member NICs.
The ICE NIC driver forces the use of the Tx packet scheduling feature in the scalar path, and updates the offload flags of the vector path to include this feature.

Fix the issue where the PTP clock was corrupted when Tx packet rate control was enabled; move the enabling and disabling of time synchronization to the port start and port stop functions, respectively.
Fix the issue where the TX port in the DCB forwarding configuration might be invalid; use fwd_topology_tx_port_get() to obtain the correct port, and also support the --port-topology parameter.
Fix the testpmd receive queue configuration error in DCB by changing the value of nb_rx_queue from send queue information to receive queue information.
Fix the duplicate write to the L2TAG1 field during VLAN offload on the AVX-512 path by merging conditions to avoid redundant stores.
Fix the condition for VLAN insertion on the AVX-512 path, ensuring that VLAN offload is only performed when IAVF_TX_VLAN_QINQ_OFFLOAD is defined and the path is the offload path.

Fix the positioning error of single VLAN insertion offload in the iavf driver, ensuring that the outer VLAN tag is inserted for single VLAN, and the inner and outer layers are correctly distinguished for QinQ.
Fix the conflict between TxPP and IEEE 1588 forwarding by introducing the txpp_ena flag to avoid multiple calls to the time synchronization function.
Fix the validation of HWS flow sampling actions, ensuring that the sampling action includes a termination action.
Fix the link mode reporting logic in the cnxk NIC driver, correctly reporting fixed or auto-negotiation based on the actual hardware negotiation result.
Fix the potential buffer overflow issue in the ixgbe VF driver caused by a buffer size mismatch when requesting PF link status.
Fix the issue in mlx5 PMD where invalid CQE caused spurious CPU wakeups in power monitoring mode; introduce a dedicated callback function to skip invalid CQE to improve energy efficiency.
Fix the issue in the mlx5 driver where the representor interrupt handler was not released when the device was closed, and add flow pool destruction logic.
Fix the issue where newly allocated but unused mempool entries were not released during shared memory pool registration, while avoiding deadlock caused by releasing MR while holding a lock.
Fix the concurrency issue caused by static variables in buddy memory allocation, and adjust the release logic to avoid double freeing.
Fix the incorrect setting of the hash_state_sz field of the request descriptor during AES-CCM operations in the QAT driver, changing it from the digest length to the AAD length.
Fix the issue where QinQ Tx offload does not work correctly in the vector offload path, move it to the non-vector path, and remove the check for the QinQ flag.
Fix a race condition when pdump is disabled: complete the removal of the local callback before forwarding the request to the secondary process.
Fixed crashes caused by null tx_pkt_prepare function pointers in multiple Intel NIC drivers (ice, ixgbe, fm10k), assigning the dummy function in vector or simple TX paths to avoid null pointer calls.
Fix the release order of send to kernel action resources in the MLX5 driver, ensuring that related actions and flow tables are released before destroying the domain.
Drain and close the associated completion queue before stopping the transmit queue.
Fix a NULL pointer issue when roc_nix is NULL in inline device write operations.
Update the handling logic of the DF flag during IPv4 fragmentation so that it inherits the DF flag of the original packet header instead of forcing it to zero.
Fix the aura limit reset to the actual buffer count instead of a fixed maximum when cleaning up the SQB pool, avoiding residual threshold buffers causing errors when creating pools later.
Fix a NULL pointer dereference in the roc_nix_sq_ena_dis function, adding a check for NULL pointer arguments and returning an error code.
Fix NULL SQ access, add a non-NULL check before accessing SQ, and simplify the pktio lock handling during threshold configuration.
Fix the use of the wrong pointer variable in error handling in the inline inbound queue setup.
Fix the CPT result address configuration logic to avoid generating garbage values when there is no inline device, and ensure configuration is triggered only when an inline device exists.
Fix the NULL check for the roc_nix pointer when NIX Rx inject is enabled, avoiding NULL pointer dereference.
Fix an illegal access error caused by a NULL pointer in Rx inject configuration.
Fix the handling of invalid default colors during default meter pre-coloring, adding index validation to avoid out-of-bounds access.
Fix the check logic for PF Rx timestamp support in the iavf driver, ensuring the capability is reported only when the PF actually supports Rx timestamps.
Fix the issue where the iavf driver does not check the validity bit when receiving timestamps, avoiding reporting incorrect timestamp values when the hardware has not captured a timestamp.

Fix the missing TCP TSO offload flag in the queue configuration conversion function in the idpf driver, ensuring the scalar transmit path supporting this feature is correctly selected when TSO offload is requested.
Fix inaccurate NIC statistics due to low-bit carry during reads.

Fix error handling during mlx5 device startup, replacing a single error cleanup label with cascaded labels to ensure only successfully initialized steps are cleaned up, avoiding state corruption causing subsequent startup failures or abnormal behavior.
Fix the uninitialized variable issue in the mlx5_link_update function in the mlx5 driver, initializing dev_link to zero in the function and setting link_autoneg to the original link value.
Fix a crash in the dpaa2 NIC driver caused by repeated calls to close during device removal.
Fix the issue where the global active VDQ state is not cleared when releasing the Rx queue in the dpaa2 driver, causing Rx to hang after detach/attach.

Fix the issue where the Rx error queue is not released in the dpaa2 driver, ensuring the pointer is set to NULL after releasing the queue and releasing the mbuf in the error queue back to the original memory pool.
Fix the incorrect capability check in the flow rule hash calculation in the mlx5 driver, changing it to the correct distribution mode determination.
Fix a NULL pointer dereference when acts->mhdr may be NULL in modify header handling in the mlx5 driver, adding a defensive NULL check in mlx5_tbl_ensure_shared_modify_header.
Fix a crash caused by a NULL pointer when destroying hardware flow rules in the mlx5 driver, adding a defensive NULL pointer check and renaming fields to improve code readability.

Fix the failure of inner UDP checksum offload in testpmd, unifying the inner and outer processing logic to resolve the issue where the inner L4 protocol cannot be recognized in various encapsulation formats.

Fix crashes in drivers such as hns3 and ngbe caused by tx_pkt_prepare being set to NULL after removing the ethdev fast path callback check, replacing it with the dummy function and removing unnecessary NULL assignments in the softnic driver.
Revert the flow engine configuration update, fixing a regression where the HWS engine caused the memzone segment count to exceed the limit, triggering untrusted VF/SF.
Fix a compilation error caused by the loss of the const qualifier in the pointer type in the fslmc bus device name parsing function.

Fix a concurrency issue in Rx/Tx statistics in the net/nbl driver, introducing a reference value mechanism so that the actual counters are updated only by the Rx/Tx burst thread, and the reference values are updated synchronously when resetting statistics.

Fix the mailbox interface call in the txgbe driver, introducing function pointers for different devices to unify the mailbox command invocation method, and adjusting the synchronization mask for EEPROM operations.
Revert the check for PF Rx timestamp support, fixing the issue where a PF supporting Rx timestamps could not enable the feature properly.
Fix a build failure in the mbuf module when compiled with GCC and RTE_MBUF_HISTORY_DEBUG enabled, removing an extra newline in the log message.

net/mlx5 expands the applicability of the mac_own bit field from only marking PMD-added MAC addresses to VF, to marking all MAC addresses added by PMD, PF, VF, and SF, but the current behavior remains unchanged, still only flushing MAC addresses added for VF.
net/txgbe removes duplicate Tx queue assignment code in txgbe_rxtx.c.

net/mlx5 distinguishes two user-related error reasons when a resizable flow template table completes resizing in mlx5_flow_hw.c (not all flow rules updated to the resized table, resizing not started), reporting errors separately instead of using the same error message.

app/testpmd corrects the mask of the flow random item in cmdline_flow.c from 0x0000ffff to 0xffffffff, restoring the correct random value conversion while resolving the ASAN global-buffer-overflow issue.

net/mlx5 corrects the error validation logic for non-template RSS expansion in mlx5_nta_rss.c, changing it to check the return value of flow_hw_create_flow() instead of checking whether the flow pointer is NULL.

app/crypto-perf fixes the failure of asymmetric operation execution in cperf_ops.c and cperf_options_parsing.c, changing it to perform parameter checks based on the configured optype instead of always performing RSA optype parameter checks, and removes the operation of copying signature data to a temporary buffer.
net/ice/base adds memory release on exit for the params structure allocated via ice_malloc in the ice_flow_set_hw_prof() function of ice_flow.c, fixing a memory leak reported by static analysis.

net/ice/base removes duplicate entries before adding a new linked list entry for the same recipe ID in ice_get_recp_frm_fw() of ice_switch.c, fixing a memory leak caused by advanced filtering operations.
crypto/cnxk removes the return statement in cn20k_ipsec.c, fixing a compilation error in debug mode.

In crypto/cnxk, in cn10k_cryptodev_ops.c, cn20k_cryptodev_ops.c, and cnxk_cryptodev_ops.h, fix the sanity check failure of TLS mbuf by clearing the data_len of segments after the target length and adjusting the pkt_len of the head mbuf.

In examples/l3fwd-power, in main.c, change the telemetry command name from "/l3fwd-power/stats" to "/l3fwd_power/stats", replacing hyphens with underscores to comply with the character requirements allowed by telemetry command registration.

In net/mlx5, in mlx5_flow_hw.c, mlx5_hws_cnt.c, and mlx5_hws_cnt.h, place the key members of the counter structure into a single uint32_t and access them atomically, fixing the race condition between the flow aging background thread and per-queue flow insertion/deletion/update; also move query_gen_when_free out of the union to keep the total memory size unchanged.
In net/e1000/base, add a compiler barrier after the register read in e1000_mac.c, fixing the initialization crash in Ubuntu 24.04 VM when using GCC 13 and -O3 optimization.

In eal/x86, in the AMD power monitor implementation of rte_power_intrinsics.c, enable a timeout-based exit condition so that lcore automatically wakes up after a specified period, with the maximum supported timeout value being 2^32 - 1.
In net/ice, in ice_ethdev.c, revert commit af05f9e37153, no longer counting the drop-all filter in Rx statistics, to avoid counting packets of non-target MAC in non-promiscuous mode.
In net/ena, in ena_ethdev.c, add validation of the physical DMA address width returned by ena_com_get_dma_width(), handling cases of timeout or invalid value retrieval.

In net/i40e, in i40e_hash.c, remove SCTP Verification Tag from the symmetric Toeplitz hash calculation of SCTP, fixing the issue where packets of the same SCTP session are distributed to multiple queues.
In net/dpaa2, in dpaa2_rxtx.c and dpaa2_hw_dpni_annot.h, correct the read position of L3/L4 checksum validation and error status, from the wrong word to the word1 of the annotation area.
In net/dpaa2, in dpaa2_ethdev.c, allow receiving packets with additional parse errors due to HW parser length errors, so that HW does not drop packets due to any parser error.

In net/dpaa2, in dpaa2_flow.c, fix the flow rule size adjustment logic; the rule size should be calculated from the new extraction position plus its size, unless that position is less than the rule's original size.
In the txgbe driver, when PHY is configured, clear the MAC error code by performing a MAC reset, avoiding the loss of the first packet after port down/up.
In the compress-perf application, remove the possible assignment of signed values to unsigned parameters, and make dictionary an optional parameter.
In the FDIR rules of the txgbe driver, declare that the raw relative offset is only used to match L4 packets, and does not support IP packets without a L4 header and L2 packets.
In the null NIC driver, revert the fast mbuf release Tx offload feature.
In the AVX512 single-packet transmit function of the iavf driver, implement the QinQ insertion feature.
In the iavf driver, when mbuf simultaneously sets the VLAN and QinQ insertion offload flags, reorder the L2TAG2 field filling logic to ensure the field is written only once.
In the NIX debug code of the cnxk driver, fix the format specifier for the bandwidth profile ID.
In the axgbe_timesync_disable function of the axgbe driver, use the local variable mac_tscr for register write operations, eliminating the unused variable warning of GCC 16.
In the flex_link_item_parse function of testpmd, determine the correct size of memcpy based on the actual flow item type (IPv4, IPv6, UDP, TCP), and reject unsupported item types.
In the flow-perf application, fix the allocation length of the array saving flow rule pointers, appending space for 1 rule instead of 1 bytes.
In the func_reentrancy test, fix the EAL initialization call to avoid passing a null pointer as parameter 2.
In the mempool test, separate the code specific to the external stack driver and rename unrelated variables to support minimal builds with the stack driver disabled.
In the crypto-perf application, the AEAD decryption test only runs when a valid test vector file is passed.
In the runtest() function of the dmadev test, treat non-zero return values as errors, fixing the misjudgment of copy and error_handling test cases due to internal or operations returning 1.
In the dmadev test, automatically adapt the ring size based on device capabilities, replacing the default 512.
In the cryptodev ZUC test vector header file, remove the array range initialization not supported by MSVC.
In the cryptodev test, initialize all fields of the rte_crypto_sym_vec structure for the CPU crypto code path.
In the func_reentrancy test, provide a valid string for argv[0] of the EAL initialization call, replacing the NULL value.
In the event_dma_adapter and trace tests, initialize variables passed as const pointer parameters, fixing the build error of clang 21.
In the debug test, add the --iova-mode=va parameter for the PPC64 no-hugepage scenario, replacing the default PA mode.
In common/sfc_efx/base, fix the unused variable warnings in efx_np.c and medford4_phy.c, as well as the type-related compiler warning in efx_np.c.
Fix the error frame dump of the dpaa2 driver to support dumping payload and parse results in mbuf format.
In ntnic_ethdev.c of net/ntnic, add a warning message when the service core is unavailable.
In net/txgbe, remove the unsupported flow action mark from the txgbe_flow.c and txgbe.ini documentation.
In r8169_hw.c, r8169_phy.c, and r8169_rxtx.c of net/r8169, fix the Coverity static analysis warnings.
In net/bnxt/tf_core, add more decoding and wildcard entry debugging for EM entries, and add a new CLI command to traverse all ports and table scopes to dump and decode all backing stores.
In qman.c of bus/dpaa, update the log from pr_xxx to DPAA_BUS_XXX for consistency.
In multiple files of net/bnxt/tf_ulp, clean up TruFlow debug/non-production print outputs.
In mlx5_vdpa.h of vdpa/mlx5, remove the unused constant MLX5_VDPA_DEFAULT_TIMER_DELAY_US.
In mlx5_crypto.c of crypto/mlx5, remove the unused constants MLX5_CRYPTO_LOG_NAME and MLX5_CRYPTO_MAX_SEGS.
In multiple files of regex/mlx5, remove multiple constants that have been unused since their introduction, as well as constants no longer used after feature changes.
In multiple files of common/mlx5, remove multiple constants that have been unused since their introduction.
In multiple header files of net/mlx5, remove the unused macros IS_BATCH_CNT, MLX5_ETHER_TYPE_FROM_HEADER, and ERRNO_SAFE.
In fm10k_common.c of net/fm10k, fix the warning caused by parameter idx being set but unused when building with GCC 16.
In eventdev/crypto's rte_event_crypto_adapter.c, fix the 16-bit formatting mismatch error reported by clang 21, changing PRIu8 to adapt to the format of the uint16_t type.
In multiple files of net/memif, net/enetfec, crypto/caam_jr, bus/uacce, and bus/ifpga, fix the const pointer qualifier discard warnings caused by the glibc update.
In app/procinfo's main.c, fix the qualifier discard warning caused by assigning the const pointer returned by strrchr in the collectd_resolve_cnt_type function to a non-const pointer.
In net/hns3's hns3_common.c, when the default MAC address provided by the firmware is invalid, print that address to locate the problem.
Removed support for Linux kernel versions below 3.17, and cleaned up related conditional compilation code. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)
Replaced the DMA adapter operation structure rte_event_dma_adapter_op with rte_dma_op, and updated all functions, tests, and driver code that use this structure. (architecture-related: public API)
Removed the DPAA driver destructor, migrated the cleanup logic to the bus layer, and improved error handling in multiple interfaces. (architecture-related: module responsibility change)

Removed v25 ABI compatibility, deleted the old CRC API compatibility symbols and default handler functions, and updated the public API to adapt to the new ABI version. (architecture-related: ABI compatibility)
Unified the return type of the rx_queue_count callback function in each driver from uint32_t to int, avoiding unnecessary symbol type conversions. (architecture-related: public API)
Removed the callback null pointer check from the Ethernet device fast path API, and used virtual callback functions instead to avoid performance overhead. (architecture-related: public API)
Refactored the mbuf sanity check from an inline function to a non-inline one, and added optional mempool parameter support. (architecture-related: public API)
Renamed and made public the Rx queue mark flag setting and clearing functions, for later use when disabling flow control. (architecture-related: public API)
Refactored the RSS receive queue creation flow of the XSC PMD, introducing independent QPN allocation and release and queue information setting functions. (architecture-related: public API)
Refactored the stop and close paths of the xsc PMD to ensure correct release of queue resources, and removed flag-based initialization tracking. (architecture-related: public API)
Refactored the RSS LUT selection function of the ice driver, using enums to specify LUT size and type, optimizing parameter passing and validation. (architecture-related: public API)
Removed the deprecated _u64 telemetry functions, which have been replaced by the _uint version since 2023. (architecture-related: public API)

Separated the driver internal header files of the power module from the public header files, and moved the rte_power_core_capabilities structure definition to the public header file rte_power_cpufreq.h. (architecture-related: public API)

Removed the deprecated queue statistics fields from the rte_eth_stats structure, added the eth_queue_stats parameter for drivers to continue providing queue statistics, and deprecated the queue statistics mapping API. (architecture-related: public API)
Refactored the EAL parameter parsing logic to first collect all command-line parameters into a structure, then process them uniformly in a fixed order. (architecture-related: public API)
Changed the return value of the doorbell write function to void, and optimized the debug log information. (architecture-related: public API)

Refactored the definition of the rte_pmu_read inline function, using conditional compilation to exclude the actual code and trigger a runtime assertion when the experimental API is not enabled. (architecture-related: public API)

Changed the PMU architecture-specific operations from static functions to callback-based ops structures, making the architecture implementation more modular and easier to extend. (architecture-related: architecture refactoring)

In ARM64 PMU initialization, removed the automatic enabling of user-space performance counter access, changed it to log a warning, and renamed the related functions. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)
In the proc-info application, replaced the deprecated coremask parameter with the corelist parameter. (architecture-related: command-line interface)
Changed the return type of the rte_bitmap_free function from int to void, removed parameter checks and return values, and simplified the API. (architecture-related: public API)
Removed the mpc device parameter from the bnxt driver; the P7 platform enables mpc by default, and the mpc=1 parameter is no longer supported. (architecture-related: driver configuration)

Moved the socket handler function type definition from the public header file to the internal header file, and renamed it with a prefixed name to avoid namespace pollution and compilation warnings. (architecture-related: public API)
The net/netvsc driver changed the device list variable to a local variable, and renamed get_vmbus_device to hn_nvs_get_vmbus_device to follow the hn_ prefix naming convention.
The net/ntnic driver changed the flow_lock variable to be used in only one file.
The net/ntnic driver renamed the global variable hwlock to nthw_lock to use a common prefix.
net/bnxt/tf_ulp split the template enums into a common enum file and application-specific definition files.
Changed coremask parsing from array-based to cpuset-based, and adjusted the declaration positions of internal functions. (architecture-related: public API change)
eal/x86 removed the unused rte_cpuflags.h include from rte_spinlock.h, and added it back in the required .c files.
mbuf directly includes rte_log.h in mbuf_log.h, removing the need for duplicate rte_log.h includes in other files.
Removed the unused rawdev pointer field from the fslmc bus driver. (architecture-related: public API)
In the DPAA2 memory pool driver, uniformly use the DPAA2_VADDR_TO_IOVA macro for address conversion, and refactored the mbuf release and allocation flows to support both VA and PA modes.
Extracted the common function eal_cpuset_to_str for converting cpuset to string, and refactored the original available_cores implementation based on this function.
Removed the redundant offload check in the Rx queue vector path, simplifying the related function interfaces.
Split the common CQ null check function into a Rx-specific function, and added a helper function to obtain the Tx CQ descriptor.

Unified the function and variable prefixes of multiple submodules in the Napatech hardware module to nthw_, involving FLM, statistics, logging, DBS, hash/flow, register ops, table ID, and global variables, etc.
Removed the cache line alignment of counter-related structures in the mlx5 driver to reduce memory usage.

Refactored the root flow table group check logic of the mlx5 driver, added a dedicated function to determine whether a group index is a root group, and replaced the direct checks in action template translation.
Renamed variables in the Intel NIC driver's Rx path selection function to improve readability, and added a support check for single-queue Rx.
The net/i40e, net/iavf, net/ice, and net/cpfl drivers now uniformly use the common Rx path selection infrastructure, with the main process selecting the same Rx path for all processes.
net/iavf removed the rx_vec_allowed field from the iavf_adapter structure, which was used only in one function; net/intel common Tx code removed the unused rel_mbufs_type member.

net/ena driver fixed the rte_intr_callback_unregister_sync return value check, added a ring pointer check during IO queue release; ena/base moved the bad req_id check to ena_com_cdesc_rx_pkt_get() to support descriptor dump.
net/ena driver improved code style by adding comments and line breaks.
net/ena/base split the phc_err statistics into three independent PHC error statistics: phc_err_dv, phc_err_ts, and phc_err_eb, and added a PHC failure error log.
net/ena/base removed the redundant conditional check because the driver only supports host/device IO queue mode.
app/dma-perf removed invalid or redundant fields and split the load_configs() function into three sub-functions.
eal/linux removed the internally duplicated VFIO macro, replaced it with RTE_DIM(), and removed unnecessary boundary checks in get_vfio_group_idx().
ethdev adjusted the handling logic for enable-related operations to be consistent with the disable function, without changing actual runtime behavior.
net/iavf renamed the Rx/Tx function type variable from burst_type to func_type.
eal simplified the check code for conflicting command-line options using utility functions and macros, and moved the checks to the argument collection phase.
Replaced the original thread affinity to string function with a new cpuset to string helper function.
app/dma-perf split the data validation part in mem_copy_benchmark() into a separate function, and split resource allocation/release into different sub-functions.

DPDK r8169 driver refactored the CFG_METHOD determination into simplified logic based on chipset_name, added the Cfg9346_EEM_MASK macro and automatic lock/unlock mechanism for configuration registers, unified the mcfg to chipset_name mapping, and removed redundant explicit lock/unlock calls.
net/bnxt/tf_core removed the code that allocated entry 0 during TCAM manager initialization, and renamed session_bmp to logical_id_bmp.
Removed unused functions and pointers in the dpaa2 driver.
In bnxt tf_core v3, removed the duplicate call to free table scope memory, and corrected the scope size check to require it to be a power of 2.
In the bnxt driver, removed conditional compilation dead code for old versions of DPDK.
Removed unnecessary VFIO header file includes from the qat, hn3_ethdev_vf, and ifpga related driver source files.
Removed unnecessary null pointer checks before free in zxdh_np.c.
Changed the prefix of all visible global symbols in ark PMD from eth_ark_XXX to ark_XXX.
Reformatted the Rx path infos array in the i40e driver.
Reformatted the Rx path infos array in the ice driver.
Changed local variables in enic_sriov.c and the wriop_bytecode array in dpaa2_sparser.c to static to avoid global naming conflicts.
Removed unused functions from multiple files in ntnic PMD.
In the mlx5 driver, changed the auxiliary data structure associated with each rule to inline allocation, merged into the same ipool allocation.

Fixed compilation issues of the bbdev test on Windows, removed variable-length arrays, replaced them with alloca or constant arrays, and added the rte_os_shim header file to support the getline function. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)
Added a buffer size check in the DMA performance test, providing a friendly error message when the buffer size exceeds the uint16 type limit.
Added enqueue/dequeue operation tests in the dmadev test.
Added a Rx/Tx offload test suite in DTS, including mbuf fast free test cases.
Added a test suite for the virtio-user/vhost-user server/client forwarding scenario in DTS, using testpmd for packet validation.
Replaced unnecessary comma operators in test code to eliminate clang -Wcomma warnings.

Optimized BMan buffer acquire and release performance by reducing byte swaps and using 128 bit read/write instructions, reducing cache miss accesses, with a performance improvement of about 10%. (architecture-related: public API)
Optimized QMan enqueue checks, simplified ring buffer pointer operations, and fixed byte order, improving data access performance. (architecture-related: public API)
Optimized the XSC NIC Rx path by checking CQ producer/consumer indices to reduce cache conflicts, improving small packet processing performance. (architecture-related: public API)

Added support for the CN20K platform in CPT LMT line initialization, and added the opcode_major field in the security engine's authentication and encryption key settings to optimize opcode handling. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)

Added TX head write-back mode and RX descriptor merge mode for the Amber-Lite NIC, enabled by default, configurable via the devargs parameter, significantly improving performance. (architecture-related: devargs configuration parameter)

Optimized the performance and readability of the rte_pktmbuf_prefree_seg function, and improved the RTE_MBUF_DIRECT macro so that common code paths fit within one instruction cache line on x86-64. (architecture-related: public API)

In the bnxt driver, when representor is not enabled, truflow is allowed to use vector mode processing to improve throughput, and added device parameter parsing logic for representor mode and scalar mode. (architecture-related: devargs configuration parameter)

Reduced the default Rx extension header size from 16 bytes to 12 bytes, removed the hash_value field, and disabled the half-offload feature to save PCIe bandwidth. (architecture-related: Rx extension header)
Updated the mlx5 driver documentation, clarifying the support scope of software steering and hardware steering. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)
Optimized the acquire and release operations of the DPAA memory pool, using the new BMan API and supporting burst release, improving release performance by about 90%.
Fixed a performance regression in QAT crypto PMD caused by non-cache-aligned source buffers, and added alignment handling in the data path.

Renamed and optimized the mbuf seed function for the Rx queue of the Ark NIC, adopting a 4K-aligned buffer allocation strategy to reduce PCIe requests, and attempting to allocate smaller blocks when memory is exhausted.
Optimized the way Tx descriptor fields are set in the ENA NIC, replacing the erase-then-set operation with direct assignment to improve performance.
Removed redundant zeroing operations for Tx descriptors in the LLQ scenario of the ENA NIC, leveraging the existing bounce buffer zeroing mechanism.

Optimized the ENETC4 data path by separating cache coherence operations into a dedicated RX/TX function, reducing memory accesses, and adding support for checksum offload and fragmented packet type parsing.
Fixed a performance issue in the Thor2 TruFlow memory manager: moving full blocks to the end of the list to ensure searches stop correctly when encountering the first full block.
For the E830 NIC, switched to a global RSS LUT when the number of queues is less than 64 to improve performance.
In packet filtering, changed from per-packet release of mbuf to batch release to improve performance.
In flow isolation mode, skip the creation and cleanup of the Rx control flow table to save resource allocation and speed up device startup.
In the ice driver's FDIR filter, changed the dynamically allocated filter profile to be embedded in the structure, removing indirect pointers.
Added memory release in the error path of FDIR raw pattern parsing in the ice driver; release virt queue op cookies memory when the virtio crypto device is closed.

Initialized the kg_cfg structure in rte_pmd_dpaa2_set_custom_hash() of dpaa2; in the ena base library, moved the memcpy operation after the state check to avoid accessing invalid memory when feature fetch fails.
Added error log printing when stats counter cache memory initialization fails in bnxt tf_ulp.

Increased the number of decimal places in results in crypto-perf to improve precision in low-performance scenarios such as RSA; added an enqueue/dequeue operation performance measurement option in dma-perf.
In crypto-perf, return an error and log when the test vector plaintext exceeds the buffer size, to avoid digest verification mismatches.
Improved the stability and robustness of hash read/write functional tests, reduced test entries to avoid timeouts on constrained platforms, and added memory allocation failure checks.

The DTS framework added a TRex performance traffic generator, implemented by calling the TRex stateless API automation library via Python shell; the DTS context supports both functional and performance traffic generators, and the test run state machine dynamically starts/stops the corresponding traffic generator based on the test type (perf or func), with only one traffic generator application running in the TG system at a time; added a boolean switch to control whether to add new shell to the current shell pool.

The examples/l3fwd and examples/l3fwd-power example programs added support for forcing the port link rate at startup to solve the problem of link up failure in auto-negotiation mode when auto-negotiation is not supported; this implementation does not support changing duplex mode, so rates such as 10M and 100M cannot be configured via this method.

The examples/l3fwd example program added a --tx-burst option to explicitly configure the Tx burst size, separate from the existing --rx-burst option; by default, the Tx burst size is consistent with the Rx burst size.
In lib/mempool/rte_mempool.c, hide zero-valued entries in the dump of the mempool cache.
In app/test-eventdev/test_perf_common.c, fixed the issue where the variable 'event' was not initialized before being passed as a const pointer argument when compiling with clang 21.
In drivers/net/bnxt/bnxt_txr.c, skip the IOVA valid range check when using external memory.
Removed multiple no-longer-used constant definitions in the net/mlx5 driver, including MLX5_VEC_TX_CKSUM_OFFLOAD_CAP, MLX5_ALARM_TIMEOUT_US, MLX5_FLOW_SFT_HLIST_ARRAY_SIZE, etc.
In drivers/net/cnxk/cnxk_ethdev.c, changed the port speed capability acquisition from hardcoded to obtaining the actual supported rates and modes from firmware.
The net/xsc driver changed the memory allocation for QP and CQ from SOCKET_ID_ANY to using the local NUMA node, so that PAS and CQE memory are on the same NUMA node as the device.
The event/cnxk driver increased the number of inflight buffers for the crypto adapter to solve the problem of performance dropping to zero under high traffic in 16 or 24 core event vector mode.
Added likely/unlikely compiler hints in conditional logic in net/ena/base to optimize branch prediction.
The net/dpaa2 driver added prefetch optimization for the next parser result, supporting VA or PA modes, but this prefetch is not executed on LX2160A.

Added a constant-time memory comparison function rte_memeq_timingsafe and replaced memcmp in the authentication verification operation of the ipsec-mb driver to enhance protection against timing side-channel attacks. (architecture-related: public API)

Fixed the missing DMA mask validation when explicitly specifying IOVA mode during EAL initialization, ensuring that DMA mask detection is always triggered during cross-platform initialization. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)
Fixed an array out-of-bounds issue caused by short file names in EAL plugin directory traversal, using a safer suffix matching function.
Fixed a memory out-of-bounds issue when creating flow rules based on indices in the mlx5 driver, by skipping items array preparation and correcting the ipool allocation/free fields.
Fixed an out-of-bounds access issue in the enetfec UIO mapping, adding a validity check for the mapping size.
Fixed a double-read vulnerability in vhost dequeue offloading by copying the virtio header to a temporary variable to prevent data races.
Replaced sprintf with snprintf and adjusted buffer sizes to fix a potential format overflow issue in the ntnic driver.
Added boundary checks for flex filter mask in the e1000 driver, fixing array out-of-bounds warnings reported by GCC-16 and preventing potential overflows.

In test_argparse.c, changed the memcpy structure copy of test_argparse_copy to use structure assignment within the same function to resolve the memcpy overflow warning caused by the compiler not recognizing flexible array space during LTO compilation.
Fixed a crash caused by not unregistering the interrupt callback after startup failure in the tap NIC.
Added a validation check in cperf_options_parsing.c to verify whether the user-configured RSA modlen is supported.

In test_cryptodev.c, fixed mbuf handling: after releasing intermediate nodes in the chain, update the head mbuf's nb_segs and pkt_len, and correct the use of rte_pktmbuf_append to ensure the head mbuf is passed rather than an intermediate node.

In the server_node_efd example's efd_server/main.c and shared/common.h, adjusted the buffer size of get_printable_mac_addr to be sufficient to hold a valid ring name, fixing the format-truncation overflow warning in snprintf caused by containing newline characters.
In examples/vdpa/main.c, limited the iface prefix length to 123 characters (128 - sizeof("1024")) to avoid format overflow when constructing ifname with snprintf.
In examples/ip_reassembly/main.c, added overflow checks for mbuf pool name formatting, so that static analysis tools confirm that lcore and queue will not cause overflow.
Fixed const pointer-related warnings in common/qat, involving function returns and variable initialization in qat_device.c, qat_device.h, and qat_comp_pmd.c, qat_asym.c, qat_sym.c.
Improved the documentation comments for functions such as rte_align32pow2, clarifying the meaning of the return value when the input is a power of 2. (architecture-related: public API)
Added a Python script for parsing mbuf history dumps and presenting them in a human-readable format, and updated the comments in the related header files.
Improved the comments in the mbuf core header file to more accurately describe the rearm_data field, the second cache line, and the synchronization requirements when adding new Rx/Tx offload flags.
Added a list of platforms tested with NVIDIA NICs to the 25.11 release notes.
Updated the requirements description for the flow count action in the mlx5 documentation, adding a minimum DOCA version requirement.
Added tested combinations of Intel platforms and Intel NICs to the v25.11 release notes.
Moved the packet processing and utility methods, artifact module, and testpmd module in dts from the framework directory to the API directory, and updated related documentation and test import paths.
Rewrote dts/README.md to retain only a high-level description of DTS-related concepts and a simple getting started guide.
Updated the framework coding guidelines in doc/guides/tools/dts.rst to include new test case decorators and setup/teardown hook descriptions.
Removed optional documentation dependencies from DTS, deleting related configurations in doc/guides/conf.py, doc/guides/tools/dts.rst, dts/poetry.lock, and dts/pyproject.toml.
Updated the IPv6 five-tuple matching limit description in doc/guides/nics/mlx5.rst, noting that new hardware now supports this feature.
Clarified in multiple baseband device documents (acc100, fpga_5gnr_fec, fpga_lte_fec, vrb1, vrb2) the support of different bbdev devices for code block and transport block level processing.
Clarified in doc/guides/prog_guide/bbdev.rst the usage, range, and mapping relationships of cyclic shift window indices in the FFT processing pipeline.
Added a test case docstring example in the "How to Write Test Suites" section of doc/guides/tools/dts.rst, including steps and verify sections.

Fixed the spelling of SIENNA to SIENA in doc/guides/linux_gsg/amd_platform.rst, added zen5 AMD EPYC 9005 tuning guide, uncore power details, and updated usage instructions for AMD Solarflare X4 and X2.
Explained in doc/guides/prog_guide/mbuf_lib.rst that the two debug options RTE_LIBRTE_MBUF_DEBUG and RTE_ENABLE_ASSERT can enable various debug checks of the mbuf library.

Clarified in doc/guides/prog_guide/telemetry_lib.rst that telemetry command names can only contain alphanumeric characters, underscores, and forward slashes, and do not allow characters such as hyphens, and noted that "/l3fwd-power/stats" is an invalid example.
Added reference documentation for the different value types supported by the argparse library in doc/guides/prog_guide/argparse_lib.rst.
Fixed mismatched backticks in Doxygen comments in lib/eventdev/rte_event_timer_adapter.h and lib/rawdev/rte_rawdev_pmd.h to be compatible with Doxygen 1.15.
Updated the Python version corresponding to the FreeBSD stable version 14.3 to 3.11 in doc/guides/freebsd_gsg/build_dpdk.rst.

Updated external links in doc/guides/windows_gsg/build_dpdk.rst, removed comments no longer applicable to MSVC builds, and rephrased instructions for opening the Visual Studio developer command prompt from CMD and Powershell.
Rewrote the section in doc/guides/tools/dts.rst about writing test suites using the DTS framework to correctly reflect the current state and usage of the DTS API.
Fixed the baseband/acc driver by adding the missing rte_acc_common_cfg.h header file to the build system's export list. (architecture-related: public API)

Added support for the RISC-V V extension, which can be enabled via the -Dcpu_instruction_set=rv64gcv option, and adjusted the machine parameter configuration accordingly. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)
Fixed the build condition in meson.build to ensure the driver compiles correctly in the arm64 environment. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)

Opened the 25.11.0-rc0 release cycle, upgraded the ABI version to 26.0, removed the ABI exception list, disabled the ABI compatibility check in CI, and created an empty release notes document. (architecture-related: version and compatibility)
Added support for Microsoft Azure Cobalt-100 SoC in the ARM build configuration. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)
Fixed the BPF build error during cross-compilation by correctly referencing header files in the target sysroot using Meson sysroot attributes. (architecture-related: build and installation methods)

Fixed compilation errors under MinGW 13 caused by the undefined NetUIO constant, adjusted header include order, and extended conditional compilation to be compatible with MinGW64. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)

Enabled the crypto extension for the ARM Cortex-A78AE configuration, fixing the infinite loop issue in crypto performance tests caused by the missing extension. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)

Fixed Windows build issues: removed variable-length arrays, replaced strsep with strtok_r, removed thousands separators in printf, included the test in the Windows build, and added the --query-rate command-line option. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)
Removed support for versions below GCC 8 and below Clang 7, and cleaned up related compile checks and compatibility code. (architecture-related: compiler version requirements)

Replaced the VFIO build switch from RTE_EAL_VFIO to RTE_EXEC_ENV_LINUX, and removed empty implementations for non-Linux systems in the crypto/bcmfs driver, making it support only Linux. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)
Removed the condition that skipped driver builds under the MSVC compiler, enabling the driver to support MSVC compilation. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)
Supported compiling the zxdh driver on 64-bit RISC-V systems, and updated the build configuration and documentation lists of unsupported architectures. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)
Removed the deprecated enable_kmods build option; kernel modules are now built by default. (architecture-related: build and installation methods)
Added a rv64gcv cross-compilation target for RISC-V, and updated the cross-build guide to support vector extensions. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)

Added link compatibility checks in the build system for libraries returned by meson find_library, to avoid build failures due to architecture mismatches and other issues. (architecture-related: build and installation methods)

Refactored the header file installation logic, consolidating scattered install_headers calls into meson.build for unified handling, fixed the issue where some driver and architecture header files were not checked, and updated the checkpatches script to prohibit direct calls to install_headers. (architecture-related: build and installation methods)

Added backward compatibility mappings for old names for the Intel driver, so that old names such as net/ixgbe can still be used on the command line to enable or disable the driver. (architecture-related: build and installation methods)

Fixed the issue in the meson build system where wildcard matching nested drivers, so that patterns like net/* can recursively match drivers in subdirectories, restoring backward compatibility. (architecture-related: build and installation methods)

Added the RTE_EXEC_ENV_NAME macro definition in the Meson build system to represent the name of the current execution environment, and updated related documentation. (architecture-related: build and installation methods)
Replaced zero-length arrays with flexible array members to eliminate the GCC extension dependency. (architecture-related: compiler compatibility)
Enabled NUMA support for the Neoverse N2 configuration. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)

Changed the PMU build script to install architecture-related header files only on the corresponding architecture, avoiding header file pollution. (architecture-related: build and installation methods)
Remove the custom macro RTE_PMU_SUPPORTED and instead rely on RTE_LIB_PMU, which is automatically defined by the build system, for conditional compilation. (architecture-related: public API)
Fix the compilation failure of the dmadev debug build caused by the missing errno definition. (architecture-related: public API)
Add support for the HiSilicon HIP12 platform in the ARM build configuration. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)
Fix the build failure of DPDK 24.11 when the TF_FLOW_SCALE_QUERY flag is enabled, and adjust the format of related log print statements. (architecture-related: build and installation methods)
Add compile-time detection in the build system to support the new DevX counter action type. (architecture-related: build and installation methods)

Update the build configuration for Microsoft Azure Cobalt 100 SoC to use CPU-specific mcpu values supported by GCC 14+, and add support for the crypto feature. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)
In virtio/vhost, the pragma for loop unrolling is changed from a compiler version check in meson.build to a direct check of gcc or clang in the header file.
Add Undefined Behavior Sanitizer test tasks in CI, and adjust the related build configuration and test skip logic.
Make the Linux uAPI header file check option mutually exclusive with the import and upgrade options, report an error when used together, and adjust the version retrieval logic.
Add a silent mode (-q option) to the Linux uAPI script so that it only outputs error messages during regular runs.
Fix the MSVC build issue by adding explicit type casts for assertions in the mlx5_rx_burst and mlx5_rx_burst_out_of_order functions to be compatible with MSVC.

Fix the order of conditional checks in the checkpatches.sh script to ensure that the -n and -r flags take precedence over the stdin check, avoiding erroneous reading of patches from standard input in non-terminal environments.
Enable the comma operator-related warning in global compilation options, while disabling this warning for drivers.
Documentation supports building and installing separately using Meson install tag without recompiling the entire project.
The GitHub Actions build workflow saves ccache when the build fails.
app/test-cmdline removes the unnecessary inclusion of the termios.h header file, allowing it to build on Windows.
hns3 PMD enables lock annotation checks.
devtools/linux-uapi.sh removes redundant error fallback commands and moves the two parts of logic for updating and checking header files into functions.
chkincs adds a staging directory for copying header files to detect issues where public header files include private header files.
Add the devtools/mailmap-ctl.py script for adding, checking, and sorting mailmap file entries.
devtools/test-meson-builds.sh uses the default release build (without debug information) and shared linking to reduce disk usage of build outputs.
The GitHub Actions build workflow refactors build dependencies into multi-line variables, and the Fedora pipeline uses a single dependency source in the prepare image job.
The GitHub Actions Fedora build pipeline adds dependencies for AMD uncore power driver.
devtools/checkpatches.sh ignores warnings from checkpatch.pl about missing Link or Closes tags after the Reported-by tag.
examples enables the format truncation warning (-Wformat-truncation).
In lib/bbdev/rte_bbdev.c, the rte_bbdev_queue_ops_dump function adds a check for whether the enqueue status string is null to fix the MinGW 13 build error.
The fast test timeout for the RISC-V architecture is increased to 60 seconds.
app/test/meson.build skips the raw test when the skeleton driver is missing, and skips the power test when the power driver is missing.
Removed the VFIO compatibility wrapper for old Linux kernels and directly use the kernel's native macro definitions. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)

Replace variable-length arrays in the BPF filter function with alloca allocation, eliminating the dependency on the C standard extension and improving Windows compatibility. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)
Fixed extra blank lines at the end of multiple driver source files to ensure files end with a single newline.
The GitHub Actions CI test switches from Fedora 39 to Fedora 43.
Remove the unused VTNET_SQ_CQ_QUEUE_IDX macro definition in drivers/net/virtio/virtqueue.h.
drivers/net/zxdh/zxdh_np.h and lib/hash/rte_cuckoo_hash.h replace zero-length arrays with ISO C99 flexible array members.
drivers/net/ark/ark_ethdev_rx.c improves the ring handling of segmented packets, handling the case where the complete packet is not yet ready.
Removed the flag that automatically generates meaningless queue extension statistics in the ice and ipn3ke drivers, and cleaned up related code.
The net/iavf driver reformats the Rx path infos array for better readability.
net/ena/base adds the command ID to the admin command failure log.
The net/ena driver version number is upgraded to 2.14.0.
Replace unnecessary comma operators in examples/l2fwd-event and examples/l3fwd.
net/bnxt skips statistics collection when the Rx queue is not started and the stats context ID is not allocated.
common/cnxk changes the aura field width of cn20k from 20 bits to 17 bits.
net/qede/base removes the unused file ecore_mng_tlv.c that is not compiled in DPDK.
Replace unnecessary comma operators in multiple modules including net/bnxt, eal, net/bnx2x, app/testpmd, and lib/ipsec.
Fixed the NVIDIA forked driver presentation link.

Added HiSilicon Accelerator DMA driver. Kunpeng SoC has an internal accelerator unit which includes zip function, and the zip also supports data copy and fill. This driver exposes this capability to DPDK applications. (architecture-related: DPDK official new feature)

telemetry: As previously announced in the deprecation notices, the functions rte_tel_data_add_array_u64 and rte_tel_data_add_dict_u64 are removed. They are replaced by rte_tel_data_add_array_uint and rte_tel_data_add_dict_uint respectively.
stack: The structure rte_stack_lf_head alignment has been updated to 16 bytes to avoid unaligned accesses. (architecture-related: ABI compatibility)
maintainers: remove some inactives
usertools/telemetry: fix exporter default IP binding
usertools/telemetry: correct script formatting
dts: add Tx offload to NIC capabilities
buildtools/pmdinfogen: fix warning with python 3.14
dts: add missing type hints to method signatures
dts: add current test suite and cases to context
maintainers: update for hns3 driver
maintainers: update for service cores and event SW driver
maintainers: update for mbuf library
test/telemetry: fix test calling all commands

The allocation timing of the pop_vlan, send_to_kernel, NAT64, and default miss actions in the HWS driver is changed from port initialization or flow configuration to on-demand deferred allocation at first use, and is changed to per-domain allocation to reduce firmware resource usage. (architecture-related: HWS action allocation policy)

Unified the Rx path selection infrastructure of the Intel NIC driver to align with the Tx side, including simplifying the feature structure, optimizing the selection logic, and adjusting the function initialization timing. (architecture-related: Rx path selection infrastructure)
Introduced a unified Tx descriptor structure for the i40e, iavf, ice, and idpf drivers, and unified ring pointers and field definitions. (architecture-related: Tx descriptor structure unification)

Completed the consolidation of the scalar transmit path of the Intel NIC driver, created a common checksum function, and extracted common Tx helper functions. (architecture-related: scalar transmit path consolidation)

Introduced an independent descriptor state tracking mechanism based on RS threshold buckets for the Intel NIC driver, and enforced that tx_rs_thresh is a power of 2. (architecture-related: descriptor state tracking mechanism)
Decoupled hash (RSS) deinitialization from parser deinitialization, and separately removed RSS configuration in the device shutdown flow. (architecture-related: RSS deinitialization decoupling)

The TAP NIC driver changed receive and transmit queues from static embedded structures to dynamic allocation at queue setup, and freed them at queue release and device shutdown. (architecture-related: TAP driver queue dynamic allocation)
To support the new SPx series NICs, refactored the command queue and split it into old and new implementations. (architecture-related: command queue refactoring)
The EAL interrupt subsystem added RTE_INTR_EVENT_* definitions and an internal API rte_intr_active_events_flags() to obtain the current interrupt event flags in callback contexts.

common/cnxk added DPC (diagnostic and performance counter) support for CN20K NPA pool operations, allowing allocation and attachment of hardware counters to monitor alloc/free, outstanding buffers, and high-watermark.
Added an internal function for the ice base driver to check for pending messages in the management control queue.
Unified the Tx path selection logic of the Intel NIC drivers (iavf, idpf, cpfl), introduced common infrastructure, and simplified path selection. (architecture-related: common data path)
Support CUDA 13.0, adapting to the new API function pointer declarations via conditional compilation. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)
Added an internal API to EAL for querying the loaded driver path, and adjusted the plugin loading logic. (architecture-related: EAL internal API)
Added custom memory allocator support for the ACL library, with a new public API. (architecture-related: public API)
Support BPF atomic xchg instructions, and added related test cases. (architecture-related: BPF instruction extension)
Defined a pause mode capability mask in the public header file for client drivers to use in flow control settings. (architecture-related: public API)
Added private APIs for RSS TIR registration and release in the mlx5 PMD. (architecture-related: public API)
Set the CPT cache line size based on platform conditions: CN10K/CN9K uses 128 bytes, others use 256 bytes. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)
Adjusted the alignment requirement of the TLS context pointer from 128 bytes to 256 bytes, and updated the related memory allocation and cleanup logic. (architecture-related: ABI compatibility)
Added RTE_MIN3 and RTE_MAX3 macros, and renamed local variables in existing macros to avoid shadow declaration warnings. (architecture-related: public API)
Added the ability to register VF reset-before and reset-after callbacks for the IAVF driver. (architecture-related: public API)

Allow variables as the first argument of the RTE_SHIFT_VAL32 and RTE_SHIFT_VAL64 macros, changing the internal implementation from UINT32_C/UINT64_C to forced type conversion. (architecture-related: public API)

Support configurable queue depth (512 to 32768), set via rx_nb_desc and tx_nb_desc, and refactored the queue configuration and initialization flow to adapt to dynamic depth. (architecture-related: queue depth configuration)
Added link speed configuration and autonegotiation status query functionality for the zxdh NIC driver. (architecture-related: link speed configuration)

Support DPDK multi-process architecture, where the primary process has full control, and secondary processes only support limited operations such as statistics query and device information query. (architecture-related: multi-process architecture)

Fixed resource release issues in the net/nfb driver, ensuring that resources allocated during initialization are correctly released in eth_dev_uninit, and added MTU setting support. (architecture-related: MTU setting support)

Added 256-NxA4/5/6 algorithm support for cryptodev, including confidentiality, integrity, and AEAD modes for Snow 5G, AES 256, and ZUC 256. (architecture-related: public API: new encryption algorithms)

Added IPsec offload hooks in the common Tx function for the iavf driver, and optimized via compile-time constants to ensure no performance impact for drivers that do not support IPsec. (architecture-related: IPsec offload hook)
Make VLAN tag insertion logic configurable, add a new enum type to choose whether to place VLAN tags in the data descriptor or the context descriptor. (architecture-related: VLAN tag configuration)
Add support for the RTL8168KD chip, enabling network speeds up to 1Gbps. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)

Adjust the jumbo frame size limit for non-gigabit network cards, set the maximum size to 16K-1 for RTL8125A, and add support for models such as RTL9151A and RTL8125K. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)
Add support for the RTL9151A network card chip, enabling 2.5Gbps network speeds. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)
Support RTL8125K network devices, with a maximum rate of 2.5Gbps. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)

Add indirect queue mapping support for the NFB driver, add a queue mapping array, adjust queue setup and initialization functions, and supplement firmware version and FEC retrieval functionality. (architecture-related: public API)
Change the NFB network card driver to create one ethdev per Ethernet port based on firmware port information, and add FEC retrieval and setting support. (architecture-related: public API)

Add a port parameter to the NFB network device driver, allowing users to specify which ports to use; it can be used multiple times, and defaults to all ports when not specified. (architecture-related: driver configuration interface)
Added PDB support for the IPsec path, including inline inbound and outbound directions. (architecture-related: IPsec PDB support)
Added Out-Of-Place security reassembly support for the CN20k platform, including reassembly path adaptation and Rx fast path processing. (architecture-related: CN20k OOP security reassembly)
Added non-in-place (Out-Of-Place) flow rule configuration support for security actions. (architecture-related: security action OOP flow rules)

Introduced HALO support in the cn20k NPA, allowing 1:1 aura-pool mapping, and added a devargs parameter halo_ena to enable or disable this feature. (architecture-related: HALO support and devargs parameter)

Added L2TPv2 tunnel support for the ice network card driver, including data structure definitions, protocol identifiers, flow pattern matching, and packet generation. (architecture-related: L2TPv2 tunnel support)
The idpf driver added PTP time synchronization support, including basic opcodes, PTP message handling, clock operations, and transmit timestamps. (architecture-related: public API)
The axgbe driver added external PHY read/write functions, supporting IEEE Clause 22 standards, and added support for Marvell M88E1512 PHY. (architecture-related: public API)
The IDPF driver added AVX2 vectorized split queue receive and transmit paths, providing support for CPUs that do not support AVX512. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)
Unified the naming of queue statistics fields for TAP PMD, and added MAC address filtering functionality. (architecture-related: public API)
Added a function to convert HWS table types to corresponding action flags, supporting root and non-root tables. (architecture-related: public API)
Added IPsec receive injection support for the CN20K platform, including injection configuration and receive injection handling functions. (architecture-related: public API)
Added packet buffer (PB) and work queue element (WQE) cache configuration options for receive queues (RQ). (architecture-related: public API)
Updated flow rules to support inbound non-in-place (Out-Of-Place) IPsec session configuration. (architecture-related: public API)
Added CPT CQ (completion queue) configuration support for inline inbound IPsec. (architecture-related: public API)
The testpmd txonly multi-flow mode added a configurable number of flows, with a new --txonly-flows parameter and set txonly-flows command. (architecture-related: public API)
Added API forward compatibility support for the uacce bus driver and the hisi_acc DMA driver. (architecture-related: API compatibility)
Added flow steering functionality for the GVE driver, including device options, extended management commands, flow rule configuration, and rte_flow API support. (architecture-related: public API)
