Added support for new Huawei SPx series network cards for the hinic3 driver, including device ID, compact CQE mode, and receive/transmit path handling. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)
Added HTN FDIR support for the new SPx series network cards, and refactored TCAM filter management, RSS, MTU, LRO, and other functionality. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)
Added software MAC address filtering for Linux TAP devices, supporting unicast and multicast address filtering. (architecture-related: public API)
Added ZUC 256 v2 pure encryption support in the CN20K crypto device driver, and refactored PDCP-related functions. (architecture-related: public API)
Added support for Snow 5G and ZUC 256 algorithms in the cnxk crypto driver. (architecture-related: public API)
The --rxq-share parameter of testpmd now dynamically allocates Rx queue sharing groups. (architecture-related: configuration behavior)
Added a devargs option drv_no_data_stashing for the DPAA2 network driver to replace the environment variable for disabling data stashing. (architecture-related: public API)

net/ice/base removed the hardware type restriction for ice_fw_supports_lldp_fltr_ctrl(), instead checking firmware API version by hardware generation (E810/E82x >= 1.7.1, E830 >= 1.7.11), and added logic in ice_cfg_sw_lldp() to fall back to legacy ethernet filter on failure.
Added support for the AES-XTS encryption algorithm in the OpenSSL crypto PMD.
Added support for V4000 Krackan2e devices for the axgbe network card driver.
Added IPv4 and IPv6 fragmentation RSS types for IAVF PMD, supporting symmetric Toeplitz hashing.
Added SHAKE-128 and SHAKE-256 algorithm support to the OpenSSL PMD.
Migrate the iavf driver Tx path to the generic scalar Tx function, remove duplicate private implementations, and add callbacks such as IPsec descriptor retrieval and context descriptor generation.
Added support for simple Tx functions in the idpf driver, and adjusted the Tx path selection logic in single-queue mode.
Enable simple transmit functions for the cpfl driver and refactor transmit path selection logic to support single-queue mode.
Add a device reset callback function for the GVE NIC driver, and clear the transmit/receive queue array in the device pointer when releasing queues.
Add an alternative probe method based on vdev for the NFB network device driver, supporting virtual or emulated devices not represented by PCI.
Added support for multiple compatible NICs for the nfb NIC driver, including NFB-200G2QL secondary cards, FB2CGHH cards, COMBO-400G1 cards, and generic CESNET-NDK cards.
Add firmware version reporting capability to the nfb NIC driver.
Optimize the MAC address allocation logic in the nfb NIC driver, prioritizing the MAC address assigned by the NIC.
Add the ability to configure real link up/down status via the MDIO register for the nfb NIC driver.
Add basic support for configuring RS-FEC link mode via MDIO for the nfb NIC driver.
Added receive MTU setting support for the nfb NIC driver, and report the maximum MTU value in device information.
Optimized the statistics retrieval method for the nfb NIC driver, changing to read the total counters provided by the firmware MAC component.
Added Out-Of-Place processing support in the event Rx fastpath of the CN20k platform.
The bnxt driver added PTP time synchronization support, processing PTP frames in the receive path and parsing timestamps in transmit completion.
The ice NIC driver added RSS hash support for L2TPv2 packets.
testpmd added the show config dcbfwdtc command to display the DCB forwarding TC list.
mlx5 PMD introduced a mechanism for delayed allocation of HWS drop action to minimize firmware resource usage.
Added support for IP fragmentation and reassembly of ordinary packets (non-secure offload), implemented by configuring UCAST_CPT rules.
Added scattered receive support for jumbo frames for the af_packet driver.
Added the ability to disable Rx tail drop via the devargs parameter drv_no_taildrop for the DPAA2 NIC driver.
net/i40e added a dependency check for QinQ multi-VLAN insertion on the VLAN_EXTEND Rx configuration flag, and updated documentation.
Updated the inline IPsec profile ID setting logic for CN20K.
net/cnxk added a check for CPT ucode 0xF2 in soft expiry processing.

test/pcapng extended test coverage: added different length packet comments, random packet size variation, 32-bit timestamp wrap, statistics block writing, RFC 864 chargen fill patterns, and increased total packet count from 4096 to 10000.
test/event skips the Rx adapter test when there is no ethdev and the device cannot be created via the net_null driver.
test/event removed the explicit dependency on the net_null driver for the Tx adapter test suite, instead skipping the last test case when the driver is not present.

test/tap added a standalone TAP PMD test suite covering device configuration, link status, statistics, MTU, MAC address, promiscuous/all-multicast modes, queue start/stop, link up/down, device start/stop, and multi-queue settings.

examples/flow_filtering added 8 code snippets: Integrity Check Flags  steering, packet type matching, ECN IP header modification, Random Match, VXLAN-GPE/GBP header field matching, NVGRE matching, NAT64 Action.

net/netvsc supports runtime reconfiguration of RX/TX queue count via port stop/configure/start, performing full NVS/RNDIS teardown and rebuild when queue count changes, reconfiguring RSS indirection table, draining TX completion in hn_dev_stop, and protecting with write locks in VF queue release.

net/af_packet derives max_rx_pktlen and max_mtu from the actual TPACKET ring frame size to support jumbo frames, allows configuring large frames via framesz devarg, and changes the data_size boundary check in eth_dev_mtu_set() to RTE_ASSERT().
Fixed an error returned when adding a dictionary container to an array container, and added corresponding test cases. (architecture-related: public API)

Fixed the issue where the iavf driver incorrectly reported the maximum queue count when the PF kernel driver does not support large VF, now reporting the correct queue count based on actual supported capabilities. (architecture-related: public API)
Fixed an out-of-bounds access issue caused by insufficient virtqueue array size in VDUSE, by defining the VHOST_MAX_VRING macro to correctly include control queues. (architecture-related: public API)
Fixed two related bugs in FreeBSD EAL memory initialization: hole placement error and memseg search potentially incorrectly occupying reserved holes. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)
Fixed the parsing of stacked VLAN frames in the rte_net_get_ptype function, supporting up to 8 layers of VLAN headers and correctly setting the ptype bitmask. (architecture-related: public API)

Fixed defects in the mbuf copy function where it incorrectly returned NULL when copying to the end of a packet, and failed to preserve the external flag when allocating from a fixed external buffer memory pool. (architecture-related: public API)

Fixed stack alignment issues during external function calls in x86 JIT compilation, added stack pointer alignment operations in prolog, and added related test cases. (architecture-related: core module: BPF JIT)
Fixed a compilation warning caused by a conflict between the enum member name unused and the mbuf parameter, renaming it to MLX5_UNUSED_DOMAIN_TYPE. (architecture-related: public API)
Fixed the issue where RSA verify operations returned decrypted data when no padding mode was used. (architecture-related: external behavior)

Added name length checks for the LPM library, rejecting overly long names and returning ENAMETOOLONG; fixed internal buffer sizes and added truncation warnings for RCU deferred queue names. (architecture-related: public API)
Added name length validation for rte_hash_create and rte_fbk_hash_create, returning ENAMETOOLONG; added truncation warnings for internal ring names. (architecture-related: public API)

Added name length validation in rte_efd_create, rejecting overly long names and returning an error; also improved logging for ring name truncation and error messages for ring creation failures. (architecture-related: public API)
Limited the length of runtime directory and Unix domain socket paths to avoid binding failures or command-line parsing errors due to overly long paths. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)
Added parameter validation and error code setting in the tailq lookup, create, and register functions, rejecting overly long names and improving error handling. (architecture-related: public API)
Added an overflow check in the statistics name retrieval function of the ethdev library, logging an error when the name length exceeds the buffer size. (architecture-related: public API)
Added length checks for names and values in the configuration file, rejecting overly long entries, and increased the read buffer to avoid silent truncation. (architecture-related: public API)

Fixed an issue where shared RX queues allowed MTU mismatch at runtime, avoiding failures in hot-adding representor or runtime MTU changes; also removed the redundant priv->mtu field, unifying tracking of MTU via dev->data->mtu. (architecture-related: public API)

Fixed a use-after-free race condition in the vhost library during cleanup caused by not safely destroying fdset, adding the fdset_destroy function to ensure the event dispatch thread exits correctly and releases resources. (architecture-related: public API)

Fixed precision loss in TSC frequency query caused by integer division performed first, changing to multiplication before division to obtain a more accurate frequency value. (architecture-related: core behavior)

Fixed the annotation of the per-lcore variable allocation function, removing the incorrect __rte_alloc_size attribute to avoid false positives from FORTIFY_SOURCE runtime checks. (architecture-related: public API)

Moved the internal data structure of the NFB NIC driver from dev_private to process_private to support correct initialization and uninitialization of Ethernet devices by secondary processes in multi-process scenarios. (architecture-related: multi-process support)
Fixed naming conflicts of global variables and internal symbols in the mlx5 driver, adding the mlx5_ prefix and making them static to avoid link symbol conflicts. (architecture-related: public API)

Fixed an issue where the fbarray name could be truncated in the secondary process, adding a return value check for snprintf and returning an error when the name is too long. (architecture-related: EAL fbarray)

Fixed an issue where flow mark metadata could not be read after reconfiguring Rx queues in the mlx5 PMD, now correctly restoring the flow mark flag at port start. (architecture-related: flow mark metadata)

Extracted the TX descriptor calculation logic from multiple Intel NIC drivers into a common function, and fixed descriptor calculation errors in the idpf driver under the TSO scenario. (architecture-related: public API)

Added missing E610 MAC type checks for the ixgbe driver, enabling correct support for E610 devices in bypass, queue statistics mapping, VLAN extension, device start, info retrieval, E-Tag, flow steering, L2 tunneling, VF jumbo frames, and receive queue setup, and added validity checks for receive queue ring size. (architecture-related: public API)

Fixed a memory leak of security flows in the ixgbe driver, adding the ability to destroy security flows and fixing the issue of still returning a pointer on creation failure. (architecture-related: public API)

Fixed a pointer passing error in the ixgbe driver's IPsec SA addition flow, changing the incorrectly passed rte_flow_action_security container to directly pass the security session pointer, and making function parameter types explicit to enhance compile-time type checking. (architecture-related: public API)

Fixed a fbarray name conflict in containers with shared hugetlbfs mounts caused by non-unique PID, generating unique names using TSC values instead, and reducing the name buffer size. (architecture-related: core module behavior)
Added length checks for string parameters in the pcapng copy function to prevent silent truncation or buffer issues from overly long strings. (architecture-related: public API)

For the CN20K platform, skip the inline IPsec write SA operation, disable the option, and execute the hardware-recommended sequence to write the SA context. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)
Fixed CPT CQ ring wrap-around handling, corrected CQ size assignment, and optimized pointer calculation and head pointer management in the CQ callback. (architecture-related: public API)
Corrected the link speed retrieval method in the nfb NIC driver by reading the MDIO register to obtain actual link speed capabilities. (architecture-related: driver behavior)

Fixed restrictions on shared Rx queues: added checks for shared Rx queues in vectorized Rx and MPRQ support checks to avoid memory leaks from incorrect resource initialization, and updated related documentation. (architecture-related: public API)

Moved HPET timer-related functions from eal_timer.c to the new eal_timer_hpet.c source file, ensuring these symbols are only exported when HPET is enabled, fixing the issue where symbol export was not controlled by build configuration. (architecture-related: build configuration control)
Fixed the interface name length in the tap driver, using the correct IFNAMSIZ instead of RTE_ETH_NAME_MAX_LEN. (architecture-related: public API)

Fixed the scatter segment count calculation logic in TAP PMD, changing iovecs to a flexible array member, and replacing runtime checks with compile-time static_assert. (architecture-related: public API)
Changed the worker thread count upper limit from the fixed value 128 to RTE_MAX_LCORE, fixing a buffer overflow on platforms with high core counts. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)

Fixed memory corruption in cryptodev in secondary process caused by inconsistent dev_id allocation, making the secondary process look up devices by device name in the existing memzone. (architecture-related: multi-process behavior)
Fixed a race condition in VF add/remove events in the netvsc driver, introducing lock protection and an event attachment mechanism. (architecture-related: VF add/remove mechanism)

Fixed an issue where the secondary process did not release port references during VF hot-removal in the netvsc driver in multi-process scenarios, adding a multi-process communication mechanism to coordinate VF removal. (architecture-related: multi-process communication mechanism)

Fixed unsynchronized fast-path ops in the mlx4 driver for secondary process, updating the burst function pointers and queue data pointers in rte_eth_fp_ops during START_RXTX and STOP_RXTX handling. (architecture-related: public API)

Added explicit checks for the igb_uio and uio_pci_generic drivers in the probe function of NBL PMD, rejecting binding and updating documentation to describe these limitations. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)

Fixed an offset overflow issue in the hash library caused by 32-bit multiplication, casting the relevant multiplication operands to size_t type to ensure correct calculation on 64-bit systems. (architecture-related: public API)
Fixed the VLAN stripped flag reporting issue for Thor2 in the bnxt driver, setting the VLAN_STRIPPED flag based on the actual stripping state in the scalar path. (architecture-related: public API)
Fixed an unaligned access issue in the rte_hash_crc function caused by unaligned input pointers, aligning the input pointer before calculation. (architecture-related: public API)
In the bnxt driver, passed the receive timestamp to mbuf via a dynamic field, and added a ptp_cfg null pointer check to avoid segmentation faults. (architecture-related: public API)

Updated the CPT RXC time configuration for the CN20k platform, changing the reassembly configuration to fixed granularity with variable activity limit time, and added the rxc_step device parameter for NIX devices. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)

Added handling for epoll errors and disconnection events (EPOLLERR, EPOLLHUP, EPOLLRDHUP) in Linux EAL interrupt handling, and added helper functions for event conversion and interrupt source removal and release. (architecture-related: EAL interrupt handling)
Fixed the bonding device detection logic in the mlx5 driver, using sysfs parsing and dedicated functions instead of device name checks. (architecture-related: bonding detection method)
Fixed memory leak in hash table under RCU deferred release configuration, including leaks when deleting entries and overwriting key. (architecture-related: hash table RCU release behavior)

Fixed port name conflict in mlx5 driver under BlueField Socket Direct configuration, supporting shared E-Switch scenarios through more generic uplink and host PF counting logic and improved port name generation and representor matching. (architecture-related: port name generation and representor matching)

Fixed regression of default flow engine for mlx5 PMD on Windows, introducing platform-specific device parameter initialization, setting dv_flow_en and allow_duplicate_pattern to 1 by default on Windows. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)
Fixed vsocket resource not released when vhost driver registration fails, restoring release operation on error path. (architecture-related: public API)
Fixed bit width error of DPC setting field in NPA structure. (architecture-related: public API)

Fixed possible 32-bit integer wraparound when adding offset and length during mbuf data read, switching to 64-bit calculation; also updated related test cases to correctly verify failure behavior of oversized reads. (architecture-related: public API)

Fixed issue where masked VXLAN/NVGRE encapsulation action in asynchronous flow API caused packets to be encapsulated with empty header, ensuring encapsulated data is passed correctly by separating tunnel header translation logic from mlx5_tbl_translate_reformat and handling it uniformly. (architecture-related: public API)

Fixed issue in mlx5 driver where VLAN stripping flags (RTE_MBUF_F_RX_VLAN and RTE_MBUF_F_RX_VLAN_STRIPPED) could be incorrectly set in CQE compression scenario, correcting position of packet header info bytes in mini CQE and check method of CVLAN bit. (architecture-related: public API)

Fixed compilation failure in pedantic compilation mode due to use of non-standard __COUNTER__, changing cache guard macro to use __LINE__ to generate unique names. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)

Fixed GEN4 elliptic curve capability detection and validation in QAT driver: rejecting unsupported RSA padding and EC curves at session configuration and returning -ENOTSUP, adding missing ECDH, ECDSA, ECPM capability entries, and making asymmetric tests return TEST_SKIPPED when session creation returns -ENOTSUP. (architecture-related: external behavior)

Fixed incorrect result length setting for modular exponentiation and modular inverse operations in QAT hardware, and fixed issue of not skipping leading zero bytes of result during comparison. (architecture-related: external behavior)
Fixed crash on BCM57608 due to incorrect structure field offset, adjusting position of multi-doorbell page size field to match firmware response layout. (architecture-related: public API)
bnxt driver now allows querying statistics when port is stopped, no longer returning error but displaying existing statistics values.
Fixed undefined behavior caused by negative shift when n is zero in rte_red.h.
Fixed issue where default copy rule was created in wrong group when flow metadata is shared, and ensured REG_C_1 register is always used when sharing flow metadata between E-Switch and VM.
Fixed issues with launch time functionality in e1000/igc NIC driver, including correct allocation of context descriptor and correct handling of txtime expiry or exceeding Qbv period.
Fixed IPv6 SRH flex section header length calculation and concurrent initialization issues in mlx5 driver.

Fixed multiple issues related to flow control, FEC, and auto-negotiation in sfc driver, including flow control mode setting, FEC flag indication, RX_TRUNC_ERR event classification, fixed speed reset, and auto-negotiation status reporting.
Fixed return type and error log logic of tap_mp_req_on_rxtx function in TAP driver.
Fixed issue in AF_XDP driver where zero-copy optimization was incorrectly triggered when transmitting external mbuf, adding check for whether mbuf is a direct buffer.
Fixed MPESW PF probe logic to support arbitrary number of ports.
Fixed flow devargs handling, dynamically setting steering default value based on hardware capability, and forcibly disabling with clear log when incompatible.
Fixed issue where mlx5 PMD allocated too many memzone under default synchronous flow API configuration, removing two unused ring objects to avoid memzone exhaustion during large-scale SF probing.
Fixed issue of setting redundant control rules in promiscuous mode, making DMAC and multicast/broadcast control flow rules created only in non-promiscuous mode.
Fixed errors in batch offset calculation and queried counter count tracking in HW flow counter query, ensuring counters exceeding 64k get correct values and all counters are queried.
Fixed issue in bnxt driver where statistics collection failed to aggregate statistics for rings exceeding RTE_ETHDEV_QUEUE_STAT_CNTRS at high queue count.
Fixed interrupt nesting issue caused by hardware statistics query in net/nbl driver, changing to dedicated thread for statistics update.
Fixed Tx scheduler hierarchy priority configuration in ice driver, re-allowing strict priority at non-root levels.
Fixed issue in ixgbe and e1000 drivers where key length was not correctly updated when getting RSS hash configuration.
Fixed length attribute in flex parser creation, setting workaround bit for all length modes, and updated internal parsers for eCPRI and IPv6 SRH.
Fixed stack alignment issue in ASan compilation, adding 64-byte alignment macro for local variables in multiple functions.
Fixed possible null pointer dereference when represented_port pattern item lacks spec in template API.
Fixed issue where TBL8 count was not correctly incremented when adding prefixes in FIB and FIB6, avoiding integer overflow.
Marked portal pointer of idxd device as volatile, and added type cast during unmap for consistency.
Fixed memory leak caused by not releasing memzone when freeing queues in net/nbl driver.
Fixed mbuf header space usage issue during packet transmission in net/nbl driver, avoiding data corruption caused by modification of shared mbuf.
Fixed possible mbuf double free during queue cleanup, adjusting port stop flow and optimizing TX/RX ring release logic.
Fixed issue in BPF program where only one execution branch was evaluated when starting with conditional jump, and added related test cases.
Fixed pcapng comment buffer overflow, switching to dynamic allocation to support arbitrary length comments, and still logging packets when allocation fails.
Added length check when copying delayed statistics name, logging warning if name is too long.
Added length check in Unix domain socket path copy to prevent security issues caused by path overflow.
Fixed buffer size of address string in memory telemetry information to prevent address overflow.
Added an overflow check when constructing hugepage file paths to prevent buffer overflows caused by excessively long paths.
Used dynamic allocation buffer instead of fixed-size array to avoid possible truncation when concatenating driver library path.
Fixed the net/null driver's Tx statistics accumulation error, changed the assignment of opackets and obytes to accumulation, ensuring that the statistics of all Tx queues are correctly aggregated.

Replaced the dynamically variable number of queues with hardware constant values, fixed the method for obtaining the maximum number of Rx/Tx queues in the nfb driver, and adjusted the state setting when the device is stopped.
Fixed a null pointer dereference issue in the queue statistics function of the net/nfb driver, and corrected the error of misusing a pointer array as a structure array.
Fixed the issue in the net/nfb driver where it stopped queues that were not started during startup failure, and changed it to only stop queues that were started.
Fixed the job leak in the asynchronous stream operation queue of testpmd, managed the lifecycle of queue_job through a linked list, ensuring that all unprocessed jobs are released before exit.
Fixed a null pointer dereference issue in the IPsec stream parsing of the ixgbe driver, avoiding crashes and undefined behavior.
Fixed a null pointer dereference issue in the nbl_dev_configure function, moved the debug log after the null pointer check.
Fixed a compilation error caused by uninitialized variables in the iavf driver under the minsize build option.
Fixed the uninitialized variable issue caused by an unchecked return value in the ulp_blob_append function of the bnxt driver.
Fixed a compilation error caused by uninitialized variables in the intel_pstate driver under the minsize build option.
Fixed a memory leak in the cpfl and idpf drivers caused by not releasing sw_ring when TX queue setup fails.
Fixed the uninitialized variable warning in the GFNI code of the hash library, explicitly zero-initializing related variables to eliminate false positives.

Fixed the initialization and configuration timing issue of the FDIR filter in the i40e driver, removed the initialization and configuration logic from the parsing function, and changed it to execute during flow create, avoiding incorrect modification of FDIR state during flow validate.
Fixed the IPv6 GTPU flow parsing error in the i40e driver, added handling for the IPv6 flow pattern item.
Fixed a memory leak in the egress IPsec flow of the iavf driver, by correctly marking the flow and adding it to the queue, ensuring that memory can be properly released during destruction.
Fixed a memory leak in the iavf driver caused by not cleaning up the IPsec engine during unload.
Fixed the input set byte count calculation error during IPv4 flow subscription in the iavf driver, corrected the byte count of the IPv4 source and destination addresses from 2 bytes to 4 bytes.
Fixed a memory leak in the DCF QoS bandwidth configuration, replaced the temporary buffer allocation from rte_zmalloc with calloc, and added a release operation in the failure path.
Fixed a memory leak in the RAW pattern during FDIR parsing in ice, released the pkt_buf buffer in the validation path, and uniformly used rte_zmalloc for memory allocation.
Fixed a null pointer crash during RTL8168FP initialization caused by the missing PHY MCU configuration function pointer, added a no-op hw_phy_mcu_config_8168fp function.
Fixed the speed classification of the RTL8168KB chip, removed it from the 2.5G device list, as the chip actually supports a maximum of 1Gbps.
Fixed the issue of incorrect link status reporting after binding PMD, ensuring the old mapping is used.
Fixed the bitmask logic error when setting 1G and 10G capabilities in the RTL8127 NIC driver.

Fixed the issue in the iavf driver where the Tx queue flags were set incorrectly after path selection, ensuring that the use_ctx and use_vec_entry flags are always correctly configured, and simplified the flag setting logic.

Fixed the issue of packet loss caused by overly long comments during pcapng copying, automatically allocating and linking additional mbuf segments when tail space is insufficient to accommodate comments of arbitrary length.
Fixed the issue in the mlx5 driver where the Tx queue startup could crash due to a null pointer dereference, moved the assignment of txq_data after the NULL check.
Fixed a counter leak issue when per-queue hairpin counters are enabled, caused by not destroying the allocated DevX queue counter objects in the error path.
Fixed the use-after-free issue in the mlx5 driver caused by not setting the shared context pointer to null after ASO management initialization failure.
Fixed a truncation issue when reading queue counters in the mlx5 driver, ensuring that the 64-bit counter value is correctly read.
Fixed the loop condition check error in the engine capability acquisition logic of the CN9k platform.
Fixed the issue of incorrectly enabling the fast path security flag under custom inbound SA configuration.
Fixed the issue in the i40e driver where the secondary process could not correctly select the Rx path when the device was not started.
Fixed the issue in the iavf driver where the secondary process could not correctly select the Rx path when the device was not started.
Fixed the issue in the ice driver where the secondary process could not correctly select the Rx path when the device was not started.

Allowed the secondary process to select the sending path by itself when the device has not yet been started, fixing the issue where the secondary process could not correctly select the sending function when the primary process had not started the device, involving multiple Intel NIC drivers.
Fixed the use-after-free issue of vhost fdset during shutdown, changed the fdset allocation from rte_zmalloc to calloc of libc.
Fixed the issue in the iavf driver where the wrong structure size was used when obtaining the IPsec status.
Fixed the issue in TAP PMD where some queues might be missed during queue statistics counting, and changed the statistics clearing method to use memset.
Extended the interface index of the fixed MAC address from one byte to two bytes, avoiding duplicate MAC when hot-plugging more than 256 devices.
Fixed a resource leak when net/tap device creation fails: ensure that process_private memory is released, and correctly release the allocated ethdev ports when memory allocation fails.
Fixed a resource leak during secondary process probing, correctly releasing eth_dev and process_private in the error path.
Fixed a memory leak in the tap driver caused by not releasing the IPC reply buffer when the queue count does not match.
Fixed the use-after-free issue in the net/tap driver when remote flow creation fails, correctly deleting the local TC rule and removing it from the linked list before releasing the flow.
Fix the memory leak when creating implicit rules in the tap driver, ensuring that remote_flow is released when the kernel returns EEXIST.
Replace variable-length arrays with fixed-size arrays in the tap driver's transmit path, add a MAC filter check in the receive path, and enable the VLA warning.

Fix the slow Rx queue configuration in the bonding driver by limiting the idle threshold to a quarter of the ring size, avoiding driver failure for small rings due to an excessively large default threshold.

In the i40e driver, remove unnecessary huge page memory allocations, change temporary variables to stack static arrays or ordinary calloc/free, and fix the issue where enabling VLAN strip unexpectedly disables outer VLAN stripping.
Add a forwarding state check to the DCB forwarding TC configuration command for testpmd, preventing configuration modification during forwarding.
Defer qdisc initialization until creating a rte_flow rule, avoiding error log printing when not needed.
Fix errors in conditional compilation directives in process.h, simplifying the #ifdef structure.
Fix the wrap-around check in the simple Tx scalar path, ensuring that when a transmit burst ends exactly at the last descriptor of the ring, tx_tail is correctly reset to 0 rather than ring_size.
Fix a resource leak in the net/mana driver caused by not releasing Protection Domains when the device is closed.
Fix a memory leak of device parameters during VF hotplug, releasing devargs in both the hotplug retry and device close cleanup paths.

Fix the issue where the auxiliary process cannot correctly set the fast-path operation structure during hotplug, ensuring it can access the device's transmit/receive queue arrays and update burst function pointers.
Fix the issue where the secondary process cannot correctly update fast-path queue data pointers and burst function pointers during hotplug, avoiding segmentation faults due to stale pointers.
Fix the misuse of commas as semicolons in the bnxt ULP driver, eliminating warnings triggered by the -Wcomma flag during clang compilation.
Fix the issue where queue statistics counters keep increasing during port stop/start loops, using queue counts from device data instead.
Fix a timestamp calculation error in the pcapng module caused by calling a copy function before the file is opened, and handle cases where the TSC difference is negative.
Fix the MAC speed setting error in SGMII 100M mode, changing it from 1G to 100M, and add a corresponding PHY implementation.
Fix the issue of residual descriptor flag bits in the Tx path of the memif driver, ensuring clean descriptor state for each transmission by direct assignment instead of bitwise OR operations.
Fix a resource leak in the net/netvsc driver caused by sub-channels not being closed when the device is removed.
Fix the duplicate release of the primary receive queue during deinitialization in the netvsc driver, removing redundant release calls.
Fix a resource leak in the net/netvsc driver on initialization failure, ensuring proper release of the primary channel and primary structures.
Fix a resource leak in the net/netvsc driver caused by not unregistering the device event callback when Rx filter fails.

Fix a resource leak on MTU changes: properly close the VMBus channel, release rxbuf_info, and reinitialize the chimney bitmap; also add hotplug callback unregistration and clearing of pending TX completions in hn_dev_start/stop.
Fix a busy loop in the DevX interrupt handling of the mlx5 driver caused by not detecting disconnect/error events, by checking interrupt event flags and unregistering callbacks.
Fix a crash in the eventdev/eth_rx adapter caused by passing an out-of-range port ID through the telemetry interface, changing the eth_dev_id type from int to uint16_t.

Fix the issue in the iavf driver where setting a default MAC address when the VF is not started causes failure to delete the primary MAC, by introducing a mac_primary_set flag to ensure deletion of the old address is only attempted when the primary MAC has been set.
Fix a crash on CN10K caused by a null event_dev pointer, adding a null pointer check in polling mode.
Fix the incorrect tag insertion order during QinQ offload in the AVX512 path, making it consistent with single-packet functions and the scalar path.
Fix dangling pointer issues in the SHA and SHAKE tests in the FIPS validation example, setting vector pointers to null after freeing to avoid double free.

Add a check for invalid topology in ice_sched_add_node, returning an error early and logging a warning when a parent node is not ready for child nodes, avoiding crashes due to abnormal topology information after NVM updates.
Fix the timer programming sequence for clock adjustment on E830 devices, adding a write to the command register to make the adjustment take effect.
Fix the data size calculation for MTU settings in the af_packet driver, making it consistent with the queue initialization path, thereby accepting all valid MTU values.
Fix the error of an unused variable when removing MAC/VLAN filters in the i40e driver, optimizing error handling logic.
Fix the issue in the bnxt driver where batch_info is read before initialization in ulp_stats_cache_main_loop, avoiding potential errors through zero initialization.
Fix a resource leak in testpmd caused by not closing file descriptors when parsing mbuf history commands.

Fix a leak of meter ASO action in the mlx5 driver when releasing back to the pool, by saving and restoring the action pointer to ensure the cached action remains valid after pool reclamation, and properly destroying it on close.

Fix an anomaly in DCB forwarding in testpmd caused by inconsistent TC counts between ports, by taking the minimum of Rx and Tx TC as the effective TC count, and adding a check for the validity of Tx queues.

Fix the issue where tx_skew is not correctly set in wait on time mode, moving skew initialization to the shared device context allocation stage, making it effective for both transmit scheduling modes.
Fix the failure to delete MAC addresses in the mlx5 driver on Linux, and always enable debug logging to aid diagnosis.

Fix the incorrect flow type setting for inner tunnel items in the ice driver, limiting the inner protocol tracking condition to only L2TPv2 tunnels, avoiding impact on FDIR rules for tunnel types such as VXLAN and GTPU.
Fix the missing check for flex parser capability when creating flex item, avoiding reporting irrelevant error messages on older firmware, and update the documentation's limitation notes accordingly.
Fix a memory leak in testpmd caused by not releasing the old job_list when executing the flow configure command multiple times.
Remove the erroneous check in the i40e driver that requires spec and mask lengths to be equal when validating raw flow item, fixing the issue where flow is rejected when using the default mask.

Fix multi-segment Rx data corruption in net/memif: move dst_off initialization to execute only once per packet, avoiding data overwrite during chained descriptor processing; also add boundary checks in both Rx paths to prevent out-of-bounds reads when n_slots is 0. Update statistics counters to record the new errors.
Fix the issue where shared groups and queue ID are not reported when obtaining Rx queue information via rte_eth_rx_queue_info_get().

Fix the CQE suppression handling logic on erroneous completions in the net/mana driver, now skipping reads only when the CQE type is a normal completion, avoiding consumer index misalignment and subsequent misreads and memory issues due to skipping error CQE.

Fix the kernel warning caused by the data path not being switched back to synthetic when the netvsc device is stopped. Switch the data path before stopping VF, switch it back after starting VF, and change the read lock to a write lock.
Fix the hardware register selection logic for NAT64 flow actions. When REG_C_6 is unavailable, use the last three available tag registers instead.

Fix the crash in the QAT driver caused by EC sessions missing keys: correct the check of the key field in session_set_ec(), zero-initialize the xform structure in test cases, and add an error log for unsupported curve ID in pick_curve().

Fix the support issue of the axgbe driver under 100 Mbps links: correct the width of the speed selection field in the MAC transmit configuration register to 3 bits to match the hardware specification, add support for 100 Mbps MAC speed selection, and fix the macro definition for auto-negotiation capabilities to correctly advertise link modes such as 10baseT and 100baseT.
Fix the ice driver's RSS LUT access issue. When VSI allocates a global LUT, correctly use the global LUT parameter instead of the PF LUT parameter.
Fix the queue memory leak in the dpaa2 driver when closing a port, caused by prematurely setting rx_vq[0] to NULL in the loop. Instead, save the base pointer before the loop and then free it.
Fix the memory leak of the Rx error queue in the dpaa2 NIC driver. Add missing frees and NULL assignments on port close and allocation failure paths.

Fix the false positive of the Rx descriptor count warning in the net/dpaa2 driver: only issue a warning when DPNI enables high-performance buffer mode (PFDR in PEB) and the total descriptor count exceeds 11264, avoiding misleading noise in normal buffer mode.
Fix the issue where allocated resources are not released when the software parser fails to load or enable, ensuring proper cleanup on error paths.

Fix the issue where the link status of the dpaa2 NIC cannot be correctly updated after port stop/start. Move the link start operation to after the LSC interrupt registration to ensure that link up events are not missed.
Fix the issue where device parameters are not correctly propagated during fslmc bus hotplug. Refresh the devargs of existing devices on rescan.
Fix the issue in the dpaa2 driver where non-VLAN packets are incorrectly inserted with a VLAN header. Now, VLAN insertion is performed only based on each packet's flags.
Fix three defects in the dump_err_pkts() function: null pointer dereference, memory leak for multi-segment packets, and the segment sequence number not being reset.

Fixed the dpaa2 driver slow-path parsing issue where the L4 packet type was set incorrectly, moved the NONFRAG flag to the end as the default value, and corrected the handling of the IP and L4 checksum flags.
Fix the L3/L4 checksum flag reporting issue in the dpaa2 driver: use separate if statements to report L3 and L4 checksum errors, and correctly mark the GOOD status when checksums pass.
Fix buffer out-of-bounds access and memory leak in the software taildrop path of the dpaa2 driver. Use the same free pattern as the ordered transmit path.

Fix the burst mode information retrieval function of the dpaa2 NIC to correctly report the actual burst function pointer used, rather than only listing the configured offload flags, and fix the issue of only displaying the first offload.
Add an upper bound to the SG table traversal in the Rx path of the dpaa2 NIC driver to prevent out-of-bounds access when the FINAL bit is not set.
Move the allocation of the MAC statistics DMA buffer from each xstats call to the device initialization phase, and free it at close, avoiding resource waste and thread safety issues.
Fix the issue where hardware is repeatedly reinitialized after downloading the backup scheduler topology. Remove the redundant initialization step in the calling code.
Fix the crash in the tap NIC driver caused by accessing an uninitialized receive queue when closing a partially configured port.
Fix the definition of the SGMII auto-negotiation status bits in the AXGBE driver so that the link status and duplex mode bits align with the hardware specification.
Fix the FEC capability check logic to correctly verify whether FEC mode is supported by the current link speed even when the port is not started.
In the ethtool example, change the mempool name buffer size from hardcoded 16 to RTE_MEMPOOL_NAMESIZE to avoid snprintf output truncation.
In the ixgbe FDIR code, change the loop counter i to a local variable in macros and functions to eliminate variable shadowing.
Rename or remove shadowed variables in multiple files in testpmd to eliminate -Wshadow compilation warnings.
In the graph example conn.c, uniformly rename the local connection variable to c to avoid shadowing the global variable conn.
In the pdump example, rename the function parameter optarg to avoid shadowing the getopt standard global variable.
In the compress-perf example, rename the parameters of 3 functions to avoid shadowing global variables with the same name.
In the crypto-perf example, rename the local variable iv_offset to a shorter form to avoid shadowing a global variable.
Rename or remove shadowed variables in multiple files in the eventdev example to eliminate -Wshadow compilation warnings.
In the flow-perf example, remove the redundant second definition of the token variable when processing command-line arguments.
In the ethtool example, fix the issue where the expected number of ports and the maximum number of ports are swapped in the error message for the port count limit.
In the zxdh driver, move zxdh_np_soft_res_uninstall() out of zxdh_np_online_uninit() to avoid double-freeing software resources.
In the EAL interrupt handling, add function name and line number information to error messages to locate the source of unallocated interrupts.
Fix the compilation warning in the cnxk driver caused by identical conditional branches. Merge duplicate branches and fix a loop condition.

In the i40e driver, change the queue comparison related types to unsigned 16 bits to eliminate compiler warnings when comparing with I40E_MAX_Q_PER_TC, and adjust i40e_align_floor to return an unsigned value.
In the vm_power example, check for truncation before copying socket_path to channel_path to eliminate the format-truncation warning from gcc 15.
In the ice base library, add data type casts in multiple files to fix comparison-with-wider-type violations detected by Windows CodeQL.
In the ipsec-secgw example, add const qualifiers to return values such as strchr in multiple files to fix discarded-qualifiers warnings caused by const functions under glibc 2.43.
Fix the compilation warning in the idpf driver caused by misuse of the comma operator. Replace commas with semicolons.
In the cfgfile test, use existing code to create temporary empty files to avoid possible filename truncation warnings and concurrency races from snprintf.
In the crypto test, update the nb_segs field after mbuf allocation to fix the append function failure and mbuf sanity check failure caused by incorrect segment count.
In app/test/test_cryptodev_asym.c, restore the data length of the RSA signature test to the correct value, which was previously incorrectly modified in the test scenario.
In app/test/test_eal_flags.c, add the log-level flag when recursively checking flag support for dpdk-test to output additional EAL debug information.

In app/test/test_pcapng.c, change the write packet test to use a fixed time duration instead of scaling by TSC frequency; and add an additional wrapper for the Windows platform to support building and running.
In app/test/test_atomic.c, change the iteration count of the atomic test from a fixed 1,000,000 to scaling inversely with the number of cores, and add a helper function in app/test/test.h.
In dpaa2_sec_dev_init() of drivers/crypto/dpaa2_sec/dpaa2_sec_dpseci.c, directly use the bus device name (dpseci.XXX) as the crypto device name, and no longer regenerate the dpsec-XXX format name.

Initialize the arg_idx variable in lib/argparse/rte_argparse.c, adjust the goto target position in drivers/bus/pci/linux/pci_vfio.c, to fix the uninitialized variable error reported by the compiler during the minsize build.
In app/test-pmd/config.c, replace the static function names in the error logs of the VLAN extend and tpid setting functions with the __func__ predefined identifier.

In mlx5_dev_spawn() of drivers/net/mlx5/linux/mlx5_os.c, release the allocated priv->flows memory when device generation fails; in drivers/net/mlx5/mlx5.c, adjust the queue and counter destruction order to destroy the queue first; in drivers/net/mlx5/mlx5_flow_hw.c, when indirect meter creation fails, call job_put to release job based on whether the HW operation has been enqueued.

In drivers/net/mlx5/windows/mlx5_os.c, add the correct setting and clearing operations for the mac_own bit field for the three functions mlx5_os_mac_addr_add, mlx5_os_mac_addr_remove, and mlx5_os_mac_addr_flush.

In drivers/net/intel/iavf/iavf_ethdev.c, change the PTP capability negotiation from being performed only at device startup to also being performed in iavf_dev_init(), and only set the RTE_ETH_RX_OFFLOAD_TIMESTAMP flag after PF confirms that Rx timestamping is enabled.
In the Rx initialization code of multiple Intel NIC drivers (cpfl, i40e, iavf, ice, idpf, ixgbe), add a check that the Rx descriptor ring size must be greater than twice the Rx free threshold.
In drivers/compress/zlib/zlib_pmd.c, fix the type conversion error in the UDC checksum calculation.

In rte_bpf_dump of lib/bpf/bpf_dump.c, add support for BPF_X conditional jumps, call instructions, BPF_MEM mode checks, and atomic instructions, and print warnings for unconventional variant instructions.
In the get_hash_oid function of examples/fips_validation/main.c, replace rte_memcpy with memcpy to avoid out-of-bounds access warnings when using vector instructions on the 15-byte array.

In the flow rule processing code of the IAVF and ICE PMD (iavf_fdir.c, iavf_fsub.c, iavf_hash.c, ice_fdir_filter.c, ice_hash.c), add explicit NULL pointer checks for the spec and mask fields of the RAW flow item.
In the VDUSE IOTLB miss handler of vhost, change the mmap failure check from checking NULL to checking MAP_FAILED, and add strerror to the error log.
net/ice adds a check for whether the root node is NULL before committing a new Tx scheduler hierarchy, to prevent invalid memory access.
net/ice fixes the printing logic of the priority mode in the Tx scheduler dump: when bit 4 of generic data is 0, it should be interpreted as strict priority enabled, not WFQ enabled.
net/mvpp2 fixes the variable shadowing issue caused by the duplicate declaration of the local variable i in the mrvl_rx_pkt_burst function.

net/zxdh adds a PCIe BAR failure check after reading the DTB queue buffer space register: a low bit of 0x3F indicates link down; also changes the generic error code ZXDH_ERR returned on DTB timeout to a specific error code.

net/nbl fixes the issue where the return values of the two ioctl calls NBL_DEV_USER_GET_BAR_SIZE and NBL_DEV_USER_CLEAR_EVENTFD were tested without being captured, and changes it to capture the return value first and then check it.

common/cnxk changes the variable-length array irq_set_buf in the irq_init function of roc_platform.c to use a fixed-size array defined by the EAL maximum interrupt vector count, eliminating the VLA compilation warning.
net/idpf removes the unused idpf_qc_tx_vec_avx512_setup function and its call logic in idpf and cpfl.

examples/vmdq_dcb replaces the field-by-field assignment of the local configuration structure with a designated initializer, ensuring that all fields (including enable_loop_back and padding bits) are zero-initialized.

net/iavf explicitly passes the local ol_flags variable to the Tx context sub-functions (segment descriptor creation and ipsec handling), avoiding these functions repeatedly reading ol_flags from mbuf.

examples/l2fwd-jobstats introduces a delay before acquiring the lock in the loop that fetches statistics, improving lock availability so that show_lcore_stats() can periodically update statistics while forwarding jobs are running.
common/mlx5 adds the missing FW error detail log output when modifying SQ and RQ.

Introduce a generic Tx path selection infrastructure for the Intel NIC drivers, where the primary process uniformly selects the Tx path, and remove the private implementations in each driver. (architecture-related: Tx path selection)

Refactor the MAC initialization logic of the NFB NIC driver, add MDIO management, improve error handling, and implement separate management of interface ports. (architecture-related: NFB driver MAC refactoring)
Update the CPT RXC structure to adapt to the CN20k and CN10k platforms, and fix the structure types in the related parsing functions. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)
Replace the __be64 type with the rte_be64_t of DPDK, reducing dependency on header files during cross-platform builds. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)
net/intel merges the buffer release functions of the simple scalar Tx paths in the ice and i40e drivers into a common function based on the i40e version.
Change the timestamp calculation to be based on the nanosecond value of the Unix epoch, ensuring monotonic increase.
Update the inline RQ mask configuration to adapt to the mbox change, and add support for the default RQ first skip byte configuration.
In the ARM64 JIT of bpf, mark all ARM opcode constants as UINT32_C, clarifying that they are 32-bit unsigned integers.
net/intel removes the no longer used tx_used field from the Tx queue structures of each driver; in the IDPF splitq scalar code, use the driver-specific rs_compl_count instead of the original tx_used.
net/iavf removes unused code left after the deprecation of the pipeline mode (involving files related to FDIR, flow subscription, generic flow, hash, and IPsec crypto).
net/ice changes to obtain link status updates from the device firmware via adminq messages, instead of relying directly on interrupts.
net/mlx5 removes the no longer used mlx5_tx_dbrec() Tx doorbell routine, which has been replaced by the generic mlx5_doorbell_ring().
net/dpaa2 replaces the hardcoded rte_delay_us(100 * 1000) with rte_delay_ms(CHECK_INTERVAL) in the link-down waiting logic.
Remove the SSE vector data paths of the i40e, iavf, and ice NIC drivers, and uniformly use the AVX2 or scalar fallback paths.
net/virtio adds a consistent prefix to multiple global variables to avoid name conflicts with application or other driver global variables during static linking.
In the AES-XBC code of common/cnxk, remove VLA and use an existing macro instead, because the cipher function is always called with in_len=16.
Refactor the context descriptor handling of the net/idpf, net/ice, and net/i40e drivers into a single function, unifying the function signature.
In the net/ixgbe driver, use a separate array desc status for tracking, making the usage of its rs_last_id array consistent with the generic Tx code.
Remove redundant callback cleanup setting to NULL during the release process of the hinic3, ionic, ngbe, octeon_ep, sfc_repr, and txgbe drivers.
In net/ixgbe, remove the MAC type check macro and change to explicit MAC type checks.
In net/ixgbe, split the security filter and the ntuple filter, and parse them independently.
In net/i40e, eliminate global filter variables by creating a wrapper function and virtual context for rte_flow_validate to pass state, and remove the unused tunnel filter.
In net/i40e, change the default RSS key to a global constant, which all callers use directly; before sending to adminq, it must be copied to a local buffer.
In net/i40e, remove the global pattern variable and change the conditional allocation during flow pattern parsing to unconditional allocation.
In the em, igb, and igc PMD of net/e1000, update the auto-negotiation flag regardless of whether the link state changes, making them consistent with the ixgbe, i40e, and iavf drivers.
In the Tx release routine of net/mlx5, remove the unused olx parameter to simplify the entire call chain.
In the net/intel generic Tx code, use non-volatile uint64_t pointers to write descriptors, and change the simple scalar Tx path to use the smaller tx_entry_vec structure.
In the test framework, allow the driver path loaded by the primary process to be passed to the secondary process to support mempool usage in the secondary process.
In tests, replace the deprecated "-c" coremask option with the "-l" option for secondary process startup parameters.
In the secondary process test of test/timer, scale the number of timers based on the number of available lcore, and shorten the timer duration and the primary process wait time to prevent timeouts.
In the capability test of test/power, if the power subsystem cannot be initialized due to permissions or other reasons, skip the test instead of failing.
Add the eventdev, cryptodev, and ethdev related tests that require devices to the driver test suite.
Define the "attic" test suite for storing unstable or unmaintained tests, and move red autotest to that suite.
In test/crypto, change the PMD-specific asymmetric test suite to a capability-based test suite.
In the file prefix test of test/eal, add extra logging to record matched, locked, or deleted file information, and add line numbers to error messages.

test/bpf skips the ELF loading test when net null is missing; add a TEST_ASSERT for mempool creation in test_bpf_elf_tx_load, and initialize the port variable in test_bpf_elf_rx_load to avoid undefined behavior in the cleanup path; fix the payload size of bpf_prm in the Rx/Tx load tests.
test/eal disables PCI probing in the vdev test and when recursively creating the primary process.
test/memcpy reduced the 32×32 full-permutation src/dst alignment offset test to a curated set of 7 offset values {0, 1, 7, 15, 16, 17, 31}, decreasing the iteration count from 38912 to 1862.
test/pcapng unifies log output to stdout and changes timestamp output to UTC.
test/mcslock scales the test iteration count by the number of cores.
test/stack scales the test iteration count by the number of cores.

test/timer replaces the volatile variables in the test_timer_secondary shared memory structure with RTE_ATOMIC() and rte_atomic_*_explicit() operations, and changes the types of expected_count and expired_count from int to unsigned int.
test/tap marks the test result as SKIPPED instead of FAILED when the tap vdev cannot be created.
test/timer, when the secondary process of timer_secondary_autotest fails, sets the stop flag before checking success or failure to avoid hanging.
app/dma-perf fixes the issue of the src and dst parameters being swapped in do_cpu_mem_copy().
test changes the boolean parameters of fast-tests to explicit NOHUGE_OK/NOHUGE_SKIP and ASAN_OK/ASAN_SKIP, and explicitly validates options in meson.build.
app/security-perf and dpdk-test rename variables to eliminate variable shadowing.
app/pipeline removes the second unnecessary ret variable definition in the main function to eliminate variable shadowing warnings.
test switches to using rte_eal_get_runtime_dir() to obtain the current file prefix and simplifies related error handling.
Optimized the memory pool object acquisition function, removed compile-time constant checks, and adjusted the cache update order to improve performance. (architecture-related: public API)

Added a mbuf fast release memory pool pointer to the generic transmit queue structure, optimized the mbuf release flow for the ice and i40e drivers, and improved performance. (architecture-related: public API)
Optimized the __rte_pktmbuf_free_direct function, reducing one memory store operation and improving performance. (architecture-related: public API)
Split HWS mode template creation into internal and external templates; internal templates skip validation to accelerate PMD initialization.
Merged lock operations during queue allocation, reducing hardware lock overhead and improving queue setup performance.
Added GENEVE tunnel TSO and receive-side outer UDP checksum offload support for the zxdh NIC driver, improving the performance of tunneled traffic.
Added a fast path for packets that do not use TSO and have only one data descriptor, improving performance.
Optimized Rx performance for RTL8127 by adjusting the Rx descriptor batch fetch count to 12.
Optimized pcapng timestamp conversion performance by using a precomputed reciprocal of the TSC frequency instead of division operations.
In the ice driver, replaced unnecessary huge page memory allocations with normal heap or stack allocations, reducing memory overhead.
In the mlx5 driver, delay the allocation of HWS tag action, creating it per domain only when the FLAG/MARK action is first used, reducing firmware resource usage.
In the mlx5 driver, implemented delayed allocation of the HWS push_vlan action, creating it per domain only on first use, reducing firmware resource usage.
For the CN20k platform, reduced the SA context push size for AES_GCM encryption to 128 bytes, improving CPT performance.
Added multi-doorbell support for the bnxt driver, dispersing doorbell accesses by detecting hardware capabilities and assigning different doorbell page indices, improving performance on P5/P7 chips.

net/iavf replaces rte_malloc/zmalloc with regular malloc or static allocation on the stack in VF mailbox IPsec processing, RSS configuration, MAC address processing, queue management, and IRQ map configuration, and adds several missing correctness checks.
net/ice replaces malloc/free with a local memory buffer for admin queue message.
test/latency relaxes the check for zero latency, allowing zero latency when TSC returns the same value on simulated hardware.
test adds rte_pause() to the seven synchronous spin loops in the atomic and thread tests.

net/intel makes several performance adjustments to tx_scalar.h in the scalar simple Tx path by adopting the same logic flow as the vector path, removing unnecessary done flag clearing, using non-volatile storage instead of the original write method, and computing the EOP bit in the loop to avoid repeated writes to the final descriptor.

The net/tap driver replaces runtime dynamically computed speed capabilities with the compile-time constant TAP_SPEED_CAPA, removes the tap_dev_speed_capa() function and redundant runtime assignments and the unused speed variable.

Adds boundary checks and loop counters to the descriptor chain traversal of the vhost control queue to prevent malicious guests from causing memory corruption or infinite loops. (architecture-related: vhost core module)

Improves mailbox exception handling by introducing a state machine instead of a simple acknowledgment flag, adding message ID and type validation, and handling timeout scenarios and pre-send state checks. (architecture-related: mailbox exception handling)
Prohibits empty BPF programs, fixing the acceptance of programs without instructions and the out-of-bounds buffer read caused by missing EXIT instructions. (architecture-related: BPF core module)

Replaces fixed-size stack buffers in pcapng block construction with dynamic allocation to avoid buffer overflow from overly long strings, and adds input length checks and allocation failure handling. (architecture-related: public API)
Fixes DES/3DES and AES key length validation, checking before copying keys to the SA structure to prevent out-of-bounds writes to adjacent IV/salt fields. (architecture-related: public API)
Fixes an array out-of-bounds access in the inl_outb_soft_exp_poll function in the cnxk driver caused by improper temporary variable declaration.
Fixes sign bit overflow caused by left shift operations in ARM JIT, using a safe macro to avoid undefined behavior.
Fixes signed integer overflow in addition and subtraction operations in the BPF verifier.
Fixes integer overflow caused by u16 type multiplication in the net/nbl driver, explicitly converting to a 64-bit type when calculating buffer sizes.
Fixes a buffer overflow in SA table setup, preventing heap corruption by correcting the SA size initialization value.
Fixes a potential buffer overflow in the hugepage path construction, using dynamic allocation for path strings and adding error handling.
Fixes an out-of-bounds read in the tap driver caused by L4 header truncation, adding boundary checks to skip checksum validation.
In the tap driver, replaces variable-length arrays in the flow item validation function with fixed-size buffers and adds size limit checks.
In the i40e driver, adds null pointer and length matching validation for RAW flow items to prevent segfaults and out-of-bounds access.
Fixes a mbuf buffer overflow in the AF_PACKET receive path caused by unvalidated packet sizes, adding boundary checks and dropping oversized packets.
Fixes a heap buffer overflow in sample group match in the net/mlx5 driver, adding size checks before comparing cached actions to avoid out-of-bounds reads.

Fixes the SM2 public key buffer overflow vulnerability by adding validation of public key coordinate lengths when setting session parameters, preventing stack buffer overflow from overly long coordinates.
vhost adds overflow checks at the snprintf call site for formatting xstat names, warning when an overly long rte_vhost_stat_name is passed.

Multiple test files (test_cryptodev.c, test_table_acl.c, test_eal_flags.c, test_memzone.c, and process.h, among others) fix or avoid various buffer overflow issues by checking snprintf return values, converting arrays to pointer arrays, using standard library calls instead of manual path concatenation, using RTE_MEMZONE_NAMESIZE instead of fixed buffer sizes, and unifying file prefix retrieval functions.
The OOP inline ingress test in test/security, when creating flow rules, first attempts to use a ESP-specific flow rule with SPI, and falls back to the default flow rule if not supported.
test/security returns TEST_SKIPPED directly to skip the inline protocol test when the underlying ethdev hardware does not support secure offload, rather than continuing to a later failure.
examples/ipsec-secgw adds support for the Chinese national cryptographic algorithms SM4-CBC and SM3-HMAC, including recognition of the "sm4-cbc" and "sm3-hmac" keywords in SA configuration parsing.
The deprecation notice adds a statement that VFIO API will soon become an internal interface or be removed. (architecture-related: public API)

The release notes add a deprecation notice for the vDPA driver API; this API will no longer provide the get_vfio_group_fd interface, and it is recommended to use the new unified VFIO container device allocation API. (architecture-related: public API)

The 26.03 release notes add a list of tested Intel platforms with Intel NICs, a list of Intel platforms with NVIDIA NICs, and IBM Power 11 platform test results. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)

ethdev corrects the description of the mbuf fast release Tx offload flag, clarifying that it supports segmented packets, and improves the general description of Rx/Tx offload to reflect that it is used for both device capability reporting and configuration purposes.

The mempool creation documentation removes obsolete optimization suggestions for element count and cache size based on old implementation details, and fixes a copy-paste error in the rte_mempool_calc_obj_size() description.
The ixgbe NIC driver documentation adds support information for Intel Ethernet Controller E610 and adapters based on this controller.

The programmer's guide adds a detailed documentation page for devargs syntax and a device hotplug documentation page, covering two devargs syntaxes and the user-visible side and internal workings, respectively.

DTS adds missing RST documentation for the QinQ test suite and fixes a build failure caused by docstring indentation, and adds a cryptodev throughput test suite to compare dpdk-test-crypto-perf results with user-provided performance metrics.
The i40e NIC guide updates the QinQ strip and VLAN filter documentation, adds a QinQ strip section, removes the obsolete statement about FW >= 8.4, and adds VLAN filter enablement commands.
The QAT guide adds instructions on QAT driver information and device service configuration.
Removes support for the discontinued AMD Solarflare SFN7xxx series NICs from the documentation.

Splits the previously merged pcap and ring driver documentation into two separate files, pcap.rst and ring.rst, unifies naming conventions, removes the obsolete API section, adds multi-queue support instructions, and improves the technical documentation style.
Adds a description of the --query-rate option in the flow-perf tool documentation doc/guides/tools/flow-perf.rst.

In the flow offload programming guide doc/guides/prog_guide/ethdev/flow_offload.rst, corrects syntax, unifies terminology, and clarifies the descriptions of concepts such as transfer flows, indirect actions, and template tables.
In the mlx5 platform documentation doc/guides/platform/mlx5.rst, explains that PMD is responsible for closing its duplicated cmd_fd during device teardown.
Clean up content in the nfb NIC documentation doc/guides/nics/nfb.rst and the features file doc/guides/nics/features/nfb.ini, and update the currently supported NIC list and firmware download links.
In the IDPF driver documentation, state that sharing completion queues among multiple transmit queues in split queue mode is not supported.
In the AMD EPYC platform documentation doc/guides/linux_gsg/amd_platform.rst, update the AMD SoC tuning guide's URL, and add a note about disabling ASPM to reduce latency.
In the nbl NIC documentation doc/guides/nics/nbl.rst, revise the format following the ENA documentation template, and add vfio-pci settings instructions.
Update the version support range for the Intel Multi-buffer library in the cryptodev guide; DPDK 24.11+ versions are adjusted from 1.4-1.5 to 1.4+.
The 25.11 release notes add IBM Power 10 test platform information.
In the ice NIC documentation doc/guides/nics/ice.rst, merge the version tables for E810 and E830, rename the original firmware column to E810 FW, and add a E830 FW column.
In the ice NIC documentation doc/guides/nics/ice.rst, remove non-LTS versions and the 21.11 version that is past its support period, and change the version table entry order to newest first.
In the i40e NIC documentation doc/guides/nics/i40e.rst, remove 21.11 and all non-LTS versions from the version tables for X710 and X722.
In the i40e NIC documentation doc/guides/nics/i40e.rst, merge the version tables for X722 and X710, using two columns: X710 FW and X722 FW.
In the ixgbe NIC documentation doc/guides/nics/ixgbe.rst, add a table of verified driver and firmware version matches.
In the ice NIC documentation doc/guides/nics/ice.rst, update the version match table to the latest verified versions at the 26.03 release.
In the i40e NIC documentation doc/guides/nics/i40e.rst, update the version match table to the latest verified versions at the 26.03 release.
Start a new release cycle, upgrade the version to 26.03-rc0, bump the ABI minor version, and initialize the release notes. (architecture-related: version and compatibility)
Rename the MLX5 debug build flag from RTE_LIBRTE_MLX5_DEBUG to RTE_PMD_MLX5_DEBUG. (architecture-related: public API)
Rename the MLX4 debug build flag from RTE_LIBRTE_MLX4_DEBUG to RTE_PMD_MLX4_DEBUG. (architecture-related: public API)

Remove the global dependency on cryptodev in reassembly configuration, making it required only on cn10k platforms, and add RXC queue configuration for cn20k platforms. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)

Change the global -Wno-comma compile option to be enabled on demand, adding it only in drivers that need it, to address compilers like MSVC that do not support this flag. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)
In the ixgbe driver, remove all conditional compilation macros that depend on the security library, since that library is now an explicit dependency. (architecture-related: build dependency change)
Remove the crypto extension from the Cortex-A78AE configuration to avoid build failures on compilation toolchains lacking AES support. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)
In the ice driver base code build file drivers/net/intel/ice/base/meson.build, disable the MSVC warning about zero-extension of unsigned long to u64.
Enable the variable shadowing warning (-Wshadow) in the global build.
Enable compiler checks for format overflow.
In the common/cnxk build configuration, remove the compile flag that suppresses the VLA warning; now using VLA will trigger the warning.
On Linux, add the --file-prefix argument to all fast-tests, using the test name as a unique prefix, to avoid EAL initialization failures caused by file prefix conflicts during parallel runs.
Disable the variable shadowing (-Wshadow) warning in app/test/meson.build, multiple example applications meson.build, and a large number of drivers meson.build.

In app/test/meson.build, declare the dependency on the net_null driver for test suites that depend on it, so tests are automatically skipped when the driver is missing, and add a warning in developer builds when net_null is missing.
In devtools/test-meson-builds.sh, adjust build types: only ABI checks use debugoptimized, the rest default to release, x86 generic use non-optimized debug, and some static builds use minsize.
In app/test/meson.build, enable format overflow warnings.
In the GitHub Actions CI configuration .github/workflows/build.yml and .ci/linux-build.sh, change the Meson build type for the Fedora GCC build to minsize.
In devtools/checkpatches.sh, add a prohibition check for the use of the perror function.
In devtools, add the dts-check-docstrings.py script to check that the docstring of all DTS test cases includes steps and verify sections; and in check-format.sh, call this script after ruff lint.

Fix the crash in devtools/check-symbol-change.py when processing patches that do not touch lib/drivers (e.g., documentation-only changes), by treating each file header (--- a/ or +++ b/) as the start of a new file, and when the path is not lib/ or drivers/, set lib to None and ignore symbol lines until the next file.

Fix two GCC false positives in the LTO build: declare an upper bound on the number of actions in the L3 decapsulation action in mlx5, and change the forced inline function in soring to a normal inline.
In doc/api/dts/meson.build, pass the -W option to sphinx for the DTS documentation build, so warnings are treated as errors.

Refactor test parameter construction in app/test/suites/meson.build, adding file-prefix as the last step, so trace_autotest_with_traces tests can use different file-prefix to avoid conflicts during parallel execution.
In the bpf_elf_load test in app/test/bpf/meson.build, exclude JMP32 instructions, because the DPDK BPF library only handles basic BPF instructions and does not support JMP32.
Add the four unassigned test cases external-mem, ipsec-sad, power-caps, and secondary timer to the fast-tests test suite.
Update the Control+L shortcut behavior to clear the screen first and then redisplay the prompt, matching standard bash and readline behavior. (architecture-related: external behavior)
Announce the deprecation of support for OpenSSL 1.1.1; future versions will require a minimum OpenSSL 3.0 version. (architecture-related: build dependency)

Update the hardware configuration of the RTL8127 NIC driver, including enabling flow control, updating PHY configuration, MAC MCU patches, and PHY MCU patches. (architecture-related: driver configuration)
Update the PHY configuration and MAC MCU patches of the RTL8126 NIC driver, and remove the deprecated configuration method. (architecture-related: driver configuration)

Update the hardware configuration of multiple models in the RTL8125 series NICs, including MAC MCU patches, PHY configuration, interrupt handling, and ASPM clock request locking. (architecture-related: driver configuration)
For the cn20k platform, update the mask and shift logic for the aura batch free operation in the RX fast path to match hardware register changes. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)

In lib/eal/linux/eal_hugepage_info.c, replace the manual string parsing of /proc/mounts with the standard getmntent(3) routine; when hugepage_dir is explicitly specified, use statfs() to directly verify the mount point instead.
Standardize the SPDX license tag format in all source files, remove redundant parentheses and spaces, unify comment style, and update the check script.
Clean up redundant blank lines and extra asterisks at the end of comment blocks in multiple library header files.
Add parentheses in the ternary expression for the TUN/TAP flag assignment to clarify operator precedence, with no functional change.

In multiple modules including power, pipeline, e1000, eal, i40e, table, net, ethdev, intel common rx, eventdev, bus/pci, bbdev, and pcapng, eliminate -Wshadow compilation warnings by renaming local variables, removing duplicate definitions, or narrowing variable scope.
In the common/dpaax, telemetry, and bus/dpaa modules, replace perror calls with logging functions.
Remove unnecessary __rte_unused attribute markers in the nfb and af_packet drivers.
Delete four source files that were never compiled, tf_core/cfa_tcam_mgr_session.c, tf_em_common.c, tf_em_host.c, and tf_ulp/ulp_utils.c, from the net/bnxt driver.
In pdcp_process.c of the pdcp library, set the physical address for the digest buffer.
In the ice driver, split the nested RTE_MIN macro into two independent RTE_MIN calls to eliminate variable shadowing issues.
Remove unnecessary variable definitions in the cpfl driver to eliminate variable shadowing issues when compiling with -Wshadow.
Remove unused rte_memcpy.h header file includes from multiple example programs.
In the FreeBSD, Linux, and Windows implementations of EAL, issue a warning when a thread name is truncated beyond 16 characters.
In zxdh_np.c of the zxdh driver, adjust the log level for some unmatched flow tables from error to debug.
Remove support for the test chip CFG_METHOD_69 (RLE0949) from the r8169 driver.
In the cpfl and idpf drivers, prevent the Rx path selection logic from being called again after device startup.
In the FDIR structure definition of the i40e driver, unify the spec and mask byte arrays to use the i40e-specific flex length macro definitions.
In meson.build of the cnxk driver, disable template file compilation for the generic target to save build time.
In ulp_mapper.c and ulp_mapper_tfc.c of the bnxt driver, add boundary checks for cword to eliminate the -Wmaybe-uninitialized warning from GCC 16.
Fix the clang compilation warning caused by misuse of the comma operator in the Intel PMD.
In the vhost, vmdq, and vmdq_dcb example programs, replace rte_memcpy with structure assignment to maintain type safety.
Add a cnf20ka platform check for the normal packet reassembly feature, disabling this feature on that platform. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)
Fix the MSVC build error by replacing 1UL with RTE_BIT64 to force the use of a 64-bit value. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)
Add return value documentation for the rte_pcapng_add_interface() and rte_pcapng_write_stats() functions in the pcapng library. (architecture-related: public API documentation)
Fix the issue where the port state was not correctly set to down when link detection failed.
Fix a typo in a comment in the pcapng module.
