Added experimental API smallocx; this API returns a pointer and the actual usable size when allocating memory, and changed the symbol name to a form dependent on the version hash. (architecture-related: public API)

Added a global slow-path mechanism that allows any thread to force other threads into the slow path on their next TSD acquisition; also refactored TSD state access to use atomic operations and wrapper functions. (architecture-related: internal mechanism)
Added the Seq module, implementing a simple seqlock to provide fast read-write concurrency support when write operations are infrequent. (architecture-related: concurrency primitive)
Added MALLOC_CONF parsing to support dynamic slab size configuration, along with corresponding integration tests. (architecture-related: configuration item)
Refactored the emitter API to be clearer as a standalone JSON emitter, and added support for outputting raw values and nested arrays in arrays. (architecture-related: public API)
Added TSD support for multi-threaded fork scenarios, ensuring the tsd_nominal_tsds list is in a reasonable state in child processes. (architecture-related: fork compatibility)
Renamed experimental_huge_threshold to oversize_threshold and allowed setting it to a low value (including 0) to disable the feature. (architecture-related: public API)
Added the lg_ceil function with corresponding unit tests, and re-added the bit_util tests to the Makefile.
Added page customization functionality with corresponding unit tests.
Added reentry protection for hook functions to prevent recursion when hooks are triggered again during execution. (architecture-related: public API)
When abort_conf is enabled, unrecognized experimental options no longer cause an abort, allowing experimental features to be tested normally. (architecture-related: configuration behavior)
Fixed a sampling count memory regression caused by refactoring; added a fast-path check function to ensure correct sampling counts when tdata is empty. (architecture-related: public API)
Fixed the bug in tcache_flush and added detection for invalid tcache id, terminating the program directly upon encountering an invalid id. (architecture-related: public API)

Avoid creating unnecessary background threads for huge arena that perform eager purging by default, while retaining the ability to create background threads when the user explicitly sets a non-zero decay time. (architecture-related: public API)
Avoid duplicate definitions of the tsd_t type, fixing build failures when integrating with FreeBSD libc. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)

Fixed an assertion error in the page cleanup function; when the configured page size is larger than the system page size, the assertion no longer triggers incorrectly and instead checks whether the address is aligned to the system page size.
Fixed a regression in tcache_bin_flush_large where an incorrect arena variable was used, causing incorrect lock operations.
Adjusted the call timing of prof_boot0 to prevent opt_prof_prefix from being overwritten during the boot process.
Fixed an incorrect call to tcache_destroy in the tcaches_flush function, changing it to use tcache_flush_cache for proper cache flushing.
Fixed an error in merging statistics for sharded bin; adjusted the merge logic to avoid double counting when not all items of the same arena have been flushed.
Fixed a compilation warning: in configuration handling, changed the check parameter for opt_lg_extent_max_active_fit from yes to no to avoid performing a minimum value check on it.
In prof_log-related functions, changed internal memory allocation from ialloc to iallocztm to avoid potential lock order inversion issues.

Changed the state access of thread-local storage (TSD) to a function interface and changed the state fields to atomic types, preparing for future remote modification of thread states. (architecture-related: TSD state interface)
Changed the inlining of atomic operations from static inline to forced inlining. (architecture-related: public API inlining method)
Renamed the hooks module to test_hooks; this is a breaking change. (architecture-related: module rename)
Renamed the configuration option huge_threshold to experimental_huge_threshold and marked it as an experimental feature. (architecture-related: configuration option rename)
Removed the experimental smallocx API from the public header files; users must add external declarations themselves to use it. (architecture-related: public API removal)
Moved the link fields in the TSD linked list into the tcache structure to optimize cache utilization.

Optimized the implementations of pow2_ceil_u64 and pow2_ceil_u32 using built-in functions or assembly instructions on supported platforms, and excluded the s390 architecture. (architecture-related: platform compatibility: exclude s390)

Added fast paths for free() and sdallocx(), including a new rtree_szind_slab_read_fast function to quickly read szind and slab information from the L1 cache, and removed frame operations in most calls. (architecture-related: public API: added rtree_szind_slab_read_fast)
Changed critical size classes (largest small class, smallest large class, largest large class) to static constants to avoid accessing extra cache lines in the fast path.

Added a fast path for malloc, assuming the size is within the lookup range and hits tcache, otherwise falling back to the default path; through tail-call optimization, malloc is treated as a leaf function, reducing the overhead of saving caller registers.
Added a check on the return value of malloc_read_fd in pages.c to avoid the security issue of negative values being converted to unsigned types and causing out-of-bounds memory access.

Limited the suppression of the -Wmissing-field-initializer warning to only compiler versions that have the bug for that warning (GCC < 5.1 and all clang versions). (architecture-related: build and platform compatibility)
Changed the type of bytes_until_sample from uint64_t to int64_t to optimize assembly generation on x86 architectures, and adjusted the sampling accumulation logic. (architecture-related: public API)

Fix the declaration of the extent_avail tree. This regression was first released in 5.1.0. (@zoulasc)

Made architecture adjustments to the profiling module: first attempted to split core data management and logging functionality into independent modules, then reverted these splits, restored the original module structure, and adjusted the visibility of related functions and variables. (architecture-related: public API and module responsibilities)

Added the experimental.utilization namespace, providing memory utilization analysis functionality, supporting input of a single pointer or an array of pointers and outputting memory utilization statistics. (architecture-related: public API: experimental.utilization)

Added redzone (redzone) checking for small sample allocations, and support for customizing abort handling via a configurable abort function. (architecture-related: public API: redzone checking and abort configuration)
Exposed the opt_safety_checks configuration item through the mallctl interface, and output this configuration value in statistics. (architecture-related: public API: opt_safety_checks)
Added a nonfull_slabs counter to bin statistics and displayed it in the statistical output. (architecture-related: public API: nonfull_slabs statistics)
Added the confirm_conf option, which, when enabled, prints all configuration strings and the setting process for each option at startup. (architecture-related: public API: confirm_conf)
Added tracking and output of nfills and nflushes for small and large allocation statistics of arena. (architecture-related: public API: nfills/nflushes statistics)

Added an experimental mallctl experimental.arenas.i.pactivep for quickly reading the pactive counter of arena, avoiding the mallctl/epoch step. (architecture-related: public API: experimental.arenas.i.pactivep)

Implemented retain functionality on Windows, by tracking the header extent state of each VirtualAlloc region, limiting merge and split operations to within the same region, to correctly support MEM_DECOMMIT. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)
Added the abandoned_vm counter to track virtual memory space leaked due to metadata allocation failures (OOM), and exposed this metric in statistical output. (architecture-related: public API)

Fixed a memory leak on Windows platforms when retain is disabled due to unsupported split, and adjusted the allocation strategy to only perform exact matches, avoiding split and merge operations. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)

Added the --enable-documentation build option, allowing users to disable documentation building, and the install target will conditionally include documentation installation based on this option. (architecture-related: build and installation methods)

Add the thread.idle mallctl which hints that the calling thread will be idle for a nontrivial period of time. (@davidtgoldblatt)
Allow small size classes to be the maximum size class to cache in the thread-specific cache, through the opt.[lg_]tcache_max option. (@interwq, @jordalgo)
Make the behavior of realloc(ptr, 0) configurable with opt.zero_realloc. (@davidtgoldblatt)
Add 'make uninstall' support. (@sangshuduo, @Lapenkov)
Support C++17 over-aligned allocation. (@marksantaniello)
Add the thread.peak mallctl for approximate per-thread peak memory tracking. (@davidtgoldblatt)
Add interval-based stats output opt.stats_interval. (@interwq)
Add prof.prefix to override filename prefixes for dumps. (@zhxchen17)
Add high resolution timestamp support for profiling. (@tyroguru)
Add the --collapsed flag to jeprof for flamegraph generation. (@igorwwwwwwwwwwwwwwwwwwww)
Add the --debug-syms-by-id option to jeprof for debug symbols discovery. (@DeannaGelbart)
Add the opt.prof_leak_error option to exit with error code when leak is detected using opt.prof_final. (@yunxuo)
Add opt.cache_oblivious as an runtime alternative to config.cache_oblivious. (@interwq)

Fix a profiling biasing issue which could cause incorrect heap usage and object counts. This issue existed in all previous releases with the heap profiling feature. (@davidtgoldblatt)
Fix the order of stats counter updating on large realloc which could cause failed assertions. This regression was first released in 5.0.0. (@azat)
Fix the locking on the arena destroy mallctl, which could cause concurrent arena creations to fail. This functionality was first introduced in 5.0.0. (@interwq)
Remove nothrow from system function declarations on macOS and FreeBSD. (@davidtgoldblatt, @fredemmott, @leres)
Improve overcommit and page alignment settings on NetBSD. (@zoulasc)
Improve CPU affinity support on BSD platforms. (@devnexen)
Improve utrace detection and support. (@devnexen)
Improve QEMU support with MADV_DONTNEED zeroed pages detection. (@azat)
Add memcntl support on Solaris / illumos. (@devnexen)
Improve CPU_SPINWAIT on ARM. (@AWSjswinney)
Improve TSD cleanup on FreeBSD. (@Lapenkov)
Disable percpu_arena if the CPU count cannot be reliably detected. (@azat)

Add mmap VM_MAKE_TAG support. (@devnexen)

Optimize the common cases of the thread cache operations.
Optimize internal data structures, including RB tree and pairing heap.
Optimize the internal locking on extent management.
Extract and refactor the internal page allocator and interface modules.

Added the initial file structure for the ehooks module. (architectural event: added ehooks module)
Extracted the edata_t cache logic into an independent edata_cache module, and added initialization, acquisition, release, and prefork interfaces. (architectural event: edata_cache module extraction)
Added the SEC module (small extent cache), caching small-sized extent to reduce pressure on the centralized allocator. (architectural event: TSD_Test_Suite module removal)
Added the prof_sys module, separating the system thread name reading functionality from the core code. (architectural event: jemalloc_Memory_Allocator module change)
Added the hpa_central module as a centralized component for the large page allocator. (architectural event: jemalloc_Memory_Allocator module change)

Separated the introspection functionality in the extent module into an independent module, and updated related interface and type names. (architecture-related: introspection functionality independently modularized)
Introduced the ecache module, wrapping eset and adding a mutex, migrating arena-related code. (architecture-related: introduced ecache module)
Added the pageslab abstraction and the psset collection for managing pageslab, implementing initialization and statistics functionality. (architecture-related: added pageslab and psset)
Added a multi-producer single-consumer queue module and its unit tests. (architecture-related: added MPSC queue module)
Added the flat_bitmap module, providing extended bitmap operations API. (architecture-related: added the flat_bitmap module)
Removed the mutex_pool module, which involved core modules and public headers, affecting component boundaries and cross-module collaboration. (architectural event: mutex_pool module removal)

Created the eset module, migrating functions such as initialization, state retrieval, statistics, insertion/removal, and fit functions from the extent module to the eset module. (architectural event: creation of the eset module and split of extent responsibilities)

Created the ehooks module, migrating hook functions such as allocation, deallocation, destruction, commit, purge, split, and merge from the extent module to the ehooks module. (architectural event: creation of the ehooks module and split of hook responsibilities)

Introduced a generic thread event initialization function, uniformly initializing tcache GC and prof sample events, and removed old global state and hardcoded calls. (architectural event: unification of thread event initialization)

Refactored the extent module into a hermetic form, removed direct dependency on arena, and split sub-features such as locks, hook calls, and implicit zeroing. (architectural event: extent module hermetic refactoring)

Migrated multiple functions from the extent module (such as rtree writes, boundary registration, slab region management, split/merge, alloc_ctx lookup, etc.) to the emap module, and refactored related interfaces to unify metadata management responsibilities. (architectural event: unification of emap module responsibilities)

Merged the base_ind_get and metadata_thp_enabled inline functions from base_inlines.h into base.h, and deleted the base_inlines.h file, simplifying the header file structure. (architectural event: simplification of base header file merge)

Unified the page allocator interface, making large block expansion use the API of the page allocation module, and added szind and slab parameters to the pa_expand function to unify API. (architectural event: unification of page allocation module interfaces)

Migrated decay (decay) related logic from the arena module to the page allocation module, including the stash_decayed function, decay function, all decay paths, and decay initialization logic. (architectural event: migration of decay logic to the page allocation module)

Migrated statistics-related logic from the arena module to the page allocation module, including nactive counters, edata_avail statistics, mapped statistics, basic statistics merging, full statistics merging, and mutex statistics reading. (architectural event: migration of statistics logic to the page allocation module)

Migrated page allocation related cleanup, destruction, and internal access logic from the arena module to the page allocation module, including pa_shrink/pa_dalloc, remaining cleanup logic, and internal access and destruction logic. (architectural event: migration of cleanup and destruction logic to the page allocation module)

Added the pa_extra.c file, migrating the fork handling logic of the page allocation module from arena.c into it, and refactored related initialization and interfaces. (architectural event: migration of fork handling logic to pa_extra.c)

Migrated the setting logic for retain growth limit from the arena module to the new pa module, and added corresponding API declarations and implementations. (architectural event: migration of retain growth setting logic to the pa module)

Removed awareness of szind and slab from the extent module, transferring related responsibilities to the emap and pa modules, simplifying the extent interface. (architectural event: transfer of extent module responsibilities to emap and pa modules)

Migrated profiling file handling logic from prof.c to the new file prof_sys.c, including refactoring of functions such as bt_init and prof_backtrace_impl. (architectural event: reorganization of profiling module files)

Migrated profiling tool functions, unwind implementation, and unbiased sampling variables to the prof_data and prof_sys modules. (architectural event: migration of profiling tool functions to prof_data and prof_sys)
Separated fast-path and slow-path data for tcache, optimizing the layout of cached bin in TSD. (architectural event: separation of tcache fast/slow path data)
Pushed thread event handling logic to each module, adding a unified event handling function for each event type. (architectural event: pushing thread event handling logic to each module)
Unified the signature of write callback functions and migrated them to the malloc_io module. (architectural event: unification of write callback function signatures and migration to malloc_io)

Split edata list operations into active and inactive linking methods, and adjusted cache and reclamation functions accordingly to utilize free space. (architectural event: split of edata list operations into active/inactive links)

Added per-page dirty state tracking for hpdata, implementing operation interfaces such as hugify, dehugify, and purge. (architectural event: addition of dirty page tracking and operation interfaces for hpdata)
Split the profiling logging functionality into a separate prof_log.c module, exposing a few internal functions to support modularization. (architecture-related: module split)

Refactor the core profiling code into two logical parts: prof_data.c handles internal data structure management and dumping, and prof.c handles mutexes and the external API. (architecture-related: module responsibility separation)

Removed the offset_state field from the arena structure, and instead use stack local variables for PRNG randomization, to avoid relying on arena state when tsd is unavailable. (architecture-related: dependency adjustment)
Removed the dependency of extent split-related functions on arena, and instead use edata_cache and ehooks parameters. (architecture-related: interface change)
Changed the header file name of the extent module from extent2 to extent, and updated related references. (architecture-related: public API change)
Changed jemalloc.c to use the emap interface, added fast lookup and update functions, and unified some function naming. (architecture-related: interface change)
Moved the page size index type and size class index type from jemalloc_internal_types.h to sz.h, and updated related header file references. (architecture-related: public API)

Moved the percpu_arena_update function from arena_inlines_a.h to jemalloc_internal_inlines_b.h, and adjusted the internal implementation to adapt to the new cache bin module. (architecture-related: public API)
Refactored the cache_bin module, restricted internal direct access, and unified and simplified interface parameter passing. (architecture-related: public API)

Moved the initialization code of cache bin from the tcache module into the cache_bin module, and added low-water mark tracking and batch allocation/flush functionality. (architecture-related: module responsibility adjustment)
Explicitly hold dynamically allocated memory pointers in the tcache structure, and simplify the related initialization, creation, and destruction processes. (architecture-related: public API)

Rewrote the cache bin module, integrating empty, full, and low-water mark state tracking into bin itself, simplifying state query logic, and adding a non-fast-path alignment check function; also changed flush operations from reverse order to forward order to speed up the flush path. (architecture-related: module rewrite)
Removed the cache index randomization logic from the extent module, and simplified the extent interface to focus only on page-level allocation. (architecture-related: public API)
Migrated the arena_decay_extent function to the extent module. (architecture-related: public API)

Added an accessor function in the decay module to get the duration of epoch, and changed direct access to decay structure members in background_thread to use this function, to encapsulate internal data access. (architecture-related: module responsibility: encapsulate decay data access)

Migrated page allocation-related caching, statistics, and reclamation logic from arena to the pa_shard module, removing arena's direct knowledge of extent. (architecture-related: module responsibility: page allocation migration to pa_shard)

Migrated the decay time acquisition function of arena to the pa module, and updated related calls to use the new pa_shard interface. (architecture-related: module responsibility: decay time acquisition migration to pa)

Migrated slab allocation-related code to the newly extracted page allocation (pa) module, using edata instead of extent types, and unified allocation and reclamation through the pa_shard interface. (architecture-related: module responsibility: slab allocation migration to pa)
Moved extent statistics to the PA module, and removed atomic operations in favor of direct assignment. (architecture-related: module responsibility: extent statistics migration to PA)

Moved the in_hook field and tsd_link field in tcache into the TSD structure, and updated the access methods of related functions. (architecture-related: module responsibility: tcache fields moved into TSD)

Changed the cache filling functionality of arena from directly depending on tcache to being based on cache_bins, thereby decoupling arena from the internal implementation of tcache. (architecture-related: module responsibility: decouple arena and tcache)
Changed the lock level of witness from a macro definition to an enum type, avoiding manual incrementing of values. (architecture-related: public API: lock level changed to enum)
Centralized the buffer size definitions for prof dump into the prof_types.h header file, and minimized memory usage for non-prof builds. (architecture-related: public API)
Extracted the reserved memory growth logic from the extent module into the geom_grow module, encapsulating it as a reusable function. (architecture-related: module responsibility migration)

Built a generic thread event handling framework, using thread allocation/deallocation byte counts as a generic event accumulator, and refactored the handling logic for events such as sampling, cache GC, and statistics intervals; also abbreviated related functions and macros with the te prefix. (architecture-related: thread event framework)

Refactored the buffer writer into an independent module, added internal buffer allocation and deallocation functions, refactored the callback mechanism, and added pipe writing functionality. (architecture-related: modular refactoring)

Migrated the iealloc function to the emap module, replaced all call sites with emap_lookup or emap_edata_lookup, and removed direct access to the internal structure of emap, using encapsulated interfaces for metadata queries. (architecture-related: module responsibility migration)

Decoupled the cache_bin module from tcache, changed to pass the cache_bin_info structure via pointer, and changed the calculation of ncached_max to be based on a query of cache_bin_info_t. (architecture-related: module decoupling)

Migrate page allocation related fields and logic from arena and pa_shard to the PAC module, including the ecache_grow structure, decay logic, statistics merging, decay rate setting, etc. (architecture-related: module responsibility migration)

Remove direct interaction between the extent structure and arena, migrate page quantization functions to the sz module, migrate default hook implementations to the ehooks module, and migrate profiling test internal interfaces to internal header files, while migrating file handling logic in prof_data to prof_sys. (architecture-related: module responsibility migration)

Remove internal test functions and variables of the profiling module from JEMALLOC_JET conditional compilation, making them always externally visible, and add comments indicating their purpose; also add dedicated test version functions for the prof_recent module. (architecture-related: public API)
Generalize the prof_cnt_all() function interface to accept the prof_cnt_t structure, and update declarations, implementations, and test cases. (architecture-related: public API)
Rename ecache_grow to geom_grow and migrate to a separate file for use in other allocators. (architecture-related: module responsibility adjustment)

Integrate the HPA component into the PAI implementation, add multiple core functions and refactor the pa_shard structure, add global HPA options and test code. (architecture-related: core module integration)
Add the SEC component before HPA shard, and implement related statistics merging and mutex statistics reading. (architecture-related: component addition)

Redesign the HPA implementation, changing large page management from global fallback to localized, directly tracking the state of entire large pages and supporting per-large-page cleaning and reclamation. (architecture-related: core architecture refactoring)

Introduce the hpdata_t structure, separating the explicit representation of huge pages from edata_t, and update HPA and psset related logic to use the new structure. (architecture-related: data structure separation)

Refactor the interaction between HPA and psset, controlling allocation and merging via flags, simplifying concurrency control and maintaining statistical correctness. (architecture-related: HPA and psset interaction)
Extract configuration options of HPA into a new structure hpa_shard_opts_t, and update related interfaces and test code. (architecture-related: HPA configuration extraction)

Extract SEC options into a structure, add multiple configurable options, and add batch allocation/deallocation interfaces as well as initialization, refresh, disable, and statistics merging functions. (architecture-related: SEC option extraction)

Move the sequence number in the edata structure out of the bitfield as an independent field, and adjust related access functions and initialization parameters to support HPA's shard fragmentation avoidance strategy. (architecture-related: edata sequence number adjustment)
Add tracking of extent is_head state in rtree leaf nodes, and refactor related bit encoding and decoding logic. (architecture-related: rtree leaf node extension)

Store edata state information in rtree leaf nodes, and make the edata_t structure 128-byte aligned, while updating related test code to support aligned allocation. (architecture-related: edata alignment and state storage)

Delegate the time for computing deferred work from background threads to the PAI layer, and add corresponding helper functions and HPA implementation. (architecture-related: background thread delegation to PAI)
Rename guard-related naming to san, laying the foundation for subsequent sanitizer work. (architecture-related: public API renaming)

Migrate multiple statistics and functions in arena (such as edata_cache, ecache_grow, decay-related, mapped statistics, extent sequence numbers, etc.) to the newly extracted pa_shard or pa modules, and introduce the decay module, refactoring page allocator responsibilities. (architecture-related: page allocator responsibility refactoring)

Remove the dependency of the profiling module on the thread_event module, moving sampling event determination earlier to the caller, with the caller computing and passing sampling event flags. (architecture-related: module dependency adjustment)
Share arena bin offsets as global variables, reducing cache misses during tcache flush. (architecture-related: core module public interface change)

Enhance the ehooks module: add ehooks_zero zeroing hooks, header tracking functionality, default zero initialization and guard marking, and adjust related function signatures. (architectural event: ehooks module change)
Add initialization function pac_init and helper function pac_decay_data_get for the PAC module. (architectural event: jemalloc_Memory_Allocator module change)
Add a zero parameter to the arena batch allocation function arena_fill_small_fresh, supporting zeroing of memory during allocation. (architectural event: jemalloc_Memory_Allocator module change)
Add an emap batch lookup interface for the tcache flush path, providing a more flexible calling method. (architectural event: emap interface extension)

Add a pluggable buffer writer supporting custom write callbacks, and apply it to prof_log_stop output; also update the malloc_cprintf function signature to adapt to this writer. (architecture-related: public API)

thread_allocated and thread_deallocated statistics counters are now always updated, no longer depending on the config_stats compilation option, and related documentation is updated. (architecture-related: external behavior)

Add Last-N recent allocation recording mode, supporting recording the last N allocations, and saving request size and thread name in record entries, for analyzing allocation lifetime, remote deallocation, and OOM investigation. (architecture-related: public API)

Force sampled allocations to be page-aligned, thereby allowing identification of sampled objects through alignment checks, and enabling fixed-size deallocation. (architecture-related: sampling behavior)

Implemented release events; the event module supports two event types: allocation and release; uses byte-based event triggering tcache garbage collection, and removed the tcache timer. (architecture-related: event mechanism)
Added a mallctl interface for dumping the most recent N profiling records, and added corresponding unit tests. (architecture-related: mallctl interface)

Added an ASSURED_WRITE macro in mallctl that forces callers to provide input, and migrated the tcache.flush and tcache.destroy interfaces to use this macro. (architecture-related: ASSURED_WRITE macro)

Added an edata_cache_small_t type to amortize the synchronization overhead of edata_cache accesses; adjusted the naming and initialization logic of related functions. (architecture-related: edata_cache_small_t type)

Added support for obtaining ehooks in the pa module by adding a base pointer to the pa_shard structure and implementing the corresponding getter function. (architecture-related: ehooks getter interface)
Added a pa_decay_stashed function in the page allocation module, and added several auxiliary interfaces. (architecture-related: pa_decay_stashed function)
Added a separate mapped field for arena statistics, and renamed the original page allocation statistics field to pa_mapped to avoid confusion. (architecture-related: arena statistics field)
Added a thread event lookahead API that supports predicting whether an event will trigger without advancing the event counter. (architecture-related: thread event lookahead API)

In the edata structure, replaced the dumpable bit with the ranged bit to mark whether the range is currently owned by the range allocator, and updated the related accessor functions and initialization logic. (architecture-related: edata structure bitfield)
Added a pipe API for the buffer writer, and added corresponding unit tests. (architecture-related: public API)
Added an option to obtain the system thread name in each profiling sample, and prohibited setting the thread name via mallctl to avoid conflicts. (architecture-related: public API)
Added a malloc_conf_2_conf_harder configuration source that allows users to override parameters set by the configuration system. (architecture-related: configuration override)
Added concat and split functionality to the ql module, and added corresponding unit tests. (architecture-related: public API)
Added rotate, concat_split, and move functionality to the ql module, and added corresponding test cases. (architecture-related: public API)
Added an empty list check function to the ql module, and added corresponding unit tests. (architecture-related: public API)
Added fork handling support to the counter module, including prefork, postfork_parent, and postfork_child functions. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)
Added batch allocation functionality, including batch allocation from new slab, public API batch_alloc, and batch allocation API accessed via the mallctl interface. (architecture-related: public API)

Added multiple tcache runtime configuration options, including slot count multiplier, slot size, GC interval, GC delay, flush ratio, etc., and displayed them in the statistics output. (architecture-related: runtime configuration)
Added fork handling to the stats module, correctly managing the state of the counter module before and after fork. (architecture-related: fork handling)
Added an atomic_load_sub_store macro in the atomic operation interface to implement an atomic load-subtract-store operation. (architecture-related: public API)
Enabled MPSS support on Solaris/Illumos, reusing Linux configuration and adjusting the address range alignment to large pages. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)
Added output space validation before heavy operations in mallctl, implemented by adding a lookup function and adjusting the control interface. (architecture-related: public API)
Added range iteration support for flat bitmap, and added corresponding unit tests. (architecture-related: public API)
Extended the control interface with ctl_mibnametomib and ctl_bymibname functions, supporting control queries by partial name and partial MIB. (architecture-related: public API)
Added a narenas_ratio configuration option that allows dynamically setting the number of arenas per CPU. (architecture-related: configuration item)
The ctl_lookup function now supports starting lookup from any node, no longer forcing a start from the root node. (architecture-related: public API)
The range parameter of PRNG now allows 1, and the related function interface has been simplified. (architecture-related: public API)
The size of each allocation request is now recorded in profiling information. (architecture-related: public API)
Page-aligned memory allocation requests can now use small size classes, avoiding unnecessary promotion to large sizes. (architecture-related: core allocation behavior)
Added statistics functionality for psset, including new purge list management functions. (architecture-related: public API)
hpa_shard added statistics for full slab and non-full slab, and integrated HPA-related data into the statistics output. (architecture-related: public API)
HPA slab size and maximum allocation are now configurable, with the new configuration items hpa_slab_goal and hpa_slab_max_alloc added. (architecture-related: configuration interface)
The HPA central mutex now supports contention statistics. (architecture-related: public API)
HPA adds a size exclusion feature, allowing allocation only within a specific size range. (architecture-related: public API)
A new --with-lg-slab-maxregs configuration option is added, allowing customization of the maximum number of regions in slab. (architecture-related: build and installation methods)
The edata structure adds an age field, provides get and set functions, and adds age-based comparison logic and corresponding heap types. (architecture-related: public API)
A fixed-point math library is added to support non-integer narenas_ratio configurations; now narenas_ratio can accept fractional values. (architecture-related: public API)
The slab_sizes configuration option adds a default option, allowing reset to default values. (architecture-related: public API)
SEC implements thread affinity, where each thread randomly selects a shard on first use and pins it. (architecture-related: public API)
Added support for page clearing using posix_madvise, which is preferred when the system is available. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)
Added experimental thread activity callback functionality, allowing tracking of statistics at a finer granularity than threads. (architecture-related: public API)
Added equivalent support for MADV_DODUMP and MADV_DONTDUMP on FreeBSD, implemented using MADV_CORE and MADV_NOCORE. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)
Each arena can now independently configure oversize_threshold, enabling manual arena to make memory and CPU trade-offs like automatic arena. (architecture-related: public API)

The HPA configuration options have been refactored, removing old options that no longer take effect, adding a new SEC option, and improving initialization logic and error handling. (architecture-related: HPA configuration)
HPA adds a hugepage eviction counter, exposed via the CTL interface and statistics output. (architecture-related: public API)
bit_util adds a generic popcount implementation, along with corresponding unit tests. (architecture-related: public API)
flat bitmap adds bitwise AND, OR, NOT operations and corresponding tests. (architecture-related: public API)

HPA's cleaning mechanism has been generalized from cleaning only completely empty hugepage to cleaning partially empty hugepage, and related metadata management has been refactored. (architecture-related: HPA cleaning mechanism)

HPA adds finer-grained cleaning statistics, including cleaning rounds, cleaning counts, hugification and dehugification counts, exposed via the console interface and statistics output. (architecture-related: public API)
HPA adds dirty page statistics, and displays dirty and retained page information in statistics output. (architecture-related: public API)
The return type of hpdata_purge_begin has been changed from void to size_t, now returning the number of pages to be purged. (architecture-related: public API)
HPA now uses a whole shard cleaning heuristic, no longer relying solely on local information to decide whether to clean. (architecture-related: HPA cleaning strategy)
Added fxp_mul_frac function to safely multiply size_t by a fraction without overflow, and added the FXP_INIT_PERCENT macro. (architecture-related: public API)

HPA's hugification trigger threshold, dehugification threshold, and dirty page ratio threshold are now configurable via runtime options or configuration files. (architecture-related: configuration interface)

Added optional internal fragmentation tracking, recording request sizes and counts of sampled allocations by size class, and providing tuple data via mallctl or statistics output. (architecture-related: public API)

Global mutex performance analysis adds statistics support for mutexes related to recent allocations and recent dumps, and adds statistics collection and reset support for prof_stats mutexes. (architecture-related: public API)

Added batch allocation and batch deallocation interfaces at the PAI layer, and implemented batch operations in HPA and SEC, reducing mutex contention and improving performance. (architecture-related: public API)

Implemented guard pages functionality, adding guard pages protected by mprotect for extent, and added allocation functions with guard pages, supporting bump allocation and caching of small-sized guarded extents. (architecture-related: guard pages functionality)

Added deferred handling for HPA, allowing some deallocation operations to run later in a background thread, and introduced a hugification delay mechanism to avoid applying hugify to short-lived huge pages. (architecture-related: HPA deferred processing)
Added ticker_geom_t type, allowing a single ticker object to share state across multiple tick streams to drive events. (architecture-related: ticker_geom_t type)
Added witness_assert_positive_depth_to_rank function, and refactored witness_assert_depth_to_rank, extracting helper function witness_depth_to_rank. (architecture-related: public API)
Added summarize/filter functionality for red-black trees, supporting tracking extra information in nodes to filter searches. (architecture-related: public API)
Added rtree_write_range function, supporting batch writes to leaf nodes, optimizing emap_register_interior and emap_deregister_interior performance. (architecture-related: public API)
Introduced a redesigned hpa_central_t framework, adjusting HPA configuration initialization logic, including dependency checks and HPA support checks. (architecture-related: public API)
Supports any number of shards, caches shard size information, and adds deferred work generation parameters for expansion and contraction functions. (architecture-related: public API)
Added min_purge_interval_ms configuration option for HPA, limiting the minimum purge interval. (architecture-related: public API)
Added custom backtrace hook and dump hook support, allowing users to inject callbacks to enhance stack backtraces. (architecture-related: public API)
Introduced a bump allocator for protected allocations, used to allocate guard extents that serve as small object guard slabs. (architecture-related: core allocator)

Added the ability for the PAI allocator to notify background threads of deferred work, and added a frequent_reuse parameter to hint whether allocations will be frequently reused. (architecture-related: public API)
Added a sized-delete size check feature that checks the parameters of each sized delete while maintaining the fast path. (architecture-related: allocator behavior)
Added proactive double free and sized dealloc detection for large-size memory deallocation. (architecture-related: allocator behavior)
Added a family of fls functions in the bit_util module and simplified the implementation of bit manipulation functions such as ffs and popcount based on them.
Added zero-padded formatting support for unsigned numbers and updated related test cases.
flat bitmap added a longest contiguous range calculation feature and added corresponding tests.
cache_bin added a batch allocation function cache_bin_alloc_batch and added corresponding unit tests.
Added insert and remove functions for psset and added corresponding unit tests.
Added a sampling interval field to the prof last-N dump output.

Added metric reporting for empty slab in HPA statistics, including page counts, active page counts, and dirty page counts for huge and nonhuge, and registered corresponding statistic nodes in the CTL interface.

Optimized stats printing, replacing string name lookups in mutex statistic reads and arena extent printing with a fast path based on mib, and added HPA shard eviction counts and prof statistic output.

Use metadata tracked in rtree leaves to protect edata, replacing the address-based mutex pool, and verify state and arena ownership before accessing neighboring edata. (architectural event: jemalloc_Memory_Allocator module change)
Fixed a crash in prof_realloc caused by incorrectly passing a pointer, and refactored the profiling data structure to safely pass post-free information. (architecture-related: public API)

Fixed the bug of the prof_active switch: when an application sequentially disables, allocates, and then re-enables prof_active, sampling becomes permanently ineffective. Now the sampling counter is correctly reset, and prof_active_get_unlocked() is used to obtain the state. (architecture-related: public API)
Fixed the stack alignment issue for tcache bin, setting correct alignment for different sizes and pointer widths. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)
Fixed the index type of the cache_bin_alloc_easy function, changing it from a signed type to an unsigned type. (architecture-related: public API)

In reentrant malloc calls, suppress the initialization of tdata and the update of performance sampling thresholds, to comply with the principle of lazy tdata creation and speed up control recovery. (architecture-related: public API)
Fixed amd64 MSVC compilation warnings by adding explicit type casts and adjusting function signatures to eliminate potential data loss warnings. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)
Added debug zero-value and address checks for the ehooks module to ensure returned memory is correctly zeroed. (architecture-related: public API)
Changed the nstime_t parameter of profiling-related functions from pass-by-value to pass-by-pointer; this is a breaking change. (architecture-related: public API)
Allow normal calls to dallocx and sdallocx functions after thread-specific data (TSD) destruction. (architecture-related: public API)

Refactored the assertion logic in the malloc fast path, splitting the size index lookup function into implementation and assertion parts, ensuring correct execution even before malloc initialization. (architecture-related: public API)
Added a size match safety check on the sdallocx slow path/sampling path, outputting more detailed error information when a size mismatch is detected. (architecture-related: public API)

Introduced the lockedint module to unify the locked access pattern for statistic counters and fixed several bugs caused by inconsistent access semantics leading to missed updates. (architecture-related: new module lockedint)

Rewrote the profiling thread event handling logic, fixed the sampling threshold reset issue in prof_alloc_rollback(), and adjusted the event rollback order in xallocx(). (architecture-related: public API behavior change)
Added atomic fence handling for edata pointers in prof_recent records to ensure concurrency safety. (architecture-related: public API concurrency safety)
Changed the initialization of prof idump counters from per-arena creation to once at prof startup, and added fork handling. (architecture-related: prof initialization behavior)

Moved the initial wait macro definitions related to thread events from the tsd header to the thread_event header, and uniformly set the initial wait value for each event to 0. (architecture-related: thread event initialization)
Allow setting the narenas configuration option to default to restore its default value. (architecture-related: narenas configuration behavior)
When a manual arena is requested, no longer fall back to automatic arena; instead, directly return failure. (architecture-related: arena allocation strategy)
In mallctl, when the output buffer space is insufficient, update the output length pointer to reflect the actual copied data length. (architecture-related: public API behavior)
Corrected the storage of usize in profiling last-N records, directly recording the actual size, and added related unit tests. (architecture-related: public API: profiling data structure)

Fixed the behavior consistency of ctl_nametomib in the reverse case, ensuring that it does not fail when the mib array length is greater than the name. (architecture-related: public API: ctl_nametomib behavior consistency)

Changed the thread name reading function to detect the presence of pthread_getname_np and pthread_get_name_np separately, for compatibility with musl libc. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)
In fixed-size deallocation error detection, report the correct and incorrect memory size information. (architecture-related: public API)
Fixed the return type error in the extent_can_acquire_neighbor function, changing the incorrect NULL to the correct false. (architecture-related: public API)

Fixed the non-monotonic clock handling anomaly in HPA caused by uninitialized nstime, added a first-read flag for hpa_hooks_curtime and initialized the timestamp on first read, added a millisecond interval calculation function, and added a consistency check to prevent uninitialized calls. (architecture-related: public API)

Added initialization state tracking for nstime_t in debug builds to prevent silent failures that are hard to debug due to uninitialized input, and fixed the issue with the use of last_purge time in HPA. (architecture-related: public API)

Fixed the issue where malloc_conf configuration strings ending with a key, ending with a comma, or malformed did not trigger an abort under abort_conf:true. (architecture-related: configuration behavior)
Fixed the issue where failing to clear prof_accumbytes when flushing tcache caused allocations to be counted repeatedly, leading to excessive performance dumps.
Fixed the handling of the tcaches mutex before and after fork; lock and unlock operations are now performed unconditionally.
Fixed the error when accessing large bin indices through cached bin descriptors, ensuring that indices for large bin start counting from 0.
Fixed the incorrect large.nflushes value in merged statistics, ensuring this field correctly accumulates the corresponding values from all arenas.
Changed the cached bin size type from signed 32-bit integer to unsigned 16-bit integer, removed the no-longer-needed negative value check assertion, and added an overflow protection assertion.
Fixed the reentrancy level issue in prof_backtrace(), renamed the underlying backtrace implementation to prof_backtrace_impl, and added reentrancy protection.

Added protection handling in extent_util_stats_verbose_get for when slabcur is NULL; when bin is completely full, obtain slab from a non-full extents heap, and updated related comments and test assertions.
During the muzzy decay process, return early when there are no pages pending purge or when decay time is set to a non-positive value, avoiding mutex acquisition.
Relaxed the condition for arena_may_have_muzzy, removed the dependency on pages_can_purge_lazy, and now judge solely based on muzzy decay interval.
Fixed the issue where transparent huge pages were still used by base_new after setting thp:never, and added transparent huge page state setting in base_map.
Correctly handle the log mutex during the fork process, ensuring it is properly initialized in the child process.
Fixed a logic error in a conditional check in the arena_prof_info_get() function.
Fixed an assertion error regarding the extent head state when using dss.
Fall back to unbuffered printing on memory allocation failure, and added stronger assertions in buffered write initialization.
Added a check for whether the thread state is normal when creating prof_tctx, to avoid creating tracking data for threads about to die.
Set the reentrancy level for the tsd_state_purgatory state to 1, and added assertions in the tsd_nominal function to ensure consistency.
Fixed a race condition during tdata deletion, adjusting the lock holding order and destruction logic to avoid lock overlap.
Fixed undefined behavior caused by a left shift operation in hash.h.
Fixed a potential issue when the variable-length array length is 0, ensuring the array length is always greater than 0.
Fixed the issue where random number generation in geometric sampling could produce zero, causing log(0); handled the boundary case as u=1.0 to ensure correct calculation.
Unified the read and selection logic for the tcache and arena flags, simplified the allocation and deallocation paths, and fixed related issues in statistics printing and fork post-processing.
Fixed the issue where large object sizes were incorrectly reduced in the tcache_bytes statistics report, and added corresponding test cases.
Adjusted the assignment order of the prof_tctx_t pointer in the large_prof_info_set function to correctly implement the atomic memory barrier.
Fixed a macro naming error in the prof-related header file.
Treat deferred prof sampling events as new events to avoid sampling bias.
Removed duplicate entries in the witness error message.
Fixed the issue of incorrect control flow order when reading the prof timestamp configuration.

Corrected the initialization order of prof_log_start, moving mutex initialization earlier, delaying hash table creation, and fixing timestamp initialization and startup condition checks. Also delayed atexit registration until the first call to prof_log_start.
Fixed a tuning parameter error introduced by configuration, restoring the nslots_max target value of tcache to the original double.
Fixed the issue of incorrect size calculation during reallocation when alignment is specified.
Fixed the issue of using the wrong size in szind calculation during performance analysis.
Fixed the position of the alloc_ctx check in free_fastpath, moving it after the threshold branch that ensures TSD functionality is normal.
Fixed a race condition during tcaches creation caused by the lock not being held continuously.
Moved the increment operation of n_search out of assert to avoid side effects in non-debug builds where assert is removed.
Fixed an assertion failure caused by a null pointer check of rtree in a specific boundary case.
Separated local and remote access of cache_bin, fixing incorrect assertions in debug mode due to concurrent access.
Fixed the time initialization function call during duration calculation in prof log.
Fixed the name and write type of the tcache_max option in statistics output.
Mark the head state during dss allocation to ensure subsequent merge operations use the correct head state.
Fixed a lock issue in arena_i_destroy_ctl, ensuring ctl_mtx is held during operations to prevent concurrency with arenas.create.
Fixed the issue where setting a thread name was not allowed when prof_sys_thread_name was enabled, and updated unit tests to skip relevant scenarios.
Fixed the issue of printing an error when hpa_dirty_mult is -1, caused by a missing level of indirection.

Fix two spelling errors in HPA that severely impact performance: configuration parsing incorrectly set the minimum value of hpa_sec_batch_fill_extra to PAGE, causing each allocation to additionally allocate a large number of pages; meanwhile, HPA used the default batch allocation implementation and did not obtain the lock optimization.
Fix the type error in the pai_dalloc_batch function where the void function incorrectly used the return statement.
Correct the calculation method of retained pages in HPA so that it correctly equals the total number of hugepage pages minus the number of touched pages.
Fix the issue where the default allocation hook could not be used when arena was created because it assumed arena had already been initialized, and add corresponding test cases.
When arena is destroyed, perform an unprotect operation on the protected slab to prevent leaking guard pages.
Fix the issue where last_event was not correctly set during thread event initialization, ensuring that event counter state remains consistent after reinitialization.

Fix the initialization order issue in prof_leak, ensure that prof_leak is automatically set when prof_leak_error is enabled, add configuration consistency checks, and move dependency checks to a separate function.
Migrate the edata merge-related functions from emap.h to extent.h, and update the call sites. (architectural event: header file responsibility migration)
Separate the calculation of the cleanup interval from the background thread logic and migrate it to a more appropriate file. (architectural event: internal responsibility migration)

Extract the comparison fields of edata into a summary structure, add corresponding getter and comparison functions, and clean up the old comparison functions. (architectural event: data structure refactoring)
Change the prof_backtrace function to accept a tsd parameter, with the caller passing in thread-local data, to support correct reentrancy protection. (architecture-related: public API)
Change the parameter type in the profiling code path from tsdn_t to tsd_t, and refactor the related function interfaces. (architecture-related: public API)

Add conditional compilation guards for C++ aligned allocation and deallocation API, enabling them only when the C++17 aligned new feature is supported, refactor the C++ API order, and add the alignedSizedDeleteImpl inline function to eliminate compilation warnings. (architecture-related: public API)
Remove the no-longer-needed usize parameter from profiling-related functions, simplifying the interface. (architecture-related: public API)
Rename the prof_tctx field in the prof_info_t structure to alloc_tctx, and synchronously update all related references. (architecture-related: public API)

Refactor profiling-related functions, delete prof_sample_check, simplify the interfaces of prof_sample_accum_update and prof_sample_should_skip, and remove the alloc_ctx parameter from prof_alloc_time_get/set. (architecture-related: public API)
Rename the core type extent_t to edata_t to resolve naming conflicts. (architecture-related: core type rename)
Refactor the prof_tctx destruction path, centralize the destruction judgment and execution logic into prof_data.c, and add the prof_tctx_try_destroy function. (architecture-related: public API)

Add a base_t pointer member to the edata_cache structure, pass the base parameter during initialization, and remove the base parameter from the edata_cache_get function. (architecture-related: public API)
Move the associated index field from the base structure into the ehooks structure, and add an interface for obtaining the index. (architecture-related: public API)
Remove the arena_ind parameter from ehooks-related functions, and instead obtain it internally through ehooks_t. (architecture-related: public API)
Remove the dependency of the extent merge function on arena, and instead pass edata_cache as a parameter, to decouple the extent module from arena. (architecture-related: module decoupling)
Refactor the profiling information setting functions, explicitly defining three setters: prof_tctx_reset, prof_tctx_reset_sampled, and prof_info_set. (architecture-related: public API)

Refactor performance analysis-related header files, move internal function implementations to source files, adjust variable references, and reduce external exposure. (architecture-related: public API)
Remove the commit parameter from the ecache allocation function; all callers directly use committed memory. (architecture-related: public API)

Unify the internal synchronization mechanism of counter_accum_t to the LOCKEDINT macro, add a fork handler function, and make the counter module more general. (architecture-related: counter module generalization)
Rename the buffer writer-related types and function names from buf_write_arg_t to buf_writer_t, and uniformly update all call sites. (architecture-related: public API)

Standardize the naming of the emap module: uniformly use the emap_ prefix, clarify lookup targets, change the alloc_ctx parameter type to emap_alloc_ctx_t, and the global variable arena_emap_global. (architecture-related: public API)
Add a boolean parameter zeroed to the emap_init function, pass it to the internal rtree_new call, and update the call sites accordingly. (architecture-related: public API)

The node allocation and deallocation functions of rtree now accept a base allocator parameter, eliminating the dependency on the global base and simplifying testing. (architecture-related: internal interface: eliminate global dependency)

Remove the prof_lookup_global function, replace the b0get call in prof_boot2 with the passed-in base parameter, and rename prof_dump_seq_mtx to prof_dump_filename_mtx. (architecture-related: public API: remove function)
The background_thread_boot1 function now accepts a base_t *base parameter and no longer internally calls b0get() to obtain base. (architecture-related: public API: function signature change)

Remove the memory filling (junking) logic from the allocation and deallocation paths of tcache and arena, and handle it at a higher level instead, to simplify internal logic and keep the fast path unaffected. (architecture-related: external behavior: memory filling logic move)

Simplify the interface of the cache_bin module, changing functions that required an index and info array to accept only a single info pointer, with the caller directly passing the corresponding info. (architecture-related: public API: interface simplification)

Modify the signature of the extent_dalloc_gap function to directly receive the ehooks parameter, no longer obtaining it internally from arena. (architecture-related: public API: function signature change)
Added a current time parameter to the initialization and reinitialization functions of the decay module to improve testability. (architecture-related: public API: added parameter)
Changed the parameters of the pa_expand function from new_usize to old_size and new_size to simplify the statistics logic. (architecture-related: public API)

Moved the attribute modification operations of edata (szind, size, szind, sn, zeroed, and state initialization) from the emap module back to the extent module, adjusting the module responsibility boundaries. (architecture-related: module responsibility adjustment)
Made the file open and write operations of the prof module replaceable to support simulating file operation failure scenarios in tests. (architecture-related: public API)

Changed the parameter of the fit function in the eset module from a boolean value to the logarithm of the maximum fit ratio, enhancing module independence and testability. (architecture-related: public API)
Parameterized the access to global variables in the eset module, adding a new exact_only parameter to decouple module dependencies. (architecture-related: public API)

Removed the redundant edata_cache parameter from multiple extent operation functions, instead accessing its internal edata_cache directly through the already passed pa_shard_t, simplifying the interface. (architecture-related: public API)
Simplified the emap split interface, removing the szind and slab parameters because they have become constants. (architecture-related: public API)

Removed the field-based access interfaces in rtree, switched to using the unified edata and metadata structures for reading and writing, and added functions such as rtree_contents_encode, rtree_leaf_elm_lookup_fast, and emap_deregister_boundary to support the new access patterns. (architecture-related: public API)
Moved the thread event wait time update function from the public header file to the source file, making it an internal implementation. (architecture-related: public API)
Changed the parameter type of the thread name assignment function from tsdn to tsd and updated the relevant call sites. (architecture-related: public API)

Refactored thread event handling, extracting wait time calculation and deferred wait time into independent functions defined by each module to remove inter-module dependencies. (architecture-related: cross-module interface refactoring)
Refactored the prof data dump interface, changing the global write callback to be explicitly passed via parameters, and simplified the related function signatures. (architecture-related: public API)

Require callers to manually zero the stack-based edata_t before use to avoid undefined behavior; also modified the parameters of edata_init and removed the edata_hugeified_set function. (architecture-related: public API)
Changed the index of the ffs family of functions to start from 0, and correspondingly adjusted the bitmap operations and the call logic in pages_map. (architecture-related: public API)
Removed the unused tsdn parameter from the geom_grow_init function, simplifying the interface. (architecture-related: public API)

Removed the atomic functionality of PRNG; all random number generation functions no longer support multi-thread safety, the state parameter was changed from an atomic type to a plain pointer, and API and tests were simplified. (architecture-related: public API)

Removed the duplicate reentrancy check in profiling, which is now handled uniformly by the thread event module; also added a size parameter to the prof_info_set function to pass the allocation size. (architecture-related: public API)

Changed the slab allocation strategy of psset from address-based first-fit to first-fit based on slab age, prioritizing longer-lived slab, while refactoring statistics maintenance and heap operations. (architecture-related: public API)
Renamed the geom_grow-related functions and types to exp_grow. (architecture-related: public API)
Changed the allocation and deallocation interfaces of hpdata to use address and byte size, simplifying usage for callers. (architecture-related: public API)

Changed the extent_alloc_wrapper function to an internal static function and set the is_head flag on the extent it allocates when retain mode is enabled, for consistency. (architecture-related: public API)

Moved the deferred operations of HPA to background threads and set the deferred allowance state of PA shard when enabling/disabling background threads. (architecture-related: cross-module responsibility migration)

Removed the no-longer-used opt_background_thread_hpa_interval_max_ms configuration option and related functions, and migrated the time calculation logic for deferred work from background threads to the PAI layer. (architecture-related: public API: configuration option removal)

In the fixed-size deallocation fast path, marked slab as true and added compile-time and runtime assertions to ensure that all findable sizes are small objects. (architecture-related: allocator behavior)

Refactored the CPU count determinism check logic, extracting it into an independent function called only when necessary; also extended support for FreeBSD and DragonFly systems, and optimized handling of non-deterministic cases, allowing cases with narenas set to not produce warnings. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)
Renamed the function san_enabled() to san_guard_enabled(). (architecture-related: public API)
Added the PAGE_FLOOR macro, replacing bit operations in sec.c to correctly compute the page-aligned floor of the maximum allocation size. (architecture-related: internal interface)
Renamed the zero_realloc option name from strict to alloc to more accurately describe its behavior. (architecture-related: public API)
Added an assertion in prof_active_get_unlocked to ensure that prof_active is always false when opt_prof is disabled.
Refactored the profiling sampling initialization logic so that the sampling random number generator uses thread-local storage for random number state, and thread data is now created on demand.
Unified the interface of extent_alloc_wrapper with other allocation functions, extracting the reserved region allocation path into an independent extents_alloc_grow function.

Refactored the bin locking logic during tcache fill and flush, moving slab allocation and deallocation operations to the same function level as the bin lock to reduce lock hold time and prepare for flat combining.
Encapsulated the handling of buffer allocation failures, simplified the initialization logic of the buffer writer, and unified the use of internal callback functions.
Removed the reset_interval parameter from prof_tdata_init_impl, no longer resetting the sampling wait time when reinitializing thread data.
Changed the maximum lookup constant from a magic number to a named constant, improving code readability and maintainability.
Cleaned up the tcache allocation logic, removing profiling and fill-related handling, simplifying the allocation flow for cached bin.
In HPA, switched to using psset's fit/insert/remove operations, removed the alloc_new and alloc_reuse functions, and added functions to update purge and hugify eligibility.
HPA statistics no longer track inactive pages; only human-readable statistics retain the relevant output, while other parts are calculated from large page size and active page count.
Added the emap_assert_not_mapped assertion to check that the specified edata has not yet been mapped into emap, and enhanced emap_do_assert_mapped's validation of metadata state.

Rewrote edata_cache_small as edata_cache_fast, changing it from a cache that guarantees no failure to a mechanism used only to reduce contention, simplifying the internal logic and updating related tests.

Refactored the insert/remove semantics of psset, changing the remove operation to an update operation; the page is unavailable for new allocations during the update; the allocation function now has an additional output parameter indicating whether deferred work is generated.
In psset, empty slabs are prioritized for cleanup, and aggregated statistics were added to assist cleanup decisions, along with corresponding unit tests.
Added a check for the prof_active state in batch_alloc().

When the last thread migrates away from an arena, all cleanup operations are immediately performed on that arena; also adjusted the arena_migrate function to directly receive an arena_t pointer instead of an index.
Added comments and more meaningful variable names for sz_psz2ind, changed reg_size_compute to a non-static function, removed the global variable sc_data_global, and added unit tests.

Added the assert_* macros and the p_test_failed function in the test framework to support immediate test abort on assertion failure, and applied them to some test files. (architecture-related: public API)

Refactored the cache_bin unit tests to test only through the public API, no longer relying on internal implementation details, and fixed related parameter errors and memory release issues. (architecture-related: public API)
Replaced the dump file opening function in tests with a new interception function, and adjusted the relevant test assertions accordingly. (architecture-related: public API)

Made the last-N performance profiling data export non-blocking by processing in batches and releasing the lock between batches, allowing sampled allocations to continue, and added a separate mutex for protection. (architectural event: jemalloc_Memory_Allocator module change)

Introduced edata_cache_small_t in HPA, replacing the original global edata_cache to reduce lock contention, and added the hpa_shard_disable function to disable this cache. (architectural event: HPA module change)

Optimized memory locality in the tcache flush path by refactoring the batch lookup interface and adding helper functions, improving parallelism on cache misses. (architectural event: emap interface refactor)

Added data prefetching in the tcache flush path, preloading edata content to reduce cache miss latency, and executed it on the path without holding the lock to reduce lock hold time. (architectural event: new prefetch function)
Switched the bitmap implementation of eset and psset from bitmap to flat bitmap, simplifying the code and improving performance. (architectural event: jemalloc_Memory_Allocator module change)

Cached summary information in the heap edata, optimized first-fit lookup to reduce cache misses, and adjusted related function interfaces and types. (architectural event: jemalloc_Memory_Allocator module change)

Allowed the fast path to adjust the low-water mark after flush, placing more allocations on an almost equally fast path, reducing malloc cycles by about 4%. (architecture-related: allocation path behavior)
Optimized the qr_meld macro, removed the a_type parameter and adjusted the internal pointer operation order, and updated related test cases. (architecture-related: public API)
Inlined the malloc fast path into operator new to reduce CPU overhead for C++ programs. (architecture-related: public API)
Added a buffered write mechanism for the malloc_stats_print function, reducing expensive malloc_write_fd calls and improving performance.

Refactored the metadata of tcache bin from a counter-based design to a pointer-based design, using pointer comparison to determine full/empty status, avoiding access to tcache_bin_info, improving fast path performance by about 15%.
Pre-stored the result of multiplying ncached_max by pointer size in tcache_bin_info, and added a helper function to get the ncached_max value, optimizing direct access performance.
Explicitly tracked cache refill state, optimized fast path allocation checks, avoiding the slow path when allocating the last item.
Moved the handling when prof_active is disabled entirely to the slow path, reducing register pressure on the malloc fast path.
Optimized the cache allocation function in the malloc fast path by reducing access to tcache_bin_info to save registers, and added a simplified version of the allocation function.
Merged the tsd state check into the event threshold check, optimizing fast path performance; when tsd becomes abnormal, reset the fast threshold to 0.
Introduced nstime initialization utility functions, replacing the original manual initialization and update patterns, and optimized the mutex spin logic.
Replaced the mutex-protected counting operation in edata_cache from atomic fetch-add to the lighter load-store, improving performance.
Optimized the large memory allocation function by passing zero-value parameters directly as booleans, and removed the no-longer-needed debug performance optimization.
Moved rtree_ctx from the TSD fast path to the end of the slow path, improving performance when using the fixed-size deallocation feature.
Migrated file write operations in the profiling data dump to use a buffered writer, and introduced a callback function to handle mapped file reads.
Moved the zero-initialization decision for opt.zero earlier into the core allocation path, avoiding repeated zeroing via memset after allocation, and simplified the related code logic.
Shortened the wait time for peak event detection, changing the default update interval from 100K bytes to 64K bytes.

Added a hard limit (8MB) for the maximum size class in tcache, and adjusted the cache bin array size and initialization logic accordingly, reducing thread-local storage usage and simplifying the layout.
Small batch allocation requests now prefer allocation through tcache to improve performance, and adjusted the prefork/postfork lock order and test logic accordingly.
Reduced the hold time of the SEC shard lock by flushing only part of the extent during flush and releasing the lock.

By forcing inlining of division constants and operation counts, kept common path state in registers, eliminating redundant operations in the arena-level dalloc function; also refactored the dalloc bin locking path, introducing stepwise functions and data structures to optimize register usage.
Cached its index in arena to reduce pointer indirection on performance-sensitive paths.
Changed the timer for arena tcache decay from ticker_t to ticker_geom_t, and removed the related per-arena state management to optimize memory locality.
HPA supports purge across reserved extent to reduce the number of expensive system calls.
Replaced macros in the pairing heap with inline functions, and introduced a helper list counting mechanism to optimize performance.
Changed the finite cache of edata_cache_small to an unbounded cache, removed the fill/flush heuristics, simplifying cache management and improving performance.
Added helper list counting and pre-merge optimization for the pairing heap insert operation, and directly replaced when the root node is better to delay helper list operations.
Optimized debug checks via conditional compilation, removing the entire loop in non-debug builds to improve performance.

Optimized the deallocation fast path by folding the tsd_fast() check into the event threshold branch, eliminating two instructions at the start of that path and improving tolerance for uninitialized TSD.
Changed the return value of the rtree fast-path lookup function from a pointer to a boolean, avoiding a NULL check branch that the compiler could not optimize, thereby eliminating an extra branch.
Added documentation comments to the public interface of the emap module and made functions no longer used externally static and hidden. (architectural event: jemalloc_Memory_Allocator module change)
Travis CI added support for the Windows platform and added platform-related build scripts for Linux and Windows. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)
Restricted test hook macro definitions to test builds to resolve Android build issues. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)
Added the --with-lg-page=16 build option to the CI configuration and test generation scripts. (architecture-related: build configuration)
Fixed Android platform builds by introducing a glibc variable to distinguish platforms, avoiding glibc-specific malloc hook detection on Android. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)
Added CPU spin-wait instruction support for the ARM32/64 architecture, detecting the yield instruction in configuration and setting the relevant macros. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)

In non-prof builds, the full size class table is no longer created; only the minimum size is retained to save memory, and compile-time assertions ensure related functions are only executed in prof mode. (architecture-related: core module behavior)
Added autoconf detection support for posix_madvise and POSIX_MADV_DONTNEED. (architecture-related: build and installation methods)
Now, when configuring --enable-prof-libunwind, --enable-prof must also be specified, otherwise an error is reported. (architecture-related: build requirements)
Fixed FreeBSD 14 build issues by detecting and adapting to Linux CPU affinity API compatibility during configuration. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)
Spaces are prohibited in prefix and exec_prefix; otherwise, the configuration process will report an error. (architecture-related: installation configuration)
During cross-compilation, correctly detect background thread support on Darwin platforms by checking the ABI type. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)
When cross-compiling for Apple M1, if the page size is not specified, default to 16K and skip detection. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)

Fixed the -Wundef warning generated when LG_SLAB_MAXREGS is undefined by changing the conditional compilation macro to CONFIG_LG_SLAB_MAXREGS. (architecture-related: conditional compilation macros and platform compatibility)

Added multiple state fields and consistency assertions in the hpdata initialization function, strengthening parameter validation and state checks at the API boundary. (architecture-related: public API hardening)
Changed the default JSON output format to compact format to save 20-50% output size. (architecture-related: public API: compact JSON output)
Adjusted LQ_QUANTUM on mips64 hardware to 4 to comply with ABI stack alignment requirements. (architecture-related: platform compatibility: mips64 ABI alignment)
Publicly defined the constant for the maximum number of cache entries and added validity checks during initialization. (architecture-related: public API: cache entry constant)
Privatized the default value of opt_lg_tcache_max into the implementation file. (architecture-related: configuration interface privatization)
Added labels to memory-mapped pages on macOS so that analysis tools such as vmmap can identify the mapping source. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)
Unified include guard style and renamed flat_bitmap.h to fb.h to match naming conventions. (architecture-related: public API)

Removed the experimental thread activity callback feature; related code has been cleaned up. (architecture-related: public API removal)
