Split TSD implementation details into a new tsd_internals.h file, making each TSD implementation header explicitly include its dependencies, achieving header self-containment. (architectural event: core internal module reorganization)
Extracted the hpa_central component from the hpa source file and migrated it to the new file src/hpa_central.c. (architectural event: core internal module reorganization)

Moved bin-related functions from arena.c to bin.c, uniformly added the bin_ prefix, and changed functions that depended on arena_is_auto checks to accept a is_auto parameter. (architectural event: core internal module reorganization)
Separated configuration parsing and initialization-related code from src/jemalloc.c into an independent src/conf.c file. (architectural event: core internal module reorganization)
Removed the build-time configuration config_limit_usize_gap and simplified conditional checks in related functions. (architecture-related: build configuration)

Transferred ownership of the SEC cache to HPA shard, simplifying the code implementation, adding fine-grained statistics for each bin, and introducing a lock mechanism with bin granularity. (architecture-related: module responsibility change)
Added experimental USDT SystemTap probe support and added multiple trace points in modules such as HPA and sec. (architectural event: USDT probe support)
Implemented the malloc_getcpu function on macOS's amd64 and arm64 architectures, enabling per-CPU region allocation. (architecture-related: public API)

Added experimental prof_sample and prof_sample_free hooks, allowing advanced users to track additional information when sampling objects for allocation and deallocation. (architecture-related: public API)
Added support for overriding compile-time malloc_conf in jemalloc_internal_overrides.h. (architecture-related: compile-time configuration override)
Added support for the deprecated attribute and added a diagnostic macro for suppressing deprecation warnings. (architecture-related: public API)

Added pid namespace support for heap profile file names; when this option is enabled, file names include a namespace identifier to distinguish processes in different namespaces. (architecture-related: public API)
HPA allows frequently reused allocations to bypass the slab_max_alloc limit; added batch allocation functions. (architecture-related: public API)

Added infrastructure for the tcache batching feature, including introducing a bin type with batching capability, initializing batcher, handling fork locks, and adding batch allocation functions to improve multi-threaded performance. (architecture-related: public API)

Extended the public API for page allocator shard statistics, added three getter functions, pa_shard_nactive, pa_shard_ndirty, and pa_shard_nmuzzy, and exposed psset internal state statistics to mallctl and malloc statistics output. (architecture-related: public API)

Enhanced the platform abstraction layer, added reentrant-safe malloc_open and malloc_close helper functions and replaced system calls, and added a frame-pointer-based safe backtrace unwinder to support mixed compilation environments. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)

Optimized time-related functionality, added support for clock_gettime_nsec_np to replace mach_absolute_time, added the nstime_ms_since function, and unified the abbreviation to nstime_ms. (architecture-related: public API)

The HPA huge page allocator added sliding-window-based peak demand tracking, huge page initialization capability, time-based purge delay and intelligent candidate selection, and an experimental option to force hugify. (architecture-related: public API)
Added handling for the opt.cache_oblivious option in configuration parsing.
In the jeprof tool, added filtering of internal functions such as je_malloc_default and do_rallocx to streamline profiling output.
Added separate statistics for edata and rtree memory allocations, and introduced the base_alloc_rtree function for rtree node allocation.
Added the batcher module for batch caching simple operation commands for later use by other threads.

Fixed the macro definition for the PowerPC architecture in quantum.h, extended the detection condition to support more PowerPC variants, ensuring correct compilation on platforms such as Darwin PPC. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)

Fixed build issues for the OpenBSD platform, enabled the pthread name-related API, and disabled per-thread CPU affinity handling not supported on that platform. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)

Fixed a segmentation fault caused by a null node in the red-black tree deletion operation, and adjusted the parameter types of the large memory release safety check function and added a size upper limit check. (architecture-related: public API)
Fixed the issue where arena selection for oversized allocations incorrectly used the global oversize_threshold, changing it to use each arena's own threshold. (architecture-related: public API)

Fixed the issue where the HPA configuration could cause an infinite purge loop, validated the HPA setting at the end of configuration parsing, and normalized or aborted based on the abort_conf option. (architecture-related: configuration behavior)
Removed the erroneous inclusion of an intermediate generated header file in the public header file jemalloc.h. (architecture-related: public API)
Allowed zero-size memalign allocations to pass without triggering an assertion failure. (architecture-related: public API)

Fixed and removed the temporary option experimental_hpa_strict_min_purge_interval, making the minimum purge interval check always effective, and fixed the logic error where the option caused only one page to be purged at a time, changing it to purge multiple pages at once after the minimum interval is met. (architecture-related: public API)

Fixed the issue where oversize_arena could not create background threads when background_thread was enabled, ensuring purge operations do not stall under low arena counts. (architecture-related: public API)

Added a configure check for the existence of the gettid() function, added conditional compilation in prof_stack_range.c, and fixed macro definition errors to ensure compatibility with older glibc versions. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)

Disabled psset tests under excessively large hugepage, and added logic in the HPA support check to return false when the hugepage size exceeds the limit. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)
Fixed the issue where setting max_background_threads via mallctl did not check whether the input was 0; now 0 values are rejected and an error is returned. (architecture-related: external behavior)
Moved the extern "C" declaration to where it is only needed, fixing errors when compiling C++ code with the clang module enabled. (architecture-related: public API)

Fixed the incorrect return value caused by a missing negation operation in the usize_min fallback in the large_ralloc_no_move function, and added corresponding unit tests. (architecture-related: public API)

Fixed the issue where conf_handle_char_p could incorrectly modify the buffer when the target buffer size was zero, and removed the unused conf_handle_unsigned function. (architecture-related: configuration handling behavior)
Fixed errors when compiling edata.h with MSVC 2019, changing the compound literal initialization in the edata_cmp_summary_get function to declare a variable first and then assign it.
Fixed the assertion failure in arena_stats_merge() caused by improper ordering of reads of nmalloc and ndalloc, avoiding the race by swapping the read order.
Fixed a race condition when updating thread names in heap profiling, avoiding a temporary null that could cause the profiling read path to obtain a null value.
Fixed an assignment error in an assertion statement in hpa_from_pai, changing the assignment operator to an equality operator to ensure the assertion correctly checks pointer equality.
Removed an erroneous assertion in arena_extent_alloc_large that could be falsely triggered when HPA was enabled due to deferred work generation.

Fixed the reference to the thread name in prof_recent dump, ensuring the thread name pointer is correctly passed; and added the prof_sys_thread_name feature in the prof_recent unit test to fix test issues in environments without a default thread name.
Fixed the bug where hpa_shard was not correctly destroyed, replacing the incorrectly called hpa_shard_disable with hpa_shard_destroy.
Fixed the uninitialized data read issue in prof_free caused by the arena_prof_info_get safety check path not initializing prof_info->alloc_tctx.

Fixed memory usage statistics for sampled small allocations, now correctly counting allocations of their effective bin size instead of incorrectly attributing them to large size classes; and added test cases to verify that sampled small memory allocations maintain expected page alignment and metadata invariants.
On configuration parsing errors, the error message now includes the configuration string fragment that caused the problem.
Fixed the register error used when reading the CPU ID via the rdtscp instruction, correcting the register from edx to ecx.
Fixed the bug where promoted allocations might not be correctly identified as promoted upon deallocation, adjusting the conditional logic in arena_dalloc_large.
Fixed the bug where nfill could be 0 when ncached_max was 1, ensuring it is set to 1 when nfill is 0, and added corresponding assertions.

Fixed the infinite purge loop in HPA caused by hpa_hugify_blocked_by_ndirty still returning true when there was no dirty memory, and added a regression test; also simplified the deferred work handling logic.

Fixed the sanity check of ncached and nstashed during tcache flush; when there are many stash items, after flush stashed, ncached may already be lower than the remaining value, in which case flush can return directly.
Fixed the issue where the locked flag was not correctly set in malloc_mutex_trylock, and added the lock state check function malloc_mutex_is_locked() and assertion verification.

Fixed the issue where the locked state was not correctly updated when pthread_cond_wait internally released and reacquired the mutex, adding the background_thread_cond_wait function to explicitly maintain this state.
Skip the mutex owner check during background thread startup, because some mutexes are not yet initialized at this point, and the global initialization lock already covers all locking operations.
Fixed the size calculation issue of the error message in the sized-dealloc security check.
Removed the configuration validation for the HPA ratio (the sum of hpa_dirty_mult and hpa_hugification_threshold), and deleted the related error configuration flag logic.
Fixed an out-of-bounds read issue in the bitmap_ffu function caused by not checking array bounds, and adjusted the loop logic to avoid loading data at invalid indices.
Fixed the issue where the deferral_allowed flag was not correctly set during arena 0 initialization, and added test cases to verify the fix.
Fixed the issue with profiling sample metadata lookup in xallocx, and added coverage for the sdallocx path in tests.
Fixed the frame-pointer-based backtracer to handle stack range changes, and fall back to the backtrace function of Linux when changes are detected.

Fixed an assertion error caused by repeated calls to huge_arena_auto_thp_switch when deleting and recreating b0 in unit tests, and ensured that enabling auto-switching before huge arena initialization takes effect correctly.
Added a check in the double-free validation for input sizes exceeding the maximum class size.
Fixed the issue where dehugify was incorrectly executed during purging, and added and updated related test cases.
Save and restore errno when calling process_madvise, to avoid accidentally modifying the errno value due to system call failures.
Reverted the change of 'not dehugifying on purge', restored the dehugify function and its calls, and added related tests and USDT tracing.
Fixed the issue of releasing the lock too early before allocation after inserting a new page from the central, ensuring the mutex is held during allocation.
Corrected the page initialization parameters when extracting from central, changed hugify_eager to start_as_huge, and added related test cases.
Fixed the issue where derived counters were not correctly skipped in the mutex statistics output of the malloc statistics in JSON format, causing array index errors.
Fixed a potential index underflow and assertion failure in psset_pick_purge when rejecting candidate entries with unqualified time, and added corresponding unit tests.

Fixed out-of-bounds check errors in arenas_bin_i_index and arenas_lextent_i_index, changed greater-than to greater-than-or-equal to prevent accessing indices beyond the valid range causing out-of-bounds reads; and added unit tests for boundary indices returning ENOENT.

Fixed the issue in the HPA shard statistics output where the full_slabs and empty_slabs JSON segments had duplicate nactive_huge keys and were missing the ndirty_huge key, and added unit tests to verify both segments contain ndirty_huge.

Fixed the off-by-one error in the boundary checks of stats_arenas_i_bins_j and stats_arenas_i_lextents_j, preventing array out-of-bounds access, and added unit tests verifying that boundary indices return ENOENT.
Fixed the incorrect fallback value when sysconf fails in the os_page_detect function, changed the wrong LG_PAGE to the correct PAGE, to avoid setting the page size to an extremely small value.

Fixed the issue in prof_stack_range where the return value type of malloc_read_fd was incorrect (using size_t instead of ssize_t), causing error checks to fail, and adjusted the error handling logic to correctly distinguish between read failure and end-of-read.
Fixed the issue where using the wrong variable in the array index loop caused array entries to not be correctly initialized.
Fixed the incorrect argument order in the edata_init call in the extent_alloc_dss function, replacing the redundant size argument with the correct slab argument.

Optimized the lock acquisition logic, no longer setting the locked flag on acquisition failure, avoiding unnecessary spinning and improving concurrency performance. (architecture-related: external behavior)
Marked the bins field of arena as deprecated, changed internal code to access via the all_bins field, and suppressed warnings at known legitimate locations. (architecture-related: public API)
Removed unnecessary arguments in the cache_bin_postincrement function call, and adjusted related code formatting. (architecture-related: public API)
Renamed the option hpa_strict_min_purge_interval to experimental_hpa_strict_min_purge_interval to clarify its experimental nature. (architecture-related: public API)

Refactored the HPA purge logic, added vectorized purge functionality for batch processing multiple hugepages, and extracted independent utility functions to support cross-page calls. (architecture-related: public API)
Removed the pidfd_open system call, switched to the PIDFD_SELF constant, and added errno save/restore and process madvise gating checks. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)
Replaced the direct comparison of thread ID with a call to pthread_equal to improve portability and reliability. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)

Refactored the transparent huge page (THP) state initialization logic, extracted a function to determine whether to skip setting the THP state, and output init_system_thp_mode in the malloc statistics. (architecture-related: public API)
Reverted the change of the experimental configuration option 'prefetch from cache_bin fast path'. (architecture-related: configuration interface)
Reverted the peak demand tracking feature, removing related initialization code and functions.
Reverted PR #2608, restoring the jemalloc changes in the Meta branch, including arena initialization, bin information configuration, and tcache default setting adjustments.
Changed malloc_write_fd and malloc_read_fd from static inline functions to non-inline global functions, and added retry loops to handle partial writes and reads.

Introduced the option experimental_hpa_max_purge_nhp to limit the maximum number of hugepages purged per purge operation, providing backward-compatible behavior control. (architecture-related: public API)

Support HPA vectorized purging, using process_madvise to reduce system calls, and support vectorized purging across multiple hugepages, introducing a batching mechanism to limit the number of ranges per system call. (architecture-related: public API)
Use local variables to set alignment for specific memory allocations, avoiding unnecessary alignment and memory fragmentation caused by permanently modifying mmap_flags.

Replaced all optimization-suppressing integer-to-pointer conversions with equivalent operations that preserve pointer provenance information, and enabled clang-tidy checks to prevent such issues in the future.
Use the compiler-provided assume built-in function instead of the original unreachable implementation, to more reliably express assumptions and avoid potential performance issues.
Optimized the alignment and locality of bin and its mutexes in arena, adjusting the memory allocation layout to improve performance.
Optimized the lock contention when flushing tcache to arena bin: partition by bin before locking, avoid full array scans while holding the lock, and know the number to flush in advance.
Changed the atomic operations for accessing the process madvise pid file descriptor from sequentially consistent to relaxed atomic operations, improving performance.

Fixed a stack out-of-bounds write vulnerability in background_thread.c caused by incorrect use of the address-of operator, and an out-of-bounds write vulnerability in malloc_vsnprintf when size is 0, and added related unit tests.
Fixed a compilation issue under MSVC 2022 caused by searching for the math library libm, skipping the libm search when MSVC is detected.
Temporarily removed the Travis CI build configuration for Windows due to infrastructure failure.
Added explicit unsigned type casts for the MALLOCX_ARENA and MALLOCX_TCACHE macros. (architecture-related: public API)
Remove Cirrus CI
Remove --enable-limit-usize-gap for cirrus CI since the config-time option is removed.
Remove unsupported Cirrus CI config
Limit Cirrus CI to freebsd 15 and 14
Fix Cirrus CI.
Test on more FreeBSD versions
CI update FreeBSD version.

Refactored the QUIC record layer, adding complete implementations for the sending side (QTX) and receiving side (QRX), supporting shared encryption level management, key updates, and AEAD restrictions. (architectural event: QUIC record layer refactoring)

Added the QUIC I/O reactor framework, providing initialization, polling, network read/write status determination, tick callbacks, and blocking wait functionality. (architectural event: QUIC I/O reactor framework)
Added the record method header file recordmethod.h, defining the record/packet protection interface. (architecture-related: public API)
Added header file e_ostime.h to ensure that struct timeval is correctly defined when ssl.h is included. (architecture-related: public API)
Allowed the use of empty passwords in PEM_write_bio_PKCS8PrivateKey_nid. (architecture-related: public API)
Added support for password-based PKCS12 files without MAC to the PKCS12_parse API.
Added an additional macro in tsan_assist.h.
Prevented senders from improperly setting the sequence number (seq) in the HPKE implementation.
In the p10cr transaction of CMP, corrected the use of CertReqId according to RFC 4210.
When no random source is configured, trust user-provided entropy as the random number source.
Removed the old QUIC virtual handshake implementation, which has been replaced by the real TLS handshake. (architecture-related: QUIC handshake implementation replacement)
Removed the DES cipher algorithm from the FIPS provider. (architecture-related: FIPS provider algorithm removal)

Separated the SSL/TLS record layer from the SSL object, migrating it to a new record layer module, refactoring the read/write, encryption, MAC computation, key derivation, and other functions of TLS 1.0/1.1/1.2/1.3, DTLS, and SSLv3, removing the direct dependency on the SSL object, introducing a new record layer method interface, and adjusting related public header files and function signatures. (Architectural event: record layer refactoring)
Refactored the write record layer logic into an independent record layer object and methods, and migrated the related code. (Architectural event: record layer refactoring)
Moved the alert sending check out of the record layer to the upper-layer write function. (Architectural event: record layer refactoring)

Migrated the write buffer management logic from the SSL connection layer to the write record layer, and refactored related functions to use the record layer's internal data structures. (Architectural event: record layer refactoring)

Moved the calculation logic of the record version number out of the record layer, changed it to be calculated by the upper-layer state machine and passed to the record layer via a template, and added a helper function to set the record protocol version. (Architectural event: record layer refactoring)

Moved the need_empty_fragments flag into the record layer structure, and set the flag conditionally during record layer initialization, removing the old location and setting logic. (Architectural event: record layer refactoring)
Moved the record padding callbacks entirely into the record layer, passing them through a dispatch array to avoid direct access to SSL_CONNECTION. (Architectural event: record layer refactoring)

Migrated the TLS 1.3 record padding-related callback functions and block size parameters from the SSL_CONNECTION structure to the OSSL_RECORD_LAYER structure, and added corresponding parameter definitions. (Architectural event: record layer refactoring)
Re-enabled the multi-block code and migrated it to the record layer, refactoring buffer management and write-related functions. (Architectural event: record layer refactoring)

Migrated the pipelining-related code from the SSL layer to the record layer, adding the tls_free method to support resource release in the record layer; migrated the write pipeline count to the new record layer structure. (Architectural event: record layer refactoring)

Refactored the write code, moved the multi-block write functionality to a separate file, and adjusted related functions to use the new record layer structure. (Architectural event: record layer refactoring)
Added QUIC receive stream management functionality, introducing the SFRAME_LIST structure and QUIC_RSTREAM object to manage received stream data. (architectural event: QUIC protocol support)
Migrated the record padding logic from tls_common.c to tls13_meth.c; only the TLS 1.3 method needs to handle record padding, other methods ignore it. (Architectural event: record layer refactoring)

Added an encryption preparation step, extracting logic such as MAC computation and encryption space reservation from the record write function into independent functions, and registering this step in each protocol method. (Architectural event: record layer refactoring)

Changed the way retransmission state is saved in dtls1_buffer_message to use standard record layer functions, and changed the parameters of dtls1_retransmit_message and dtls1_set_message_header from SSL* to SSL_CONNECTION*. (Architectural event: record layer refactoring)
Removed the old buffer management code; the related functionality has been migrated to the new record layer. (Architectural event: record layer refactoring)
Created an internal SSL object for QUIC-TLS to represent TLS connections, and refactored the SSL initialization flow to support passing method parameters. (architectural event: QUIC-TLS integration)
Separated the QUIC-related code from the FIPS source file, and added the QUIC packet processing function. (architectural event: QUIC support refactoring)

Added the ability to obtain EVP methods by a specified provider, including introducing the provider parameter in the underlying constructor, adding multiple internal functions to obtain signature, asymmetric cipher, key exchange, and KEM methods by provider, and supporting cached retrieval. (architecture-related: Provider method retrieval)

Allowed providers to override error marking functions, moving ERR_set_mark, ERR_pop_to_mark, and ERR_clear_last_mark to separate source files and adding the ERR_count_to_mark function; the legacy provider was reimplemented using the upcall mechanism for ERR-related functions. (architecture-related: public API)

Refactored OSSL_LIB_CTX internal object management, changing from dynamic CRYPTO_EX_DATA to hardcoded static members with early initialization to reduce lock contention; added decoder_cache support. (architecture-related: core module refactoring)

Added an interface to remove all methods registered by a specified provider, and modified the cleanup behavior when provider is deactivated or fails self-test, changing it to directly clear associated methods instead of only refreshing the cache; also optimized the activation and deactivation logic. (architecture-related: Provider method cleanup)
Removed the AES SIV cipher algorithm from the FIPS provider. (architecture-related: public API)

Centralized ARM SHA3 CPU detection logic into armcap.c, added the ARMV8_WORTH_USING_SHA3 flag and enabled it for Apple M1/M2; unified the SHA3 capability detection macro into ARMV8_HAVE_SHA3_AND_WORTH_USING. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)

Removed the redundant internal header file include/internal/decoder.h, migrated the function declarations within it to include/crypto/decoder.h, and updated the include paths of related source files. (architecture-related: public API)
Moved the TLS1_FLAGS_QUIC macro definition from the public header file to an internal header file, making it private. (architecture-related: public API)

Refactored the legacy blake2 EVP structure to directly use the base blake2 implementation, avoiding dependence on provider-specific init functions, and changed the corresponding init functions in provider to static. (architecture-related: separation of responsibilities between EVP and Provider)
Removed the unused reset function and its related implementation from OSSL_RECORD_METHOD. (architecture-related: public API)

Refactored the QUIC congestion control abstraction interface, changing the loss and acknowledgment notification logic to pass each packet individually to the congestion control module. (architecture-related: QUIC congestion control interface)

Refactored the option handling mechanism for QUIC connections, separating connection-level and stream-level options, allowing streams to independently inherit and update options. (architecture-related: QUIC option handling mechanism)

Adjusted the child provider reference counting logic; self-referencing child providers no longer increment or decrement the parent provider's reference count, avoiding hindering parent provider unload; non-self-referencing child providers retain reference count propagation. (architecture-related: provider reference counting)
Migrated the logging functionality in the HTTP server to an independent log module and cleaned up related code. (architecture-related: independent logging module)
Migrated OSSL_TIME-related code to libcrypto and adjusted conditional compilation to support the UEFI environment. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)
Allowed reinitialization of existing signing/verification operations in do_sigver_init.
Added a null digest implementation in the default provider to maintain compatibility with 1.1.1.
Added support for different R_BITS lengths for KBKDF.
Added the OSSL_STACK_OF_X509_free() function to replace the common X509 stack free pattern.
Added context copy functions for digest and encryption algorithms, involving implementations in crypto/evp/digest.c, crypto/evp/evp_enc.c, and declarations in include/openssl/evp.h.
Added the -no_ems option to the s_client and s_server applications, corresponding to SSL_OP_NO_EXTENDED_MASTER_SECRET, applicable to versions below (D)TLS 1.2.

Made CMS signing/verification support PKEY from provider implementations, extended ossl_cms_ecdsa_dsa_sign() to handle other algorithms processed in the same way, and supported signing with and without digests.
Allowed specifying custom stack allocation functions for the POSIX async context, while updating async_null.c, async_win.c, and documentation and tests to maintain a consistent interface.
Raised the default security level from 1 to 2. (architecture-related: security level)
When releasing the last reference to EVP_PKEY, no longer acquire the write lock, because at that point the key is used by only a single thread and is about to be freed.

Replaced the __ARMEL__/__ARMEB__ macros used in the aarch64 assembly code with the correct __AARCH64EL__/__AARCH64EB__ macros for aarch64, involving the dual-architecture files poly1305-armv8.pl and armx.pl.
Refined the documentation for multiple API including DES_random_key, EVP_DigestInit, OCSP_REQUEST_new, and RSA_sign.
Reverted the version string changes in QUIC-related code.
Extended callback handling for the -quic -debug options of s_client to support new QUIC callback codes for printing sent and received data.
Changed the random number seed acquisition method for weak entropy sources from rand_generate to rand_get_seed and rand_clear_seed, with the callee allocating and filling the buffer and cleaning up.
EVP_PKEY_CTX_set0_rsa_oaep_label() added compatible handling for the NULL label parameter to match the man page description and maintain backward compatibility.
In BN operations, correctly return an error when the return value aliases with the modulus (aliasing).
Moved the calculation logic for record layer overhead into the record layer and cleaned up related code.
Moved recordmethod.h to an internal header file and updated the reference paths in related files.

Added new QUIC stream state query API, including SSL_get_stream_type, SSL_get_stream_id, SSL_is_connection, SSL_is_stream_local, and SSL_stream_reset, for obtaining stream identifiers, types, and connection status. (architectural event: QUIC protocol integration)
Added an implementation of PVK KDF (PIN Verification Key key derivation function) in providers. (architectural event: new PVK KDF implementation)
Added PRF support based on SHA-3 for PBES2, integrating the SHA-3 hash as an alternative to HMAC into PBKDF2. (architectural event: new SHA-3 PRF support)

Added Brotli compression support (RFC7924), implemented the corresponding BIO and COMP methods, and displayed the Brotli disabled state in the command-line tool. (architectural event: new Brotli compression support in the Compression module)
Added ZSTD compression support, including compression/decompression methods, BIO filters, and related tests. (Architecture-related event: Compression module added ZSTD compression support)
Added SM4-GCM and SM4-CCM algorithm support, including implementations and OID definitions. (Architecture-related event: Provider_Crypto_Implementations added SM4-GCM/CCM algorithms)

Added default provider support for Keccak-224, 256, 384, and 512 algorithms, including s390x hardware acceleration, provider registration, function implementations, and name definitions. (Architecture-related event: Provider_Crypto_Implementations module change)
Added Argon2 key derivation function (KDF) implementation, supporting three modes: Argon2d, Argon2i, and Argon2id. (Architecture-related event: Provider_Crypto_Implementations module change)

Added XOF (extendable output function) support for the blake2b512 digest algorithm, allowing output length to be set via context parameters. (Architecture-related event: Provider_Crypto_Implementations module change)
Enabled KTLS receive functionality in TLS 1.3, and fixed sequence numbers and BIO usage in the receive path. (Architecture-related event: SSL_Protocol_Engine module change)

Added SSL_get0_iana_groups() and SSL_client_hello_get_extension_order() functions, allowing users to obtain groups and extension order in TLS handshake without memory allocation, for low-cost computation of SSL fingerprints (JA3). (Architecture-related event: SSL_Protocol_Engine module change)

Added QUIC protocol basic support: added OSSL_QUIC method declarations, empty implementations, and helper functions, as well as variable-length integer encoding/decoding and WPACKET sub-packet operation interfaces. (architectural event: QUIC protocol support)
Added support for loading root certificate authorities (CA) from the Windows Cryptography API. (Architecture-related event: Added Windows storage support)
Implemented the AES-GCM-SIV algorithm defined by RFC8452 in the default provider. (Architecture-related event: Added AES-GCM-SIV algorithm)
Ensured various SSL options are passed to the record layer, and updated related test functions. (Architecture-related event: Record layer change)
Implemented an event queue in SSL, supporting creation, addition, removal, and retrieval of events. (Architecture-related event: SSL protocol engine module change)
Implemented KTLS support in the new read record layer code, refactored encryption state transitions and key update functions. (Architecture-related event: SSL protocol engine module change)

Supported passing data from one epoch to the next epoch, and added record layer parameter parsing and cleanup logic on connection release. (Architecture-related event: SSL protocol engine module change)
Added declaration of receive-side depacketization function ossl_quic_depacketize in QUIC header file. (Architecture-related event: QUIC protocol engine module change)

Implemented initial versions of QUIC ACK manager, statistics manager, and congestion control API, and added accompanying tests and design documentation. (Architecture-related event: QUIC protocol engine module change)
Added QUIC frame encoding and decoding functions, and added corresponding test cases. (Architecture-related event: QUIC protocol engine module change)

Implemented deterministic ECDSA and DSA signatures based on RFC6979, added HMAC_DRBG KDF implementation, and introduced nonce_type parameter in the signature API. (Architecture-related event: Cryptographic provider implementation module change)

Supported decoding SM2 parameters, adjusted elliptic curve key text output function to correctly display parameter type when curve is SM2. (Architecture-related event: Cryptographic provider implementation module change)

Added QUIC receive-side depacketizer, implementing frame processing functions, stream management logic, and frame legality checks based on packet type. (Architecture-related event: QUIC receive-side depacketizer added)

Added QUIC demultiplexer and record layer receive side, supporting packet parsing, header protection, key derivation, and related tests. (Architecture-related event: QUIC demultiplexer and record layer receive side added)
Implemented functionality to obtain human-readable state strings for the record layer. (Architecture-related event: Record layer state string functionality)
Options, modes, and read-ahead settings of record layer objects can now be updated after instantiation. (Architecture-related event: Record layer settings can be updated after instantiation)
Added custom record layer setting functions and optimized record layer error handling logic. (Architecture-related event: Custom record layer setting functions)
Added receive time field and decoded packet sequence number field, and supported send-side key update. (Architecture-related event: SSL_Protocol_Engine module change)
Implemented QUIC flow control functionality, adding send-side and receive-side flow control controllers. (Architecture-related event: SSL_Protocol_Engine module change)

Implemented DHKEM algorithm for EC, X25519, and X448 curves at the provider layer, adding authenticated encapsulation and decapsulation API. (Architecture-related event: Provider_Crypto_Implementations module change)
Implemented QUIC send stream management functionality, including ACK processing and integer set data structure. (Architecture-related event: SSL_Protocol_Engine module change)

Added QUIC congestion feedback queue (CFQ) implementation, including core functions such as queue management, frame addition, marking sent/lost, and release. (Architecture-related event: QUIC protocol module added)
Implemented the QUIC transmission packet information manager (TXPIM). (Architecture-related event: QUIC protocol module added)
Added implementation of the QUIC frame loss detection (FIFD) module. (Architecture-related event: QUIC protocol module added)

Added RAND_set0_public and RAND_set0_private functions for public and private DRBG, and modified DRBG creation logic to support entropy injection in FIPS known-answer tests. (Architecture-related event: Provider_Crypto_Implementations module change)

Added implementation of QUIC TX packet packer and stream mapper, including frame generation, acknowledgment, loss handling, and stream state management. (Architecture-related event: SSL_Protocol_Engine module change)

Implemented preliminary support for loading signature algorithms from provider, and refactored signature algorithm related data structures and functions in certificate and SSL contexts. (Architecture-related event: SSL_Protocol_Engine module change)
Reimplemented support for brainpool curves in TLSv1.3, simplified processing logic, and created new TLS_GROUP_ENTRY values. (Architecture-related event: SSL_Protocol_Engine module change)

Renamed internal function ossl_sleep to public function OSSL_sleep and moved it to crypto/sleep.c to resolve the issue where dependent functions could not be found during shared library linking. (Architecture-related: HPKE module added)
Introduced BIO preparation step before writing, and added KTLS buffer allocation and release functions. (Architecture-related: SSL protocol engine module refactored)

Integrated QUIC_RSTREAM into RX unpacker, replacing the previous placeholder implementation, so that received data can be queued and flow-controlled through the stream controller. (Architecture-related: QUIC protocol engine changed)

Added pseudo-loss support for QUIC ACKM, allowing specified packets to be forced to be marked as pseudo-lost during connection retry, and avoiding triggering congestion control. (Architecture-related: QUIC protocol engine changed)
Added ossl_quic_demux_set_bio function for QUIC demultiplexer, allowing runtime change of the BIO from which it reads data. (Architecture-related: QUIC protocol engine changed)

Supported computation and verification of QUIC Retry Integrity Tag, and added unused field in QUIC packet header structure to ensure serialization consistency. (Architecture-related: QUIC protocol engine changed)

Added transport parameters and related constants for QUIC protocol, and added connection ID comparison function; also rejected integer transport parameters with trailing extra bytes to enhance parsing robustness. (Architecture-related: QUIC protocol engine changed)
QUIC record layer now allows rekeying of INITIAL encryption layer during connection retry; other encryption layers still not allowed. (Architecture-related: QUIC protocol engine changed)

Implemented front-end I/O API for QUIC, including connection and stream management, read/write operations, error handling, and blocking mode support, and connected it to SSL API functions, enabling QUIC connections to use SSL read/write, handshake, and event timeout interfaces. (Architecture-related: QUIC protocol engine integrated)

Added QUIC-TLS record layer implementation, including record read/write, state management, transport parameter callbacks, and replaced the virtual handshake layer with real QUIC TLS implementation, adding necessary TLS parameters and extension support. (Architecture-related: QUIC-TLS record layer implemented)

Implemented full functionality of QUIC channel, including connection initialization, handshake management, key update, flow control, transport parameter handling, and state machine management; also completed receive unpacker implementation based on QUIC_CHANNEL, refactored frame processing functions, and added protocol error checks and stream state management. (Architecture-related: QUIC channel and unpacker implemented)
QUIC TXP no longer sends STREAM frames before handshake completion; added API to notify handshake completion and updated related tests. (Architecture-related: QUIC transport behavior changed)
Allowed MTU to change over time and automatically detect MTU, improving URXE state management and return handling. (Architecture-related: QUIC MTU auto-detection)

Added internal API for setting custom TLS record layer, added a parameter in record layer method to allow specifying custom record layer method via internal function; extended new_record_layer function to support passing master key, length, and KDF digest parameters, and updated related calls. (Architecture-related: TLS record layer interface extended)

Added KTLS zero-copy sendfile support disabled by default on Linux, and added KTLSTxZerocopySendfile option to enable this feature, while updating related documentation and unit tests. (Architecture-related: SSL protocol engine KTLS support)
Added internal support for SSL objects, allowing custom extensions to be registered at SSL level rather than only SSL_CTX level. (Architecture-related: SSL protocol engine custom extension support)

Added BIO polling descriptor API, supporting retrieval of read/write polling descriptors, and updated SSL related functions to adapt to QUIC connections. (Architecture-related: SSL protocol engine QUIC adaptation)

Implemented hybrid public key encryption (HPKE) defined by RFC9180, supporting all modes, suites, and export mechanisms, and provided corresponding API, documentation, and tests. (Architecture-related: HPKE module added)

Added XTS mode implementation for SM4 algorithm, supporting encryption/decryption, context management, and parameter setting. (Architecture-related: Provider_Crypto_Implementations module added SM4-XTS encryption mode)
Added support for AES-128/192/256 GCM-SIV mode in FIPS provider. (Architecture-related: Provider_Crypto_Implementations module added AES-GCM-SIV encryption mode)
Added TLS server support for QUIC, including error handling improvements and ALPN negotiation callback. (Architecture-related: SSL_Protocol_Engine module added QUIC TLS server support)

Implemented zero-copy read for QUIC receive stream, added ossl_quic_rstream_get_record and ossl_quic_rstream_release_record API, and introduced ring buffer as side storage for stream frame data. (Architecture-related: SSL_Protocol_Engine module added QUIC zero-copy read API)

Add the ability to query connection termination cause for QUIC channels and test servers, introducing the QUIC_TERMINATE_CAUSE structure and extending the related API. (architectural event: SSL_Protocol_Engine module adds connection termination cause query)
Add a callback function for setting the TLS handshake message mutator, allowing modification before the handshake message is written. (Architecture-related event: SSL_Protocol_Engine module change)

Optimize the SSL_shutdown implementation for QUIC, adding the SSL_shutdown_ex API to support passing application error codes on local shutdown. (Architecture-related event: SSL_Protocol_Engine module change)
Add support for detecting stream end and sending stream end signals for the QUIC frontend I/O API. (Architecture-related event: SSL_Protocol_Engine module change)

QUIC TXP adds the ability to generate probe packets and adjusts the congestion control check logic to allow sending probe packets even when sending is not possible. (architectural event: SSL_Protocol_Engine module change (QUIC support)
Implement a memory-based datagram BIO (BIO_s_dgram_mem), reusing BIO_s_dgram_pair code and adding tests. (architectural event: SSL_Protocol_Engine module change (QUIC support)

Add the TLS1_FLAGS_QUIC flag, set during QUIC connection initialization, and provide the SSL_IS_QUIC_HANDSHAKE macro to detect whether a SSL connection is used for the QUIC handshake. (architectural event: SSL_Protocol_Engine module change (QUIC support)

Implement the SSL_rstate_string and SSL_rstate_string_long functions for QUIC connections and adjust related functions to correctly support QUIC. (architectural event: SSL_Protocol_Engine module change (QUIC support)
Implement the SSL_has_pending functionality in QUIC, adding an internal interface to check pending data. (architectural event: SSL_Protocol_Engine module change (QUIC support)
Add HelloRetryRequest support for QUIC connections, modifying the SSL_stateless function to correctly handle QUIC SSL. (architectural event: QUIC support integration)
Add SSL_set_fd support for BIO_s_datagram to the QUIC SSL and extend test cases. (architectural event: QUIC support integration)
Add version setting restrictions for QUIC SSL connections, enforcing a minimum protocol version of TLS1.3, and add tests. (architectural event: QUIC support integration)
Add channel-only tick mode, processing only state synchronized by the channel mutex in thread-assisted mode. (Architecture-related event: SSL_Protocol_Engine module change)
Add frontend support for thread-assisted mode for QUIC connections, including initialization, startup, and cleanup functions. (Architecture-related event: SSL_Protocol_Engine module change)
Support the rstream get/release record mode at the QUIC TLS layer, avoiding internal data copies during reads. (Architecture-related event: SSL_Protocol_Engine module change)

Allow partial release of TLS records, enabling plaintext cleanup at the record layer and avoiding forced removal of the const qualifier. (Architecture-related event: SSL_Protocol_Engine module change)
Implement the NewReno congestion control algorithm for QUIC and switch to it in the QUIC channel. (Architecture-related event: SSL_Protocol_Engine module change)
Add datagram injection support for QUIC connections, adding the SSL_inject_net_dgram function. (architectural event: SSL_Protocol_Engine module change (QUIC)
Add the SSL_is_tls() and SSL_is_quic() functions to determine the protocol type. (architectural event: SSL_Protocol_Engine module change (protocol type API)

Add QUIC stream creation and management API, supporting any number of streams, including local and remote stream creation, and implementing flow control and error handling. (architectural event: SSL_Protocol_Engine module change (QUIC stream API)
Implement the SSL_get0_connection function for QUIC connections, allowing retrieval of the underlying SSL object. (architectural event: SSL_Protocol_Engine module change (SSL_get0_connection API)

Add handling of OSSL_PKEY_PARAM_EC_PUB_X,Y requests for EC legacy keys to support tpm2-tss loading of legacy EC keys. (architectural event: Provider_Crypto_Implementations module change (EC key parameters)

Refactor FIPS option handling code, introducing a unified option structure, and add an option to restrict available digests for DRBG. (architectural event: Provider_Crypto_Implementations module change (FIPS option refactoring)
Add QUIC stream setting and accepting API, including SSL_set_default_stream_mode, SSL_accept_stream, and SSL_get_accept_queue_len. (Architecture-related: QUIC protocol engine changed)
Add QUIC incoming stream rejection policy API and automatic rejection implementation, supporting SSL_set_incoming_stream_reject_policy. (Architecture-related: QUIC protocol engine changed)
Implement QUIC MAX_STREAMS flow control, including receive stream controller support and receive path enforcement. (Architecture-related: QUIC protocol engine changed)
Implement QUIC implicit stream creation, automatically creating streams when receiving remote STREAM frames, in compliance with RFC requirements. (Architecture-related: QUIC protocol engine changed)
Add QUIC stream garbage collection mechanism, including stream fully acknowledged determination and sending partial ID to ensure functionality. (Architecture-related: QUIC protocol engine changed)
Add frame acknowledgment and stream update callback support for the QUIC FIFD initialization function. (Architecture-related: QUIC protocol engine changed)
Add the ability to query peer STOP_SENDING and RESET_STREAM status for the QUIC TSERVER. (Architecture-related: QUIC protocol engine changed)
Add the ability to pop new inbound streams for the QUIC test server and improve stream reset detection. (Architecture-related: QUIC protocol engine changed)
Extend the QUIC stream mapping initialization function parameters to be aware of the server role and initialize more internal state. (architectural event: QUIC stream mapping interface change)
Add initial QUIC support for msg_callback, currently only supporting triggering callbacks when datagrams are received. (architectural event: msg_callback QUIC support)
Add tracing support for QUIC datagrams, extending SSL_trace to dump QUIC datagram reception information. (Architectural event: SSL_trace QUIC datagram tracing)

Modified SSL_get_event_timeout API, added is_infinite parameter to distinguish whether timeout is infinite, and added support for DTLSv1 timeout control commands in the QUIC implementation to maintain compatibility. (Architectural event: SSL_get_event_timeout API change)

Added SSL_trace support for QUIC packets, extended tracing functionality to support multiple frame types and sent frames, and added tracing callback support for sent QUIC packets. (Architectural event: SSL_trace QUIC packet tracing)

Added NEW_CONNECTION_ID frame handling, adjusted active connection ID limit, supported recording key periods, added ACK send callback interface, allowed encoding/decoding to preserve header bits, and implemented RFC 9000 section 9.6 requirements, discarding packets from new server addresses that have not been migrated. (Architectural event: multiple changes to QUIC protocol implementation)
Added validation of preferred_addr transport parameter for QUIC conformance. (Architectural event: QUIC protocol implementation)
Allowed applications to trigger QUIC key update (TXKU) via SSL_key_update, and added corresponding internal interfaces and tests. (Architectural event: QUIC protocol implementation)

Supported SSL_OP_CLEANSE_PLAINTEXT option, set plaintext clear flag during QUIC stream initialization, and added data erasure functionality for send streams. (Architectural event: QUIC protocol implementation)
Implemented RFC 9000 10.1 requirements, set QUIC idle timeout period to at least three times the current probe timeout (PTO). (Architectural event: QUIC protocol integration)
Added public function for computing ciphertext payload length for QUIC QTX. (Architectural event: QUIC protocol integration)
Added ping and stateless reset functionality for QUIC channel, adjusted server shutdown interface to support application error codes. (Architectural event: QUIC protocol integration)

Implemented rate limiting in QUIC shutdown state, ensuring shutdown transmission size does not exceed three times the receive size, enhancing protocol compliance. (Architecture-related event: SSL_Protocol_Engine module change)
Added internal interface for setting QUIC send buffer size, and helper functions for getting connection and stream types. (Architecture-related event: SSL_Protocol_Engine module change)
Implemented stream flushing on QUIC connection close, added interfaces for getting polling descriptors and network read/write status. (Architecture-related event: SSL_Protocol_Engine module change)

Supported most control commands for BIO_SSL based on QUIC, adjusted internal read/write BIO acquisition method and added QUIC compatibility check. (Architecture-related event: SSL_Protocol_Engine module change)

Added unreliable transmission support for QUIC control frame queue (CFQ), so frames like PATH_RESPONSE are no longer retransmitted when lost. (Architecture-related event: SSL_Protocol_Engine module change)

Introduced addressing mode (addressed mode) in QUIC, supporting disabling peer address mode by setting NULL or AF_UNSPEC address, and adjusted handling logic at connection layer. (Architecture-related event: SSL_Protocol_Engine module change)

Improved QUIC blocking configuration: automatically set network BIO to non-blocking mode, refactored blocking support detection logic, added infinite timeout parameter. (Architecture-related event: SSL_Protocol_Engine module change)
QUIC implementation automatically replies with PATH_RESPONSE frame upon receiving PATH_CHALLENGE frame. (architectural event: QUIC protocol integration)
Added receive-side flow control mechanism for CRYPTO stream of QUIC channel. (architectural event: QUIC protocol integration)
QUIC QRX added function to allow processing 1-RTT packets after handshake completion, and re-join delayed queue. (architectural event: QUIC protocol integration)

In QUIC TLS tick function, after handshake completion, instead of returning directly, continue calling SSL_read() to handle possible post-handshake messages. (architectural event: QUIC protocol integration)
Added support for QUIC server to use pre-existing SSL_CTX context instead of always creating new one. (architectural event: QUIC protocol integration)
Added stateless reset (stateless reset) handling support for QUIC channel. (architectural event: QUIC protocol integration)

In QUIC, if NewSessionTicket message contains early_data extension, its max_early_data value must be 0xffffffff, otherwise it is a protocol violation; added validation logic. (Architectural event: QUIC protocol validation logic change)
Added minimal version negotiation packet handling logic for QUIC connection. (Architectural event: QUIC version negotiation handling)

Optimized TLS 1.3 handshake key switching timing, switch client write key as early as possible when not using early data, to support QUIC requirements. (Architectural event: TLS 1.3 key switching optimization)

Implemented backpressure mechanism for stream creation in QUIC application layer, added stream count flow control check, block or reject new stream creation when reaching peer stream limit. (Architectural event: QUIC flow control backpressure mechanism)
QUIC APL supports waiting for peer-initiated shutdown, added related flags and waiting mechanism. (Architectural event: QUIC shutdown waiting mechanism)

Store module added deletion of API OSSL_STORE_delete, and extended loader registration to support deletion and opening extension functionality. (Architectural event: Store module added deletion of API)
Added functionality to query local initiation status for QUIC stream, and enhanced cleanup operations to support send streams. (Architectural event: QUIC stream functionality enhancement)

Added SSL_inject_net_dgram, quic_get_stream_error_code, ossl_quic_get_stream_read_error_code, and ossl_quic_set_write_buffer_size functions, and supplemented frame_type field in connection close information. (Architectural event: QUIC added public API functions)
Implemented SSL_want function for QUIC connection, supporting return of expected I/O status. (Architectural event: SSL_Protocol_Engine module change (QUIC protocol support)

Added SSL_net_read_desired and SSL_net_write_desired functions for TLS/DTLS connections, so that they can correctly return the expected read/write status in non-QUIC scenarios. (Architectural event: SSL_Protocol_Engine module change (QUIC protocol support)
Added the ability to set a PSK session lookup callback for QUIC servers. (Architecture-related event: SSL_Protocol_Engine module change)
SSL_get_rpoll_descriptor and SSL_get_wpoll_descriptor now also support TLS/DTLS connections, no longer limited to QUIC. (Architecture-related event: SSL_Protocol_Engine module change)

Added support for SSL_get_shutdown() for QUIC connections, enabling it to return SSL_SENT_SHUTDOWN and SSL_RECEIVED_SHUTDOWN status. (architectural event: SSL_Protocol_Engine module change (QUIC support)
Added callback mechanisms for QUIC channels, record sending, and test server modules, enabling the test framework to modify QUIC packets before they are encrypted and written to the network.

The asn1parse command added three input formats: PEM, DER, and B64, with PEM as the default, and deprecated the original -strictpem option for backward compatibility. (architecture-related: command-line input format)
Enabled brainpool curve support for TLS 1.3, and added related signature algorithms and group ID mappings. (architecture-related: TLS 1.3 curve support)
Added Chacha20-Poly1305 encryption algorithm support for the kernel TLS of FreeBSD. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)

Implemented RFC7250 raw public key (RPK) support, allowing TLS connections to be established using only private keys, and added related API, unit tests, documentation, and command-line tool support. (architecture-related: raw public key (RPK) support)
Added the -digest option to the openssl cms command, supporting signing with precomputed digests; also added the CMS_final_digest() API function. (architecture-related: public API)

In CMP certificate path validation, when a certificate is found to be expired or not yet valid, it is no longer directly rejected; instead, the user-set validation callback is called first to decide whether to accept it. (architecture-related: CMP certificate validation behavior)
Added random number generation support based on RNDR/RNDRRS instructions for the ARM64 platform, and used it as the default seed source. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)
Added global read/write locks for object database operations, making OBJ series calls thread-safe. (architecture-related: public API)
Added multiple registered OIDs for the CMPv2 extension, including CMP module identifiers, information types, and registration control identifiers. (architecture-related: public API)
Enabled BIO_gets() functionality for BIO_s_connect(), and refactored HTTP tests to support testing of text content. (architecture-related: public API)

The CMP mock server added the -ref_cert option and the ossl_cmp_mock_srv_set1_refCert() function, used to verify certificate information in revocation requests based on a reference certificate. (architecture-related: public API)
Allowed the use of standard cipher suite names to specify cipher strings, and added corresponding tests. (architecture-related: external behavior)

Implemented an optional hashAlg field for the certConf message of CMPv3, setting this field when using a fallback hash algorithm and setting the protocol version to 3. (architecture-related: external behavior)

Added support for the RFC8879 compressed certificate extension, including compressed sending and receiving of server and client certificates, and added related API and configuration options. (architecture-related: public API)
Added checks for multiple unknown options during option initialization, and added a function to set unknown_name. (architecture-related: public API)
Added support for EncryptedPrivateKeyInfo output for ECX key encoding, and fixed related error codes. (architecture-related: public API)

Added TCP Fast Open (TFO) support for socket BIO and s_client/s_server, supporting Linux, macOS, and FreeBSD, disabled by default, and can be enabled via the enabled-tfo option. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)
Added the necessary OID defined in the ETSI specification for CAdES processing. (architecture-related: public API)

Added preemptive thread support, providing internal API for thread creation and synchronization primitives for POSIX and Windows platforms, with support for compile-time disabling and runtime enabling. (architecture-related: public API, platform compatibility)
Added codesign purpose support in X.509 certificate validation, and added the corresponding validation parameter code_sign. (architecture-related: public API)

Added signed BIGNUM conversion functions, including BN_signed_bin2bn, BN_signed_bn2bin, etc., and refactored internal implementations to uniformly handle signed and unsigned data. (architecture-related: public API)
Added support for signed BIGNUM in OSSL_PARAM and OSSL_PARAM_BLD API, and fixed zero-value boundary cases. (architecture-related: public API)
Added support for id-it-caCerts to the CMP module, added related API functions and internal functions, and added the -srvcertout command-line option. (architecture-related: public API)

Added assembly architecture support for the RISC-V 64-bit platform, including cpuid runtime detection, bit manipulation extension Zb[abcs], and byte swap macros BSWAP4/BSWAP8, and fixed the SHA macro condition check. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)

Added the asn1_string_to_time_t function and added tests, and modified OBJ_find_sigid_by_algs to allow searching for signature algorithms without a digest and added tests. (architecture-related: public API)

Enhanced SSL thread safety and validation mechanisms: added locks for platforms that do not support TSAN, changed retry verification to the SSL_set_retry_verify function, and added the StrictCertCheck configuration option. (architecture-related: public API)

Added AES hardware acceleration support for RISC-V 64-bit and 32-bit platforms, covering the ZKND/ZKNE/Zbkb instruction set and multiple encryption modes. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)
Added functions to obtain the verification certificate store and chain certificate store for SSL and SSL_CTX. (architecture-related: public API)
Added more SRTP protection profiles, including dual AEAD configurations for RFC 8723 and ARIA series configurations. (architecture-related: public API)
Added public case-insensitive string comparison functions OPENSSL_strcasecmp and OPENSSL_strncasecmp. (architecture-related: public API)
Introduced CMP protocol version 3, while keeping version 2 as the default version. (architecture-related: version and compatibility)
Added support for BIO_sendmmsg and BIO_recvmmsg to BIO_dgram. (architecture-related: new features in the BIO layer)
Exported the CMS_EnvelopedData type and added the CMS_EnvelopedData_decrypt function. (architecture-related: public API)
Added the d2i_PUBKEY_ex_fp and d2i_PUBKEY_ex_bio functions, supporting passing a library context and property query when reading public keys from a file or BIO. (architecture-related: public API)
Added two new BIO types, BIO_s_dgram_pair and BIO_s_dgram_mem, providing ring-buffer-based datagram pair and in-memory datagram functionality. (architecture-related: public API)
Added datagram mode support for BIO_s_mem, switchable via a new BIO control command, and introduced the BIO_s_dgram_mem method. (architecture-related: public API)
Added the CMS_SignedData_verify function as an extended variant of CMS_verify. (architecture-related: public API)
Added the X509_PUBKEY_set0_public_key function, extracted from X509_PUBKEY_set0_param and optimizing the public key setting logic. (architecture-related: public API)
Added partial string matching support for the Content-Type value in OSSL_HTTP_REQ_CTX_nbio, allowing parameters after a semicolon to be ignored. (architecture-related: public API)
Added the OSSL_trace_string function and the OSSL_TRACE_STRING_MAX constant for formatted output of trace strings. (architecture-related: public API)

RISC-V rev8 instruction support has been extended to the zbkb extension, and an early clobber constraint has been added for the two-instruction bswap. (architecture-related: platform compatibility: RISC-V zbkb extension)
Removed the unused 1-bit GCM implementation and added the ossl_gcm_ghash_4bit function. (architecture-related: public API: added ossl_gcm_ghash_4bit)

The -CAfile option now supports certificate files in DER format; when loading, it first attempts PEM format, and after failure automatically attempts DER format. (architecture-related: public API: -CAfile supports DER format)
Improved error handling in X509_STORE_CTX_init and added the X509_STORE_CTX_init_rpk function. (architecture-related: public API)
Added the BIO_sendmmsg and BIO_recvmmsg API families, including method set/get, send/receive functions, error determination, and debug callback support. (architecture-related: public API)
Added the CRMF API function OSSL_CRMF_CERTTEMPLATE_get0_publicKey() to retrieve the public key from a certificate template. (architecture-related: public API)
Allowed setting arbitrary bag attributes via a callback function during PKCS12 export; added the PKCS12_create_ex2 and PKCS12_SAFEBAG_set0_attrs interfaces. (architecture-related: public API)
Allowed accepting private key input when a public key is expected, and refactored the loading logic to support silent mode. (architecture-related: public API)
Added the for_comp flag to the certificate compression process, skipping unnecessary error handling during compression. (architecture-related: certificate compression behavior)
Introduced the OSSL_CRYPTO_ALLOC macro to provide the compiler with a hint that the returned pointer is not aliased. (architecture-related: public API)
Added support for password-based encryption (PBE) using hmacWithSM3. (architecture-related: public API)
Added the id-ct-signedTAL content type OID for RPKI Trust Anchor Key signed objects, and added OID definitions for ASPA objects. (architecture-related: public API)

In the record layer, replaced the internal type SSL_COMP with the public type COMP_METHOD, and added the ability to query the current compression method through the record layer. (architecture-related: public API)

CMP added support for rootCaCert in genm messages and rootCaKeyUpdate in genp messages, including client API, server simulation, and command-line tool implementations. (architecture-related: public API)
Added two API functions: OSSL_CMP_CTX_get0_libctx() and OSSL_CMP_CTX_get0_propq(). (architecture-related: public API)
Certificates generated by default now use X.509 V3 version, unless the -x509v1 option is specified in the req command. (architecture-related: external behavior)

Added {lib}_R_{lib}_LIB error library reference support for external modules such as engines, and implemented the corresponding error library initialization function in the e_capi engine. (architecture-related: public API)
Added CPU feature detection support for the LoongArch64 architecture, defining cpuid-related macros and variables. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)
Added protocol version compatibility checks in the handling of the TLS 1.3 key_share extension. (architecture-related: protocol compatibility)
Add the RIPEMD160 digest algorithm to the default provider. (architecture-related: public API)

Support all five EdDSA instances in RFC 8032 (Ed25519, Ed25519ctx, Ed25519ph, Ed448, Ed448ph), specify instances via EVP API and OSSL_PARAM, and allow passing context strings. (architecture-related: public API)

Updated FIPS 140-3 KAT tests, modified the signature self-test function to set the DRBG state before each test, and added functions to reset and set the main DRBG; also added test cases for RSA, EC, and DSA key generation self-test failures in FIPS mode, and fixed the issue where the buffer size parameter was not correctly set in the signature self-test. (architecture-related: FIPS self-test behavior)

Add the -self_test_oninstall option to the fipsinstall command to run self-tests at installation; also change the default behavior to be controlled by the -self_test_onload option. (architecture-related: FIPS installation behavior)

Added an option to disable implicit rejection for RSA decryption, allowing users to choose whether to use the implicit rejection padding mode via control parameters. (architecture-related: public API)
Added a new API for the QUIC congestion control module to query the time for the next release of the sending budget. (architecture-related: internal API)
Added OID 1.2.156.10197.1.104.10 and its corresponding NID, short name, and long name for the SM4-XTS algorithm. (architecture-related: public API)
Added one-shot compression/decompression functionality for zlib, providing the COMP_zlib_oneshot method, and adjusted the compilation conditions for COMP_zlib. (architecture-related: public API)
Re-added 3DES to the FIPS provider and provided it as a non-approved algorithm for backward compatibility; also updated related documentation and tests. (architecture-related: FIPS provider)
Added libctx support for the X9.31 key generation function and added coverage tests. (architecture-related: public API)

Added manual URXE injection support for QUIC QRX, refactored the internal receive callback into a public injection interface, and adjusted related cleanup and initialization logic. (architecture-related: public API)
EVP_PKEY_Q_keygen now supports SM2 key generation. (architecture-related: public API)
Implement the OSSL_PROVIDER_get0_default_search_path function, and add documentation and tests. (architecture-related: public API)

Refactor HPKE context initialization, fetch the AEAD encryption algorithm in advance and save the algorithm information to avoid repeated fetching; also enhance parameter validation for the export function. (architecture-related: public API)
Update the QUIC version string from QUIC to QUICv1. (architecture-related: protocol version identifier)

Add two new error codes, PROV_R_INVALID_MEMORY_SIZE and PROV_R_INVALID_THREAD_POOL_SIZE, and their corresponding error description strings to the provider error system. (architecture-related: public API)
Allow OBJ_create to accept NULL OID parameters to create objects and NID. (architecture-related: public API)
Remove conditional compilation for ENGINE-related categories in trace categories, so that all categories always exist, and optimize the category lookup logic. (architecture-related: public API)
Add KMAC support for KBKDF, and extend the size limits for input key and context to 512 bytes. (architecture-related: external behavior)
Add additional libctx and propq support for PKCS12, add related API, and fix a memory release issue. (architecture-related: public API)
ECDSA and DSA signature contexts can now retrieve the OSSL_SIGNATURE_PARAM_NONCE_TYPE parameter. (architecture-related: public API)
Support handling signedAndEnveloped type content in PKCS7_decrypt. (architecture-related: public API)
Add support for the IgnoreUnexpectedEOF option in the SSL configuration command. (architecture-related: SSL behavior option)
Support passing a password callback when opening store, to enable early authentication of PKCS11 modules. (architecture-related: public API)
Add the EC_GROUP_to_params function to convert an elliptic curve group into a OSSL_PARAM array. (architecture-related: public API)
Fix the -reqin option, and add the OSSL_CMP_MSG_update_recipNonce function. (architecture-related: public API)
Add an option for the FIPS module to enforce EMS checking in TLS1_PRF KDF. (architecture-related: FIPS configuration)

Add type function extensions for keymgmt import/export with provider context, so that provider can dynamically return parameter arrays based on configuration, while maintaining backward compatibility. (architecture-related: public API)
Allow overriding the time source of the QUIC channel, and add a callback function pointer for debugging or testing. (architecture-related: public API)

To support Windows XP, add the condition variable signal function ossl_crypto_condvar_signal, and adjust the timeout wait interface, removing the timeout_expired parameter. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)
Add the SSL_get_handshake_rtt function to obtain the handshake round-trip time. (architecture-related: public API)
Enable POSIX thread support on the VMS platform, and remove unused memory barrier functions. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)
Add the SSL_R_CONN_USE_ONLY error code definition, and remove the old numbering. (architecture-related: public API)
Add the macro OSSL_DISPATCH_END as the end marker for OSSL_DISPATCH arrays. (architecture-related: public API)
Add the app_conf_try_number function to simplify retrieval of configuration values and unify error handling patterns. (architecture-related: new public function app_conf_try_number)
Add the selected Microsoft OID, and introduce a ms-corp alias for OID 1.3.6.1.4.1.311, updating all related OID definitions. (architecture-related: public API)
Add the SSL_get0_group_name() function to obtain the group name used for key exchange. (architecture-related: public API)
Allow clients to connect to HTTP servers via IPv6. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)
Remove the restriction on cross-signing self-signed certificates; cross-signing self-signed certificates is now allowed. (architecture-related: certificate behavior)
Add support for the SHA256/192 hash algorithm, which is a variant of SHA256 output truncated to 192 bits. (architecture-related: public API)
Add missing PKI/PMI object identifiers, including related OID definitions and macros. (architecture-related: public API)
Support X.509v3 extensions for all NULL syntaxes, and add corresponding parsing and printing functions. (architecture-related: public API)
Add limited random number support for the WebAssembly WASI target, based on getentropy. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)
Add the OSSL_trace_string public API function. (architecture-related: public API)
Add datagram mode support for BIO_s_connect, and support configuring non-blocking mode in datagram mode. (architecture-related: BIO_s_connect datagram mode)
Enhance BIO_s_datagram: support non-blocking mode configuration, add peer address detection API, and capability negotiation control commands. (architecture-related: public API extension)
Add the OSSL_PROVIDER_load_ex function to support passing parameters when loading provider; refactor related loading functions. (architecture-related: public API)
Add two setting functions, X509_STORE_CTX_set_get_crl and X509_STORE_CTX_set_current_reasons, to support custom CRL verification. (architecture-related: public API)
EVP_PKEY_can_sign() and EVP_PKEY_assign() now support the RSA-PSS key type, treating it the same as standard RSA. (architecture-related: public API)

In the polling descriptor structure, the type field was changed to an unsigned integer, and a new integer-typed custom value member was added to support third parties using integers instead of pointers. (architecture-related: public API)
Added dupctx support for the aes-gcm, aes-ccm, aria-gcm, and aria-ccm cipher implementations by copying the context and fixing the internal key pointer. (architecture-related: public API)
Added fallback implementations for the UINT32_C and UINT64_C macros to support different 64-bit processor ABI. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)

The FIPS self-test now uses a test RNG, avoiding dependence on a real random number generator, and keeps the DRBG settings original for later replacement of the seed source. (architecture-related: FIPS self-test)

Added an association between ECDSA and SHA3 hash functions in the object cross-reference table to support the ECDSA with SHA3 signature algorithm. (architecture-related: public API: ECDSA with SHA3 signature algorithm support)
Added a new public function BIO_ADDR_copy() to copy BIO_ADDR objects. (architecture-related: public API: BIO_ADDR_copy)
Added the SP800-56Br2 6.4.1.2.1 (3.c) requirement for RSA key pair checks, ensuring that the key length is a positive even number. (architecture-related: RSA key pair check standard)

Added user cleanup callbacks for random number entropy and nonce, and updated the cleanup function to prioritize user-provided callbacks. (architecture-related: public API: random number entropy cleanup callback)

Changed the settable parameter of the BLAKE2b digest from OSSL_DIGEST_PARAM_XOFLEN to OSSL_DIGEST_PARAM_SIZE, added a digest size validity check, and added support for gettable parameters. (architecture-related: public API parameter change)
Added unbiased random integer generation functions ossl_rand_uniform_uint32 and ossl_rand_range_uint32. (architecture-related: public API: new random number generation functions)

In the s390xcap environment variable, allowed specifying "z16" as a machine generation, as an alias for "z15"; also added support for the BSD-ppc, BSD-ppc64, and BSD-ppc64le configurations, changing AT_HWCAP to be obtained at runtime and set to 16 when undefined.
Added the OSSL_CMP_CTX_reset_geninfo_ITAVs() function, supplementing the previously missing implementation of this interface along with documentation, header file, and library symbol table entries.
In the evp.h header file, added a comment for the EVP_MD_CTX_FLAG_NON_FIPS_ALLOW macro, stating that this macro has been deprecated since openssl-3.0 and is no longer used.
When OPENSSL_NO_QUIC_THREAD_ASSIST is defined, the quic_thread_assist.c file is no longer compiled. (architecture-related: build and installation methods)
Socket now displays the destination address upon connection.
Enabled the UTF-8 name option by default, making -nameopt utf8 the default behavior.
Added the -ktls command-line option to s_client to enable the Kernel TLS feature.

Added the -ktls option to s_server to enable KTLS, and made the -sendfile option depend on -ktls; also added the -tfo, -cert_comp, -enable_server_rpk, -enable_client_rpk, and -zerocopy_sendfile options.
Support for sending new extensions in certificate request messages, which clients can echo in certificate messages.
Allowed passing empty or missing digest parameters in core_obj_add_sigid, and updated related documentation and tests.
Made the -sans option of the CMP application support email addresses (rfc822Name type).
Added wrap mode, brotli/zstd compression support, configurable salt length to the enc command, and allowed printing only the key and IV when no input file is provided.
Implemented the AES-256-CTR encryption algorithm in the dasync engine.
Enabled tracing functionality for the HTTP client, outputting request and response headers, and dumping response content on error.
Added request and response tracing log functionality for the APPS HTTP server, refactored log output, and normalized error messages.
When using the -CA option and neither -CAserial nor -CAcreateserial is specified, the x509 tool generates a random serial number, and improved serial number loading error handling.
Added a warning to the x509 application, giving a hint when options such as -CAkey are ignored if the -CA option is not specified.
Added printing of the recommended private key length in the DH key text output, and changed the key selection condition from public key to key pair.
Added the -macsaltlen option to the pkcs12 command, allowing users to specify the MAC salt length, and updated the default salt length.
Added the interactive reconnection command C to s_client, allowing users to disconnect and reconnect to the server at any time during the session.
Added configuration option support to the speed command, introducing the CONF variable for reading configuration.
Added the ossl_time_muldiv utility function in the time module.
Added the -mlock option to the speed command, which can lock the throughput measurement buffer into memory to reduce paging effects; this feature is only supported on Linux and Windows.
Added the --all-algorithms option to the list command, which can list all available algorithm categories.
