Added a limit on the number of delayed datagrams at the receiving end of the QUIC record layer, and added related configuration parameters.
Applied the configured maximum send fragment length in the write record layer, and adjusted the buffer allocation logic.
Added a post-encryption processing step function for adding operations such as MAC after encryption, and refactored related write record functions to call this new function.
Added the is_empty function for the list data structure, and added corresponding tests.
Add a function for QUIC ACKM to obtain the PTO duration.
Add connection ID encoding/decoder for QUIC transport parameters, and make the ID field optional.
Add functionality to QUIC demux for re-injecting URXE and checking pending URXE, and fix the return value logic of the injection function; also refactor the operation logic of the pending URXE list.
Add server-side state machine support for QUIC DHS, refactor the original client-side state machine code into independent functions, and introduce error state handling.
Add error reason text for transport parameter handling of the QUIC channel, and add server-side support.
Add basic server-side support for the QUIC channel, including handling new connections, reset tokens, TLS clock, receive preprocessing, and forged packet limit checks.
Implement the QUIC test server module, add interfaces for creation, release, connection state, and handshake state queries, and optimize resource release logic.

Add an option to the dsaparam command to specify the bit length of the sub-prime q during DSA key generation via command-line parameters, and optimize context initialization and error handling for parameter generation and key generation.
Add help functionality to the genpkey command-line tool to display the types and values of pkeyopt parameters.
Change the info buffer of HKDF to dynamic allocation, remove the fixed size limit, and increase the upper limit.
When the -pubin option is specified, public key checking is implicitly enabled.
Add a condition variable wait function with timeout, ossl_crypto_condvar_wait_timeout, supporting POSIX and Windows platforms.
Add a locking mechanism to the QUIC front end to ensure multi-thread safety.
Allow callers to determine whether an ACK-eliciting packet was sent, and add related tests.
Implement core functionality for QUIC thread assistance, including stopping, waiting for stop, cleanup, and notification of deadline changes.
Add QUIC protocol support to the s_client tool, including command-line options, I/O multiplexing, and sending FIN functionality.
Optimize the timing of QUIC channel creation, create the channel earlier, and store initial flow control parameters.
The fipsinstall tool adds the -no_drbg_truncated_digests and -pedantic options to control DRBG digests and strict FIPS mode.
The openssl dgst -list command now also lists digest algorithms that cannot be obtained through the new API but can be obtained through the old API.
The CMP tool supports specifying certificates to revoke by issuer and serial number, and improves validation and warning logic for related options.
Add two helper functions to the params module for allocating a buffer and copying matching parameters, and for allocating a buffer and concatenating all matching parameters.
Add an advanced command mode to s_client, where commands are enclosed in curly braces {} and support parameters, and improve connection information output and user data handling.
Add the CRYPTO_GET_REF function to support querying the current reference count value, and refactor related reference count operations.
Add support for --version and its synonyms to the openssl command-line tool, and fix the resource release method for the error output stream.
Add setter functions for message callbacks and callback arguments, ensuring these values are correctly propagated to QRX, QTX, and TXP after channel creation.
Add ERR_raise() calls in QUIC-related functions to record errors in scenarios such as EVP call failures, improving error tracing capability.
Add the ability to set SSL_trace as the message callback for tserver, and refactor internal structures to support SSL objects and thread safety.
The RSA key generation control items rsa_keygen_pubexp and rsa_keygen_primes now also apply to RSA-PSS keys.
The functions get_rsa_payload_n, get_rsa_payload_e, and get_rsa_payload_d now also support RSA-PSS keys.
Implemented broadcast support for condition variables on Windows XP, adding functions for condition variable creation, release, wait, timed wait, signal, and broadcast.
Add the -saltlen option to the pkcs8 command-line tool of OpenSSL, allowing users to specify the salt length.
Add the -saltlen option to the enc command-line tool of OpenSSL, allowing users to customize the salt length for PBKDF2 (default 16 bytes), replacing the previous fixed 8 byte upper limit.
Add the -quiet option to the req command, and adjust the progress dot display behavior so that it is shown with -verbose and hidden with -quiet.
Implemented control command handling related to polling descriptors in BIO_s_sock.
Add the -outpubkey option to the genpkey command to support outputting a separate public key file.
Replace the jdkTrustedKeyUsage configuration option with the new -jdktrust command-line option; specifying this option automatically enables -nokeys.
In QUIC connection close information queries, add support for the frame type that caused the close.
Update the QUIC example program to support specifying hostname and port via command-line parameters, and add support for IPv6 addresses.
Add a fallback mechanism for key loading in store_result: when loading from the global key management object fails, attempt to obtain the key management object from the store provider.
Add a non-interactive mode run flag for s_client.
Add -verbose/-quiet flags to dhparam, and add -quiet or -verbose support to commands such as ca, dsaparam, gendsa, genpkey, and genrsa.
Add the -quiet option to the -print_certs functionality of pkcs7.
Add the -trace option to quicserver; when enabled, dump communication trace output to stderr.
Add a priority queue implementation, adding header file include/internal/priority_queue.h and implementation file ssl/priority_queue.c.
Add a query function to QUIC TXP to determine whether TXP wishes to generate packets, for use by QUIC CSM.
Add a mutex for QUIC Channel.
Extend tracing capabilities to also trace datagrams that have been sent to the peer.
Change the random output size to long type and add an option to choose the block size.
Add functionality to the CMS demo program to print the signingTime attribute, and add Makefile.

Add extra messages to the DTLS test, including a handshake with HelloVerifyRequest and its discard; and add a DTLS next epoch test to verify that packets from the next epoch can be buffered and used when received.
Add a test for all-zero RSA keys.
Add return value checks for ASN1_item_i2d in fuzz/asn1.c.
Add unit tests for the event queue.
Add the HMAC-SM3 test case from GM/T 0042-2015 Appendix D.3.
Add thread support to the evp_test test framework, with the maximum number of threads configurable via the Threads configuration option.
Extend test_quic_write_read() to include session resumption, repeating the test with the session obtained from the first iteration to confirm successful session resumption.
Add a test for PEM_read_bio_Parameters() to ensure that no password is requested when reading parameters.
Add blocking mode support for qtest_shutdown.
Update ssltraceref.txt and save the new trace to ssltraceref-new.txt during test runs.
Add a command-line option to evp_test to set the provider.
Defer further context copy support for ciphers.
Add a test to verify that the open_ex password check functionality works correctly.
Add timeout support to quictestlib.c to handle unreliable datagram delivery.
Add a packet-splitting BIO that splits QUIC datagrams containing multiple packets into separate datagrams for each packet.
Add an internal function ossl_X509_ALGOR_from_nid() in crypto/asn1/x_algor.c and call it in p5_pbev2.c, cmp_protect.c, cms_rsa.c, and cms_sd.c to simplify the code.
Add an internal function evp_generic_fetch_from_prov() in crypto/evp/evp_fetch.c to fetch an EVP method from a specified provider, and add corresponding internal documentation.
Add an internal function evp_keymgmt_fetch_from_prov() in crypto/evp/keymgmt_meth.c to fetch a keymgmt method from a specified provider.
Add ctx dup operations for multiple KDF implementations (pbkdf2, sskdf, krb5kdf, sshkdf, pbkdf1, hkdf, scrypt, kbkdf).
Add a secure memdup function in providers/common/provider_util.c for context cloning, and implement ctx dup operations for x942kdf, tls1_prf, and pkcs12kdf.
Add a check in create_popo_signature() of crypto/crmf/crmf_lib.c to verify whether the public key and private key match.
Allow transport parameters to be set later in QUIC Dummy Handshake Layer; server mode is not yet implemented.
Add more detailed trace information for the remaining QUIC frame types in ssl/quic/quic_trace.c.
Add various QUIC constants in include/internal/quic_types.h.
Allow PATH_RESPONSE to force padding in ssl/quic/quic_txp.c.
Extend util/quicserver.c to support multiple streams, using a separate stream for each HTTP request, and creating a unidirectional response stream for unidirectional incoming streams.
Add a new internal static assertion macro ossl_static_assert_type_eq for compile-time type checking.
Add a zero-time macro in include/internal/time.h.
Add portable EINTR detection support in include/internal/sockets.h.
Add the missing '#include <openssl/bio.h>' in include/internal/asn1.h.
Remove legacy calls to OBJ_create() in apps/x509.c.
Add a check in ossl_kdf_ctx_create() of crypto/hpke/hpke_util.c to verify that the obtained KDF is not NULL.
Add checks for the return result of ASN1_STRING_set() in crypto/x509/v3_ist.c and crypto/asn1/asn1_gen.c.
Add RSA encryption example code, including demos/encrypt/rsa_encrypt.c, rsa_encrypt.h, and the corresponding Makefile.
Add missing OSSL_DECODER entries in CHANGES.md and NEWS.md, and expand the description content in CHANGES.md.
Add an entry in NEWS.md about the enhanced 'openssl list'.
Mention the providers concept in NEWS.md and CHANGES.md.
Add NEWS and CHANGES entries for the 3.0 release.
The subject or issuer name of an X.509 object now defaults to displaying as a UTF-8 string.
Add an entry in CHANGES.md stating that OBJ_* calls are now thread-safe.
Add Simple SSL Echo Client/Server example programs and related files under the demos directory.
Add CHANGES entry for version 3.0.1.
Add initial QUIC technical requirements document.
Add documentation for BN_mod_sqrt() and remove the corresponding missing marker from util/missingcrypto.txt.
Copy ddd-02-conn-nonblocking as-is as the base version for the thread helper variant.
Add QUIC multi-stream client demo program demos/guide/quic-multi-stream.c.
Add the migration guide to the new guide series and add new documentation files such as ossl-guide-migration.pod.
Add TLS client demo program demos/guide/tls-client-non-block.c using non-blocking sockets.
Add QUIC HTTP/3 demo program based on nghttp3, and add SNI support for the demo in a subsequent commit.

Refactor the check logic for the consistency of the destination connection ID of packets within datagrams in the QUIC receive path, to avoid a use-after-free vulnerability caused by a malformed first packet. (Architecture-related event: SSL_Protocol_Engine module change)

Fixed the issue where the QUIC channel failed to correctly handle delayed packets after the handshake layer generated new keys, ensuring that the receive queue is re-checked after obtaining new keys. (Architecture-related event: SSL_Protocol_Engine module change)

Fixed the reference counting and release logic of BIO in the QUIC front-end I/O API, transferring the release responsibility from QUIC_CHANNEL to QUIC_CONNECTION, and renamed related functions to reflect the ownership change. (Architecture-related event: SSL_Protocol_Engine module change)
Fixed the implementation of SSL_get_error in the QUIC front-end I/O API, adjusting the order of QUIC error checks. (Architecture-related event: SSL_Protocol_Engine module change)

Fixed the WANT_READ signal issue of SSL_read in the QUIC front-end I/O API, ensuring that the WANT_READ error is correctly returned when no data is read in non-blocking mode. (Architecture-related event: SSL_Protocol_Engine module change)

Fixed the issue where CONNECTION_CLOSE frames were generated simultaneously at multiple encryption levels in the QUIC transmission packager; now they are only generated at the lowest non-discarded encryption level. (Architecture-related event: SSL_Protocol_Engine module change)
Prohibit the use of non-QUIC cipher suites in QUIC connections, and add related test cases. (Architecture-related event: SSL_Protocol_Engine module change)
Prohibit the use of NPN (Next Protocol Negotiation) in QUIC contexts. (Architecture-related event: SSL_Protocol_Engine module change)
Prohibit post-handshake authentication during QUIC connection initialization. (Architecture-related event: SSL_Protocol_Engine module change)
Prohibit setting the maximum fragment length in non-disabled mode on QUIC SSL connections. (Architecture-related event: SSL_Protocol_Engine module change)
Prohibit the early data feature of QUIC SSL, and add related test cases. (Architecture-related event: SSL_Protocol_Engine module change)

Prohibit pipeline-related operations such as setting the maximum send fragment, splitting send fragments, and the maximum pipeline count on QUIC SSL connections, and add corresponding tests. (Architecture-related event: SSL_Protocol_Engine module change)
Restrict the use of SSL_CTX_set_ssl_version and SSL_set_ssl_method in QUIC contexts. (Architecture-related event: SSL_Protocol_Engine module change)

Updated the implementations of SSL_set_quiet_shutdown and SSL_get_quiet_shutdown for QUIC, explicitly stating that QUIC is currently not supported, and adjusted internal structures to use SSL_CONNECTION. (Architecture-related event: SSL_Protocol_Engine module change)
Block the SSL_clear operation in the QUIC SSL implementation, making it return failure, and add corresponding tests. (Architecture-related: SSL_Protocol_Engine module change (QUIC SSL implementation)
Fixed a possible segmentation fault when calling SSL_shutdown on a QUIC connection. (Architecture-related: SSL_Protocol_Engine module change (QUIC protocol integration)
Updated the QUIC scheduling method to use SSL object pointers instead of QUIC_CONNECTION pointers, and fixed an erroneous code. (Architecture-related event: SSL_Protocol_Engine module change)
Delay the creation of the default XSO to support client-first or server-first QUIC application protocols. (Architecture-related event: SSL_Protocol_Engine module change)

Fixed multiple issues in the QUIC protocol implementation, including role identification, stream state management, flow control, locking, callback mechanisms, STOP_SENDING handling, FIN detection, stream release behavior, unidirectional stream detection, list usage errors, and time callback parameter passing. (Architecture-related event: SSL_Protocol_Engine module change)

Fixed multiple issues in QUIC multi-stream support: correction of SSL_get_stream_type function logic, multi-stream count reference handling, send stream buffer space management, receive buffer check optimization, and variable uninitialized issues. (Architectural event: QUIC protocol implementation)

Fixed multiple issues in the QUIC protocol implementation, including acknowledgment handling, flow control, stream mapping, BIO acquisition, and thread safety. (Architectural event: QUIC protocol implementation)

Fixed QUIC key update related issues: prevent old keys from processing new packets, correctly execute the key update process, and strictly enforce the validation of ACK packet sequence numbers against the key epoch. (Architecture-related event: SSL_Protocol_Engine module change)

Adjusted the QUIC connection ID handling logic to comply with RFC 9000 specifications, strictly limiting the number of active connection IDs, and closing the connection when the peer limit is exceeded. (Architecture-related: QUIC connection ID handling)
Fixed QUIC network error handling, returning SSL_ERROR_SYSCALL when a network error is encountered. (Architecture-related event: SSL_Protocol_Engine module change)

Implemented saving and restoring of error state for the QUIC channel, saving the thread error state when a permanent error is encountered, and restoring it to user calls after protocol shutdown. (Architecture-related event: SSL_Protocol_Engine module change)

Following RFC 9000 section 3.3, corrected the consistency between stream states and allowed frame types: ensure that STREAM frames are no longer sent in the Reset Sent state, and corrected the final_size calculation for RESET_STREAM frames. (Architecture-related event: SSL_Protocol_Engine module change)

Fixed QUIC protocol conformance: added packet type helper functions, improved transport parameter parsing, and added packet validation and empty packet payload detection as required by RFC 9000. (Architecture-related event: SSL_Protocol_Engine module change)
Release the no longer needed QUIC stream send and receive buffers, and correctly calculate the final size of RESET_STREAM frames. (Architecture-related event: SSL_Protocol_Engine module change)

The QUIC stream state machine model now correctly handles the final size, and the processing logic of STOP_SENDING frames has been optimized. (Architecture-related: QUIC protocol implementation change)
Enforce that QUIC frame type encoding must use the minimum number of bytes, and add related detection and tests. (Architecture-related: QUIC protocol implementation change)

Enforce checking of reserved bits in the QUIC encrypted packet header; if non-zero, treat it as a protocol violation and trigger a connection error. (Architecture-related: QUIC protocol implementation change)

According to RFC 9000 section 17.2.5.1, added validation for Retry packets in the QUIC channel: if its SCID is the same as the initial packet's DCID, discard the Retry packet. (Architecture-related: QUIC protocol implementation change)
According to RFC 9000 section 13.3, restrict MAX_STREAM_DATA frames to be generated only when the receiving stream is in the RECV state. (Architecture-related: QUIC protocol implementation change)

Per RFC 9000 Section 19.8, enforce a mandatory limit on the maximum stream size; stream frames exceeding 2^62 - 1 will trigger a protocol error. (Architecture-related: QUIC protocol implementation change)
Fix the handling of the final size of RESET_STREAM frames in the QUIC protocol to comply with RFC 9000 specifications. (Architecture-related: QUIC protocol implementation change)
Per RFC 9000 Section 12.5, prohibit CFQ from sending disallowed frame types in specific PN spaces. (Architecture-related: QUIC protocol implementation change)

Following RFC 9000 Section 12.5, mask application-layer CONNECTION_CLOSE frames to ensure they are converted to transport-layer CONNECTION_CLOSE frames when sent at non-1-RTT encryption levels, avoiding leakage of application data. (Architecture-related event: SSL_Protocol_Engine module change)
Fix the issue in the QUIC protocol where processing NEW_TOKEN frames with empty Token did not report an error as required by RFC 9000. (Architecture-related event: SSL_Protocol_Engine module change)

Fix the handling of STREAM_DATA_BLOCKED frames to comply with RFC 9000 specifications: ignore frames for deleted streams and return a protocol error for send-only streams. (Architecture-related event: SSL_Protocol_Engine module change)

Per RFC 9000 Section 19.14, add validation of the maximum stream ID encoding value when parsing STREAMS_BLOCKED frames, triggering a connection error when the limit is exceeded. (Architecture-related event: SSL_Protocol_Engine module change)
Implement RFC 9000 specifications for QUIC clients, rejecting Initial packets sent by the server that contain a non-zero token length. (Architecture-related event: SSL_Protocol_Engine module change)

Fix the retirement handling logic for FIN and reset states in QUIC streams, ensuring correct notification to the stream mapping upon read completion or reset receipt. (Architecture-related event: SSL_Protocol_Engine module change)
After QUIC connection termination, no longer process received data packets. (Architecture-related event: SSL_Protocol_Engine module change)

Add send stream state validation in QUIC APL, ensuring write operations only occur in valid stream states, and fix related error handling. (Architecture-related event: SSL_Protocol_Engine module change)

Per RFC 9000 specifications, when a client receives a zero-length connection ID, treat the RETIRE_CONNECTION_ID frame as a protocol violation and trigger error handling. (Architecture-related: QUIC protocol implementation change)
Fixed the issue where SSL_connect() failed to block correctly in blocking mode for QUIC connections. (Architecture-related: QUIC protocol implementation change)
Set the ping deadline to infinite during QUIC channel initialization to prevent immediate timeout before connection acceptance. (Architecture-related: QUIC protocol implementation change)

Fixed QUIC handling in the SSL state string function, added a helper function to select the BIO method based on connection type, and cleaned up code related to multi-block transmission and version checks. (Architecture-related event: SSL_Protocol_Engine module change)
Fix the inheritance issue of early data attributes in QUIC contexts, prohibit block padding, and normalize header guard macros. (Architecture-related event: SSL_Protocol_Engine module change)

Per RFC 9000, correct QUIC acknowledgment delay behavior, including proper initialization of the maximum acknowledgment delay and setting it to 0 in the Initial/Handshake packet space. (Architecture-related event: SSL_Protocol_Engine module change)

Per RFC 9000, refine the handling logic for QUIC connection closure and draining states, including adjusting ACK deadline calculation, adding a connection close reason copy function, and optimizing poll descriptor updates. (Architecture-related event: SSL_Protocol_Engine module change)
Uniformly use the SSL_R_QUIC_PROTOCOL_ERROR error reason and log detailed error information. (Architecture-related event: SSL_Protocol_Engine module change)

Fix the error return value when closing QUIC connections, automatically drain streams that did not end normally, and optimize congestion control wake-up timing. (Architecture-related: QUIC protocol implementation change)

Fix the error code sent by QUIC channels when transport parameters are not received, changing it to the correct missing cryptographic extension alert. (Architecture-related: QUIC protocol implementation change)

Fix the issue in QUIC channels where the client did not correctly discard the Initial encryption level after sending the first Handshake packet. (Architecture-related: QUIC protocol implementation change)

Correctly convert TLS handshake errors to QUIC protocol errors, add error codes and error reporting interfaces, and trigger protocol error handling at the channel layer. (Architecture-related: QUIC protocol implementation change)

Enforce PN monotonicity after forced key updates at the QUIC receiving end, discarding packets that use old keys and have PN greater than or equal to the new key's starting PN. (Architecture-related: QUIC protocol implementation change)
Fix the missing unlock call issue detected by Coverity in QUIC APL, and introduce lock management refactoring. (Architecture-related event: SSL_Protocol_Engine module change)

Ensure that when a QUIC connection closes, the underlying TLS SSL object is marked as closed so that the session can be used for resumption. (Architecture-related event: SSL_Protocol_Engine module change)

Improve the error reporting mechanism for QUIC channels, add error state recovery and more detailed error information, and optimize error handling during the TLS handshake process. (Architecture-related event: SSL_Protocol_Engine module change)

Fix the error handling in the QUIC protocol when the server sends post-handshake CertificateRequest, treating it as a protocol violation rather than an unexpected message. (Architecture-related event: SSL_Protocol_Engine module change)
In QUIC connections, treat receiving TLS KeyUpdate messages as unexpected messages and trigger a connection error. (Architecture-related event: SSL_Protocol_Engine module change)
Fixed the issue of losing the QUIC flag when clearing SSL connection data, ensuring that the QUIC state is preserved after cleanup operations. (Architectural event: QUIC protocol integration)
Fixed the address mode determination logic in QUIC connections, handling read and write capabilities separately. (architectural event: QUIC protocol integration)

Fixed the handling logic of control commands in QUIC mode, added internal functions to correctly route QUIC and non-QUIC ctrl calls, and adjusted QUIC compatibility for control commands such as version checks and fragmented sending. (Architectural event: QUIC control command handling refactoring)

Fix multiple issues in the QUIC protocol implementation: add a QUIC cipher suite lookup function, handle duplicate transport parameters, and correctly propagate TLS errors. (Architecture-related: QUIC protocol implementation change)
Fix the issue in QUIC connections where BIO_free_all was not used when releasing the BIO chain, ensuring consistency with TLS behavior. (Architecture-related event: SSL_Protocol_Engine module change)
Fix the handling of EC_KEY by {i2d,d2i}_PublicKey when the EVP_PKEY type is EVP_PKEY_SM2.
In QUIC channels, if the TLS handshake completes but the peer's transport parameters are not received, raise a protocol error.

Improve error differentiation in X509 storage lookups; the function now returns -1 for internal errors and 0 for not found, and adds lock checks and sorting optimizations. (architecture-related: public API)
Memory allocation functions now report the ERR_R_MALLOC_FAILURE error on failure, and the OSSL_ERR_STATE_free function has been made public. (architecture-related: public API)
Add a global lock for the OBJ_add_sigid function to ensure thread safety when concurrently adding signature algorithms. (architecture-related: public API)
New NID allocations use atomic operations when TSAN is supported, otherwise use locks; refactor lock management and allow creation of ASN1_OBJECT without OID. (architecture-related: public API)
Introduce the HAS_PREFIX() and CHECK_AND_SKIP_PREFIX() macros to replace manual string prefix checks, fix boundary handling, and add helper functions. (architecture-related: public API)
Enable checking of return values for EVP operations in cryptographic performance tests, and fix conditional logic in error handling. (architecture-related: public API)
Fix the error checking logic for PBM calculation in CRMF, adjust the const qualifier of the template getter function, and add related comments. (architecture-related: public API)
Fix the HTTP server port output format, refactor socket address acquisition logic, and adjust the OCSP responder function signature to remove the port parameter. (architecture-related: public API)
Public and private DRBG no longer use derived functions, clean up parameter passing to avoid passing unknown parameters. (architecture-related: public API)
Fix handling of memory allocation failures in X509_ALGOR_set0(), add return value checks to ensure error propagation, simplify code, and update documentation. (architecture-related: public API)

Improve error reporting for parsing configuration values/options in the v2i_AUTHORITY_KEYID function, adding error reasons for unknown options, incorrect values, etc. (architecture-related: public API)

Fix issues with handling AKID and SKID extensions based on configuration, refactor logic to support the none option and suppression for self-signed certificates. (architecture-related: configuration option change)
Fix the issue in OSSL_STORE_open_ex() where an unregistered scheme causes spurious errors. (architecture-related: public API)
Prefer the issuer certificate from the DANE TLSA record over the peer certificate to correctly build the certificate chain. (architecture-related: external behavior)
Fixed a compilation error on the kfreebsd kernel of Debian caused by AT_SECURE not being declared. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)
Fixed a type incompatibility issue in VMS code under the x86_64 cross-compiler. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)
Fix compatibility issues with random API on macOS versions below 10.12, raising the minimum supported version to 10.12. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)
Revert unnecessary performance optimizations in PKCS7_verify(), remove temporary read-only memory BIO, simplify logic, and fix error handling. (architecture-related: public API)
Fix the issue where EC public key export defaults to compressed format, change to default uncompressed format, and respect user-specified format parameters. (architecture-related: public API)
Fix the issue where the BIO_free function returns 0 when the callback returns a non-positive value. (architecture-related: public API)
Fix the issue where the BIO_ctrl, BIO_callback_ctrl, BIO_pop, and BIO_next functions no longer record errors when passed a NULL parameter. (architecture-related: public API)

Fix the EVP_PKEY_eq() function to correctly handle keys containing only private key components, and adjust the match functions of the DH, DSA, EC, ECX, and RSA key management implementations to relax the interpretation of the selector bits. (architecture-related: public API)

Optimize the fetch logic for EVP_PKEY operations, prioritizing fetching the operation implementation from the key's KEYMGMT, and add a fallback mechanism that attempts to fetch the operation implementation from the key's owning provider when the key cannot be exported from the current provider. (architecture-related: external behavior)
When SM2 uses an invalid digest, it now correctly reports an error, avoiding silent failure. (architecture-related: external behavior: SM2 signing)
Fix the issue in the dasync engine where EVP_CIPHER_CTX_copy cannot correctly copy the cipher context. (architecture-related: public API: EVP_CIPHER_CTX_copy)
Fix the X509_PUBKEY_dup function to attempt to copy the key rather than merely incrementing the reference count. (architecture-related: public API behavior change)
Fix incorrect return value checks in the BN_bn2binpad and BN_bn2nativepad functions to correctly determine negative or zero values. (architecture-related: public API)

Fix issues reported by Coverity: check return values during zlib compression/decompression initialization and return an error on failure; fix dead code in the logic of EVP_DigestSignFinal. (architecture-related: public API)
Fix the output structure of the DER encoders for EC and SM2, removing incorrect public key serialization logic. (architecture-related: DER encoding behavior)
Fix the issue in d2i_PublicKey when handling EC parameters in provider keys, and add corresponding test cases. (architecture-related: public API)
OSSL_PARAM_BLD_push_BN and OSSL_PARAM_BLD_push_BN_pad now return an error for negative parameters, and the relevant documentation has been updated. (architecture-related: public API)
Fix the failure of ARMv7 and ARM64 CPU feature detection on FreeBSD by correctly using the AT_HWCAP and AT_HWCAP2 constants instead of hardcoded values. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)
Fix parsing errors in the OSSL_HTTP_proxy_connect() function when parsing HTTP response headers. (architecture-related: public API)
Fix the issue where the HTTP client cleans up the TLS BIO via a callback function on disconnect, and ensure OSSL_HTTP_close correctly handles this cleanup. (architecture-related: public API)

Fix the issue where negative input for unsigned integer types was not rejected during parameter parsing, now correctly reporting an error; also allow sign extension for OSSL_PARAM_INTEGER types in OSSL_PARAM_allocate_from_text(). (architecture-related: public API)

Fix crashes caused by applications statically linking libcrypto/libssl causing engines to use a different OpenSSL runtime, by preventing the engine's libcrypto from installing atexit handlers. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)
Allow copying uninitialized digest contexts, and fix error handling in EVP_DigestFinalXOF on already finalised contexts. (architecture-related: public API)

The x509 tool now returns a non-zero exit code when certificate IP/Email/hostname verification fails, and refactors the verification logic to unify error handling. (architecture-related: exit code behavior)
Fix the issue where EVP_PKEY_CTX_get_rsa_pss_saltlen() fails to correctly return when an integer value is specified, and add regression tests. (architecture-related: public API)
Fix the issue in HTTPS proxy usage where proxy environment variables were ignored due to a callback design flaw, adjusting the proxy determination logic. (architecture-related: proxy behavior)
Disable the encrypted MAC extension for GOST cipher suites in TLS 1.2. (architecture-related: TLS protocol behavior)
Fix timeout handling in OSSL_HTTP_get() during redirects, add timeout checks, and add a new retry timeout error code. (architecture-related: public API)
Fix the issue in OSSL_HTTP_REQ_CTX_nbio() where parsing responses with non-200 status codes incorrectly cancels keep-alive, and adjust the order of error checks. (architecture-related: public API)

Fix the check of the port parameter in proxy mode in the OSSL_HTTP_set1_request() function to match the documentation: when using a HTTP proxy, the server address must be provided, and the port is optional. (architecture-related: public API)

Fix the issue in libssl where internal errors in X509_verify were incorrectly returning SSL_ERROR_WANT_RETRY_VERIFY, now treating verification errors as verification failures to avoid application crashes. (architecture-related: external behavior)
Fix the todata and fromdata operations of EVP_PKEY to no longer incorrectly include private key data when public key is selected, and add related tests. (architecture-related: public API)
Re-enable CCM mode for KTLS because the kernel has fixed the decryption failure issue in CCM mode in TLS 1.3. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)
Change the declaration of the OSSL_provider_init function from extern to OPENSSL_EXPORT to ensure correct export on Windows systems. (architecture-related: public API)
Fix the memory leak in the OSSL_CMP_MSG_read function caused by not releasing the allocated message object when file reading fails. (architecture-related: public API)

Ensure that digest methods created via EVP_MD_meth_new() take the legacy path during initialization; and add tests for custom digests created via EVP_MD_meth_new() to verify that their init and cleanup functions are correctly invoked. (architecture-related: external behavior)

Fixed a potential memory leak when reusing EVP_MD_CTX in EVP_DigestInit_ex(), ensuring that the old md_data is properly freed and the cleanup function is called before initialization. (architecture-related: public API)
Fix the null pointer dereference issue in the BN_hex2bn function, and add a check for the static data flag to prevent errors when a static BIGNUM is passed. (architecture-related: public API)
Fixed the issue where EVP_PKEY_fromdata incorrectly returned a newly allocated pkey on failure; it now correctly frees and sets it to NULL. (architecture-related: public API)

Fixed the issue in EVP_PKEY_derive_set_peer_ex where the peer key was exported to the wrong keymgmt, ensuring that the keymgmt corresponding to the operation is used for export. (architecture-related: public API)

Fixed compilation errors in the UEFI environment caused by SSE being disabled, and added the EFIAPI calling convention to the abs_val() and pow_10() functions. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)
Added multiple new error codes and corresponding error description strings to the CRYPTO module. (architecture-related: public API)

Added detailed error messages to the built-in parameter conversion functions, covering error cases such as range overflow, negative unsigned, imprecise real, wrong type, buffer too small, null function argument, and unknown real size. (architecture-related: public API)
Added error reporting to the failure return path of the OSSL_PARAM_merge function, and uniformly replaced strcasecmp with OPENSSL_strcasecmp. (architecture-related: public API)
Fixed the issue in EVP_DigestSignFinal where *siglen was incorrectly read when sigret is NULL. (architecture-related: public API)
Fixed the issue of incomplete temporary data cleanup on the s390x platform, ensuring that the entire parameter buffer is correctly cleared. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)

Fixed the issue where EVP_PKEY_CTX_set_dh_nid and EVP_PKEY_CTX_set_dhx_rfc5114 did not correctly return errors during parameter conversion, added error handling for invalid values, and added related tests. (architecture-related: public API)
Fixed the issue where record length checks might be missed when KTLS is enabled, and added KTLS test support. (architecture-related: KTLS compatibility)

Fixed the malloc failure issue in PEM_write_bio_PKCS8PrivateKey() caused by zero-byte memory allocation when an empty password string is passed, and added related test cases. (architecture-related: public API)

When dynamically loading an engine, detect whether the engine is linked to OpenSSL 1.1.x (by checking the EVP_PKEY_base_id symbol), and if so, abort the loading to avoid a crash. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)
Fixed the scope of the extern "C" block in the C++ wrapper, ensuring that function declarations are correctly wrapped. (architecture-related: public API)

Fixed the counter overflow issue in the PPC AES GCM implementation, added wrapper functions, and adjusted macro definitions to correctly handle the counters. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)
Included internal/numbers.h in speed.c to resolve the issue where SIZE_MAX is undefined on platforms such as z/OS. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)

Restored the check on the DH public key size, and added validation for the ECDHE uncompressed point format to comply with the TLS 1.3 specification; also adjusted related security check logic. (architecture-related: TLS 1.3 protocol behavior)

On the aarch64 architecture, when compiling with clang and enabling BTI, fall back to the swapcontext implementation to fix compatibility issues with setjmp/longjmp. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)
Fix the handling logic in OSSL_CMP_CTX_setup_CRM() for obtaining default values from CSR and reference certificates, and update related documentation. (architecture-related: public API)
At security levels ≥ 3, treat the SSL_kDHEPSK and SSL_kECDHEPSK cipher suites as forward-secret (PFS) cipher suites. (architecture-related: security behavior)

On FreeBSD, use timegm instead of the mktime and timezone variables to fix compilation errors in asn1_string_to_time_t, and add memory allocation failure checks. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)

Fixed the bug where openssl req -x509 could not generate a certificate from a CSR; it now supports generating CA-signed certificates using the -CA and -CAkey options, and added regression tests. (architecture-related: external behavior)
Make ASYNC_set_mem_functions thread-safe by adding a read-write lock to protect the setting and use of custom memory allocation functions. (architecture-related: public API)
Removed the call to pthread_atfork because the related functions are now no-ops, and some platforms do not support this function, causing link failures. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)

The EC_GROUP_new_from_params function in the FIPS module no longer supports explicit elliptic curve parameters, only accepts named curves, and returns the new error code EC_R_EXPLICIT_PARAMS_NOT_SUPPORTED. (architecture-related: public API)
Fixed build warnings on OpenBSD caused by time_t being a 64-bit type, and adjusted the print format for SSL session time values. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)
Prohibit duplicate HelloRetryRequest messages. (architecture-related: TLS protocol behavior)

In TLSv1.3, limit the lifetime hint of session tickets to at most 1 week(s) to comply with the RFC 8446 specification, and added corresponding test cases. (architecture-related: TLS protocol behavior)

Fixed the issue where the OSSL_PARAM_get_*_ptr family of functions incorrectly retained the error state when the pointer and string types do not match, and added the ossl_param_get1_octet_string function to extract parameters into an allocated buffer. (architecture-related: public API)
Allow the DH parameter to be specified at any position in the SSL configuration command, and added corresponding test cases. (architecture-related: external behavior)
Fixed the compilation issue in recordmethod.h caused by the function pointer name new conflicting with a C++ reserved word, and renamed it to new_record_layer. (architecture-related: public API)

Fixed the handling logic of URI in the SSL_CERT_DIR environment variable, and added the SSL_CERT_URI environment variable as the default certificate URI source. (architecture-related: certificate loading behavior)
Fixed the logic error in the X509V3_parse_list function that could occur on memory allocation failure due to not checking the return value of X509V3_add_value. (architecture-related: public API)
Fixed the wincrypt.h symbol conflict, adjusted the preprocessor directives in types.h, and added build tests. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)

Fixed the DH private key check: when the q parameter is missing, it no longer fails directly, but instead performs a reasonable range check based on p and length; also enhanced boundary conditions for the public key check. (architecture-related: external behavior)

Fixed undefined behavior in CMAC, GMAC, HMAC, and SipHash when reinitializing EVP_MAC, ensuring correct reinitialization, and prohibited Poly1305 from reusing keys. (architecture-related: external behavior)

Introduced a reservation mechanism for OSSL_METHOD_STORE, adding a separate large lock to resolve race conditions during concurrent method construction in multithreaded scenarios. (architecture-related: internal architecture)
Moved the call to ossl_deinit_casecmp to the end of OPENSSL_cleanup to ensure that cleanup functions depending on OPENSSL_strcasecmp can execute properly. (architecture-related: external behavior)
Fixed the BIO_get_ktls_send and BIO_get_ktls_recv macros to ensure their return values are only 0 or 1. (architecture-related: public API)

Fixed locale initialization issues to ensure string comparison functions work correctly; removed dependency on locale code and directly implemented strcasecmp and strncasecmp functions. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)
Fixed the issue where KTLS was enabled too early when using BIO_new_connect, causing connection failure; changed to enable it after the connection is successful. (architecture-related: public API)
Make OSSL_LIB_CTX_load_config thread-safe by adding read-write lock protection for configuration module list operations. (architecture-related: public API)
Implement the UnsafeLegacyServerConnect configuration option to make it consistent with the documentation. (architecture-related: public API)
Add necessary header file inclusions for the NonStop platform to support fixed-size integer types. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)

Add missing declarations for random seed functions, correct parameter types to match the core dispatch table definitions, and add a new user entropy retrieval function. (architecture-related: random seed function interface)
Only check the expected Content-Type when the HTTP status code is 200. (architecture-related: HTTP response handling)
Fix the default key length regression for Blowfish CFB and OFB ciphers, correcting it from 64 bits to 128 bits. (architecture-related: Blowfish default key length)
Fix undefined behavior in EC_GROUP_new_from_ecparameters caused by a seed length of 0, adding a length check and returning an error. (architecture-related: public API behavior fix)
Fix the return value check defect in the EVP_PKEY_get_params function to ensure correct determination of whether parameter retrieval succeeded. (architecture-related: public API behavior fix)
Fix the issue of incorrect return value checking in EVP_CIPHER_CTX_ctrl, changing the original boolean judgment to a correct numeric comparison. (architecture-related: public API behavior fix)
Upgrade the serverinfo format in SSL_CTX_use_serverinfo() to v2 and fix related error handling. (architecture-related: public API)
Fix incomplete return value checks in functions such as EVP_CIPHER_CTX_set_key_length to ensure correct handling of negative return values. (architecture-related: public API)
Fix incorrect return value checks in the EVP_PKEY_CTX_set_rsa_pss_saltlen and EVP_PKEY_CTX_get_rsa_pss_saltlen functions. (architecture-related: public API)

Fix return value checks for the EVP_PKEY_CTX_set/get_* series of functions, changing the original boolean judgment to a correct <=0 comparison to ensure failures are correctly caught. (architecture-related: public API)

Improve RSA key generation behavior: in non-FIPS mode, when the public exponent e is less than 65537, fall back to the multi-prime key generation method; when no prime candidate is found, explicitly throw the error "no prime candidate". (architecture-related: public API)
Fix the "defined but not used" warning/error in the OPENSSL_atexit function caused by incorrect conditional compilation macros. (architecture-related: public API)
Fix the DSA, DH, EC, and RSA key export routines to ensure they do not incorrectly return success when parameter allocation fails. (architecture-related: key management module)
Fixed the dsaparam and gendsa commands to support the -provider and -propquery options, and updated the related help text. (architecture-related: command-line interface)
Fixed a build failure in kdf_exch.c caused by a missing SIZE_MAX macro definition, and added the necessary header file inclusion. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)

Fixed the issue where the decoded-from-explicit flag of the EC group was lost when moving across provider; now the flag is correctly exported during serialization. (architecture-related: cross-provider behavior)
Fixed the issue in DTLS where the handshake sequence number was not correctly reset when retransmitting ClientHello. (architecture-related: DTLS handshake behavior)

Fixed the issue where the -provider and -propquery options were not effective in multiple command-line tools (dhparam, ecparam, pkeyparam, dgst, genrsa). (architecture-related: common command-line interface)
Improved the use of the use_ssl parameter in the OSSL_HTTP_open function to ensure that an explicit boolean value is passed to the callback function. (architecture-related: public API)

Adjusted the random number seed generation method for the OpenVMS platform, using a timestamp plus sequence number instead of a high-precision time function. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)
Fixed a memory leak in X509V3_add1_i2d when deleting extensions under the X509V3_ADD_DELETE flag due to not freeing memory. (architecture-related: public API)

Fixed the padding issue in the Keccak implementation on the s390x platform, using intermediate message digest calculation and manually handling Keccak padding. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)
Made all EVP _is_a functions accept and safely handle NULL parameters to avoid null pointer dereferences. (architecture-related: public API)

Fixed the signed shift issue detected by UBSAN on the aarch64 architecture, adding the U suffix to integer constants in related macro definitions to ensure unsigned operations. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)
During DTLS record layer initialization, ensure that a datagram memory BIO is used instead of a regular memory BIO. (architecture-related: DTLS record layer behavior)
Removed the reference to rlayer.rstate and fixed the ssl3_pending function to correctly return the length of pending application data. (architecture-related: public API behavior)

Added a manual locking mechanism for VC++ 2008 and earlier x86 compilers to resolve the Windows XP 32bit compatibility issue caused by the lack of an inline implementation of InterlockedOr64. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)
Fixed the issue in DTLS where SSL_pending() and SSL_has_pending() did not consider buffered application data. (architecture-related: public API behavior)
Fixed a segmentation fault in PEM_write() caused by calling strlen() when the header parameter is NULL. (architecture-related: public API)

Fixed a regression in the CMS_final function that ignored the result of CMS_dataFinal, ensuring that errors are correctly returned when signature verification fails. (architecture-related: public API)

Fixed an issue in EVP_CIPHER_CTX_get_iv_length() where a missing range check could return an out-of-bounds value, and improved the default logic to fall back to returning the IV length of cipher when the cipher context does not support obtaining the IV length. (architecture-related: public API)
Fixed an issue where the return value of SMIME_crlf_copy was ignored; now it correctly returns an error when memory allocation fails. (architecture-related: external behavior)
Fixed a regression in EC_KEY_set_private_key(), which now allows setting the private key to NULL while maintaining backward compatibility. (architecture-related: public API)
In the smime command, explicitly made the six operations mutually exclusive and added checks to prevent specifying multiple operations simultaneously. (architecture-related: smime command behavior)
Check whether the IV length is less than zero; if EVP_CIPHER_CTX_get_iv_length returns -1, treat it as an error and handle it. (architecture-related: public API)

Fixed a regression introduced by the GCM mode refactoring, adjusted the default implementations across platforms, and improved support for the RISC-V instruction set branches. (architecture-related: RISC-V support)

Fixed an issue in the session cache where new entries could be unexpectedly deleted due to the addition order, adjusted the addition logic, and added related tests. (architecture-related: public API behavior)

Fixed an issue in the PKCS7_dataVerify function where the certificate revocation list (CRL) was not used when verifying PKCS#7 signatures, and cleaned up related variable naming. (architecture-related: public API behavior)

Fixed an endianness issue in the AES-GCM-SIV implementation, replaced the byte-swapping function, and corrected the mulx_ghash handling logic on big-endian architectures. (architecture-related: platform compatibility: big-endian architectures)
Improved error checking and error reporting for functions related to X.509 attributes, and optimized code style. (architecture-related: public API)
Corrected the fallback subject handling logic in OSSL_CMP_CTX_setup_CRM(), prioritizing the subject name from CSR as the default value. (architecture-related: public API)

Added direct error returns for insertion failures in X509_VERIFY_PARAM_add0_table, added sorting in X509_VERIFY_PARAM_lookup to ensure correct lookups, and improved coding style. (architecture-related: public API)
Added missing direct error reporting in stack.c and improved coding style, while also fixing imprecise uses of the stack API across multiple files. (architecture-related: public API)

Fixed the setting logic of the modified flag in the X509 and X509_REQ signing functions, including setting the flag when modifying attributes or signatures, setting the flag only after successful signing, and adding null pointer parameter checks to ensure correct re-encoding after signing. (architecture-related: public API)

Limited the maximum block size of symmetric ciphers to 2^30 bytes, fixing crashes and infinite loops that could occur due to differences between sizeof(long) and sizeof(size_t). (architecture-related: public API behavior restrictions)
Unify the ZLIB conditional compilation macros to the OPENSSL_NO_ZLIB prefix, and make the BIO_f_zlib() function always available. (architecture-related: public API and build configuration)

Fixed the return type of the rlayer_skip_early_data callback function, correcting it from a pointer type to int, resolving test failures caused by copy-paste errors. (architecture-related: public API)

Fixed an issue in TLSv1.3 where strict checking of legacy_record_version caused connection failures with defective servers; the client now ignores incorrect record versions. (architecture-related: TLS compatibility)

Fixed an issue on the s390x platform where the key length was not correctly set during ECX key derivation, adjusting the derivation logic to align with the common code. (architecture-related: s390x compatibility)

Fixed issues with BIO_sendmmsg and BIO_recvmmsg on FreeBSD, including handling cases where loopback sockets on BSD systems do not support local addresses, and corrected the retrieval of the address parameter in sendmmsg. (architecture-related: FreeBSD compatibility)
Fixed the fallback logic for AES-GCM on Power 8 CPU, correctly using the default implementation when necessary instructions are missing. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)

Fixed CMS_add0_cert to no longer report an error when the certificate already exists, instead silently ignoring it and returning success; also fixed resource leaks in CMS_add1_cert and CMS_add1_crl when reference counting fails. (architecture-related: public API)

Fixed compatibility issues between the EVP_PKEY_eq function and the 3.0.0 FIPS provider, adjusting the selection parameter during comparison based on whether the key contains a public key. (architecture-related: public API)
Fixed the omission of resetting ctx->genm_ITAVs in OSSL_CMP_CTX_reinit(), avoiding errors in subsequent OSSL_CMP_exec_GENM_ses() calls. (architecture-related: public API)

Fixed code formatting issues in the CMP and CRMF modules, and corrected the parameter checking logic for certificate revocation requests and the condition judgment when printing PKIStatusInfo. (architecture-related: public API)

Fixed issues where BIO_ctrl_pending and BIO_ctrl_wpending could return erroneous values when the underlying layer returns an error, and set the return value upper limit to SIZE_MAX to prevent overflow. (architecture-related: public API)
Fixed the error reported in d2i_CMS_ContentInfo and adjusted the related test cases. (architecture-related: public API)

Fixed an issue on s390x where X25519 and X448 key generation did not correctly use IKM, ensuring HPKE and DHKEM work correctly on systems supporting PCC instructions. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)
Added a workaround for the DJGPP platform to convert UTC timestamps to time_t by setting the environment variable TZ=UTC. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)
Fixed the missing length validation for the IP address family, adding length checks in the canonical and canonicalization functions. (architecture-related: public API)
Fixed the issue with marking the modified field and return values in the set and sign functions related to X509, X509_CRL, and X509_REVOKED. (architecture-related: public API)
Made CRYPTO_secure_malloc() correctly trigger the ERR_R_MALLOC_FAILURE error when memory allocation fails. (architecture-related: public API)

Stopped directly reporting ERR_R_MALLOC_FAILURE in most places, changed to reporting more specific subsystem error codes, and fixed related custom malloc wrapper issues. (architecture-related: public API)

Fixed the propagation issue of error return values in BN_check_prime(), ensuring that when internal functions return an error, -1 is correctly returned, thereby allowing callbacks to abort primality testing or key generation. (architecture-related: public API)
Fixed the SHUT_RD and SHUT_WR macro definitions on the Windows platform and added missing header file references. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)

Fixed the issue where signing certificates no longer implicitly refreshes the cached TBSCertificate, ensuring that the modified flag is correctly set before signing to ignore cached encoding. (architecture-related: public API: X509_sign_ctx)

Fixed SCTP compilation errors, added the ossl_statem_get_state function, and changed the parameter types of SSL_in_before and ossl_statem_clear from SSL* to SSL_CONNECTION*. (architecture-related: public API: parameter type change)

Fixed the issue where the CMS_decrypt_set1_* series of functions incorrectly added misleading error queue entries in cases of non-recipient mismatch. (architecture-related: public API: CMS_decrypt_set1_*)
Added a check for memory allocation failure in the SRP_VBASE_init function to promptly catch potential memory errors. (architecture-related: public API: SRP_VBASE_init)
Replaced BIO_free(bio_err) with BIO_free_all(bio_err) to correctly handle the BIO chain that may be returned in the VMS environment. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)
Fixed the failure of make update due to error code number conflicts, and adjusted the error code number for SSL_R_SEQUENCE_CTR_WRAPPED. (architecture-related: public API)
Fixed the SSL_alloc_buffers and SSL_free_buffers functions so they work correctly again. (architecture-related: public API)

Fixed the issue where the public key was incorrectly considered mandatory when using PEM_read_bio_PrivateKey_ex; now the public key becomes optional when a private key is requested. (architecture-related: public API behavior)

Check for the existence of the private key before calling the eddsa signing function, and added related test cases to cover scenarios such as missing private keys and short keys. (architecture-related: external behavior)

Fixed the issue where selection parameters were not correctly propagated during key export, ensuring that private keys are not attempted to be exported when only public keys are needed, and updated the caching mechanism to avoid subsequent operations misusing incomplete information. (architecture-related: public API)
Added the missing default fallback implementation for ghash on the x86_64 platform. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)
Changed the thread pool support functions to compile only when thread pools are enabled, fixing related issues. (architecture-related: build and installation methods)

Fixed a compilation warning on platforms where uint32_t is defined as unsigned long int due to the use of OSSL_PARAM_construct_uint, and switched to OSSL_PARAM_construct_uint32. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)

Fixed an issue with retrieving the PSS salt length from the provider, resolving a discrepancy where the provider interpreted magic number constants differently than the OpenSSL core, and added related tests. (architecture-related: compatibility between the provider and the core)
Removed unnecessary cancellation state and type settings in POSIX threads, fixing an Android compilation failure. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)
Fixed an issue where HPKE tests failed when chacha20 or poly1305 was disabled, and corrected the conditional compilation macros. (architecture-related: build conditions)
Fixed the implementations of SSL_tick and SSL_get_tick_timeout in the QUIC front-end I/O API so that they correctly return success status. (architecture-related: public API)

Adjusted error returns and error codes in QUIC handshake handling, added cleanup support for send streams, and modified the timeout query interface to accept SSL objects. (architecture-related: interface change)
Treat received unknown frame types as protocol violations, directly triggering a protocol error instead of ignoring and continuing processing. (architecture-related: QUIC protocol behavior)

Fixed handling of zero-value BIGNUM in the parameter API, ensuring that a zero-value BIGNUM allocates at least one data byte when building parameters via OSSL_PARAM_BLD, and correctly represents zero in OSSL_PARAM_set_BN. (architecture-related: public API)

Fixed the constants used for comparing name printing flags in X509_REQ_print_ex and X509_print_ex, replacing X509_FLAG_COMPAT with the correct XN_FLAG_COMPAT, and fixed a bug caused by X509_NAME_print_ex returning different error values under different flags. (architecture-related: public API)
Prohibit enabling partial write mode (EPW) while an AON write operation is in progress, and removed the related fix function. (architecture-related: QUIC write operation behavior)

Fixed the condition for determining read completion in the QUIC front-end I/O API, ensuring that completion status is correctly returned when the write length is zero. (architecture-related: public API)
Fixed an issue where EVP_KDF_CTX_get_kdf_size() incorrectly returned 0 when SSKDF was used in combination with KMAC; it now correctly returns SIZE_MAX. (architecture-related: public API)
Improved the detection logic for legacy keys when loading private keys via the engine. (architecture-related: public API)

Fixed an issue on s390x platforms when implementing Keccak XOF via CPACF, by using an empty input block for single-block operations to simulate XOF behavior. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)
Reverted the change that added datagram support to BIO_s_mem(), restoring the original streaming memory BIO behavior. (architecture-related: external behavior)
Fixed the bin2bn function: when the input length is zero, directly return a zeroed BIGNUM, making calls with s==NULL and len==0 safer. (architecture-related: public API)
Fixed the issue where the bn2bin function did not accept negative lengths, and added related tests. (architecture-related: public API)

Prohibited creating DSA and DH keys lacking parameters; when importing keys, parameters must be provided simultaneously; the decoder no longer creates DSA keys lacking parameters. (architecture-related: external behavior)
Prohibited calling SRTP-related functions in QUIC TLS connections. (architecture-related: public API)
Fixed the Ed448 pre-hashing functionality on the S390X platform, falling back to a non-accelerated implementation when performing pre-hashing. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)
Relabeled X25519 and X448 as FIPS-approved algorithms, restoring their use in FIPS mode. (architecture-related: FIPS compliance)

Fixed the incomplete return value check in EVP_CIPHER_asn1_to_param, changing two conditions that only checked <0 to <=0, and correctly handling EVP_CIPHER_get_asn1_iv returning zero as success. (architecture-related: public API)
Fixed PKCS12_newpass() to support PBES2-encrypted PKCS12 files, and added support for libctx and propq parameters. (architecture-related: public API)
The IV length of ChaCha20-Poly1305 must now be 12 bytes; truncation is no longer supported, and passing other lengths will return an error. (architecture-related: public API: IV length constraint)

Fixed a regression in OSSL_CMP_certConf_cb when checking newly registered certificates, improved certificate verification logic, and added corresponding tests. (architecture-related: public API: CMP certificate verification)

Fix the state setting issue in CMP server and client during transaction processing, including correctly setting recipNonce when message verification fails, and supplementing the missing rejection state when the client rejects a new certificate. (architecture-related: public API)

Fix the error in double-key triple DES random key generation that occurs when only two keys are set; fix error checks in functions such as RSA_public_decrypt and ASN1_item_i2d; fix a possible null pointer dereference in functions related to EVP_PKEY. (architecture-related: public API)
Fix a possible double free issue in CMS_add1_crl, and a use-after-free memory error in the SSL library. (architecture-related: public API)
Fix a memory leak caused by repeated calls to SSL_CTX_set1_groups_list, by freeing the original memory before overwriting the pointer. (architecture-related: public API)
Fix SSL_add_dir_cert_subjects_to_stack to skip subdirectories, avoiding loading directories as certificate files. (architecture-related: public API)

Fix a double-free vulnerability in the OSSL_HTTP_get function by initializing the request context pointer to NULL and setting it to NULL after freeing to avoid repeated freeing. (architecture-related: public API)

Fix several minor issues in thread-assisted mode: add an interface to check whether the client is connected, ensure proper cleanup of thread-assisted resources during release, and correct the condition variable release method. (architecture-related: public API)

When context copying fails during signing and verification operations, no longer return an error immediately; instead, continue using the original context to avoid interrupting the process due to copy failure. (architecture-related: public API behavior)
Fix an infinite loop in DSA signing caused by invalid parameters (such as q=1 or priv=0), by adding retry count limits and parameter validation. (architecture-related: public API behavior)
Fix a possible infinite loop in ECDSA signing due to invalid group parameters, by adding a minimum order check and a maximum retry count limit. (architecture-related: public API behavior)
Fix a typo in the certificate verification error string, and add support for the Raw public key untrusted error code. (architecture-related: public API)
Fix a type conversion error when assigning size in EVP_DigestFinal_ex. (architecture-related: public API)
Fix an issue in EVP_PBE_CipherInit_ex where the fallback mechanism fails because the return value of EVP_get_digestbynid is not assigned to md. (architecture-related: public API)
Handle the case where EVP_PKEY_get_default_digest_name returns UNDEF, allowing certain algorithms to not specify a digest. (architecture-related: public API)
Add a finalized flag to the EVP digest context to prevent an already finalized context from being incorrectly reused. (architecture-related: public API)

Provide more specific error codes for QUIC handshake failures, such as returning SSL_R_REMOTE_PEER_ADDRESS_NOT_SET when the peer address is not set, and returning SSL_R_BIO_NOT_SET when BIO is not set. (architecture-related: public API)
Fix the behavior of the SSL_has_pending function under QUIC connections so that it correctly detects whether there is pending data. (architecture-related: public API)
Fix a regression in the OBJ_nid2obj function where it returns NULL for NID_undef, so that it returns a UNDEF object. (architecture-related: public API behavior change)
Adjust the parameter order of the HPKE API, moving libctx and propq to the end as optional parameters, to maintain consistency with other HPKE API. (architecture-related: public API)
Fix the SM4 capability detection condition, restricting it to the __aarch64__ architecture, and remove checks for __arm__ and __ARM_MAX_ARCH__. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)
Fix an issue in EVP_CIPHER_CTX_ctrl where setting the key length and IV length skips calling the underlying provider if the value is the same as the current one. (architecture-related: public API)
Fix an issue in the UEFI environment where OPENSSL_die does not correctly call abort(). (architecture-related: platform compatibility)
Fix the return type of the OSSL_CRMF_CERTTEMPLATE_get0_publicKey function, removing the const qualifier. (architecture-related: public API)

Fix a regression in loading SSL certificate directories when building without POSIX IO: skip the current directory and parent directory when reading directories, avoiding the use of stat() to check whether a file is a directory. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)

In TLS 1.3 and above, no longer send an empty renegotiation info SCSV; only copy the minimum and maximum protocol versions when the method type of the SSL object is the same as SSL_CTX; tighten the range for determining valid DTLS versions. (architecture-related: protocol behavior)

Initialize the rstate variable in the record layer to ensure that SSL_rstate_string*() API returns values consistent with older versions; adjust the return value of the QUIC record layer state string to be consistent with the TLS version. (architecture-related: public API)

Fix an issue where the CMP client returns an error response when using the -csr option without providing a private key; refactor the private key retrieval logic and add a public key retrieval function; fix an issue where the old certificate is checked for a new certificate when there is no private key. (architecture-related: public API)

Sort relevant stacks before multiple lookup operations to ensure correctness, involving X509 storage, EVP_PBE_find_ex, provider lookup, X509_policy_check, X509V3_EXT_get_nid, and X509_TRUST_get_by_id. (architecture-related: public API)
Fix multiple issues related to EC and RSA encryption algorithms, including buffer sizes, key type conversion, parameter translation, and digest initialization. (architecture-related: public API)
Fix a bug related to atomic operations and thread disabling, and add an atomic load function. (architecture-related: internal API)
Fix a retry flag copying issue in zlib and ok BIO flush operations, making flush operations retryable. (architecture-related: BIO behavior)

Fix a stack corruption issue in the UI module, ensuring that when UI_new returns NULL it is handled correctly, avoiding stack corruption caused by an uninitialized password buffer. (architecture-related: public API)
Fix a macro attribute conflict with cmocka, replacing __attribute__((malloc)) in the OSSL_CRYPTO_ALLOC macro with __attribute__((__malloc__)). (architecture-related: public API)
Fix the parameter type of the macsaltlen option so that it accepts a positive integer instead of no argument. (architecture-related: command-line interface)

Optimize the OSSL_sleep function, using a combination of sleep() and usleep() on Unix systems to solve long-delay compatibility issues, and simplify the sleep implementation on the Windows platform. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)
Fix an error in parameter validation in the EVP_MD_CTX_get_params function, correcting the erroneously called function pointer to the correct get_ctx_params. (architecture-related: public API)

Fix the implementation of the QUIC time callback override, changing the function return value from void to int, and adding thread-safe lock protection, while ensuring that the callback is correctly used to obtain the time when creating a channel. (architecture-related: public API)
In PBKDF2 key derivation and PKCS12 MAC generation, ignore fetch errors from EVP_MD_fetch when using legacy algorithms, to avoid polluting the error stack. (architecture-related: external behavior)
Fix a memory leak of the encrypted content key in CMS_ContentInfo_free, and enhance defensive checks for null pointers in ossl_cms_get0_env_enc_content. (architecture-related: public API)

Fix an issue where the RAND_poll function fails to reseed correctly in non-no-deprecated builds, ensuring that it can call RAND_seed to reseed. (architecture-related: public API: RAND_poll reseeding behavior fix)

Fix OSSL_CMP_MSG_http_perform(), add the OSSL_CMP_OPT_USE_TLS option to control whether to use TLS, and optimize the logic for determining TLS usage. (architecture-related: public API: new OSSL_CMP_OPT_USE_TLS option)

Fixed the issue where decoders did not correctly pass the property query parameter (propq), added a settable context parameter interface for all decoders, ensuring internal functions can use the passed property query parameter. (architecture-related: decoder interface)
Fixed the issue where the BN_RECP_CTX_set function did not check whether parameter d is zero, returning failure early when d is zero. (architecture-related: public API)

Fixed the issue in TLSv1.2 of incorrectly using supported_groups, which is only applicable to TLSv1.3, and added a check for group version compatibility. (architecture-related: TLS version compatibility)

Fixed the issue where the CONF_modules_load_file_ex function attempted to load an empty file name when the default configuration file path is empty, changing it to directly return success without error. (architecture-related: public API)
Fixed the return value error of the ossl_config_int() function in UEFI systems, ensuring correct return values in UEFI environments. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)
Disable the concatenated AES-GCM implementation on the PPC32 architecture because that implementation is unavailable. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)
Automatically disable tick suppression in QUIC blocking operations to avoid indefinite hangs. (architecture-related: QUIC behavior)

Mask most mutable API operations while a QUIC connection is in the shutdown flush phase to prevent unsafe reads/writes, handshakes, or stream creation during shutdown. (architecture-related: QUIC shutdown behavior)
Fix LSX detection on LoongArch by using getauxval(AT_HWCAP) instead of the cpucfg instruction to check both hardware and kernel support. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)
Fix the issue where a selection value of 0 after decoding caused data loss when exporting/importing keys; now all selection flags are used. (architecture-related: external behavior: key export)

In the DH_check function, when the modulus is too large, in addition to returning an error code, also set the corresponding error bit in the output parameter to improve the robustness of caller error handling. (architecture-related: public API: DH_check error handling)
Fix unreachable and redundant code in the x509 certificate and CRL loading functions, and optimize error handling logic. (architecture-related: public API)

Fix the return value regression for X509_VERIFY_PARAM_add0_policy and X509_VERIFY_PARAM_add0_table to ensure they return 1 on success instead of the number of stack entries. (architecture-related: public API)
Fix the issue where SSL_has_pending() could produce an error when called before the connection is established; ensure it returns 0. (architecture-related: public API)

Fix the conflict between the error return value in the ossl_cmp_asn1_get_int() function and the OSSL_CMP_CERTREQID_NONE constant by changing the error return value from -1 to -2, and update the caller ossl_cmp_pkisi_get_status() to handle this change correctly. (architecture-related: external behavior)

Fix the issue where the PEM_read_bio_Parameters function should not prompt for a password when reading parameters; it now fails directly instead of asking for a password. (architecture-related: public API)

Fix the no-autoload-config option so that it no longer automatically loads configuration during engine and provider lookups, and correct the locking mechanism for provider lookups. (architecture-related: engine and provider lookups)
Fix the error caused by certificate auxiliary data during PKCS#12 creation by prioritizing the friendly name and local key ID passed by the caller. (architecture-related: public API)

Fix the recursive deadlock caused by memory allocation failure in OPENSSL_init_crypto(OPENSSL_INIT_LOAD_CRYPTO_STRINGS) by introducing a staging and recovery mechanism for the error string loading area to avoid recursive calls. (architecture-related: initialization behavior)

Fixed the backward compatibility issue with the OSSL_HTTP_REQ_CTX_set_request_line function, which now allows path parameters to begin with http:// for proxy scenarios. (architecture-related: public API behavior)
Added checks for the return value of i2d_X509_NAME in X509_NAME_hash_ex and X509_NAME_hash_old to avoid using invalid data when encoding fails. (architecture-related: public API behavior)
Fixed configuration of BIO helper functions in the QUIC context: avoid using buffering and set the datagram socket type. (architecture-related: public API)
Fixed a memory leak in the error path of the OSSL_DECODER_CTX_new_for_pkey() function. (architecture-related: public API)
Added the missing privilegeWithdrawn and aACompromise entries to the OCSP CRLReason table. (architecture-related: public API)
Avoid sending duplicate CONNECTION_CLOSE frames; clear the pending-send flag after sending. (architecture-related: QUIC protocol behavior)

Fixed retry flag propagation for BIO in dgram_bio connections, added TCP Fast Open support, simplified release logic, and adjusted the IPv6 detection macro. (architecture-related: TCP Fast Open support)

Fixed the issue in QUIC reads where a FIN had been received but the buffer was empty, failing to correctly return SSL_ERROR_ZERO_RETURN, thereby avoiding excessive blocking of SSL_read. (architecture-related: public API: SSL_read behavior fix)

Adjusted error handling during QUIC stream creation, updated the error code value for stream count limits, and changed the related error reporting from non-IO errors to non-normal errors. (architecture-related: public API)

Fixed the QUIC stream backpressure condition, changed the related error type from non-normal errors to non-I/O errors, and updated the corresponding error code; added the QUIC_RAISE_NON_IO_ERROR error macro. (architecture-related: public API)
Fixed a merge error in the quic-multi-stream.c example caused by function renaming, updating SSL_set_initial_peer_addr() to SSL_set1_initial_peer_addr(). (architecture-related: public API)
Fixed an assembler error when including loongarch_arch.h in assembly files by protecting external variable declarations with conditional compilation. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)

Implemented the chacha20 method for the dupctx cipher, supporting EVP_PKEY_CTX_copy functionality, and correctly handling deep copies of the tlsmac pointer to avoid double free. (architecture-related: public API)

Fixed an issue where OPENSSL_init_crypto, during implicit initialization, loaded configuration into the current default library context instead of the initial global default library context. (architecture-related: public API)
QUIC: SSL_clear is no longer a no-op; it now returns an error and reports unsupported. (architecture-related: public API)
Fixed the regression in the OSSL_PARAM_BLD_push_BN_pad() function that disallowed passing a NULL BIGNUM, which now supports NULL parameters again. (architecture-related: public API)
Fixed seed source usage in the FIPS module to ensure the user-requested seed source is used instead of the default. (architecture-related: FIPS seed source behavior)
Change the HTTP server listening address from the IPv6 wildcard to a generic wildcard, fixing test failures on IPv4-only machines. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)
Fix the bio_dgram_test failure on the NonStop platform and adjust the default buffer size. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)
Remove the C11 _Static_assert-related macro definitions and their usage to resolve compatibility issues on certain platforms. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)
