Fixed the issue where linear search did not work correctly in the CHARSET_EBCDIC environment, and improved error handling and locking in OBJ_create. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)
Added an error code for invalid attribute queries in the random number module. (architecture-related: public API)

Fixed a memory leak issue caused when the FIPS provider is used in different threads, ensuring the main thread is registered to receive thread stop notifications. (architecture-related: FIPS provider thread safety)

Fixed the inconsistent printing behavior of EVP_PKEY_print_private in OpenSSL 3.0; it now prints only the parts the backend considers private key components, and adjusted the output logic of the DSA and ECX encoders to match expected behavior. (architecture-related: public API)

Removed the initialization of FFC parameters in the DH and DSA init methods to maintain behavior consistent with the 1.1.1 version, and support methods for intercepting existing keys. (architecture-related: external behavior)

Modified the semantics of the FFC public key verification function so that it no longer returns failure on non-fatal errors, but instead sets an error code and returns success, thereby preventing DH_check_pub_key from failing due to non-fatal issues. (architecture-related: external behavior)

Fixed CVE-2023-5363: handle key length and IV length parameters early during EVP cipher initialization to avoid security issues where AEAD ciphers truncate the IV or use uninitialized bytes due to late parameter processing. (architecture-related: public API)

Fixed the compilation failure of ssl.h in the MingW environment caused by using gets as a parameter name; changed the parameter name in the BIO_meth_set_gets function prototype to ossl_gets. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)
Fixed a CMS-related bug: added the missing error reporting call in CMS_add1_signer and fixed the algorithm OID check. (architecture-related: public API)
Added length checks for overly large Q parameters in the DH key computation and generation functions, and unified the behavior of DH_check_pub_key. (architecture-related: public API)
Fixed the issue where the EVP_PKEY_get_bits, EVP_PKEY_get_security_bits, and EVP_PKEY_get_size functions did not add error entries to the error queue on failure. (architecture-related: public API)
Fixed warnings caused by using the %n format specifier during cross-compilation, and rewrote the path concatenation logic. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)
Fixed the drainage calculation logic in QUIC transmission, using a more accurate send buffer condition. (architecture-related: QUIC transmission behavior)
Fixed the issue where encryption operations did not correctly return errors when the key was not set or the key length was changed. (architecture-related: encryption behavior)

Fix the issue of setting non-blocking mode for socket on the Nonstop platform, using fcntl(F_GETFL) instead of FIONBIO; also fix error handling in BIO_accept when host or port is NULL. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)
Fix a memory leak of ASN1_TIME objects that may occur in PKCS7_add0_attrib_signing_time when PKCS7_add_signed_attribute fails. (architecture-related: public API)
Fix a possible memory leak in PKCS7_add_attrib_smimecap when PKCS7_add_signed_attribute fails. (architecture-related: public API)
Fix a memory leak in CMS_sign_receipt caused by not releasing ASN1_OCTET_STRING objects on the error path. (architecture-related: public API)
Change the scope of the no_legacy_server_connect option from server-side to client-side. (architecture-related: external behavior)
No longer automatically detect the ARMV7_TICK feature; use it only when explicitly enabled by the user via OPENSSL_armcap. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)
Simplify the use of EVP_PKEY_decrypt() in CMS, PKCS7, and CRMF through helper functions, and remove unnecessary constant_time_* and ERR_clear_error() calls in OSSL_CRMF_ENCRYPTEDVALUE_get1_encCert().
Conditionally compile out code that depends on CHACHA in test/bio_dgram_test.c and test/quic_record_test.c.
Fix a possible infinite loop in BN_mod_sqrt() when p is not prime (CVE-2022-0778).
Enforce an output buffer size check in EVP_MAC_final() to ensure it is large enough to hold the MAC output.
Add missing checks during SM2 digital signature generation to comply with clauses 6.1 and 6.2 of GMT 0003.2-2012.
Modify DES_set_key() so that its return value is consistent with DES_set_key_checked(), but always set the key schedule to avoid accidental use of an uninitialized key schedule.

Fix the carry overflow error of bn_sqr_comba4/8 on mips 32-bit targets, and also fix the issue that mips64 targets do not correctly handle carry propagation, involving crypto/bn/asm/mips.pl and test/bntest.c.
Fix a memory leak in EC_POINT_hex2point where pt is not freed, involving crypto/ec/ec_print.c.
Fix the cleanup logic in context_init error handling, prohibiting the use of OSSL_LIB_CTX_free() on contexts that are not fully initialized, involving crypto/context.c.
Add validation of the category parameter passed to OSSL_trace_end(); return immediately if invalid, involving crypto/trace.c.
Fix the code for detecting aarch64 features when getauxval() is unavailable, adding missing prototype declarations and a closing brace '}', involving crypto/armcap.c.

Change the internal error reason for disabling legacy signature algorithms to a more specific configuration error message, involving ssl/statem/statem_clnt.c, ssl/statem/statem_lib.c, and related error code definition files.
Change the definition of OSSL_SIGNATURE_PARAM_NONCE_TYPE from "nonce_type" to "nonce-type" to be consistent with the documentation, involving include/openssl/core_names.h.

Ensure that ossl_obj_nid_lock is allocated before use, split OBJ_new_nid into external and internal variants, with the external variant calling ossl_obj_write_lock to initialize the lock, involving crypto/objects/obj_dat.c.

Remove the redundant copy of the key schedule pointer in PROV_GCM_CTX to avoid issues caused by unsynchronized updates during dupctx, involving multiple GCM hardware implementation files and header files.
Set RC4-related macro definitions on libcrypto/liblegacy, and add the missing prototype declaration for rc4_md5_enc, involving crypto/rc4/build.info and cipher_rc4_hmac_md5.h.
Fix the issue where loading a private key may produce spurious errors, by properly managing the error stack to avoid them.
Fix the issue where fingerprint calculation failure is incorrectly treated as an invalid certificate, and update test cases.
Fix the descriptions and diagnostic information for options such as -key, -in in the openssl req and openssl x509 commands, and add clearer warning messages.
Fix the issue when generating AKID through v2i_AUTHORITY_KEYID(), correctly handle the AKID suppression logic in self-signed certificate scenarios.
Improve the diagnostic information of the OpenSSL command-line tool for missing/redundant parameters and unknown passwords or digests, making error reports clearer and more accurate.
Improve file access error messages for load_key_certs_crls-related functions, and remove the redundant load_key_certs_crls_suppress function.

Move the decoder input structure matching check to the processing stage, ensuring that skipping occurs only when the decoder of the first specified input structure in the chain does not match the user-specified structure.
Explicitly specify data structure names for certificates and CRL objects in PEM to DER decoders, and add support for the SM2 parameter.

In the file: scheme of OSSL_STORE, set the decoder context input structure name based on the certificate or CRL type the user expects to load, avoiding password prompts for unrelated password-protected objects.
Fix the resource cleanup issue when BIO creation fails.
Fix the double free issue in EVP_PKEY_CTX_dup() caused by not nullifying the pointer after a failed release.
Fix the reference count error when copying the DH key exchange context.
Improve the boundary check of parameter num_ in the bio_write function, correctly handling negative input.
Fix the nc_email function by adding a check for null bytes in the middle of ASN1 strings.
Fix the parameter comparison logic in the dh_cmp_parameters function so that it correctly compares the parameters of two keys.
Fix a potential double-free issue when obtaining the PRNG seed fails.
Fix the issue where a pointer may be incorrectly freed when DRBG instantiation fails.
Fix the incomplete return value checks of EVP_PKEY_fromdata_init and EVP_PKEY_fromdata, ensuring that negative error returns are correctly handled.
Fix the BN_CTX leak and add missing memory allocation failure checks.
Fix potential BIO resource leaks in cmp_vfy.c and encoder_lib.c.
Fix a memory leak caused by not freeing the path string during configuration loading.
Fix a potential memory leak when processing the includedir field in configuration files.
Fix the handling of ENGINE references in the pkey_set_type function, ensuring correct reference counting.
Fix a lock leak in evp_keymgmt_util_export_to_provider caused by not releasing the lock when caching fails.
Change the -reqexts option to an alias of -extensions, unifying extended configuration handling.
Fix the issue of repeatedly copying the embedded EVP_PKEY in X509_dup.
Fix the double-free issue of memory BIO in OCSP_sendreq_bio.
Add checks for return values of functions such as BN_new and sk_RSA_PRIME_INFO_new_reserve to prevent memory errors caused by allocation failures.
Fix a crash when encoding a EC public key if the public key value is empty, and change it to return an error instead.
Fix a memory leak caused by not releasing the Post-Handshake Auth digest when saving the handshake digest fails.
Fix a segmentation fault caused by a null pointer in ctx->p2 when calling fix_dh_rfc5114.
When setting the TLSv1.3 cipher suite, no longer include disabled cipher suites.
Fix memory leaks in the SSL module, including the ssl_create_cipher_list and tls_parse_stoc_key_share functions.
Remove the isinited variable in child_prov_globals and always acquire the lock; also fix resource release and function call parameters during child provider creation.
Fix the issue where deactivation could not be correctly performed when provider has no associated store, ensuring that cleanup operations are completed even when store is empty.
Actively unregister child callbacks before releasing the child libctx to avoid receiving callbacks when libctx is half-released.
Change the read lock to a write lock in ossl_provider_find to correctly synchronize stack sorting operations that may occur in multi-threaded scenarios.
Fix the concurrency count confusion caused by not holding flag_lock when calling child provider callbacks, and adjust the lock release timing to ensure correctness.

Fix the do_X509_REQ_verify and do_X509_verify functions to correctly return -1 on initialization failure, and add the cert_matches_key function to replace X509_check_private_key to optimize key matching logic.
Adjust SKID calculation to prioritize the public key of subject_cert, and only use the public key of subject_req when the certificate is empty, to clarify parameter semantics.
Fix the return value check of OBJ_obj2txt, and use TEST_int_gt in tests to correctly verify the return value.
Add missing null pointer checks for return values in multiple functions, fixing potential null pointer dereference issues.
Reset rwstate to SSL_NOTHING before calling ASYNC_start_job, fixing the issue where the state was not correctly reset after an asynchronous job was paused and resumed.
Fix the incomplete return value check of EVP_Cipher, ensuring that all error cases are correctly handled in CMAC_Final.
Fix the return value check logic of asn1_item_embed_d2i to ensure that error conditions are correctly identified.
Fixed the return value check of the random byte generation function to ensure correct handling of error conditions.
Fixed the return value check of the EVP_PKEY_paramgen_init function to ensure correct detection of initialization failure.
Fixed the return value check of EVP_PKEY_keygen_init to correctly handle error cases that may return negative values.
Fixed the return value check of the RAND_bytes_ex function, changing the incorrect logical NOT check to a correct <=0 check.
Fixed the return value check of SSL_export_keying_material, changing the logical NOT check to a comparison with zero to ensure correct detection of failure.
Fixed the return value check of BIO_read_filename, changing !BIO_read_filename to <= 0 to ensure correct error detection.
Fixed the issue where SSL BIO does not support the BIO_gets method, causing HTTP clients to fail to load non-ASN.1 content under TLS, by falling back to the BIO_get_line function as an alternative.
By introducing dynamic engine identifiers and a dedicated linked list, prevent the same dynamic engine from being loaded repeatedly, fixing memory corruption issues caused by repeated loading.
Fixed the issue with the order of PSS parameter settings in RSA signature verification initialization, using unrestricted PSS parameters by default until key setup is complete.
Fixed the logical dead code reported by Coverity, adjusting the exponent bit calculation in the RSAZ_mod_exp_x2_ifma256 function and adding an assertion to ensure rem is not zero.
Fixed multiple issues where the return value of ossl_bio_new_from_core_bio() was not checked, and added the new function msblob2key_does_selection.

Fixed the diagnostic output and return value of parse_http_line1 in error cases, added a new retry timeout check function may_still_retry, and added tracking of text content types in OSSL_HTTP_REQ_CTX_nbio.
Check the return value of BN_dup() to avoid using a null pointer when memory allocation fails.
Added checks for the return value of BIO_new() in cmp_vfy.c and t_x509.c, logging an error and returning when memory allocation fails; also removed redundant ERR_raise calls.

Fixed the signature algorithm type retrieval function to return the algorithm name instead of a null pointer for unknown algorithms; also fixed the certificate release function to use the new stack release interface, and unified the code style.
Fixed the issue where the passphrase callback in the PVK encoder was not correctly initialized, refactored the password acquisition logic, and improved error handling and memory cleanup.
Fixed the issue where the caller's key was incorrectly freed in the error path when setting temporary DH keys.

Fixed the error handling of network-related options (such as -server) in the CMP tool when compiled without socket, and performed multiple code cleanups and functional enhancements; optimized the documentation descriptions of multiple options in the openssl-cmp command; added notes in the CMP application and API documentation about the criticality of server authentication when receiving trust anchor certificates.
Fixed the -rspin option so that it also works correctly when -reqin is not used simultaneously.
Fixed the mutual exclusion logic for the -server, -use_mock_srv, -port, and -rspin options, and improved the related documentation.
Fixed the issue where s_server could not correctly skip the GET / prefix when returning file paths in -WWW mode.
Fixed the issue where s_client did not correctly send SNI data when using the -proxy option.
Fixed error handling in the shacrypt function, changing direct returns to jumps to the error cleanup path to ensure allocated resources are released on failure.
Fixed the issue where resources allocated via CRYPTO_malloc were not correctly released on certain error paths.
Fixed incomplete return value checks for EVP_PKEY_CTX_ctrl in multiple places, changing the condition from <0 to <=0 to correctly catch all error cases.
Fixed the issue where EVP_MD_CTX resources were not correctly released in the tls1_mac function, ensuring the resource is also released on error paths.
Fixed resource leak issues in multiple core modules and optimized the string comparison method.
Fixed indentation issues in providers/implementations/digests/sha3_prov.c and providers/implementations/kdfs/pbkdf2.c.
Fixed the issue where Decoder, Encoder, and Store loader failed due to internal assertion errors when fetching with a query string, and added related test cases.
Fixed a regression in the -kdflen option of the pkeyutl command, and also adjusted the parameter checking method and the buffer size for reading input data.
Fixed the logic for nulling the pointer when cleaning up old MD data, ensuring that md_data is set to NULL only after memory is released.
Fixed a condition judgment error when record counting was not handled in the kTLS RX offload path.
Fixed the evp_keymgmt_util_match function so that after the first cross-export attempt fails, it correctly attempts cross-export in the other direction.
Fixed a null pointer dereference issue by adding null checks in the load_cert_certs and next_item functions.

Fixed the issue in s_server where records of 2^14 bytes in length could not be correctly processed due to BIO_gets null termination, and adjusted buffer allocation and read sizes to support full record length.
Fixed the BIO_FLAGS macro definition conflict, corrected the duplicate macro definition, and added comments in the public header file to avoid future conflicts.
Added a return value check for X509_STORE_lock to prevent dirty data when lock acquisition fails.
Added checks for whether the global pointer is NULL in multiple BIO core operation functions to avoid null pointer dereferences.
Added a null pointer check for memory allocation failure in the UI data copy function, and return 0 on failure.
Fixed an undefined behavior issue in the hash function in lhash caused by shifting a 32-bit value right by 32 bits.
Fixed the IV length of the DES EDE ECB implementation, setting it to 0 to comply with the specification that the ECB mode does not use IV.
Fixed the issue where the ciphers command ignored the -propquery option, ensuring the option takes effect correctly.
Cached the IV length in the EVP encryption context to avoid expensive parameter queries on each lookup, and fixed related bug.
Used opt_int_arg() to parse integer arguments in the speed command to avoid incorrect handling of hexadecimal input, and updated the help information to describe the input format.
Fixed the issue where the default_context_thread_local thread-local data was not properly cleaned up.
Output auxiliary messages to standard error stream, fixing the output target for certificate request self-signature verification.
Fixed the issue in openssl rehash where memory allocation failures were not checked, added a check on the return value of OPENSSL_strdup and free memory on failure.
Added a null pointer check for the return value of rand_get_global to avoid potential null pointer dereference, and return an error on failure to obtain.
Added missing null pointer checks for calls such as BIO_new to avoid null pointer dereference issues caused by returning NULL.
During CMP initialization, if no protection certificate or old certificate is provided, use the subject of the CSR as the default message sender.
Check the return value of CRYPTO_strdup() to fix potential null pointer dereference issues caused by memory allocation failures.
In async_posix, when stack memory allocation fails, a memory allocation error report is now triggered.
Renamed the function parameter name strlen to strlength to avoid conflict with the C++ reserved word.
Fixed a potential null pointer dereference in BN_mod_exp2_mont when parameter m is zero, and added a regression test.

Fixed the issue in openssl s_server -WWW where an attempt to call SSL_sendfile when KTLS was not actually enabled caused request failures; added a KTLS availability check and issued a warning when it is unavailable.
In s_client and s_server, added a check on the return value of BIO_new_file(), outputting an error message and exiting when file opening fails.
Fixed a memory leak in the append_ia5 function caused by not freeing the allocated stack when memory allocation fails.
Fixed the issue in PEM_read_bio_ex where the return value of BIO_read was not checked, added failure handling and optimized the error path.
Fixed the init_client() function's TCP protocol detection logic, using BIO_ADDRINFO_protocol() to correctly obtain the protocol type to set the NODELAY option.
Fixed the issue of invalid IV length caching in EVP encryption code, avoiding cache invalidation due to excessive invalidation.
Fixed an issue where padding for DH key exchange was not always enabled when using X9.42 KDF; padding is now forcibly enabled.
Fixed the bug caused by incorrect parameter types in the dup method of the scrypt KDF provider, refactored the function signature and added correct parameter conversion.
Added a detection function in dynamic engine loading to avoid false errors caused by misjudging OpenSSL 1.1.x engines.
Fixed the issue of uninitialized reads in SSL_shutdown and SSL_do_handshake.
Fixed the issue of inconsistent parameter declarations in the Camellia decryption function.
Fixed the openssl check -rsa command to support checking both RSA and RSA-PSS keys.
Fixed the issue where the -proxy and -starttls options could not be used together in openssl s_client, moving HTTP proxy connection handling before STARTTLS protocol selection.
Fixed the null pointer dereference issue caused by not checking when evp_pkey_get_legacy() returns NULL, and added null pointer checks in multiple Ed25519/Ed448 signing and verification functions.
Fixed the crash issue of ERR_load_strings() when configuring no-err, skipping the initialization and cleanup of the error string hash table through conditional compilation.
Fixed the issue of incorrect error reporting in CMS I/O functions, and added related test cases.
Fixed the issue where client certificate chain checking failed due to ca_dn being NULL when the server did not send CA names under TLS-1.3.
Fixed the potential null pointer dereference issue in sshkdf when memory allocation fails.
Fixed the unchecked return value issue reported by Coverity, explicitly ignoring the return value of EVP_CipherInit_ex.
Fixed the issue of not checking the return value of bn_rshift_fixed_top, correctly jumping to error handling when the function fails.
Allowed setting the SM2 distributed ID parameter to an empty string.
Fixed the null pointer dereference issue in the create_cert_store function caused by X509_STORE_new possibly returning NULL, added null checks and returned errors on failure.
Fixed the potential null pointer dereference issue in the PBKDF2 implementation caused by EVP_KDF_fetch returning a null pointer, added return value checks.
Fixed the potential null pointer dereference issue in the ssl_set_cert_and_key function caused by not checking the return value of EVP_PKEY_copy_parameters.
Fixed the assertion failure in the DTLS server caused by MTU exceeding the maximum fragment length, and added a regression test.
Fixed the wild pointer dereference issue in the make_ocsp_response function that may occur due to not checking the return value of OCSP_basic_add1_status.
Fix the MAC key usage issue in the RC4-MD5 cipher suite caused by a copy-paste error, which incorrectly used TLS AAD data as the MAC key.
Remove the misused function ossl_provider_clear_all_operation_bits and all its calls, fixing the issue where operation bits were incorrectly cleared when the method cache was refreshed.
Fix the error in the OPENSSL_LH_flush function where the num_items counter was not reset.
Fix the error that may occur when calling finalization in an uninitialized SipHash context; now it correctly returns failure.
Fix the issue where the mac size of sipcopy was not correctly set during siphash copying, and ensure the context is fully copied.
Fix the issue where the entire structure was not fully copied during poly1305 context copying, and reset the update flag during initialization.
Fix the issue where the method store was incorrectly cleared when refreshing the query cache, rename related functions, and adjust internal fields to clarify their purpose.
Fix the issue where the locale was not initialized before calling evp_pkey_name2type.
Distinguish fatal errors from non-fatal errors during record layer creation, so that non-fatal errors can be handled by other record layer attempts.
Add cache flushing and removal functionality to the method stores for encoders, decoders, and store loaders, ensuring proper cleanup when providers are deactivated or modified.
Fix the issue where optional attributes might be incorrectly ignored when a new provider is added; now always attempt to construct methods.
Fix compilation failures caused by disabling compression functionality, and add conditional compilation guards to the relevant code.
Fix the issue of incorrectly passing the digest during Ed25519/Ed448 signing in CRMF, ensuring that such keys do not use a digest during POPO signing.
In s_server, when connection initialization fails and no read has been attempted, an error is now reported to distinguish configuration errors from client-caused errors.
Fix the crash in the fix_dh_paramgen_type function caused by invalid parameter types, add checks for invalid values, and return an error.
Adjust the header include order, placing internal/e_os.h before string.h, to fix compilation issues.
Fix the issue where the clang-14 compiler incorrectly optimized code due to strict aliasing rules; change the relevant functions to inline macros to prevent code from being unexpectedly removed.
Adjust the loop condition to make the risk of zero-length loops more explicit, fixing related issues.
Fixed the issue where the -CAfile option was ignored in the x509 application; now -CAfile takes effect correctly when using the -new or -in option.
Fixed a memory leak in the crl_set_issuers function caused by not releasing temporary objects when allocation or insertion of the issuers stack fails.
Fixed a leak in the X509_issuer_and_serial_hash function due to improper memory release.
Fixed a security issue in GOST key exchange regarding buffer size determination; switched to dynamically allocated buffers to avoid overflow.
Fixed a crash in ssl_security_cert_chain caused by a null pointer in the certificate chain; added a null pointer check.
Fixed incorrect return value checking in EVP_CIPHER_CTX_rand_key to ensure proper determination of key generation success.
Fixed an error in return value checking for UI_method_set_ex_data; the function returns 0 or 1 instead of a negative number, so the condition was changed from < 0 to logical negation.
Fixed an error in return value checking for EVP_PKEY_CTX_set_group_name; changed the error condition from logical negation to less than or equal to zero.
Fixed return value checking for the X509_LOOKUP_* series of functions; changed the check for equality to 0 to less than or equal to 0 to correctly handle error cases.
Fixed a memory leak in the decoder on the error path, ensuring the decoder reference count is correctly released.
Fixed return value handling for EVP_PKEY_check and EVP_PKEY_param_check to correctly handle cases where the return value is 0 or negative.

Fixed memory leaks in EVP_PKEY-related functions, including correctly releasing pkey when evp_pkey_copy_downgraded() fails, and fixing the issue in evp_pkey_export_to_provider where tmp_keymgmt was not released when keymgmt is null.
Fixed the return value checking logic for UI_add_input_string to ensure correct determination of its execution result.
Fixed a memory leak in ossl_provider_doall_activated: when the callback fails, previously pushed and reference-counted provider are now correctly released.

Fixed the issue where the release function was called before the reference count was initialized when creating a provider; now ossl_provider_free is called only after the reference count is correctly initialized.
Fixed a memory leak in ossl_method_store_add() caused by failure of ossl_prop_defn_set().

Fixed the issue where CONF_modules_unload still attempted to use the lock when lock initialization failed inside CONF_modules_finish; now the initialization result is checked and returns early on failure.
Fixed the issue where the add_provider_groups function did not clean up the algorithm pointer on failure.
Fixed a use-after-free issue in the hmac_dup function's error handling; now the digest field is zeroed when copying fails.
Fixed a potential use-after-free of md in sm2_dupctx; after copying the context, the md field of the target context is cleared.

Fixed a bug in BN_mod_exp_mont_consttime on x86_64 that could incorrectly return the modulus m instead of zero, by uniformly using standard Montgomery reduction instead of the internal function bn_from_montgomery for the final step.
Add an extra reduction step in the RSAZ modular exponentiation implementation to ensure the result is fully reduced within the modulus range.
Revert the fixed-length unrolled Montgomery multiplication optimization for the PPC architecture, as that implementation produces incorrect results.
Fix a crash in X509v3_asid_subset() caused by a null pointer in the asnum or rdi fields, and add corresponding test cases.
Fix a crash in v2i_IPAddrBlocks() caused by an excessively large IP address prefix length, and add a validity check for the prefix length.
Fix a defect in the range_should_be_prefix() function that incorrectly determines whether an IP address range should be represented as a prefix, and add corresponding test cases.
Fix an issue in the kdf_derive() function where the input buffer length parameter is inadequately adapted when calling EVP_KDF_derive(), and add an error check for an output buffer that is too small.
To avoid recursive locking, separate the lock used to protect initialization state variables from init_lock, and add an independent lock.
Fix an issue in the c_rehash tool where it incorrectly retains a prefix when computing CRL hashes; it now correctly removes the prefix.
Fix the return value of the set_dateopt() function so that the -dateopt option works correctly.
Add a check for the return value of OPENSSL_malloc() in ASN1_TIME_to_tm() to prevent using a null pointer when memory allocation fails.
Improve error diagnostics when setting TLS groups: clear the error information and explicitly report invalid groups.
Fix an issue in the dh_priv_encode function where negative return values are not handled correctly, preventing incorrect propagation.
Fix the handling of negative return values when encoding DSA private keys, and add a length check to avoid errors.
Add a null pointer check for the return value of OPENSSL_strdup in the by_store_ctrl_ex function, and return an error immediately if allocation fails.
In the UNIX socket option handling of s_server, add a null pointer check for the return value of OPENSSL_strdup, and jump to error handling on failure.
Add validity checks for the saltlen and trailerfield parameters in the RSA key writer to prevent errors from invalid parameters.
Fix a memory leak in EC_GROUP_new_from_ecparameters where, when parsing elliptic curve parameters, the allocated BIGNUM objects are not properly freed after ASN1_INTEGER_to_BN fails.
Fix an issue in rsaz_mod_exp_avx512_x2 where the parameter unit is incorrect when calling bn_reduce_once_in_place, by converting the modulus bit size to a word count.
Fix an issue where the KDF object does not return correctly when memory allocation fails.
Fix lock contention and resource release logic in provider storage to avoid double unlocking and potential memory leaks.
Fix the issue in the RSA key pair verification function where negative return values were not correctly treated as verification failures.
Fix a memory leak in ossl_rsa_fromdata caused by memory allocation failure in collect_numbers.
Use OPENSSL_zalloc to allocate the EVP_PBE_CTL structure, fixing the memory uninitialization issue.
Fix code formatting issues in crypto/x509/v3_addr.c and adjust the order of IPAddressFamily length checks.
Fix the Content-Length calculation logic in the HTTP client, including the BIO_CTRL_INFO return value based on file BIO and the calculation in set1_content().
Fix a crash when use_ssl is not set but SSL_CTX is provided, and add parameter consistency validation.
Fix a parameter error in the OSSL_HTTP_REQ_CTX_nbio function caused by a copy-paste error, correcting the retry check object from rbio to req.
Fix a potential crash when calling CONF_modules_unload() after calling OPENSSL_cleanup().
Fix the issue in bn_gcd where the return value of BN_one() is not checked, avoiding potential errors when memory allocation fails.
Fix parameter passing errors in the SSL_set_srp_server_param_pw function, correcting GN->N and GN->g to s->srp_ctx.N and s->srp_ctx.g.
Fix the release order of HTTP TLS information in the CMP context to avoid crashes, and add null pointer protection.
Fix a memory leak in EVP_PKEY_get1_encoded_public_key caused by the failure of the second call to EVP_PKEY_get_octet_string_param.
Roll back the core change in chain_build() error reporting, no longer setting errors in check_issued.
Fix a segmentation fault in SSL code caused by a EVP_MD pointer being NULL.
Fix the issue where the keylength field is not copied when copying FFC parameters.
Fix a potential null pointer dereference in the ossl_provider_ctx function, adding a null check.
Fix the issue in openssl s_client/s_server where the verify_callback function does not check if the certificate is null before printing error certificate information.
Fix a memory leak in the PKCS12_pbe_crypt_ex function, ensuring the out variable is released on the error path.
Fix a null pointer dereference in the ossl_provider_ctx function, checking if prov is NULL before accessing prov->provctx.
Fixed the null pointer dereference issue in the ossl_sa_free function by adding a null check for the input parameter.
Fixed the null pointer dereference issue caused by incorrectly set function pointers during GCM operations on the s390x platform.
Fixed the issue where the record limit counter in GCM mode was incorrectly reset when AAD changed; it is now only reset when the key changes.
Fixed a potential double-free issue caused by not setting the rrl object to NULL after freeing it.
Fixed a crash caused by an unset public key when retrieving encoded public key parameters, added error reporting when the group is not set, and corrected the data size parameter.
Fixed the issue found by Coverity of missing null checks before dereferencing.
Fixed a resource leak in the do_ssl3_write function caused by direct returns, changed to jump to the error handling path.
Fixed the issue where the X509_REQ_get_extensions function did not record an error when encountering malformed extension attributes; it now adds an entry to the error queue.
Fixed the issue on the s390x platform where Ed25519 and Ed448 signature operations did not correctly set the signature length, and return an error on signature failure.
Fixed a potential crash in the check_transactionID_or_nonce() function when the actual parameter is NULL.
Added test cases for the trace API and added parameter validity checks in the functions that retrieve category names and numbers.
Fixed the return values of CRYPTO_mem_debug_push() and CRYPTO_mem_debug_pop() to correctly return 0 instead of -1.
Fixed a potential memory leak in BN_rand_range() when a NULL parameter is passed; it now returns an error immediately.
Fixed the issue in TLSv1.3 where no session ticket was sent when the ticket key callback returned 0, and adjusted the state machine to support constructors deciding not to send messages.
Fixed the age calculation error for cookie and PSK caused by the low 32-bit overflow of time_t, and extended the timestamp field to 64 bits to avoid overflow.
Fixed the issue of incorrectly calling RLAYERfatal when the record layer pointer is NULL or about to be freed, and changed to use ERR_raise to record the error.
Fixed a potential null pointer dereference in the ssl3_cipher function when the encryption context is empty or no cipher is set.
Fixed a memory leak in the TLS 1.2 compression feature by correctly freeing the SSL3_RECORD structure when releasing the record layer.
Fixed an out-of-bounds access issue in DH key derivation caused by type mismatch.
Fixed the issue in the speed tool where statistics were incorrect in multi-process mode due to not waiting for child processes, and added child process waiting and status checks.

Fixed a bug in QUIC where Initial keys were discarded too early when processing Handshake packets; now Initial keys are discarded only after the Handshake packet is successfully decrypted and authenticated.
Fixed the handling of the status field in the CMP context, replacing magic numbers with mnemonic constants, and updated the related documentation.
Fixed a memory leak in the record layer, adjusting the release order to ensure the record layer is cleaned up before releasing the connection BIO.
Fixed the handling logic when the failInfo PKI status information is not set or is missing.
Fixed logic errors and memory leak issues in the CMS_decrypt* family of functions.
Fixed an issue in the gen_new function where ITAVs were incorrectly checked.
Added a non-null check for the return value of sk_SSL_CIPHER_value in the ciphers command to avoid potential null pointer dereference issues.
Always use binary format for input files, including standard input.
Enhanced the robustness of pipe data parsing in speed.c by adding safe conversion functions and fixing parsing logic to avoid potential parsing errors.
Fixed an issue in the duplicated function where parsing errors were not correctly reported, and simplified the function implementation.
Fixed a resource leak issue in the pkcs12 command caused by not breaking out of a loop in time.
Fixed an issue where a null pointer check was missing when strchr returns NULL, thereby avoiding undefined behavior.
Fixed an issue in the dgram_pair_read_inner function where the pointer was still moved when the buf pointer was NULL.
When an asynchronous encryption operation fails, add the error code returned by the kernel to the OpenSSL error queue, along with detailed error information.
Fixed an issue where the cipher-specific cleanup function was not called when cleaning up EVP_CIPHER_CTX.
Fixed a regression in i2d_re_X509_REQ_tbs() by removing the redundant i2d_X509_REQ_INFO call and directly returning its result.
Fixed a potential division by zero exception in division operations.
Fixed a potential recursion issue in err_set_debug() when malloc fails.
Fixed a potential infinite recursion issue in CRYPTO_THREAD_lock_new when memory allocation fails, switching to CRYPTO_zalloc and avoiding setting errors when allocation fails.
Fixed the MGF1 digest setting error in RSA, ensuring that digest names and attributes are correctly passed when setting the OAEP and MGF1 digests, and added support for implicit rejection parameters.
Fixed type overflow issues in QUIC congestion control and ACK management on 32-bit Windows by changing size_t to uint64_t in related shift operations and delay calculations.
Fixed an issue where legacy EVP_PKEY_CTX objects did not support the group parameter for X25519 and X448, adding parameter conversion handling to avoid errors.
Fixed an issue where an error code was returned when receiving a record with only a header and no data in DTLS scenarios.
Fixed an issue in QUIC stream code on 32-bit Windows where the result of a subtraction was not explicitly cast to size_t.
Fixed type conversion and length check issues in QUIC wire format decoding functions on 32-bit Windows.
Corrected the return value of dtls_write_records to use the standard record layer return value, and migrated error handling from SSLfatal to RLAYERfatal.

Fixed incorrect memory freeing in EC key encoding functions, ensuring ASN1_STRING_free is only called on ASN1_STRING types, and removed unnecessary ASN1_OBJECT_free calls on objects returned by OBJ_nid2obj.
Fixed the total_timeout handling logic for RR and GENM transactions in the CMP client, ensuring timeout checks are correctly applied to all transaction types.
Fixed the resource release order issue between DRBG and engines in the global default context, releasing DRBG before engines are released.
Fixed a potential memory leak in the CMS_decrypt_set1_password function by clearing previously set decryption keys before setting a new password.
Moved the sequence number increment operation for DTLS record writing from post-write processing to post-encryption processing, and added corresponding handling functions.

Refactored thread join and cleanup logic, introduced a generic synchronization wrapper to serialize concurrent join operations, fixed race conditions, and removed unsupported forced termination functionality.
Deferred BIO release operations to the final stage of connection cleanup, ensuring all record layer objects are released before releasing the BIO, avoiding memory leaks.
Fixed a regular expression error in file extension matching in the c_rehash tool, avoiding incorrect matching of non-certificate files.

Fixed a tainted scalar issue found by Coverity, adding zero-value checks for compressed length and uncompressed length when printing compressed certificates to avoid division by zero and null pointer risks.
Fixed an issue reported by Coverity by checking whether the buffer is empty before cleaning up temporary packets, avoiding uninitialized access.
Added a check for the return value of BIO_new_fp when creating the BIO output chain, returning NULL if it returns NULL, to avoid building an invalid BIO chain.
Fixed an issue caused by reseeding after fork when using the EGD random source, and adjusted related test conditions to avoid running fork safety tests in EGD mode.
Fix the asan error caused by insufficient lifetime of the input/output buffer array in pipe mode by moving the array declaration earlier to ensure it remains accessible during the EVP_Cipher call.
Re-enable the TLS 1.3 encryption test and fix the null pointer check in the tls_free function.
Fix the lock type error in provider_remove_store_methods, changing the read lock to a write lock.
Fix the calculation of the encryption growth limit, allow the stitching cipher suite to grow more during encryption, and add assertions to verify that the reserved space is sufficient.
Fix the issue of insufficient buffer size when reading pipelined data, and remove unnecessary early data movement logic.
Fix the dtls_get_max_record_overhead function to return a more accurate maximum record overhead value and ignore compression cases.
Fix the issue in the ssl3_dispatch_alert function where alerts cannot be sent when there is pending write data, and correctly handle retry scenarios.
Fix the memory leak in PEM_write_bio_PrivateKey_traditional caused by not releasing the key copy on the error path.
Fix the segmentation fault caused by a null pointer in EVP_PKEY when writing private keys in PEM, and add corresponding test cases.
Unify the use of encryption growth macros and correct the calculation of reserved bytes when MAC is added independently of the cipher algorithm, avoiding buffer overflow.
Limit the maximum length of the modulus in large number modular arithmetic to prevent exceptions caused by excessive stack allocation.
Fix null pointer dereference and resource leak issues in X.509 v3 address validation.
Allow passing a NULL pointer when calling ossl_quic_rstream_free, avoiding null pointer dereference.
Fix the handling of zero-length parameters in QUIC transport parameter encoding.
Fix the parsing width of the certificate compression algorithm field, changing it from single-byte to double-byte reading.
In the dgst command, when the first argument is a built-in hash name, set it as the digest algorithm name.
Fix the memory leak when releasing the DTLS record layer, ensuring that the old record layer object is correctly released when the send message queue is empty.
Fix the double locking issue in X.509 policy mapping and remove redundant flag settings.
Fix the undefined behavior caused by left-shifting a signed integer in init_info_strings, converting the relevant types to unsigned long.
Fix the error checking in apps/speed.c for ECDH and FFDH performance tests, changing the return value comparison to less than or equal to zero to correctly handle error cases.
Fix the check logic for the return value of the EC_GROUP_check_named_curve function to ensure correct validation of named curves.
In PKCS7 decryption, disable the implicit rejection mechanism for RSA keys and use a new decryption allocation function to fix the key matching assumption.

Fixed an assertion failure caused by concurrent access to the attribute cache in multi-storage environments; now, when caching attribute definitions, it checks whether an entry already exists and reuses it.
Added tests for RR/GENM messages to verify that end_time is correctly initialized, and adjusted the internal handling of total_timeout.

Fixed multiple Coverity issues in HPKE: removed redundant null pointer checks, changed goto to return; added checks for the return values of RAND_bytes_ex and KEM_INFO_find; removed unused variables and logging code.
Fixed a bug in QUIC channel where the wrong encryption level index was used during handshake key negotiation, and performed code cleanup (using assertions and simplifying memory copies).

Added null pointer parameter checks in the ossl_gen_deterministic_nonce_rfc6979 function, and changed goto end in the error handling path to direct returns, to fix the resource leak reported by Coverity.
Fixed an issue where an error was incorrectly raised during retryable read operations on BIO_s_dgram_pair, avoiding spurious errors during normal operation.

Improved QUIC network error handling: explicitly handle network errors in the demultiplexer, including detecting stateless reset tokens and returning permanent failure results; distinguish permanent failures from temporary errors in QTX; treat network errors in the channel as connection-fatal events, terminating the connection directly when the network BIO permanently fails, and fixed related transport parameter parsing and idle timeout handling.
Fixed a division-by-zero error in the ssl3_mac function caused by a hash size of zero.
Fixed an issue in QUIC send stream handling where an infinite skip incorrectly returned FIN, and added helper functions and cleanup code.
Fixed a potential double free issue in set_trace_data() caused by OPENSSL_strdup() failure, and adjusted the order of setting channel data to avoid erroneous freeing.
Fixed a null pointer dereference crash that could occur in the CMS decryption function when handling an unsupported content type.

Fixed the QUIC server connection state determination, changing the state from "handshake complete" to "handshake confirmed", ensuring the server is not considered connected before handshake confirmation.
Fixed a segmentation fault in RSA_generate_multi_prime_key when a NULL exponent is passed, and added corresponding test cases.

Fixed the TLS hostname selection issue in the CMP application, ensuring the hostname without the port is correctly obtained, and added parameter validation and proxy adaptation; also improved diagnostic information for TLS options, added warnings when necessary options are missing, and adjusted validation order and flag handling.
Fixed an issue in the CMP application where the host and port fields in the APP_HTTP_TLS_INFO structure were freed prematurely, ensuring proper memory management.
Fixed a null pointer dereference issue in EC key generation caused by memory allocation failure, ensuring parameters are set only after context allocation succeeds.

Fixed corruption caused by not taking a write lock on OPENSSL_STACK when searching for CRLs in hashed directories, by sorting the stack after each modification to avoid sk_find mutation, and optimized handling when no CRLs are installed.
Fixed the error check for RAND_bytes_ex() in generate_q_fips186_4(), changing the condition from <0 to <=0, to correctly catch failures where 0 is returned.
Fixed an issue where errors were not correctly reported when calling BIO_recvmmsg() with a dgram pair, ensuring that error reasons are recorded via ERR_raise when errors occur.
Fixed an issue in the padlock engine where key byte swapping was skipped due to conditional compilation.

Fixed the issue where cipher suites were sent repeatedly in QUIC, removed the TLSv1.3-specific cipher suite list for QUIC, and adjusted the cipher suite list creation logic to avoid allocating memory when the list is empty.

For applications such as storeutl and gendsa, an error is now given when extra arguments appear after the file/URI argument, and the documentation is improved to state that options must be given before the file/URI argument.
Fixed the incomplete return value check of X509V3_add1_i2d(), which now correctly captures both error codes -1 and 0.

Fixed the incorrect check of the return value of default_check() in default_fixup_args(), changing the condition from less than zero to less than or equal to zero to correctly handle internal error cases.
Fixed the incomplete return value check of EVP_CIPHER_param_to_asn1(), changing the condition from < 0 to <= 0 to correctly capture error return values.
Fixed the incomplete return value check of CMS_SharedInfo_encode, which now correctly handles the error case of less than or equal to zero.
Fixed the return value check of BIO_set_indent(), changing the error condition from less than zero to less than or equal to zero.
Fixed two return value errors in ossl_cmp_msg_check_update(), extended the CMP version number check to support PVNO_2 and PVNO_3, and corrected the error reason code when recipNonce does not match.
Fixed incomplete return value checks in multiple BIO-related functions (BIO_dup_state, BIO_set_md, BIO_set_accept_name) to ensure error cases are correctly captured.

Fixed the handling of the -reqin and -rspin options in the CMP client, ensuring the parameters take effect correctly and adding necessary nonce updates; also fixed a spelling error in the -newkeypass warning and improved the help text.

Fixed multiple bugs in tools under the apps directory: memory leak in psk_find_session_cb in s_server, incorrect diagnostics in the encryption loop of the speed tool, and crashes in commands such as openssl chacha20.
Fixed the idle timeout handling of the QUIC channel to prevent transport parameters from setting the idle timeout to 0.
Fixed lock issues during the QUIC handshake, refactored the handshake function to correctly acquire and release locks, and added a new option mask helper function.
Fixed a spelling error in QUIC Thread Assisted Mode, correcting the mutex type from CRYPTO_RWLOCK to CRYPTO_MUTEX, and adjusted the compilation conditions.
Fixed a time unit error in the early data age calculation, correcting the mistakenly used second granularity to millisecond granularity.
Fixed issues with setting and copying the digest property in FFC parameters.
Fixed the issue of residual irrelevant error entries in the error queue when early data decryption fails.
Fixed a memory leak of certStatus in CMP message construction, releasing certStatus when push fails.
Added a null pointer check for memory allocation failure in the stream_frame_new function to prevent potential null pointer dereference.
Checked the return value of DSA_set0_key in the ossl_dsa_key_from_pkcs8 function and generated an error message on failure.
Fix the dgram_sendmmsg issue in sendto caused by address family size mismatch, and use BIO_ADDR_sockaddr and BIO_ADDR_sockaddr_size to obtain the address and size.
Fix the error in QUIC DEMUX where the time field initialization and address clearing mistakenly used local instead of peer.
Fix the type mismatch between size_t and int in cms_ec.c, and improve error handling.
Fix a segmentation fault caused by passing an incorrect context when cleaning up the parent random number generator.
Fix the error in the key pair validation logic in the rsa_has function, ensuring that the existence of the modulus n is correctly verified when checking the private key.
Fix the comparison logic of tls12_check_peer_sigalg in pkeyid, using EVP_PKEY_KEYMGMT instead of the hardcoded -1.
Fix a resource leak in the ssl_cert_dup function caused by memory allocation failure.
Fix the incorrect macro name for quic_reactor detection in Windows, and use INVALID_SOCKET instead of -1 as the invalid socket value.
Limit the maximum sleep time of the sleep function to avoid long loop waits caused by passing excessively large values.
Fix the compatibility issue of the UINT64_C macro in the argon2 KDF implementation under older compilers by using an explicit UL suffix instead.
In the derive error path, no longer release the KDF context to avoid problems caused by premature release.
Fix mutex lock operations and lock release issues in QUIC thread auxiliary mode, and introduce the NAT timeout macro.
Fix the boundary checks for negative p, q, and g values in DSA_sign, and add related tests.
Fix the memory leak caused by calling i2d_ECDSA_SIG when the signature pointer is NULL in ECDSA_sign, and add test cases.

Fix a segmentation fault in EVP_PKEY_CTX_dup caused by a missing null pointer check, and add a null check for the dupctx function pointer when duplicating signature, key exchange, asymmetric cipher, and key encapsulation contexts.
Prohibit the use of QUIC connections when ALPN is not specified, otherwise report an error and terminate; add related test cases.
Fix the lock contention issue during QUIC datagram injection, ensuring proper locking when calling SSL_inject_net_dgram.
Fix the issue in DTLS where application data records were not correctly processed due to out-of-order arrival, and now allow buffering of application data records from the next epoch.
Fix the condition variable wait logic, use the correct function for signal notification, and adjust the wait state mask.
Fix the potential null pointer dereference issue in the get_payload_public_key_ec function, and return directly when checking that eckey is null.
Fix the incorrect null pointer check in the evp_keymgmt_gen_cleanup function, changing the condition from checking gen to checking gen_cleanup.
Move the initialization call for configuration loading out of RUN_ONCE to avoid initialization issues caused by recursive calls.
Fix the issue in ECX key generation where the public key operation was incorrectly used, and change it to the correct key generation operation.
Fix the error in the least common multiple (LCM) calculation during RSA multi-prime key validation.
Fix the issue in Kunpeng-920 hardware acceleration initialization for SM4-GCM where the function for setting the decryption key was incorrectly used.

Fix parameter checking and memory allocation issues in the EVP and X509 modules, including the return value check for check_curve, the string space allocation for curve names, and the default setting for ctrl_cmd.
Fix the issue of self-signed warnings when loading CSR files with the -vfyopt option, by passing the verification option parameters to the CSR loading function.
Fix the memory leak in engine_cleanup_add_first() caused by not freeing memory when insertion fails.
Fix the issue where SSL_trace cannot print certificate data under a non-default libctx, and correct the certificate parsing logic to properly use the specified libctx and attribute queries.
Fix the issue of unstable rehash results by implementing a comparison function to ensure correct sorting of file entries.
Fix the usage of the time callback in QUIC TXP to ensure the time callback function is correctly invoked.
Fix the use-after-free issue caused by memory allocation failure when adding x509 policy nodes.

Fix the error handling of ossl_policy_level_add_node and sk_X509_POLICY_NODE_push in the tree_calculate_user_set function to prevent memory leaks, and correctly return failure status when user_policies allocation fails.
Add a null pointer check for input parameters in the SMIME_crlf_copy function, returning an error when a null pointer is passed.

Improve the management of the HTTP callback parameter pointer in the CMP client, releasing the old value before setting a new one and setting it to null during cleanup to avoid memory leaks or dangling pointers.
Fix the issue of pport_num being uninitialized in OSSL_parse_url, and add the init_pint helper function to initialize the integer value pointed to by the pointer.
Fix the issue where parameters are not converted to unsigned char type when calling functions such as isdigit.
Fix the potential memory leak in the ASN1_TIME_normalize function when the input pointer is null.
Fix the issue where X509_NAME_cmp may incorrectly return -2 when handling empty names.
Fix the issue of requesting inappropriate groups in HelloRetryRequest, ensuring that groups already sent by the client but not meeting TLSv1.3 requirements are not requested again.
Fix the error reported by int_ctx_new() when using a 1.1.1n SM2 key with an EC method engine.
Fixed the busy loop caused by incorrectly calculating the next tick deadline when an ACK cannot actually be sent.
When attempting to decode a PKCS#12 object, first check whether a MAC exists for verification, to avoid always prompting for a password when there is no MAC.
Fixed the issue where the openssl speed -multi -evp command output incorrect algorithm names; it now correctly displays the specified algorithm name.
Fix the issue where input data was truncated during pkeyutl decryption; now the full input data is allowed to be read.

Fix memory allocation and reference counting issues in EC_KEY, EVP_RAND, and SSL_CTX, including correctly initializing reference counts, releasing allocated resources on allocation failure, and adding error logs.
Fix the handling logic for non-ACK-triggered packets in QUIC TXP, ensuring the probe request count is decremented correctly, and optimize stream frame generation and padding behavior.
QUIC ACKM no longer records non-transport data packets into congestion control, avoiding incorrect notification to CC in pseudo-loss scenarios.
Remove unreachable type-checking code in SSL_CTX_use_certificate_file and correct the error code.
Fix the issue where pointers in QUIC packet encoding may become invalid when the dynamic buffer grows.
Fix the condition check in ssl3_do_write() when handling write retries, changing the return value check from less than 0 to less than or equal to 0, to correctly handle the case where BIO returns 0.
Fix the parameter handling error when setting/getting labels for RSA OAEP in legacy engines.
Fix the issue where forced PING frame generation in QUIC TXP was incorrect, ensuring PING is correctly generated when forced acknowledgment is needed.
Use safe multiplication and division functions in QUIC flow control calculations to expand the possible result range.
Fix unreachable code in cms_main(), adjust the handling logic for recipient certificate parameters during non-encryption operations, and add corresponding warning messages.
Fix a bug in STREAM FIN generation in QUIC TXP, correctly clearing the FIN flag when a data block is truncated.
Fix a typo in the QUIC channel state enumeration name, correcting the erroneous QUIC_CSM_STATE_ACTIVE to QUIC_CHANNEL_STATE_ACTIVE.
Fix the issue in the X509at_add1_attr function where it searched the wrong stack when checking for duplicate attributes, and change it to correctly search the target stack.
Fix the issue in the mac_export function where it exported empty data when the selection was empty, and add a check for the private key selection flag.
Add offset boundary checks to the QUIC protocol decoding function, conforming to RFC 9000 Section 19.6.
Added QUIC test cases to verify malformed encrypted stream data, and fixed type conversion issues in the related code.
Added fault injection test cases for the NEW_CONN_ID frame to the QUIC tests, and fixed the handling logic for non-1-RTT packets when injecting ordinary frames.
Fixed a bug in QUIC TXP where a TXPIM packet could be used after being freed, and introduced a reference count flag to avoid access after freeing.
Added fault injection test cases for STREAM, MAX_DATA, and MAX_STREAM_DATA to the QUIC multi-stream tests, and fixed the packet type check in the injection function.
Fixed the issue in the QUIC protocol where the handshake was not advanced on zero-length writes, ensuring that the handshake completes normally even when zero bytes are written.
Fixed the issue in quicserver where the buffer write position was not correctly tracked when processing requests arriving in chunks.
Fixed a regression issue in the QUIC UINT_SET removal operation, corrected the range overlap judgment condition, and added range truncation handling.
Fixed a memory leak issue in the event queue caused by memory allocation failure.
Fixed the issue in QUIC QRX of handling negative IV length values, avoiding assertion errors due to type mismatch.
Fixed a potential null pointer dereference issue in QUIC QTLS.
Fixed a type conversion issue when handling negative IV length in QUIC QTX, ensuring correct nonce construction.
Fixed the issue in QUIC connection close where the return value of block_until_pred was not checked, avoiding errors from continuing execution after a failed blocking wait.
Fixed the issue in QUIC TSERVER where the return value of ossl_quic_rstream_read was not correctly handled, and correctly zeroed related variables on read failure.
Fixed a null pointer dereference issue in QUIC UINT_SET caused by not checking the memory allocation result.
Added selection checks for the msblob and pvk decoders, ensuring they are only used when the requested key selection matches.
Fixed the error message format in the load_key_certs_crls function: added the missing newline and removed redundant error prompts.
Improved the warning text when skipping unknown name attributes in parse_name(), and fixed the handling logic in bio_to_mem() when maxlen is -1.
Fixed a bug where the values of the -csr and -serial options could not be reset.
Fixed the issue of incorrectly triggering an envelope content type error when releasing signed content, and added a dedicated function for cleaning up envelope content.
Fixed the issue of not clearing the el->md pointer on error paths, avoiding potential memory errors.
Fixed the lifecycle management issue of dummybio in the QUIC record layer, avoiding use-after-free errors.
Fixed the issue where reason_len was not set in QUIC protocol error handling, and corrected the return value logic of the has_read_ended function on read failure.
Fixed the division-by-zero error in kmac_setkey caused by a block size of zero, changing it to return an error instead.
Added appropriate error promotion in multiple locations in QUIC, including protocol errors and parameter errors, and optimized the polling descriptor validation logic.

Improved QUIC application-layer error reporting by changing some non-protocol errors to non-I/O error types, and refactored the channel configuration flow to use a unified context; also added the passing of connection close reason and its length.
The QUIC channel now only handles the first protocol error; subsequent protocol errors are ignored.
Improved the error messages for QUIC TLS, returning clearer error codes and hints when ALPN is not configured.
Fixed the implementation of the BIO_CTRL_DGRAM_GET_LOCAL_ADDR_ENABLE control command in BIO_s_dgram_pair so that it correctly returns results through pointer parameters.
Added return value checks for RAND_bytes(), calling app_bail_out to exit on failure; also changed the output buffer parameter to inp.

Fixed the issue of premature discarding of the INITIAL encryption level in the QUIC protocol; now it is only triggered on the server side when a HANDSHAKE packet is successfully decrypted, and on the client side when a HANDSHAKE packet is successfully sent.
Fixed the issue of incorrectly using ossl_assert when memory allocation fails in bn_wexpand, changing it to directly check whether the return value is NULL.
Fixed the memory leak caused by process_data_dest not being freed on the error path when copying OSSL_DECODER_CTX.
Fixed the issue of prematurely freeing the previous BIO when setting a new record layer, avoiding freeing it while it is still referenced.
Fixed the memory leak in tls_new_record_layer: when setting the encryption state fails, tls_int_free is now correctly called to free the partially allocated record layer structure.
Added a check for the return value of ASN1_STRING_set in the spkac_main function, fixing a potential unchecked return value issue.
Removed a redundant NULL check in cmp_genm.c that would not actually trigger; this change eliminates Coverity false positives.
Fixed the issue of not checking the return value of X509_STORE_lock() in ossl_x509_store_ctx_get_by_subject().
Fixed the issue where, when sending data, if the amount of data exceeds the capacity of a single datagram, datagrams are continuously generated and sent until all data is sent.
Correctly initialized all fields of RXE for QUIC non-encrypted packets.
Fixed the QUIC channel sending logic to ensure that packets already sent are still flushed when packet generation fails; also added an error reason parameter for locally closing connections.
Fixed the memory leak in the ossl_encode_ctx_setup_for_pkey function caused by not freeing the allocated name stack on the error path.
Changed the TLS record type from int to uint8_t to avoid endianness issues in SSL_trace().
Fixed the handling logic of PING frames in QUIC, adjusted the error code for unknown frames, and optimized the frame callback mechanism.

Dynamically determine I/O errors, improving QUIC error classification and handling logic; refactored QUIC I/O error handling, added a helper function to uniformly set last_error, and initialize the error state to no error when entering I/O operations.
Generalized the CMP protection calculation function to correctly support Edwards curves, and added corresponding test cases.
Added a data availability check when peeking at the number of ranges in ACK frames to prevent excessive memory allocation due to declaring too many ranges.
Handle non-IO retry errors (such as SSL_ERROR_WANT_RETRY_VERIFY, SSL_ERROR_WANT_X509_LOOKUP, etc.) during TLS handshake in QUIC connections, and propagate these errors up to QCSO.
Fixed the conditional judgment error in the dupctx function of the aes_gcm_siv cipher family, so that it correctly copies data when aad is non-null.
Fixed potential memory leaks in CRYPTO_zalloc and CRYPTO_realloc when OPENSSL_MALLOC_FAILURES is enabled, and adjusted the fault injection check position.
Fixed the ossl_param_build_set_multi_key_bn function to avoid incorrectly setting BIGNUM values that are NULL to zero.
Fixed error handling in the engine cleanup function, resolved memory leaks, and adjusted the rollback logic.
Fixed the clearing and setting logic of error flags in OSSL_STORE.
In multiple demo and tools, explicitly return NULL when creating BIO fails.
Fixed the memory leak caused by not freeing users_pwd in the SRP_VBASE_new function.
Fixed the valtype value of the dkeyform option, changing from uppercase F to lowercase f to support engine functionality.
Corrected the way error return values are checked in the cms_sd_asn1_ctrl() function.
Fixed the memory leak in the rsa_pub_encode function when RSA-PSS parameter encoding fails.
Fixed the issue of corrupted output when using the req command with the -out and -modulus options.
Fixed memory leaks in OpenSSL applications, ensuring proper cleanup when key generation and parameter generation fail.
Fixed the memory leak in the prepare_rsa_params function when the salt length is negative or when memory is insufficient.
Fixed the issue where the sm4, aes, and aria ccm and gcm variants omitted redirecting the key pointer during dupctx.
Fix the build issue when SSL trace support is disabled, and output a warning message when the -trace option is specified.
Fixed the issue where error messages incorrectly reported bad decrypt on encryption operation failure; encryption failures now correctly display bad encrypt.
Fixed a null pointer dereference issue in engine_table_register caused by a missing jump.

Fixed error handling for out-of-memory conditions in CRYPTO_get_ex_new_index, ensuring that the meth stack is correctly freed and reset when reserving an index fails, preventing subsequent data overwrites.

Fixed an issue in lhash where the contract function returned directly on realloc failure, causing inconsistent hash table state; it now continues the contraction operation and only updates internal pointers when realloc succeeds.
Fixed an issue where special handling for foreign key did not take effect correctly when signing with a legacy key based on an application method in a no-engine build.
Fixed quote handling for strings in the ossl_property_list_to_string function to ensure the generated property strings can be parsed correctly.
Fixed the order of null checks for the global structure pointer during random number seed initialization.
Fixed a use-after-free vulnerability in the random number seed generation function.
Fixed undefined behavior in the BN_gcd function caused by shifting negative values, by explicitly casting the relevant shift operands to unsigned types.
Fixed a segmentation fault in the SCTP BIO implementation caused by inconsistent private data structures, by embedding generic dgram data into the SCTP data structure.

Fixed an issue in the QUIC auxiliary thread where the condition variable wait timeout used the wrong time, ensuring the real time is passed to avoid test hangs; also adjusted lock operations and thread stop signaling.
Fixed multiple bugs related to packet processing in the QUIC channel, including default stream popping, incorrect tick deadline calculation, and assertion failures caused by Retry packet handling.
Fix memory leaks and asynchronous task parameter setting issues in the KEM and signature algorithm performance tests in the speed command.

Fixed multiple QUIC-related issues, including initial token length checks, time conversion truncation, protocol violation handling, URXE ordering, ACK timeout calculation, packet loss detection, and null pointer freeing.
Fixed error handling in CMS and PKCS7 that could occur due to not checking for a zero return from EVP_PKEY_get_size.
Added multiple null pointer checks in ossl_ctrl_internal to prevent null pointer dereferences.
Fixed a memory leak when creating the label octet string fails in RSA OAEP encryption.
Fixed an issue where the HTTP client did not correctly return 0 when the response length check failed.
Fixed the use of an uninitialized variable in TLS extension parsing.
Fixed the issue where quicserver could not bind when duplicate hostname mappings existed; it now tries all addresses and starts as long as one bind succeeds.
Fixed the issue where quicserver fell into an infinite loop when handshake or request reception failed; it now terminates the server and returns an error.
Fixed the issue where s_client reported an error when receiving data exactly equal to BUFSIZZ.
Fixed the resource leak issue in ossl_quic_new caused by error injection.
Fixed the issue where the want_ack flag was not correctly checked when generating ACK frames.
Fixed the issue where ossl_quic_sstream_is_totally_acked incorrectly returned 0 when the stream had no appended data.
Fixed a possible memory leak when loading built-in compression algorithms.
Fixed the incorrect usage of the likely macro in ossl_rand_uniform_uint32.
Fixed the issue where the original length tracking was incorrect due to flow control when generating QUIC stream frames.
Fixed the issue where keyslot could leak under error conditions.
Fixed the null pointer dereference issue in ossl_quic_new caused by memory allocation failure.
Fixed the issue with implicit-length STREAM frames when PATH_RESPONSE frames are present, and refactored the padding logic.
Fixed the padding handling issue for ACK_ONLY type packets in QUIC TXP.
Fixed a possible memory leak of PSK temporary keys in ssl3_free.
Fixed a possible memory leak in the custom_ext_add function on specific error paths, ensuring that the custom extension's free callback is called on failure.
Fixed the bug where the priority queue removal function failed to correctly reclaim free slots when removing the last element from the heap.
Fixed the issue where packets were not marked as full when the stream had adopted implicit length in QUIC transport.
Fixed the upper bound check for variable output size in the BLAKE2 algorithm, correctly limiting it to the algorithm's default output size.

Fixed the issue in dtls1_hm_fragment_new where the msg_header field was not initialized when allocating hm_fragment, and switched to zero-initialized allocation to avoid referencing undefined data during free.
Fix the issue in the DTLS record layer where the current record layer could be incorrectly freed under certain error conditions; move the freeing logic to dtls1_clear_sent_buffer.
Fix the tag length boundary check when calculating the plaintext payload length in the QUIC record layer; correctly return no available space when the available space equals the tag length.
Fix the issue with tracking connection-level credit consumption in QUIC, ensuring that stream data is no longer added after connection credits are exhausted.
Fix the output length handling in EVP_PKEY_decrypt, using the actual decrypted output length when generating the master key.
Change the output of successful certificate request self-signature verification in the openssl req -verify command from standard error to standard output.
Remove the unnecessary dependency on NDEBUG in cmp_client_test.c, involving test/cmp_client_test.c.
Correct the return value description error for RSA_print in the documentation, and fix the error checks in related tests, involving doc/man3/RSA_print.pod and test/evp_pkey_provided_test.c.

Fix the issue where test-rand RNG incorrectly returns success when data is insufficient; change it to return failure without advancing the data pointer; also fix the error of failing when a parent RNG is specified, changing it to ignore that case, involving files such as providers/implementations/rands/test_rng.c.
Fix the issue of incorrect order of NULL pointer checks in test/ssl_old_test.c, moving the check before use, involving test/ssl_old_test.c.
Fix the incomplete check of the return value of BIO_gets, involving test/danetest.c.
Fix the error in checking the return value of EVP_PKEY_decrypt, involving test/acvp_test.c, test/evp_extra_test.c, and test/threadstest.c.
Fix the test function and calling method for EVP_DigestVerifyFinal, involving demos/signature/EVP_Signature_demo.c and test/evp_extra_test.c.
Fix the error in checking the return value of TXT_DB_write, involving test/sslapitest.c.
Fix the error in checking the return value of BIO_set_prefix, involving test/bio_prefix_text.c.
Add a return value check for the OPENSSL_strdup call in test/evp_test.c, returning an error on failure, involving test/evp_test.c.
Fix the error handling issue of Coverity 1506709 in test/fake_rsaprov.c.
In test/evp_test.c, make evp_test skip MAC tests when the digest or cipher is disabled.
In util/check-format.pl, fix the detection of missing/extra blank lines in local declarations, and fix false positives on 'for(;; stmt)'.
Fix coding style and other (mostly minor) issues in test/timing_load_creds.c.
Add documentation and tests for EVP_PBE_alg_add, involving doc/man3/EVP_PBE_CipherInit.pod, test/evp_extra_test2.c, and util/missingcrypto.txt.
Fix default padding regression for the 3.0.0 FIPS provider in test/recipes/30-test_evp_data/evppkey_ffdhe.txt.
In test/bio_dgram_test.c, use memset() instead of initialization to fix old clang warnings, and fix the BIO_dgram_pair random test failure.
Add tests for TLSv1.3-only clients sending correct key_share in test/ssl-tests/14-curves.cnf and test/ssl-tests/14-curves.cnf.in.
Add missing include header for DH_get0_priv_key() in test/evp_extra_test2.c.
Fix Coverity 1516095 dead code issue in test/cert_comp_test.c.
Fix -Wunused-but-set-variable warning in test/testutil/driver.c, remove unused num_failed_inner variable.
Fix CI interruption caused by incompatible merge in test/quicapitest.c.
In test/helpers/ssltestlib.c, when building with OPENSSL_NO_POSIX_IO or OPENSSL_NO_SOCK, define an empty wait_until_sock_readable() function to fix the missing issue.
In test/quic_record_test.c, for tests requiring ChaCha, also require Poly1305.
Check inconsistent values returned by SSL_get0_alpn_selected() in test/ssl_old_test.c.
Fix connect-or-fail issue in QUIC multi-stream test in test/quic_multistream_test.c.
In test/bio_dgram_test.c, when using BIO_s_dgram_mem() to set explicit buffer size, include header size in calculation.
In test/quic_tserver_test.c, increase OSSL_sleep(1) to OSSL_sleep(100) to fix test issues on slow machines.
In test/evp_test.c, when ignoring copy failure on old FIPS provider, use ctx_base instead of ctx to fix provider-compatible CI regression.
Add QTEST_FLAG_CLIENT_TRACE flag in test/helpers/quictestlib.c and test/helpers/quictestlib.h to enable client debug trace output capability.
In apps/cmp.c, avoid negative index dereference, use memcpy instead, and fix related warning messages.
Rename MIN() macro in providers/implementations/kdfs/kbkdf.c to ossl_min() with ossl prefix to avoid name conflict.
Refactor gen_init in providers/implementations/keymgmt/rsa_kmgmt.c to avoid passing NULL-valued gctx to rsa_gen_set_params which directly dereferences gctx.

Remove empty_fragment_done mechanism from ssl/record/methods/tls_common.c and ssl/ssl_local.h, because prefix records are no longer added recursively, but are added each time tls_write_records is executed.
Fix deadcode issue reported by Coverity 1516101 in ssl/d1_lib.c.

In apps/lib/apps.c's opt_legacy_okay, remove the explicit check for engines, because the providers indicator already indicates whether it is a legacy request, and by default, when there are no explicit providers, it returns legacy as available.
Add dupctx support for the rc4_hmac_md5 algorithm and each size of aes_WRAP, located in cipher_rc4_hmac_md5.c, cipher_aes_cbc_hmac_sha.c, and cipher_aes_wrp.c respectively.

In multiple places, change unnecessary write locks to read locks: crypto/x509/by_dir.c avoids locking when no content is added; crypto/ex_data.c uses a read lock when only reading EX_CALLBACK data; crypto/x509/x509_lu.c uses a read lock when retrieving values from the stack; crypto/engine/tb_asnmth.c's ENGINE_pkey_asn1_find_str() uses a read lock instead of a write lock.

Fix the negative loop boundary issue reported by Coverity 1503218 in crypto/encode_decode/decoder_pkey.c, changing the loop index and end value to int type; fix the constant expression result issue reported by Coverity 1493746 in crypto/stack/stack.c.

Fix the memory leak of the BIO_ADDR_hostname_string return value in init_client() in OpenSSL apps/lib/s_socket.c, adding OPENSSL_free to free it; fix the null pointer check style and code format of crl_set_issuers in crypto/x509/x_crl.c.
Rename internal functions related to curve448 (involving arch_32/f_impl32.c, arch_64/f_impl64.c, curve448.c, f_generic.c, field.h) to resolve symbol conflicts with intel/ISA-L.
In crypto/evp/legacy_sha.c's EVP shake_ctrl(), add the missing NULL evp_ctx check.
