In include/internal/ffc.h, move the FFC check flags that conflict with the DH check flags, resolving the conflict between DH flags and FFC flags.
Remove the outdated comment about ERR_clear_error() from crypto/cmp/cmp_http.c.
In crypto/err/err.c, make ERR_str_reasons consistent with err.h again, fixing the printing issue of common reason strings.

Fix spelling errors in multiple files (including Configure, INSTALL.md, README-ENGINES.md, apps/cmp.c, many documentation files, crypto and providers implementation files, ssl/statem/statem_srvr.c, test files, etc.).
In crypto/trace.c, add the missing trace category entries.
In apps/prime.c's openssl prime command, pre-check the numbers.

In crypto/property/property_parse.c's put_str, use memcpy instead of strncpy to fix the gcc warning, because only the string content is copied (without the terminating NUL) and the length comes from strlen().

When provider activation fails, record the three cases of module load failure, init function being NULL, and init function returning an error as different errors, rather than uniformly recording them as init function failure.

Fix the missing OSSL_NELEM header file in the QUIC implementation, adding the internal/nelem.h include; add assertions and comments for the default XSO conversion, fix the QSSO spelling, the return value of SSL_attach_stream when compiled without QUIC, and clean up outdated comments.
Fix further issues reported by check-format.pl regarding whitespace within 'for (...)'.
Fix the spelling error in the PROV_RC5_CTX structure name, which originated from a typo when copying and pasting from blowfish.
Fix the occasional CI failure caused by unaligned access at line 562 in rsaz_exp_x2.c (UBSAN reports that the load address of uint64_t type is not aligned to 8 bytes).
Revert the fix for the unaligned access issue in rsaz_exp_x2.c from commit 8511520842b744d1794ea794c032ce5f78cd874b.
Removed the redundant debugging printf from evp_test.c; this printf could cause a runtime error when the name was NULL.
Fix the return type of compute_pqueue_growth().
Fix the Coverity warning introduced by commit 2b9e2afc382490592078cdb69d06f54f0fefd4c6.
Remove residual code of ossl_crypto_mem_barrier from Win32 and other architectures.
Replace exit status codes 0 and 1 with EXIT_SUCCESS and EXIT_FAILURE in multiple example programs under the demos directory.
Fix issues when compiling build_wincrypt_test.c with MSVC.
Resolve function name conflicts in the djgpp environment.
Replace sys/poll.h with poll.h in sockets.h.
Check the return value of CRYPTO_atomic_add() in drbg.c (Coverity 1531836).
Use the codespell tool to find and fix spelling errors in multiple files.
Include the <openssl/err.h> header file in refcount.h.
Adjust the default parameters of RXFC for QUIC CHANNEL.

Ensure an appropriate fallback "unsupported" error is added on decoding failure, fixing the issue where the error was not added because flag_construct_called was incorrectly set even when the construct function failed.
Replace plain printf in quicserver.c with BIO_printf output to stderr, and do not build quicserver under the no-stdio configuration.
Remove the unused member read_iv from the ossl_record_layer_st structure.
Remove redundant point multiplication from ossl_ec_key_public_check().

Fix multiple minor issues in OpenSSL: correct the pointer dereference type cast for BIO_CTRL_DGRAM_GET_LOCAL_ADDR_ENABLE, fix documentation spelling errors and QUIC comment terminology, and fix the incorrect argument passing of ensure_channel_started in quic_do_handshake.
Fix the issue where the ossl_blake2b_param_init function only performs initialization without reading the data to be initialized.
Add algorithm description comments in rand_uniform.c.

Fix the diagnostic verbosity level of the CMP client: add the print_to_bio_err function to separate server error output; split the option index start variable of read_config() into start_opt and start_idx; add negative number validation for OPT_VERBOSITY; relax the configuration file numeric option validation to num < 0 to allow zero values.
Move the warning for overly long section names to a new position so that it takes effect again.
Fix ssl_free() and BIO_free() to honor the BIO_NOCLOSE flag.
Produce an error for duplicate attribute names during attribute parsing.

Fix the dasync engine EVP_PKEY_RSA method: add the EVP_PKEY_FLAG_AUTOARGLEN flag, remove the manual release of dasync_rsa in destroy_pkey and change it to automatic release, and add NULL checks for the original method function pointers in multiple RSA callbacks such as paramgen_init, keygen_init, and encrypt_init.
Avoid a possible null pointer dereference in s_socket.c.
Fix a memory leak in the afalg engine.
In apps/x509, adjust the self-signed check to run before setting the issuer name.
Fix the unsafe BIO_get_md_ctx check.
Fix improper calls to x509_name_cannon and X509_self_signed.
Fix a race condition in init_thread_stop() and remove the global variable default_DSO_meth to avoid data races.
Fix SSKDF not declaring a buffer size that is too small, and check that the buffer is large enough to hold the MAC output.
Do not warn about using standard input when generating a new request.
Free bindhost and bindport.
Fix psk_server_cb in s_server to support DTLS.
provider_util.c does not release the ENGINE reference when clearing cipher or digest, and the copying of cipher and digest is incorrect, leading to memory leaks and potential double-free issues.
Avoid undefined behavior of NULL+X in bss_mem.c.
Modify the wording about secure renegotiation in the s_client and s_server tools, because TLS v1.3 does not use renegotiation at all, to avoid misleadingly showing "not supported".
In e_rc5.c, handle the issue reported by Coverity 1493382 that the parameter cannot be negative.
Fix the return value check in ossl_do_blob_header.
Fix the invalid code issue reported by Coverity 1494649 in apps/lib/opt.c.
Memory allocated by X509_STORE_new in demos/cms/cms_ver.c and demos/smime/smver.c needs to be freed.
Fixed a use-after-free issue in crypto/evp/digest.c when using HMAC and MD copy.
Fixed a null pointer dereference issue in providers/implementations/storemgmt/file_store.c after line 178 where ctx may be NULL.
In crypto/provider_core.c, ossl_provider_add_to_store avoids freeing a provider that has not had its reference count incremented, preventing use-after-free.
In crypto/core_namemap.c, handle the case where looking up a non-legacy cipher/MD returns NULL.
In crypto/passphrase.c, compensate for the behavior of the UI method always adding a NUL terminator, so that the buffer used by pem_password_cb can fill the entire buffer.
apps/speed.c skips the unavailable md5 in FIPS mode to avoid openssl speed failure.
Fixed misuse of NULL check in crypto/rand/rand_egd.c.
In crypto/store/store_result.c, try_pkcs12() correctly handles NUL termination of the passphrase.
In crypto/ui/ui_openssl.c, close_console always performs unlocking because the lock is always held.
In crypto/x509/x509_vfy.c, X509_STORE_CTX_purpose_inherit handles the case where the default purpose is 0, avoiding an erroneous return when the main purpose is set to X509_PURPOSE_ANY.
In apps/lib/apps.c, app_http_tls_cb fixes a double-free issue when TLS is not used.
Added error information on failure returns in crypto/param_build.c and crypto/param_build_set.c.
Corrected the gettable parameters for DH key exchange in providers/implementations/exchange/dh_exch.c.
Added NULL checks for the return value of OPENSSL_strdup in apps/s_server.c and apps/ocsp.c to prevent passing NULL parameters when memory allocation fails.
In demos/sslecho/main.c, fixed a getline parameter type warning and removed the OPENSSL_free call on a non-dynamically allocated fixed-size array.
In apps/dhparam.c, added a warning print when the -in parameter is ignored.

Unified fixes for DTLS and related function return value checks: dtls1_process_record error return value changed to 0 and callers adjusted accordingly; PKCS7_SIGNER_INFO_set and PKCS7_RECIP_INFO_set changed to <= 0 checks; return values of addr_contains, BIO_dgram_sctp_msg_waiting, and SRP master key generation functions all adjusted to 0 to indicate error.

Fixed the check of the return value of evp_pkey_ctx_set_params_strict in the EVP_PKEY_CTX_set0_rsa_oaep_label function: changed the original code that only returned 0 when the return value was false (0) to save the return value and return it directly when it is <= 0, thereby correctly passing negative error codes.

Fixed the error in the return value check of X509_REVOKED_add1_ext_i2d in apps/ca.c, changing the logical NOT check ! to <= 0 to correctly handle the error case where the function returns a negative value to indicate failure.

Fix the return value check of BIO_get_cipher_status: change the condition in three places in crypto/cms/cms_smime.c and crypto/pkcs7/pk7_smime.c from logical negation (!BIO_get_cipher_status(...)) to less than or equal to zero (BIO_get_cipher_status(...) <= 0), to correctly handle the negative value error cases that this function may return.
Fix a copy-paste error when setting propq in CTLOG_new_ex of crypto/ct/ct_log.c.

In crypto/encode_decode/decoder_meth.c, encoder_meth.c, and providers/implementations/encode_decode/decode_der2key.c, check the return value of ossl_parse_property(), and check whether the d2i_public_key function pointer exists.
Fix unexpected NULL assignments in ternary operators in crypto/encode_decode/decoder_meth.c, encoder_meth.c, and crypto/store/store_meth.c.
In evp_pkey_copy_downgraded() of crypto/evp/p_lib.c, when *dest is NULL at entry and a subsequent failure occurs, fix the memory leak of the automatically allocated EVP_PKEY.
In ec_export of providers/implementations/keymgmt/ec_kmgmt.c, no longer incorrectly report success when OSSL_PARAM_BLD_to_param() fails.
Add a check for the return value of i2s_ASN1_INTEGER() in crypto/x509/v3_sxnet.c.
In crypto/provider_core.c, avoid including the decoder/encoder/store header files into the FIPS module.
In crypto/http/http_client.c, add a check for the return value of OPENSSL_strdup, returning an error on failure.
In cmp_calc_protection() of crypto/cmp/cmp_protect.c, fix a memory leak triggered by a memory allocation failure.
In apps/speed.c, reset outlen each time EVP_PKEY_derive is called.
Add a check for the return value of OBJ_new_nid() in crypto/objects/obj_dat.c.
In the get_current_time function of crypto/bio/bss_dgram.c, added an error check for the return value of gettimeofday, outputting error information via perror when the call fails.
In the OSSL_TIME fallback implementation of include/internal/e_os.h, add the internal/time.h header file inclusion to ensure OSSL_TIME is defined.
Add BN_CTX_end at the end of the function in crypto/sm2/sm2_sign.c to pair with BN_CTX_start.
Fix the symbol undeclared issue in crypto/dso/dso_vms.c caused by improper handling in a previous commit.
cmac_set_ctx_params() returns failure when the cipher mode is not CBC, and add negative test cases for CMAC and GMAC using the wrong mode.
Fix the -Wunused-but-set-variable warning reported by Clang 15 in crypto/pem/pem_lib.c, crypto/x509/x_name.c, and crypto/txt_db/txt_db.c, removing the unused variables line, l, and ln.
Change the error attribution raised in OPENSSL_sk_set to ERR_LIB_CRYPTO.
In crypto/bn/rsaz_exp_x2.c, avoid potential undefined behavior under strict aliasing rules.
Add a missing check for failure of make_ocsp_response in apps/ocsp.c, and add a verification that fdopen returns NULL in apps/speed.c.
Fix the issue of uninitialized variables in ssl/quic/quic_txp.c.

Fix error return values or error checks in BIO_f_asn1(), BIO_set_write_buffer_size/BIO_set_read_buffer_size, rsautl_main, SMIME_crlf_copy(), EVP_PKEY_decrypt_init, and ossl_cms_EncryptedContent_init_bio(), so that severe errors return -1 instead of 0, or correctly propagate error conditions.
In apps/lib/apps.c, move the stdin operation on unbuffer from before loading the key to before obtaining the password, to fix the issue of key loading failure when the password is passed via stdin.
Fix the erroneous logic in apps/storeutl.c that prevents the simultaneous use of the serial and issuer parameters, allowing both to be used together.
Fix the handling of FIN stream chunking in ssl/quic/quic_txp.c.
Fix the output of certificate and certificate list files in apps/cmp.c when the certificate does not exist.
In ssl/quic/quic_rx_depack.c, distinguish different error messages for stream conditions.
In crypto/mem_sec.c, separate the macro definition check from its use, avoiding checking the definition of an undefined macro and referencing that macro in the same #if condition.
Change the error return value of i2r_ADMISSION_SYNTAX() in crypto/x509/v3_admis.c from -1 to 0, to be consistent with other i2r implementations.

Minor fixes to the QUIC test server: correct the output parameter comment of ossl_quic_tserver_write to bytes_written; change the error label in quic_channel.c to err and add protocol error reporting; in quic_txp.c, change multiple variables such as is_last_in_dgram, must_pad, and have_ack_eliciting from char to int; split the long PROGRAMS list line in test/build.info.

In ossl_bn_rsa_fips186_4_derive_prime() of crypto/bn/bn_rsa_fips186_4.c, change the jump on failure of BN_priv_rand_range_ex() or BN_add() from goto end to goto err, so that the function returns 0 instead of 1.
Correct the function pointer type of kbkdf_dup in providers/implementations/kdfs/kbkdf.c to OSSL_FUNC_kdf_dupctx_fn.
In crypto/property/property.c, call OPENSSL_init_crypto() only when fetch uses the default libctx.
Minor fixes to QUIC congestion control, involving ssl/quic/quic_ackm.c and test/quic_cc_test.c.
Fix the issue where an unsorted stack is incorrectly sorted during search, avoiding race conditions, involving crypto/stack/stack.c.

Fix the issue where CRYPTO_THREAD_cleanup_local calls pthread_key_delete on uninitialized data when default_context_do_init has not been called, by adding a flag to check whether initialization succeeded, involving crypto/context.c.
Fix the issue of infinite loop caused by not releasing zero-length records when processing handshake fragments, involving ssl/record/rec_layer_s3.c.
Avoid generating RSA keys with p < q, and swap p and q in non-ACVP test cases, involving crypto/rsa/rsa_sp800_56b_gen.c.
Remove spurious errors produced by the ca application when specific configuration file entries are not provided, involving apps/ca.c.
Fix the compilation issue when both DTLS and TLS are disabled, involving test/sslapitest.c.
Fix the error format string used when reporting errors in quic_tls.c, involving ssl/quic/quic_tls.c.
In ssl/quic/quic_impl.c, fix the call to expect_quic_with_stream_lock in the ossl_quic_is_stream_local function by adding the missing /*io=*/0 parameter.

Add missing BIO_closesocket() calls in the error handling paths of the QUIC client demo code, involving demos/guide/quic-client-block.c, demos/guide/quic-client-non-block.c, demos/guide/quic-multi-stream.c, and related documentation.
Add functionality in the application library to output the correct prompt message when the store cannot be opened, involving apps/lib/apps.c.
Ignore incorrect signatures in CertificateVerify messages during fuzzing, involving ssl/statem/statem_lib.c.
Remove redundant error print output in apps.c, involving apps/lib/apps.c.
Remove the mandatory requirement for CRT parameters in ossl_rsa_set0_all_params, allowing RSA keys to not include CRT parameters, involving crypto/rsa/rsa_lib.c.

Update the openssl passwd documentation page, remove duplicate descriptions of the -1 and -apr1 options in DESCRIPTION, and unify them in the OPTIONS section, involving doc/man1/openssl-passwd.pod.in.
Re-add the four functions d2i_X509_bio(), d2i_X509_fp(), i2d_X509_bio(), and i2d_X509_fp() to the documentation, involving doc/man3/d2i_X509.pod and related missing function list files.

Fix the documentation description of the return value of OBJ_obj2txt() (off-by-one error), remove the obsolete BUGS section, and fix the function code style, involving crypto/objects/obj_dat.c and doc/man3/OBJ_nid2obj.pod.

Fix the description of the -list option in the openssl-dgst documentation, correct -digest-commands to -digest-algorithms, adjust the option order, and add examples, involving doc/man1/openssl-dgst.pod.in.
Fix the bug in the QUIC DDD design document ddd-06-mem-uv, involving doc/designs/ddd/ddd-06-mem-uv.c.

Update the QUIC tutorial demo code to use SSL_get_stream_read_state() to distinguish stream errors from connection errors, involving demos/guide/quic-client-block.c, demos/guide/quic-multi-stream.c, and related documentation.
Fix the description of the default value of the ess_cert_id_alg option in the openssl-ts(1) manual page.
Adjust the QUIC demo code to match the TLS client blocking code style, and fix spelling errors in the documentation.

Update the Makefile for the QUIC DDD demo, fix signedness issues in the demo source code, remove extra newline in the host port format string, and change to send the actual message length instead of the buffer size.
Fix the uninitialized warning for the buffer_size variable in crypto/armcap.c when compiling with -Wconditional-uninitialized.
Fix the compilation error of test/rdcpu_sanitytest.c when building with the no-asm configuration.
Fix the build failure in test/quicapitest.c due to unavailable SRTP-related functions when building with the no-srtp configuration.
Fix the compilation issue of ssl/quic/quic_ackm.c in clang-6/7/8 strict build mode.
In util/quicserver.c, removed the while loop code waiting for QUIC server shutdown (including the ossl_quic_tserver_shutdown call and the wait_for_activity call).
Move the maximum fragment length check from the SSL object to the record layer. (Architecture-related event: SSL_Protocol_Engine module change)

Migrate the encryption code, record type handling, buffer allocation, and other logic for each version of TLS/SSL from the common module to protocol-specific record layer methods, remove DTLS special handling, and refactor the record layer write path. (architectural event: record layer method refactoring)

The discard_enc_level implementation of QUIC TXP no longer automatically notifies QTX to discard encryption levels; the caller must handle this itself. (Architecture-related event: SSL_Protocol_Engine module change)
Optimize the receive processing logic of the QUIC channel, only reprocess the receive queue after receiving a new receive-side key. (Architecture-related event: SSL_Protocol_Engine module change)

Connect the SSL_CTX control functions and callback control functions in the QUIC front-end I/O API to the standard SSL implementation, and remove the no longer needed ossl_quic_conn_from_ssl function. (Architecture-related event: SSL_Protocol_Engine module change)

Rename the want_net_read and want_net_write fields in the QUIC internal API, add protocol error handling logic, and improve transport parameter handling. (Architecture-related event: SSL_Protocol_Engine module change)

Refactor the SSL option setting mechanism of QUIC, add the ossl_quic_set_options, ossl_quic_clear_options, and ossl_quic_get_options functions, and restrict QUIC connections to only allow certain options. (Architecture-related event: SSL_Protocol_Engine module change)

Optimize QUIC channel lock management: move the mutex out of the connection structure to support flexible initialization and destruction, and support releasing and reacquiring the mutex during polling waits. (Architecture-related event: SSL_Protocol_Engine module change)

Refactor the QUIC API: change the get_record() data field to const, change the front-end API parameter from QUIC_CONNECTION to SSL, introduce the QUIC_XSO type to replace QUIC_STREAM, and rename SSL_tick and SSL_get_tick_timeout to SSL_handle_events and SSL_get_event_timeout respectively. (Architecture-related event: SSL_Protocol_Engine module change)

Enhance QUIC functionality: forward unknown control commands to the underlying SSL, the termination reason function returns a constant pointer and adds state checks, the congestion control option interface migrates to OSSL_PARAM, and refactor the error promotion mechanism to support per-stream error handling. (Architecture-related event: SSL_Protocol_Engine module change)

Rename the incoming stream rejection policy related API and fields, and remove SSL_attach_stream and SSL_detach_stream from the public API to internal functions. (Architecture-related event: SSL_Protocol_Engine module change)

Refactor QUIC stream state management: define stream states based on RFC, add state query functions, remove the recv_fin_retired field and switch to a state machine. (Architectural event: QUIC protocol integration)
NewReno congestion control wake-up deadline changed to immediate, no waiting required. (Architectural event: QUIC protocol integration)

Refactor QUIC TLS error handling, add the raise_error function to uniformly record handshake layer errors and save error state, and adjust the ossl_quic_tls_get_error interface to return an error state object. (Architecture-related event: SSL_Protocol_Engine module change)

Refactor DTLS write record layer, create the dtls_write_records() function and move it into the record layer method, so that DTLS uses the common tls_write_records() and record layer buffers instead of the buffers in s->rlayer.
Update SSL error code definitions, renumber stream-related error codes, and add error description strings. (architecture-related: public API: error code definitions)
Migrate the load_csr_autofmt function to the shared library and update the calls, adding a verification option parameter. (architecture-related: public API: load_csr_autofmt migration)
Rename OSSL_CMP_CTX_get0_trustedStore to OSSL_CMP_CTX_get0_trusted, and update the related test cases. (architecture-related: public API: function renaming)
Deprecate the OPENSSL_LH_stats series of functions, and migrate the internal LHASH definitions to new macros. (architecture-related: public API: deprecation of OPENSSL_LH_stats)

Modify the X509_http_nbio and X509_CRL_http_nbio macro definitions to avoid including ocsp.h, and adjust header file dependencies. (architecture-related: public API: header file dependency adjustment)
Change the parameter types of settings and options in recordmethod.h to const. (architecture-related: public API)
Remove the ossl_namemap_add_name_n API, simplifying the internal implementation. (architecture-related: public API removal)
Refactor the ASN1_item_pack function, using ASN1_STRING_set0 to replace manual memory management, and fix error codes and length checks. (architecture-related: public API behavior change)
Extract the GCM function pointers into a separate structure, and add dedicated functions to initialize these function pointers. (architecture-related: public API structure change)

Clean up and refactor the implementations of X509_check_private_key and X509_REQ_check_private_key, and mark the parameters of X509_REQ_get0_pubkey and X509_REQ_check_private_key as const. (architecture-related: public API)
Remove the const qualifier from the second parameter of the PKCS12_SAFEBAG_set0_attrs function. (architecture-related: public API)
Rename the record layer types SSL3_BUFFER and SSL3_RECORD to TLS_BUFFER and TLS_RL_RECORD, respectively. (architecture-related: record layer type renaming)
Simplify the custom interface for QUIC BIO polling descriptors, changing the custom field from an array to a single pointer. (architecture-related: public API)
Rename the QUIC probe request API function name from ossl_ackm_get_probe_request to ossl_ackm_get0_probe_request, and remove the TODO comment in the documentation. (architecture-related: public API)

Refactor the aarch64 feature detection code, removing the detection method based on SIGILL, switching to more reliable methods such as getauxval and sysctl, and fix the HWCAP macro redefinition warning on FreeBSD. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)
Rename OSSL_CMP_get_caCerts to OSSL_CMP_get1_caCerts, and improve the documentation for OSSL_CMP_exec_certreq. (architecture-related: public API)
Partially revert support for the Windows CA certificate store, restoring the original certificate directory lookup logic. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)
Update the reference counting operations in the engine module to structure-based atomic operations, and add new inline functions. (architecture-related: public API)
Change the reference counting of BIO from lock-based atomic operations to structure-based atomic operations. (architecture-related: public API)
Migrate the reference counting of ECX keys from lock-based atomic operations to structure-based atomic operations. (architecture-related: public API)
Update the reference counting operations in the store module to structure-based atomic operations. (architecture-related: public API)
Update the reference counting and lock release in SSL_SESSION_free to atomic operations, and add the release of peer_rpk. (architecture-related: public API)
Update the reference counting implementations of encoders and decoders to structure-based atomic operations. (architecture-related: public API)
Update X509_STORE_free to use structure-based atomic operations. (architecture-related: public API)

Migrate the reference counting mechanisms for multiple objects in the EVP module from lock-based atomic operations to atomic reference counting within the structure. (architecture-related: public API)
Remove unused QUIC server method declarations and implementations, and clean up related test code. (architecture-related: public API)
Make the BIO_CONNECT_free function static, and clean up error handling for memory allocation. (architecture-related: public API)
Rename the QUIC function SSL_set_initial_peer_addr to SSL_set1_initial_peer_addr. (architecture-related: public API)
Change the type of the rectype parameter of the write_record function from int to uint8_t, unifying the representation of TLS record types. (architecture-related: public API)
Revise the QUIC connection close information API, merging the is_local and is_transport fields in SSL_get_conn_close_info into a flags field. (architecture-related: public API)
Move the deprecation version of functions related to lh_stats from OpenSSL 3.2 to 3.1, and fix the related deprecation macro definitions. (architecture-related: public API compatibility)
Add internal hardening checks to the HPKE implementation, including stricter parameter validation and more accurate error reporting. (architecture-related: public API behavior)
Standardize the progress callback mechanism for command-line tools such as dhparam, dsaparam, genpkey, and req.
Move e_os.h from the source root directory to the include/internal/ directory, and update the include paths in all source files that include this header.
Move the implementation of OPENSSL_strcasecmp() and related functions from crypto/ctype.c to crypto/o_str.c to avoid duplicate implementations in legacy.so.
Extract the declarations of the FIPS option functions into a separate header file providers/common/include/prov/fipscommon.h.

Clean up the RISC-V extension test macros, replacing the RV32I_* and RV64I_* macros with unified RISCV_HAS_* macros, merge test macros into riscv_arch.h, and rename the include files related to acceleration handling.

When processing TLS 1.3 records under KTLS, skip steps such as unpadding, outer type checking, and inner type extraction, and adjust record length checks and type pointer passing in message callbacks.
Clarify the logic in X509V3_set_ctx where the subject/req parameters are used to construct SAN email addresses from the subject DN, and improve code style and error codes.

Improve diagnostic information for transactionID mismatches in CMP, uniformly use the i2s_ASN1_OCTET_STRING function to handle string representations of ASN1_OCTET_STRING, and adjust the recipNone check for consistency.
Replace the unsigned long type in the DER writer with uint32_t, and rename related functions and update call sites.
When the DTLS record layer is closed, push unprocessed records in the buffer to the next record layer object, and adjust the epoch setting of the unprocessed record queue.
In OSSL_HTTP_REQ_CTX_nbio, switch to using OSSL_TRACE_STRING to output the message body, and optimize Content-Type matching, error status handling, and trace output format.
Migrate the read buffer release logic of SSL_MODE_RELEASE_BUFFERS to the record layer, and clean up leftover TODO code.
Rename the DTLS1_BITMAP structure and related functions to DTLS_BITMAP, and adjust bit operations to support 64-bit systems.
Rename the require_ca parameter to non_leaf to more accurately reflect its meaning.
Migrate the internal time representation of the libssl and crypto modules from time_t and struct timeval to OSSL_TIME, keeping the public API with original types but converting internally.

Change the parameter types of the COMP_METHOD structure and related functions from unsigned int to size_t, change return values to ossl_ssize_t, add NULL pointer checks, and remove non-functional COMP_METHODS.
Refactor the write record layer to provide correct return values, and replace SSLfatal calls with RLAYERfatal.
Call get_max_records in the record layer code, use the returned data to decide how to split pending write data into records, and adjust record release and write functions accordingly.
Move the QUIC_CONNECTION type definition to an internal header file, add functions to obtain a QUIC_CONNECTION pointer from a SSL pointer, and add setter/getter for the QRX and ACKM fields.
Remove leftover TODO comments and adjust the alignment calculation logic when writing TLS records.
Removed two no-op function pointers that were never called from OSSL_RECORD_METHOD.
QUIC RX adds reference counting support, no longer requiring callers to manage reference counts, and removes the OSSL_QRX_PKT_WRAP wrapper structure.
Removed the logic in the QUIC receiver that automatically discards the Initial encryption layer; this operation is now handled by the upper layer.
QUIC TX no longer internally manages the reference count of BIO; changed ossl_qtx_set1_bio to ossl_qtx_set_bio, and callers must ensure the BIO lifecycle themselves.
Removed multiple no-longer-used fields from the SSL_CONNECTION structure, including encryption context, compression/extension, IV and MAC keys, to clean up the internal structure.
Reverted the timing attack fix in RSA decryption, but retained the change that moved derive_kdk to a separate function.
Added the CERTIFICATE_VERIFY_MAX_LENGTH constant to limit the maximum length of CertificateVerify messages, and applied it in the state machine.
Refactored the DRBG implementation so that it manages lock acquisition and release itself, no longer relying on the EVP layer's lock/unlock hints.
Improved the check logic for the -tls_used option in the CMP client: when the -server URL is HTTPS, -tls_used is automatically enabled.
Updated the reference counting operation for DH objects to a structure-based atomic operation.
Updated the reference counting operation for DSA to a structure-based atomic operation.
Updated the reference counting operation for the DSO module to a structure-based atomic operation.
Updated the ASN1 locking functions to manage reference counts using structure-based atomic operations.
Updated the reference counting operation for the EC module to a structure-based atomic implementation.
Changed the reference counting and activation counting operations for provider to structure-based atomic operations.
Updated the reference counting for RSA to a structure-based atomic operation.
When sending congestion control probe packets, no longer generate full-size packets, but only generate small packets containing PING and ACK frames.
Performed a major refactoring of QUIC TXP to correctly handle padding logic, and introduced new packet generation geometry calculations and commit flow.
Removed redundant parentheses in the felem_reduce method of secp384r1.
Removed the check for completeness of private key parameters in ossl_rsa_todata, so that it only returns the parameters that have been set.
Pass the DTLS record version to the message callback function.
Added an interface in the QUIC ACKM module that allows querying the largest acknowledged packet sequence number (largest acked PN).
Clean up and refactor the DTLS code, including merging BIO_CTRL_DGRAM_SET_NEXT_TIMEOUT calls, simplifying return types, and style fixes.
Add and apply the HAS_CASE_PREFIX(), CHECK_AND_SKIP_CASE_PREFIX(), and HAS_CASE_SUFFIX() macros to multiple components.
In the pkcs12 command-line tool, rename the enc_flag variable to enc_name for better readability.
Simplify the definition of the ARIA AEAD cipher in crypto/evp/e_aria.c, removing fixed macro variables and keeping only the cipher mode name and key length.

In crypto/evp/e_aes.c and crypto/evp/e_chacha20_poly1305.c, replace code that directly references EVP_CIPHER_CTX structure fields (such as ctx->buf, ctx->encrypt) with the corresponding interface API.
In providers/common/provider_util.c and test/evp_kdf_test.c, stop using global EVP_CIPHER and EVP_MD.
Change the strength check for TLS RC4 ciphers to a data-driven approach, adjust strength values, and remove hardcoded security checks.
In crypto/evp/digest.c, remove three NULL checks for type (since type cannot be NULL), and move the check for ->engine inside the CPP macro guard for engines.

In crypto/property/property_parse.c and crypto/property/property_query.c, stop overwriting the global variables ossl_property_true and ossl_property_false each time a OSSL_LIB_CTX is created; instead, pre-initialize them and verify that each OSSL_LIB_CTX's settings are consistent with the pre-initialized values.
In crypto/provider_core.c, include/internal/provider.h, and the documentation, remove the unused field flag_fallback and the function ossl_provider_set_fallback.
In crypto/provider_core.c, ossl_provider_new no longer calls ossl_provider_find to check whether a provider already exists; the caller is responsible for confirming this.
In crypto/provider_conf.c, extract the configuration-triggered provider activation logic into a separate function.
In crypto/bn/bn_lib.c, modify bin2bn() to process data from the least significant block to the most significant block, and refactor the inner loop to simplify the calculation for each bignum block.
In key_to_type_specific_pem_bio_cb of providers/implementations/encode_decode/encode_key2any.c, use the passphrase callback passed as a parameter.
Improve the print_itavs() function in apps/cmp.c.
Simplify the code in read_write_req_resp() of apps/cmp.c, since the req parameter cannot be NULL.
In crypto/cmp/cmp_ctx.c, remove redundant code in multiple getter and setter definitions.
In ssl/statem/statem.c, statem_clnt.c, statem_local.h, and statem_srvr.c, remove unused parameters related to get_construct_message_f.
In apps/lib/apps.c, fix various code style issues found by check-format.pl.
In crypto/evp/pmeth_gn.c, remove the unused callback variable.
In apps/genrsa.c, use progress_cb.
In crypto/evp/e_aes.c and crypto/evp/e_aes_cbc_hmac_sha1.c, avoid directly accessing the key length field.
In ssl/record/rec_layer_s3.c's do_ssl3_write(), restore the use of the variable thiswr (reverting the unwanted change from #5253).
Unify the macro naming for the SSL key exchange algorithm, replacing the old aliases SSL_kEDH and SSL_kEECDH with the more common SSL_kDHE and SSL_kECDHE.
In ssl3_get_record(), introduce the auxiliary variable using_ktls to simplify the condition checks in the KTLS receive path.
Move the method code of the Record layer to the ssl/record/methods/ subdirectory, involving adjustments to ssl/build.info, ssl/record/build.info, and related source files.

In crypto/core_algorithm.c, crypto/core_fetch.c, and include/internal/core.h, refactor the preconditions and postconditions of method construction so that ossl_method_construct_precondition() can be aware of the |no_store| flag to distinguish between permanent and temporary storage.
In X509_print_ex(), clear unused variables.
Avoid duplication of code for locale initialization.
In ossl_namemap_name2_num, avoid unnecessary calls to OPENSSL_strndup().
Remove the use of ossl_statem_in_error() from the record layer, and instead check whether the record layer has set an alert code.
Move the sequence number into the OSSL_RECORD_LAYER object to reduce the record layer's references to the SSL object.
Remove some remaining references to the SSL object in the record layer.
Rename 'multi' to 'n_responders' in files such as apps/ocsp.c for clarity.
Remove the redundant early exit logic from BN_consttime_swap.
Remove some remaining references to the SSL object from the DTLS record layer.

Clean up unused fields and redundant code in the record layer, including removing the create_empty_fragment parameter from do_dtls1_write(), removing unnecessary read buffer settings, removing temporary function pointers no longer needed in OSSL_RECORD_METHOD, removing KTLS-specific code in tls_setup_write_buffers, resolving TODO(RECLAYER) in SSLv3 code, and cleaning up old code after migration to the new architecture.
Clean up the use of the GHASH macro and remove GCM_FUNCREF_4BIT from GCM_MUL.
Standardize the DTLS record layer naming, changing dtls1_* references to dtls_*.
Introduce and use ossl_asn1_string_set_bits_left() for the libcrypto refactoring.
Perform code cleanup on app_http_tls_cb() and tls_error_hint().
Unify the internal representation type of epoch to uint16_t.
Change the return value of the constructor from boolean type to an enum type to represent three different return values.
Rename all ossl_sleep calls to OSSL_sleep, and remove the no longer necessary internal/e_os.h include.
Change OSSL_TIME to a struct type to prevent misuse.
Call QUIC flow control functionality in QUIC receive stream management.
Change the internal linked list implementations of demux, record RX, ackm, and tx record layer in QUIC to use list.h.
Change uint_set to use the list data type, replacing the original self-implemented linked list, involving uint_set.h, quic_ackm.c, quic_sstream.c, and uint_set.c files.
stack's pop/shift/value no longer adds error information on out-of-bounds access, only returns NULL, partially reverting commit 30eba7f35983a917f1007bce45040c0af3442e42.
Start using WPACKET in DTLS write record code to replace direct buffer writes.
Introduce a single function in the record layer to uniformly handle the increment of the sequence counter, replacing the previous approach scattered across multiple different implementations.
Remove the dtls_write_records function, as it is functionally equivalent to tls_write_records_default after the preceding commit.
Remove multiple redundant code sections, involving d1_lib.c, multiple record layer files, and state machine related files, etc.
Remove the ossl_crypto_thread_native_terminate function and related implementations.
Migrate multiple declarations from record.h and record_local.h to within ssl/record/methods, and delete declarations that are no longer needed.
DH_check[_params]() uses dh's own libctx for prime checking; DH parameter generation also uses libctx.
Separate the handling of RX and TX encryption levels in the QUIC channel.
The QUIC channel drives the demuxer only once per tick.
Remove the redundant assignment of ftmp4 in felem_mul_ref of p521.
hpke_aead_enc/dec() is refactored to take a OSSL_HPKE_CTX * parameter.
Use ossl_assert in the QUIC channel and reactor.
Clarify probe types in QUIC ACKM.
Refactor the probe reporting mechanism in QUIC ACKM to support bookkeeping purposes.
QUIC SSL implements buffer management, involving SSL_alloc_buffers documentation, ssl_lib.c, and quicapitest.c.
Rename multiple function names from the OSSL_QUIC_FAULT prefix to the QTEST_FAULT prefix.
In the QUIC implementation, switch CRYPTO_RWLOCK to use ossl_crypto_mutex.
FFC cleanup: remove unnecessary checks in ossl_dh_get0_params() and ossl_dsa_get0_params(); restrict dsa keygen tests to the FIPS module; change ossl_ffc_set_digest() to return void.
Refactor the locking mechanism of QUIC thread-assisted mode to be infallible.
Update HKDF, KBKDF, and SSKDF to use shared functions.
Enhance the unpacking function for SSL objects in QUIC Dispatch.
Clean up handling of SEND_STREAM/RECV_STREAM in QUIC stream mapping.
Make QUIC RXDP keep the AEC code records consistent for STOP_SENDING/RESET_STREAM events.
Sort the ASN.1 stack before using lookups; the sorting in a_strnid.c remains without lock protection.
Convert the struct_ref field of the ENGINE structure to an atomic type, using atomic primitives for incrementing and decrementing reference counts.
Replace clumsy and error-prone patterns in applications with the new function app_conf_try_string().
Create the internal/ssl.h header file and move the type definition of ossl_msg_cb into it; rename msg_callback_s to msg_callback_ssl.
Refactor the state output of QUIC TXP to use an extensible structure.
The QUIC channel notifies ACKM upon handshake confirmation.
Make the definition of ACK triggering (ACK eliciting) in QUIC RXDP more resilient and centralized.
QUIC send stream state transitions to the DATA_SENT state.
Integrate the DATA_SENT state into QUIC consistency handling.
In the FIPS self-test, use tsan_counter instead of tsan_add for incrementing.
Return immediately if namemap is NULL.
The QUIC implementation is updated to use structure-based atomic operations.
Convert reference counting to a structure containing a count and an optional lock; the legacy provider and the QUIC implementation are synchronously updated to use structure-based atomic operations.
Mark the felem_square and felem_mul wrapper functions of nistp521 as static for static linking.
Remove duplicate definitions in include/internal/quic_types.h and add comments.
Delete the unreachable conditional check and the fplace decrement code at lines 710-711 in the fmtfp() function in crypto/bio/bio_print.c.
Delete unused internal functions in crypto/evp/pmeth_lib.c and include/crypto/evp.h.
Simplify the QUIC API mask handling in ssl/ssl_lib.c.
Remove redundant checks in crypto/cms/cms_sd.c.
Remove the unused parameter sending from the derive_secret_key_and_iv() function in ssl/tls13_enc.c.
Move the QUIC string conversion functions from the header file to the ssl/quic/quic_wire.c source file.
Move the can-poll flag into the QUIC reactor, involving include/internal/quic_reactor.h and ssl/quic/quic_reactor.c.
Clean up poll descriptor management for the QUIC channel, involving include/internal/quic_channel.h and ssl/quic/quic_channel.c.
Remove the unused structure ssl3_comp_st from ssl/ssl_local.h and util/indent.pro.
Fix fixed-size handling for dgram_pair and dgram_mem in crypto/bio/bss_dgram_pair.c.
Update OPENSSL_buf2hexstr() in crypto/o_str.c to use DEFAULT_SEPARATOR.
Fill in the rec_version field of decoded DTLS records in ssl/record/methods/dtls_meth.c.
Remove the duplicate definition of SSL_AD_NO_ALERT, remove the macro redefinition in ssl3_cbc.c, and delete the no longer used read field from the SSL3_RECORD structure.

Remove the unnecessary undef in crypto/bn/bn_asm.c; remove the statistical tracking feature of LHASH; remove the unreachable strlen() call in crypto/x509/v3_sxnet.c; remove the unused libctx functions runonce and onfree in crypto/context.c and include/internal/cryptlib.h.
Remove the duplicate #include header files included in multiple source files.
Add a check on the result of inserting the provider into the stack in apps/list.c; add a check on the return value of ossl_property_value() in parse_unquoted of crypto/property/property_parse.c.

Adjust some positions in apps/ocsp.c to clarify that they refer to the certificate list; improve the code style, comments, and related documentation of crypto/x509/x509_lu.c and crypto/x509/x509_vfy.c.

Fix some pointer comparison issues in crypto/ec/ecp_smpl.c.

In crypto/asn1/i2d_evp.c, apps/s_server.c, apps/pkcs12.c, crypto/txt_db/txt_db.c, crypto/bn/bn_exp.c, and crypto/http/http_client.c, remove or avoid useless assignments outside loops to variables (ctx, i, wvalue, rctx, bags) that are only used inside loops and are reassigned at the start of each loop iteration.

In crypto/bn/bn_local.h, remove the unused PTR_SIZE_INT macro definition.
In ssl/quic/quic_channel.c and related header files, remove the special code for stream 0.
Remove the TX key update handling logic from the QUIC TXP, involving quic_types.h and quic_txp.c.
Add utility functions for the QUIC WIRE to determine whether the packet number PN is within an ACK frame, involving quic_wire.h and quic_wire.c.
Allow querying the next packet number PN to be used in the QUIC TXP, involving quic_txp.h and quic_txp.c.
Refactor the key update callback of the QUIC RX to provide the packet number PN, involving quic_record_rx.h and quic_record_rx.c.
Fix the error path of the QUIC stream reset to release the lock, add a check of the stream frame reception state, simplify test cleanup calls, and correct multiple spelling errors.
In get_cert_by_subject_ex(), add a check of the return value of X509_STORE_lock(), involving by_dir.c.
Add an assertion when the POSIX thread mutex lock fails, involving thread_posix.c.
Replace ssl3_get_message() with tls_get_message_header() and/or tls_get_message_body(), involving rec_layer_d1.c, rec_layer_s3.c, and ssl_local.h.
Remove redundant free operations on NULL, involving providers/fips/fipsprov.c.
When calling isspace(), cast the argument to unsigned char, involving apps/cmp.c, apps/lib/apps.c, apps/req.c, test/evp_test.c, and test/testutil/provider.c.
When TSAN is unavailable, use locks for lhash statistics collection, involving lh_stats.c, lhash.c, and lhash_local.h.
In OSSL_METHOD_STORE, complete the algorithm cleanup so that alg_cleanup correctly clears the OPENSSL_SA leaf nodes of freed content, involving property.c.
In ec_kmgmt.c, check the return value of BN_CTX_get() in a timely manner; if both x and y are NULL, skip subsequent operations.
Update tls13encryptiontest for the new read record layer structure, involving tls_common.c and tls13encryptiontest.c.

Fixed the failure of enginetest when compiling with deprecated API disabled and API version specified as 1.1.1, and added the missing header file inclusion. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)

Fixed the issue with SSL_trace() in the QUIC API test on big-endian platforms, changing the type field of the record template structure to unsigned char type. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)

Added multi-stream support to the QUIC test server, added tick, connection state, and termination state query functions, and modified the read/write interfaces to support specifying stream ID. (architecture-related: internal API: QUIC test server)

Added an internal API for white-box testing key updates in QUIC, including setting TXKU threshold overrides, getting send and receive key epoch, and fixing idle timeout calculation and retry token handling. (architecture-related: internal API: QUIC key update test)
Added write checks for lock checking in threadstest, and used a lock alternative path on platforms that do not support TSAN operations, involving threadstest.c.
Worked around the atexit crash issue on the NonStop platform, avoiding dynamically loading the legacy provider into applications statically linked with libcrypto, involving test/evp_extra_test.c.
Allow qtestlib to use a simulated time implementation, and modified test cases to use this feature, removing sleep calls that may fail. (architecture-related: test framework change: simulated time)
Added tests for OSSL_PROVIDER_load_ex, involving provider_internal_test.c and provider_test.c.
Added a new QUIC test server tool, extending the test server API, supporting stream state queries, local connection ID updates, and network activity waiting.
Replaced bitwise OR operators with logical OR operators in test code to eliminate the -Wbitwise-instead-of-logical warning from Clang.
Added the missing string.h header file in the test file test/v3ext.c.
Added tests to verify the order of TLS extensions, and added helper functions to get extension types and related macro definitions.
Added a fuzzer for the PEM format to discover the CVE-2022-4450 vulnerability.
Add provider-based speed test functionality for KEM and SIG algorithms.
Added a decoder fuzzer to discover CVE-2023-0217.
Added test cases for concatenating multiple info fields for KBKDF, SSKDF, and X963KDF.

Added the OPENSSL_TEST_RAND_SEED environment variable, allowing the test random number seed to be set independently without affecting test order, and displaying the correct seed environment variable when tests fail.
Introduced richer noise patterns in the noisy dgram BIO, supporting random packet loss, delay, and duplicate datagrams, and added debug output to track the noise processing.
Improved the malloc failure test: allowed percentage values in OPENSSL_MALLOC_FAILURES to support two decimal places, and added the OPENSSL_MALLOC_SEED environment variable to support randomization.
Fixed a potential array overflow issue reported by Coverity, increasing the parameter array size in digest_test_run from 3 to 4.
Add RFC6979 deterministic ECDSA known-answer test cases in evptest format, involving 30-test_evp.t and evppkey_rfc6979.txt.
Added a standalone timing test program and related certificate and key files, involving timing.c, timing-cert.pem, and timing-key.pem.
Added test cases for RNDR and RNDRRS, and merged with RDRAND tests to share common logic, involving rdcpu_sanitytest.c, rdrand_sanitytest.c, and related test scripts.
Added thread tests for object creation in test/threadstest.c, and refactored multi-threaded tests to use common code.
Added tests for the DANE cross-certificate fix, involving new cross-certificate key/root certificate files and the dane-cross test case.
Add SM2 encryption test cases from GM/T 0003.5-2012 in test/sm2_internal_test.c.
Extended the custom extension test in test/sslapitest.c to cover scenarios where a custom extension is added to a certificate request and a response is expected in the client certificate message.
Handled the conflict between FIPS and KTLS in test/sslapitest.c, because the KTLS CHACHA enabled by new Linux kernels (>= 5.11) does not meet FIPS requirements.
Fixed a memory leak in test/asynctest.c, ensuring that after ASYNC_start_job() automatically calls ASYNC_init_thread(), ASYNC_cleanup_thread() is eventually called.
Added failure test cases for property parsing in test/property_test.c.
Adjusted test cases to accommodate the change of the default security level from 1 to 2, and fixed the DH automatic test failure caused by the security level increase.
Added tests to verify obtaining the correct signature provider for non-exported keys, involving files such as test/fake_rsaprov.c and test/provider_pkey_test.c.

In test/evp_extra_test.c, tested that calling EVP_DigestSign(), EVP_DigestSignFinal(), EVP_PKEY_sign(), EVP_PKEY_get_raw_private_key(), or EVP_PKEY_get_raw_public_key() with a short output buffer returns failure.
Fixed test_CMAC_keygen in test/evp_extra_test.c to ensure the buffer size is correctly passed to EVP_DigestSignFinal.
Fixed acvp_test sig_gen in test/acvp_test.c to ensure the signature buffer size is set before calling EVP_DigestSign().
Add SM2 signature test cases from GM/T 0003.5-2012 in test/sm2_internal_test.c.
Fix the potential memory leak in test/ssl_old_test.c.
Add tests for ENGINE-related issues in test/evp_extra_test.c to capture the engine handling problems fixed by the first 3 commits.
Fix the issue under the no-cmac configuration in test/evp_extra_test.c.
Add a test in test/evp_extra_test.c to verify that the key is usable after the EVP_PKEY_fromdata call.
Remove the unused variable sctx and its definition and operations in test_509_dup_cert of test/x509_dup_cert_test.c.
Remove the redundant repeated calls to RAND_get0_private() in test/rand_test.c.
Add test/safe_math_test.c and update the build configuration to add unit tests for integer overflow helper functions.
Check the return values of BN_new() and BN_dup() in test/testutil/tests.c.
Add unit tests for weak keys and key parity checks in test/destest.c.
Add a test for reinitialization via EVP_DigestSignInit() in test/evp_extra_test.c.
Add a SIPHASH MAC digestsign test with reinitialization in test/evp_extra_test.c.

Add priority queue unit tests involving test/priority_queue_test.c and the test recipe file.

Add a test in test/evp_extra_test2.c for copying an uninitialized EVP_MD_CTX.
Enable and fix the test_bn2padded() test in test/bntest.c, updating it to the current API.
Add memory allocation checks in test/bio_enc_test.c.
Refactor test_fromdata() in test/evp_extra_test.c by splitting it into two functions: make_key_fromdata() and test_selection().
Add a free operation before returning in test/cmp_vfy_test.c.

Improve the test for adding an empty digest signature algorithm in test/upcallstest.c.
Add unit tests for the ossl_property_name_str and ossl_property_value_str functions in test/property_test.c.
In test/sslapitest.c, test that PEM_BUFSIZE is correctly passed to the size parameter of pem_password_cb.

Add memory allocation failure checks in multiple test files, including return value checks for functions such as OPENSSL_strdup, OPENSSL_malloc, sk_SCT_new_null, OSSL_PROVIDER_load, BIO_new_mem_buf, BIO_new, and glue2bio.
Change the pkey KDF copy failure test to a copy success test, and add context copy operations in the KDF test.
In test/params_conversion_test.c, check whether errors are correctly raised during parameter conversion, and in test/params_api_test.c, fix the extra conversion copy issue on big-endian machines.
Add a cipher context copy test in test/evp_test.c.
Add test cases for EVP_PKEY_set1_encoded_public_key(), with the changed file being test/evp_pkey_dparams_test.c.

Fix the resource leak issue in test/helpers/handshake.c (Coverity 1498613).

Check whether the UnsafeLegacyServerConnect option exists in test/ssl-tests/17-renegotiate.cnf and test/ssl-tests/17-renegotiate.cnf.in.

Add tests for various API calls for TLSv1.3 record padding in test/sslapitest.c.
Open files in binary mode in test/pkcs12_api_test.c to fix failures on MinGW.
Add explicit pointer checks in test/helpers/ssltestlib.c and test/list_test.c to fix Coverity-reported NULL dereferences.
