Optimize the modular exponentiation function, remove unused variables, adjust initialization order, add parameter alias checks, and extend the acceleration path to support more modulus sizes. (architecture-related: public API)

Optimize dual 1536/2048-bit modular exponentiation for Intel IceLake CPU, using AVX512_IFMA256 ISA, and extend related functions to support multiple modulus bit widths. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)
Add runtime feature detection for ARM platforms to enable EOR3 instructions and loop unrolling optimizations, thereby improving AES-GCM performance. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)

Enable vectorized AES-GCM implementation based on AVX512 vAES and vPCLMULQDQ instructions, and update struct member order comments to match new assembly module dependencies. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)

Optimize ChaCha20 performance for the ppc64le architecture, add support for POWER10 processors, achieving approximately 50% performance improvement through 8-way parallel processing. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)

Add RISC-V hardware acceleration support for the SHA512 algorithm, introducing macro definitions based on RISC-V extension instructions through conditional compilation. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)
Optimize AES-GCM performance for p9+ ppc64le platforms, introduce concatenation methods, and add related macro definitions and function declarations. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)

On ARM processors, utilize SM4 hardware instructions to implement SM4 algorithm optimization, achieving performance improvements of approximately 8 to 40 times. (architecture-related: platform compatibility: ARM SM4 hardware acceleration)

Add MD5 assembly implementation for the aarch64 architecture, enabled by modifying conditional compilation macros, significantly improving performance. (architecture-related: platform compatibility: aarch64 MD5 assembly)

On aarch64 platforms, utilize SM3 hardware instructions to accelerate the SM3 algorithm, automatically detect hardware support, and platforms without support still use the original C implementation. (architecture-related: platform compatibility: aarch64 SM3 hardware acceleration)

Add GCM multiplication acceleration based on clmul instructions for the RISC-V 64-bit architecture, support runtime detection of Zbb and Zbc extensions to select implementations, and retain a C language fallback implementation. (architecture-related: platform compatibility: RISC-V GCM multiplication acceleration)

Add support for the SVE extension on aarch64, and use SVE instructions to accelerate ChaCha20 encryption, with performance improvements up to 20%. (architecture-related: platform compatibility: aarch64 SVE ChaCha20 acceleration)

Add an optimized implementation of SM4 based on ASIMD instructions for ARM platforms (N1/V1 microarchitectures), improving performance in parallelizable modes such as ECB, CTR, GCM, and CBC decryption, and add VPSM4-related key setup and encryption/decryption functions. (architecture-related: platform compatibility: ARM ASIMD SM4 acceleration)

Optimize the EVP_MD_CTX_copy_ex function to reduce frequent writes to the reference count of EVP_MD objects, alleviating cache contention issues during high-frequency multi-threaded use. (architecture-related: public API)
Add an assembly implementation based on the RISC-V Zksh extension for the SM3 algorithm, supporting both RV32 and RV64 architectures. (architecture-related: RISC-V support)

Add ROTATE inline assembly support for SM3, and move the ROTATE inline assembly to a header file to optimize SM3, SHA, and other hash functions simultaneously. (architecture-related: core header file change)
Enable loop unrolling and EOR3 optimization for AES-GCM on Neoverse N2 processors to improve performance. (architecture-related: platform compatibility: Neoverse N2)

Optimize the implementation of tolower and related character classification functions, replacing table lookups with direct ASCII range comparisons to avoid memory accesses and improve performance; also change some macro definitions to function declarations and adjust interface signatures. (architecture-related: public API: interface signature adjustment)
Reintroduce the fixed-length (n=6) PPC Montgomery multiplication optimization, and add support for the Power10 MADD300 instruction. (architecture-related: platform compatibility: Power10)

Optimize the KMAC algorithm on the s390x architecture by manually padding the last data block and using the kimd instruction for hardware acceleration, improving performance by 2 to 3 times; also use the klmd instruction to optimize keccak XOF processing, accelerating scenarios with multiple result blocks. (architecture-related: platform compatibility: s390x)
Add VPAES vector extension optimization for AES on the LoongArch64 architecture, and define corresponding capability detection macros. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)
Add SM4 optimization support for the Kunpeng-920 platform, enabling related acceleration by identifying HiSilicon CPU models. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)

Optimize FIPS RSA key generation performance by using modular inverse operations instead of greatest common divisor tests, and add the BN_are_coprime function; also adjust the number of Miller-Rabin primality test rounds to the value specified by FIPS 186-5, replacing the original fixed 64 rounds. (architecture-related: public API)

Optimize GCM mode performance for the RISC-V platform, selecting different implementations based on runtime-supported extensions (Zbc, Zbkb, Zbb), using the clmul instruction and reducing register usage; also integrate GHASH hardware acceleration, giving GCM mode full hardware acceleration capability on RISC-V. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)

On the PowerPC64LE platform, when Altivec and ISA 3.0 (Power 9 and above) support is detected, enable assembly implementations of felem_square and felem_mul. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)

Enable hardware-accelerated SHA3 absorb functions on Apple CPU compatible with ARMv8.2, improving large-block data processing performance by approximately 36%. (architecture-related: ARMv8.2 hardware acceleration)
Enable additional optimizations for GHASH, RAND, and AES on the Arm64 platform on Windows. (architecture-related: Windows Arm64 optimization)
Added support for the embedded-struct doubly linked list type OSSL_LIST, which requires no dynamic memory allocation and allows a struct to belong to multiple lists simultaneously.
Implemented SM4 AESE optimization for the ARMv8 platform, adding vpsm4-armv8.pl, vpsm4_ex-armv8.pl, and hardware acceleration implementations related to SM4-XTS.

Added offloading support for modular exponentiation (ME) and Chinese Remainder Theorem (CRT) of the Crypto Express Adapter on the S390x platform, and added recognition of the nocex token in the OPENSSL_s390xcap environment variable to disable offloading.
Enabled AES optimization for Apple Silicon M2 systems in crypto/armcap.c.
Applied the aes-gcm unroll8+eor3 optimization patch to the Neoverse V2 platform.
In crypto/bn/rsa_sup_mul.c, add __umulh() intrinsic support for MSVC on non-x64 platforms; _umul128() is only used on x86_64.
Replaced pointer bitwise operations with ternary conditional operators in crypto/bn/bn_nist.c to eliminate implementation-defined behavior issues in the C standard.
Added a fast lookup mechanism for OSSL_PARAM based on TRIE, generating pre-built data structures in core_names.h via a Perl script to accelerate parameter lookup by name.
Changed the write lock for default random method lookup to a read lock in RAND_get_rand_method(), falling back to a write lock only when necessary.
Added inline assembly acceleration support for the SHA256 algorithm based on the RISC-V Zknh extension.
Simplified the Ed25519 square root calculation, replacing the original u*v^3 * (u * v^7)^((p-5)/8) with u * (u*v)^((p-5)/8), reducing the number of multiplications by 3 and squaring operations by 2.
Cached key length and IV length to avoid expensive parameter queries on each lookup, and skip provider calls when parameters have not changed.
Optimized SM4 encryption/decryption performance in non-assembly mode by introducing a table lookup method to replace the original rotation operations.
Converted NULL attribute queries to empty strings, fixing performance degradation caused by lack of caching.

Optimized SM4-GCM encryption/decryption performance on the ARM platform by reusing the existing high-performance CTR encryption interface instead of single-block encryption, achieving up to a 4-fold performance improvement.
Refactored decoder internal logic to reduce repeated calls to OSSL_DECODER_is_a and EVP_KEYMGMT_is_a, improving performance for repeated decoding operations.
Optimized the evp_md_init_internal function to avoid reallocating the algorithm context when the digest algorithm has not changed, and refactored the release logic of the algorithm context.
Added an inline assembly implementation of ROTATE for DES based on the RISC-V zbb/zbkb extension.
Optimized the performance of the ossl_lh_strcasehash function, roughly halving the runtime.
Ensured that prefix records use a small buffer, avoiding allocation of a full-size write buffer when only the prefix is needed.
Optimize the SM4 key setup function, improving performance by approximately 48% through refactoring nonlinear transformations and loop unrolling.
Optimize DRBG parameter retrieval, allowing secure parameters such as max_request to be read without locking, improving concurrency performance.
Optimize key updates in the QUIC channel, adding a mechanism to force generation of ACK to accelerate key update completion.

Change the state access of the FIPS module from a lock mechanism to using memory ordering operations to improve performance and reduce synchronization overhead; also add HMAC-SHA-256 known-answer tests and RNG recovery verification.
In non-blocking mode, when SSL_read fails, add a reactor tick and retry reading to improve data delivery success rate.
Introduce a caching mechanism for PKEY decoders, reusing OSSL_DECODER_CTX objects with the same parameters to improve performance.
Introduce branch prediction hints in EVP_EncryptUpdate and EVP_DecryptUpdate and optimize input length conversion and division operations to improve performance under GCC/Clang.

Adopt a Solinas reduction strategy with 56-bit redundant limbs for the secp384r1 curve, achieving efficient modular multiplication, with digital signature speed improved by 446% and verification speed improved by 106%.
Optimize SM2 performance on the aarch64 architecture, adding a dedicated SM2 P-256 elliptic curve implementation.
Reuse memory allocations between ACK frame processing in QUIC RXDP, and add improvements such as key update checks and flow control notifications.
In s_client's QUIC mode, when user data is pending, set the select timeout to 0 to avoid unnecessary waiting.
test/params_test.c adds performance tests for OSSL_PARAM_allocate_from_text with integers of arbitrary size.
test/ocspapitest.c correctly checks the return values of memory allocation functions.
Remove DSA512 from the speed test, and update apps/speed.c and openssl-speed documentation accordingly.
The apps/speed.c speed command adds RSA encryption/decryption performance measurement, previously only measuring RSA signing/verification.
Add a QUIC backpressure test in test/quicapitest.c to verify whether backpressure eventually occurs when one end sends data faster than the peer can process.
In apps/speed.c's EdDSA_sign/verify_loop(), fix the EdDSA performance test failure caused by the context being finalized by reinitializing the context.

In the test_pipelining function of test/sslapitest.c, use fragsize as the condition to fix the crash caused by calling OPENSSL_free on the read-only string constant msg during error handling when idx==5.
In crypto/property/property_string.c, use a stack structure instead of hash table search to efficiently convert indices to strings.
Remove the unused and untested _fetch_by_number function family, involving decoder_meth.c, encoder_meth.c, evp_fetch.c, keymgmt_meth.c, store_meth.c, and related header files and documentation.
Implement automatic optimization of the QUIC APL write buffer size in ssl/quic/quic_impl.c.
In crypto/bn/bn_lib.c, replace OPENSSL_cleanse with memset in bn2binpad to avoid fuzzer recognizing the buffer as uninitialized.
In crypto/sparse_array.c, reduce the sparse array block size to improve the performance of the ossl_sa_doall_arg function.
In providers/implementations/include/prov/ciphercommon.h, align the IV/buf fields of the prov_cipher_ctx_st structure to improve performance of unaligned memory access on certain architectures.
In crypto/chacha/chacha_enc.c, add inline assembly for ROTATE based on the RISC-V zbb/zbkb extensions for ChaCha.
In crypto/encode_decode/encoder_pkey.c, improve the performance of the encoder collection.
In the GCM implementation in providers/implementations/ciphers/ciphercommon_gcm.c, adopt a new faster parameter location mechanism.
In EVP_PKCS82PKEY_ex in crypto/evp/evp_pkey.c, improve performance by directly determining the key type to avoid trying all loaded decoders.
In d2i_AutoPrivateKey and related functions in crypto/asn1/d2i_pr.c, first probe whether the file is PKCS8 to improve decoder performance.
In providers/implementations/ciphers/cipher_sm4_ccm_hw.c, enable hardware acceleration for SM4-CCM.
In providers/implementations/ciphers/cipher_sm4_gcm_hw.c, enable VPSM4_EX_CAPABLE hardware acceleration for SM4-GCM.

In ossl_provider_doall_activated() in crypto/provider_core.c, refactor the lock mechanism, changing the write lock of flag_lock to a read lock, and protecting activatecnt with atomic operations to reduce lock contention.
In rsa_get_blinding() in crypto/rsa/rsa_ossl.c, optimize the lock strategy, using a read lock normally and falling back to a write lock only when needed.
In crypto/evp/evp_enc.c, eliminate unnecessary EVP_CIPHER reference count increment/decrement operations.
In apps/speed.c, fix the information output format, reducing the repeated "built on: built on:" to a single "built on:".
When OPENSSL_SMALL_FOOTPRINT is defined, remove the lock step stack used for fast property-to-name resolution in crypto/property/property_string.c to reduce memory consumption.
In crypto/property/property.c, when no available timer provides a seed for random cache refresh, fall back to a global seed updated on each refresh, making cache refresh slightly less deterministic.
In engines/e_devcrypto.c, suppress warnings when opening /dev/crypto fails and returns ENXIO.
In apps/speed.c, limit the rsaBITS algorithm name check.
In apps/speed.c, fix the Coverity 272011 resource leak issue.
Fix a potential memory leak in crypto/provider_child.c.
Fix a possible memory leak on the error path in ssl/ssl_lib.c, ensuring that no extra memory is allocated when ossl_ssl_init() fails.
Remove the unused num print_message parameter in apps/speed.c.
Fix an incorrect ERR_raise() call in crypto/x509/v3_purp.c to use the correct library identifier.
Fix memory leaks in dane_tlsa_add in ssl/ssl_lib.c that could leak X509 objects, pkey, or danetls_record objects in multiple error cases.

In ssl/statem/extensions_cust.c's custom_exts_free, fix a possible use-after-free issue where custom_exts_free is called twice due to a memory allocation error when ssl_cert_dup calls custom_exts_copy.

Fix memory safety issues in the EVP module caused by undersized buffers or integer overflows, including signed integer overflows in EVP_EncryptUpdate and EVP_DecryptUpdate. (architecture-related: EVP interface security fix)

In RSA PKCS#1 v1.5 decryption, introduce an implicit rejection mechanism that returns a random message generated from the private key and ciphertext when padding checks fail, to guard against Bleichenbacher side-channel attacks. (architecture-related: RSA PKCS#1 v1.5 implicit rejection)
Fix out-of-bounds access caused by IV length checks in CBC and CTR modes, replacing them with safer boundary validation and returning an error. (architecture-related: CBC/CTR mode security fix)

Fix the issue in OCSP_basic_verify where signature verification errors return a positive value, avoiding incorrect trust of OCSP responses under the OCSP_NOCHECKS flag. (architecture-related: public API)
Disable SSL3, TLS1.0, TLS1.1, and DTLS1.0 at security level 1 and above, allowing these protocols only at security level 0. (architecture-related: security policy and protocol compatibility)
Enable and implement a security callback function in the record layer, replacing the original compression security detection logic. (architecture-related: record layer security callback)

Add default private key lengths based on RFC7919 for DH named groups, and automatically set smaller key lengths when generating safe prime parameters to improve performance; also modify the private key generation logic to require that a security strength parameter be provided. (architecture-related: DH private key generation behavior)

Fix the use of custom EVP_CIPHER and EVP_MD objects to ensure initialization prioritizes custom objects, and fix a possible null pointer dereference in digest processing. (architecture-related: public API)
Add a second verification in the public key check function to ensure that the public key conforms to the requirements of SP 800-56A. (architecture-related: public key verification)
Introduce a new option RSA_PSS_SALTLEN_AUTO_DIGEST_MAX for RSA-PSS signatures and set it as the default to conform to FIPS 186-4. (architecture-related: public API)
Fix the protection type mismatch issue in CMP message verification, rejecting mismatched protection methods. (architecture-related: public API)
Following the release of FIPS 186-5, update the approval status of EdDSA (Ed25519 and Ed448) in FIPS mode: first mark as unapproved, then re-mark as approved. (architecture-related: FIPS compliance)
Fix the comparison method for x400Address in GENERAL_NAME_cmp, replacing ASN1_TYPE_cmp with ASN1_STRING_cmp, fixing CVE-2023-0286. (architecture-related: public API behavior change)
Reverted the change that marked EdDSA as a FIPS-approved algorithm, re-marking it as unapproved in the FIPS provider. (architecture-related: FIPS algorithm status change)
In FIPS mode, restrict the digest algorithms usable by HMAC and Hash DRBG, allowing only SHA1, SHA2-256, SHA2-512, SHA3-256, SHA3-512. (architecture-related: FIPS digest algorithm restrictions)
In EVP_PKEY_get_bn_param(), ensure that successfully filled temporary buffers are wiped before release to prevent sensitive data residue. (architecture-related: public API)
Added negative integer checks for the ASN1_BIT_STRING_set_bit and ASN1_BIT_STRING_get_bit functions to prevent potential overflow issues. (architecture-related: public API)

Limit the length of OBJECT IDENTIFIER that the OBJ_obj2txt function can process to no more than 586 bytes, to guard against performance issues caused by overly long sub-identifiers (CVE-2023-2650). (architecture-related: public API)

Fixed a denial-of-service vulnerability in DH_check() when handling excessively large moduli, adding a maximum modulus check (32768 bits), returning an error directly when this limit is exceeded. (architecture-related: public API: DH_check adds maximum modulus check)

Fixed CVE-2023-3817, adding a validity check for the q parameter in DH_check to avoid denial-of-service attacks due to invalid q values. (architecture-related: public API: DH_check adds q parameter check)
Change the default algorithm for the ess_cert_id_alg option of TSA from sha1 to sha256, improving security. (architecture-related: public API: ess_cert_id_alg default value changed to SHA256)
Change the default salt length of the PBES2 KDF from 8 bytes to 16 bytes to meet FIPS compliance requirements. (architecture-related: external behavior)
When changing the IV length, invalidate the previously set IV, enhancing the security of the cipher implementation. (architecture-related: external behavior)

In crypto/ec/curve448/f_generic.c and crypto/ec/curve448/field.h, change the parameter type of gf_serialize from uint8_t* to uint8_t[SER_BYTES] to leverage array bounds for improved gcc warning checks.
In crypto/aes/aes_core.c, make the non-assembly constant-time code path a non-default option, retaining the option but no longer enabling it by default to avoid a 95% performance penalty.
In crypto/evp/asymcipher.c, crypto/evp/kem.c, crypto/evp/m_sigver.c, and crypto/evp/signature.c, add checks to all operations using EVP_PKEY to ensure that EVP_PKEY exists.
Adjust the security strength rating of the CCM8 cipher suite from 64 bits to 80 bits, and lower the security level to 0, to reflect the lower security strength due to its short tag.
Fix a potential out-of-bounds issue in help output caused by width exceeding buffer size, refactor output logic to use dynamic length calculation, and add a width upper bound check.
Add range checks for the -multi parameter in apps/speed.c, and fix a buffer length overflow caused by MAX_MISALIGNMENT, unifying the loop upper bound to INT_MAX.
Use safe mathematical functions to compute rounding sizes to prevent integer overflow.
Fix address leakage and RAND_bytes_ex return value checks in CBC_MAC_ROTATE_IN_PLACE, changing to constant-time loading.
Fix multiple security vulnerabilities in the c_rehash tool (CVE-2022-1292, CVE-2022-2068), no longer invoking openssl via shell, and improve file operation security.
Add assertions when reusing algorithm contexts to ensure the digest object is provided, preventing security issues due to implicit acquisition.
Prohibit the SSL2_VERSION version number from appearing in SSLv3 record headers to prevent ambiguity when validating record formats.
Fix a crash that may occur when creating ASN1 template objects under memory exhaustion, ensuring that the object is properly initialized before calling the free callback.
Fix a memory leak in the ec_key_simple_oct2priv function caused by failure of BN_bin2bn.
Increase the iteration factor for computing auxiliary primes in RSA key generation from 5 to 20 to match the FIPS 186-5 standard update.
Add sensitive memory cleanup and error checks to the private key encoding functions for DH, DSA, EC, and RSA.
Securely erase the MAC key of SSLv3 when cleaning up the record layer.
Fix a heap buffer overflow in BIO_ADDR_dup caused by copying the entire structure, and change to copying the correct union member.
Fix an out-of-bounds read in the ssl_cipher_process_rulestr function when the rule string ends with '-'.
Verify that the random number generator (RNG) has been correctly restored after the FIPS self-test.
Fixed an out-of-bounds write vulnerability in the punycode decoder (CVE-2022-3602), correcting an off-by-one error in the buffer boundary check.
Fixed a buffer overflow vulnerability in the punycode decoder (CVE-2022-3786), resolving a potential buffer overflow in the ossl_a2ulabel function.
Fixed the tainted scalar issue reported by Coverity, adding an upper bound check for the variable uclen in compressed certificate handling.
Fixed a security issue in BN_mod_exp_mont_consttime where an oversized modulus caused a buffer length overflow, and added invalid parameter checks.
Fixed a timing side-channel vulnerability in RSA decryption, eliminating exploitable timing differences by adjusting blinding, error reporting, and padding check logic.
Fixed a type confusion vulnerability in nc_match_single caused by incorrectly assuming the OtherName type, which could lead to incorrect certificate name constraint checks.
Fixed a potential double-free issue in PEM_read_bio_ex where the header and data pointers were not cleared on failure.
Fix a use-after-free vulnerability in the BIO_new_NDEF function caused by an invalid BIO chain resulting from callback failure.
Cleaned up the internal buffer used to generate k in the BN_generate_dsa_nonce function to prevent sensitive data leakage.
Fix a NULL pointer dereference vulnerability in FFC public key and private key verification functions; add null checks for parameters and return corresponding error codes.
Fixed a security vulnerability (CVE-2023-0216) where a null pointer was dereferenced when PKCS7 object data was not set.
Fixed an issue in pk7_doit.c where the return value of BIO_set_md() was not checked, preventing a null pointer dereference due to digest algorithm initialization failure, fixing CVE-2023-0401.
Adjusted session ID generation and renegotiation check logic in fuzzing mode to allow the post-handshake phase to be triggered, supporting the discovery of CVE-2021-3449.
Fixed a timing leak vulnerability in RSA private key decryption, adding the constant-time function bn_correct_top_consttime to eliminate side-channel risks.
Fixed a security vulnerability where invalid policy extension flags in leaf certificates were not checked, ensuring all certificates are correctly validated.
Fixed a resource overuse vulnerability in X.509 certificate policy constraint validation (CVE-2023-0464), preventing denial-of-service attacks by limiting the number of policy tree nodes.
Fix a use-after-free vulnerability in the argon2 KDF caused by not freeing the MAC context.
Replaced the original calculation in QUIC NewReno congestion control with a safe multiplication function to prevent integer overflow.
Replaced getenv() with ossl_safe_getenv() in HTTP proxy handling to safely read environment variables.
Fix a stack use-after-free issue in QUIC caused by local variables on the stack in callback functions; change the protocol string in the ALPN selection callback to a static constant.
Fix a potentially overflowing integer operation in the HKDF_Expand function; change the addition comparison to a subtraction comparison to avoid potential overflow risk.
Add a check for received packet forgery limits in the QUIC channel and enforce the limit when processing received packets.
Fix the validation of the final size in RESET_STREAM frames, ensuring the received final size matches the previously recorded value to prevent illegal modification.
Ensure QUIC packet number duplicate suppression is performed after AEAD verification to avoid side-channel attacks.
Updated legacy verification strength checks for DSA keys, tightening security conditions according to SP 800-131Ar2.
Add data clearing functionality to the release, resize, and pop operations of the send and receive ring buffers.
Fix the vulnerability of ignoring empty associated data in AES-SIV mode, ensuring zero-length associated data is also correctly authenticated.
Harden the QUIC ring buffer by adding safe math operations and offset upper bound checks to prevent integer overflow caused by internal misuse.

Add v3name fuzzing for CVE-2023-0286 (fuzz/v3name.c, test corpus, and build configuration), TLS name constraint tests for CVE-2021-4044 (EE certificate without SAN), and DH_check() tests for CVE-2023-3446.
Add safe ceiling division functions and integer overflow helper functions in include/internal/safe_math.h, and use these safe math calls for overflow detection in crypto/x509/v3_ncons.c.
Adjust tests in test/dtlstest.c to handle no-dtls1_2 configurations, fixing test failures caused by DTLSv1 being disabled at the default security level.

In crypto/punycode.c, change ossl_a2ulabel() to use WPACKET to build the output string, remove the unused output size parameter, and adapt the modified parameter in crypto/x509/v3_ncons.c so that punycode handles string termination.

In SSL_get_shared_ciphers() in ssl/ssl_lib.c, replace the conditional statement with if (n >= size) and use OPENSSL_strnlen() instead of strlen(), and replace strcpy(p, c->name) with memcpy(p, c->name, n).
Convert weak key and key parity check tests to constant-time implementations in crypto/des/set_key.c.

In crypto/ec/ecx_backend.c, when creating an ECX key, if the private key is too short, the key is no longer created and then freed, to avoid OPENSSL_secure_clear_free() writing to memory with the wrong length.

In crypto/x509/x509_vfy.c, fixed the issue where X509_verify() incorrectly reported an internal error and caused an infinite verification loop when the certificate has no SAN extension and name constraints are present.
In try_pkcs12() in crypto/store/store_result.c, clear the passphrase to prevent it from remaining on the stack.
In crypto/rand/rand_pool.c, improve the error message when the random pool overflows.
In BIO_f_cipher() flush in crypto/evp/bio_enc.c, add a progress check to avoid an infinite loop on error.
In crypto/conf/conf_def.c, prevent the configuration fuzzer from timing out due to a large number of include directives.
In the QUIC APL in ssl/quic/quic_impl.c, add receive stream state validation.

Add CVE-2023-4807 fix notes (POLY1305 MAC not saving non-volatile XMM registers on Windows 64-bit), CVE-2021-4044 fix notes (improper handling of negative values in `X509_verify_cert()` causing `SSL_get_error()` to return incorrectly), and CVE-2022-2068 fix notes (`c_rehash` script command injection) to CHANGES.md and NEWS.md, and fix the date format of multiple release entries.
Add GitHub token permission configuration to multiple GitHub Actions workflow files.
Add manual pages for SSL_get_certificate and SSL_get_privatekey, and update the list of missing documentation. (architecture-related: public API)

Updated the QUIC API design document, added definitions for multi-stream operation APIs, and renamed some APIs (e.g., SSL_tick changed to SSL_handle_events). (architecture-related: public API renaming)
Update the FIPS build instructions to guide how to build a compliant FIPS provider and use it with the latest version. (architecture-related: FIPS build instructions)

In the installation documentation, record the unexpected behavior of shared library pinning during static builds, and provide workarounds using the no-shared and no-pinshared configuration options. (architecture-related: build and installation methods)

Add comments to the OPENSSL_INIT_set_config_filename and OPENSSL_INIT_set_config_appname functions explaining the reason for using standard strdup instead of OPENSSL_strdup. (architecture-related: public API)
In Configurations/README.md, update the documentation for RC4_CHAR and RC4_INT to state that they should not be used in new configuration targets.
Added explanatory comments for the chunk order in the BIGNUM structure.
Update the CHANGES.md file to add change entries for version 3.0.1 and adjust the version title format.
Add a version title for the upcoming 1.1.1n release in CHANGES.md.
In the README, update the upgrade guide link to the migration_guide manual page and update the copyright year.
Add missing links to the OpenSSL 3.0 manual pages in the README.
Fix formatting issues in the NOTES-Windows.md documentation to resolve documentation check failures.
Add Tomáš Mráz's key fingerprint to the release key fingerprints document.
Add a design requirements document for the QUIC packet demultiplexer.
In CHANGES.md, note that case-insensitive string comparison no longer uses locale and is now implemented directly.
Add the design document for the QUIC connection ID cache, and update related descriptions to support many-to-one matching.
Update CHANGES.md and NEWS.md, add multiple change entries for the OpenSSL 3.1 version, and record security fixes and version changes.
Delete the obsolete ssl/record/README.md file.
Add missing documentation for X509_REQ_get_extensions() and X509_REQ_add_extensions{,_nid}().
Add missing documentation for the X509_gmtime_adj() function.
Fix the missing right parenthesis in the rsa command help text.
Add the design document for the QUIC Stream Receive Buffers module.
In CHANGES.md, organize the version record of RIPEMD160 joining the default provider, and remove duplicate entries.
Add and improve the QUIC API overview design document, describing API design goals, new and changed interfaces, and update the glossary.
Add and improve the QUIC I/O architecture design document, add block diagrams and adjust wording.
Add documentation for EVP_ASYM_CIPHER-RSA, and update the missing documentation list.
Add documentation and danger warnings for BIO_s_dgram-related functions, and update the missing documentation list.
In CHANGES.md, add a record of support for KMAC in KBKDF.
Add comments to the buffer adjustment function of the QUIC test fault injector, explaining that the buffer is over-allocated.
Add a design document for the QUIC thread auxiliary mode.
Display the default iteration count (10000) of PBKDF2 in the help information and documentation of the enc command.
In the FIPS mode documentation and changelog, record the new -no_drbg_truncated_digests option, used to prohibit the use of truncated digests in Hash and HMAC DRBGs.
Add documentation for the advanced command mode (-adv option) and QUIC mode for s_client.
Update CHANGES.md and NEWS.md, record security fixes (CVE-2023-0465, CVE-2023-0464, CVE-2023-1255) and correct related documentation.
Add comments in Windows thread-related code, explaining that the LONG type is the same size as int.
In the NEW_CONNECTION_ID frame handling, add an RFC 9000 compliance note stating that the current implementation already meets the relevant requirements.
Add a new non-blocking QUIC client example and improve the socket creation function to support non-blocking mode and error handling.
Fix the missing comma in the option list in the openssl-rsautl manual page.
Update comments in the QUIC transport code to add a reference to RFC 9000 Section 10.2.3 to clarify compliance.
Add explanatory comments to example code and add a new guide page for the non-blocking QUIC client example.
Expand the non-blocking example with instructions on how to perform other useful work, and correct the erroneous protocol type in the comments.
Rename the design document OSSL_PROVIDER_load_ex to ossl-provider-load-ex.md and update the document title accordingly.
Add a new design document describing how to allow AlgorithmIdentifier parameter data to be passed to cryptographic operations and provide convenience functions for all algorithms.
In the HTTP/3 example README, add a link to the nghttp3 library and update the build and run instructions.
Add comments to the HTTP/3 demo code explaining the design intent of key functions and flows.
In the README, add a reference to the demos subfolder to guide users to example code.
Added RFC 9114 reference for HTTP/3 in QUIC documentation, and added a link to the IANA standard list of ALPN protocol IDs.
Add a standalone README for the guide examples explaining how to set LD_LIBRARY_PATH to run them, and update links and descriptions in the main README and QUIC README.
Update the changelog and news documents for the OpenSSL 3.2 beta 1 release.
Modify the TLS example program to accept hostname and port from command-line arguments and add support for IPv6 options.
In CHANGES.md, record that the BLAKE2b hash algorithm supports configuring the output length by setting the size parameter.
Add OpenSSL 3.2 manual page links in the README.
Updated CHANGES.md and NEWS.md to record CVE-2023-5678, OpenSSL 3.0.2 and 3.0.3 version changes, OPENSSL_str[n]casecmp function changes, and PVK KDF migration.

Added multiple EVP demonstration programs in the demos directory, including RSA key encoding/decoding, X25519 key exchange, ARIA-256-CBC, Poly1305-AES, SHAKE256 XOF digest, SIPHASH, RSA key generation, and RSA-PSS signing and verification.

Added QUIC record layer design document, high-level QUIC implementation overview, dgram API discussion document, and guidelines for writing public function and macro documentation under doc/designs/quic-design/ and doc/ directories.

Add initial demonstration-driven design (DDD) example code and related documentation under the doc/designs/ddd/ directory, including scenarios such as blocking/non-blocking connections, file descriptors, and in-memory BIO.
Support multibin in the configuration of the NonStop platform, allowing multiple binary models to coexist to address the limitations of the DLL loader on that platform.

In doc/man3/X509_STORE_CTX_new.pod, supplement the documentation for the purpose and trust setting functions of X509_STORE_CTX_set_purpose(), X509_STORE_CTX_set_trust(), and X509_STORE_CTX_purpose_inherit().
Add multiple EVP demonstration programs under the demos directory, including EC key encoding, AES key wrap, CMAC, and HMAC, and clarify the AES-256-CBC algorithm used in the CMAC demonstration.

Add multiple design documents, including the QUIC connection state machine, frame in-flight manager, RX unpacker frame table, thread pool, and TX packetizer, covering the connection state machine diagram, images related to the frame in-flight manager, stream receive buffer implementation details, record layer design updates, QUIC API overview and SSL API classification list, and fault injector design.
Fix the description regarding certificate serial number storage in openssl-x509.pod.in.

Update the SHAKE documentation to specify the default output length: SHAKE128 defaults to 16 bytes (security strength 64 bits), SHAKE256 defaults to 32 bytes (security strength 128 bits), and synchronously update the dgst application code and tests.
Complete the missing cmp entries in openssl-cmds.pod.in.
Fix the description in openssl-ec.pod.in to clarify that uncompressed is the default value.
Fix the incorrect default algorithm in the openssl pkcs12 help information, correcting the default digest algorithm from SHA1 to SHA256.
In openssl-ocsp.pod.in, explain that the relevant options are flexible regarding the certificate input format.
Update the openssl-mac.pod.in documentation to state that standard input should also be in binary format.
Add documentation for the OPENSSL_gmtime function family, OPENSSL_gmtime.pod, and update the build configuration and the list of missing cryptographic features.
Add an entry for record layer changes in CHANGES.md.
Add the code of conduct file CODE-OF-CONDUCT.md.
Add a DSA signature demonstration program (EVP_DSA_Signature_demo.c) and DSA parameter generation and key generation demonstration programs, along with related header files and Makefile.
Update the FIPS-related build instructions in README-FIPS.md and link to the new locations of certificates and security policies.
Update the record layer design document record-layer.md based on implementation experience.
Update the stream receive buffer design document stream-receive-buffers.md, supplementing implementation details.

Clarify the handling of negative values for OSSL_CMP_OPT_MSG_TIMEOUT and OSSL_CMP_OPT_TOTAL_TIMEOUT by OSSL_CMP_CTX_set_option() in the CMP documentation, and fix the documentation for -msg_timeout and -total_timeout in openssl-cmp.pod.in.
Expand the description of error code generation in crypto/err/README.md.
Add a SSL API category list (quic-api-ssl-funcs.md) to the QUIC API overview document.
Make minor adjustments to the QUIC API design document quic-api.md.
Add a new QUIC fault injector design document quic-fault-injector.md.

Sync documentation, update the history record of changes related to OSSL_PKEY_PARAM_EC_POINT_CONVERSION_FORMAT to take effect since 3.0.8, and sync the latest content of CHANGES.md and the openssl-3.0 branch.
Make minor updates to the QUIC I/O architecture design document.
Improve the text descriptions in the CMP application and documentation regarding (un)trusted certificates, srvCert, and other content.
In NOTES-NONSTOP.md, record the limitation on HPE NonStop platforms where static linking and dynamic linking cause SIGSEGV during atexit() handling.
In the openssl-enc.pod.in document, clarify the change in behavior of enc -S in version 3.0.
Add a new QUIC glossary document glossary.md.
Add information about the OpenVMS 'ias' port in NOTES-VMS.md.
Add OpenSSL OMC PGP key fingerprints in doc/fingerprints.txt for subsequent signature verification of tarball and release announcements.
Fix the documentation that incorrectly marks openssl-genrsa as deprecated since OpenSSL 3.0.
Add a minimal blocking TLS client demo program tls-client-block.c and its Makefile build configuration.
Fix minor issues in the TLS client blocking demo program and its man page.
Modify the GitHub issue template question.md to direct users to GitHub Discussions for questions.
In the openssl-kdf.pod.in document, add explanations for the 'salt' and 'info' parameters, and make other minor improvements.
Update the description of the shutdown process in the QUIC client blocking tutorial to provide more accurate instructions.
Add the QUIC DDD (Demystifying DTLS over UDP Design) final report document REPORT.md and update README.md.
Add a QUIC client demo program quic-client-non-block.c using non-blocking sockets, and update the related Makefile.
Allow the QUIC DDD example program to set the target host and port from the command line.
Made unplanned changes to the QUIC DDD example ddd-05-mem-nonblocking.c.
Made unplanned changes to the QUIC DDD examples ddd-01-conn-blocking.c and ddd-03-fd-blocking.c, including renaming QUIC_client_method() due to namespace adjustments and forcing the use of ALPN.
Made planned changes to the QUIC DDD examples ddd-01-conn-blocking.c, ddd-03-fd-blocking.c, and ddd-05-mem-nonblocking.c.
Made two types of changes to the doc/designs/ddd/ddd-02-conn-nonblocking.c file: Planned changes and Unplanned changes.
Made two types of changes to the doc/designs/ddd/ddd-02-conn-nonblocking-threads.c file: Planned changes and Unplanned changes.
Made two types of changes to the doc/designs/ddd/ddd-06-mem-uv.c file: Planned changes and Unplanned changes.
Added the demos/signature/EVP_ED_Signature_demo.c file and its corresponding Makefile, and updated demos/README.txt.
Updated the QUIC API table document doc/designs/quic-design/quic-api-ssl-funcs.md.
Added the design document doc/designs/fetching-composite-algorithms.md, enabling explicitly fetched EVP_SIGNATURE implementations to be used.
Added the QUIC description file README-QUIC.md.
Updated the README.md file.
Updated the format, header descriptions, and reference links of NEWS.md and CHANGES.md to better conform to release-note standards.
Updated the Makefile in the QUIC DDD documentation.
Disabled the P10-specific Chacha20 and AES-GCM assembly implementations on the AIX system to avoid build issues. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)
Optimized the configuration script to update files only when the configdata.pm content changes, avoiding unnecessary source rebuilds. (architecture-related: build configuration optimization)

Added optional support for Armv8.3-A Pointer Authentication and Armv8.5-A Branch Target Identification in aarch64 assembly code, controlled by compiler macros. (architecture-related: ARM security feature support)
Removed the explicit inclusion of synchapi.h, which does not exist in WinSDK 7.1, and switched to windows.h, which already includes that header. (architecture-related: Windows platform compatibility)
Fixed the VMS installation script to uniformly use platform->shlib_version_as_filename() to obtain the shared library version filename. (architecture-related: VMS platform compatibility)

Fixed the mismatch between logical name deassignment and definition in VMS installation, ensuring that the shutdown script correctly deassigns the engine directory logical names defined by the startup script. (architecture-related: VMS installation script fix)
Fixed VMS installation by adding a check for the existence of the built-in provider in the IVP script. (architecture-related: VMS installation verification fix)

Enabled USE_SWAPCONTEXT on the IA64 architecture, using swapcontext instead of setjmp/longjmp to correctly save the register stack engine, fixing async interface test failures. (architecture-related: IA64 architecture support)

On the s390x architecture, marked the internal cpuid symbol OPENSSL_s390xcap_P and function OPENSSL_cpuid_setup as hidden to avoid them accidentally becoming global symbols in static libraries. (architecture-related: symbol visibility)

Fixed compilation failures on macOS 10.7 and 10.8 caused by incompatible __atomic_is_lock_free parameters in clang, by disabling the __atomic_* built-in functions on these systems. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)

To support C++20 header-units, fixed header self-containment issues: conditionally included stdio.h in multiple headers and adjusted the inclusion order of some headers to avoid including other headers inside the extern "C" block. (architecture-related: public API)
Fixed build issues on TANDEM and old POSIX systems, and allowed disabling locale support via the -DOPENSSL_NO_LOCALE configuration option. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)
Added the compile configuration option OPENSSL_NO_UNIX_SOCK to control Unix domain socket support, and adjusted the related conditional compilation logic. (architecture-related: build configuration)
Fixed UWP build by manually declaring the VirtualLock function in memory safety related code. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)
For the HP-UX platform, avoided including the non-existent sys/select.h and switched to sys/time.h. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)

Changed the C version detection macro from __STRICT_ANSI__ to __STDC_VERSION__, and based on this defined the internal macro OSSL_NO_C99 to handle compatibility issues before C99. (architecture-related: build compatibility)

Added a new Windows on Arm build target, supporting the use of clang-cl as assembler and compiler, and updated the armcap source to adapt to Windows platform feature detection. (architecture-related: platform compatibility: Windows on Arm)
Added test support for Alpine Linux (musl) in CI. (Architecture-related: Platform compatibility: Alpine Linux (musl))

Support building OpenSSL with QUIC functionality disabled, add conditional compilation guards for internal functions and test cases, and add the no-quic option to the CI configuration for m68k cross-compilation. (Architecture-related: Build and installation methods: Support building with QUIC disabled)
Disable atomic reference counting to support threadless builds, falling back to plain addition. (architecture-related: build and installation method: support threadless builds)
Added a hybrid CRT (Hybrid CRT) build target for Windows and updated the related documentation. (architecture-related: build and installation methods)
Added support for the Clang 16 compiler in the CI workflow. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)

Modified the util/wrap.pl.in script to unify behavior on platforms such as VMS, and removed the no longer needed util/local_shlib.com.in and util/unlocal_shlib.com.in files. (architecture-related: build and installation methods)
Fixed strict warning issues in Windows builds, removing unnecessary const qualifiers in the CMP API to keep declarations consistent with definitions. (architecture-related: public API)

Fixed the duplicate OPENSSL_armcap_P symbol issue on ARM platforms by restricting its definition to 64-bit architectures, ensuring only one copy remains in libcrypto.a. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)
Disabled the P10-specific AES-GCM assembly code build on macOS. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)

Fixed a build error with the Visual Studio 2010 x86 compiler due to missing InterlockedOr64, extending the conditional macro coverage to that compiler version. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)
Fixed a compilation error caused by incompatible function pointer types when using clang-cl 16 or later. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)
Introduced the no-ecx build option to remove ECX-related functionality, thereby reducing binary size for platforms that do not need it. (Architecture-related: Build option no-ecx)

Introduced HAVE_MADVISE and NO_MADVISE macro definitions, allowing builders to explicitly control whether to call the madvise function in environments lacking it. (Architecture-related: Build configuration: madvise control)
Disable floating-point-related code in the UEFI environment to avoid build issues caused by floating-point operations. (Architecture-related: Platform compatibility: UEFI floating-point disable)
Fix build issues in the Cygwin environment by conditionally including the Windows.h header. (architecture-related: platform compatibility: Cygwin build fix)
Allow disabling HTTP support at compile time, adding conditional compilation guards to the relevant code. (architecture-related: build configuration: HTTP support can be disabled)
Add continuous integration support for the Cygwin environment and fix the reference format of the Windows header. (architecture-related: platform compatibility: Cygwin CI support)

Add a no-apps build option to disable building applications (such as the openssl program), and update related documentation and CI configuration. (architecture-related: build configuration: no-apps option)
Fix WebAssembly/WASI builds, force the use of timegm, and add WASI support for the base implementation of OPENSSL_issetugid. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)
Fix build failures when IPv6 is disabled, adding conditional compilation guards to IPv6-related code. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)
Fix compilation errors on HP-UX due to missing SIZE_MAX definitions, adding necessary header references in ssl/priority_queue.c. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)
Move the ALIGN32 and ALIGN64 macro definitions uniformly to common.h, and fix compilation issues under clang-cl.exe due to missing __GNUC__ definitions. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)
Add a fallback definition for socklen_t on the VMS platform to resolve the issue of this type being missing in the current VMS C header. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)
Add necessary header includes in ssl/quic/quic_cfq.c to support platforms that do not define macros such as UINT64_MAX. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)
When building on the NonStop platform, exclude references to the poll.h header because that platform does not define it. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)
Fix build failures on older glibc due to missing sendmmsg by adding a glibc version check to ensure support for both recvmmsg and sendmmsg. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)
Fix the build failure of SHA3 when there is no assembly mode on the ARM64 platform. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)

Improve coverage mapping, remove support for the OpenSSL 1.1.1 stable version, and extend compilation configurations for other branches to enhance test coverage. (architecture-related: build and installation methods)
Add local build instructions for win-arm64 in the Windows build documentation.
Add build tasks using brotli and zstd in the CI configuration, and add a Windows compression test workflow. (Architecture-related: Build dependency: brotli/zstd)

In the cross-platform compilation CI workflow: lower the optimization level for ppc64le to avoid seg fault; disable stringop-overflow warnings on s390x and m68k; add QEMU_CPU and OPENSSL_* environment variable mechanisms to control ISA extensions; add RV64 cross-compilation targets supporting Zb* and Zk* extensions for RISC-V; disable the test_afalg test on cross-compile targets.
Adjust the CI workflow: add no-rfc3779 check and thread pool configuration, modify memleak/ubsan dependencies, QUIC build and coveralls options, and revert one no-shared/no-modules replacement.
Fix the shebang of the test script to /usr/bin/env perl, and fix trailing spaces and spelling errors in documentation and configuration files.
Fix a link error caused by missing AArch64-specific symbols when building on non-AArch64 Armv8 systems.
Replace the Windows 2016 environment in CI with Windows 2022, and add a Perl installation step.
Fix the header guard macro name in include/crypto/dsa.h to avoid duplication with the guard macro in dsaerr.h.
Disable floating-point formatting support in the UEFI build to avoid compilation issues; and revert the previous fix, removing conditional compilation and header file inclusion.
Fix build failures with XLC/XLCLANG compilers on AIX: in 32-bit builds, check both _ARCH_PPC64 and __ILP32__ macros to avoid misjudgment.
Fix DJGPP compilation issues: add support for the MSDOS platform in conditional compilation to provide the in_addr_t definition, and add the necessary Watt-32 header files in sockets.h.
Add test support for GCC 11, GCC 12, Clang 13, and Clang 14 compilers in CI, and upgrade the CI environment to Ubuntu 22.04.
When a child process terminates due to a signal, the signal is now re-sent to the process itself so that the parent shell can correctly capture and output the information.
Fix a build failure on FreeBSD caused by a missing data declaration, adjust variable scope, and add skip logic when addresses match.
Fix a compilation error in Cygwin builds caused by struct in_pktinfo missing the ipi_spec_dst field, by skipping the assignment of that field via conditional compilation.
Enable the usleep-based ossl_sleep() implementation for the djgpp platform to resolve compilation failures caused by circular dependencies.

Fix a compilation failure on the DJGPP platform caused by undefined WATT32_NO_OLDIES leading to declaration conflicts in the Watt-32 library, by defining that macro before including socket header files.
Remove the explicit MSVC target architecture name in the Windows CI configuration, and let the compiler auto-detect it instead.
Add DJGPP build support to the CI cross-compilation workflow.
Enable QUIC support in Windows CI builds.
Add Clang 15 compilation testing to the CI configuration, and add steps to install Clang 15 from the LLVM PPA for Ubuntu 22.04.
Separate SCTP tests from the daily CI workflow into a separate workflow to fix daily build errors.
Improved the definition of the DSO_MALLOC macro to cover all possible compilation scenarios.
Ensure SIZE_MAX is defined when defining OSSL_SSIZE_MAX, by including internal/numbers.h to compensate for operating system differences.
Fixed build issues on the NonStop platform by adjusting conditional compilation header file inclusion.
In the CI configuration, replace no-shared with no-modules to fix ASAN memory leak detection issues.
Replace snprintf calls in multiple source files with BIO_snprintf to fix Windows build issues.
Reverted the previously added cross-compilation CI configuration for RISC-V Zb* and Zk* extensions because the current QEMU version does not support them.
Fix build file selection logic to use the correct configuration variables; also update documentation to explain how to specify custom build file templates via environment variables.

In the argon2 KDF implementation, replace stdint.h and limits.h with openssl/e_os2.h and internal/numbers.h respectively to enhance compatibility with old compilers, and adjust the header file inclusion order.
Remove the CI workflow for cross-version compatibility checks between the 3.0.0 provider and the current version of FIPS.
Upgrade the actions/setup-python action version used in CI to v4.7.0.

Fix OS Zoo CI failures: update the operating system matrix, remove outdated versions and add new versions; install git in the Alpine Linux step and remove the fuzz/corpora submodule checkout; enable QUIC support in all configurations; optimize workflow configuration.
Add a new no-docs build option to skip the generation and installation of documentation (such as man pages) during the build.
Enable QUIC support by default, update build configuration and documentation, and add relevant changelog entries.
Provide a default definition for SSL_OP_CISCO_ANYCONNECT in the internal header file when it is not defined in the public header file, to fix compilation issues.
Removed the setting of PTHREAD_MUTEX_NORMAL to resolve build failures caused by this macro not being defined in certain glibc configurations.
Add a warning comment in the provider cross-version compatibility check workflow stating that when triggered by a pull request, the PR branch will not be used, but the master branch will be used.
Add steps to obtain CPU information in multiple CI workflows, and configure continue-on-error in the Windows workflow.
Fix spurious warnings generated when compiling test/packettest.c with gcc 11.2.0 to avoid --strict-warnings build failures.

In the openssl-fipsinstall documentation, explain that if the user automatically loads the FIPS module via a configuration file, self-tests may run before setting the self-test callback, causing the self-test callback to potentially not be used during the fipsinstall process.

Under the OpenSSL 3.1 section of CHANGES.md, add changelog entries for versions 3.0.0 through 3.0.1, noting fixes for several file name and file reference errors in the build, installation, and setup scripts (which caused installation verification failures), and slightly enhance the installation verification script.
Add a disable option for QUIC in Configure, with QUIC disabled by default.
Add no-http related content to CHANGES.md and INSTALL.md.
Move the generation of include/openssl/configuration.h from a Makefile target to configdata.pm, updating it only when the content actually changes to reduce unnecessary source recompilation.
Add the fuzz-checker.yml workflow to GitHub Actions for the last run-checker fuzzing CI.
Add the os-zoo.yml workflow to GitHub Actions, adding specific builds for older operating system versions.

Fix the VMS installation script by changing $config{pointer_size} to $target{pointer_size}, defining the OSSL$MODULES logical name, and making program name version information consistent with the major version number.
Add a CI workflow for daily Coverity static analysis builds.
Add a run check in CI to test safe_math without compiler support.
Explicitly specify the runner used in Windows CI as windows-2019 instead of windows-latest.
Add TLSfuzzer testing to CI.
Add CI tests using the FIPS provider from the 3.0 branch with the master build.
Add CI tests using the FIPS provider from the master branch with the 3.0 build.
Add the oqsprovider external test, including related CI configuration, submodules, test scripts, and documentation.
Upgrade actions/setup-python in CI workflows from 4.3.0/4.3.1/4.4.0 to 4.5.0.
Automatically add the -DPEDANTIC compilation option when UBSan is enabled, and ensure this behavior in CI workflows and the Configure script.
Add a CI workflow to test older versions of the FIPS provider.
Add dependabot configuration to automatically update GitHub Actions versions.
Fix the fips-label.yml script to adapt to the changes after the upgrade of actions/github-script.
Use a more generic include directory path to specify fuzzer header files in the Fuzz checker CI.
Upgrade coverallsapp/github-action in the CI workflow from 1.1.3 through multiple versions to 2.2.1.
Include supported branches in the Coveralls CI configuration.
Add a make help option, implemented based on the kubernetes controller Makefile help, and add helper scripts.
Add a CI action for cross-validating the FIPS provider, testing all released or in-progress FIPS approved versions.
Configure checkout submodules in multiple CI workflows to ensure the fuzz/corpora data required for regression fuzz testing exists.
Add a GCC 13 compiler test configuration in the compiler-zoo workflow of CI.
Add no-threads build tests in the ci and windows workflows of CI.
Add a thread sanitizer test for QUIC in the ci workflow of CI.
Update the test version to include 3.1.1 in the provider-compatibility CI workflow.
Add 3.0.9 to the FIPS version list in provider-compatibility.yml.
Reassign the run-checker tasks: move the ones that fail more easily to pull request CI, and the ones that fail less easily to push and daily CI.
Change the failing tests in compiler-zoo.yml and cross-compiles.yml to run on pull request.
Fix the build target for the rsa_encrypt example in demos/encrypt/Makefile.

Added or modified Makefiles in the demos directory and its subdirectories (bio, cipher, digest, encode, encrypt, kdf, keyexch, mac, pkey, signature, sslecho), providing all, clean, and test targets, where tests requiring external input have their test target as a no-op.

Add braces for initializing subobjects in the ch_init() function of ssl/quic/quic_ackm.c, and add the -Wno-missing-braces compilation option in Configure to eliminate warnings from older clang, while removing unnecessary extra braces in zero-value initializers.
Upgraded versions of third-party actions used by multiple GitHub Actions workflows, including actions/checkout, actions/github-script, actions/setup-python, and coverallsapp/github-action.
Update the OpenSSL 3.1 version used for FIPS compatibility testing in .github/workflows/provider-compatibility.yml from 3.1.1 to 3.1.2 to match the target version planned for FIPS 140-3 validation.
Reverted commit 86051eb2, restoring the original state of .github/workflows/compiler-zoo.yml and .github/workflows/cross-compiles.yml.
Remove files under the test directory from the coverage report.
Remove the no-shared build option and the -DFUZZING_BUILD_MODE_UNSAFE_FOR_PRODUCTION macro definition from the coveralls workflow.
Fix the invocation of lcov in the coveralls workflow to correct the regression introduced by commit febe8cf4.
Correct the working directory for opensslwrap.sh in provider-compatibility.yml.
Add several non-default compilation options to the Windows CI build to check their availability.
Remove the FUZZING_BUILD_MODE_UNSAFE_FOR_PRODUCTION macro definition from some builds that do not execute fuzz testing.
Add a separate job in CI to run fuzz testing with the fuzzing build mode enabled.
In the run-checker-daily.yml workflow, do not run the openssl application if it is not built.
The quic_record, quicapi, and quicfaults tests are not supported in fuzzing builds.
Revert the unintended changes introduced by fac61ea in fuzz-checker.yml.
Reschedule some CI jobs to run daily or on push, and move jobs that are more likely to trigger CI failures and are less time-consuming to the main CI for pull requests.

Fixed extra semicolons in ossl_rsa_pss_get_param_unverified, dh_validate_private, and dh_validate_public, and replaced DH_check_pub_key with DH_check_pub_key_ex in dh_validate_public. (architecture-related: public API change)
Add extern "C" declarations to the hpke.h and thread.h header files to support correct inclusion in C++ code. (Architecture-related: public API: C++ compatibility)
Removed the call to the internal function err_free_strings_int() and kept an empty implementation for compatibility. (Architecture-related: compatibility: public API compatibility)

Prefer the GNU library initialization mechanism by moving the definitions of __attribute__((constructor)) and __attribute__((destructor)) earlier to improve platform compatibility. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)
Remove legacy compatibility code for the VxWorks platform and uniformly use the standard sys/un.h header file. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)

Fix compilation issues of thread library functions on non-UNIX platforms by limiting the function definitions in threads_lib.c to compile only on UNIX systems. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)
Update OpenSSL version references: update all references to OpenSSL 3.1 in the master branch to 3.2, including deprecated macros and API level checks. (architecture-related: public API compatibility)
Revised the field types in the structures related to SSL_get_conn_close_info, changing is_local and is_transport from char to int. (architecture-related: public API)
Moved the more general parts of internal/cryptlib.h to a new file internal/common.h, and directly include internal/nelem.h where needed to clean up unused includes.
Use the OPENSSL_USE_IPV6 macro instead of AF_INET6 to control the exclusion of IPv6 code.
Use #pragma comment(lib) only under the _MSC_VER compiler, avoiding unknown pragma warnings under llvm/gcc + mingw-w64 when USE_BCRYPTGENRANDOM is enabled.
Updated ifdefs under the xlclang compiler frontend on AIX so that the fallback DEP mechanism takes effect without affecting XLC.
Avoid using the C++ reserved word template in function parameters.
Disabled printf format checking in the MinGW environment.
In fuzzer.h, use <openssl/e_os2.h> instead of <stdint.h> to be compatible with old compilers that do not support C99.
In internal/sockets.h, ensure errno.h is included when needed.
Fixed tab and indentation formatting issues in two Perl scripts, unifying to 4-space indentation.
Fixed the indentation formatting issue of the tls13_hkdf_expand function parameters.
Added Apache 2.0 copyright headers to CI workflow scripts.
Fixed coding style issues in 113 files, involving multiple modules.
Added missing blank lines in NEWS.md.
Fixed code style issues in apps/cmp.c reported by check-format.pl.
Fixed indentation issues in providers/common/provider_util.c.
Updated .gitignore to ignore the test-generated file /test/evp_pkey_ctx_new_from_name.
Fixed code formatting indentation issues in the BLOCK_CIPHER_custom macro invocation.

Fixed spelling errors and terminology inconsistencies in multiple files, including changing fall thru to fall through, host name to hostname, time zone to timezone, etc., to align with the LDP standard.
Improved the output format of the openssl list command by adding a blank line at the end of each command and algorithm list for clearer output.
Add TODO comments in the QUIC implementation to mark parts that are currently no-ops and protocol errors and cache optimizations that need to be handled in the future.
Fix style issues in the QUIC code, including adding blank lines and adjusting preprocessor directive indentation.
Add a TODO comment in the QUIC implementation regarding CCM support.
Performed style fixes on the QUIC connection state machine code, including indentation adjustments, comment updates, and normalization of conditional checks.
Add the missing copyright header to the crypto/bn/rsa_sup_mul.c file.
Adjust code formatting and fix a typo.
Fix punctuation errors in comments in the QUIC test files.
Add a comment in the do_X509_sign() function suggesting that RFC 5280 compliance measures could be considered in the future.
Add comments in the cert_response and initial_certreq functions to mark unused parameters, and adjust state constants for better readability.
Update the .gitignore file to add ignore entries related to LSP support, preventing developers from accidentally committing these files.
Add a comment in the QUIC channel termination state regarding the persistence time from RFC 9000 Section 10.2.
Fixed indentation formatting issues in function code in the QUIC server.
Made maintenance improvements to the noisy dgram BIO test helper, including adding optional debug output, removing unused redundant read/write functions, and unifying terminology.
Update CHANGES.md and NEWS.md files to synchronize version change records and prepare for the OpenSSL 3.2.0 release.
Check the return value of OPENSSL_strdup (CRYPTO_strdup) in apps/lib/app_rand.c and apps/lib/engine_loader.c to prevent potential memory access errors.

Check the return value of EVP_MD_fetch in dh_exch.c and ecdh_exch.c, check the return value of OSSL_PARAM_BLD_new in dsa_kmgmt.c, and check the return values of BIO_new() and its internally called functions in apps.

Replace double semicolons ;; with single semicolons ; in ssl_rsa.c, statem_lib.c, and t1_lib.c, move declarations before code in rsaz_exp_x2.c, remove duplicate declarations in quic_ssl.h, and refactor if conditions in speed.c to avoid empty statements.
Minor code cleanup in o_names_init, which could cause a small memory leak.

Remove duplicate BIO_get_ktls_send calls in do_ssl3_write, remove unnecessary BIO_get_ktls_recv calls in ssl3_get_record, and change the usage of BIO_get_ktls_send in ssl3_write_bytes to boolean form.
Abstract out policies and extensions in CA.pl.
In cmp_server.c, log the received request type before checking request details.
In the ERR module, exempt flags from being printed as fallback decimal reason codes.
In multiple KDF implementations (krb5kdf, pbkdf1, pbkdf2, pkcs12kdf, scrypt, sshkdf), always reset buflen after clearing the buffer.
The PVK decoder now prompts for the PVK passphrase instead of the PEM passphrase.
check_format.pl adds a check for blank lines inside and after local variable declarations.
Remove empty statements in e_dasync.c and replace double semicolons ;; with single semicolons ; as statement separators in apps/ca.c.

bn_lib.c changes the byte order check to a binary condition to avoid VS2022 false positive about uninitialized local pointer; x509_trust.c changes the condition from == -1 to < 0 to avoid gcc-12 false positive about null pointer dereference.

Add checks for return values of EVP_KDF_fetch(), OPENSSL_strndup(), BN_bn2hex(), OPENSSL_sk_new_null(), BN_BLINDING_lock(), OPENSSL_strdup() in dh_kdf.c, v3_utl.c, encode_key2text.c, encoder_pkey.c, rsa_ossl.c, dh_exch.c.

Fix multiple uninitialized values and integer overflow issues reported by Coverity: add initialization or assertions for variables in cipher_des_hw.c, cipher_tdes_default_hw.c, e_des.c, e_des3.c, ecp_nistz256.c, curve448.c, bn_exp.c.
Add macro guards to prevent duplicate inclusion for md32_common.h, der.h, tsan_assist.h, and multiple ciphercommon header files.
Handle the return value of X509_TRUST_get_by_id() more consistently in x509_trust.c.
In ec_kmgmt.c, allow other parameters to be exported along with domain parameters.
In defn_cache.c, add assertions for attribute definition cache entries to ensure that new entries are the first entry rather than replacing an existing entry.
In der_rsa_key.c, improve the DER writer's check for invalid saltlen.
In bss_dgram.c, avoid using unions in getsockopt and SystemTimeToFileTime calls.
Add extra header includes in priority_queue.h.
In cms_sd.c, fix code style/format issues reported by check-format.pl.
Removed the unused 4bit and 8bit GCM implementations from gcm128.c and the related header files.
Add test/timing_load_creds to .gitignore.
Remove the unused ssl/record/dtls1_bitmap.c file.
Add explanatory comments in pkcs7.h.in and perform minor cleanup of code in crypto/cms/ and crypto/pkcs7/.
Fix negative return value issue reported by Coverity 1513478 in tls13_enc.c.

Remove three TODO(RECLAYER) markers in `ssl3_write_bytes`: delete the disabled multiblock code block and related variables; delete the TODO comment about whether the `tot == len` condition is still needed; update and move the `max_pipelines` comment to explain that the splitting method and quantity are obtained via the record layer method, and add the handling logic for when it is 0 or not configured.
Add ssl_log_secret call in tls13_key_update to log newly computed traffic keys during key update.
Remove explicit zero initialization of static const variables in crypto/bio/bss_dgram_pair.c to avoid warnings from older clang due to the first member of the struct being a struct.
Remove unused variable in tls_write_records_default() in ssl/record/methods/tls_common.c.

Cast values to types matching printf format strings in crypto/asn1/x_int64.c, ssl/ssl_ciph.c, ssl/ssl_txt.c, ssl/t1_trce.c and related test files to fix -Werror=format errors on djgpp where int32_t is defined as unsigned long int.
Cast socklen_t to size_t in assertion comparisons in crypto/bio/bss_dgram.c to avoid warnings when socklen_t is a signed type.
Skip checks for negative timeval in include/internal/time.h for djgpp because tv_sec is unsigned on djgpp.
Hide unused but set variables in crypto/bio/bss_dgram.c with #ifndef __DJGPP__ to fix unused-but-set-variable warnings on djgpp.
Fix negative loop boundary issue reported by Coverity 1515953 in crypto/encode_decode/encoder_pkey.c.
Remove some TODO(RECLAYER) comments in ssl/record/rec_layer_s3.c, ssl/ssl_lib.c and ssl/t1_enc.c because DTLS migration is complete.
Remove the ossl_rand_pool_add_additional_data() function, which is not called anywhere, and its declarations in multiple platform seeding files.

Disable -Wtype-limits and -Wtautological-constant-out-of-range-compare warnings in Configure, and add QUIC virtual handshake layer prototype file include/internal/quic_dummy_handshake.h, ssl/quic/quic_dummy_handshake.c and its build configuration.
Update multiple GitHub Actions workflow files according to dependabot suggestions.
Remove unused ALIGN64 macro in crypto/bn/rsaz_exp_x2.c.
Remove unused header file includes in crypto/pkcs7/bio_pk7.c.
Improve diagnostic messages in apps/lib/http_server.c, e.g., provide clearer error hints when the port number is already in use.
Remove redundant __NR_getrandom macro definition in providers/implementations/rands/seeding/rand_unix.c and add comments.
Remove unused macros in crypto/rc2/rc2_local.h and crypto/rc5/rc5_local.h.
Remove unused macros in crypto/cast/cast_local.h and crypto/des/des_local.h.
Improve diagnostic information in load_key_certs_crls() in apps/lib/apps.c when content of the expected type is not found.
In ssl/record/methods/tls_common.c, ensure that buffer allocation reserves enough space for the explicit IV.
In ssl/quic/quic_channel.c, if the channel is already associated with a libctx, pass it to QRX and QTX.
In demos/sslecho/main.c, ignore the SIGPIPE signal to handle the case where the client closes the connection abruptly.
In apps/s_client.c, replace strstr with strchr for scenarios where a single character is searched.
In include/internal/ring_buf.h, remove unused variables to eliminate clang 16 warnings.
In apps/cmp.c, improve warning messages when options are used.
In include/internal/quic_ackm.h and ssl/quic/quic_ackm.c, clarify the role of is_inflight.
In ssl/quic/quic_fifd.c, note that retransmission stream data is not retransmitted.
In crypto/engine/eng_rdrand.c, add workaround handling for false positive warnings from MSAN.
In crypto/x509/by_dir.c, remove useless assignment to variable j (Coverity 1531872).
In crypto/s390xcap.c, avoid copying structures during initialization to be compatible with older compilers and avoid duplication of read-only data.
Fix incompatible uint64_t format specifiers in QUIC tracing and test code.

Move the inclusion of e_os2.h earlier in test/helpers/quictestlib.c to ensure consistency of symbol definitions.

Update the QUIC ping deadline when a packet is received.
Reset s->rlayer.wnum on retransmission events to record the amount of data sent.
Fix GCC compilation warnings in crypto/conf/conf_sap.c about the flags, appname, and filename variables being set but unused.
Add parentheses around the kill call in util/wrap.pl.in to ensure it receives all arguments.

Add comments in the QUIC multi-stream test.
Clear ownership information when copying a session.
