Added a QUIC local connection ID manager (LCIDM) supporting generation, registration, lookup, and retirement of connection IDs. (Architectural event: new LCIDM added to QUIC internal support modules)
Added a QUIC remote connection ID manager (RCIDM) supporting creation, release, rotation, and update of connection IDs. (Architectural event: new RCIDM added to QUIC internal support modules)
Added the QUIC_PORT object, providing interfaces for creation, destruction, state management, and access to subcomponents. (Architectural event: new QUIC_PORT added to the SSL_Protocol_Core module)
Formalized the state management of the QUIC port, added a stateless reset handling function, and optimized the packet processing flow. (Architectural event: module change in QUIC port management)

Migrated QUIC channel routing from QRX-DEMUX to PORT-LCIDM, updated the registration and removal logic for local connection IDs, and switched to the new idle timeout error code constant. (Architectural event: QUIC channel routing migration)

Completed the migration of the stateless reset token handling logic in the QUIC channel to the SRTM module, and adjusted the libctx reference and initialization order. (Architectural event: stateless reset token handling migrated to the SRTM module)

Began refactoring the lifecycle management of QUIC connections using the QUIC_ENGINE object, changing the creation and property access of ports and channels to be performed through the engine object. (Architectural event: introduction of the QUIC engine object to refactor the connection lifecycle)

Removed legacy calls in QUIC CHANNEL that had been migrated to QUIC_PORT, and moved the network read/write BIO setup functionality to QUIC_PORT. (Architecture-related: QUIC module responsibility migration)

Introduced engine and port management for QUIC TSERVER, delegated channel creation and network IO setup to the port, and improved the corresponding resource release logic. (Architecture-related: QUIC TSERVER engine and port management)
Added an SSL_CTX field to the QUIC port parameters and port structure, used to construct the handshake layer object when creating new channels. (Architecture-related: QUIC port structure extension)

QUIC_PORT now handles creation of all channels and adds functions for updating the polling descriptor and setting the network read/write BIO. (Architecture-related: QUIC_PORT responsibility extension)

Changed the access method for resources such as libctx, propq, mutex, and now_cb in QUIC channels to be obtained indirectly through QUIC_PORT, refactored related functions, added an interface to obtain the number of remote available streams, and improved channel cleanup logic. (Architecture-related: QUIC channel resource access refactoring)

Migrated QUIC DEMUX and default packet processing logic from CHANNEL to PORT, and added port-level connection management, timing, and network reception functions. (Architecture-related: QUIC DEMUX migration to PORT)

Migrated stateless reset processing logic from the QUIC channel to the port layer, and integrated this processing into the port's default packet handler. (Architecture-related: Stateless reset migration to PORT)

Migrated the network I/O part of the QUIC channel's timing processing code to the QUIC port layer, and refactored related function calls. (Architecture-related: Timing processing network I/O migration to PORT)
Moved QUIC connection ID generation logic to quic_types.c, and added a random connection ID generation function.
Added QUIC stateless reset token support, including generator, manager, and their integration in the port. (Architectural event: QUIC stateless reset token support)

Refactored the QUIC packet routing mechanism: introduced the QUIC_PORT object, removed the old demultiplexer routing, and changed to injecting packets directly through the channel. (Architectural event: QUIC packet routing refactoring)
Added creation and release of the local connection ID manager in the QUIC port's initialization and cleanup processes. (Architectural event: QUIC port adds local connection ID manager)
Added counter functions for QUIC RCIDM to obtain the number of active and retired connection identifiers. (Architectural event: QUIC RCIDM adds counter functions)
Add QUIC engine object and its initialization, destruction, reactor acquisition and other functions. (Architectural event: QUIC engine module change)
Add DTLS fuzzing support, including updating the fuzzing corpus submodule, adding dtlsclient and dtlsserver fuzzing programs and related test recipes.

Add QLOG logging functionality, supporting events such as connection start, status update, parameter setting, connection close, packet loss recovery, packet_sent and packet_received, and supporting custom titles. (Architecture-related: QLOG logging)
Add the -no_cache_extracerts option and the OSSL_CMP_OPT_NO_CACHE_EXTRACERTS constant to control the CMP extra certificate caching behavior. (architecture-related: public API)
Add a GCM acceleration implementation based on the Zvbb and Zvbc extensions for the RISC-V platform, with runtime priority detection and use. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)
Add a GCM acceleration implementation for the RISC-V Zvkg extension, prioritizing the use of vector instructions. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)
Add an SM4 encryption implementation based on the Zvksed extension for the RISC-V 64-bit platform. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)
Add a SHA256 implementation based on the Zvknha extension for the RISC-V platform, and adjust SHA512 conditions to support the Zvkb extension. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)

Provide a SHA-512 hardware acceleration implementation for the RISC-V Zvknhb extension, automatically enabled when the extension is supported and the vector length meets the conditions. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)
Add an AES implementation based on the Zvkned extension for the RISC-V 64-bit architecture, supporting OCB and XTS modes. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)
Add an SM3 implementation based on the Zvksh extension for the RISC-V platform, and adjust the enabling conditions to support lower vector lengths. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)
Add vector extension support for RISC-V, detecting and caching the vector register length at runtime. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)
Add the settable parameter OSSL_ASYM_CIPHER_PARAM_OAEP_DIGEST_PROPS for RSA asymmetric encryption. (architecture-related: public API)
Add delayed delivery support for all types of responses on both the CMP client and server side, and refactor transaction cleanup and polling logic. (architecture-related: public API)
Extend SSL_SESSION time-related functions by adding _ex versions that use time_t, and change the original functions to call the new functions. (architecture-related: public API)

Add an optional certProfile request message header and the -profile option to the CMP library and command line, and add the OSSL_CMP_{HDR,CTX}_get0_geninfo_ITAVs getter functions. (architecture-related: public API)
Add the EVP_DigestSqueeze() API, supporting multiple squeezes of output data of different lengths for XOF algorithms such as SHAKE. (architecture-related: public API)
Add the OSSL_CMP_MSG_get0_certreq_publickey function to obtain the public key from a certificate request. (architecture-related: public API)
Enhanced the RSA provider to support automatic generation of CRT coefficients (dmp1/dmq1/iqmp) via new parameters in EVP_PKEY_fromdata(). (architecture-related: public API)
Extended SHA-512 family support on RISC-V platforms to those with vector length of at least 128 bits, and switched to the Zvkb extension. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)
Added AES-ECB, AES-CTR encryption functions and AES-GCM vector encryption implementations based on the Zvkned and Zvkb extensions for RISC-V platforms. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)
Added EVP_DigestSqueeze() support to the digest provider on s390x platforms. (architecture-related: public API: EVP_DigestSqueeze)

Removed the hardcoded limit on the TLS 1.2 exporter context length, and instead dynamically allocate memory and add length validation. (architecture-related: external behavior: TLS 1.2 exporter context length)
Added unbiased random integer range generation functions ossl_rand_uniform_uint32 and ossl_rand_range_uint32. (architecture-related: public API: ossl_rand_uniform_uint32 and others)
Added key setting state tracking in cipher contexts; encryption operations return an error when the key is not set. (architecture-related: external behavior: cipher context key state check)
Added the ERR_pop function to pop the top error entry from the error state stack. (architecture-related: public API)
Added the SSL_OP_PREFER_NO_DHE_KEX option, allowing servers to prefer non-DHE mode in PSK key exchange. (architecture-related: public API)
Adjusted provider activation logic: the activate parameter must be set to yes/true/1 to activate, maintaining backward compatibility. (architecture-related: external behavior)
Added the thread-safe X509_STORE_get1_objects function, which returns a reference-counted copy of the store's objects. (architecture-related: public API)
Allowed ignoring unknown signature algorithms and groups in configuration via the ? prefix, and ignore duplicates. (architecture-related: configuration behavior)
Added optimized FIN API, including the SSL_write_ex2 function and the SSL_WRITE_FLAG_CONCLUDE flag, allowing the stream to be concluded while writing data. (architecture-related: public API)
Added QUIC tuning API, providing functions to get and set uint type values, and added related error codes. (architecture-related: public API)
Made SSL_clear_options pass new options to the record layer, and ensured SSL_set_options synchronously updates the write record layer's options. (architecture-related: public API)
Introduced RCU lock implementation as an alternative locking mechanism for OpenSSL, and added corresponding test cases. (Architecture-related: RCU lock mechanism)
Added idle timeout configuration and stream count related APIs for the QUIC channel, and adjusted the local connection ID replacement implementation. (architecture-related: public API)
Add feature query implementation for QUIC connections, including functions such as idle timeout, stream availability, automatic tick, and event handling mode. (architecture-related: public API)
Add functionality to record the implementation version in QUIC QLOG, supporting customization of log output by overriding the implementation name and process ID. (architecture-related: public API)
Add content type OID (id-ct-rpkiSignedPrefixList) for RPKI signed prefix lists, and update the related object identifier table. (architecture-related: public API)
Add SSL type to BIO polling descriptors, and add corresponding macro definitions and structure members. (architecture-related: public API)

Add the SSL_poll function, supporting QUIC polling, including error codes, front-end implementation, back-end flags, automatic tick, and compatibility with builds without QUIC. (architecture-related: public API)
Add QUIC event handling mode API, including get and set functions and constant definitions, and implement mode control and automatic tick triggering. (architecture-related: public API)
Move QUIC transport error codes from internal header files to public header files, making them a public API. (architecture-related: public API)
Define a dedicated error code for idle timeout, and rename the QLOG setting function. (architecture-related: public API)
Introduce a default header line limit (256) for HTTP responses, and add the OSSL_HTTP_REQ_CTX_set_max_response_hdr_lines API to adjust this limit. (architecture-related: public API)
The -geninfo option of the CMP application now supports multiple ITAVs and string-type values.
Add support for AES-192 to the RISC-V vector AES implementation, falling back to generic key generation in OCB and XTS modes.
Add the -reqout_only option to the CMP client application, which only dumps or saves the initial request without actually sending it.
Improve the -reqin option so that it can read an alternate public key from the first request message file, and optimize error messages and warnings.
Add monotonically increasing datagram ID support for the QUIC demultiplexing and receive path, and expose it to the upper layer.
Enhance the openssl rand command to support specifying the number of bytes using k, m, and g suffixes.
Add functionality to dynamically change the QLOG instance for the QUIC FIFD, QTX, and TXP components, allowing QLOG to be set after instantiation.
Add a new RCID creation function for the QUIC remote connection ID manager, increase the maximum connection ID count limit, and adjust the retirement count logic.
In OCSP requests, switch to using an untrusted certificate chain to generate a valid certificate ID.
Add a -set_issuer option to the openssl x509 command to override the certificate issuer name, and make -subj an alias for -set_subject.
Add missing -rand option support for the genpkey command.
Add a new ossl_qtx_set_qlog_cb callback interface, allowing QLOG instances to be obtained through the callback.
Add query functionality for write buffer size, used space, and available space for QUIC streams.
Add support for UTF-8 multibyte sequences in the JSON encoder.
Add bandwidth limiting support in the noisydgram BIO filter.
Implement known-answer tests (KAT) for KBKDF using KMAC128.
Add credit accessors for QUIC receive flow control (RXFC), and adjust related interfaces to const pointers.
Add more entries such as ODCID to the QUIC glossary.
Add support for the android-riscv64 platform in the configuration.

Fix state handling for SHA-3 related functions on the s390x platform, ensuring absorb, final, shake_final, and keccak_final correctly support extensible output functions (XOF). (architecture-related: platform compatibility)
Restrict RSA-OAEP related functions to be valid only for RSA keys; calling them with non-RSA keys will return an error. (architecture-related: public API)
Fix AES-GCM related functions and macro definitions, changing the dependent RISC-V vector extension from zvbb to zvkb. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)
Unify the return value of CRYPTO_gcm128_decrypt to be consistent with CRYPTO_gcm128_encrypt, returning 0 instead of -1 on failure. (architecture-related: public API)
EVP_PKEY_get_bits, EVP_PKEY_get_security_bits, and EVP_PKEY_get_size now add corresponding error entries to the error queue on failure. (architecture-related: public API)
Fix the %n format specifier warning during cross-compilation, optimizing path length calculation and buffer allocation. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)
Fix SM2 key encoding so that it correctly uses the ECC key type instead of the SM2 OID in PrivateKeyInfo and SubjectPublicKeyInfo. (architecture-related: public API: SM2 key encoding)
Invalidate a previously set IV when changing the IV length. (architecture-related: external behavior: IV invalidation)
Fixed the issue where the X509_REQ_delete_attr function incorrectly returned an integer value when the parameter was empty, and changed it to return a NULL pointer. (architecture-related: public API)

Modified the callback interface of the default packet handler in the QUIC demultiplexer so that it receives the parsed target connection ID, and removed the stateless reset detection logic. (architecture-related: public API)

Fixed the issue on the Nonstop platform where the BIO_socket_nbio function could not correctly set the socket non-blocking mode, and adjusted the conditional compilation logic to use the fcntl(F_GETFL) method. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)
Fixed the incorrect return value of EVP_MD_get_size() for BLAKE2s, so that it now correctly returns the output size of BLAKE2s. (architecture-related: public API)

Added a consumed credit parameter to the QUIC transport stream credit control function, so that when a single packet contains multiple stream data, connection-level credit consumption is correctly tracked to prevent overuse. (architecture-related: public API)
Fixed a potential use-after-free issue in X509v3_asid_add_id_or_range, and cleaned up partially created choice objects. (architecture-related: public API)

Fixed the issue where the SignatureAlgorithms configuration command could not use provider signature algorithms; now, when parsing this configuration, the provider signature algorithm list is correctly loaded. (architecture-related: external behavior)
Added read lock protection to the CRYPTO_secure_used function, fixing the issue of unlocked access to shared variables. (architecture-related: public API)
Fixed the detection conditions for the riscv64/riscv32 architectures, adding a check for the OPENSSL_CPUID_OBJ macro. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)
Fixed the error in X509_load_cert_file_ex() caused by reference counting issues when loading multiple PEM format certificates. (architecture-related: public API)
Introduced hash thunking functions, which fix the ubsan undefined behavior warnings caused by mismatched function pointer types by wrapping the callback calls. (architecture-related: public API)

Added a retry mechanism and length validation for generating connection IDs in the QUIC LCIDM, and renamed related fields to improve code clarity. (architecture-related: QUIC connection ID management)
Fixed the issue where the BN_GF2m_mod_inv function caused an infinite loop when the parameter p was 1, and added input validity checks. (architecture-related: public API)

Fixed the potential length overflow issue in param_build.c in the OSSL_PARAM_BLD_push_utf8_string and OSSL_PARAM_BLD_push_utf8_ptr functions caused by storing the return value of strlen() in an int, and added length checks. (architecture-related: public API)

Fixed the issue where an invalid gen_type value could be assigned to the context during DSA parameter generation, and added assertions in the generation function to verify the valid range of gen_type. (architecture-related: public API)
Added necessary NULL pointer checks to the EVP_CIPHER API to prevent segmentation faults caused by accessing NULL pointers when the cipher is not initialized. (architecture-related: public API)
Fixed the issue where the default buffer length calculation under TLSv1.3 did not include the content type byte. (architecture-related: external behavior)
Allowed duplicate addition of CMS attributes, fixing the regression issue introduced previously. (architecture-related: public API)

Removed support for the OSSL_MAC_PARAM_DIGEST_NOINIT and OSSL_MAC_PARAM_DIGEST_ONESHOT flags, marked them as deprecated and ignored, and fixed the segmentation fault caused by calling EVP_MAC_init. (architecture-related: public API)
Unify error handling in SSL_CONF_cmd, recording internal errors in cases such as index out of bounds. (architecture-related: public API)
Rolled back the previous 'classic' key detection improvement for engine-provided private keys, removing the code that forced conversion of legacy keys. (architecture-related: public API)

Added null pointer checks for the cleanup and construct functions in the OSSL_ENCODER_to_bio function, returning 0 and reporting initialization failure if they are not set. (architecture-related: public API)

Added null pointer checks for the integer type getter functions of OSSL_PARAM to prevent dereference crashes when the parameter data is NULL, and supplemented corresponding test cases. (architecture-related: public API)

Fixed partial block encryption issues in CFB and OFB modes on the s390x platform, switching to use the processed byte count information in the generic cipher context, ensuring this information is correctly reset when the context is reinitialized. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)
Fixed multiple memory leaks in the X.509 SXNET extension, including leaks in SXNET_add_id_asc, SXNET_add_id_ulong, and sxnet_v2i functions. (architecture-related: public API)

Fixed macro definition issues on the PowerPC architecture to enhance platform compatibility, including macro support in Darwin PowerPC and poly1305_ieee754.c. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)

Fixed the issue where the soft_load directive in provider configuration must be an explicit boolean value, requiring its value to be an explicit boolean (such as 1/0, yes/no, on/off, true/false), and added documentation for it. (architecture-related: configuration behavior)
Fixed the dgram_sendmmsg failure on the GNU/Hurd platform due to missing IP_PKTINFO, by disabling the recvmsg method to avoid immediate errors. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)
Fixed the value conflict of the CMP_R_UNEXPECTED_SENDER error code, adjusting it to 106. (architecture-related: public API)

Merged the two functionally similar functions RECORD_LAYER_clear() and clear_record_layer(), added RECORD_LAYER_reset() to replace the original clear_record_layer(), and fixed a bug where certain data might not be correctly freed when using RECORD_LAYER_clear(). (architecture-related: public API)
Fixed null pointer dereference crashes in PKCS12 and PKCS7 caused by possibly empty ContentInfo data. (architecture-related: public API)

Fixed the issue where OSSL_PARAM_allocate_from_text() failed to correctly report an error when inputting an odd number of hexadecimal digits, and added related tests. (architecture-related: public API)

Fixed the error reporting of EVP_PKEY_sign, EVP_PKEY_verify, and EVP_PKEY_verify_recover functions when passed a null context, now correctly returning a null parameter error, and returning an operation not supported error when provider support is missing. (architecture-related: public API)
Fixed the issue of incorrect parameter lists for the CRYPTO_DOWN_REF function when compiling on Windows with the Intel C++ compiler. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)
Fixed the error code conflict, adjusting the value of SSL_R_FEATURE_NEGOTIATION_NOT_COMPLETE to avoid duplication. (architecture-related: public API)
Fixed build errors on the s390x platform when assembly is disabled (disable-asm), avoiding link failures caused by defining the S390X_MOD_EXP macro. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)
Fixed the issue of obtaining the process ID for QUIC QLOG on Windows, switching to use GetCurrentProcessId(). (architecture-related: platform compatibility)

Fixed potential memory corruption in functions such as ECDSA_sign and DSA_sign when a NULL signature buffer is passed, which could occur due to changes in signature length, now directly returning the required signature length; also, the internal SM2 signing function returns an error when sig is NULL. (architecture-related: public API)
Fixed incorrect internal pointer references in the SSL_export_keying_material function in QUIC scenarios, and added corresponding test cases. (architecture-related: public API)

Fix the processing order of SSL_ctrl operations in QUIC connections, ensuring that routing to the QUIC method occurs before checking whether the connection object is NULL. (architecture-related: public API)
Fix memory corruption in SSL_set1_groups_list() when setting 40 or more groups, and add corresponding test cases. (architecture-related: public API)
Add minimum length validation for GeneralizedTime and UTCTime to prevent overly short time strings from being incorrectly parsed. (architecture-related: parsing behavior)
Fix the issue where BIO_get_new_index() returns an error when the index is exhausted. (architecture-related: public API)
Fix build failure on RISC-V platforms due to missing OPENSSL_CPUID_OBJ check. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)
Disable the recvmmsg datagram method on Android versions below 5, because this API is only supported from API Level 21. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)
Fix the issue where the crl and req commands did not exit correctly with a non-zero status upon verification failure; they now exit with exit code 1. (architecture-related: external behavior)
Correct the OSSL_sleep implementation for the NonStop PUT model, introducing sleep() and removing deprecated SPT model support. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)
Fix VMS build issues by replacing snprintf with BIO_snprintf to improve cross-platform compatibility. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)
Fix the issue on NonStop platforms where sleep(0) caused abnormal thread context switching. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)
Fix the issue in X509_print_ex and X509_REQ_print_ex functions where nmflag comparison used the wrong constant, correct the return value judgment logic, and remove useless assignments.
Make the -ignore_keyusage option of the CMP application also take effect for the simulated server.
Fix memory leak in rsa_cms_decrypt function caused by failure of EVP_PKEY_CTX_set0_rsa_oaep_label call, ensuring label is freed on failure.
Fix the logic of request ID validity check in CMP to avoid conflict between OSSL_CMP_CERTREQID_NONE and erroneous return values.
Add release logic for the QLOG title field in SSL_CTX to support the title setting feature.
Fix the AES-XTS key length check condition to correctly match key lengths containing two sets of keys, and correct the hardware declaration macro definition.
Fix potential undefined behavior when session->cipher is NULL, adding an assertion check.
Fix possible errors when the return value aliases the modulus or exponent parameter in modular arithmetic, and add related tests.
Adjust the bit values of internal FFC check flags to avoid conflict with public DH check flags.
Fix the issue in CMS and PKCS7 where the zero return value of EVP_PKEY_get_size() is not handled correctly, avoiding errors caused by allocating zero-length memory.
Fix the null check of the SSL_CONNECTION pointer in ossl_ctrl_internal to prevent null pointer dereference.
Fix the memory leak when X509_ALGOR creation fails in RSA OAEP encryption.
Fix the error handling of the HTTP client response length check, ensuring that failure is correctly returned when the length exceeds the limit or is inconsistent.
Reject integer transport parameters with trailing extra bytes to enhance parsing robustness.
Fix the use of an uninitialized variable in TLS extension parsing.
Fix the issue where the QUIC_TLS object release does not check for a null pointer, making the release function tolerate null pointers.
Fix the issue where the packet loss detection timer may falsely determine packet loss when triggered; now packet loss processing is performed only when packet loss is actually detected.
Fix the issue where quicserver cannot bind a socket when duplicate address entries exist; now it skips the address and continues trying when binding fails.
Fix the issue where quicserver enters an infinite loop when handshake or request reception fails; now it terminates the server and reports the error.
Fix the issue where s_client reports an error when receiving data exactly equal to the maximum buffer capacity; now it allows receiving the full size without triggering an error.
Fix the drain calculation logic in QUIC TXP, remove the deprecated parameter, and directly determine based on the stream buffer state.
Fix the memory leak in the ossl_quic_new function and optimize the error handling path.
Fix the issue where the want_ack flag of a specific pn_space is not correctly checked when generating ACK frames, avoiding the creation of ACK frames when not expected.
Fix the issue where ossl_quic_sstream_is_totally_acked incorrectly returns 0 when no data has been appended to the stream, and add tests.
Fix the possible memory leak when loading built-in compression methods.
Fix the misuse of the likely macro in rand_uniform, correcting the erroneous unlikely to likely.
Fix and strengthen QUIC connection ID length validation to prevent out-of-bounds access and ensure compliance with the specification.
Fix the issue in stream frame generation where the original length tracking is incorrect due to flow control, ensuring correct determination of whether to continue serializing the next data block.
Fix the issue where key slots may be leaked under error conditions, ensuring that the corresponding key slots are correctly cleaned up during error handling.
Fix a potential null pointer dereference in ossl_quic_new() by returning NULL directly in the cleanup path instead of jumping to error handling.
Fix an error when implicit-length STREAM frames coexist with PATH_RESPONSE frames in QUIC transmission, adjusting padding generation logic and stream-related frame generation.
Fix incorrect padding handling for ACK_ONLY type packets in QUIC transmission, avoiding erroneous padding addition in ACK_ONLY mode, and adjust handshake state update logic.
Enhance robustness of QUIC SRTM on memory allocation failure by adding failure checks and returning errors in add, remove, and cleanup operations.
Fix a potential memory leak of ssl->s3.tmp.psk.
Fix a memory leak in the custom_ext_add function caused by not releasing custom extension resources on error paths.
Fix a defect in the priority queue removal function where the free slot was not correctly reclaimed when the element was the last in the heap.
Fix the null pointer check logic in QUIC RCIDM and ensure that the current RCID is correctly retired when processing retirement.
Fix the upper bound of the output size in the BLAKE2 algorithm to use the default output byte count of the corresponding variant.
Fix the issue where packets were not correctly marked as full when QUIC streams use implicit length, potentially causing erroneous addition of more stream-related frames.
Fix the uninitialized hm_fragment allocation in DTLS to avoid crashes due to accessing garbage data during free.
Extract the duplicated connection identifier generation function and adjust calls, and fix the condition check during qlog initialization.
Allow error tracking at the port level and fix the duplicate triggering issue in network error handling.
Fix the issue where the current write record layer could be incorrectly freed when clearing the sent message queue, moving the logic for freeing the old write record layer to dtls1_clear_sent_buffer.
Fix the issue on Windows where QUIC port recvfrom fails due to an unbound socket, by adding send state and server flags to ensure the client does not receive before sending data.
Fix the tag length check logic in QUIC record sending, correctly returning zero when available space equals the tag length.
Fix a potential memory leak in PKCS7_add0_attrib_signing_time: when the internally created ASN1_TIME object is not freed if adding the signing attribute fails.
Fix a potential memory leak in the make_receipt_request function when CMS_ReceiptRequest creation fails, ensuring rct_to and rct_from are correctly freed.
Fix potential memory leaks of X509 objects, public keys, or TLSA records on multiple error paths in the dane_tlsa_add function.
Fix a memory leak in the PKCS7_add_attrib_smimecap function caused by not freeing the ASN1_STRING object.
Fixed a potential memory leak in the CMS_sign_receipt function, ensuring that the ASN1_OCTET_STRING object is freed during error handling.
Fixed a potential memory leak in the ct_move_scts function by changing the failure path to free the SCT object directly instead of attempting to put it back into the source stack.
Fixed a use-after-free issue in custom_exts_free that could be caused by double freeing; reset the pointer and count after freeing.
Fixed a memory leak of the propq field in the SM2 signing context; properly free propq in the free function and safely copy the field in the copy function.
Fixed a double-free issue introduced in DANE certificate handling; adjusted the certificate freeing logic for specific usage scenarios.
Fixed a strict aliasing violation caused by type punning in NIST prime field arithmetic; introduced a memcpy helper function to safely load/store 32-bit words.
Fixed an incorrect static variable declaration in QUIC TSERVER.
Fixed the implementation of the PreferNoDHEKEX option; handle this option correctly in tls_parse_ctos_psk_kex_modes.
Fixed robustness of QUIC LCIDM when LHASH operations fail; ensure proper cleanup of resources when memory allocation or hash table insertion fails.
Fixed a segmentation fault caused by calling EVP_MAC_CTX_get_mac_size() before initialization in CMAC; added a null pointer check.
Fixed an issue where provider parameters were incorrectly set on ENGINE-based ciphers when the SSL context uses an ENGINE.
Fixed a crash during provider initialization caused by an empty output dispatch table; added a null pointer check.
Fixed an issue in the rehash tool where the NAME_MAX limit prevented handling long file names; changed to dynamically calculate the actual file name length to allocate the buffer.
Fixed a potential memory leak in the cms_main function caused by not checking the return value of sk_X509_push.
Fixed a potential memory leak in smime_main: added a check for the return value of sk_X509_push and jump to cleanup code on failure.
Fixed an ASN1_OBJECT leak in the opt_verify function caused by X509_VERIFY_PARAM_add0_policy failure.
Fixed ossl_decoder_cache_flush() to no longer raise an error when the cache has already been freed, avoiding false reports during cleanup.
Fixed a priority issue with the -genstr/-genconf options in the asn1parse command, avoiding blocking when trying to read PEM data from standard input even when a generation string is specified.
Fixed an uninitialized read caused by sscanf returning -1 on empty input strings; changed the return value check from == 0 to <= 0.
Fixed a segmentation fault caused by null pointer dereference when parsing stable sections in configuration files due to null values, and added corresponding test cases.
Fix the issue of improper use of LHASH in QUIC LCIDM, disabling contraction before traversing the hash table to avoid memory leaks caused by rehashing.
Fix the issue in DH parameter generation where gen_type could be set to an invalid value -1, by checking the lookup result before assignment, and adding an assertion to verify the gen_type range.
Fix possible memory leaks in a2i_GENERAL_NAME and do_othername functions, ensuring that allocated resources are properly released on failure paths.
The pkcs12 command no longer forcibly loads configuration files; the unnecessary configuration loading logic has been removed.
When copying ECX keys, first check whether the public key exists, then decide whether to copy the public key data.
Fix the issue in SSL configuration processing where an error in one configuration item would skip the remaining items; now all configuration items are applied and errors are aggregated.
During connection, change hostname information output from standard output to standard error to avoid interfering with pipe forwarding.
Fix declspec alignment syntax, moving the alignment attribute from after the variable name to before the type.
Update comment markers in the QUIC port header file, and fix the port initialization logic to ensure the port is always added to the engine's port list.
Fix the issue in the IPAddressOrRange_cmp function where the missing default case could lead to comparison using garbage data.
Fix and optimize the QLOG module, including initialization timing, connection ID usage, buffer calculation, and frame log parsing.
Fix the issue where calling EVP_<OBJ>_fetch with a colon-separated name caused an assertion failure; change it to return an error, and add corresponding test cases.
Add null checks for configuration options during x509 extension creation to prevent crashes or undefined behavior caused by invalid settings.
Fix the length check error in the KTLS scenario when the maximum fragment length extension is not negotiated, avoiding errors caused by default values.
Correct the condition check for method cache setting in evp_fetch.c, using meth_id instead of name_id for the check.
Fix the assertion failure in tls_common.c caused by incomplete record layer cleanup.
Add a check for the return value of ASN1_OBJECT_new in the OBJ_create function; if allocation fails, report an error and return.
Fix the undefined behavior caused by signed integer left shift leading to arithmetic expression overflow.
Fix the error caused by using the -rev option in s_server together with DTLS.
Fix the bit clearing logic of the bit_set function in QLOG, correcting the incorrectly used mask to the negated mask.
Fixed the issue of using the wrong client/server version when selecting a method, avoiding unexpected failure of subsequent calls to SSL_set_accept_state().
Delayed the generation of transport parameters for the QUIC channel, and fixed state transitions and error code usage.
Fixed an error in idle timeout calculation in the QUIC channel, and added helper functions to correctly handle timeout values.

Fixed a memory leak in req_main caused by using BIO_free instead of BIO_free_all; when the private key is output to standard output via HARNESS_OSSL_PREFIX, out is a BIO stack, now correctly freeing the entire stack.
Treat the case where the QLOG environment variable is an empty string as the default filter.
In the QUIC port receive path, moved the stateless reset check before connection lookup to ensure clients correctly handle stateless reset token frames.
Fixed an off-by-one error in the buf2hexstr_sep() function during EBCDIC encoding conversion.
Fixed a memory leak caused by not cleaning up allocated resources when bind_afalg fails; call afalg_destroy on the failure path for cleanup.
Fixed the correct usage of the QLOG instance on the server side in the QUIC channel, changing from directly setting QLOG to setting it via a callback function.
Fixed the default setting of error values during JSON encoder initialization.
Fixed issues in QLOG filtering lexer analysis, flushing JSON output on release, and corrected the length calculation for extracted strings.
Allowed overriding the process ID for QUIC QLOG, and fixed the return value of the event enable check.
Fixed code indentation issues in QUIC QLOG.
Fixed missing spaces in error messages.
Fixed a memory leak on the error path during DRBG initialization by introducing a dedicated free function pointer to ensure proper resource cleanup.
Fixed an array index calculation error in the ossl_gf_mul function to prevent potential segmentation faults.
Fixed the issue where the x509 command still prints the "reading from stdin" warning when input is redirected; the warning is now only displayed when used with an interactive terminal.
Fixed the handling when the sig parameter is NULL in the ossl_ecdsa_deterministic_sign function, now directly returning an error.
The openssl engine -c command now correctly displays whether the engine supports EC algorithms.
Fixed the ossl_json_flush() function to ensure it actually flushes the underlying BIO.
Fixed the judgment logic for automatic QUIC tick, changing the check based on implicit event handling mode to one based on non-explicit event handling mode.
Fixed a crash caused by not checking for a NULL pointer when printing an invalid PKCS12 certificate; added a NULL check before accessing the encryption algorithm.
Fixed the issue where the subjectAltName=dirName syntax check failed in the -addext parameter of the openssl req command.
Fixed a possible memory leak when successfully loading a CRL.
Fixed an incorrect function call in dasync_rsa_decrypt, correcting EVP_PKEY_meth_get_encrypt to EVP_PKEY_meth_get_decrypt.
Fixed the issue of unlimited memory growth in the no-cached-fetch compilation mode due to incomplete cache matching logic.
Fixed a possible memory leak when module initialization fails.
Fixed the type conversion issue of the digest_length variable, avoiding integer overflow caused by EVP_MD_get_size() returning a negative number.
Fixed the type conversion issue of digest_size and added a validity check for the return value of EVP_MD_get_size().
Fixed the build failure of demos/sslecho/main.c on OpenBSD by adding the missing netinet/in.h header file.
Fixed the issue where BIO_s_connect incorrectly set keepalive on datagram sockets; now keepalive is enabled only on stream sockets.
Fixed errors in the SM4-XTS aarch64 assembly implementation, involving the vpsm4-armv8.pl and vpsm4_ex-armv8.pl files.
In the kdf_test_ctrl function of test/evp_test.c, added a NULL check for the p variable for malformed input values lacking a colon, preventing a null pointer dereference in prepare_from_text.
Fixed the issue of inconsistent script numbering in multi-stream tests.
In test/json_test.c, changed script_name and script_title from pointers to arrays so that MSVC can correctly fill symbol addresses in constant initializer lists instead of dereferencing variables.
In fuzz/asn1.c, limited the printing of overly long ASN1 items to avoid fuzzer timeouts.

In the tls_prov_get_capabilities function of test/tls-provider.c, added a range assertion for xor_group.group_id (65024–65279-NUM_DUMMY_GROUPS), changed the assignment of the dummy group ID to go through the local variable dummygroup_id, and corrected the pointer type to unsigned char*, to fix intermittent CI failures in sslapitest.
Fixed ANSI C compatibility issues in the QUIC QLOG test by changing overly long string literals to arrays and fixing commas in enum definitions.
In apps/list.c, when a provider cannot return parameters, downgrade the error to a warning and continue listing subsequent providers.
Added a call to OPENSSL_DIR_end in the error handling path of apps/rehash.c, fixing a memory leak.
Fixed a leak of the conn object in doc/designs/ddd/ddd-02-conn-nonblocking-threads.c.

Changed the type of the `need_skip` variable in QUIC QLOG from `uint64_t` to `size_t`, and correspondingly adjusted the type casts and constants (`UINT64_MAX` to `SIZE_MAX`) in the related assignment expressions.
Changed CRYPTO_MUTEX and CRYPTO_CONDVAR from void to type-safe definitions, and fixed bugs in QUIC code exposed by this change.

In the QUIC SRTM module, changed the local variables prev_seq_num and prev_opaque in the check_mark function from uninitialized state to explicitly initialized to 0 and NULL, to fix clang compiler related issues.

Unify the build patterns of the Makefiles in the demos directory, use implicit rules to compile object files and explicit rules to link, fix compilation warnings, and make the top-level demo Makefile usable.
In ssl/quic/quic_rcidm.c, removed the trailing commas at the end of the enum definitions RCID_STATE_RETIRING and RCID_TYPE_NCID, to fix ANSI C compliance issues.
Fixed a conditional judgment error in the JSON test, and simplified the JSON operations in the QLOG cleanup process.
In the generic sha3 absorb implementation in providers/implementations/digests/sha3_prov.c, added state transition checks from the initialised and updated states to the XOF_STATE_ABSORB state.

Improved the handling of delayed delivery in the CMP protocol, including polling support for client and server, sender random number saving, error handling, and test case optimization, and moved the polling state check logic from the mock server to the CMP server core. (architecture-related: CMP protocol behavior)

Migrated the RISC-V vector crypto extension from zvbb to its subset zvkb, improving flexibility; updated ghash and SM4 related functions and macro definitions. (architecture-related: platform compatibility: RISC-V vector crypto extension)
Changed the return value of OPENSSL_sk_push when passed NULL from -1 to 0, simplifying the calling logic. (architecture-related: public API behavior change)

Removed the unnecessary INT_MAX size check in param_build.c, and changed the size parameter type of the param_push function from int to size_t, making the code more consistent with params.c. (architecture-related: public API parameter type change)
Replaced the read-write lock implementation of the CONF_MOD API with RCU locks, to demonstrate the usage of RCU locks. (architecture-related: thread safety model change)
Updated the SSL error code definitions, adjusting the number of SSL_R_POLL_REQUEST_NOT_SUPPORTED. (architecture-related: public API error code change)
Uniformly renamed the QUIC error code macros, changing QUIC_ERR_* to OSSL_QUIC_ERR_*, which is a breaking change. (architecture-related: public API macro renaming (breaking change))
Changed the RLAYER_USE_EXPLICIT_IV macro to directly check the DTLS version number, enhancing future compatibility. (architecture-related: public API)

In crypto/sha/sha256.c and crypto/sha/sha512.c, added the INCLUDE_C_SHA256 and INCLUDE_C_SHA512 macro mechanisms respectively, so that the architecture can still retain the C code as a fallback implementation when SHA256_ASM/SHA512_ASM is defined.
Refactored the BLAKE2s implementation using macros, eliminating code duplication and supporting variable output lengths.
Unified the calculation logic for ping timeout and idle timeout in the QUIC channel, and refactored the implementation of local connection ID replacement.
Added a sub-channel list for QUIC_PORT, maintaining this list during channel creation and destruction.
Removed the deprecated stateless reset handling code in QUIC DEMUX, and added datagram ID allocation when receiving datagrams. Also removed the old DEMUX-QRX routing code in QUIC QRX.
Saved a reference to LCIDM during QUIC channel initialization, added a reference to the QUIC port for the channel, and adjusted the way the demultiplexer is obtained.

Switched the blinding mechanism of QUIC SRTM from MAC-based to AES-128-ECB, removed assertions that were no longer needed, and replaced secure memory comparison with ordinary memory comparison in the comparison function.
Changed the return types and local variables of the ssl_cert_info-related lookup and disable check functions to const, making them read-only accesses.
Unified the server version selection logic for TLS and DTLS, removed the special handling for DTLS, and changed to uniformly calling the version negotiation function.
Simplified the SSL protocol version comparison logic, introduced a unified ssl_version_cmp function to replace the original static version_cmp, and used it uniformly across multiple functions.
Refactored QLOG instance management, changing from directly storing the QLOG pointer to dynamically obtaining it through a callback function, and delaying instantiation until the first event trigger.

In the ossl_cmp_msg_check_update function in crypto/cmp/cmp_vfy.c, improved the diagnostic information for the check of the expected sender name, and synchronously updated the related error code definition file.
In the check_msg_all_certs function in crypto/cmp/cmp_vfy.c, removed redundant trace output when 3GPP mode is not enabled.
Rename the likely/unlikely macros in include/internal/common.h to ossl_likely/ossl_unlikely to conform to the openssl-specific prefix required by the coding style.
Removed obsolete SRT definitions in ssl/quic/quic_channel_local.h.
Changed nid_to_group in ssl/t1_lib.c, the bitmask table in ssl/statem/statem_dtls.c, and scsv in ssl/statem/statem_clnt.c to read-only.

Removed the unused ssl_bad_method function in ssl/ssl_lib.c, the unused return value reception in apps/s_time.c, and the logical dead code of the i2r_issuer_sign_tool function in crypto/x509/v3_ist.c.
In apps/engine.c, crypto/dso/dso_dl.c, crypto/dso/dso_dlfcn.c, and ssl/ssl_conf.c, replaced strstr() that matches a single character with strchr().
Refactor in apps/cmp.c to fix code style issues and improve source-level debugging convenience.
Extract the BLAKE2B provider definition into a macro, eliminating duplicate function implementations.
In include/internal/list.h, allow declarations to be separated from function definitions.
Add iterator macros in include/internal/list.h.
In QUIC-related header files, consolidate forward object declarations into a single header include/internal/quic_predef.h, and fix duplicate structure definition issues.
In ssl/ssl_local.h and ssl/t1_enc.c, remove redundant functions that are no longer called after the record layer refactoring.
In ssl/record/rec_layer_s3.c and ssl/record/record.h, remove wpend_ret which is only assigned but never used.
Move the increment operation of the DTLS epoch into the cipher state change function, involving multiple files under ssl/record/ and ssl/statem/ and ssl/t1_enc.c.
In ossl_rsa_fips186_4_gen_prob_primes() in crypto/rsa/rsa_sp800_56b_gen.c, remove the unused Xpout and Xqout parameters.

In ssl/quic/quic_impl.c and ssl/quic/quic_tserver.c, adjust the release of the QUIC TLS object and the tserver TLS object to before the channel release, to avoid accessing freed resources during callbacks.
Renamed the JSON encoder's sink setting function to ossl_json_set0_sink, and simplified the return value of the initialization function.
Refactored the QUIC QTX write flow, extracting packet mutation and qlog logging logic into separate functions, so that injected frames are also recorded by qlog.
In ssl/d1_srtp.c, multiple files under ssl/record/methods/, ssl/s3_enc.c, ssl/ssl_ciph.c, ssl/ssl_lib.c, and ssl/ssl_local.h, change some global mutable structures to constants.
In include/internal/quic_stream_map.h and ssl/quic/quic_stream_map.c, allow bidirectional streams and unidirectional inbound streams to be tracked separately.
Move the NULL pointer check in SSL_get_value_uint into the QUIC-specific implementation function ossl_quic_get_value_uint.

In ssl/record/methods/dtls_meth.c, ssl/record/methods/ktls_meth.c, ssl/record/methods/recmethod_local.h, and ssl/record/methods/tls_common.c, remove unused function parameters from tls_int_new_record_layer.

In ssl/record/methods/dtls_meth.c, ssl/record/methods/recmethod_local.h, ssl/record/rec_layer_d1.c, ssl/record/rec_layer_s3.c, ssl/record/record.h, ssl/ssl_lib.c, and util/indent.pro, remove the record_queue structure that is no longer useful.
In crypto/pkcs7/pk7_smime.c, remove one of the two consecutive duplicate checks "if (i <= 0)".

Implemented pairwise consistency testing (PCT) for EDDSA, performing signature and verification operations after key generation, and unified for EVP_PKEY_keygen and EVP_PKEY_pairwise_check. (architecture-related: public API)
In test/recipes/30-test_evp_data/evpciph_aes_common.txt, add longer additional test cases for AES-CBC, AES-ECB, and AES-XTS modes to enhance test coverage.
Fixed a race condition in the QUIC multi-stream test, frame injection logic, and random failures on Windows, and enhanced QLOG diagnostics.
Added stream support to the quic-client fuzzer in fuzz/quic-client.c, enabling it to accept and create new streams and call SSL_write().
Added behavior tests for session cache overflow scenarios in test/sslapitest.c.
Added test files for the JSON encoder and fixed logic errors in test helper functions.
Added scenario tests for including provider configuration files in test/conf_include_test.c, test/recipes/90-test_includes.t, and related test data files.
Fixed a potential NULL pointer dereference in test/ssl_old_test.c.
In digest_test_run() in test/evp_test.c, expanded the parameter array size from 2 parameters plus sentinel to 3 parameters plus sentinel to fix the array overflow risk reported by Coverity 1548054.
In the QUIC test helper library quictestlib, allowed deleted TLS extensions to still be output, and synchronously modified the related tests in quicfaultstest.c.
Added tests for missing, malformed, duplicate, and other QUIC transport parameters in test/quicapitest.c.
Added test/rand_test.c and registered it in test/build.info to test the uniform random number generator.
Added negative tests for key length changes in test/evp_extra_test.c.
Removed dead code in the cleanup phase of the tparam_on_enc_ext() function in test/quicapitest.c to fix Coverity 1548382.
Added the QUIC SRTM test file test/quic_srtm_test.c and the corresponding test recipe test/recipes/70-test_quic_srtm.t, and registered them in test/build.info.
Added lock protection for the fake_now variable in test/helpers/quictestlib.c to fix a multi-threaded data race detected by ThreadSanitizer.
Added tests test/quic_lcidm_test.c, fuzzer fuzz/quic-lcidm.c, and corresponding test recipes for the QUIC LCIDM module, and modified ssl/quic/quic_lcidm.c.
Added unit tests for issue #22644 in test/priority_queue_test.c.
Added tests test/quic_rcidm_test.c and fuzzer fuzz/quic-rcidm.c and corresponding test recipes for the QUIC RCIDM module.
Added the OP_POP_ERR operation in test/quic_multistream_test.c, made error tests non-mutating, and restored error code tests.
Removed dependencies on the legacy DEMUX-QRX routing in test/quic_record_test.c and test/quic_txp_test.c.
Imported the reproduction case for issue #22708 as test data in test/recipes/30-test_evp_data/evpkdf_hkdf.txt.

In the ctx cmp_ctx test in test/cmp_ctx_test.c, when a DUP operation failure causes val3_read and val2_read to point to the same pointer, reset val3_read to 0 to avoid double-freeing the aliased pointer, fixing Coverity 1551739 and 1551737.
In test/danetest.in, add the missing TLSA usage/selector/matching type combination test case PKIX-TA(0) SPKI(1) Full(0), i.e., the success scenario of "0 1 0".
In test/sslapitest.c, add a test for ENGINE lazy loading in TLS (loading after SSL_CTX construction).

Add a minimal test provider test/p_minimal.c and its loading verification test, and statically link the legacy provider to evp_extra_test to avoid crashes caused by conflicts between statically linked libcrypto and dynamically loaded legacy provider.
Add test/x509_load_cert_file_test.c and the test recipe test/recipes/60-test_x509_load_cert_file.t to test the X509_load_cert_file() function.
In test/http_test.c, add a test scenario for OSSL_HTTP_parse_url where the port number in the URL is an empty string.

In test/tls13encryptiontest.c, add tests for the return codes of EVP_CIPHER_CTX_get_block_size and EVP_CIPHER_CTX_get_iv_length, ensuring that expected error codes are returned instead of crashing on abnormal operations.
In test/evp_test.c, fix the provider compatibility check crash, avoiding calling EVP_MAC_CTX_get_mac_size() before EVP_MAC_init() in older versions where it is not fixed.
In test_export_key_mat() in test/sslapitest.c, restrict long context support to the new fips provider only.
Added test cases to verify ignoring unknown signature algorithms and groups marked with a question mark.
Add tests to verify the functionality of s_server using "-cert_chain" to construct OCSP requests, adding test scripts, certificate files, and the test recipe test/recipes/82-test_ocsp_cert_chain.t.
In the DTLS renegotiation test configuration test/ssl-tests/18-dtls-renegotiate.cnf and its source file, set the maximum protocol version to DTLS 1.2.
In test/sslapitest.c, add a KTLS test to verify that long application data records can be written and read back.
In test/ssl_old_test.c, fix the bio_err stream handling by using the creation and destruction functions provided by the test framework, avoiding crashes due to uncreated locks.

In test/evp_extra_test.c, add a test for reusing the encryption context, using the same key, IV, and algorithm to detect whether hardware-related contexts are correctly reset, covering encryption and decryption iterations for cfb128 and ofb128.
Fix test cases in test/evp_extra_test.c, test/evp_pkey_provided_test.c, and test/keymgmt_internal_test.c so that they actually run the intended tests on repeated keys.
In test/siphash_internal_test.c, fix the uninitialized array variable key to avoid reading garbage values in SipHash_Init().

In test/sslapitest.c, extend the SSL connection reset/clear tests to add tests for SSL_set_accept_state() and SSL_set_connect_state(), and cover scenarios where unread buffered data needs to be cleared.
In the QUIC multi-stream test, add test functions to verify the available stream count API and the write buffer status API.
Enhance the random platform adaptability of the QUIC multi-stream test by adjusting test script operations to improve stability.
Add unit tests for the QUIC QLOG feature to verify the log output format.
Enhance the robustness of the poll test in test/quic_multistream_test.c.
Add tests using the bandwidth limiting filter in test/quicapitest.c and the related helper files test/helpers/quictestlib.c/h.
Extend the multi_resume test in test/sslapitest.c to cover the scenario where the same session is resumed multiple times simultaneously and one of them is marked as not_resumable.
Add a return value check for xor_get_aid() in test/tls-provider.c to avoid NULL pointer dereference caused by X509_ALGOR_new() allocation failure.
Remove dead code in test/tls13ccstest.c that performs a duplicate invalid value check on tst.

Adjust the Fedora 39 configuration in .github/workflows/interop-tests.yml to lower the SECLEVEL in openssl.cnf to 0 to support TLS 1.3 tests with TLS_AES_128_CCM_8_SHA256, and change to check out a specific tag instead of a branch to simplify updates.
Lower the ASLR value in the CI workflow file to fix random failures in asan/tsan/ubsan runs caused by overly high address space layout randomization settings.
Fix the Windows test running instructions in test/README.md by changing single quotes to double quotes to avoid test name parsing errors.
Add optimized AES-128/192/256-CBC encryption and decryption function declarations for the RISC-V platform, replacing the old implementations. (architecture-related: public API)

Add an accelerated implementation of the CHACHA20 cipher based on RISC-V vector extensions (rvv and zvbb), and adjust the original C implementation to support conditional compilation selection. (architecture-related: public API)

Add a multi-block AES-128/256-XTS implementation based on the vector crypto extension for the RISC-V platform, and update the hardware selection logic to prioritize this accelerated scheme. (architecture-related: public API)

Optimize AES-CTR performance for ARM Neoverse V1 and V2 by unrolling the loop up to 12 blocks to fully utilize AES pipeline resources, and add support for Apple M3 and Microsoft Cobalt 100 processors. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)
Add an MD5 assembly implementation for loongarch64, improving performance by approximately 5-7% through optimized instruction ordering. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)
Enable the AES-GCM unroll8 optimization for the Microsoft Azure Cobalt 100 platform, improving performance by 18% to 32%. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)
Optimize the RISC-V SHA-256 implementation to support the zvknhb extension, move constant loading to a separate subroutine, and simplify the initialization process.
On the RISC-V platform, reduce the vector length required for SM3 hardware acceleration from 256 bits to 128 bits, and update the corresponding extension check conditions.
Mark the ossl_assert macro as likely to hint the compiler to optimize the non-failure path.
Automatically optimize the QUIC write buffer size, add a maximum buffer limit and a free space guarantee mechanism, and adjust the write operation path to use the new wrapper functions.
Enable AES and SHA3 optimizations on Apple Silicon M3, with AES performance improving by 19-36% and SHA3 improving by 4-7% for buffers of 256 bytes and above.
Optimize the circular buffer logic in the BIO_hex_string function to avoid using the modulo operation to improve performance.
Move the discovery of legacy algorithm types from each creation of EVP_PKEY_CTX to EVP_KEYMGMT construction time to improve performance.
Optimize the ec_field_size() implementation by directly calling EC_GROUP_get0_field instead of creating and copying BIGNUM objects, simplifying the code and improving performance.
Remove one unnecessary memcpy operation in the DTLS message reassembly function and use pointers to directly reference buffer data instead.
In apps/speed.c, add performance test support for KMAC128 and KMAC256, refactor the MAC setup/cleanup code to introduce mac_setup() and mac_teardown(), and accept "cmac" as an algorithm string.
Optimize the field order of the QUIC channel structure to reduce memory padding.

Based on the code audit results, add additional hardening checks to the HPKE internal implementation, including stricter parameter validation, improved error code usage, and optimization of the random selection function. (architecture-related: HPKE interface hardening)
Add security checks for excessively large moduli P and Q to DH_check_pub_key() and DH_generate_key(), and add corresponding error codes. (architecture-related: DH interface security enhancement)

Limit the key size to no more than 16384 bits during RSA public key checks, and set the number of Miller-Rabin primality test rounds to 5, to fix the issue of long computation times caused by excessively large keys or too many rounds (CVE-2023-6237). (architecture-related: RSA public key check behavior change)

Fix the issue in the ASN1_mbstring_ncopy function where the output parameter was not properly cleaned up in the error handling path, avoiding a potential use-after-free vulnerability. (architecture-related: ASN1_mbstring_ncopy fix)

Fix the security vulnerability in the pbkdf1 key derivation function where requesting a key length exceeding the maximum digest size read random stack memory, add length validation and return an error. (architecture-related: key derivation behavior)

Fix the security vulnerability of unlimited session cache growth in TLSv1.3 (CVE-2024-2511), and enhance the security of non-resumable sessions to ensure that non-resumable sessions are not misused. (architecture-related: SSL session behavior)
Add overflow checks to the parse_number, parse_hex, and parse_oct functions, and fix the error in hexadecimal character conversion in parse_hex.
Detect and prevent stack overflow crashes caused by recursive references in configuration files, and fix the issue where error messages were incorrectly cleared when configuration parsing failed.
Fixed a heap buffer overflow vulnerability in the ASN1 OID loader when processing invalid input starting with a comma; it now correctly detects and handles leading commas.
Fixed an integer overflow issue in the ossl_asn1_time_from_tm function, preventing overflow triggered by constructing specially crafted time values.

Fixed a potential key data disclosure issue in the blake2b and blake2s final functions caused by an uncleared stack buffer; when the output length is not a multiple of 8, the temporary stack variable is cleared immediately after copying the result.
Fixed a potential key disclosure issue caused by uncleared stack variables in the PBKDF1 derivation function.
Fixed an unsafe sprintf call in QUIC QLOG by switching to length-limited BIO_snprintf, improving security.
Added session cache handling tests in test/sslapitest.c, repeatedly creating sessions to be added to the cache and ensuring the cache size does not exceed the expected value.

Updated documentation for openssl-s_client, openssl-s_server, COMP_CTX_new, SSL_CONF_cmd, and SSL_CTX_set_options to state that TLS record compression is disabled by default and cannot be used at the default security level 2 in OpenSSL 3.2 and above.
Removed references to CVE-2023-5678 from CHANGES.md and NEWS.md because the vulnerability was fixed in master/3.2 before release.

Documented a behavior change for the -verify option in the crl and req applications: since OpenSSL 3.3, the exit code is 1 when verification fails. Additionally, when -CApath, -CAfile, or -CAstore options are specified, the -verify option is implicitly enabled. (architecture-related: command-line option behavior)
Added a -6 option to the QUIC and TLS client example programs to support IPv6 connections.
Added standalone README files for the guide examples and updated the related READMEs to fix links and descriptions.
Recorded in CHANGES.md that the BLAKE2s hash algorithm now supports configurable output length settings similar to BLAKE2b.
Recorded in CHANGES.md that the BLAKE2b hash algorithm supports configuring the output length by setting the size parameter.
Added a link to the OpenSSL 3.2 manual pages in the README.
Synchronized CHANGES.md and NEWS.md files, updating version numbers and release notes.
Modified NEWS.md to be more like a release notes format.
Added a proposed editing conventions document for NEWS.md.
Synchronized CHANGES.md and NEWS.md files, merging change records from the 3.2 branch into the master branch.
Added a glossary entry for RIO (Reactive I/O subsystem) in the QUIC design document.
Fixed syntax errors in CONTRIBUTING.md, changed "Guidelines how to" to "Guidelines on how to", and added a link to the documentation policy.
Updated the build and run instructions for the QUIC HTTP/3 example, including adding shared library path settings, suggesting installation of dependency packages, and cleaning up the build script.
Disabled the build of the quicserver tool in util/build.info when the configuration uses the no-apps option.
Added a new QUIC debugging and tracing guide document, introducing two debugging methods: QLOG and packet capture.
Updated the content of README.md.
Updated README-QUIC.md, moving some QUIC-related content to the guide and providing a summary in README-QUIC.md, while clarifying how to use s_client with QUIC.
Updated the content of demos/README.txt.
Added a reference to the demos subfolder in README.md.
Added references to HTTP/3 and ALPN ID in README-QUIC.md.

Updated doc/designs/ddd/Makefile and several demo source files, fixing symbol issues, removing an extra newline in the host-port format string, and changing to calculate the actual message length instead of sending the entire buffer size.
Added the LCID/RCID concepts to the QUIC glossary in doc/designs/quic-design/glossary.md.
Added entries for CVE-2023-5678 in CHANGES.md and NEWS.md.

In CONTRIBUTING.md, provided an example commit message containing "CLA: trivial", stating it should be placed at the bottom of the commit message, and updated the force-push command to include the repository and branch information.
Modified the title of CHANGES.md to make it more appropriate.
Added a known issues section in dev/NEWS-FORMAT.md.
Removed the mention of NEWS.md from CONTRIBUTING.md.
Added documentation for the -prefer_no_dhe_kex option to the s_client and s_server command documentation.
Added a reference to util/check-format.pl in CONTRIBUTING.md and fixed several minor issues.
Supplemented the documentation for the LHASH down_load function in doc/man3/OPENSSL_LH_COMPFUNC.pod and removed the corresponding entry from util/missingcrypto.txt.
Documented that configuration entries for unknown TLS groups and signature algorithms marked with ? are ignored, and an error is returned if the resulting list is empty.

In doc/man3/SSL_get_error.pod, add documentation for SSL_R_UNEXPECTED_EOF_WHILE_READING, explaining that it can be used for control flow decisions, and synchronously modify the related implementation in ssl/record/rec_layer_s3.c.
Updated CHANGES.md and NEWS.md to add change records for feature enhancements and security fixes for the upcoming new version.
Modified CHANGES.md and NEWS.md to reflect changes in the DN output format.
Improved the descriptions of the -cert_chain and -status_verbose options in the openssl-s_server documentation.
Improved the descriptions of standard IANA cipher suite names in the openssl-ciphers documentation.
In the openssl-req documentation, aligned the description of string_mask with the actual behavior of the software.
Fixed the style of the openssl-mac documentation.
Updated the documentation about FIPS hmac keys in INSTALL.md, correcting previous inaccuracies.
Prepared release content for 3.3 alpha 1 and alpha 2 in CHANGES.md, NEWS.md, and VERSION.dat.
Clarified the purpose of the -keys option in the openssl-storeutl documentation.
Updated CHANGES.md and NEWS.md to record new features and improvements since OpenSSL 3.2.
Refactored the pkg-config exporter to use a templated approach, added new .pc.in template files, and updated .gitignore to ignore generated .pc files. (architecture-related: pkg-config configuration)

Added a CMake configuration file exporter for OpenSSL, generating OpenSSLConfig.cmake and OpenSSLConfigVersion.cmake, and updated .gitignore to ignore these files. Also updated CHANGES.md and NEWS.md to record this change. (Architecture-related: CMake configuration)

Introduced the libabigail tool in CI to check ABI compatibility of libcrypto and libssl, fixed CI failures caused by ABI differences, synchronized symbol version files, and added the EVP_DigestSqueeze symbol to the ABI configuration. Added debug symbols in CI builds to support verification, and updated ABI XML files. When checks fail, automatically output XML diff for debugging. (architecture-related: ABI compatibility)

In the OpenSSL CMake configuration file, added a check for the existence of the sharedlib_import method to avoid errors on platforms lacking this method. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)
Removed support for the SPT threading model on NonStop platforms and rolled back changes previously introduced to support that model. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)
Fixed a header inclusion conflict for struct timeval on Windows platforms, only including winsock2.h when winsock.h or winsock2.h has not been included. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)
Modified the out-of-source-and-install task in CI to support read-only source trees, and added the enable-quic configuration option. (architecture-related: build configuration)
Disabled the build of hardware-accelerated AES on PPC Mac platforms. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)
Changed ABI difference checking from CI failure to using a label marker, and refactored the related CI workflow. (architecture-related: ABI compatibility)

Fixed the shared library detection condition in the VMS installation script, replacing $config{no_shared} with $disabled{shared} to maintain consistency with configuration data. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)
Fixed a build failure when enabling KTLS on FreeBSD by adding a null implementation for the unsupported zero-copy sendfile feature. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)

Added a build-time configuration option to control whether OPENSSL_cleanup() is registered with atexit(), to address compatibility issues on specific platforms; also updated related documentation and CI configuration. (architecture-related: build configuration)
Added _dclass to the Windows platform symbol allowlist to support calls to isnan() and isinf() in JSON encoding. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)
Enabled qlog support by default, updated documentation, and removed the explicit enable option from CI configuration. (architecture-related: build and installation methods)

Fixed a build failure on FreeBSD variants due to the in_pktinfo structure missing the ipi_spec_dst field, by conditionally compiling to skip setting that field. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)
Added the -mxgot option for m68k cross-compilation to resolve relocation truncation issues. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)

Allow EVP tests to run on pull requests and removed the restriction that some steps are only for push events.

Adjusted the macro definition for the QUIC idle timeout value. (architecture-related: public API: macro definition change)

Added deprecation notices in the QUIC DEMUX and QRX header files, marking some functions for removal and recommending explicit routing via QUIC_PORT and QUIC_LCIDM instead. (architecture-related: internal interface deprecation: QUIC DEMUX/QRX)
Added M1 macOS runners to the ci.yml, os-zoo.yml, and run-checker-daily.yml workflows.

Make QUIC_PORT a required component of the QUIC CHANNEL.
Change the default HMAC algorithm from MD5 to SHA256, remove the logic that skips HMAC, and exit with an error if the specified hash function is not found.
Add IANA-assigned numbers in t1_trce.c for two hybrid post-quantum key exchange algorithms widely used in testing.
Uniformly use lcid_obj in QUIC LCIDM to refer to QUIC_LCID.
Remove the duplicate u64 typedef in aes_x86core.c, which is already defined in aes_local.h.
Add explicit type casts in the get_time wrapper function of QUIC PORT.
Remove the unnecessary unsigned int cast of cipher_ctx->blocksize in e_devcrypto.c.
Fix comments and documentation for QUIC engine, port, channel, and mutexes to clarify object ownership, lifetime, and release responsibility.
Remove the leftover abort code macro definition in QLOG.
Fix uninitialized variable warnings and correct literal types in tests.

Perform minor maintenance updates to the QLOG module, including adding header files, adjusting platform compatibility, optimizing character checking functions, and fixing comments and code formatting.
Add missing checks for the return value of SSL_CTX_ctrl for SSL_CTX_set1_verify_cert_store() and SSL_CTX_set1_chain_cert_store() calls in apps/lib/s_cb.c.
Rearrange CI jobs, moving less-used jobs to daily or push-time runs, and keeping jobs that are more likely to trigger failures and are less time-consuming in the PR main CI.

Added an internal hash table implementation based on the hopscotch algorithm, supporting RCU locks, lock-free read operations, filtering, and early termination of iteration, with performance improvement of about 6% compared to the original LHASH_OF.

Refactored the generation of FIPS options to use macros and a unified header file to maintain naming consistency, and renamed the security detection function to clarify its FIPS configuration attribute. (architecture-related: public API)

Added an internal default value API for OpenSSL, querying the installation path via the registry on Windows and returning compile-time constants on Unix. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)
Changed RCU thread-local storage from global variables to per-library-context management to support the FIPS module, and fixed the issue where tests did not correctly call the thread stop function.
Refactored X509_REQ_get_extensions() and added a const qualifier to it.

Replaced the core hash table from LHASH with a new lock-free-read hashtable, applied to core_namemap, supporting lock-free read operations. (Architecture event: core hash table replaced with lock-free hashtable)

Added a FIPS indicator for CMAC, allowing TDES to be enabled in FIPS mode via configuration or settable parameters, and refactored the initialization function to support parameter passing. (Architecture event: CMAC internal header file change)
Prohibited the use of SHA1 in DH and ECDH key exchanges, and renamed the FIPS indicator function to ossl_fips_ind_digest_exch_check. (architectural event: FIPS indicator change)

Added full support for RFC 5755 attribute certificates, including ASN.1 definitions, I/O API, configuration file loading, getter/setter, signature verification, attribute management, and printing functionality. (architecture-related: public API)
The CMP client adds support for requesting CRL updates via genm messages and receiving CRLs via genp messages, and adds corresponding command-line options. (architecture-related: CMP protocol)
Add FIPS self-tests for EDDSA, exposing relevant APIs via conditional compilation to support the FIPS module. (architecture-related: FIPS self-test)

In CMS_verify and PKCS7_verify, certificates passed via the -certfile option are also used to build the certificate chain, and the lookup priority of PKCS7_get0_signers has been adjusted. (architecture-related: public API)

Added integrity-only cipher suite support for TLS v1.3, including a new ssl_cipher_get_evp_md_mac() API, extending the record layer to support MAC-only operations, adding build options and test vectors. (architecture-related: TLS 1.3 integrity suites)
Added definitions for OIDs id-kp-wisun-fan-device and id-on-hardwareModuleName. (architecture-related: public API)

Added init, update, and final functions for the three API groups EVP_PKEY_sign, EVP_PKEY_verify, and EVP_PKEY_verify_recover, supporting direct use of explicitly fetched composite signature algorithms. (architecture-related: public API)

Refactored the EdDSA signature algorithm implementation, added support for the EVP_PKEY_sign/verify_message series of functions, and added initialization and operation functions for the ph and ctx variants for Ed25519 and Ed448. (architecture-related: public API)
Added new atomic operation APIs CRYPTO_atomic_store and CRYPTO_atomic_add64 to resolve false positives from the thread sanitizer. (architecture-related: public API)
Enabled support for POSIX context functions on FreeBSD for compatibility with asynchronous operations. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)
Added a function for QUIC stream reception to determine whether there is data waiting to be read. (architecture-related: public API)

Added CPU capability detection and CPUINFO printing support on the RISC-V platform, enabling OpenSSL to output CPU capability information on the RISC-V architecture. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)

Made conf_diagnostics configuration also apply to SSL configuration errors; when configuration diagnostics are enabled, the SSL_CONF_FLAG_SHOW_ERRORS flag is automatically set to display error information. (architecture-related: configuration diagnostics behavior)

Deprecated SSL_SESSION_get_time and SSL_SESSION_set_time functions, and introduced corresponding new functions; also deprecated SSL_CTX_flush_sessions and introduced SSL_CTX_flush_sessions_ex to address Y2038 compatibility issues. (architecture-related: version and compatibility)
Added digest algorithm and key length restriction checks for HKDF, SSHKDF, SSKDF, X963KDF, TLS1-PRF, and TLS1.3 KDF in FIPS mode. (architecture-related: FIPS compliance)

Added support for X.509 v3 extensions: targetingInformation, acceptableCertPolicies, acceptablePrivilegePolicies, delegatedNameConstraints, holderNameConstraints, subjectDirectoryAttributes, and associatedInformation. (architecture-related: public API)
Added support for X.509v3 auditIdentity, userNotice, and basicAttConstraints extensions. (architecture-related: public API)

Added a FIPS indicator callback mechanism, settable via OSSL_INDICATOR_set_callback(), to record or handle non-approved algorithms when non-approved algorithm checks occur. (architecture-related: public API)

Added the no-short-mac option to the FIPS module and the fipsinstall tool, which controls whether to perform runtime checks for overly short MAC outputs; this option is enabled by default. (Architecture-related: FIPS configuration option)

Added explicit FIPS indicator support for the PBKDF2 KDF, allowing configuration of lower-bound check behavior in FIPS mode and prohibiting the use of XOF digests. (architecture-related: FIPS compliance)
Added a standalone jitter entropy source provider, which can replace SEED-SRC, and provided an example configuration. (Architecture-related: entropy source provider)

Refactored the RSA EVP_SIGNATURE implementation, adding support for RSA+hash composite algorithms (sigalg) by wrapping hash functions and adding corresponding initialization, signing, verification, and context parameter handling functions. (architecture-related: public API)

Added the ability to list TLS signature algorithms, supporting display of built-in algorithms and provider-registered algorithms, and added the --tls-signature-algorithms option to the openssl list command. (architecture-related: public API)
