Extended the TLSv1.3 record layer padding API, adding SSL_set_block_padding_ex() and SSL_CTX_set_block_padding_ex(), which support setting different padding block sizes for handshake messages and application data messages respectively. (architecture-related: public API)
Added the X509v3_add_extensions function to add a list of extensions to an extension stack, and updated calls in the CMP module to use this new function. (architecture-related: public API)
Extended the X509_REQ_add_extensions_nid function to support appending or overwriting existing extensions in certificate requests. (architecture-related: public API)
Refactored the EVP_PKEY operation type check macros so that internal macros reuse public macros, and added missing public operation type macros. (architecture-related: public API)

Replaced and deprecated the TS_VERIFY_CTX_set_data, TS_VERIFY_CTX_set_store, TS_VERIFY_CTX_set_certs, and TS_VERIFY_CTX_set_imprint functions, adding corresponding set0 versions to improve memory management. (Architecture-related: API deprecation and replacement)
Extended the mask field in the ssl_method_st structure to 64 bits to support SSL operation option flags beyond 32 bits. (Architecture-related: SSL option extension)
Added the OPENSSL_strtoul wrapper function for reliable error checking of strtoul conversions. (architecture-related: public API)
Added signature digest check support to the fipsinstall tool and the FIPS provider, allowing configuration of signature digest check options. (architecture-related: public API)
Added the eddsa_no_verify_digested option in the fipsinstall tool and FIPS provider to prohibit Ed25519/Ed448 from verifying pre-hashed data. (architecture-related: public API)
Added an option in the fipsinstall tool and FIPS module to disable RSA PKCS#1 v1.5 padding, disabled by default. (architecture-related: public API)
Added a KBKDF key check option in the fipsinstall tool and FIPS module, allowing configuration of KBKDF key checking. (architecture-related: public API)

Added EVP_CIPHER_CTX_set_algor_params and EVP_CIPHER_CTX_get_algor_params APIs, as well as algorithm parameter set and get functions for EVP_PKEY_CTX, to replace the old PKCS7/CMS-related control commands. (architecture-related: public API)

Added FIPS indicator support for Triple-DES encryption, allowing Triple-DES to be used by default for decryption in FIPS mode but prohibiting encryption, and also prohibiting the use of Triple-DES CMAC in FIPS mode. (architecture-related: FIPS compliance)

Added ED25519 and ED448 support for EVP_PKEY_sign_init_ex2() and EVP_PKEY_verify_init_ex2(), supporting only pre-hashed mode, requiring the instance to be explicitly specified via parameters. (architecture-related: public API)
Refactored the DSA signature and verification implementation, added support for the DSA+hash composite algorithm, and enhanced FIPS compliance checks. (architecture-related: public API)
Added key generation parameter retrieval and retrievable parameter query functionality, allowing parameters to be queried after key generation. (architecture-related: public API)
Refactored the ECDSA signature and verification implementation, added support for the ECDSA+hash composite signature algorithm. (architecture-related: public API)

Added a configurable item pbkdf2-lower-bound-check in the FIPS installation tool, enabled by default, to match the default behavior of the FIPS provider v3.0. (architecture-related: build and installation methods)
Avoid using decryption-only type ciphers when obtaining 3DES ciphers in FIPS mode, and added the decrypt_only parameter for detection. (architecture-related: public API)
Added key length checking for HMAC in the FIPS module, and introduced an internal dispatch table so that KDF can bypass this check when using HMAC. (architecture-related: public API)
Added key size compliance checks for the KMAC algorithm in FIPS mode, and ensured that relevant FIPS indicator status is passed when copying contexts. (architecture-related: public API)
Added key length checking for KBKDF in FIPS mode, in compliance with SP 800-131a revision 2 requirements. (architecture-related: FIPS compliance)
Added support for wrap and unwrap operations in the pkeyutl command, and added corresponding command-line options. (architecture-related: public API)

Added a FIPS indicator in ECDH cofactor mode, ensuring that curves with non-1 cofactor correctly multiply the private key during key derivation, and added FIPS compliance checks. (architecture-related: FIPS compliance)
Added parameter support for AES GCM to indicate whether the IV is generated internally. (architecture-related: public API)
Exposed EVP_DigestSignFinal and EVP_DigestVerifyFinal interfaces in the FIPS module, and updated self-tests. (architecture-related: public API)
Added FIPS verification message parameter support for ECDSA signature verification contexts. (architecture-related: FIPS compliance)
Add verify_message parameter support for RSA signature and verification initialization, and refactor related functions. (architecture-related: public API)
Add support for the issuedOnBehalfOf X.509v3 extension. (architecture-related: public API)
Add FIPS indicator support for X25519 and X448 key generation and key exchange operations, and add a parameter interface to obtain the FIPS approved status. (architecture-related: public API)

Add public key verification for ED25519 and ED448, supporting checking whether the public key is a valid point on the curve via EVP_PKEY_public_check() in FIPS mode. (architecture-related: public API)
Add the EVP_MD_CTX_get_size_ex() function to correctly handle size retrieval for XOF digests, and add get_ctx_params() support for the SHAKE implementation. (architecture-related: public API)
Add elf_aux_info() support for OpenBSD, extending conditional compilation in CPU feature detection code for ARM and PowerPC. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)
Add error codes and corresponding error descriptions for entropy source continuous test failures. (architecture-related: public API)
Implement the SP 800-90B Continuous Random Number Generator Test (CRNGT) for the FIPS module, replacing the existing crngt implementation. (architecture-related: FIPS compliance)
Implement key length checking for the X9.42 KDF, requiring input keys to be at least 112 bits, and add corresponding FIPS configuration options. (architecture-related: FIPS configuration)
Increase the maximum response length limit for CRL downloads. (architecture-related: public API: CRL download response length limit)
Add the windowscontext option to the openssl info command to display Windows installation context information. (architecture-related: platform compatibility: Windows installation context)
Add -not_before and -not_after options to the ca, req, and x509 applications to explicitly set the certificate validity start and end dates.
In s_client output, add a new line after the cipher line to display the protocol version separately.
Enable the RSA-SM3 signature combination in the default provider.
Add logging support for early data messages in ssl/t1_trce.c for the -trace option.
Add an ECDH key exchange demonstration program, involving demos/keyexch/ecdh.c, the corresponding Makefile, and the documentation EVP_KEYEXCH-ECDH.pod.
Add a blocking single-client MVP TLS server demonstration program demos/guide/tls-server-block.c and related documentation.
Add tests in test/sslapitest.c to verify that connections can be successfully established when using session_secret_cb.
Add additional test cases for bn_gcd in test/recipes/10-test_bn_data/bngcd.txt.
Remove the no longer applicable SHAKE128 OAEP test case to fix the build failure.
Remove the alias relationship between DSA and dsaWithSHA1, fixing the confusion between key algorithm and signature scheme. (Architectural event: ASN1_Core module change)

Fix the X509v3_get_ext_by_critical and X509_EXTENSION_set_critical functions, changing the default value of the extension's critical attribute from -1 to 0, and optimize the comparison logic for the critical value. (architecture-related: public API)
Fixed the CMS_get1_certs and CMS_get1_crls functions to ensure they return NULL only on error, rather than returning NULL when the certificate or CRL list is empty. (architecture-related: public API)
Fix a memory leak when replacing an existing object in OBJ_add_object, and improve error handling by rolling back changes on insertion failure. (architecture-related: public API)
Fix the issue where provider signature algorithms set via the SignatureAlgorithms configuration command were not used and fell back to defaults. (architecture-related: public API)

Fix issues in the SM2 encryption and decryption implementation: during encryption, regenerate the random number if the KDF output is all zeros; during decryption, report an error and exit if the KDF output is all zeros. (architecture-related: public API)

Fix the issue where setting msg_name on a connected UDP socket caused sendmsg to fail on macOS and OpenBSD, by detecting the socket connection state to avoid setting the peer address. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)
Fix the behavior of EVP_PKEY_CTX_add1_hkdf_info so that it correctly performs an append operation instead of overwriting. (architecture-related: public API)

Fixed a potential memory corruption issue in ECDSA_sign, DSA_sign, and similar functions when NULL is passed as the sig parameter due to non-deterministic signature length, and unified handling of NULL sig in internal APIs. (architecture-related: public API)
Fix the append logic of the RCU callback linked list on Windows to avoid a circular list, making it consistent with the pthread version behavior. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)
Fix the error type when SSL_sendfile fails, changing it from an SSL error to a system call error, and include the system error information. (architecture-related: public API behavior change)
Disable the recvmmsg datagram method on Android versions below 5 to be compatible with old APIs. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)
Fix the check logic in OSSL_CMP_validate_msg so that the OSSL_CMP_OPT_PERMIT_TA_IN_EXTRACERTS_FOR_IR option is usable again. (architecture-related: public API)
Replace the PKCS#1 v1.5 padding in the RSA key pair consistency test with no padding mode, and add the corresponding self-test description constant. (architecture-related: public API)
Fix the OSSL_sleep function for the NonStop PUT model by introducing the sleep() call, and remove support for the deprecated SPT model. (Architecture-related: public API and platform compatibility)
Reject setting invalid CSR version numbers, enhancing input validation. (architecture-related: public API behavior change)
Fixed an issue where an error was sent when no root CA certificate update was available, and adjusted the behavior of the related CMP functions. (architecture-related: public API behavior change)

Fixed a possible out-of-order issue in RCU pointer dereference when compiling with clang on Apple M1 virtualized CPUs, by using inline assembly to switch to the ldar instruction to ensure correct memory barriers. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)
Fixed the issue of setting keepalive for datagram socket errors in BIO_s_connect; keepalive is now enabled only for stream sockets. (architecture-related: public API)
Fixed the socket descriptor checking logic on the Windows platform to correctly identify invalid sockets. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)
Removed the X25519 and X448 curves from FIPS approval, modified the FIPS provider properties to unapproved, and excluded them from capability advertisements. (architecture-related: FIPS compliance)

Made EVP_DigestFinal fail for SHAKE128 and SHAKE256 when OSSL_DIGEST_PARAM_XOFLEN is not set, and updated the related initialization functions and tests. (architecture-related: public API behavior change)

Fixed the issue of repeatedly looking up the default CA path; when no URI is specified, the default certificate directory is no longer automatically used, avoiding duplicate loading. (architecture-related: public API behavior change)
Fixed the handling of empty parameters in EVP_PKEY_CTX_add1_hkdf_info and added related test cases. (architecture-related: public API behavior change)
For connections with TLS versions higher than 1.0, use an empty renegotiate extension instead of SCSV to indicate renegotiation support. (architecture-related: TLS protocol behavior)

Fixed the handling logic when the -certout and -chainout parameters specify the same file name, and added support for certReqTemplate type genm responses. (architecture-related: CMP command-line interface)
Fixed undefined behavior that could occur when the session ID length is zero, avoiding memory copy on a null pointer when the length is 0. (architecture-related: public API behavior fix)

Fixed the issue where configuration diagnostic values were overwritten when not set in the configuration file, ensuring diagnostic settings are updated only when explicitly specified in the configuration file. (architecture-related: public API behavior fix)

Added reason codes with correct offsets for two TLS alerts and supplemented the corresponding error strings, fixing the issue where reason strings could not be looked up correctly. (architecture-related: public API error code correction)
Added a null pointer check for the EVP_CIPHER_CTX_get_key_length function, returning 0 when ctx->cipher is null. (architecture-related: public API behavior fix)
On QNX systems, added a check for the __QNX__ macro in conditional compilation to avoid using the ipi_spec_dst field in the in_pktinfo structure. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)

In FIPS mode, RSA-OAEP padding and verification functions now block the use of XOF digest algorithms such as SHAKE, and corresponding test cases have been added. (architecture-related: external behavior)
Explicitly call OPENSSL_cpuid_setup during FIPS provider initialization to ensure the capability vector is correctly set. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)
Enhanced the strictness of IPv4 address parsing in the ipv4_from_asc function, rejecting invalid input formats. (architecture-related: external behavior)

Fixed a regression when measuring SHAKE128/SHAKE256 with the -evp parameter; now EVP_Digest_loop() uses the correct init, update, and extendable-output functions for XOF mode. (architecture-related: public API)

Fixed the cpuid_obj conditional compilation check for SM3 and SM4 on RISC-V, ensuring that the relevant hardware acceleration code is enabled only when OPENSSL_CPUID_OBJ is defined. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)

Fixed incorrect handling of the max_fragment_length extension in PSK sessions, ensuring that new sessions correctly initialize this field and that resumed sessions no longer incorrectly require this extension. (architecture-related: public API)

Fixed the SSL_select_next_proto function by adding non-empty and format validation of the client protocol list, preventing unvalidated lists from causing security issues (CVE-2024-5535). (architecture-related: public API)
Fixed the ASN1_item_verify_ctx function to return -1 on internal errors or ASN1 library errors instead of continuing execution. (architecture-related: public API)

Fixed the fallback mechanism in EVP_PKEY_CTX_add1_hkdf_info() when the legacy provider does not implement the gettable parameters interface; now it decides whether to fall back by checking the list of gettable parameters. (architecture-related: public API behavior)

Fixed a pointer width mismatch in hash table lookups on non-64-bit systems caused by using CRYPTO_atomic_load; switched to ossl_rcu_deref for safe loading. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)

Fixed handling of NULL returned from the configuration path, ensuring that commands such as openssl version return an empty string instead of NULL when no configuration file is present, avoiding crashes. (architecture-related: public API behavior)
Fixed OSSL_LIB_CTX_free(NULL) not correctly handling a null pointer, and added related documentation. (architecture-related: public API)

Fixed conditional compilation indentation and logic in the defaults code, ensuring that the run_once routine is defined only when OSSL_WINCTX is defined, avoiding compiler errors. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)
Fixed a potential crash in the EVP_DigestUpdate function when ctx->update is NULL. (architecture-related: public API)
Corrected the OID name, changing ac-auditEntity to ac-auditIdentity. (architecture-related: public API)
Fixed the VS2010 x86 build error by adding the CRYPTO_atomic_add64 and CRYPTO_atomic_and atomic operation functions and updating the RCU lock implementation. (architecture-related: public API)
Fixed OPENSSL_hexstr2buf_ex() writing one byte before the output buffer and reporting an incorrect length when handling zero-length input. (architecture-related: public API)

Fixed a potential deadlock in ENGINE_get_first, ENGINE_get_last, ENGINE_get_next, and ENGINE_get_prev functions when up_ref fails, by ensuring the global lock is released. (architecture-related: public API)
Extended the error information in duplicate attribute error entries to include the name of the duplicate attribute. (architecture-related: public API)
Fixed a build error under mingw64 caused by a reader_idx type mismatch; changed the field type to uint32_t and corrected related comments. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)
Prohibit the use of XOF digests in multiple KDFs (PBKDF2, X9.42 KDF, HKDF, SSKDF, X963KDF, TLS1-PRF) and adjust the related FIPS lower-bound check logic. (architecture-related: external behavior)

Implemented error handling and a retry mechanism for the jitter random number generator, retrying up to 3 times to handle intermittent failures, improving reliability. (architecture-related: external behavior)

Fixed the initialization of the FIPS indicator structure by changing field types to smaller integer types and replacing memset with a loop assignment, making initialization more robust. (architecture-related: public API: FIPS indicator structure)

Removed the option allowing X9.31 padding in RSA encryption, because that padding mode is only applicable to signatures and should not be used in encryption. (architecture-related: RSA encryption: removed X9.31 padding option)

Fixed the issue where looking up an EVP algorithm by name failed if the name was not yet registered; now it attempts to automatically load the algorithm before looking it up. (architecture-related: public API: EVP algorithm lookup behavior)
After calling ASN1_item_i2d, both the return length being negative and the pointer being NULL are now checked, enhancing the robustness of error handling. (architecture-related: public API)
Fixed the incorrect lock type in CRYPTO_atomic_store, changing the read lock to a write lock. (architecture-related: public API)

Fixed the issue in TLS 1.3 where the wrong alert was sent when key_share was missing; it now sends illegal_parameter. Additionally, added a check for the absence of the supported_versions extension to comply with the RFC specification. (architecture-related: TLS 1.3 protocol behavior)
Fixed the type mismatch of reader_idx in the InterlockedExchange call on Windows, avoiding MinGW compilation warnings. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)

Added restrictions in the FIPS provider for X9.31 padding: prohibiting its use for RSA signing (only verification is allowed), and enforcing that the RSA modulus size must be a multiple of 1024 + 256*s. (architecture-related: FIPS compliance)
Prohibited the use of XOF digests in the SM2 signature implementation. (architecture-related: SM2 signature)
Temporarily disabled read-write lock support under the Non-Stop KLT thread model due to issues in its read-write lock implementation. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)
3DES cipher suites are no longer allowed in FIPS mode and have been removed from the FIPS flags of the relevant cipher suites. (architecture-related: FIPS compliance)

In FIPS mode, the use of pre-generated hashes for EdDSA verification is prohibited, and an indicator has been added to allow bypassing this restriction via configuration or parameters. (architecture-related: FIPS compliance)
Fixed the incorrect return code check in http_server_init() and added a call to BIO_set_accept_ip_family to support IPv4/IPv6 dual-stack. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)

Fixed the issue where SSL_pending() or _has_pending() incorrectly started a connection; added an early return check in the QUIC implementation when the connection has not been started. (architecture-related: public API)
Fixed the alias issue for the audit entity OID, correctly mapping ac-auditEntity to ac-auditIdentity. (architecture-related: public API)
Reverted the incorrect verification indicator restrictions and options for EdDSA in FIPS mode to ensure FIPS compliance. (architecture-related: FIPS compliance)

Fixed the issue where SSL_handle_events() and SSL_poll() implicitly started a connection when it had not been started; they now only perform the relevant operations when the connection has already been started. (architecture-related: public API)
Fixed an issue where OSSL_HTTP_open() could not correctly set the default port for IPv6 host addresses. (architecture-related: public API)
Fixed the value of a larger index in the FIPS indicator macro definition. (architecture-related: public API)
Fixed handling of the PBMAC1 algorithm in PKCS12 MAC verification in FIPS mode, and implemented support for PBMAC1 as defined by RFC 9579 in PKCS#12. (architecture-related: PBMAC1 support)
Fixed the message callback function and related assertions and error codes when a Change Cipher Spec record is received in TLSv1.3. (architecture-related: TLS protocol implementation)
Changed the TLS alert type sent when PSK binder verification fails to DECRYPT_ERROR, to comply with RFC 8446. (architecture-related: protocol compliance)
Added sanity checks for parameters such as p, q, e, d relative to the modulus n in the RSA decoder, rejecting invalid keys and preventing timeouts. (architecture-related: public API)

Fixed issues in the base64 BIO where internal whitespace was handled incorrectly under the BIO_FLAGS_BASE64_NO_NL flag, decoding behavior was abnormal after skipping invalid input, buffered lines were not decoded promptly on retryable reads, and return values were inconsistent after read completion; also improved related documentation and tests. (architecture-related: public API)
Updated the return value check for EVP_MD_size() to treat values less than or equal to zero as errors, to correctly handle SHAKE algorithms returning zero. (architecture-related: public API)

On s390x, when the digest used for HMAC computation is provided by an engine, hardware acceleration is disabled to ensure the engine's digest implementation is used correctly. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)
Fixed a potential out-of-bounds array access in EVP_CIPHER_CTX_get_algor_params due to incorrect handling of negative i values. (architecture-related: public API)

Fixed HMAC digest detection on s390x by using EVP_MD_is_a() instead of EVP_MD_get_type(), avoiding the HMAC acceleration path being skipped when zero is returned under the FIPS provider. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)
Fixed the issue where extra data in TLS CertificateVerify messages was ignored; such messages are now detected and rejected. (architecture-related: protocol behavior)

Fixed prehash-by-caller handling for ED25519 and ED448 signing and verification on s390x, correctly falling back to the non-accelerated path when prehash or prehash-by-caller is enabled. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)
Fixed a type conversion error in Windows thread code when calling InterlockedExchangeAdd, changing incorrect long * and long to LONG * and LONG. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)

Fixed an error on s390x where SHAKE squeeze operations without prior data absorption caused incorrect behavior; the NIP flag is now correctly set on the first squeeze, and corresponding test cases were added. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)

Fixed an issue on s390x where SHA3 absorb operations with zero-length data caused incorrect subsequent hash output; KIMD instructions with no data are skipped and state transitions are delayed. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)

Fixed a build failure on ARM when compiling with OPENSSL_SMALL_FOOTPRINT due to gcm_ghash_4bit being undeclared; the ghash function pointer is now set to null under conditional compilation. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)
Fixed the S/MIME type for AuthEnvelopedData, correctly setting authEnveloped-data when writing. (architecture-related: public API)
Fixed a potential null pointer dereference triggered by non-standard pkcs11 parameters, adding null pointer checks in i2o_ECPublicKey and EC_POINT_point2oct. (architecture-related: public API)

Fixed incorrect detection of the ECDH cofactor FIPS indicator, and added test cases covering all parameter combinations. The test is skipped when the curve is not supported by the FIPS provider. (architecture-related: FIPS indicator behavior)
Fixed handling of PBMAC1 when the PRF field is missing in PBKDF2-params, defaulting to hmacWithSHA1. (architecture-related: PKCS12 parsing behavior)
Fixed a potential double-free issue in SRP_user_pwd_set1_ids caused by not nullifying the pointer after freeing. (architecture-related: public API)

When the application provides custom memory allocation functions via CRYPTO_set_mem_functions, CRYPTO_aligned_alloc no longer uses posix_memalign or aligned_alloc, but instead uses CRYPTO_malloc and manually aligns memory to ensure consistency of allocation and deallocation. (architecture-related: public API)
Reverted the API change to OPENSSL_version, restoring its original behavior. (architecture-related: public API)
Modified SSL_get_event_timeout in ssl/quic/quic_impl.c to return infinity when the connection has not started.
Fixed build failure when --strict-warnings is enabled due to missing const qualifiers on function parameters, adding const qualifiers to the relevant parameters.
Fixed undefined behavior that could be triggered by char type arguments when using ctype.h functions, adding unsigned char casts to ensure arguments meet C standard requirements.
Fixed error handling in CMS_EncryptedData_encrypt and related functions, avoiding memory leaks on error paths.
Allow short reads in asn1_d2i_read_bio, continuing the loop when the actual number of bytes read is less than expected instead of directly reporting an error.
Fixed a double-free issue in the add_attribute function caused by improper ownership transfer, moving the X509_ATTRIBUTE_create call to the end of the function to avoid subsequent errors.
In ossl_ecdsa_deterministic_sign, removed the old handling for a NULL sig parameter, now directly returning an error, and added a check for a NULL digestname parameter.
Fixed a crash caused by a null pointer when accessing the PKCS7 encryption algorithm.
Fixed the syntax check failure for subjectAltName=dirName with the -addext parameter in the openssl req command, now using the correct configuration file for extension syntax validation.
Fixed an error when running openssl speed -evp -decrypt caused by the AEAD cipher decryption not setting a fake tag, adding fake tag setting for decryption operations in the default loop function.
Added null pointer checks in the provider store API to prevent exceptions when the open or attach methods are not provided together.
Fixed the issue in the PKCS#12 tool where the private key file was written before password verification, deferring the write operation until after the import password verification passes.

Fixed unbounded growth of the session cache in TLSv1.3: when copying a session, avoid copying cache linked-list pointers that may be modified concurrently, and add a dedicated copy function to ensure the copy is resumable. Also, when caching a session, check whether it is marked non-resumable to prevent non-resumable session objects from entering the cache.
Fixed the issue where the crl and req commands did not exit with a non-zero status when certificate verification failed.

Fixed the issue in the d2i function where the passed pointer was not set to NULL after releasing the reference-counted object in error handling, ensuring that callers can correctly determine the object state.
In tls_retry_write_records, record error information and trigger an error when a system call fails.
Replace the pairwise consistency test for RSA key generation from PKCS#1 v1.5 encryption/decryption to PKCS#1 v1.5 signature generation and verification, to comply with NIST SP 800-131Ar2.

Fixed the error handling in the create_digest function when EVP_MD_get_size returns a negative value, treating non-positive numbers uniformly as errors and returning 0; also merged the memory release logic into the err label to avoid *md_value leakage.
Added a public key existence check during SM2 signing to avoid null pointer crashes.
Fixed the null pointer dereference issue in the readbuffer_gets function caused by missing parameter checks.

Fixed the potential integer overflow issue in the ssl_cipher_get_overhead function caused by type mismatch, changing the local variable type from size_t to int, and adding validity checks on the return value of the encryption algorithm.

Fixed the integer overflow and type conversion issues in TLS 1.3 PSK extension handling, changing the return value type of EVP_MD_get_size to int and adding validity checks, while also correcting the error handling path.
Fixed the integer overflow issue in the DANE TLSA adding function by checking whether the return value of EVP_MD_get_size is negative or zero, avoiding overflow during unsigned integer conversion.
In tls13_generate_master_secret, changed the variable type receiving the return value of EVP_MD_get_size from size_t to int, and added a validity check on the return value to avoid integer overflow.

Fixed potential integer overflow issues in multiple modules caused by EVP_MD_get_size returning a negative number, involving components such as SSL/TLS, DRBG, KMAC, ECDSA, DSA, X509, SM2, timestamp, FFC parameter generation, and RSA PSS.
Fixed the memory leak in the OSSL_STORE_SEARCH_by_key_fingerprint function caused by not releasing allocated memory.
Fixed the issue where the module failed to load because it was not activated during configuration loading, ensuring that the module path is correctly set from the template.
Fixed the memory leak during provider initialization and the issue of not releasing resources when setting the module path fails.
Always allocate and release the lock for the provider's activatecnt_lock, ensuring that CRYPTO_atomic_add does not silently fail when a lock is needed.
Fixed the issue of duplicate mutex allocation when creating RCU locks on Windows threads.
Fixed the memory leak on the error path in the ossl_provider_new function.
Fixed a memory leak in the list_provider_info function caused by not releasing the providers collection on the error path.
Fixed a memory leak in the CONF_modules_unload function caused by prematurely creating to_delete when new_modules allocation fails.

Fixed the reservation calculation for PING frames in QUIC TXP, added the txp_need_ping function to uniformly determine whether a PING needs to be sent, and correctly applied this logic during initialization and generation phases.

Fixed the issue where the key length was not correctly set when the initial key is empty in HKDF, ensuring the key length is valid, in preparation for subsequently enforcing a minimum key length requirement.
Fixed the issue of incorrectly releasing the read buffer while there are still unprocessed records or the application has not released all records, preventing a potential security vulnerability.
Fixed a use-after-free vulnerability: after releasing rl->packet, set its pointer to NULL and reset its length, and added assertions in read functions to ensure the pointer is non-NULL.
Fixed a potential null pointer dereference issue in the hashtable caused by not checking whether the pointer is NULL.
Fixed a double-free issue in the module_add function in conf_mod.c.
Fixed a data race issue in the get_cert_by_subject_ex function caused by checking the sorting state of the X509 store object without proper locking.
In BN_DEBUG mode, corrected the top value of BIGNUM during EC/DSA nonce generation, avoiding assertion failures in subsequent operations due to an incorrect top value.

Fixed the timing issue of setting the server signature algorithm, moving it earlier to before calling session_secret_cb, ensuring the certificate validity flag is correctly set; also optimized the client compression method checking logic.
Added a size pre-check before DSA parameter validation, avoiding long computation times due to excessively large parameters, fixing security vulnerability CVE-2024-4603.
When RSA key generation fails, zeroize and free the p and q members in the rsa structure to meet the FIPS 186-5 standard requirements.
Fixed a memory leak issue caused by not releasing pkey_ctx when initialization fails.
Added key matching support to the hash table, preventing errors caused by hash collisions.
Fixed a potential memory leak in OSSL_IETF_ATTR_SYNTAX_add1_value when handling unknown types.
Fixed a potential memory leak in the PKCS12_add_key_ex function.
Fixed the issue in NPN extension handling where selected_len being 0 caused an internal error, changed to returning a handshake failure alert.
Fixed a memory leak in the frame_ack function in quic_trace.c, ensuring allocated memory is correctly released on the error path.
Fixed a crash caused by the RNG context being released after FIPS on-demand self-tests, added a reference count before the self-test to prevent premature release.
Fixed several minor issues in the RCU thread code: added the OSSL_LIB_CTX parameter to the ossl_rcu_lock_new function, and added an operation to clean up local keys in ossl_rcu_free_local_data.
Fixed a data race in SSL_SESSION duplication caused by concurrent modification of the prev pointer, and changed it to copy only safe fields.
Fixed the return value when the extension is not sent during NPN extension negotiation, so that it correctly returns the not-sent status.
Fixed the issue where SSL BIO incorrectly called SSL_shutdown when freed during the initialization phase.

Fixed multiple style and error issues in the ossl_print_attribute_value function, including correcting the return value, avoiding modification of the attribute pointer, and simplifying the BIO_printf return code conversion.
Fixed the issue in the evp_pkey_ctx_setget_params_to_ctrl function where the context action type was not correctly set, ensuring correct assignment in bidirectional translation scenarios.
Fixed the issue where the OPENSSL_config function did not free the appname memory after initializing the encryption.

Added error checks for when the result of obtaining the group order is empty in the ECDSA signature setting and signing functions, and replaced some internal function calls for random number generation and zero value checking.
Fixed the print_hex() function: correctly handle input of length 0, and use OPENSSL_buf2hexstr() instead of OPENSSL_buf2hexstr_ex() to solve the problem of insufficient buffer length.
Fixed the incorrect key type used in RSA encryption operations in the OpenSSL speed test, correcting the private key to a public key.
Fixed the issue in ossl_engine_table_select where unlock was incorrectly called after a write lock failure.
Fixed a data race between ossl_method_store_do_all and ossl_method_store_insert by cloning the algorithm store and iterating without locking.
Avoid giving unnecessary -help prompts when adding duplicate extensions via -addext.
Fixed build errors under VS2010 by moving variable definitions to the beginning of functions to conform to coding style, and added null pointer checks.

Fixed the issue in ssl_conf.c where using atoi to parse input strings could not correctly detect errors; switched to OPENSSL_strtoul for safe conversion and verification that the entire string was correctly parsed.
Fixed a memory leak in the rsa_cms_sign function caused by failure of the X509_ALGOR_set0 call, explicitly freeing the allocated ASN1_STRING object on the error path.

Fixed the line continuation logic in the configuration parser, ensuring that backslash continuation is correctly handled only in non-retry mode, avoiding erroneous deletion of backslash characters in the middle of lines.
Fixed the issue in KBKDF where the is_kmac flag could not be reset after the MAC was set to KMAC, ensuring proper operation when switching to HMAC or CMAC later.
Fixed a type conversion error in the opt_uintmax function, correcting a potential signed overflow issue to an unsigned type conversion.
Fixed the issue in the tls13_cipher function where the negative return value of EVP_CIPHER_CTX_get_iv_length() was not checked, avoiding potential errors.
Fixed a possible memory leak during reconnection and cleaned up redundant null checks.
Fixed the TLS extension tag list, added the missing early_data entry, and changed the array declaration to constant.
Fixed a potential integer overflow in the i2a_ASN1_OBJECT function due to BIO_write returning an error; the subsequent dump operation is now performed only after a successful write.
Fixed the incorrect macro name in fipsinstall used to disable the DRBG truncation digest option.
Fixed a memory leak in the show_digests function where digest objects obtained via EVP_MD_fetch were not freed.
Provide a clearer error message in deterministic ECDSA signing when no digest is provided.
Removed unnecessary restrictions on settable parameters in the ECDSA signing context, always allowing all settable parameters.
Fixed the issue of duplicate colons in otherName display by removing the extra colon to avoid duplication.
Fixed issues in the proxy function regarding IPv6 address escaping and whitespace matching in the no_proxy list.
Fixed a file descriptor leak in RAND_write_file that could occur due to fdopen failure; the file descriptor is now closed and the function returns early on failure.
Fixed a crash in ossl_print_attribute_value() caused by not checking the ASN.1 type; DN syntax handling is now restricted to sequence types.
In the FIPS module's RSA encryption implementation, replaced function calls for unapproved checks with the corresponding macros to correctly use macros for indication.
Fixed a memory leak in the speed application by ensuring the ecdsa_key object is freed after use.
Fixed the req command so that it no longer outputs a warning about reading certificate requests from standard input when standard input is redirected.
Fixed the inability to check policies when the certificate stack is empty by adding an early return for empty stacks.
Fixed a memory leak caused by not freeing the X509_NAME object when printing it fails.
Fixed the issue where the -async_jobs option in test mode reported an error when the system does not support asynchrony; it now returns success.
Fixed a possible memory leak in the list_tls_signatures function when the built-in signature algorithm list is an empty string.
Fixed a memory leak in s390x_HMAC_CTX_copy where the target context already had a buffer that was not freed.
Fixed error handling for missing compression methods in the client Hello, so that the correct alert code is now returned in accordance with the protocol specification.
Fixed the alert type returned when receiving an invalid Change Cipher Spec value in TLS 1.3, changed to SSL_AD_UNEXPECTED_MESSAGE conforming to RFC 8446.
Fixed SM2 private key decoding error, allowing SM2 private keys to be decoded using the id_ecPublicKey algorithm identifier, and added SM2 test cases.
Fixed the issue where TLS keys were not correctly reclaimed in the thread event handler function, adding cleanup operations on creation failure and release.

Fixed the digest validity check logic, correcting the erroneous conditions md_nid < 0 or md_nid <= 0 to md_nid == NID_undef, ensuring that DSA, ECDSA, and RSA signature providers correctly identify invalid digests.

Fixed boundary cases in password callback handling: reserve one byte at the end of the buffer for the null terminator, and verify that the length returned by the callback does not exceed the buffer size, preventing out-of-bounds access leading to crashes.
Fixed null pointer dereference and memory leak issues when EVP_MD_fetch() returns a null pointer in the PKCS#12 PBMAC1 implementation.

Added missing error messages for tag length validation in the AES-OCB algorithm; when the tag length exceeds the maximum value, an invalid pointer is passed in encryption mode, or the custom tag length does not match the context, a clear error code is now returned.
Fixed the duplicate engine reference issue in ossl_ec_key_dup, removing unnecessary engine initialization and assignment.
Fixed the issue where the output length was not validated and not correctly set in the RSASVE recovery operation, and added output length validation in the encapsulation operation.
Fixed the salt length parameter in TLS 1.3 HKDF key derivation, using the correct prevsecretlen instead of mdlen, avoiding potential errors or crashes.
Added ossl_prov_is_running checks to multiple FIPS provider functions, preventing output when the provider is in an error state.
Fixed a potential memory leak in the PKCS7_signatureVerify function, ensuring the abuf buffer is correctly freed on error paths.
Fixed a memory leak caused by sk_ASN1_UTF8STRING_push failure in the save_statusInfo function, adding release handling for duplicate strings.
Fixed a memory leak in the tls_parse_ctos_psk function where sess was not released on error paths.
Added the netinet/in.h header file inclusion in demos/sslecho/main.c to fix compilation errors on OpenBSD.
Modified the check logic in ssl/ssl_lib.c to treat the case where md size is 0 as an error.
Fixed compilation warnings in multiple demo programs and made them enableable via the enable-demos configuration option.
Fixed clang compilation warnings in multiple files in demos, including aesccm.c, aesgcm.c, quic-client-non-block.c, etc.
Fixed signal handling issues on the Windows platform in demos/bio/saccept.c.
Corrected the signedness type of addr_len in demos/sslecho/main.c to eliminate signedness differences.
Fix a memory leak on the error path in tls_provider_init() in test/tls-provider.c.
Fix unaligned access in the hash table fuzz test by using memcpy instead of direct extraction in fuzz/hashtable.c.
Correct the error library identifier from ERR_LIB_CMS to ERR_LIB_ESS in crypto/ess/ess_lib.c.
Add a cleanup jump label in test/threadpool_test.c to fix a memory leak.
Add a return value check for EVP_MD_get_size() in apps/rehash.c to avoid negative values and limit to not exceed EVP_MAX_MD_SIZE.
Handle both old and new format AID.params keys in providers/implementations/ciphers/cipher_rc2.c.
Add return value error checks for CRYPTO_atomic_load and CRYPTO_atomic_store calls in crypto/hashtable/hashtable.c.
Fix the thread availability error string in providers/implementations/kdfs/argon2.c to correctly display the requested number of threads and the available number of threads.

Remove the -MT option in Configurations/unix-Makefile.tmpl to fix the circular object dependency issue caused by duplicate output object file names when using -o and -MT with older GCC (e.g., GCC 4.1), and also fix makedepend for the nonstop platform.
Add a missing NULL check for prov_config_test in test/prov_config_test.c.
Call tear_down on the early exit path in the test_encode_tls_sct() function in test/ct_test.c.
Add a NULL check for the return value of CRYPTO_THREAD_lock_new() in test/threadstest.c to avoid null pointer dereference.
Replace snprintf with BIO_snprintf in test/quic_multistream_test.c to resolve the link error caused by snprintf being unavailable under VS2010.
Suppress spurious error output that still appears when the sysdefault test passes (test/recipes/90-test_sysdefault.t and test/sysdefaulttest.c).
Add explicit OP_SLEEP yield operations to support cooperative threads in the QUIC tests in test/quic_multistream_test.c.
Add a check for a NULL output pointer in the null_cipher function to avoid performing a memory copy operation when the output buffer is empty.
Change the type of digest_size from size_t to int in demos/digest/BIO_f_md.c and add a check for the return value of EVP_MD_get_size().
Fix compiler warnings in UEFI, BN, TLS client, and RISC-V capability detection code, including unused variables, GCC loop optimization, uninitialized variables, and function prototype issues.

Unify code consistency between crypto/threads_pthread.c and crypto/threads_win.c: unify uint64_t/LONG to uint32_t, fix the issue where the return value of atomic_or_uint_nv was incorrectly cast to int *, cast READER_COUNT and ID_VAL results to uint32_t, and align comments in threads_win.c with threads_pthread.c.

Change the KU_ constants to be defined via the corresponding X509v3_KU_ constants, add comments explaining the bit order, and mark X509v3_KU_UNDEF as deprecated. (Architecture-related: public API: constant definition changes and deprecation)

On Unix platforms, migrate the implementation of OSSL_sleep() from the obsolete usleep() to nanosleep(), while retaining the use of usleep() on DJGPP and TANDEM platforms, and providing the OPENSSL_USE_USLEEP macro as a fallback option. (Architecture-related: platform compatibility: OSSL_sleep migration to nanosleep)

Migrate the compression method stack from libssl's global variables to the OSSL library context, to eliminate the atexit call in libssl. (Architecture-related: architecture refactoring: compression method stack migration to OSSL library context)

Replace the compile-time default path macro with a runtime query API, and add unit tests for Windows registry key lookup. (Architecture-related: platform compatibility: default paths changed to runtime queries)

Move the KDF key check in the FIPS module from the derive function to the set_ctx_params function, ensuring that validation is performed when setting key parameters. (Architecture-related: FIPS module behavior change)
Remove the bypass capability of FIPS self-tests, delete the indicator-related validation logic, and ensure that self-tests must be executed. (Architecture-related: FIPS self-test behavior change)

Replace the EVP_MD_get_flags and EVP_MD_FLAG_XOF macros in the code with the new EVP_MD_xof() function call, and fix the boundary check of mdlen in PKCS1_MGF1 and the resource leak in cipher_test_init in the tests. (architecture-related: public API)

Rename the internal LIST_* macros to macros with the OSSL_ prefix (such as OSSL_LIST_*), to avoid conflicts with macros of the same name in BSD queue.h, involving include/internal/list.h, ssl/quic/quic_engine.c, ssl/quic/quic_port.c, and ssl/quic/quic_rcidm.c.

Optimize the handling logic of SSL_pending and SSL_has_pending in the QUIC protocol, fix the default stream creation behavior for zero-length writes, adjust the read wait function to support peek mode, and modify the write operation to return WANT_READ error when no data is written.
Remove unnecessary underscores in SSL alert description strings to keep them consistent with other alert description formats.
Refactor the atomic operation fallback implementation, implementing it separately by type to enhance type safety, and introduce the USE_ATOMIC_FALLBACKS macro for test builds.
Hide the -w option and its related output in non-Windows builds, and adjust the display format of directory paths.

In crypto/bn/bn_mod.c, crypto/sha/keccak1600.c, crypto/store/store_strings.c, engines/e_afalg.c, test/asn1_encode_test.c, test/bioprinttest.c, and test/sslapitest.c, replace manual array size calculations with the OSSL_NELEM() macro (i.e., ARRAY_SIZE).
In apps/lib/apps.c and crypto/pkcs12/p12_npas.c, remove the reception or invocation of unused return values.
In the ossl_rsa_multip_cap function in crypto/rsa/rsa_mp.c, remove the hardcoded value of cap.
In test/tls-provider.c, rename prov_ctx to xor_prov_ctx, and in ssl/tls13_enc.c modify variable names to enhance readability.
In ssl/d1_lib.c, ssl/ssl_local.h, and ssl/t1_lib.c, remove SSL_ENC_FLAG_EXPLICIT_IV which is only set but never read.
In crypto/threads_pthread.c, change inline to ossl_inline and clean up misaligned preprocessor directives.
Change the context data flag variable from a bit-field type to an integer type, and update the parameter types of the related setter functions.
Remove unimplemented librandom stub code, involving cleanup of Configure, INSTALL.md, crypto/info.c, and providers/implementations/rands/seeding/rand_unix.c.
In EVP_DecryptFinal_ex in crypto/evp/evp_enc.c, remove a dead store.
In ssl/ssl_conf.c, remove redundant >= 0 checks for block_padding and hs_padding, because strtoul already catches negative value input.
In ossl_ht_insert() in crypto/hashtable/hashtable.c, allow grow_hashtable() to iterate at most 4 times.
Remove the unused parent_dispatch field from the DRBG structure.
In apps/s_client.c, increase the read buffer size to 16 kiB (the maximum TLS record size), and use a fully allocated buffer for reading.
In ossl_rcu_write_lock/unlock in crypto/threads_pthread.c, add TSAN annotations so that the thread sanitizer considers no lock held on both the read and write sides, to eliminate RCU false positives.
In providers/implementations/signature/sm2_sig.c, split one if statement into two if statements to avoid calling EVP_MD_get_size() twice.

In the structure ssl_session_st, move the CRYPTO_REF_COUNT references field from after the verify_result field to the end of the structure, after the next pointer, and add a comment stating that access requires protection by ctx->lock; also update the comments for the prev/next pointers to note that access requires protection by ctx->lock.
In ssl/ssl_lib.c, remove libssl's use of stdio.h and sprintf.
In ossl_ht_delete in crypto/hashtable/hashtable.c, use ossl_rcu_deref for h->md with read-once semantics to prevent the value from being recomputed during the deletion operation.
In the FIPS allowed digest algorithm detection in providers/implementations/rands/drbg.c, remove the extra check for XOF digests, because XOF digests cannot exist among the whitelisted algorithms.
Extract the hexadecimal character conversion code from multiple files into a common implementation, adding include/internal/to_hex.h and using it in the crypto and ssl modules.
Remove the never-used event queue code and related test files from libssl, including ssl/event_queue.c, include/internal/event_queue.h, and test/event_queue_test.c.
Change the declarations of ed25519_digest_sign, ed448_digest_sign, ed25519_digest_verify, and ed448_digest_verify in eddsa_sig.c from non-static to static, to limit their scope to within the file.
In dsa_sig.c, ecdsa_sig.c, eddsa_sig.c, and sm2_sig.c under providers/implementations/signature/, delete the aid field from the signature provider context.
Add module path loading tests for OSSL_PROVIDER_load in test/prov_config_test.c and related test configurations, and skip the test if p_test.so does not exist.

Add a -chunk option to the evp_test test, supporting processing data in chunks of a specified size, and covering chunking logic in cipher, digest, signature, verification, encoding, and MAC tests, while also adding FIPS approved indicator checks.

Add session cache handling tests in test/sslapitest.c, verifying that the cache does not exceed the expected size when sessions are created repeatedly, and testing session behavior when the cache overflows.

In the multi_resume test in test/sslapitest.c, extend the simultaneous resumption scenario to test the case where the same session is resumed multiple times simultaneously and one of them is marked as not_resumable.
In test/threadstest.c, add locks to CRYPTO_atomic_add calls in the rw/rcu tests, change the counter to 64-bit to avoid overflow, and add a division-by-zero check.
In test/threadstest.c, disable RCU tests on macOS to avoid random failures on that platform.
Added fuzzers for attribute certificates, hash tables, and providers.
Move ossl_asn1_string_to_time_t() from crypto/asn1/a_time.c to test/testutil/helper.c; this function is used only for testing.
In test/sslapitest.c, use OSSL_TIME functions instead of direct arithmetic on time_t.
In test/crltest.c, extend test cases for different failure modes of PEM_ASN1_read_bio.
In test/hmactest.c, add more tests for multiple update calls to HMAC.
In test/lhash_test.c, add multithreaded hash table tests, and add the doc/internal/man3/ossl_ht_new.pod documentation.
In test/v3ext.c, fix a memory leak in the error path.
In test/sslapitest.c, ignore early data related test results when the test takes more than 7 seconds, to avoid intermittent failures due to timeouts.
In test/bad_dtls_test.c, add a check for EVP_MD_CTX_get_size() to avoid integer overflow when implicitly converting from int to size_t in evp_pkey_ctx_store_cached_data().
Add simple API tests for x509_acert, covering reading, printing, signing, and verification of attribute certificates.
In test/prov_config_test.c, perform cleanup and fix potential memory leaks.
In fuzz/decoder.c, also restrict the execution of EVP_PKEY_param_check for DHX keys.
Skip test cases that depend on X25519 and X448 in FIPS mode.
Remove tests for concurrent calls to OSSL_LIB_CTX_load_config.
Fixed a potential memory leak in test/bad_dtls_test.c.
In test/quic_multistream_test.c, skip the test when built with the PUT thread, and document this design assumption in NOTES-NONSTOP.md.
Fixed a memory leak in the error path of test/ecstresstest.c.
Fixed a memory leak in the error case of test/cmp_hdr_test.c.
Used correctly formatted ALPN data in ssl/quic/quic_tserver.c.

Added tests for ASN1_item_verify(), added the new certificate file test/certs/ee-self-signed-pss.pem, updated test/certs/setup.sh, and added the test script test/recipes/25-test_x509.t and tests in test/x509_test.c.

Added the test script test/recipes/60-test_x509_req.t and test/x509_req_test.c to verify that a malformed X509 request with the version field set to version 6 fails when reading data or when calling X509_REQ_verify.
Moved the PEM certificate in test/x509_req_test.c to the file test/certs/x509-req-detect-invalid-version.pem to make x509_req_test ANSI-compatible.
In test/x509_req_test.c, freed the certFilePath memory allocated by test_mk_file_path() and made that variable local to fix a memory leak.
In fuzz/decoder.c, lowered the limit for key checks to avoid timeouts on clusterfuzz.

In fuzz/quic-srtm.c, ensured that commands extracted from the fuzz buffer are always valid and reasonably distributed between 0 and 3 by using a modulo operation, avoiding timeouts caused by unbounded growth of the SRTM hash table.
In fuzz/quic-lcidm.c, limited the number of commands that can be used in a single file to avoid spurious timeouts due to too many commands.
Added RSA-{hash} tests for EVP_PKEY RSA sign and verify initialization, message signing, and recovery operations.

Added a FIPS indicator for TEST-RAND, which is always non-FIPS because it is used for internal tasks and is not validated; changes involve providers/implementations/rands/test_rng.c and util/perl/OpenSSL/paramnames.pm.

In tests, added FIPS indicator checks for MAC, KDF, and TEST-RAND: in evp_test.c, check the FIPS approved flag for MAC; add FIPS indicator tests for KDF and extend multiple evpkdf and evppkey_kdf test data files; add unit tests for the TEST-RAND FIPS indicator in rand_test.c and corresponding test scripts.

Fixed potential defects in three test code areas: in sslapitest.c, fixed a potential NULL pointer dereference; in bio_enc_test.c, fixed the issue where the return value of BIO_read was not checked for error conditions, causing fallback in length calculation; in evp_test.c, added a check for the return value of OSSL_PARAM_get_size_t.
In test/provider_test.c and test/provider_fallback_test.c, added OSSL_PROVIDER_unload() calls on failure of OSSL_PROVIDER_add_builtin() and test_provider(), respectively, to avoid memory leaks.
Modified KDF test data in evpkdf_ssh.txt, evpkdf_tls12_prf.txt, evpkdf_tls13_kdf.txt, and evpkdf_x963.txt to adapt to expected results after behavior changes.

Added the test files oversized_line.cnf and oversized_line.txt, and added a test scenario in the 04-test_conf.t test plan for configuration line lengths exceeding 512 characters that contain backslashes.
Added unit test data in evppkey_dsa.txt, evppkey_ecdsa.txt, evppkey_rsa.txt, and evppkey_sm2.txt for disallowed XOF digest algorithms.

In test/evp_test.c, move the creation of EVP_PKEY_CTX to keygen_test_run(), have keygen_test_parse() insert all values into KEYGEN_TEST_DATA, and change the 'Ctrl' parameter to use only settables instead of legacy controls; add EC keygen tests in evppkey_ecc.txt.
Update the EdDSA tests in test/recipes/30-test_evp_data/evppkey_ecx.txt to accommodate FIPS and non-prehash scenarios.
Add meaningful skip messages in test/sslapitest.c.

Modify the HKDF test code in test/evp_test.c so that EVP_PKEY_CTX_get_params() returns 1 instead of 0 when there is no gettable/getter, to fix failures when cross-testing with the 3.1.2 FIPS provider.
Correctly set the padding mode in acvp_test.
Limit large numbers to 128 bytes to avoid infinite loops in the fuzzer during extensive mathematical operations.
Check the length variable when reading in cmsapitest to prevent overflow of the returned length when extremely large files are passed via BIO.
Change the existing KeyGen Ctrls in evp_test to use provider algorithm parameter names.
Add missing FIPS version checks in rand_test.c and evprand.txt.
Add error reasons to the test data files for RSA, X9.42, SSHKDF, Single Step KDF, TLS 1.3 KDF, KMAC, HKDF, X9.63, TLS 1.2 PRF, PBKDF2, and TLS 1 PRF.
Add positive FIPS indicator failure tests for DRBG in evprand.txt.
Revert the change that skipped failing tests when the FIPS provider supports eddsa_no_verify_digested, restoring the original test behavior of test/cmp_protect_test.c.
Add initialization for the default greeting in test/provider_internal_test.c to avoid printing a null pointer.
Revert the change in test/evp_test.c that made "FIPSversion" skip the default provider.
Update the new FIPS indicator tests in multiple evp test data files to use the FIPSversion option in combination with the Availablein option.
In fuzz/hashtable.c, allow the case where rc == -1 during insertion to be normal when fuzzing.
Avoid running SM2 tests with the 3.0.0 FIPS provider in test/endecode_test.c.

Add test/bio_pw_callback_test.c and related test data to add tests for the BIO password callback functionality, covering scenarios such as negative return values, zero-length passwords, passwords that fill the buffer, incorrectly reported lengths, and binary passwords containing null bytes.
Fix the !fips v3.0.0 check in test/endecode_test.c to fix the issue where SM2 tests were not run when the FIPS provider was not loaded.
Remove redundant non-negative checks for unsigned values in test/bio_base64_test.c.
Avoid null pointer dereference in test/cmp_vfy_test.c.
Adjust tests in test/evp_libctx_test.c to obtain output lengths for EVP_PKEY_encap and EVP_PKEY_decap.
Add SSKDF KMAC tests, FIPS indicator tests, and short salt length tests for Single Step KDF in test/recipes/30-test_evp_data/evpkdf_ss.txt and providers/common/include/prov/fipscommon.h.
Add testmode option to speed application in apps/speed.c, running each speed test iteration once and returning error code on failure.

In test/bio_pw_callback_test.c, refactor password variables from char* to const char[] arrays, use sizeof instead of predefined lengths, and rename key_password to weak_password; also replace global variables in callback tests with local structures containing magic number and result flag.
Change public key validation for known safe prime groups to partial validation to avoid unnecessary full validation overhead. (Architectural event: Providers_Implementation module change)

Optimized the performance of the ChaCha20 stream cipher on the RISC-V platform, accelerating it by using both the scalar ALU and the vector ALU, and added an implementation that uses only vector instructions (without relying on the Zvkb extension); the runtime scheduling logic was also adjusted accordingly to prioritize the Zvkb version. (Architecture-related: Platform compatibility: RISC-V)

Added HMAC hardware acceleration support for s390x platform, using CPACF instruction KMAC to accelerate SHA-224, SHA-256, SHA-384, and SHA-512 algorithms, with performance improvement up to two times. (architecture-related: platform compatibility: s390x)

Introduced new modifier bits for CPACF SHA3/SHAKE instructions on s390x platform, and conditionally skip ICV initialization to optimize short message processing performance while maintaining backward compatibility. (architecture-related: platform compatibility: s390x)
Enabled loop unrolling and EOR3 optimization for SHA3 on Ampere processors. (Architecture-related: Platform compatibility: Ampere)
Enabled AES-XTS optimization on AIX systems. (Architecture-related: Platform compatibility: AIX)

Optimized SSL certificate loading performance by using hash table instead of linear search for certificate name deduplication in SSL_add_file_cert_subjects_to_stack and SSL_add_dir_cert_subjects_to_stack, significantly improving speed when loading large numbers of certificates. (Architecture-related: public API: SSL certificate loading)

Optimized handling of conflicting entries during lock-free reads of hash table, using entire hash table instead of only neighborhood for lookup, and updated related tests to support lock-free read mode. (Architecture-related: core hash table implementation)

Allow group methods to customize initialization, and add precomputation implementation for P256 curve, avoiding expensive Montgomery arithmetic structure initialization, thereby significantly accelerating TLS handshake.

Optimized the public key check function to skip unnecessary expensive calculations when the cofactor is 1, because the point being on the curve already implies that the scalar multiple point is at infinity.
Fixed memory leaks on error paths in make_addressPrefix() in crypto/x509/v3_addr.c; fixed memory leaks on error paths after copying or creating a module STACK_OF in crypto/conf/conf_mod.c.
Fixed Coverity-found memory leaks and use-after-free issues in test/evp_test.c.
Performance improvements in crypto/hashtable/hashtable.c; set the hash table bucket count to 2048 in crypto/core_namemap.c.

Upgraded the FIPS provider's security check mechanism: changed configurable security checks to use FIPS indicators and always execute them, while disabling DSA signing in the FIPS provider and adding corresponding indicator checks. (Architectural event: FIPS indicator mechanism change)
Prohibited DSA key generation in the FIPS provider, implemented via FIPS indicators. (Architectural event: FIPS indicator mechanism change)
In FIPS mode, restricted EC key generation to only allow curves with security strength not less than 112 bits, and added FIPS indicators. (Architectural event: FIPS indicator mechanism change)
Added a validity check on the digest size in the OSSL_STORE_SEARCH_by_key_fingerprint function to prevent integer overflow. (architecture-related: public API)
Added the enable-pie configuration option to support building position-independent executables to enhance ASLR security. (architecture-related: build and installation methods)

Made the BN_generate_dsa_nonce function implement constant-time and unbiased random number generation, and added related internal helper functions. (Architecture-related: constant-time implementation)
Changed the ossl_gen_deterministic_nonce_rfc6979 function to a constant-time implementation, eliminating timing side-channel risks. (Architecture-related: public API constant-time implementation)
Added strength parameter passing in the bnrand_range function to support more secure random number generation. (architecture-related: public API parameter change)
In the FIPS module, changed memory deallocation for multiple key functions to clear-then-free, complying with ISO 19790. (Architecture-related: public API security compliance)
Optimized the computation of shared powers of 2 in BN_gcd, using a constant-time approach, and added a constant-time selection function. (Architecture-related: constant-time implementation)
On Windows platforms, return UNDEFINED when WININSTALLCONTEXT is not defined to avoid security risks. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)
Added a version number check in the CSR verification function, rejecting certificate requests with version numbers not equal to 1. (architecture-related: public API behavior change)
Add validation in the client ALPN extension parsing that the server-selected protocol is among the client's originally advertised list. (architecture-related: external behavior)
Prohibit RSA encryption from using PKCS#1 v1.5 padding in FIPS mode. (architecture-related: FIPS mode encryption behavior)
Restrict the salt length of RSA-PSS in the FIPS provider and add corresponding validation logic. (architecture-related: FIPS provider RSA-PSS salt length restriction)
Harden the BN_GF2m_poly2arr function, reject invalid polynomials, fix the return value semantics, and add tests. (architecture-related: public API: BN_GF2m_poly2arr return value semantics fix)
Force the OpenSSL internal DRBG to use a derivation function to meet FIPS validation requirements. (architecture-related: FIPS compliance: DRBG uses derivation function)
Harden the handling of unrecoverable sessions to prevent accidental use of unrecoverable sessions.
Add a check on the return value of the digest size retrieval function in the RSA signature implementation to prevent integer overflow.
Add a check and type conversion for the return value of EVP_MD_get_size() in the hmac_drbg_kdf_set_ctx_params function to avoid integer overflow.
Add checks on the return value of EVP_MD_get_size() in RSA signature, verification, control, and PSS initialization functions to avoid integer overflow.
Add checks on the return value of EVP_MD_get_size() in DSA signature and verification functions to avoid integer overflow.
Add lower-bound checks for plaintext and ciphertext in RSA no-padding mode, conforming to the SP800-56Br2 specification.
Fix a type error in certificate name checking to prevent a denial-of-service vulnerability (CVE-2024-6119).
Fix a heap buffer overflow caused by shrinking during hash table iteration, by temporarily setting the load factor to 0 to prevent shrinking.
Fix a potential integer underflow in the RSA OAEP padding check caused by not validating that the digest length return value is negative.
Fix a potential overflow of the length value in asn1parse_main due to loop reading of BIO, and add an overflow check.
Add an integer overflow check during length accumulation in the i2d_name_canon function.
Fix a potential integer overflow issue in the do_print_ex function by adding an overflow check for the output length calculation.
Fix an integer overflow issue in the RSA-PSS salt length calculation, add validity checks, and set the verification message flag in FIPS mode.
Allow customizing the FIPS provider vendor name prefix via the FIPS_VENDOR field in VERSION.dat, replacing the previous code patching approach.
Update CHANGES.md and NEWS.md in preparation for the upcoming release.
Add a regression test case in test/recipes/30-test_evp_data/evppkey_ecc.txt with a special private key that triggers CVE-2011-4354.
Extend the SSL_free_buffers test in test/sslbuffertest.c to cover behavior when buffers should not be freed and pipeline usage scenarios.
Move the helper function for loading the dasync engine from sslapitest.c to the common files ssltestlib.c and ssltestlib.h so that sslbuffertest can reuse the pipeline testing capability.

Change the digest_length type in demos/digest/EVP_MD_demo.c and EVP_MD_stdin.c from unsigned to int to avoid implicit conversion when EVP_MD_get_size() returns a negative number and subsequent checks leading to integer overflow.
Add a link to the documentation policy in the contribution guide to help contributors understand documentation writing standards.
Synchronously update CHANGES.md and NEWS.md to record changes for OpenSSL 3.4, including new features, improvements, FIPS 140-3 indicators, and removal of obsolete entries.
Update the Valgrind usage documentation, improve list formatting, add hyperlinks, and update command substitution syntax to the $() form.

Update documentation for the crl and req commands to state that the -verify option exits with exit code 1 on verification failure and is implicitly enabled when -CApath, -CAfile, or -CAstore is specified.
Update Windows platform documentation to state that OPENSSLDIR, ENGINESDIR, and MODULESDIR paths can be defined via the registry at runtime, and add a summary table of registry behavior.
Add badges for daily checks and provider compatibility status in the README.
Record the CVE-2024-6119 security fix in the CHANGES and NEWS documents.
Add a security advisory entry for CVE-2024-5535 in the CHANGES and NEWS documents.
Add missing links in NEWS.md for the OpenSSL 3.4 version section.
Add comments for RSA KEM encapsulation and decapsulation operations stating that the outlen parameter must report the length of the output buffer to ensure the buffer size is sufficient.
Improve the description of newline handling in BIO_f_base64.pod and openssl-enc.pod.in.
Add a new design document doc/designs/fips_indicator.md explaining FIPS indicator requirements.
Fix the string_mask documentation in openssl-req.pod.in to be consistent with actual software behavior.
Fix the documentation description in INSTALL.md regarding the FIPS HMAC key.
Add the design document doc/designs/handling-some-max-defines.md, discussing the handling of some MAX macro definitions.
Clarify in openssl-storeutl.pod.in the purpose of the -keys option.
Add future OpenSSL release keys to doc/fingerprints.txt.
Supplement the installation documentation in INSTALL.md, and add NOTES-ANSI.md and NOTES-POSIX.md to explain ANSI C and POSIX related considerations.
Document that SHAKE-128 and SHAKE-256 no longer have a default digest length, and the xoflen parameter must be set before use.
Add the SSL_set_session_secret_cb() function documentation SSL_set_session_secret_cb.pod, and add corresponding entries in build.info, missingssl.txt, and other.syms.
Update CHANGES.md in sync with the 3.3 branch.
Supplement documentation for the RFC 9579 PBMAC1 in PKCS#12 implementation, adding manual pages such as PBMAC1_get1_pbkdf2_param.pod and PKCS12_gen_mac.pod, and update related build files.
Update the documentation for the openssl-version command, correcting the description of the -w option and adding historical notes.
Clarify in openssl-s_client.pod.in and openssl-s_server.pod.in that the supported curves (groups) include named EC parameters, X25519, X448, and FFDHE groups.
Add the CMAC_CTX.pod manual page, documenting the deprecated CMAC_CTX functions and their EVP_MAC replacement interfaces, and update build.info, missingcrypto.txt, and other.syms.

Revise the passing-algorithmidentifier-parameters.md design document, extending the AlgorithmIdentifier parameter passing mechanism to support obtaining the full AlgorithmIdentifier, and update EVP_EncryptInit.pod and paramnames.pm.
Add links in openssl-ca.pod.in and openssl-dgst.pod.in pointing to the location where signature options are defined.
Fix detailed descriptions in multiple man1 and man3 documents regarding IPv6 host addresses and whitespace character handling in no_proxy.
Add the Dockerfile, README.md, and run_endpoint.sh needed for generating QUIC interoperability containers.
Document the new -testmode option of the speed command in openssl-speed.pod.in.

In the openssl-s_client documentation, add an explanation of the connection premature closure issue that may occur when using `s_client` in non-interactive environments (such as cron jobs), and guide the use of the `-ign_eof` option and input redirection to handle stdin and complete TLS session data exchange, while also noting that `-ign_eof` may cause infinite hanging in SMTP and HTTP/1.1 scenarios and the solution to that problem.
In the openssl-fipsinstall documentation, supplement the HISTORY section added in 3.0+ versions, as well as the command-line options added in 3.1+, 3.2+, and 3.4+ versions.
Added CPACF feature codes and their required MSA level macro definitions for the s390x architecture. (Architecture-related: Platform compatibility: s390x CPACF support)

Fixed the remaining issue of build failure on RISC-V platforms due to missing OPENSSL_CPUID_OBJ check, adding the macro condition in the conditional compilation of multiple AES hardware implementations. (Architecture-related: Platform compatibility: RISC-V build fix)

Fixed multiple build issues on VMS platforms, including replacing incompatible function calls, adding necessary macro definitions, and handling compiler warnings. (Architecture-related: Platform compatibility: VMS build fix)

Moved the macro definitions of _XOPEN_SOURCE and _XOPEN_SOURCE_EXTENDED from source files to configuration targets to avoid conflicts with definitions on other platforms. (Architecture-related: Build configuration: _XOPEN_SOURCE macro definition migration)

Removed all references to FLOSS in NonStop builds because the SPT thread model build is deprecated and FLOSS is no longer a dependency. (Architecture-related: Platform compatibility: NonStop build dependency change)
Fixed VS2010 compilation errors by replacing static inline with the ossl_inline macro for compatibility with older compilers. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)
Added a type definition for uintptr_t for the UEFI platform. (architecture-related: public API)

Adapted all exporter files to use the new variables in util/mkinstallvars.pl, enabling pkg-config files to better utilize relative directory values. (architecture-related: build and installation methods)

Modified the path retrieval function on Windows platforms, removing fallback handling for OPENSSLDIR, ENGINESDIR, and MODULESDIR, directly using macro definitions, and changing the default return value of ossl_get_wininstallcontext to UNDEFINED. Also fixed the incorrect WININSTALLCONTEXT macro in the Windows CI configuration. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)

Updated the Windows registry key path to be based on the major and minor version numbers instead of the full version string, allowing patch versions to share the same key. Also added a registry key setting step in the Windows CI workflow and added unit tests to verify the registry key lookup functionality. (architecture-related: version and compatibility)

Fixed the issue where the directory resolution became empty in the CMake export configuration due to environment variable name changes, updating the variable names to match the new build information. (Architecture-related: CMake export configuration)

Fixed the incorrect calculation of the internal variable _ossl_prefix in the OpenSSLConfig.cmake.in template so that it works correctly under build configurations. (Architecture-related: CMake export configuration)

Fixed and synchronized the CMake and pkg-config export configurations to correctly include the include directory when the build directory is separated from the source directory, and unified variable naming. (architecture-related: build and installation methods)
Added NO_INTERLOCKEDOR64 macro detection for 32-bit MinGW builds to fix build failures. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)
Add a build configuration for the Windows platform that enables FIPS and disables the thread pool and QUIC. (Architecture-related: Windows build configuration)
Add 3.3 and 3.2 branches to the Coveralls build configuration.

Modify the macro definitions for the ANSI C compatibility check in the GitHub CI workflow, replacing `_DEFAULT_SOURCE` with `_XOPEN_SOURCE=1` and `_POSIX_SOURCE=200809L` to support the use of `timezone`, `ssize_t`, and `strdup()`.
Add support for macOS 14 (M1) runners in the CI workflow, and convert some jobs to a matrix strategy to run on both macOS 13 and macOS 14.
Add the -mxgot compilation option for m68k cross-compilation to resolve relocation truncation issues.
Downgrade the upload-artifact and download-artifact actions in GitHub Actions from v4 to v3 for compatibility with GitHub Enterprise Server.
For CI builds on the hppa architecture, lower the optimization level from -O2 to -O1 to avoid random crashes that may be caused by the compiler or emulator.
Remove the macOS-11 runner environment from the CI configuration in response to GitHub's upcoming end of support for that system.
Under specific build configurations, change the random seed source name to use a macro definition to support running all tests with the JITTER seed source in CI.
Add OpenSSL 3.4 version support to the provider compatibility tests and prov-compat-label tests in CI.

Convert the example programs in the demos directory to be managed by the main build system, add build.info files in multiple demos subdirectories, enable demos builds in the CI workflow, and disable the Windows build of the http3 demo due to linking issues with the nghttp3 library on Windows.

Modify the GitHub CI workflow to fix artifact upload issues for parameterized jobs, package multiple artifacts into a single archive before uploading, move the artifact upload code into a shell script, and experimentally support uploading qlog artifacts.
Add a debuginfo build target to separate DWARF debug information from shared libraries into separate files on Unix platforms.
Fix check_format.pl's detection of single-statement `if` statements with braces but no else.
Fix the nested quoting issue in the jitter test in the GitHub workflow, and allow direct specification of string names.
Fix the extra space in the error message of openssl fipsinstall to make its format consistent with the success message.
Skip compiling DSA speed test support when DSA support is not needed in the library, consistent with how other algorithms are handled.
Fix the issue in the GitHub workflow where an extra `$` character in an expression caused it to always be true.
Add a static analysis workflow for local Coverity Connect.
Added a Provider compatibility PR CI job.
Fixed the use of environment variables in the Windows CI workflow to conform to PowerShell syntax.
Modified the os-zoo CI workflow to enable IPv6 builds when the container supports it, to fix test issues caused by the newly added IPv6 in Alpine containers.
Disabled the default case check (`-Wno-switch-default`) for clang 18 in the os-zoo CI workflow to resolve CI failures caused by many switch statements lacking a default case.
Fixed compatibility issues with sed/awk commands in Windows CI by switching to PowerShell commands to extract version numbers.
Removed the no longer needed `-Wno-switch-default` compilation option from os-zoo.yml.
