Added a code style check workflow that only evaluates modified lines in changed files of a commit, with support for exemption via the `style:exempted` label; a subsequent update made the workflow use check-format-commit.sh to check the entire commit range of a PR, allowing style fixes as separate commits.
Modified the windows_comp.yml workflow to run openssl after the build completes.
Added a workflow to automatically deploy docs.openssl.org when documentation changes.
Added the `enable-weak-ssl-ciphers` configuration option to the full_featured CI job.
Added a GitHub Actions workflow to build QUIC interoperability containers nightly and push them to quay.
Disabled parallel test execution in the coveralls.yml workflow.
Added debug information generation tests to the CI configuration, installing gdb and verifying debuginfo file loading.
Moved QUIC interoperability Docker related files from the interop/quic-openssl-docker directory to the test/quic-openssl-docker directory.
Upgraded actions/download-artifact from 3 to 4.1.7 in .github/workflows, and synchronously updated actions/upload-artifact to maintain compatibility.
Reduced the footprint of Windows CI.
Made the 'Cleanup artifact' step in fips-label.yml conditional like the other steps.
Upgraded coverallsapp/github-action from 2.3.0 to 2.3.2 in coveralls.yml.
Combined no-ec2m with enable-fips configuration in run-checker-merge.yml.
Included the <sys/types.h> header in e_os2.h to correctly use the POSIX type ssize_t. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)
Defined deprecation macros for OpenSSL version 3.4. (architecture-related: version and compatibility)
Replaced multiple sprintf() calls with BIO_snprintf() and added buffer size parameters to avoid compiler warnings and improve code security. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)
Added the no-fips-post configuration option to disable self-tests of the OpenSSL FIPS provider.
Removed extra spaces in error message output.
Fixed typos in comments and adjusted blank lines to conform to code style.
Deleted the old PGP key fingerprint; the new key information is included in the documentation.
Added comp.h to .gitignore.
Added a comment in DRBG seed generation explaining that the legacy code path is only for compatibility with legacy applications and will not be called in normal use.
Fixed extra blank lines in apps/speed.c.
Upgraded the version of the actions/setup-python dependency used in CI.
Fixed code style issues in EVP-related header files.
Added an ignore rule for the macOS system file .DS_Store in .gitignore.
Adjusted code style in hashtable.c, standardizing spaces around macro definitions and operators.
Fixed coding style issues in crypto/evp/evp_err.c.
Avoided an infinite loop in ossl_ht_insert() in crypto/hashtable/hashtable.c.
Removed the inclusion of unistd.h in demos/bio/sconnect.c and demos/sslecho/main.c on the Windows platform, and replaced getline with fgets in demos/sslecho/main.c.
Renamed the macro WININSTALLCONTEXT to OSSL_WINCTX.
Added a (void) cast to explicitly ignore the return value of ossl_quic_rxfc_on_retire() in ssl/quic/quic_stream_map.c.
Replaced strnlen() with the portable OPENSSL_strnlen() in fuzz/provider.c.
Handled the case where OPENSSL_strdup may return a null pointer in apps/rehash.c.
Explicitly include e_os.h in crypto/rand/randfile.c to use close().
Upgrade actions/download-artifact from 4.1.7 to 4.1.8 in .github/workflows.
Fix the syntax of .github/dependabot.yml.
Include .ctags.d in the tarball in .gitattributes.
Upgrade coverallsapp/github-action from 2.2.3 to 2.3.0 in coveralls.yml.
Ignore the newly generated header file include/openssl/x509_acert.h in .gitignore.
In fuzz/decoder.c, limit key sizes during execution checks, restricting DH safe prime checks to 8192 bits and private key and pairwise checks to 16384 bits.
Fix comment errors in multiple source files, including spelling, grammar, and content errors.
Fix multiple spelling and grammar errors in documentation and help messages.
Document the new debuginfo Makefile target in CHANGES.md.
fix: let util/mkbuildinf.pl use SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH, even if it's zero
Fix big-endian Power10 chacha20 implementation
Fix no-thread-pool build on Windows

Missing .rodata for AVX2/AVX512 codepaths
Fix compile err when building VC-CLANG-WIN64-CLANGASM-ARM target
Update krb5 to latest master to pick up CVE fixes
fipsmodule.cnf: set the signature digest checks option on installation
fips: install with the kbkdf key check option set
fix: util/mkinstallvars.pl mistreated LDLIBS on Unix (and Windows)
Allow shared iOS builds
Configure: Remove -Wswitch-default from strict warnings
Add aix-clang and aix64-clang configuration
MASM: Need to strip arguments after .pdata or .xdata
Give util/mkinstallvars.pl more fine grained control over var dependencies
Configure: make absolutedir() use rel2abs() on Windows too
VMS: Redefine _XOPEN_SOURCE_EXTENDED with the value 1
fix crash in ecp_nistz256_point_add_affine()
Implement riscv_vlen_asm for riscv32
chacha-riscv64-v-zbb.pl: better format
chacha-riscv64-v-zbb.pl: add comment about vector register allocation
Add linux-arm64ilp32-clang target
updated to oqs-provider 0.6.0
Add an Apple privacy info file for OpenSSL
Unable to run asm code on OpenBSD (amd64)
extend x86_64-xlate.pl perlasm so it can handle .rodata sections properly

Add QUIC object base types and QUIC Domain SSL object definitions, including core functions such as object initialization, engine/port/SSL object retrieval, and blocking mode support, providing infrastructure for QUIC support. (Architectural event: SslProtocolStack module adds QUIC support)

Add the SLH-DSA post-quantum signature algorithm module, supporting signing, verification, key generation and import, and update related function comments and test code. (architecture-related: public API)

Remove the obsolete header file include/openssl/asn1_mac.h, which has been deprecated and may affect backward compatibility for code that depends on it. (Architectural event: remove public header asn1_mac.h)
Move the SSL object unpacking macro to a separate header file and introduce QUIC_OBJ as the public header for QUIC objects. (architecture-related: public API)

Refactored the QUIC context (QCTX) to support listener and domain type SSL objects, added APIs to get listener and domain, and moved the locking mechanism from the channel level to the domain level. (architecture-related: public API)

Centralize time override handling from QUIC connections into the QUIC engine and unify the setting interface; time overrides can now be set on any QUIC SSL object. (architecture-related: external behavior)

Before creating a QUIC channel, the port creates a QRX object to perform AEAD validation on initial packets; after validation passes, the channel is created and the pre-created QRX is passed to the channel constructor. (architecture-related: external behavior)
Move the SSL error string loading functionality from libssl to libcrypto, allowing libssl to be safely unloaded without dangling references. (architecture-related: module responsibility)

The storage of polynomials in the ML-DSA key is changed from arrays to pointers, the vector and matrix initialization logic is adjusted, a signature initialization function is added, and the pre-shared key setup interface is refactored. (architecture-related: public API)

On the s390x platform, the probing of crypto cards for ME/CRT offloading is deferred from the initialization phase to the first actual ME/CRT operation; if ioctl returns ENODEV, the global flag OPENSSL_s390xcex_nodev is set to disable subsequent offloading attempts, and if ENOTTY is returned, the file descriptor is marked as no longer used and is not closed at termination.
Enable AES and SHA3 optimizations on macOS systems with Apple Silicon M4 chips.
Add AVXIFMA ISA support for Intel Sierra Forest CPU, optimizing RSA exponentiation operations. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)
Remove the legacy ASN1 method table for SLH-DSA, switch to custom encoders for DER decoding, and add a function to obtain the signature length.
Integrate the encoding/decoding implementations of ML-KEM and ML-DSA, extracting duplicate code and data structures into a shared module.
Add a function in the FIPS module to detect whether self-tests are running.

Add a new QUIC listener SSL object type and complete API, including creation, accepting connections, getting queue length, listening, blocking connection acceptance, discarding pending connections, and getting the listener object. (Architectural event: QUIC listener API added)

Added QUIC Domain SSL objects and related APIs, including creation, release, getting domain objects, creating connections from listeners, and supporting domain flags configuration via SSL_CTX_set_domain_flags. (Architectural event: QUIC Domain API added)
Add OS notifier functionality to the RIO subsystem, and improve socket error handling and resource cleanup on Windows platforms. (Architectural event: RIO notifier added)

Integrate an inter-thread notification mechanism into the QUIC reactor, supporting waking up blocked waiting threads via a notification file descriptor in multi-threaded scenarios, and allowing notification scheduling when tick results are merged. (Architectural event: QUIC reactor thread notification)

Added QUIC blocking operation support: the reactor layer adds external registration blocking operation functions (enter/leave blocking regions), and the application layer adds APIs to get the notifier file descriptor and blocking regions. (Architectural event: QUIC blocking operation support)
Modify SSL_poll to support blocking QUIC objects, and add QUIC polling translation and cleanup functions. (Architectural event: SSL_poll supports QUIC blocking)
Add blocking mode support for QUIC objects, and add null pointer checks to enhance robustness. (Architectural event: QUIC object blocking mode)

Added a random number generation API in the FIPS provider, and introduced RAND_set1_random_provider() to support replacement by an external random provider, while implementing the FIPS 140-3 CRNG test. (Architectural event: OpenSSL_Core_Headers module change)

Added poll builder module and QUIC polling mechanism, supporting immediate-mode polling API and third-party QUIC stack reuse of TLS implementation. (Architectural event: SslProtocolStack module change)
Added EVP pipeline encryption API, including initialization, update, and final processing functions. (Architectural event: OpenSSL_Core_Headers module change)

Implemented QUIC server address validation based on retry packets, including sending retry packets, generating validation tokens, binding new connections, and updating the channel creation logic to support retry packets. (Architectural event: SslProtocolStack module change (QUIC))
Added support for the 512 and 1024 variants of ML-KEM, and optimized the API and internal implementation. (Architectural event: new ML-KEM header file)
Added the public flag SSL_LISTENER_FLAG_NO_VALIDATE for QUIC listeners, allowing address validation to be skipped. (Architectural event: OpenSSL_Core_Headers module change)

Added support for the ML-KEM algorithm, including self-tests, DER encoders/decoders, text encoders, and key management parameters, and added alias names without hyphens. (Architectural event: new ML-KEM header file)
Added public endian load and store functions, supporting read and write of 16/32/64-bit unsigned integers. (Architectural event: new byteorder.h header file)

Implemented a flexible encoder for ML-DSA, supporting two private key formats (seed and expanded key), refactored the key management, encoding/decoding, and parameter retrieval interfaces, and added support for the ML-DSA-87 parameter set. (architectural event: ML-DSA encoder and key management refactoring)

Added the CMS_NO_SIGNING_TIME flag, allowing creation of CMS SignedData signatures without the signing time attribute, and added the -no_signing_time option to the cms command-line tool. (architecture-related: public API)
Added support for X.509v3 extensions, including authorityAttributeIdentifier, roleSpecCertIdentifier, and attributeDescriptor. (architecture-related: public API)
Added central key generation support for the CMP protocol, including client options and server-side processing logic. (architecture-related: public API)
Stopped probing for getentropy(3) on FreeBSD, unconditionally using getrandom(2) instead, and retained a fallback for older versions. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)
Added OID definitions related to TCG (Trusted Computing Group) and platform certificates. (architecture-related: public API)
Add error codes and corresponding error descriptions for entropy source continuous test failures. (architecture-related: public API)
Added the sslkeylog configuration option, disabled by default; when enabled, key logs are recorded according to the SSLKEYLOGFILE environment variable. (architecture-related: configuration interface)
Added PROVIDER and QUERY trace categories, added QUERY trace points in the method store, and updated tests to support the new categories. (architecture-related: public API)
Added the EVP_get1_default_properties function to retrieve the default property string for a specified library context. (architecture-related: public API)
Added support for the X.509v3 timeSpecification extension. (architecture-related: public API)
Added support for an internal jitter entropy source for the random number seed source in the FIPS provider. (Architecture-related: FIPS provider)
Increased the maximum response length limit for CRL downloads from 100KB to 32MB. (architecture-related: public API)

Made the internal parameter printing function public as the API function OSSL_PARAM_print_to_bio, and updated the implementation of provider-related internal functions. (architecture-related: public API)

Added the digest_copyctx function for EVP_MD, optimized the performance of EVP_MD_CTX_copy_ex, implemented this function in the default provider, updated documentation, and added test cases. (architecture-related: public API)

Added support for the DEFAULT keyword and the '-' prefix to the SSL_CTX_set1_groups_list() function, allowing specification of default groups or removal of specific groups in the group list, and fixed related error handling. (architecture-related: public API)
Added the X509_VERIFY_PARAM_get_purpose() function to retrieve the purpose value of verification parameters. (architecture-related: public API)

Added support for the SLH-DSA post-quantum signature algorithm, including complete functionality such as key generation, signature verification, public key loading, encoders/decoders, FIPS support, and self-tests. (architecture-related: public API)

Added support for the ML-KEM-768 post-quantum key encapsulation mechanism algorithm, including underlying operations, public API, Provider interface, and TLS group registration. (architecture-related: public API)

Implemented the QUIC version negotiation retry mechanism, including the server sending the RETRY_SCID parameter, the packager accepting version parameters, and the client retrying the connection based on the server's version list. (Architecture-related: QUIC version negotiation)
Improved the QUIC header decoding function by adding a failure reason output parameter to distinguish version mismatch from other decoding errors. (architecture-related: public API)
Added macro definitions for the maximum number of pipeline stages in the cipher pipeline in the EVP header file. (architecture-related: public API)
Added the EVP_MAC_init_SKEY function to support initializing MAC contexts via EVP_SKEY, and refactored MAC algorithm registration and error handling logic. (architecture-related: public API)
Forced the FIPS 3.0.9 provider callback to use the jitter entropy source, and added entropy retrieval functions between the core and the provider. (architecture-related: FIPS compatibility)
Added full support for the ML-DSA digital signature algorithm, including key generation, signing, and verification functions. (architecture-related: added ML-DSA algorithm)

Added a hybrid KEM provider for ML-KEM and ECDHE, supporting four hybrid groups (X25519+ML-KEM-768, X448+ML-KEM-1024, P-256+ML-KEM-768, P-384+ML-KEM-1024), and added a function to list TLS groups. (architecture-related: hybrid KEM provider)
Enhanced QUIC port binding functionality, supporting connection establishment without odcid, and added address validation control flags. (architecture-related: public API)
Implemented the SSL_new_from_listener() function to create QUIC connection objects from a listener. (architecture-related: public API)
Extended OPENSSL_ia32cap to support more CPUID bits and increased the environment variable buffer size. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)

Added the ossl_rand_pool_adin_mix_in function to XOR additional input into the existing entropy of the random pool, and refactored the related random pool entropy mixing logic. (architecture-related: public API)
Added support for multiple X.509v3 extensions: attributeMappings, allowedAttributeAssignments, aAissuingDistributionPoint. (architecture-related: public API)
Added the QUIC callback function SSL_CTX_set_new_pending_conn_cb to notify newly created SSL objects awaiting acceptance, and support for SSL object pre-allocation. (architecture-related: public API)

Added QUIC NEW_TOKEN token generation and cache management functionality, including public APIs to create and manage the token cache, and optimized the sending strategy. (architecture-related: public API)
Added support for the ML-DSA-44 and ML-DSA-87 algorithms, and fixed data encoding issues on big-endian systems. (architecture-related: public API)
Added DER encoders for public and private keys and text output functions for ML-DSA keys, and refactored the related encoders for ML-KEM and SLH-DSA. (architecture-related: public API)
Added new OID definitions for the post-quantum cryptographic algorithms ML-KEM, ML-DSA, and SLH-DSA. (architecture-related: public API)
Added the EVP_SKEY secret key management interface, supporting operations such as key generation, import, export, reference counting, and query. (architecture-related: public API)
libssl now accepts any key management that implements the group, no longer restricted to a specific provider. (architecture-related: public API)
Made the quic-tls API work correctly even when QUIC is not enabled, adjusted error handling logic, and added configuration functions. (architecture-related: public API)
Added support for QUIC token functionality, including NEW_TOKEN frame processing, token cache allocation, and initial token lookup and verification. (architecture-related: QUIC protocol)
Support setting, getting, and boolean querying of provider configuration parameters, and added related APIs and command-line support. (architecture-related: public API)
Improved import and export of ML-KEM keys, supporting ASN.1 private key format and the retain_seed parameter. (architecture-related: public API)
Added support for the ML-DSA digital signature algorithm, including key management, signing, FIPS integration, and self-tests. (architecture-related: new algorithm support)
Support multiple key shares, extended the group list definition, and updated the key_share extension handling logic on both client and server sides. (architecture-related: TLS protocol)
Make the provider context available in encoders, and added the PEM_ASN1_write_bio_ctx function to support passing the provider context. (architecture-related: public API)
Added ML-DSA key generation self-tests for the FIPS module. (architecture-related: public API)
The EVP_CIPHER_CTX_get_block_size function now allows a NULL ctx parameter and returns 0, and the related documentation was updated. (architecture-related: public API)
Separated the ML-KEM encoding and decoding code into independent files, added support for seed/key preference decoding, and updated related documentation. (architecture-related: public API)
Added a generic key management implementation for the default provider, supporting import, export, and encryption operations for symmetric keys. (architecture-related: public API)

Added gettable and settable context parameters for the ML-DSA signature algorithm, and added algorithm identifier serialization functions needed for generating X.509 certificates. (architecture-related: public API)
Added an API for the QUIC server to obtain the connection ID length of short header connections. (architecture-related: public API)
Support HTTP transfer via a BIO set with OSSL_CMP_CTX_set_transfer_cb_arg, and adjusted connection management logic. (architecture-related: public API)
Added support for generating X.509 certificates via the OpenSSL command line for the SLH-DSA algorithm. (architecture-related: public API)
Added support for passing the μ value directly to the ML-DSA verification function, replacing the message and skipping part of the preprocessing steps. (architecture-related: public API)
Added TLS signature algorithm support for ML-DSA, registering the ML-DSA signature algorithm constants in the TLS group capabilities. (architecture-related: TLS capabilities)
Implemented fetching algorithms (digest and mac) directly from the provider for DRBG_HASH and DRBG_HMAC. (architecture-related: Provider internal interface)
The signature algorithm configuration now accepts both IANA standard names and internal names for matching. (Architecture-related: signature algorithm configuration)
Added EVP_PKEY_CTX_dup support for the SLH-DSA algorithm. (architecture-related: public API)
Added the SSL_NO_EOED macro to skip processing of the EndOfEarlyData message in scenarios where it is not needed (such as QUIC). (architecture-related: TLS protocol behavior)
Added hybrid KEM algorithms (X25519MLKEM768, X448MLKEM1024, SecP256r1MLKEM768, SecP384r1MLKEM1024) in the FIPS provider. (Architecture-related: FIPS provider algorithms)

Enabled ML-KEM capabilities in the FIPS provider, added long name identifiers for the ML-KEM-512, ML-KEM-768, and ML-KEM-1024 algorithms, and added aliases without hyphens for the ML-DSA algorithms (such as MLDSA44). (Architecture-related: algorithm names and compatibility)

Added accessor interfaces for IANA signature scheme names for TLS connections, and output the signature algorithm name in the connection summary; s_client prefers the IANA registered name when reporting the peer's signature algorithm. (architecture-related: public API)

Adjusted the default TLS group list, added hybrid ML-KEM groups, sent two key shares by default, and streamlined the default group list; also made the deprecated TLS elliptic curve groups from RFC 8422 disableable and moved the deprecated curves to the end of the list. (Architecture-related: TLS groups and key shares)
Added the __isoc23_strtol symbol to unix-symbols.txt.
s_server now supports reading HTTP requests over early data, removing the conflict restrictions between -early_data and -www options.
Added the internal function ossl_serial_number_print to print certificate serial numbers (decimal and hexadecimal), and updated related calls and header file declarations.
Implemented key length checking in the X9.42 KDF to ensure the input key meets the 112-bit length requirement (in FIPS mode).
Added a Windows installation context information item to the openssl info command.
Added the -cipher option to the req command, allowing users to specify the private key encryption algorithm, and changed the default encryption algorithm from DES-EDE3-CBC to AES-256-CBC.
Changed the default encryption algorithm for the req, cms, and smime applications from DES-EDE3-CBC to AES-256-CBC, and removed the related conditional compilation guards.
Keep a reference to the user's original SSL object when creating a QUIC SSL connection.
Added the ability to set the local address for BIO_dgram_pair, and fixed the handling of the local address during destruction and writing.
Add a high-level check applicable only to RSA keys for the -verifyrecover option of pkeyutl.
The negotiated TLS 1.3 group information is now always displayed when printing ephemeral keys, no longer limited to the client and only in -brief mode.
Enhanced QUIC address validation token functionality, including token generation, encryption, parsing, and verification.
Added IPv6 support to the QUIC interoperability demo program, with the server using a dual-stack socket to listen on both IPv4 and IPv6.
Added opaque key support to the openssl command-line tool, with the enc command supporting EVP_SKEY objects and the list command supporting EVP_SKEYMGMT.
Check the return value of OSSL_PROVIDER_do_all and output an error message on failure, while also adding the new list_tls_groups function for listing TLS groups.
Added the skeyutl command-line tool for symmetric key management operations.
Added reference counting to QUIC tokens to prevent them from being unexpectedly freed while the client is waiting to send Initial frames.
In the FIPS module, perform ML-KEM self-tests only when ML-KEM is enabled.
Added support for the ML-DSA signature algorithm in the SSL trace functionality.
The dgst command now supports one-shot signature algorithms and refactored the printing logic for output and verification results.
Added trace messages to the init, teardown, gettable_params, get_params, query, and unquery operations in the provider API.
Added the hq-interop ALPN client demo program, including quic-hq-interop.c and related build configuration and Docker test support files.
Added session resumption support to the hq-interop demo program.
Added the HTTP/3 demo server ossl-nghttp3-demo-server.c based on QUIC server support and nghttp3.
Added the non-blocking QUIC server demo program quic-server-non-block.c.
Added the blocking QUIC server demo program quic-server-block.c to work with the existing QUIC client demo program, while removing util/quicserver.c.
Documented in CHANGES.md the limitation that QUIC currently cannot perform recursive SSL calls, as this may lead to deadlocks.
Added documentation in CHANGES.md for the new provider random-number hook (provider random hook).
Documented in CHANGES.md the change to the default DRBG implementation.
Documented VAES/AVX-512 support for AES-XTS in CHANGES.md.
Added build.info build configuration for the QUIC server demo program, located in the demos/quic/server/ directory.
Added QUIC server multiplexing tests to the CI workflow run_quic_interop_server.yml.

Refactored the workflow matrix of the QUIC interoperability runner, splitting steps into separate jobs to reduce the number of tasks generated by matrix expansion, limiting the maximum number of tasks to 49.
Added workflow_dispatch input parameters to the coveralls.yml workflow.
Enabled extended EVP tests in the coveralls.yml workflow.
Added a run-checker task with the no-ml-dsa option to the run-checker-ci.yml workflow.

Fixed multiple issues in the ML-DSA implementation, including key encoding/decoding, signature verification logic, and constant-time helper functions, and fixed the issue of partially uninitialized hint buffer. (Architectural event: OpenSSL_Core_Headers module change)

Fixed typos, adjusted comment formatting, fixed the return value of SSL_get0_listener in non-QUIC scenarios, removed redundant header files, and fixed memory leaks in tests. (architecture-related: public API behavior)
Fixed handling of SSL_pending and SSL_has_pending in QUIC applications to be compatible with s_client. (architecture-related: public API behavior)

Fixed the issue in QUIC non-blocking writes where a zero-byte write incorrectly returned SSL_ERROR_WANT_READ, and changed it to return SSL_ERROR_WANT_WRITE. (architecture-related: public API behavior)
Fixed symbol usage in the RIO notifier, switching to platform-specific socket read/write functions. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)
On Windows platforms, added necessary type casts for socketpair and WSASocketA usage, and fixed parameter type mismatches in setsockopt calls. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)

Fixed multiple issues in QUIC listener creation, including thread safety, memory release, and port configuration, and implemented the ability to create new connections from the listener. (Architecture-related: QUIC protocol support)
Added conditional compilation checks for the QNX system to avoid using the ipi_spec_dst field in the in_pktinfo structure. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)
Added a getsockname call and error handling in notifier initialization on the Windows platform. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)

Fixed the issue where the client's signature algorithm was not correctly saved during post-handshake authentication (PHA), ensuring the client always uses the signature algorithm from the current extension when receiving a PHA request. (Architecture-related: TLS handshake behavior)

Fixed multiple minor issues in the QUIC concurrent API, including adjusting structure field order, correcting comments, adding null pointer checks, optimizing error handling paths, and unifying the invalid socket value check. (architecture-related: QUIC concurrent API)

Fixed an incorrect parameter type conversion for InterlockedExchangeAdd in Windows thread code, changing incorrect long * and long to correct LONG * and LONG, ensuring correctness of atomic operations across platforms. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)
In deterministic ECDSA signatures, if no digest name is provided, a clear error message is now returned instead of failing silently. (architecture-related: external behavior)
Removed unnecessary restrictions on settable context parameters for ECDSA; all settable parameters are now always available. (architecture-related: external behavior)
Fixed the issue where OSSL_HTTP_open() did not correctly set the default port for IPv6 host addresses. (architecture-related: public API)
Added checks for NULL file names in multiple file loading functions to avoid null pointer dereferences. (architecture-related: public API)
Removed the restriction on the key type name in the EVP_PKEY_Q_keygen function; it now accepts any unrecognized key type name. (architecture-related: public API)

When rejecting invalid FFDHE and ECDHE key shares, changed the alert type sent from SSL_AD_INTERNAL_ERROR to SSL_AD_ILLEGAL_PARAMETER to comply with RFC 8446. (architecture-related: external behavior)

Fixed the issue of incorrect salt length parameter in TLS 1.3 HKDF key derivation, ensuring the correct prevsecretlen is used instead of mdlen, avoiding potential crashes or incorrect output. (architecture-related: TLS 1.3 key derivation)
Added a provider runtime state check in the RSA KEM context creation function in the FIPS module, and corrected the initialization operation type. (architecture-related: FIPS module)
Fixed build errors when OPENSSL_NO_SSLKEYLOG is undefined. (architecture-related: build and installation methods)
Fixed documentation and usage issues for X509v3_add_extensions when sk_X509_EXTENSION_num(exts) <= 0 and target is NULL. (architecture-related: public API)

Corrected the implementation related to the maximum response header line count feature, adjusted the function declaration position, and cleaned up debug tracing code. (architecture-related: public API)
Fixed error handling when key log setup fails, key log cleanup logic in SSL_CTX_free, and the error code value for ssl_cache_cipherlist. (architecture-related: public API)

Fixed the OSSL_trace_begin function so that it returns NULL when the corresponding trace category is not enabled, thereby correctly honoring the disabled category setting. (architecture-related: public API)
Fixed a potential double-free issue in the SRP_user_pwd_set1_ids function when memory allocation fails. (architecture-related: public API)
Fixed the SSL_inject_net_dgram function so that it correctly returns the return value of ossl_quic_demux_inject instead of always returning 1. (architecture-related: public API)
Added support for PKCS7 signed content of type V_ASN1_SEQUENCE, fixed the data copying issue, and added related tests. (architecture-related: public API)

When the application provides custom memory allocation functions via CRYPTO_set_mem_functions, posix_memalign or aligned_alloc is no longer used; instead, custom malloc is used and memory is manually aligned. (architecture-related: public API)
Fix the blocking behavior of SSL_poll when there are no poll items: if a timeout is specified, sleep and wait. (architecture-related: public API)
Revert the OPENSSL_version API change, restore the original format of the returned directory path, and adjust the version command output. (architecture-related: public API)

Fix a potential use-after-free issue in the REF_PRINT_COUNT macro after reference count decrement, by passing the reference count return value instead of the object pointer. (architecture-related: reference counting behavior)

Fix the memory ordering guarantee for reference count operations, changing the release operation from relaxed semantics to release semantics, and use stronger acquire-release semantics in TSAN builds to eliminate false positives. (architecture-related: thread safety guarantee)
Fix a build failure on riscv64 with musl by checking whether __NR_riscv_hwprobe is defined to decide whether to enable RISC-V hardware probing. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)

Fix incorrect checks of the return value of EVP_PKEY_set1_encoded_public_key in multiple functions, and correct the parameter check logic in DH CMS and the error codes in TLS handshake. (architecture-related: public API behavior fix)
Fix a memory leak in OSSL_HPKE_CTX_new caused by not freeing duplicated strings on the error path. (architecture-related: public API memory leak fix)

Fix a memory leak in BIO_get_accept_socket caused by BIO_parse_hostserv failure, ensuring that allocated hostname and service name memory is properly freed on parse failure. (architecture-related: public API memory leak fix)
Fix a memory leak in PKCS12_add_key_ex caused by PKCS8_add_keyusage failure, ensuring that the allocated PKCS#8 key information structure is freed. (architecture-related: public API memory leak fix)

Fix the wrong alert type in certificate compression handling, changing the unsupported compression algorithm error to an illegal parameter alert, and add a check for zero decompressed length. (architecture-related: SSL certificate compression behavior)
Fix the get_entropy function of DRBG so that it can provide the requested amount of entropy, not just its own strength value. (architecture-related: DRBG entropy behavior)

Fix the issue where callbacks use the wrong SSL object in QUIC scenarios, ensuring that the user-visible SSL object is passed in callbacks instead of the internal SSL object used only for QUIC. (architecture-related: QUIC callback behavior)

Fix the issue where the ORIG_DCID parameter is incorrectly selected when the QUIC server sends Server Hello in the retry scenario, ensuring that the correct original connection ID is used. (architecture-related: QUIC connection ID behavior)

Fixed the issue where QUIC objects incorrectly reported a 'no cipher match' error when calling the cipher list setting function; now the error is only reported when the method supports ciphers and there are no TLSv1.2 ciphers. (architecture-related: public API)
In FIPS mode, when the jitter entropy source encounters a permanent failure, the provider is now set to an error state. (architecture-related: FIPS behavior)

When the server receives an unsupported QUIC version, it no longer discards the Initial packet but replies with a version negotiation packet, and new functions for validating tokens and cleaning up encryption have been added. (architecture-related: QUIC protocol behavior)

Fixed the issue where SSL_write_ex and SSL_write_ex2 on a blocking QUIC stream could transmit data repeatedly, and corrected the logic for recording the number of bytes written. (architecture-related: QUIC write behavior)

Fixed the issue where EVP_PKEY_print_private() failed when used with a non-default provider; when exporting the key, if only the private key is selected, the public key selection is automatically added. (architecture-related: public API)
Version negotiation packets now send and receive the supported version list in network byte order. (architecture-related: QUIC version negotiation behavior)

Fixed the variable name error in the CRYPTO_atomic_store function in the Solaris build, and corrected the use of atomic memory order macros in the CRYPTO_atomic_load function. (architecture-related: platform compatibility: Solaris atomic operations)
Fixed a null pointer dereference issue in the PKCS7_OP_SET_DETACHED_SIGNATURE command in PKCS7_ctrl. (architecture-related: public API: PKCS7_ctrl)
Reverted the behavior changes of CMS_get1_certs() and CMS_get1_crls(), and fixed related issues. (architecture-related: public API)

Fixed the handling of additional input in jitter_generate, changing it to be mixed with the output via XOR instead of being added directly to the entropy pool. (architecture-related: random number generation behavior)
Fixed the redundant address-of operation when passing x->acinfo in the X509_ACERT_sign_ctx function. (architecture-related: public API)
Fixed compilation issues on the arm64_32 platform by limiting the special handling for Apple M1 to 64-bit pointer environments only. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)
Fixed compiler warnings in safe_math.h caused by __GNUC__ being undefined, by first checking if the macro is defined before comparing versions. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)
Fix the X509_PURPOSE_set() function to support clearing purpose requirements and adjust the purpose checking logic. (architecture-related: public API)
Fix the X509_PURPOSE_add function to use the short name as the primary key and add a function to obtain an unused ID. (architecture-related: public API)
Fix memory leaks and change the default encryption algorithm from DES-EDE3-CBC to AES-256-CBC. (architecture-related: public API)
Fix a potential crash in the X509_add_cert function when a NULL certificate is passed; now it directly returns 0 when the cert parameter is NULL. (architecture-related: public API)

Add return value checks for up_ref calls in multiple modules to ensure that when reference count operations fail, resources are correctly released and an error is returned. (architecture-related: public API)
Fix the callback function signature mismatch in the evp_generic_fetch family of functions, resolving the warning reported by UBSan. (architecture-related: public API)

Fix the issue where ossl_lib_ctx_get_concrete() returns NULL when the library context is not initialized, causing potential crashes in related locking and random number generation functions; a null pointer check has been added. (architecture-related: public API)
Fix the order of the QUIC encryption level enumeration to conform to the INITIAL, 0RTT, HANDSHAKE, 1RTT order specified by RFC 9000 and 9002. (architecture-related: public API)

Fix the incorrect use of the OPENSSL_HTTP_PROXY and OPENSSL_HTTPS_PROXY environment variables in the proxy adaptation function; now it correctly reads the corresponding proxy variable depending on whether SSL is used. (architecture-related: public API)
Improve the ASN1_TIME_print function to fix the printing of fractional seconds on EBCDIC platforms and add the missing GMT time zone indicator. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)

Fix issues in the OSSL_HTTP_REQ_CTX_nbio() state machine regarding incorrect state handling, the return content for non-fatal HTTP status codes, and the empty string check during HTTP redirects. (architecture-related: public API)
Fix the byte order issue in the polynomial sampling function in ML-DSA, and fix the MSVC compilation error to support cross-platform compilation. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)

Add a pending count check during QUIC connection cleanup to prevent releasing the port when there are still pending operations, thereby avoiding use after free. (architecture-related: QUIC protocol implementation)
Fix coverage test issues in ML-DSA key handling, remove the unused propq field, and correct the public key comparison condition. (architecture-related: public API)
Fix the issue of missing built-in provider configuration information. (architecture-related: provider configuration behavior)
Fix support for zero-length messages in the AES-GCM-SIV algorithm by removing the early return and length check restrictions. (architecture-related: AES-GCM-SIV algorithm behavior)
Fix multiple issues in SLH-DSA and add the new function slh_dsa_key_dup(). (architecture-related: public API: added slh_dsa_key_dup)

Added a null pointer check for pctx in the EVP_DigestSign function, ensuring that an initialization error is returned when pctx is null. (architecture-related: public API: EVP_DigestSign null pointer check)

Fixed the issue where QUIC might send NEW_TOKEN frames prematurely before the handshake completes; now such frames are scheduled only after the handshake completes and the amplification limit is lifted. (architecture-related: QUIC protocol behavior)

Fixed Windows compilation error: in crypto/defaults.c, changed the type of the temporary registry buffer from LPCTCH to LPCTSTR, and added corresponding type casts to be compatible with the mingw-w64 environment. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)
Fixed wide character handling and size check issues in Windows registry configuration probing. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)
Added a null pointer check for the X509v3_addr_canonize function, returning an error when the addr parameter is NULL. (architecture-related: public API)
Allow AES-SIV mode to handle zero-length plaintext and additional authenticated data (AAD), and fixed related return value issues. (architecture-related: cipher mode behavior)

Fixed SLH-DSA signature verification functionality, added algorithm short names and NID mappings to support OBJ_find_sigid_algs() and OBJ_sn2nid() calls, and fixed null pointer checks when retrieving key parameters. (architecture-related: public API)

Fixed the issue of identifier lookup failure in ML-DSA signature verification, added signature algorithm identifier mappings and short name aliases for the ML-DSA algorithm. (architecture-related: public API)

Updated the ASN.1 encoding/decoding format for ML-KEM, changing the seed in the private key to OCTET STRING type, and adjusted the related encoding/decoding table structure. (architecture-related: ASN.1 encoding/decoding format)

Fixed the no-ml-dsa configuration option, added it to the bulk group and CI tests, and added conditional compilation guards for ML-DSA related functions in self-tests. (architecture-related: build configuration)

Added two checks for ML-KEM private key import: when both seed and key are provided, check the consistency of the implicit rejection value z; when both public key and private key are provided, verify that the redundant public key matches the copy in the private key. (architecture-related: key import behavior)

Fixed ML-DSA key management functions so they return the seed parameter as documented, and ensure no error is reported when requesting unavailable parameters. (architecture-related: ML-DSA key management behavior)

Modified the ML-DSA private key to public key function, adding a check for consistency between the decoded t0 value and the computed value, and added corresponding test cases. (architecture-related: ML-DSA core validation)
Removed the inclusion of the poll.h header file to avoid compilation errors on NonStop platforms. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)

To be compatible with old compilers that do not support __ATOMIC_ACQ_REL, changed the RCU callback list operation from atomic exchange to mutex protection, and adjusted the synchronization order. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)
Fixed error enum conflict by changing the sequence number of SSL_R_MISSING_QUIC_TLS_FUNCTIONS from 421 to 423. (architecture-related: public API)
Made signature algorithm name matching case-insensitive and fixed the logic in the related function. (architecture-related: public API)
Changed the alert type for zero-length cipher suite list from illegal_parameter to decode_error to comply with RFC 8446. (architecture-related: external behavior)
Changed the keyshare order check from a fatal error to only logging a trace message, improving compatibility with certain clients. (architecture-related: external behavior)

Fixed the issue where the EVP_PKEY_derive_set_peer_ex function incorrectly freed the peer key on error, restoring the original behavior: no longer freeing and clearing the peer key after a control operation failure. (architecture-related: public API)

Changed 'no valid group' from an error to allowed, fixed the handling logic when the group list is empty or contains only whitespace, and optimized memory allocation and reference count checks in SSL connection initialization. (architecture-related: external behavior)
Restricted the seed length for SLH-DSA key generation to be exactly 3*n, and added corresponding test cases. (architecture-related: public API)

Enhanced validation for ML-DSA key generation and decoding: check seed and private key consistency and private key matching explicit public key, and fixed the memory release order in the key reset function. (architecture-related: public API)

Fixed Windows atomic operation support by adding a lock-protected fallback implementation for CRYPTO_atomic_add when InterlockedExchangeAdd64 is missing. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)

Fixed the issue where EVP_DecodeUpdate could write to unallocated memory due to zero bytes produced by padding equal signs during decoding, by adding a new eof parameter to control padding handling, and updated related documentation and tests. (architecture-related: public API)
Fixed compilation failure on AIX 7.1 caused by conflict between system macro definitions and variable names in the code. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)

Fixed the issue where libctx was not correctly passed in CMS password recipient information operations, ensuring key derivation and cipher initialization use the correct library context. (architecture-related: public API)
Fixed build error on Windows XP due to socket handle non-inheritable flag, falling back to a call without that flag when WSASocketA fails. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)
Fixed the issue in SAN URI name constraint checking that did not correctly handle the userinfo component; now URIs containing a userinfo part are allowed. (architecture-related: public API)
Fixed the issue where the legacy code path was incorrectly entered when EVP_PKEY_CTX already had a keymgmt associated. (architecture-related: public API)
Adjusted the resource release order in SSL_free and ossl_ssl_connection_free to ensure SSL_get_app_data() remains available during QUIC TLS callbacks. (architecture-related: public API)

Fixed the issue where CCM cipher suites were incorrectly allowed in the QUIC TLS API, by adding an internal flag to distinguish QUIC internal connections, ensuring only correct cipher suites are allowed. (architecture-related: public API)

Fixed the issue in QUIC 0-RTT scenarios where the server-side handshake read key switch occurred too late, avoiding the need for the application layer to call SSL_do_handshake() additionally to obtain the key. (architecture-related: public API)
Allow the default provider to use digests without NID for ECDSA signing, and fix the issue of invalid checks in DSA signing. (Architecture-related: provider behavior)
Fix signature algorithm edge cases: allow RSA PSS certificate signing with the same digest, and avoid sending TLS 1.3 signature algorithms to TLS 1.2 clients. (architecture-related: public API)
Fix the behavior of SSL_new() when using the QUIC server method, and add test cases to verify correctness in this scenario. (architecture-related: public API)

When parameter retrieval fails, if the result pointer is non-NULL and the error is not that the buffer is too small, set the returned size to zero instead of returning a non-zero value, to avoid misleading callers into thinking data was written.
Add version field checking in the PKCS8 decoder.
Fix compilation issues caused by missing indirect inclusion of winsock.h, and add necessary header references in relevant source and header files.
Fix undefined behavior caused by not casting char type arguments to unsigned char when using ctype.h functions.

Fix two issues in the translation of EC parameters to legacy controls: fix_ecdh_cofactor correctly returns a value in the POST_PARAMS_TO_CTRL state, and evp_pkey_ctx_setget_params_to_ctrl allows returning 0 as a valid return value.
Fix the BIO reference counting issue during QUIC connection cleanup, releasing the network read/write BIO objects before releasing the port.
Fix the release order of TLS objects during QUIC connection cleanup, ensuring TLS is released before the channel is released.
Fix the QUIC listener release issue by adding a dedicated release function, and resolve the memory leak that prevented listener release when pre-allocated connection objects were used.
Fixed multiple bugs in the QUIC server API, including memory leaks and inbound connection setup issues.
Fix the bug in default XSO handling on the QUIC server side.
Fix the reference counting issue of the QUIC listener, correctly releasing the listener object during connection cleanup and adjusting lock operations.
Fix the incorrect condition check for default stream creation on the QUIC server side.
Fix the QUIC APL functions to use the correct prologue, update the context checking method for multiple functions, and add error handling for the listener in control functions.
Fix the possible assertion failure or deadlock in the QUIC reactor when waiting is not possible.
Fix the assignment of net_read_desired in the QUIC port subtick so that it is determined based on the port running state, ensuring the reactor correctly waits on the listening port.
Revise the connection state check in the QUIC write path to be compatible with s_client's SSL_pending and SSL_has_pending handling.
Ensure that incoming stream data can still be drained after the connection is closed.
Fixed the issue where default streams could still be created after QUIC connection termination; now a protocol-closed error is returned immediately.
Added default domain flags support for the QUIC engine, deciding whether to enable the notifier based on domain flags, and passing reactor flags to reactor initialization.

Optimized the notification mechanism of the QUIC channel to other threads in scenarios such as termination and timeout, and fixed the encoding logic of the initial connection ID when retrying connections.
QUIC objects now require the blocking support flag to be included in domain flags in order to use blocking mode.
Added conditional compilation protection for thread support to the mutex assignment in QUIC listener creation.
Fixed the registration logic of blocking operations for inter-thread notification in SSL_poll, ensuring proper cleanup of incomplete items and returning the result count.
Fixed a memory leak on the error path in the rsa_cms_sign function; when X509_ALGOR_set0 fails, explicitly free the allocated ASN1_STRING variable.
Added a check in rehash.c for OPENSSL_strdup returning a null pointer, preventing undefined behavior when memory allocation fails.
Fixed an issue where a null pointer dereference could occur when checking CRL due to issuer being a null pointer.
Fixed the error return code check in http_server_init(), changing the condition from < 0 to <= 0.
Fixed issues in OSSL_HTTP_adapt_proxy() when handling escaped IPv6 host addresses and whitespace characters in the no_proxy list.

Fixed buffer boundary issues in password callback handling, ensuring space is reserved for the null terminator and validating the length returned by the callback, preventing out-of-bounds access that could cause crashes.
Fixed null pointer dereference and memory leak in the PBMAC1 implementation in PKCS#12 that could be caused by EVP_MD_fetch failure; added null checks and resource release.
Fixed the missing NIP flag when performing a squeeze for an empty SHAKE message on s390x, and added corresponding tests.
Fixed the handling logic of the s390x SHA3 absorb function for zero-length data, avoiding incorrect KIMD instruction calls that could cause abnormal subsequent hash output.
Fixed multiple issues in SSL_poll for QUIC, including stream completion detection, immediate-mode polling, and result_count reporting for failure events, and optimized the related implementation.
In the issuer serial number output of the AC target extension, print <none> when the issuer name or UID is empty.
Fixed the build failure on ARM architecture with OPENSSL_SMALL_FOOTPRINT due to gcm_ghash_4bit being undeclared; set the ghash function pointer to NULL when that macro is defined.
On the Windows platform, ensure WSAStartup is initialized before calling WSASocketA, and optimized error handling.
Added QUIC lock calls for functions called from poll_translate_ssl_quic to ensure thread safety.
Handle the case where the connection object may be NULL in QUIC server scenarios, add NULL pointer checks and handling, adjust lock mechanism and timeout calculation logic.
Ensure the QUIC engine is always scheduled, regardless of whether the connection has been started or terminated.
Fix duplicate engine reference issue in ossl_ec_key_dup.
Fix SMIME type setting for AuthEnvelopedData to correctly output authEnveloped-data.
Fix signed and unsigned comparison issue in jitter random number generation.
Fix null pointer dereference issues in EC public key encoding and point conversion functions.
Fix the issue where the set_ctx_params function in RSA signature algorithms returns an error value for unknown parameters, making it consistent with other algorithms by always returning 1.
Add OSSL_ prefix to internal list macros to avoid conflicts with BSD macro definitions in system headers.
Fix the issue where the rsasve_recover function does not correctly set the output length after successful decryption, and add validity checks for the output buffer length.
Fix lock acquisition and release order issue in FIPS CRNG test.
Fix the issue where the ECDH cofactor FIPS indicator triggers incorrectly, and fix related memory leaks; also add test cases covering all parameter combinations.
Fix processing order error in the pkey command when the input file and output file are the same file.
Fix the processing logic in the dhparam command when the input file and output file are the same file, ensuring the input is read before opening the output to avoid premature truncation of the file.
Fix possible processing errors in the dsaparam command when the input file and output file are the same file.
Fix the processing issue in the OCSP tool when the request input file and output file are the same file.

Fix the processing logic in the ecparam and pkeyparam tools when the input file and output file are the same file, ensuring the output is opened after reading the input to avoid overwriting. Also fix the return value of the list curves function and the return value checks for parameter printing.
Fix possible errors in the pkcs8 command when the input file and output file are the same file, adjusting the timing of opening the output file to ensure the input is read before writing the output.
Fix the processing logic in the storeutl tool when the URI and output file path are the same, delaying the opening of the output file to inside the process function.
Fix handling when PBKDF2 PRF is missing in PBMAC1, defaulting to hmacWithSHA1, and add null pointer checks.
Fix the memory leak in the PKCS7_signatureVerify function where the buffer was not released when EVP_VerifyUpdate failed; move the release operation to the error handling path.
Fix the memory leak in the save_statusInfo function caused by sk_ASN1_UTF8STRING_push failure; add the corresponding release operation.
Fix the memory leak in the ossl_quic_calculate_retry_integrity_tag function, ensuring that allocated resources are correctly released on the error path.
Fix the network read/write expectation determination function in the QUIC listener, replacing the channel reactor in ctx.qc with the reactor in ctx.obj.
Fix the memory leak in the tls_parse_ctos_psk function where sess was not released on the error path.
Fix the build failure on the AIX platform caused by missing sendmmsg/recvmmsg.
Revert the workaround previously introduced to avoid the unreliable ftell issue in Windows text mode.
Open PEM files in binary mode on the Windows platform to avoid the MSVCRT ftell text mode issue.
Unify the calculation method for the maximum alignment value in the TLS read and write buffers, fixing the inconsistency between the two.
Fix the ambiguity in signature algorithm output by changing ed25519 and ed448 to lowercase, and adding explicit name output for algorithms such as RSA-PSS and brainpool.
Fix the logic errors in the hostname, email, and IP matching checks in the check_cert_attributes function, ensuring correct determination of match results.
Fix multiple incorrect uses of BN_check_prime: add error checking in the prime command and correct the return value assertions in tests.
Fix the issue of incorrect return value checks in multiple functions, ensuring that failure conditions are correctly detected.
Add validation for empty ciphers and invalid block sizes in the check block size function in speed.c to avoid division by zero errors.

Fix the failure of the openssl speed -evp command when performing decryption benchmarks for AEAD ciphers (such as CCM, GCM, OCB, SIV); now both encryption and decryption (with or without AAD) execute correctly.
Fix the issue of missing newline after printing Full Name.
Fix the memory leak in the copy_issuer function caused by sk_GENERAL_NAME_reserve failure; release ialt on the error path.
Add return value checks for the SLH_DSA hash functions and propagate error status to all calling functions to enhance robustness.

Fix the segmentation fault in the QUIC stream object caused by accessing a freed stream structure when SSL_stream_reset is called after receiving the FIN bit; treat the state where the stream has received all data as write-complete, allowing correct reset.
Fix the incorrect error checking for non-original input lengths in the -verifyrecover operation in pkeyutl, and enhance error messages when signature/verification input is too long.
Fix a memory leak in the cmd_RecordPadding function caused by not releasing the internal string copy on early exit.
Fixed the issue where the stream id was set too late when generating stream frames, causing incorrect header size calculation for high stream ids and frames not fitting into packets.

Fix the check logic for the -peerkey option in pkeyutl: add validation that the peer public key and private key types match, correct the decapsulate call arguments, and adjust the condition for raw key operations.
Fix a memory leak in the dsa_gen function by ensuring the local variable dsa is released on early exit.
Fix the issue in pkeyutl where pkey was freed multiple times on several error paths, and fix a memory leak in the -verifyrecover error case.

Fix the issue in the sm2_sig_verify function where BN_CTX_end was incorrectly called on memory allocation failure, and adjust the allocation order of EC_POINT_new to ensure BN_CTX_start is called first.
Fix a potential memory leak in ecx_gen_init caused by not properly freeing the copied parameter memory when ecx_gen_set_params fails.
Fix a memory leak in DSA key generation initialization caused by not properly cleaning up internal parameters.
Fix the condition error in the parameter check in dh_cms_set_peerkey(), ensuring that only missing parameters are allowed to pass.
Fix the QUIC datagram length check logic, now correctly discarding datagrams smaller than 1200 bytes.
Fix the issue of discarding the wrong packet number when retrying after version negotiation, ensuring that packet 1 is discarded instead of packet 0 to trigger initial packet retransmission.

Fix the issue where the genpkey command could leave an empty file when the encryption password does not match; now the key is first written to a memory buffer and only written to the actual output file on success.
Improve the handling of additional input in the jitter RNG by adding the additional input to the random pool before obtaining entropy, and fix related error handling.
Fix a potential double-free issue in ossl_cms_get1_crls_ex() when the CRL reference count increment fails.
Fix multiple issues in the QUIC demo server, including buffer overflow, uninitialized variables, and resource leaks, and improve stream shutdown and URL handling logic.
Fix a memory leak caused by not freeing RAND_POOL when entropy pool mixing fails.
Fix a leak of the originator certificate in the cms application.
Fix a segmentation fault in CMS encryption using key agreement when the originator flag is set; now a clear error message is returned.
Add a check for pctx being NULL in EVP_DigestVerify to prevent crashes due to null pointer dereference.
When pushing an algorithm, decide whether to set the store parameter to NULL based on the no_store flag to correctly handle the no-store scenario.
Fix the issue in s_server where the -naccept option caused the listening socket not to be closed in a timely manner.
Fix the memory leak in the ossl_cmp_rp_new() function on the error path.
Remove the unnecessary realloc call in ossl_property_merge to avoid memory leaks.
Fix the ikmlen length check in ossl_ec_dhkem_derive_private, correcting the comparison object from Nsecret to Nsk.
Fix the use of an uninitialized value in ossl_quic_demux_inject, ensuring the datagram ID is correctly assigned before being added to the pending list.
Fix the code logic for the wrap and unwrap functions in pkeyutl, including correcting the key type setting, output file handling, and parameter passing for decryption operations.
Correct the value of the MARSHALLED_TOKEN_MAX_LEN macro and update the related comments.

Fix the concurrency issues in the RCU lock where query processors were reused prematurely and ID field updates lost references, ensuring a minimum of 3 query processors and introducing atomic operations to guarantee update atomicity.
Fix the memory leak in the mac_gen_init and cmac_gen_init functions when parameter setting fails.
Fix the memory leak caused by not releasing the WPACKET resource on the error path in the eddsa_signverify_init function.
Fix the issue in PEM_ASN1_write_bio where the data size calculation used a fixed value, changing it to allocate using the maximum block size.
Fix the potential leak of the OSSL_STORE_INFO object on the error path in the add_uris_recursive function.
Fix the memory leak in the cert_response() function where the certificate object was not released on the error path.
Fix the memory leak on the error path in the ossl_rsa_multiprime_derive function, ensuring that newly created BIGNUM objects are correctly freed on exceptions.
Fix the issue in the io_getevents function where a structure was passed by value instead of by reference to the system call.
Fix the printf format error in debug_print for the size_t type variable in template_kem.c, changing %d to %zu.
Fix the handling order of the -list_curves option in the ecparam command, ensuring curves are listed before reading input.
Fix the potential crash in the ossl_serial_number_print() function when the ASN1_INTEGER content is empty; it now correctly prints (Empty) and returns safely.
Fix the build failure caused by the misuse of the preprocessor concatenation operator with string literals.
Fixed a memory leak caused by not releasing CRYPTO_REF when releasing QUIC token, and added error handling when building the token.

Fixed the issue where the ossl_quic_trace function failed to correctly obtain the connection ID length when parsing short headers; now the actual length is obtained via the API to correctly parse the header.
Fixed a crash caused by an array out-of-bounds access when configuring certificates through a configuration file, due to the certificate key algorithm being dynamically added by the provider.
Avoided repeated calls to ssl_load_sigalgs in tls1_set_sigalgs_list, and fixed a potential issue caused by an incorrect loop condition in ssl_cert_lookup_by_pkey.
Fixed issues reported by Coverity by adding null pointer checks in tests and simplifying conditional statements.
Fixed a potential crash when obtaining the group ID due to a null session, by adding a null pointer check.
Reverted QUIC initial packet validation modifications, fixed interoperability test issues, and cleaned up the code.
Fixed the issue where quic_tls.c was missing necessary header files due to refactoring; re-added quic_record_util.h to obtain the required macro definitions.

Fixed multiple issues reported by Coverity, including correctly handling null key objects in encryption initialization, adding memory allocation failure checks, and adding output buffer null pointer checks.
Refactored the EVP_SKEY initialization logic to enforce that skeymgmt is not null and added missing memory allocation checks, fixing issues found by Coverity.

Fixed the issue with initial packet AEAD validation in the QUIC port when skipping retry packets, ensuring that old receivers are correctly discarded and validated packets are rescued from them and injected into the new channel.
Improved the consistency of ML-KEM key checks by cross-validating seed values during import and loading, and setting a hard error on load failure to prevent key information leakage.
Fixed the condition check in the SSL_CTRL_GET_PEER_SIGNATURE_NAME branch in ssl3_ctrl to avoid null pointer dereference when peer_sigalg is null.
Added null pointer checks for the return value of SSL_CONNECTION_FROM_SSL in the SSL_set1_client_cert_type and SSL_set1_server_cert_type functions to prevent potential null pointer dereferences.
Fixed issues reported by Coverity by adding provider reference count checks in key management methods to avoid potential null pointer dereferences.
Fixed the issue in openssl-ts where the wrong function was called when loading the certificate store; changed to use the add function for compatibility with org.openssl.winstore.
Added null pointer checks to multiple SSL functions to fix null pointer dereference issues reported by Coverity scans, and adjusted variable declaration order and function call parameters.
Fixed the BIO reference counting issue found by Coverity scans by adding a check on the return value of BIO_up_ref in the SSL BIO set function.
Fixed an error in the key share handling logic in the TLS client when receiving a HelloRetryRequest that does not request new key shares.
Fixed the improper use of error codes in libssl; libconf error codes are no longer raised from libssl code.
Fixed a potential dangling pointer issue when calling OSSL_ENCODER_to_data() multiple times in the FIPS provider, and added corresponding test cases.
Improve ML-KEM key validation logic: when both seed and private key are provided, now compare the full ML-KEM private key encoding result, not just the public key hash.
Fix a crash issue in the QUIC implementation that may be caused by a null pointer.
Escape control characters in distinguished names by default.
Fixed a race condition in RCU queue reclamation, avoiding a use-after-free error when allocating more than 3 QPs; also added test cases to cover high-concurrency scenarios.
Fix a memory ordering issue in update_qp on weakly ordered systems by adding a dummy atomic release operation to ensure the new value of reader_idx is visible in get_hold_current_qp.
Adjust reference counting and error handling when setting peer keys to ensure the provided EVP_PKEY is correctly held.
Fixed the issue where the server channel did not set the initial secret when creating qrx itself, ensuring that client hellos spanning multiple datagrams are correctly decoded.
Fix the fetchable parameter list in ECX key management by removing the mandatory digest parameter from the general ECX parameters, keeping it only for Ed25519/Ed448.
Add a null pointer check for the return value of OCSP_BASICRESP_new in the make_ocsp_response function to avoid potential crashes.
Fix the QUIC record layer incorrectly decrementing the unreleased counter when releasing a record fails; only update the counter after successful release.
Fix the issue in CMS where the SHAKE digest algorithm lacked a default length; set a fixed digest length for it during initialization.
Fix a null pointer dereference in asn1_ex_i2c caused by uninitialized ASN1_TYPE elements; add handling for the V_ASN1_UNDEF type and return an error code.
Fix the reporting of certificate chain public key information in s_client to correctly display the group name for elliptic curve keys instead of the bit length.
Fix a double-free issue in hybrid ML-KEM key copying caused by the attribute string not being correctly copied.
Fix a segmentation fault in the pkeyutl command-line tool caused by a null pointer.

Replace ASN1_INTEGER_get() with ASN1_INTEGER_get_int64() in ossl_serial_number_print() to eliminate ambiguity between success and error for the -1 return value, and improve error reporting and cross-platform behavior.
Reclaim the TLS key used to store thread_event_handler.
Correct the argon2 thread availability error string to properly display the requested number of threads and the available number of threads.
Preserve fileprefix during h3ssl reuse in the http3 demo server; restore the value after zeroing the structure.
Fix the copying of the url value in the http3 demo server to avoid copying data from overlapping memory regions, which caused incorrect output.
In the SSL_read error handling of the http3 demo server, add a ZERO_RETURN branch, which is a non-fatal error.
When sk_OPENSSL_STRING_push fails, free the allocated data to fix a memory leak.

In ossl-nghttp3-demo-server, change the size variable type of the read call from int to size_t to avoid negative values being interpreted as extremely large unsigned values and triggering FORTIFY_SOURCE detection.
When scrypt fetch fails, do not free the context itself.
In kdf_scrypt_reset(), set the freed pointer to NULL to prevent subsequent use from causing a double free.
Allow importing unknown keys through the generic type, so that SKEY can still be used when no specific skey management is available.
Fix the factor size and modulus bit size checks to only allow 1024, 1536, or 2048.
In policy_section(), when sk_POLICYQUALINFO_push() fails, add POLICYQUALINFO_free() to free qual on the error path, fixing a memory leak.

In quic-hq-interop, when the maximum stream limit is reached and SSL_new_stream() returns NULL, allow multiple retries, and adjust the number of stream batches used in parallel to 1/4 of the total available streams.

Fixed three minor issues: corrected the typo "incomming" to "incoming" in comments; removed the redundant NULL assignment to qc->listener in quic_impl.c; added a NULL check for qc in quic_port.c before qc->tls = NULL to avoid potential null pointer dereference.
In template_kem.c, check whether outlen is a null pointer before dereferencing it.
Add NULL checks to QUIC code to fix multiple null pointer dereference issues found by Coverity scanning.
Fix the issue in qlog where need_skip was not set when QUIC frame header parsing failed: when ossl_quic_wire_peek_frame_header() returns failure, set *need_skip to SIZE_MAX before returning 0.
Correct the return value of i2d_ASN1_bio_stream() when flags do not include the SMIME_STREAM bit, so that it returns the actual result of ASN1_item_i2d_bio() instead of always returning 1.
In ktls_meth.c, properly free OSSL_RECORD_LAYER when the return code is not successful, fixing a memory leak.
Fix the condition inversion error in qlog_event_helpers.c, changing the number of skipped bytes to at most PACKET_remaining() instead of at least PACKET_remaining().
In apps/lib/apps.c, add a check for the return value of OPENSSL_strdup() to ensure memory allocation succeeds.
In apps/pkcs12.c, fix the logic issue where MAC presence is required when verifying the MAC, and add the test case nomac_parse.p12.
In demos/http3/ossl-nghttp3-demo-server.c, fix compatibility issues with multiple clients and handle minor issues found during review.
In demos/guide/quic-hq-interop.c, handle review fixes.
Added a QUIC blocking server demonstration guide, including the quic-server-block.c example code and the accompanying documentation ossl-guide-quic-server-block.pod.
Updated error codes in crypto/err/openssl.txt.
Replaced strdup with OPENSSL_strdup in ossl_rand_ctx_new() in crypto/rand/rand_lib.c.
Removed calls to BIO_printf() in FIPS_MODULE in crypto/property/property.c.

Fixed RCU-related issues in crypto/threads_pthread.c and crypto/threads_win.c: changed the allocate_new_qp_group parameter to unsigned int, and adjusted the position of id_ctr in rcu_lock_st to improve stack alignment.
Fixed C++ style comments to C style comments in crypto/ec/ecp_nistz256.c and crypto/armcap.c.
Fixed the filter provider to return the correct provider context.
Added the --ignore-errors mismatch argument to lcov in .github/workflows/coveralls.yml.
Excluded the combination of the amplificationlimit test and the mvfst client in .github/workflows/run_quic_interop_server.yml.
Merged the QUIC client and QUIC server interoperability CI workflows, integrating the related YAML configuration files.
Adjusted the configuration for ssl-trace being enabled by default in .github/workflows/run-checker-ci.yml and run-checker-daily.yml.
Adjusted the task list in .github/workflows/run-checker-daily.yml, removing some disablables items that are disabled by default.

Removed the SSL_TOKEN_STORE_HANDLE type, replaced it with the opaque SSL_TOKEN_STORE, and removed the related public API functions SSL_CTX_get0_token_store and SSL_CTX_set1_token_store. (Architectural event: OpenSSL_Core_Headers module change)
Renamed the EVP_SKEY_get_raw_key function to EVP_SKEY_get0_raw_key to follow OpenSSL naming conventions. (Architectural event: OpenSSL_Core_Headers module change)
Optimized the certificate issuer lookup logic, simplified the cache lookup flow of X509_STORE_CTX_get1_issuer, and unified the internal lookup functions. (architecture-related: public API)

In the FIPS provider, replaced the signature verification API from EVP_DigestSign/Verify with EVP_PKEY_sign/verify, and removed the related APIs and conditional compilation logic. (architecture-related: public API)

Refactored the SSL keylog functionality, using BIO_up_ref and callback mechanisms to manage reference counting, and returning an error in SSL_CTX_new_ex when the keylog file setting fails; also updated related function names and comments. (architecture-related: public API)

Refactored the creation logic for QUIC ports and channels, and optimized the connection acceptance flow so that ossl_quic_accept_connection directly returns the TLS connection object. (Architecture-related: QUIC protocol stack)

Refactored the internal implementation of the DER encoder/decoder, unified the signatures of PKCS8 and public key decoding functions, and migrated encoding helper functions to the crypto/encode_decode/ directory and exposed them as public interfaces, in preparation for supporting ML-KEM/ML-DSA. (architecture-related: public API)
Deprecated all BIO_meth_get_* functions and added deprecation macro support for OpenSSL 3.5. (Architecture-related: API deprecation)

Changed zeroization operations in the FIPS module to be controlled by the OPENSSL_PEDANTIC_ZEROIZATION macro, covering scenarios such as HKDF, PBKDF2, and integrity verification. (architecture-related: FIPS behavior)

In RSA_free, changed the condition for zeroizing sensitive data from the FIPS_MODULE macro to the OPENSSL_PEDANTIC_ZEROIZATION macro, and fixed the parameters of the reference count printing macro. (architecture-related: public API)

Refactored the SLH-DSA implementation, removed the reference counting of SLH_DSA_KEY, unified types, added helper functions, and restricted key text output to non-FIPS modules. (architecture-related: internal API)

Added FIPS support for ML-KEM and ML-DSA, including new raw seed/raw private key formats, removal of the pairing consistency test for ML-DSA under FIPS, and conditional compilation for hybrid KEM. (architecture-related: public API)
Prefer configuring the DRBG with cipher algorithms from the same provider as the DRBG. (architecture-related: external behavior)
Extracted the duplicated fnv1a_hash function into a common ossl_fnv1a_hash function and updated the callers. (architecture-related: internal API)
Unified the default group lists for QUIC and TLS, and removed the QUIC-specific default group list macro definitions. (Architecture-related: QUIC/TLS default group list unification)
Updated FIPS self-test definitions, changed SLH_DSA to SLH-DSA, and removed redundant KEM key generation definitions. (architecture-related: public API)

Refactored signature algorithm handling logic: adjusted the order of the default signature algorithm list (ML-DSA-65 first), introduced min/max TLS and DTLS version range checks, added the tls_sigalg_compat function to unify version compatibility checks, and added TLSv1.2-specific names for some algorithms. (Architecture-related: Signature algorithm handling logic refactor)
Moved the inclusion of <winsock.h> from include/internal/e_os.h to a dedicated header file include/internal/e_winsock.h.
In BIO_socket_wait() in crypto/bio/bio_sock.c, use poll() instead of the original implementation when available.
Defined and used the ossl_bio_print_hex function to replace the hex printing logic in related modules in crypto/x509, and added internal documentation.

In the RCU code in crypto/threads_pthread.c and crypto/threads_win.c, reduced the minimum qp count to 2, changed the reader_idx atomic load in get_hold_current_qp to RELAXED, and clarified related comments.
Adjusted the key generation and signature verification flows for SLH-DSA, updated the internal context type, and fixed the dispatch table for signature functions.
When verifying server X.509 certificates, also use the ERR marking mechanism, and adjusted the order of certificate reference counting and verification flow.
Refactored the inclusion of e_os.h in the ssl module: removed the inclusion from ssl_local.h, and instead include it directly in source files that need it, placing it at the top of the include list.
In multiple source files under the apps directory, directly include the "e_os.h" header file as needed.
Refactor the load_key_certs_crls() function in apps/lib/apps.c, clean up the code, and add explanatory comments.
Unify the event handling mode of the QUIC APL into QUIC_OBJ, use the QUIC_OBJ pointer as the parent object reference, and unify blocking mode handling for all object types.
Refactor the QCTX context and I/O locking method of the QUIC APL, adjust the QUIC connection type determination, and use SSL_DOMAIN_FLAG_THREAD_ASSISTED to control the thread-assisted mode.

Refactor the QUIC context lock functions and organize the QUIC_XSO/QUIC_LISTENER type definitions, while completing the static library dependencies for related header files and certificate compression tests.
