Add an assert(0) assertion in QUIC stream state handling to catch unexpected default branches; avoid performing tick operations before the QUIC channel connection is established, and add the local_transport_params_consumed flag to prevent local transport parameters from being set repeatedly.
Clean up unused functions and macros in ssl_local.h.
Add the ossl_param_is_empty() utility function, and call this function in all provider implementations with set_ctx_params() to detect OSSL_PARAM arrays that contain only the terminating entry.
Remove the aid field from the DSA, ECDSA, EdDSA, and SM2 signature provider contexts.
Add skeleton template files and build configuration for KEM and key management.
Use sk_X509_ATTRIBUTE_deep_copy() in pk7_doit.c to copy the attribute stack to clean up the code.
Remove two unused union members from struct x509_object_st.
Convert a redundant check in apps/passwd.c into an assertion.
Adjust the remove_id() logic in demos/http3/ossl-nghttp3-demo-server.c to support removing multiple streams, and create a new h3conn for new connections in read_from_ssl_ids().
Organize the code of demos/http3/ossl-nghttp3-demo-server.c according to review comments.
Remove the non-null check for SSL_free() in demos/http3/ossl-nghttp3-demo-server.c, because SSL_free() already handles the NULL case internally.
Check the return value of CRYPTO_atomic_add() in provider_deactivate().
Clean up the dead assignment to argc in apps/cms.c.
Refactor the MAKE_ENCODER macro in providers/implementations/encode_decode/encode_key2any.c, removing the unused evp_type parameter.
Remove the leftover accepted flag in the QUIC implementation, and remove the check for pending in ossl_quic_free.
Remove redundant ossl_provider_prov_ctx related code, involving crypto/provider.c, crypto/provider_core.c, and include/internal/provider.h.
Use siphash to implement the lcidm hash function in ssl/quic/quic_lcidm.c, including adding a random hash key value to the lcidm structure and updating the LCIDM lookup to include the hash key.
Make SSL/TLS group names case-insensitive, involving ssl/t1_lib.c and related documentation.
Always use NULL BIO when using the QUIC TLS API, modifying the file ssl/quic/quic_tls.c.
Remove unused fields from the DRBG structure, modifying the file providers/implementations/rands/drbg_local.h.
Replace sprintf() calls in multiple files with BIO_snprintf() to avoid compiler warnings, involving 16 files in the apps, crypto, and test directories.
Remove unnecessary sk_GENERAL_NAME_free() calls on NULL in crypto/x509/v3_san.c.
Use a static array of length 256 to store a copy of OPENSSL_MALLOC_FAILURES, involving crypto/mem.c, documentation, and header files.
Change the FIPS zeroization operation to use the OPENSSL_PEDANTIC_ZEROIZATION macro definition, modifying the file crypto/ffc/ffc_params.c.

The ML-KEM KEM provider now uses the operation type to distinguish between encapsulation and decapsulation parameter handling, cleans up one-time entropy, and improves checks for output buffer and null length pointers.
Remove the unused variable "group" from providers/implementations/keymgmt/ec_kmgmt.c.
Extend trace logging for provider algorithm fetching/caching and other operations, involving crypto/context.c, core_fetch.c, evp_fetch.c, and property.c.

Rename token_store functions for consistent naming: change setter functions to set1 (due to increased reference counting), and correspondingly rename internal QUIC functions, involving multiple ssl header and implementation files.
Modify ossl_quic_get_peer_token to return a QUIC_TOKEN structure and remove the QTOK type, involving ssl/quic and ssl_lib.c.
Refactor the parameters of get0_best_issuer_sk() in crypto/x509/x509_vfy.c and adapt the calling convention of build_chain().
The FIPS module ignores attribute queries when fetching internal algorithms, modifying the file crypto/evp/evp_fetch.c.
Include one-time key generation functions for internal FIPS use in crypto/evp/evp_lib.c.
Avoid attribute query operations in crypto/rand/rand_lib.c.
Remove unnecessary error checks and unused code for EC_get_builtin_curves in apps/ecparam.c.
Remove redundant macro definitions from providers/implementations/keymgmt/rsa_kmgmt.c.
Clean up unused atomic stub functions in crypto/threads_pthread.c to eliminate clang's -Wunused-function warning.
Make CRYPTO_atomic_load/store use the same preprocessor guard conditions as other CRYPTO_atomic_X functions.
In crypto/rand/rand_lib.c and test/conf_include_test.c, change string allocation to use OPENSSL_strdup() to match the memory source later freed by OPENSSL_free().

Add ML-KEM-768 known-answer tests from BoringSSL and extend the test framework to support deterministic key generation, encapsulation, and decapsulation, as well as key export/import functionality. (architecture-related: public API)

Remove redundant RSA encryption/decryption known-answer tests in the FIPS module because the existing RSA signature verification KAT already satisfies the testing requirements for all RSA use cases, thereby reducing module startup overhead. (Architecture-related: FIPS self-test optimization)
Add pairing consistency tests for ML-KEM key generation and import in FIPS mode to meet FIPS 140-3 requirements. (architecture-related: FIPS compliance)
Add test coverage for issue #25298 and unify the indentation format of JSON test configuration files.
Refactor and unify multiple duplicated ST_KAT_PARAM to OSSL_PARAM conversion code in providers/fips/self_test_kats.c.
Make minor fixes to the QUIC RADIX test framework in test/radix/quic_bindings.c, test/radix/quic_ops.c, and test/radix/terp.c, including eliminating uninitialized variable warnings.
In test/testutil/tests.c, call test_flush_stdout() before test_note() output to prevent interleaving of bio_out buffered data with TAP parser output that could corrupt test output.
In test/lhash_test.c, adjust the free order to free the hash table before freeing the atomic worker_lock, avoiding freeing hash table elements with an already-freed lock.
Make minor cosmetic changes to test/http_test.c.
Remove the unused buffer field from the stanza structure in test/testutil.h.
Support thread-local overriding of the output BIO in test/testutil.h and test/testutil/basic_output.c.
Add the QUIC RADIX test framework implementation under the test/radix/ directory, involving main.c, quic_bindings.c, quic_ops.c, quic_radix.c, quic_tests.c, and terp.c.

Add QUIC RADIX test functionality in quic_bindings.c, quic_ops.c, and quic_tests.c under test/radix/, including key log support, multi-threaded tests, SSL_poll functionality tests, enhanced blocking support, and domain function tests.
Fix a minor flaw in test/radix/quic_bindings.c.
In test/radix/quic_ops.c, ensure that the connection acceptance operation does not block.
Fix the simple_conn test in test/radix/quic_tests.c.
Add QUIC basic domain flag tests in test/quicapitest.c.
Remove test cases from test/quic_multistream_test.c that verify blocking SSL_poll does not work.
Add QUIC listener polling support tests in test/radix/quic_tests.c.
Eliminate undefined behavior in test/wpackettest.c caused by dereferencing unaligned rand_data directly as uint64_t.

Add test/bio_pw_callback_test.c and related test data, covering BIO password callback behavior for negative return values, zero-length passwords, passwords that exactly fill the buffer, incorrectly reported lengths, and binary passwords containing null bytes.

Refactor the callback test code in test/bio_pw_callback_test.c, replacing global variables with a local structure containing a magic number and a result flag, to handle user data and verify the callback is called at least once.
Remove redundant non-negative checks for unsigned values in test/bio_base64_test.c.
Change the password variable in test/bio_pw_callback_test.c from char* to const char[], update memcpy and return statements accordingly to use sizeof, and rename key_password to weak_password.
Add tests for EVP_get_default_properties, involving test/default-for-evptest.cnf, test/evp_extra_test.c, and test/recipes/30-test_evp_extra.t.
Add early ticking tests in test/quicapitest.c to ensure that calling SSL_handle_events() or SSL_get_event_timeout() early does not inadvertently start the connection.
Fix null pointer dereference in test/cmp_vfy_test.c (Coverity 1619463).
Adjust tests in test/evp_libctx_test.c to obtain output lengths for EVP_PKEY_encap and EVP_PKEY_decap.
Fix provider compatibility CI regression in test/evp_libctx_test.c introduced by #25522.
Add a test in test/threadstest.c for freeing a shared EVP_PKEY across threads.
Use test_random() in the multithreaded hash table test in test/lhash_test.c for better reproducibility.
Enhance the stress test strength of test_hashtable_multithread() in test/lhash_test.c.
Fix misuse of size_t variadic arguments as int in EVP_PKEY_Q_keygen in test/acvp_test.c, test/evp_libctx_test.c, test/pairwise_fail_test.c, and test/threadstest.c.
Add new_session_cb callback tests for QUIC objects in test/quicapitest.c.
Add tests in test/quicapitest.c for setting TLSv1.2 cipher suites for QUIC objects.

Extend the QUIC interoperability test framework to support server-side testing, add demos/guide/quic-hq-interop-server.c, and modify test/quic-openssl-docker/Dockerfile and run_endpoint.sh to support the server role.

Modify the version negotiation test in test/quic_multistream_test.c: change script_74 to use the QUIC channel mutator to invalidate the initial packet version instead of using the packet injector, and update the gen_version_neg function to correctly insert version 0 in the packet header of script_75.
Add new key type tests for EVP_PKEY_Q_keygen, involving test/evp_extra_test2.c and test/build.info.
Zero the parameter array in test/evp_test.c to ensure correct initialization.

Fix intermittent failure of test/lhash_test.c on Windows by setting the pending_delete flag before actual deletion, preventing other threads from acquiring the delete callback before ossl_ht_write_unlock().
Add nocache provider behavior tests, involving test/nocache-and-default.cnf, test/p_test.c, and test/recipes/20-test_nocache.t.
Fix memory leak on error path in test_evp_cipher_pipeline().
Fix multiple test failures when the default TLS security level is set to 0 at compile time.
Fix memory detector issue in tls_construct_stoc_next_proto_neg where the npa variable is uninitialized and passed to WPACKET_sub_memcpy_u16.
Declare the missing variable in memleaktest.c as volatile to prevent gcc from optimizing away the memory leak.
Fix sporadic test failure in 30-test_evp_extra.t.
Fix unaligned memory access for uint64_t type in test/wpackettest.c.
Make ML-KEM tests run in FIPS builds as well.
Add evp_test support for ACVP test vectors for ML-DSA, and enlarge the evp_test line buffer to 32K.
Add tests for KDF context reset in test_kdf_scrypt().
Add coverage tests for ML-DSA and remove some ACVP test data from ml_dsa.inc.
Add new quic-server fuzz test and update the fuzz corpus submodule.
Update endecode_test.c to accommodate ML-DSA being added to the FIPS provider.
Add digestsign tests for ML-DSA, requiring the digest to be NULL.
Use the recorded short connection ID length in pktsplitbio and qtestlib to decode packets.
Set the properties of the ML-KEM codec to fips=yes.
Add initial version ML-KEM fuzzer supporting key creation, generation, encapsulation/decapsulation, shared secret derivation, import/export, and key comparison operations.
Update ML-DSA signature generation, key generation, and signature verification test data to cover μ input.

Add initial version SLH-DSA fuzzer supporting key pair generation, parameterized key generation, import/export, and signature verification operations; also update corpus to include ml-kem seed corpus.
Remove session and PSK tests from clienthellotest as they are too fragile and of limited value.
Add test for configuring provider certificates via configuration file to cover previously crashing scenario.
Add TLS certificate tests for ML-DSA, add certificate and key files for root-ml-dsa-44 and server-ml-dsa-44, and update 20-cert-select test configuration.
Increase timeout for test_fin_only_blocking test from 20ms to 40ms to accommodate longer SSL_read_ex() duration on high-load systems.
Introduce hybrid KEM tests in FIPS mode in sslapitest, and fix test_ssl_new to reuse FIPS provider for tests, generating different test configurations based on FIPS provider version.
Allow DHE in TLS 1.2 and earlier in ssl_test.c.
Add SSL_NO_EOED macro test in sslapitest.c corresponding to test_no_end_of_early_data test case.

Introduce extended test mechanism in evp_test, running only when EVP_TEST_EXTENDED environment variable is set to non-zero integer; also add Verify-Message-Public test type accepting public key instead of private key for verification.
Increased the line length limit for reading stanzas in testutil to support very long data lines for PQC algorithms, especially SLH-DSA.
Fix reference output files for ssltrace test, update ssltraceref.txt and ssltraceref-zlib.txt to match slightly longer frame format after merge.
Fix memory leak in ecdsa_keygen_knownanswer_test, free allocated EC_POINT when subsequent checks fail.
Fix compilation issue in quicapitest.c under no-ssl-trace configuration.
Add check for zalloc returning NULL in tls-provider.c by inverting if statement.
Replace snprintf with BIO_snprintf in http_test.c; replace strdup with OPENSSL_strdup and add NULL check in quicapitest.c.
Fix buffer growth calculation and stream acknowledgment issues in QUIC tests.
Improve QUIC tests: add wildcard matching, advance simulated time to ensure handshake completion, and use fake time to resolve Windows platform instability.
Add OOM (out-of-memory) handler in x509 fuzzer.
Set the initial value of op_num in test/radix/terp.c to 0; this variable is only used to record the number of completed operations.
Re-enable the RCU stress test on MACOSX; this test was previously disabled due to random failures.
Enable the required groups for high security level tests in the test configuration.

Fix the incorrect prediction of the result code in the slh-dsa fuzz test, so that the determination of expect_rc_init depends on both the allocation of a context_string larger than 255 bytes and whether selector bit 1 creates that parameter.
Add a record overflow test to the regression test suite for the tlsfuzzer external test.
Adjust expectations for the legacy FIPS provider in evp_libctx_test.c, not requiring the kemop operation to succeed for the outdated FIPS module.
Remove the RSA KEM test from the evp_test data file evppkey_rsa.txt.
In the evp_test data file evppkey_rsa.txt, set the condition for the SHA1/MD5 tests to depend on the default provider.
Fix the untested error code path in test/evp_test.c.
Add evp_test data for ECX KEM tests in test/recipes/30-test_evp_data/evppkey_ecx_kem.txt.
Test in test/sslapitest.c that no BIO needs to be set when using the QUIC TLS API.
Test the use of EVP_DigestSignInit() with ECDSA and the KECCAK-256 hash in test/evp_extra_test.c.
Fix an infinite loop in test/quic_multistream_test.c caused by injecting an overly short OSSL_QUIC_FRAME_TYPE_PATH_CHALLENGE packet, and add more frame type formatting to handle empty frame issues.

In test/helpers/noisydgrambio.c and test/helpers/quictestlib.c, configure the backoff time to be calculated per frame count, so that QUIC tests do not drop the first two initial frames, to handle the case where ML-KEM key sharing causes TLS messages to span multiple datagrams.
Remove verbose tar output in .github/workflows/make-test to avoid log clutter.
Exclude the retry interoperability test with the msquic server in .github/workflows/run_quic_interop.yml, and re-add chrome to the client list.
Support sending files in demos/http3/ossl-nghttp3-demo-server.c for browser testing, and adjust the polling logic to work compatibly with chrome.
Added AES-XTS hardware acceleration support for x86_64 and s390x architectures, leveraging AVX-512 and CPACF instructions to improve performance. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)
Optimize the fast path of X509_STORE_CTX_get1_issuer() in crypto/x509/x509_lu.c, x509_vfy.c, and x509_local.h.
Optimized the decoder to reduce unnecessary decoder attempts by more precisely tracking input types (DER, PVK, MSBLOB) and algorithms, improving performance.
Optimized the ossl_namemap_name2num_n function to use hash table lookup instead of strndup, improving performance.
Added skeymgmt helper functions in crypto/evp/skeymgmt_meth.c and include/crypto/evp.h to directly fetch from the same provider.
Refactored the squeezing logic for empty tuples in ssl/t1_lib.c to improve efficiency when handling multiple empty tuples.
Pass IV to EVP_CipherInit_ex for non-AEAD ciphers in -evp runs in apps/speed.c.
Updated CHANGES.md to document performance optimization of AVX_IFMA parallel modular exponentiation on Intel Sierra Forest processors.
Check block size before running EVP_Cipher_loop() in apps/speed.c.
Changed the declaration of aead_ivlen to #define in apps/speed.c.
Reverted the previous incorrect macOS RCU fix in crypto/threads_pthread.c.
Cleaned up and accelerated ML-KEM implementation in crypto/ml_kem/ml_kem.c, providers/implementations/encode_decode/encode_key2any.c, keymgmt/ml_kem_kmgmt.c, mlx_kmgmt.c, and test files.

Prohibited SHA1 with strength below 112 bits in DH and ECDH key exchanges, renamed related FIPS indicator check functions, and skipped CMS test cases that depend on SHA1. (architecture-related: external behavior)

Fixed buffer overflows caused by direct dereferencing of BIO_ADDR in multiple places in the QUIC stack, switched to BIO_ADDR_copy() for safe address copying, and added zeroing in BIO_ADDR_make. (architecture-related: public API)
Refuse to import private keys that have not passed the PCT test, and add a validate method to the provider to encapsulate the PCT test. (Architecture-related: provider validate method)
Fixed the issue where the OSSL_PKEY_PARAM_SECURITY_BITS getter in ML-DSA returned an incorrect security bit value (off by a factor of 8). (architecture-related: public API)

The BN_GF2m_poly2arr function now rejects polynomials with a constant term of zero or degree exceeding the limit, and clarifies the meaning of return values to prevent memory out-of-bounds and CPU exhaustion attacks.
Forced the OpenSSL internal DRBG to always use the derivation function, removing the optional use_df parameter to meet FIPS validation requirements.
Added zeroization of the public key when freeing ECX keys to comply with FIPS security requirements.
In the FROS and WOTS implementations of SLH_DSA, added zeroization of secret keys and temporary buffers, and adjusted error handling paths to ensure sensitive data is properly cleared.
In the FIPS self-test module, zeroized temporary output variables to meet ISO/IEC 19790 security standard requirements.
Fixed a heap buffer overflow in the ossl_i2c_ASN1_BIT_STRING function that could occur when the data is all zeros.
Adjusted the server address validation logic to be disabled only for new connections without tokens, ensuring that tokens provided via NEW_TOKEN frames are still validated.
Added send and receive credit tracking functionality for unvalidated QUIC connections, recording and adjusting credit checks and consumption logic before connection validation completes.

Fixed the security vulnerability (CVE-2024-12797) where the SSL_VERIFY_PEER flag was not effective when using RPK; now the client aborts the connection when server X.509 validation fails, and added related test cases.
Added constant-time validation macros for ML-KEM key generation, encapsulation, and decapsulation functions, supporting detection of secret-dependent side channels under Valgrind.
Fixed the timing side-channel vulnerability in ECDSA signature computation (CVE-2024-13176) by introducing a fixed-top modular exponentiation function to eliminate timing signals.
Fixed the multi-threaded data race issue in the asn1_str2tag() function caused by the tntmp variable being incorrectly declared as static.
Rejected incorrect public key hashes in private keys and refactored key management functions to enhance security and correctness.

Fixed the Minerva timing side-channel vulnerability for the P-384 curve on PPC platforms: switched to bn_mul_mont_int in Montgomery multiplication and rewrote the assembly implementation of the felem arithmetic functions.
Before creating the QUIC channel, perform initial AEAD packet validation through a pre-created QRX object; after validation passes, create the channel and pass the QRX into it.
Extended the HTTP method check in TLS record header validation to add detection of PATCH, DELETE, OPTIONS, and TRACE methods.
Refactored the FIPS indicator check in providers/implementations/keymgmt/ec_kmgmt.c to use ossl_fips_ind_ec_key_check() for consistency with other locations.
Updated documentation in INSTALL.md and doc/man7/openssl-env.pod to reflect the security risks of SSLKEYLOGFILE.
Added entries for CVE-2024-9143 in CHANGES.md and NEWS.md and updated security release information.
Added PROV_R_INVALID_TAG_LENGTH and ERR_R_PASSED_INVALID_ARGUMENT error messages for tag length validation of the EVP_CTRL_AEAD_SET_TAG parameter in cipher_aes_ocb.c for the AES-OCB algorithm.
Added amplification limit tests in the run_quic_interop_server.yml workflow to verify that the server adheres to QUIC amplification limits in CI runs.
Added daily run checker tests in run-checker-daily.yml to verify that tests still pass when users lower the default TLS security level during configuration.
Migrated the fuzz-checker workflow to ubuntu-24.04, fixed the missing afl++-clang package, used clang-18, and configured ubsan with -fno-sanitize=function.
Enhanced ThreadSanitizer CI tests in ci.yml and run-checker-merge.yml.
Disabled SLH-DSA in the MemorySanitizer build in ci.yml.
Added a MemorySanitizer run configuration with SLH-DSA enabled in run-checker-daily.yml.

Added sections for OpenSSL 3.5 in CHANGES.md and NEWS.md, and updated the related release notes.
Recorded changes to the DRBG in the FIPS provider and the addition of the PKCS#7 internal content verification feature in CHANGES.md.
Updated the Wiki links in the documentation to point to the new GitHub Wiki location.
Added the doc/designs/evp_skey.md design document describing the scheme for using opaque objects as symmetric keys.
Added and updated the doc/designs/quic-design/server/quic-server-api.md QUIC server API design document.

Added and updated the doc/designs/quic-design/server/quic-polling.md QUIC polling design document, including renaming the OSSL_ prefix to SSL_, adjusting the section structure, and adding discussion of event types.
Updated the doc/designs/quic-design/glossary.md QUIC glossary document.
Added doc/designs/quic-design/quic-concurrency.md and the accompanying SVG diagram, describing the QUIC concurrency architecture design.
Updated the QUIC TLS design document, adjusting the callback function parameter names to match the new third-party QUIC stack API.
Added the EVP pipeline API design document.
Fixed detailed descriptions in multiple man1 and man3 documents regarding IPv6 host addresses and whitespace handling in no_proxy.

Added notes in the openssl-s_client.pod.in documentation about non-interactive use of s_client, explaining the -ign_eof option and input redirection, and pointing out potential hangs in SMTP and HTTP/1.1 scenarios.
Add more documentation comments to the demos/guide/quic-hq-interop.c example code.

Add configuration support for the Embarcadero-Borland Clang Compiler 64 (BCC64) in Configurations/50-cppbuilder.conf, and update NOTES-WINDOWS.md.

In the EVP_PKEY_encapsulate.pod and EVP_PKEY_decapsulate.pod documentation, explain that unwrappedlen/wrappedlen must be set to the corresponding buffer size, and synchronously update the providers/implementations/kem/rsa_kem.c implementation.
Add a HISTORY section for 3.0+ in the openssl-fipsinstall documentation, and record the command-line options added in versions 3.1.0, 3.2.0, and 3.4.0 respectively.
Unify the terms app and apps in CHANGES.md to command and commands to maintain terminology consistency.

Improve the descriptions of options such as -rawin, -digest, and -sign in the openssl-pkeyutl documentation, update SHA-1 to SHA256 in examples and default values, and fix several other documentation contents.
Fix the error in the encryption example command in the openssl-smime documentation by moving the PEM recipient certificate parameter to the end of the command line.
Change the example value of default_md in the openssl-ca documentation from md5 to a more appropriate value.
Remove references to git.openssl.org from README.md.

Document the non-standard behavior when checking the EKU extension of CA and TA certificates in multiple documentation pages (including openssl-cms, openssl-s_client, openssl-s_server, openssl-verification-options, and related man3 pages).
Add a HISTORY section to multiple documentation pages that lack it, and add a check for the HISTORY section in the find-doc-nits tool.
Add the ML-DSA design document doc/designs/ml-dsa.md, and update the related EVP_PKEY-ML-DSA, EVP_SIGNATURE-ML-DSA, and OSSL_PROVIDER-default documentation.
Move crypto/bn/README.pod to the internal documentation location doc/internal/man3/bn_mul_words.pod, and remove outdated information.
Update the OpenSSL documentation links in doc/README.md to the currently used addresses, and remove the standards.txt section that points to pages that no longer exist.
Make minor corrections to CMP and HTTP related documentation (openssl-cmp.pod.in, OSSL_CMP_ITAV_new_caCerts.pod, OSSL_HTTP_transfer.pod) and configuration files.
Update NEWS.md before release, adding omitted change descriptions and new feature lists.

Update QUIC related documentation: remove the limitation note in README.md that QUIC is only client-supported, add information about OpenSSL 3.5 server-side QUIC support and example run commands in README-QUIC.md, and record QUIC server support in CHANGES.md, NEWS.md, and related man3 documentation.
Update README-FIPS.md to reflect the latest release version and FIPS validation version information.
Added a list of known issues for OpenSSL 3.5.0 in NEWS.md.

The fipsinstall tool now defaults to saving the status indicator for backward compatibility when it detects that the loaded FIPS provider is version 3.0.x, and added support for the x942kdf_key_check option. (architecture-related: FIPS configuration behavior)

Added a GitHub Actions release workflow that automates the release process. (architecture-related: release process)

Fixed an incorrect variable reference in a die statement in the build script configdata.pm.in.
Added conditional compilation guards for the ossl_rand_jitter_get_seed function so that it is excluded when OPENSSL_NO_FIPS_JITTER is defined.

Fix the release process so that when the tag name contains alpha or beta, the GitHub Release is correctly marked as a pre-release version.
Allow uploading build artifacts even if tests fail.

Added the 3.5 branch in coveralls.yml.

Run make update to update error code related files, including openssl.txt, proverr.h, and provider_err.c.

In demos/guide/quic-hq-interop-server.c, add read retry handling for transient SSL_read failures.
In demos/quic/server/server.c, change the QUIC Server Demo to use only IPv4, and add a QUIC server usage demonstration along with the related Makefile and README.

In apps/lib/http_server.c, clarify that http_server_init() uses IPv4 or IPv6.
In ssl/rio/rio_notifier.c, add error message output in ossl_rio_notifier_init().
In ssl/t1_trce.c, add ML-KEM TLS Supported Groups according to the newly assigned IANA numbers.
In demos/guide/quic-server-non-block.c and related documentation, remove redundant FD_SET calls.
In crypto/x509/v3_admis.c, adjust the namingAuthority output format of the admission extension, adding two-level indentation.
Correct "a SSL" to "an SSL" in multiple documents, comments, and code.
In demos/http3/ossl-nghttp3-demo-server.c, add the <sys/socket.h> header file inclusion for OpenBSD.
In multiple files, check the return values of various sk_*_push functions such as sk_X509_CRL_push, sk_POLICY_MAPPING_push, sk_GENERAL_NAME_push, and handle them accordingly.
Update the ML-DSA encoder in crypto/ml_dsa/ml_dsa_key.c and the providers encoding implementations to adapt to master branch changes.

In the QUIC implementation, remove the unimplemented SSL_LISTENER_FLAG_NO_ACCEPT flag and related documentation, and move connection close frames handling, RETIRE CONN ID frames implementation, and EAGAIN handling for QUIC retry/verneg frames to QUIC FUTURE.
Move the token store definition from openssl/ssl.h.in to include/internal/quic_predef.h.
In apps/lib/s_cb.c, add logging of the peer temporary key name from the provider.
In quic_tls_api.c, add the ssl_unwrap.h header file inclusion.
In the key management implementations of ml-dsa, ml-kem, and slh-dsa, avoid performing pairwise tests during key generation CAST.
