Fixed the issue of decoders being prioritized via attribute query strings, so that attribute queries can be applied to decoder instance scoring and selection.
Ensure the FIPS internal provider is actively loaded at initialization, to avoid the problem of it not being found due to lazy loading. (architecture-related: core module behavior)

Separate the memory allocation of public and private keys in ML-KEM and ML-DSA key structures; private key parts use secure memory, public key parts use normal memory, to reduce secure memory usage. (architecture-related: secure memory allocation)

Separate the storage of handshake traffic hash from tls13_change_cipher_state, and have the state machine explicitly store it at the appropriate time. (architecture-related: TLS 1.3 state machine refactoring)

Add symmetric key management (SKEYMGMT) support in the FIPS provider, including algorithm support, the EVP_SKEY_import_SKEYMGMT function, and the key_type parameter of the derive_skey function. (architecture-related: public API)
Add LMS signature algorithm support, including public key decoding, signature verification, FIPS provider integration, and key management. (architecture-related: public API)
Add the EVP_PKEY_derive_SKEY and EVP_KDF_derive_SKEY API families, supporting direct derivation of secure key objects via key exchange and KDF. (architecture-related: public API)
Implement KEMRecipientInfo (RFC9629) in CMS, add ML-KEM support, and add the -recip_kdf and -recip_ukm command-line parameters. (architecture-related: public API)
Add OCSP multi-staple support for TLS 1.3 server certificates, allowing an independent OCSP response for each certificate in the certificate chain. (architecture-related: public API)
Add the SSL_CTX_set_ec_point_formats and SSL_set_ec_point_formats interfaces for configuring EC point formats, and add the SSL_OP_LEGACY_EC_POINT_FORMATS option. (architecture-related: public API)

Add fixed-digest HKDF algorithms: HKDF-SHA256, HKDF-SHA384, and HKDF-SHA512; the digests of these algorithms cannot be changed, and the corresponding RFC 8619 algorithm identifiers are defined. (architecture-related: public API)

Add hardware acceleration support for the SM4 encryption algorithm on x86-64 platforms, including key setup, encryption, and decryption functions, and integrate it into CCM, GCM, XTS, and other modes. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)
Add the kekcipher option for CMS password recipient information, and prohibit the use of AEAD ciphers as key encryption algorithms. (architecture-related: public API)

Add detailed output for the openssl list -store-loaders command, displaying settable parameters of provider-based STORE loaders; also add the OSSL_STORE_LOADER_settable_ctx_params function. (architecture-related: public API)

Support parsing of private key information in PKCS#8 V2 format, and verify that the version number only allows v1 and v2, while rejecting the inclusion of a public key in v1. (architecture-related: parsing behavior)

Add z17 machine generation support for the s390x architecture, allowing the specification of z17 as the machine generation via the environment variable OPENSSL_s390xcap. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)

Introduce a thunk mechanism for the OPENSSL_sk interface, allowing the setting of a custom free function, and call this function in OPENSSL_sk_pop_free to avoid UBSan warnings. (architecture-related: public API)
Refactor parameter helper code and add the OSSL_PARAM_set_octet_string_or_ptr function. (architecture-related: public API)
HKDF functionality enhancement: allow the salt parameter to be set to null, and extend the gettable parameters to support digest algorithms and modes. (architecture-related: public API)
ML-DSA, ML-KEM, SLH-DSA algorithm enhancements: expose internal functions, add msg_update support, and add security category parameters. (architecture-related: public API)
ECX, EC, DSA key management add support for security category parameters. (architecture-related: public API)

Expose settable parameters of the symmetric key management module, supporting the passing of raw byte data via the OSSL_SKEY_PARAM_RAW_BYTES parameter; add the EVP_PKEY_get_security_category function. (architecture-related: public API)
Allow copying a PKEY context without an operation set and then performing key generation. (architecture-related: public API)

Added CRYPTO_THREAD_get_local_ex and CRYPTO_THREAD_set_local_ex APIs, using enum fixed key IDs to implement thread-local storage based on key and libctx values, and updated the cleanup function for FIPS self-tests. (architecture-related: public API)
Update FIPS indicator functions to provide non-positional and positional versions of set_ctx_param and get_ctx_param. (architecture-related: public API)

provider_util adds helper functions such as set_propq and set_engine, and refactors the loading functions for cipher, digest, and macctx to directly accept individual parameter pointers. (architecture-related: public API)
Add the X509_CRL_get0_tbs_sigalg public API to obtain the TBSCertList signature algorithm identifier of a CRL. (architecture-related: public API)
Introduce the SSL_OP_SERVER_PREFERENCE option, replacing the inaccurately named SSL_OP_CIPHER_SERVER_PREFERENCE. (architecture-related: public API)

Add an MD5 assembly implementation for the RISC-V architecture, supporting rv64gc and the Zbb instruction set, with performance improved by 10%–50% compared to compiler-generated code. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)
Add array memory allocation routines that automatically perform integer overflow checks, making allocation semantics clearer. (architecture-related: public API)
Pass the ERR_count_to_mark function to the provider via the in scheduling array during provider initialization. (architecture-related: public API)
Add contentCommitment as an alias for nonRepudiation in the X.509 keyUsage extension, and update the output logic to avoid duplicate display of the alias. (architecture-related: public API)
Implement deterministic ECDSA signing functionality in the FIPS provider and add self-test descriptors. (architecture-related: FIPS compliance)
Add the pairing consistency test required by FIPS 140-3 during DH key generation. (architecture-related: FIPS compliance)
Added FIPS module import PCT error codes and their corresponding error description strings. (architecture-related: public API)

Improved conflict detection in OBJ_create(), checking for duplicate objects after acquiring the write lock and returning NID_undef on duplicates; also refactored OBJ_add_object() to support duplicate detection. (architecture-related: public API)
In FIPS mode, added pairwise consistency tests (PCT) for Ed25519, Ed448, EC, and RSA key imports to meet FIPS 140-3 requirements. (architecture-related: FIPS compliance)
In RCU code, reduced the minimum number of qp to 2, changed the atomic load of reader_idx to RELAXED memory order, and clarified comments.
Added the -in option to the prime command, supporting reading numbers from a file for primality testing.
Added SHA256-192 digest algorithm support inside the FIPS provider and created an internal digest table.
The ML-DSA export function now supports exporting the public key separately.
The x509 tool added the -multi option to support processing multiple certificates, fixed the issue of the -addreject option misusing the trust list, and re-added ERR queue printing on errors.
Added unidirectional and bidirectional stream type flags to SSL_accept_stream, allowing callers to specify accepting streams of specific types.
The openssl application added the ability to initialize secure memory at startup via the environment variables OPENSSL_SEC_MEM and OPENSSL_SEC_MEM_MINSIZE.
The openssl rand command now uses the loaded library context to generate random numbers.
Added support for the hh length modifier in the _dopr function, enabling correct handling of signed char and unsigned char type arguments.
Added pairwise consistency tests for SLH-DSA key import in FIPS mode, and added helper functions to obtain the libctx and reset the key.
Added support for the %t format specifier to handle ptrdiff_t type arguments in BIO printing functions.
Added key size checks before applying the key, and adjusted the key initialization order.
Added changelog and news entries for the new openssl configutl tool.
Added a design document for RFC4514 DN output format.
Added a changelog entry in CHANGES.md about the refactoring of OSSL_PARAM name resolution.
Updated generated decoder implementations (including various ciphers, digests, key management, and signature algorithms) to handle return codes.
Added an initial HTTP/1.0 server implementation for benchmarking the OpenSSL QUIC stack, accepting only GET requests and returning HTTP 200 OK with a text/plain response body.
Add GENERIC SKEYMGMT support in the legacy provider.
Add generated parameter decoders and related build configuration for blake2.
Add helper functions to copy custom extensions using legacy parameters.
Add new utility function PACKET_get_4_len() in the packet module to get 4 bytes from network order and store as uint32_t.
Add helper functions for non-positional parameters to the params module.
Move creation of the ADDED_OBJ hash table to a RUN_ONCE routine to avoid creation checks while holding the write lock.
Use OPENSSL_zalloc instead of the malloc+memset combination in ecp_nistp256.c.
Remove assertions in core_namemap.c and correctly handle error returns from ossl_ht_insert on memory allocation failure.
Make padding and salt length parameter decoding in the RSA signature implementation more straightforward.
Update the keymgmt template to use auto-generated parameter name decoders and add missing functions.
Fix compilation errors and runtime probing issues for Windows registry configuration, correcting buffer types and API calls. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)
Fix the issue where the client failed to correctly save the signature algorithm extension during TLS post-handshake authentication. (Architecture-related: TLS handshake behavior)
Fix URL parsing issues with missing port and paths containing ISO 8601 timestamps. (architecture-related: public API)
Remove references to poll.h on the NonStop platform to avoid including that header. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)
Fix memory ordering issues on weak-ordered systems by adding a dummy atomic release operation in update_qp to ensure visibility. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)

Fix the list of gettable parameters in ECX key management by removing the OSSL_PKEY_PARAM_MANDATORY_DIGEST parameter from the common ECX parameters, keeping it only in the Ed25519/Ed448 parameter lists. (architecture-related: public API)
Adjust the cleanup order when releasing SSL connections to ensure SSL_get_app_data() is accessible in callbacks, and fix OCSP resource release. (architecture-related: public API)

Fix the use of CCM cipher suites in the QUIC TLS API by introducing an internal flag to distinguish internal QUIC connections, ensuring cipher suite restrictions are correctly applied. (architecture-related: QUIC TLS API)

Move the change of the QUIC 0-RTT handshake read key earlier into SSL_set_accept_state to avoid the application needing an extra SSL_do_handshake call when no data is readable. (architecture-related: SSL_set_accept_state)

Fixed the issue where the i2d_ASN1_bio_stream() function always returned 1 when the SMIME_STREAM flag was not set, so that it now correctly returns the actual result of the ASN1_item_i2d_bio() call. (architecture-related: i2d_ASN1_bio_stream)

Fixed a silent error in EVP_CIPHER_CTX_get_updated_iv, added the OSSL_PARAM_set_octet_string_or_ptr API function, and switched multiple cipher get_ctx_params implementations to use this function to correctly set the IV parameter. (architecture-related: OSSL_PARAM_set_octet_string_or_ptr)
Fixed the error of multi-line output in the crl command, ensuring that a global variable is used to set the change. (architecture-related: public API)

Fixed edge cases in signature algorithm negotiation: allow self-signed certificates to use signature algorithms not declared in extensions, and corrected the memory allocation call; also avoid sending TLS 1.3 signature algorithms to TLS 1.2 clients. (architecture-related: signature algorithm negotiation behavior)
Fixed a memory leak in the UI_dup_* family of functions where the duplicated string was not freed when memory allocation failed. (architecture-related: public API)
Fixed a potential crash in SSL_do_handshake when the SSL_CONNECTION pointer is NULL, by adding a NULL pointer check. (architecture-related: external behavior)

Fixed the issue of retrieving the updated IV in the ChaCha20 cipher, adjusting the counter increment logic to ensure the updated IV is correctly returned. (architecture-related: ChaCha20 cipher behavior)
Fixed the issue of calling SSL_new() when using the QUIC server method. (architecture-related: QUIC public API)
Fixed the issue of calling SSL_accept() on a QUIC server connection object; it now works normally. (architecture-related: QUIC public API)

Fixed the issue where HKDF with a fixed digest was incorrectly restricted when setting the digest; parameters can now be correctly retrieved and set, and related tests were updated. (architecture-related: public API)

Fixed the issue where EVP_PKEY_CTX_dup() did not copy the keymgmt pointer, avoiding a segmentation fault caused by accessing a NULL pointer in a subsequent call to EVP_PKEY_CTX_derive_set_peer_ex(). (architecture-related: public API)
Fixed the issue where SSL_poll incorrectly reported a stream as writable when it was not actually writable, by adding a check for send credit. (architecture-related: public API)
Fixed the default private key DER output format to PKCS#8, and extended the -traditional option to support DER output. (architecture-related: CLI behavior)

Fixed the issue where SSL_accept() and SSL_get_error() incorrectly added errors to the error stack when passed an incorrect object type, and ensured that SSL_set_accept_state() and SSL_set_connect_state() no longer produce spurious errors. (architecture-related: public API)

When importing an ML-KEM private key, if the public key hash does not match, an appropriate error message is now added to the error stack, rather than merely failing to parse. (architecture-related: public API)

Added error queue entries for keymgmt, signature verification, and asynchronous encryption operations, adding more detailed error information when provider operations fail. (architecture-related: public API)

Added error checks for BIO_printf, BIO_puts, and asn1_write_micalg calls in the SMIME_write_ASN1_ex function, ensuring the function returns correctly when writes fail. (architecture-related: public API)
Improved I/O error checking in the PEM_write_bio_ASN1_stream function, ensuring return values are also checked when writing the PEM header and footer. (architecture-related: public API)
Added missing I/O error checks to the SMIME_crlf_copy and SMIME_text functions, ensuring errors are handled correctly when write operations fail. (architecture-related: public API)
Added missing I/O error checks to the SMIME_text function, ensuring the correct error status is returned when BIO_write fails. (architecture-related: public API)
Added error queue entries for providers when signing and verification operations fail, to compensate for cases where they may not add errors. (architecture-related: public API)

Fixed a crash on PPC64 targets below Power9 for the P-384 curve caused by incorrect use of the accelerated implementation; it now falls back to the generic implementation. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)
In the FIPS module, when the pairwise consistency test for ML-DSA or SLH-DSA fails, the module enters an error state. (architecture-related: FIPS compliance behavior)
Fixed the handling logic for hostnames and IP addresses in the SSL_set1_host and SSL_add1_host functions, and updated the related documentation. (architecture-related: public API)
Fixed issues with BIO_printf for negative %e formatting and INF/NAN formatting, avoiding infinite loops and normalizing display of invalid values. (architecture-related: public API)
Relaxed the strict check for absolute paths in the file: URI scheme, now allowing relative paths to improve user experience. (architecture-related: external behavior)
Added a dummy field to the poll builder structure to resolve compatibility issues with Microsoft compilers regarding empty structures. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)
Fixed handling of erroneous downgrade signals, ensuring connections are correctly rejected when a non-compliant server sends an erroneous downgrade signal. (architecture-related: external behavior)

Fixed two issues in DTLS application data record handling: discarding empty records to avoid SSL_read() incorrectly reporting failure, and fixing the issue where the pointer was not advanced after releasing buffered records, causing repeated reads of empty data. (architecture-related: external behavior)

Fixed behavior issues related to renegotiation and session reuse in DTLS and TLS protocols: DTLS now terminates the connection upon receiving a no_renegotiation warning, and the TLSv1.3 server no longer incorrectly sends the PSK extension after SSL_clear(). (architecture-related: external behavior)
When resetting an SSL connection, reset the consumed flag for QUIC TLS local transport parameters to 0. (architecture-related: QUIC TLS internal behavior)
Treat a 0 value returned by DH key computation as an error, and added a check for an empty DH object. (architecture-related: DH key computation behavior)
Fixed a memory leak in the PKCS7_verify function where tmpout was not freed when OPENSSL_malloc failed, moving the BIO_free call to a unified error handling path. (architecture-related: public API)

Fixed the failure of the cipher BIO to mark its state as finished on a non-retryable EOF, preventing decryption failures caused by subsequent BIO_flush or read operations incorrectly attempting to finalise the encryption state again. (architecture-related: cipher BIO behavior)
Added parameter precondition checks for the ASN1_STRING_TABLE_get and ASN1_STRING_TABLE_add functions; invalid parameters now return an error. (architecture-related: public API)

Fixed the issue where SSL_set_SSL_CTX() overwrote connection custom extensions when switching contexts; added a flag to preserve connection custom extensions, avoiding loss of QUIC transport parameters. (architecture-related: public API)
Removed the deprecated _strlen31 function and its strlen macro redefinition on Win64 platforms, which had potentially serious side effects. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)
Fixed the EVP_RAND_nonce function to correctly return the actual result and added parameter error checks, improving API robustness. (architecture-related: public API)
Allowed reuse of thread-local storage keys in configurations without threads, breaking the hard limit of 256 LIB_CTX values. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)
Fixed the issue on s390x where HMAC did not return an error when update or final was called after the context had been finalized. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)
Migrated thread-local storage management for the random number generator to a new API, avoiding exhaustion of operating system thread-local storage space. (architecture-related: public API)

Migrated the thread event handler in the FIPS module to the new thread-local API, avoiding space exhaustion caused by allocating thread-local storage keys independently for each context. (architecture-related: public API)
Fixed the inconsistency of the parameter name in SSL_select_next_proto between the header file and the documentation. (architecture-related: public API)

Introduced the CRYPTO_THREAD_NO_CONTEXT special context identifier to avoid stack overflow caused by recursive calls in the thread-local storage API; also fixed parameter type conversion and size checks in ASYNC_init_thread. (architecture-related: thread API)

Refactored parameter handling in ciphercommon, removed obsolete and incorrect AEAD parameters, and switched to new parameter handling; fixed the list of settable context parameters for the ChaCha20-Poly1305 cipher. (architecture-related: public API)

Fixed multiple bugs in the LMS signature implementation, including W=1 truncated digest checksum errors, code review issues (error handling, byte order conversion, resource release), and added test coverage based on NIST ACVP. (architecture-related: public API)
Fixed the issue where OSSL_STORE did not consider cached information in the EOF check; moved the cached information check into the OSSL_STORE_eof function. (architecture-related: public API)
Refactored the parameter getter functions in the ECX/ED key manager, fixing the missing security category and FIPS indicator for the ED algorithm. (architecture-related: public API)

Fixed the issue where the QUIC ACK manager infinitely probed for timeout before the client handshake confirmation; according to RFC 9002 requirements, keep probing for timeout until the HANDSHAKE_DONE frame is received; added the is_server parameter to distinguish client and server behavior. (architecture-related: public API)
Fixed the issue where memory allocation failures were not reported in CRYPTO_realloc and CRYPTO_aligned_alloc; added error reporting and parameter validation. (architecture-related: public API)
Corrected error handling in signature verification operations to avoid generic errors overriding provider-specific errors. (architecture-related: public API)

Fixed the handling of IPv4-mapped IPv6 addresses in BIO_CTRL_DGRAM_QUERY_MTU by reusing the dgram_get_mtu_overhead function to correctly subtract the corresponding IP header size. (Architecture-related: BIO layer behavior)

Fixed the issue of cooperation between SSL_poll() and SSL_shutdown() in QUIC connections; when all streams are flushed, notify the channel so that SSL_poll() can correctly return events, thereby allowing SSL_shutdown() to continue completing the shutdown. (architecture-related: public API)
Fixed the memory leak caused by not freeing xalg->parameter when EVP_CIPHER_param_to_asn1 fails in PKCS7_dataInit. (architecture-related: public API)

Fixed the issue in the CMS_RecipientInfo_kemri_set_ukm function where the return value of ASN1_OCTET_STRING_set was not checked, and avoid calling OPENSSL_cleanse when keklen exceeds the buffer size. (architecture-related: public API)
Added an error reporting mechanism for memory allocation failures in the CRYPTO_realloc function. (architecture-related: public API)
Added the duplicate parameter error code PROV_R_REPEATED_PARAMETER and its corresponding error description string. (architecture-related: public API)

Fixed the handling of negative width parameters in bio_print.c to conform to printf specifications; negative width is correctly treated as a left-alignment flag. (architecture-related: external behavior)
Fixed the issue of incorrectly adding a prefix when the value is zero in octal and hexadecimal formatting. (architecture-related: external behavior)

Fixed the issue where OSSL_sleep may return early due to signals on POSIX systems; by looping to check the remaining time, ensure the actual sleep duration reaches the specified value. (architecture-related: public API)
Added an SSLfatal call when key log recording fails to ensure the SSL fatal error assertion is triggered. (Architecture-related: SSL error handling behavior)

Fixed the issue in OSSL_DECODER_CTX_new_for_pkey where the write lock was not released on the memory allocation failure path, avoiding assertion failures caused by repeated locking by the same thread. (architecture-related: public API)

Removed the OSSL_CRYPTO_ALLOC attribute from the declarations of CRYPTO_memdup, CRYPTO_strdup, and CRYPTO_strndup functions because this attribute is not applicable to functions that return initialized copies. (architecture-related: public API)

Corrected the synthesis logic of the pre-release version identifier in the OPENSSL_VERSION_NUMBER macro to ensure that 0xfL is correctly generated when there is no pre-release version. (architecture-related: version and compatibility)
Added a CRYPTO_FREE_REF call in ossl_quic_free_token_store to fix a potential memory leak on platforms that do not support atomic operations. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)
Abort the connection immediately when the client has no key share to send. (architecture-related: TLS 1.3 handshake behavior)
Fix the OBJ_create function to return NID_undef on error and the newly created NID on success. (architecture-related: public API)

Fix the issue where the extension list was not correctly cleared after deleting the last extension in a certificate, CRL, and CRL entry, and refactor the deletion logic, adding helper functions to automatically clean up empty extension lists. (architecture-related: public API)

Fix the issue where deterministic ECDSA signing failed in FIPS mode on the S390 platform, by creating the correct BN_CTX context for the inverse operation. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)
Fix the issue where BIO_snprintf did not terminate the output with \0 on the error path, and adjust related tests to verify this behavior. (architecture-related: public API)
In FIPS mode, prohibit the use of SHA512-224 and SHA512-256 for ECDSA/DSA signing, because these algorithms have no corresponding OID. (architecture-related: FIPS compliance)

Fix the incorrect initialization of the output buffer length in EVP_SealInit for RSA public key encryption, ensuring the RSA modulus length is used instead of the input KEK length. (architecture-related: public API)
Add an error check for the return value of i2d_X509_NAME in X509_ocspid_print, jumping to error handling on failure. (architecture-related: public API)
Fix the issue where the public_from_private() function incorrectly returned success on the error path; it now correctly returns 0 on failure. (architecture-related: public API)
Fix the OPENSSL_VERSION_NUMBER macro so that its status bits are always zero, consistent with the documentation description. (architecture-related: version and compatibility)
Disable read-write mutex locks on the RISC-V architecture to resolve a glibc implementation issue. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)
Fix the handling in EVP_PKEY_can_sign when query_operation_name returns NULL, and add corresponding tests. (architecture-related: public API)
Fix the issue where the inner content type value passed on big-endian platforms was incorrect, ensuring only the lowest byte is passed. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)
Release tmpext when X509V3_EXT_add() fails to avoid a memory leak.
In the default provider's PBKDF2 implementation, throw an error when the check is disabled and the iteration count is set to zero.
Fix the decoding issue for SM2 private keys (PEM format, ECPrivateKey).
In ml_kem_encapsulate(), throw the PROV_R_NULL_OUTPUT_BUFFER error when shsec is NULL.
Fix the compilation failure of string concatenation caused by incorrect use of the preprocessing concatenation operator.
Fix the issue where Windows line endings caused incorrect file reading; now both Unix and Windows newline characters are handled correctly.
Fix boundary cases when processing short or empty files, add an error message for empty files, and prevent out-of-bounds access.
In the key exchange operation, ensure that the reference to the peer key is also retained under the provider path.
Removed the DAYS parameter from the certificate request to avoid generating warnings, and fixed an error caused by an uninitialized variable.
Added null pointer checks in cms.c and ocsp.c to prevent potential null pointer dereferences.
Fixed an issue where the legacy code path was incorrectly entered when the EVP_PKEY context was already bound to a keymgmt.
Fixed an issue in the QUIC record layer where the un-released counter was incorrectly decremented when releasing a record failed.
Fixed the issue in CMS where the default digest length was missing when using SHAKE as the digest algorithm, and added specific digest length settings for SHAKE128 and SHAKE256.
Fixed a null pointer dereference in asn1_ex_i2c() caused by an unhandled V_ASN1_UNDEF type, and added a corresponding branch to avoid a crash.
Allowed ECDSA to sign with digests that have no NID, and fixed an invalid digest check in DSA signing.
Fixed a memory leak when the ktls record layer creation fails, and switched to the correct free function.
Fixed the issue in ML_DSA where the security bit parameter was incorrectly multiplied by 8 when being obtained.
When obtaining the random number method, first check whether the random method lock exists, to avoid a crash during the exit cleanup phase because the lock has already been released.
Corrected the reporting of the public key algorithm of the certificate chain in the s_client command, supporting the provided key, and displaying the curve name instead of the bit count for EC keys.
Fixed the incorrect condition judgment when skipping packets in qlog event recording, and corrected the erroneous reversed condition to the proper comparison.
Added a null pointer check for the return value of OPENSSL_strdup() in the load_index function, ensuring that when memory allocation fails, the error handling path is correctly jumped to.
Fixed a potential double-free issue when copying hybrid ML-KEM keys, added a deep copy of the attribute string, and checked the consistency of the key material.
Fixed the encoding of the SHAKE algorithm identifier so that it does not carry parameters.
Fixed the length calculation error and the issue of non-null-terminated strings in the parameter value output function, and added hexadecimal output for octet strings.
Fixed a segmentation fault in the pkeyutl command-line tool caused by dereferencing a null pointer after failing to load the key, added a null pointer check, and output an error message.
Fixed a potential null pointer dereference in the final_maxfragmentlen() function, and moved the NULL check of s->session to the beginning of the function.
Fixed the issue in the Windows certificate store provider where, due to recent decoder changes, the new API was not correctly used to create decoder instances.
Add missing error message when CMS output write fails.
Fix a potential deadlock when calling RAND_get0_primary() with only the FIPS provider loaded, by narrowing the lock scope to avoid recursive locking.
Fix incorrect operation type during ML-DSA signature message initialization, and improve deep copy handling of signature data in context copying.
Add a check during signature algorithm initialization to ensure that the update and final functions are either both present or both absent, preventing providers from supplying only one of them.
Fix FIPS provider compatibility regression by adjusting the error queue check in tests to only run on FIPS provider 3.6.0 and above.
Fix the zeroization issue of z and d values during ML-KEM key reset, ensuring the zeroing operation covers the complete memory region.
Fix a memory leak in pkeyutl caused by EVP_PKEY_CTX_ctrl_str failure, releasing passwd before jumping.
Add a check for negative return values from BIO_snprintf in BIO_dump_indent_cb to avoid potential undefined behavior.
Fix a BIGNUM memory leak in apps/prime.c.
Fix a memory leak in the sconnect example caused by not freeing ssl_bio, and add BIO_free calls on error paths.
Fix debug log printing in the OSSL_CMP_MSG_http_perform function: remove an extra format specifier and add a missing colon in another log message.
Fix a memory leak in ossl_method_store_add caused by not properly freeing internal resources of impl.
Add a NULL check for the ba_ret pointer in the init_client() function to avoid potential null pointer dereference, and simplify the address saving logic.
Fix a potential leak of duplicate EVP_PKEY_CTX on error paths, and improve error reporting in signature and verification operations.
Fix a potential double-free of the EVP_MD variable after yield_secret_cb failure when using an external QUIC implementation.
Fix the key switching order in the QUIC handshake, ensuring the write key is set before the read key to avoid failure to confirm after reading data.
Fix the DTLS message callback showing incorrect messages for messages spanning multiple fragments (such as certificates).
Add validation for trailing extra bytes in the TLS compressed certificate extension handler, returning a decode error alert if unparsed data exists.
Add a check for an empty private key in the sm2_sig_gen function to prevent crashes due to null pointer dereference when the private key is not set.
Fix null pointer dereference and return value issues in the ecx_gen_init function, enhancing keymgmt initialization robustness.
Fixed the issue in the ossl_rio_poll_builder_add_fd function where a local pointer was not updated after reallocation, leading to a write to freed memory.
Unified all *_gen_cleanup functions to safely handle NULL context parameters, avoiding crashes when NULL is passed.
Fixed the issue in the SSL verification callback where the user SSL object was passed instead of the internal SSL object.
Added error handling for failure of master key thread-local storage setup; on failure, memory is freed and an error is returned.
Fixed a potential issue in FIPS mode caused by a missing NULL pointer check during master key cleanup.
Updated the CCM implementation to use improved parameter handling and fixed the issue of claiming support for more parameters than actually supported.
Reduced the number of buckets in the name mapping hash table from 2048 to 512 to avoid memory allocation failure issues.
Fixed the issue where openssl s_time incorrectly returned exit code 1 when using the -new command-line switch; it now correctly returns 0.
Fixed a use-after-free issue in LMS verification initialization, avoiding erroneously clearing an existing key when the key is NULL.
In the FIPS module, added a pairwise check during DH key import and changed the error state type for import failure from a general PCT to an import-specific type.
Fixed memory allocation and type issues in the QUIC polling server example.
Fixed the alignment of the OPENSSL_*alloc macro definitions to comply with code format checking tool requirements.
Fixed handling of empty IDN to be consistent with the behavior of incorrect IDN, and added test cases.
Fixed the issue where CRYPTO_aligned_alloc failed to correctly dereference the pointer parameter under the OPENSSL_SMALL_FOOTPRINT condition.
Fixed a potential NULL pointer dereference in EVP_DigestSignUpdate caused by not checking pctx->pmeth for NULL; added a NULL check in the legacy path and returns an initialization error.
Fixed the printing issue of the uppercase prefix 0X in the X conversion specifier; it now correctly outputs 0X or 0x based on the format flags.
Fixed the logic error in the NULL pointer check in the bring_oscp_resp_in_correct_order function; it now correctly checks the content pointed to by the pointer rather than the pointer itself.
Fixed the dangling pointer issue caused by not setting the pointer to NULL after freeing the OCSP response, avoiding subsequent use of freed memory.
Fixed the incorrect NULL pointer check in the get_ocsp_resp_from_responder function; it now correctly checks the allocation result pointed to by the pointer.
Removed the incorrect conditional compilation macro in fuzz/dtlsserver.c, fixing the missing variable declaration issue under specific build configurations.

Fix the issue where the QUIC channel may fail when processing the second transport parameter extension in the HelloRetryRequest scenario. The server side resets local transport parameters after receiving HRR to avoid duplicate parameter errors.

Fix the issue where the largest_pn value of the temporary qrx in a QUIC connection is not migrated to the qrx of the new channel, causing subsequent frame decryption failures. Added migration logic for the largest_pn array in the port default packet handler.
Fix the byte order handling error in the supported versions of the QUIC version negotiation packet, including byte order issues during sending and parsing.
Fix the possible extra zero padding in the %#o format to conform to POSIX specifications.
Fix the space padding calculation issue in bio_print.c so that signs, prefixes, and zero padding are correctly counted in the precision.
Fix the handling logic where the '-' flag takes precedence over the '0' flag in formatted output to conform to the POSIX standard.
Fix code issues in CMS KEM recipient information regarding UKM setting and key cleanup.

Fix the issue in rand_lib where thread-local storage allocation failure was not checked. Now, when setting fails, the allocated random number generator is released and NULL is returned, gracefully handling the failure.

Fix the issue where RCU read lock triggers an assertion on memory allocation failure. Changed the return value of ossl_rcu_read_lock to int to indicate success or failure, and updated all callers to gracefully handle lock failure.

Fix the race condition caused by sharing an OSSL_STORE_CTX in multi-threaded scenarios. The store is no longer kept open in by_store_ctrl_ex; instead, it is reopened each time cache_objects is called.
Fix the use of an incorrect operation identifier during SKEYMGMT enumeration and add related tests.
Add a null pointer check for SSL_CONNECTION in quic_channel.c to prevent potential null pointer dereference.
In the CMS KEM encryption function, when EVP_CIPHER_param_to_asn1 fails, release the allocated ASN1_TYPE parameter to prevent memory leaks.
Add a null pointer check in the display function of the HASH extension to prevent crashes caused by a null hashValue.
Fix the issue in tls1_set_server_sigalgs where SSLfatal was not set on memory allocation failure, avoiding assertion failures triggered by subsequent state machine checks.
Fix the null pointer check error in the dtls1_shutdown function by changing the check object from the original SSL object to the converted SSL_CONNECTION object.
Fix the null pointer check in pkey_dh_derive to ensure both keys are set when deriving DH keys.
Fix the issue where the precision value may be negative when an empty precision string is provided, resetting it to zero to conform to POSIX specifications.
Fix the behavior of the %n format specifier to record the virtual write position instead of the actual number of bytes written, and restore support for length modifiers.
Fix the precision handling logic in the fmtint function: negative precision is treated as omitted with a default precision of 1, and the '0' flag is ignored when precision is specified.
Fix the issue where printing an integer outputs an empty string when the value is zero and the explicit precision is zero.
Fix memory leaks in multiple BIO examples by adding a call to free ssl_bio at the end of the function.
Fix a memory leak in the PKCS12 password change function caused by not freeing the PKCS7 object.
Fix the double-free issue of OCSP_SINGLERESP, avoiding repeated freeing of referenced single responses when freeing OCSP_BASICRESP.
Fix the condition for detecting reallocation failure in qtx_resize_txe(), avoiding misinterpreting the return of the same pointer as failure, and ensure NULL is correctly returned on failure.
In the FIPS provider, convert ML-DSA key import failures to a transient error state.
In the FIPS module, set the correct transient error state when ML-KEM key import fails; also make the ml_kem_load function static in the non-FIPS module.
Fix the reference counting issue during EVP_SKEY allocation, ensuring the key management object's reference count is correctly incremented during allocation and properly released on failure.
Fix SLH-DSA key import so that if the pairwise test fails, it enters the FIPS error state.
Fix the DER encoding length of SM3 digest information so that RSA-SM3 signatures conform to the standard.
Fix the missing unlock operation on a specific error path in the ossl_provider_new function, avoiding potential deadlock or resource leak.
Update the SSL trace functionality to correctly display all MLKEM-based group names (MLKEM512, MLKEM768, MLKEM1024, and SecP384r1MLKEM1024), and add corresponding test cases.
Fix the issue of excessive loop iterations caused by user-provided overly large width or precision specifications, by adding the eob_ok function to terminate the loop early in non-extensible buffers.
Fix the memory ordering issue between update_qp and get_hold_current_qp, adding release/acquire barriers to ensure visibility of reader_idx.
Remove the pairwise consistency test (PCT) during ECX key import, aligning with other algorithms.
Fix the ML-KEM key equality check to ensure correct comparison when one of the keys is not set.
Fix the race condition in ossl_quic_conn_stream_conclude in QUIC, moving the error promotion operation before unlocking.
Fix the double-free issue in ossl_siv128_init() on the failure path, setting the relevant context to NULL after freeing it.
Add a note to the CHANGES.md changelog that SSLv3 is disabled by default since version 1.1.0.
In the client processing loop of sslecho, set client_skt to -1 after closing it to avoid potential double close.
Fix build failures for test/radix/quic_tests.c and test/quic_multistream_test.c on the AIX platform.
Assign fixed interface names to Docker networks in the QUIC interoperability CI workflow to resolve connection-to-server failures caused by the nondeterminism introduced by Docker Engine v28.0.
Fix a typo in the GitHub Action workflow file .github/workflows/ci.yml.
Fix qlog-related issues reported in ssl/quic/qlog_event_helpers.c.
Add missing I/O error checks in the multi_split() function in crypto/asn1/asn_mime.c.
Use an index variable to print provider algorithm details in crypto/provider_core.c, fixing trace output.
In crypto/provider_conf.c, assign the return value of ossl_provider_info_add_to_store to the added variable to avoid a memory leak where entry is not freed when it fails.
Add OPENSSL_free(gix) in ssl/t1_lib.c when sk_TLS_GROUP_IX_push() fails, avoiding a memory leak.
Fix memory management issues in port_make_channel in ssl/quic/quic_port.c and optimize the handling logic of port_new_handshake_layer.

Change the last argument of the IMPL_*_SIGALG macros in the DSA, ECDSA, and RSA signature implementations under providers/implementations/signature to pass strings directly instead of stringizing them inside the macro.
Fix encoding issues for subject, issuer, sender, and recipient distinguished name characters in apps/cmp.c.
Add a check for an empty ecdhe encoded key in ssl/statem/statem_srvr.c.
Add a NULL check in ossl_quic_get_peer_token in ssl/quic/quic_impl.c so that the lookup fails when the QUIC channel has not yet set the peer address.
Fix a potential resource leak in the configuration file in apps/configutl.c (Coverity 1646846).
In demos/cms/cms_ddec.c, change the variable checking the return value of BIO_new_file() from "in" to "dcont".

Change the EdDSA signature implementation to use a structure-based TRIE decoder for parameter handling and return the correct parameter list for variant settables; also change MLX key management to use TRIE and structure-based parameter decoding, and fix two defects where the properties parameter was not listed in the settables table and was only ignored when a public key was present.
In the FIPS provider, ECX, RSA, and EC key management transition to a transient error state on import failure.
Add checks for the return values of BIO_new() and EVP_MD_get_size(), fix a null pointer dereference in OSSL_PARAM_merge, and fix Coverity issue 1655294 in ml_kem.c.

When the q parameter is not provided, the DH private key generation function generate_key generates a private key value that is 1 bit larger than the DH group size; it is now silently reduced by 1 to comply with the constraint q = (p-1)/2.
Improve the method of locating the openssl executable in the c_rehash.in tool.
In threads_pthread.c, change the suffix condition for the thread lock contention log file from the fopen() call to the FIPS_MODULE macro.

Fix the issue where the QUIC receiving side incorrectly calls ossl_ackm_on_rx_packet() to ACK a failed packet when depack_process_frames() fails; set the initial value of ok to -1 to distinguish processing failure from success.

Fix the RSA key size validation error in the EVP_PKEY_RSA_keygen demo program by changing the checked object from the default bits value to the command-line parsed bits_i, ensuring the 512-bit minimum limit takes effect.
Unify the return value check for RSA_public_decrypt() to consistently check for the error form of < 0.

Fix the buffer length check error in the put_str() helper function of ossl_property_list_to_string() when the output buffer has only 1 byte remaining and the property name/string value requires quotes.
Fix the memory leak of the wrapper object in the error path of x509_store_add() where X509_OBJECT_free is called after setting the X509_OBJECT type to X509_LU_NONE.
Fix the use-after-free error for public_keys and private_keys in evp_test.
In apps/cms.c, add failure handling for I/O errors in BIO_printf(), remove unnecessary ERR_print_errors() calls, and add missing error messages in several error cases.
In apps/prime.c, remove unnecessary checks for NULL values, remove dead code, and remove unused assignments.

Change the base_id_conversion table in evp_pkey_type.c to static to fix CI failures under --strict-warnings configuration, and add missing char* casts for format arguments in ERR_raise_data() in bss_file.c.

Remove unnecessary parameter existence checks in cipher_chacha20_poly1305.c.in, remove dead code in apps/configutl.c, and add a check for the return value of CRYPTO_THREAD_init_local() in threads_common.c.
Improve the X509_V_ERR_CERT_NOT_YET_VALID error message to suggest that it may be caused by an incorrect system clock.
Removed the duplicate definition of cipher suite 0xC102 in ssl/t1_trce.c, keeping IANA-GOST2012-GOST8912-GOST8912 as the canonical definition.
In crypto/evp/signature.c, add more specific diagnostic data when the provider does not implement the required function.
Fix the copy-paste error in the file name in the error output of apps/genpkey.c.
Fix the RCU-related TODO: update the parameter type of allocate_new_qp_group to unsigned int, and move id_ctr in rcu_lock_st to improve stack alignment.
Remove the handling of the HARNESS_OSSL_PREFIX environment variable from apps/lib/apps.c.
Clean up and expand the use of ERR_print_errors() in apps/s_client.c.
Add a check for the return value of BIO_new_file() in demos/cms/cms_denc.c.
Remove the accidentally left hardcoded debug statement from apps/ec.c.

Add conditional compilation for FIPS-specific parameters in implementations of multiple KDF and encryption algorithms, making them available only in FIPS mode, to enhance FIPS compliance. (architecture-related: FIPS compliance)
Expose the internal API for RSA key pair consistency testing in the FIPS module. (architecture-related: public API)

Split the ML-DSA internal signature verification function into mu calculation and actual signature/verification parts, and add a new public mu calculation helper function to support chunked input messages. (architecture-related: public API)
Remove the unused JSON floating-point encoding function to avoid dependency on the libm math library. (architecture-related: build dependency)
Change OPENSSL_cpuid_setup from a constructor to a non-constructor, removing its automatic initialization behavior. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)
Deprecate function declarations and definitions related to EVP_PKEY_ASN1_METHOD. (architecture-related: public API deprecation)
Change the boolean parameter in JSON encoding from int to stdbool type. (architecture-related: public API)

Deprecate internally used ASN1_METH-related code, protect old interfaces with conditional compilation, and add RSA-PSS aliases for compatibility with older versions. (architecture-related: public API compatibility)

In SSKDF and X9.42 KDF, alias the parameter names key and ukm as secret and uinfo respectively, and remove independent references to the key parameter. (architecture-related: public API parameter aliasing)
Remove two unsupported parameters in HMAC. (architecture-related: public API parameter removal)

Remove the FIPS pairwise consistency check during key import for DH, EC, and RSA algorithms, and revert the previously exposed RSA key pairwise consistency test API. (architecture-related: API revert)
Migrate the async-job API, RCU, and ERR library to the new thread-local storage API to reduce OS-level thread-local storage key usage.
Declare generic OSSL_PARAM structures and helper functions in cipher-related code, and refactor cipher header files to support improved parameter handling.
Change evp_skey_alloc from static to non-static for use across multiple source files.
Refactor PBKDF2 boundary check logic, unify checks in FIPS and non-FIPS modes, and fix type conversion issues.
Add lock contention reporting functionality, refactor and add stack output to enhance debugging capabilities.
The set_ctx_params and get_ctx_params interfaces of the DRBG module are changed to use automatically generated parameter decoders, simplifying the parameter processing flow.

Change the parameters of the ossl_slh_dsa_key_fromdata function from a single OSSL_PARAM array to separate public key and private key parameters, and use ossl_slh_dsa_key_reset instead of manual cleanup.
Change the LMS public key parameter decoding to use the generated parameter decoding method.
Change the fromdata function of ECX keys to receive separated public key and private key parameters, with the caller responsible for parameter lookup.
The HMAC implementation no longer uses secure memory to store keys, but uses ordinary memory allocation, and adds an empty length check.
In ossl_prov_drbg_generate(), move the system call out of the write lock protection area.
Move BIO_err_is_non_fatal() from bio_err.c to bio_lib.c.
Clarify the handling of the ret variable in cms_main() in apps/cms.c.
Clean up unused constants and functions from providers/implementations/rands/drbg_local.h.
Hide the 'engine' parameter in multiple KDF implementations.

Rename source files in multiple provider implementation modules such as storemgmt, rands, encode_decode, signatures, asymciphers, and digests to .c.in template files, and convert them to use generated parameter decoders/parsers for parameter handling.
Convert encode_key2any, decode_pem2der, encode_key2ms, and decode_pvk2key in the encode_decode module to use generated parameter parsing.
Restore checks for NULL parameters in multiple KDF implementation files and in ml_kem_kmgmt.c.in and mlx_kmgmt.c.in.
Remove unused code from crypto/ec/ecp_sm2p256.c.
Clean up unnecessary #include directives in multiple files under crypto/cmp/ and crypto/crmf/.
Replace OPENSSL_assert() calls with ossl_assert() in crypto/evp/bio_b64.c.
Add assertions in crypto/threads_pthread.c to confirm successful lock acquisition.
Remove the by_store_subject_ex() function from crypto/x509/by_store.c.
Use the new name/type code generator in providers/implementations/ciphers/ciphercommon.c.in.
Use the new name/type code generator in providers/implementations/ciphers/cipher_chacha20_poly1305.c.in.
Update get params and from data calls in providers/implementations/keymgmt/ml_kem_kmgmt.c.in to use the TRIE decoder.
Update get params and from data calls in providers/implementations/keymgmt/ml_dsa_kmgmt.c.in to use the TRIE decoder.
Prevent conflicts with the common names NONE, GET, SET in crypto/evp/ctrl_params_translate.c.
The ml-kem key management implementation is updated to use the improved parameter handling mechanism.
The ml-dsa key management implementation is updated to use the improved parameter handling mechanism.
The GCM generic cipher implementation is updated to use the improved parameter handling mechanism.
The ChaCha20-Poly1305 cipher implementation is updated to use the improved parameter handling mechanism.
Refactor thread-local functions in initthread.c, simplifying function naming and extracting helper functions to enhance readability.
The cipher generic implementation switches to a table-based parameter decoding approach.
The ml-dsa signature implementation switches to a TRIE- and structure-based parameter name decoder.
The digest generic implementation converts algorithm fetchable parameters to use structure-based TRIE decoding.
Multiple KDF implementations (scrypt, pbkdf2, tls1prf, sshkdf, x9.42kdf, kbkdf, sskdf, pvkkdf, hkdf) are converted to use generated OSSL_PARAM parsers, and the tls1_prf.c file is renamed.
Remove the max parameter from the parameter concatenation helper function and synchronously modify multiple KDF implementations.
Multiple KDF implementations (argon2, krb5kdf, pbkdf1, hmacdrbg_kdf, pkcs12kdf) are converted to use generated OSSL_PARAM parsers.
Multiple MAC implementations (CMAC, KMAC, GMAC, SipHash, BLAKE2, HMAC, Poly1305) are converted to use parameter decoders.
Multiple key exchange implementations (ECX, DH, ECDH) are converted to use generated parameter decoders.
ml_kem and EC KEM implementations are converted to use generated parameter decoders.
KEM-related files are renamed to support automatic generation of parameter parsing, involving files such as ec_kem, ecx_kem, ml_kem_kem, rsa_kem.
Extract the lock contention recording functionality from the pthread thread implementation into a standalone module.
The mac_legacy_sig signature implementation calls the updated ossl_prov_set_macctx function.
The signature operations of blake2, ecdsa, slh_dsa, sm2, rsa, dsa and the key encapsulation implementations of ecx kem, rsa kem are updated to use generated parameter decoders
Simplify the handling of OPENSSL_SMALL_FOOTPRINT in CRYPTO_aligned_alloc, removing unnecessary initialization of *freeptr and ret
Make the padding type decoding in rsa_enc.c.in more direct
Make the mode decoding in hkdf.c.in more direct
Consolidate the buffer/sbuffer/maxlen/currlen parameters passed in bio_print.c into a single structure
Re-add the OSSL_ prefix to parameter names in multiple provider implementation files and paramnames.pm
Added a self-test function for LMS signature verification in the FIPS module. (architecture-related: FIPS self-test)
Reintroduced the RSA encryption/decryption known-answer tests (KAT) to meet FIPS-140-3 certification requirements. (architecture-related: FIPS self-test)
Added a test verifying that no BIO needs to be set when using the QUIC TLS API
Allow the use of brace blocks in case and default branches of switch statements, and updated related tests.
Added FIPS version and availability markers to the ECDSA deterministic test data.
Added a test for EVP_DigestSignInit() using the ECDSA and KECCAK-256 hash algorithms
Fix formatting issues for multiple frame types in quic_multistream_test.c, including supplementing missing frame type enumerations and correcting frame injection such as PATH_CHALLENGE
Extend the fallback period of the noisydgram BIO to be configurable by frame count, ensuring that the first two initial frames are not dropped in QUIC tests
Relax the tight timeout value in test_exec_IR_ses_poll_no_timeout() in cmp_client_test.c
Added multiple expected output configuration files for the configuration tool tests, covering scenarios such as escape characters, spaces, ordering, and variables.
Implement corruption convenience functionality for ML-DSA PCT (pairwise consistency test) in ml_dsa_kmgmt.c
Add PCT implementation tests for ML-DSA, SLH-DSA, and ML-KEM
Replace the hardcoded mscert array content in test/ossl_store_test.c with smaller certificate data, reducing the test file size from 117 lines to 27 lines.
Change the certificate search condition of the test_store_open_winstore function in the test file test/ossl_store_test.c from searching by subject name to searching by issuer name.
Initialize the result pointer in test/bio_comp_test.c to avoid undefined behavior caused by freeing an uninitialized pointer when the original allocation fails.
Add OPENSSL_free() to release contents in the error handling path of test/timing_load_creds.c to avoid memory leaks.
In test/helpers/quictestlib.c, use goto instead of return when TEST_ptr(*cssl) fails, to release bdata and avoid memory leaks.
In test/testutil/testutil_init.c, add OPENSSL_free() to release trace_data when an error occurs, to avoid memory leaks.
In test/evp_test.c, call EVP_MD_free() to release fetched_digest when OPENSSL_zalloc() fails, to avoid memory leaks.
Add regression tests for incorrect HMAC API usage in test/hmactest.c.

Added condition-variable-based thread interlocking in test/helpers/quictestlib.c to block the server from performing a tick of the QUIC reactor until the client calls SSL_connect, fixing intermittent quicapi test failures caused by a race condition.
In test/sslapitest.c, add a test for double-freeing EVP_MD objects when using an external QUIC implementation, by making the yield secret callback fail to trigger the kdfdigest release path.
In test/lms_test.c, add negative tests for LMS key generation, EVP_PKEY_sign_message_init, EVP_PKEY_paramgen_init, and signing.

Added tests in test/sslapitest.c and test/helpers/ssltestlib.c/h to verify that QUIC operations yield write secrets before they yield read secrets; added tests in test/quicapitest.c to verify that SSL_set_verify callbacks receive the correct SSL object.

In test/quicapitest.c, fix the conversion error from size_t to const int; in test/quic_multistream_test.c, add OPENSSL_free() to release bdata on error; in test/quic-openssl-docker/hq-interop/quic-hq-interop.c, add a return value check for OPENSSL_zalloc().

In test/bio_pw_callback_test.c, add BIO_free() to avoid memory leaks when PEM_read_bio_PrivateKey fails; in test/evp_extra_test2.c, fix double-free of PKEY and RSA leaks; in test/evp_extra_test.c, add OPENSSL_free() to release label when EVP_PKEY_CTX_set0_rsa_oaep_label() fails.
In test/evp_kdf_test.c, separate the integer and string retrieval of the 'mode' parameter to avoid duplicate runtime parameter errors; skip the updatability check for the "engine" parameter.
In test/threadstest.c, add a test to verify that keys can be repeatedly created and destroyed.
In test/rand_test.c, add a unit test demonstrating memory out-of-bounds access.
In util/check-format-test-negatives.c, add a second macro indentation test and annotate a hint for known false positives.
In fuzz/server.c, add return value checks for BIO_new, SSL_CTX_new, and EVP_PKEY_new.
In test/helpers/ssl_test_ctx.c and test/pkey_meth_test.c, deprecate ASN1_METH-related tests and adjust NID parsing in ssl_test_ctx to be compatible with the new behavior.

In test/params_api_test.c, use inlen instead of outlen to limit the copy length in swap_copy(), and adjust le_copy() to match the output buffer size, fixing the stringop-overflow false positive on s390 with gcc 12.
Fix the failure of the check-ansi job in the openssl-3.5 branch caused by commit 60775e3, modifying the file test/provider_pkey_test.c.
Add signature tests for SM2 and remove unnecessary available check lines in evppkey_sm2.txt.

In the evp_test test framework, add a global configuration item "Test-Entropy" that allows replacing the public and private DRBG with a specified deterministic byte sequence to achieve reproducible random input; meanwhile, change the parameter handling logic in fips_crng_test.c.in and test_rng.c.in to use OpenSSL's automatically generated parameter decoder (produce_param_decoder), replacing the original manual OSSL_PARAM_locate and type-setting code.

Add memory fault tests: the handshake-memfail test verifies crash and ASan safety by causing the i-th malloc of the SSL handshake to fail successively; add the allocfail-tests configuration option (disabled by default, depends on crypto-mdebug); add mem_alloc_test and mem_alloc_custom_fns_test to test OpenSSL memory allocation functions for boundary correctness such as zero size, overflow, and OOM, with support for custom allocation functions.

Test code defect fixes: in mem_alloc_test.c, avoid referencing the freed old_ret after realloc, and correct the assignment in test_xaligned_alloc that was mistakenly a comparison; in sslapitest.c, fix the sizeof error in create_new_vfile array allocation, and avoid early return in test_tlsext_status_type that causes memory leaks; in ml_kem_internal_test.c, add EVP_MD_free on error paths to prevent memory leaks.
In test/bioprinttest.c, add checks comparing with libc output, integer and string printing checks, and make test vectors const.
In test/timing_load_creds.c, add fclose() on error paths to release fp.
In test/lms_test.c, reorder code to eliminate the Coverity false positive of unused value.
In test/quic_tserver_test.c, reduce the increment of sleep time.
In test/sanitytest.c, fix the timer disarming usage of setitimer by using a zeroed structure instead of NULL argument.
In test/testutil/main.c, move global_init before test_open_streams so that the allocator implementation can be changed before the first malloc call.
In test/stack_test.c, check the return value of sk_sint_push in test_int_stack.
In test/bioprinttest.c, use the entire buffer for checks, no longer reducing the buffer size by 1.
In test/tls13groupselection_test.c, test setting a client to send a key share that is not allowed in TLSv1.3.
In test/bioprinttest.c, fix the missing length modifier in int_data to avoid getting wrong values on architectures such as mips and armv7.
In test/bioprinttest.c, explicitly assign the %n result to the val field of the union to fix incorrect comparisons on big-endian architectures.
In test/slh_dsa_test.c, omit the import PCT test.
In test/threadstest.c, add a trace message in the torture_rcu_high test, and change the initial value of newly allocated values from zero to non-zero to detect problems.
In test/wpackettest.c, in test_WPACKET_quic_vlint_random(), replace return cleanup(&pkt) with return 0 when RAND_bytes() fails, to avoid cleaning up an uninitialized pkt.
In test/radix/terp.c, in TERP_run(), wrap the stats printing call with the have_terp guard condition to avoid accessing uninitialized terp when jumping to the err label before TERP_init() succeeds.
In test/threadstest.c, fix logic errors in torture_rw_high/low tests: remove the use of "old" that is never assigned, and delete the redundant first assignment to "*iterations" in the loop.
In test/lms_test.c, skip the LMS test when obtaining the LMS algorithm fails, and check for specific LMS errors.
In test/sslapitest.c, skip the test_ssl_trace() test when the FIPS provider version is lower than 3.5.
In test/sslapitest.c, re-enable the ssl_trace_test() test.
In test/property_test.c, add tests suggested by Shane Lontis.
In test/recipes/30-test_evp_data/evpkdf_krb5.txt, add KRB5KDF tests using incorrect key sizes.
Fix the issue in util/check-format.pl where a typedef with a space and '(' after the type name causes a false positive, and add a corresponding test in util/check-format-test-negatives.c.

On aarch64, implement interleaved AES-CBC-HMAC-SHA1/256 and AES-CBC-HMAC-SHA512 encrypt-then-authenticate modes, supporting only non-padding mode with input lengths that are multiples of 16 bytes, to improve performance. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)
Enable the optimized implementation based on SM3 ISA extensions for x86-64 platforms. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)
Enable unroll8 and unroll12 optimizations for AES-GCM on Neoverse N3 and V3 processors. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)

On Qualcomm Snapdragon X systems, enable AES and SHA3 optimizations by identifying the Oryon X1 CPU and enabling the relevant instruction sets, resulting in performance improvements of up to 26.5% (AES) and 15% (SHA3) for large block data. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)
Add an optimized implementation for AES-CFB128 mode based on Intel AVX-512 and VAES instruction sets. (architecture-related: public API)

Replace the blinding structure for RSA keys with a sparse array indexed by thread ID, eliminating the dependency on write locks and greatly reducing lock contention under multithreading. (Architecture-related: RSA blinding lock elimination)

Add a new SM3 optimized implementation based on the Zbb extension for RISC-V platforms, automatically detecting and utilizing the Zbb instruction set for acceleration in SM3 hash computation. (Architecture-related: RISC-V platform optimization)
Add a new optimized SHA-256 implementation based on the Zbb extension for RISC-V platforms, and automatically select this implementation at runtime based on hardware support.
Add a new optimized SHA-512 implementation based on the Zbb extension for RISC-V platforms.
Update the parameter decoding for CCM mode AEAD ciphers to use a TRIE decoder to improve the performance of setting and getting the authentication tag.
Refactor master_key from a sparse array to a top-level fixed array, changing to direct lookup by index to improve performance.
Restore the use of operating system-level thread-local storage keys to manage the default OpenSSL context, to improve performance when frequently switching the default context.
Add lock contention detection functionality to the pthreads implementation, enabled via the REPORT_RWLOCK_CONTENTION macro, which can record lock blocking time and call stacks.
Add ossl_likely and ossl_unlikely macros to common conditional branches in the digest function to optimize branch prediction performance.
Add branch prediction hints (ossl_likely/ossl_unlikely) to multiple functions in bn_lib.c, and uniformly change memory allocation calls to OPENSSL_calloc form for micro-optimization.
Optimize branch prediction in CRYPTO_malloc using ossl_likely and ossl_unlikely macros, and extract the error reporting logic into an ossl_report_alloc_err function call.
Optimize branch prediction in the OPENSSL_init_crypto function using ossl_likely and ossl_unlikely macros to improve performance.
Introduce the ossl_likely macro in the OSSL_PARAM_locate and OSSL_PARAM_get_uint64 functions to optimize branch prediction for performance improvement.
Change lock contention data storage to be managed independently per thread ID, eliminating the locking overhead when writing reports and significantly improving performance.
Change the write lock in the CRYPTO_secure_actual_size function to a read lock, because no write operation is needed within the critical section.
Refactor the lock mechanism for object addition and lookup to reduce lock contention and improve concurrency performance.

In apps/speed.c, support more signature algorithms: for algorithms that cannot be initialized via EVP_PKEY_sign_init (such as ML-DSA-65), try EVP_PKEY_sign_message_init; increase MAX_SIG_NUM and fix the error in loopargs_t where the signature field uses MAX_KEM_NUM; disable testing of composite signature algorithms (such as RSA-SHA256).
Optimize the use of ossl_likely/ossl_unlikely in crypto/bn/bn_gf2m.c and crypto/threads_pthread.c.
Document the x86-64 SHA-512 family optimization, leveraging the SHA512 ISA extension to improve digest algorithm performance.
Add support for the PGO (Profile Guided Optimization) build type in Configure, Configurations/10-main.conf, and INSTALL.md.
In providers/implementations/ciphers/cipher_chacha20_poly1305.c, convert the parameter name decoder to a TRIE-based implementation to improve performance, and update the related build.info file.
In crypto/threads_common.c, reduce the memory overhead of CTX_TABLE_ENTRY: change the ctx table to a sparse void* array, directly set thread-local data, and avoid allocation and cleanup overhead.
In .github/workflows/coveralls.yml, Configurations/10-main.conf, and Configure, add branch coverage report support for the coveralls run.
In cache_objects() in crypto/x509/by_store.c, suppress potentially irrelevant error queue entries when calling OSSL_STORE_find().
In apps/cmp.c, call BIO_free() to release the bio when ASN1_i2d_bio_of() fails, avoiding a memory leak.
In crypto/ts/ts_rsp_sign.c, release seq after PKCS7_add_signed_attribute() fails, fixing a memory leak.
In providers/implementations/rands/test_rng.c, fix a memory out-of-bounds error.
Move the BIO_free() call in test/quic-openssl-docker/hq-interop/quic-hq-interop.c to the err label to free memory on the error path.
In apps/openssl.c, when trace_data is non-NULL but other errors occur, add OPENSSL_free() to free trace_data to avoid memory leaks.
Fix the memory leak in the abnormal branch of the ssl_set_cert_and_key function in ssl/ssl_rsa.c.
In providers/implementations/kdfs/argon2.c.in, avoid searching for the "size" parameter each time by recording the position of the size parameter in the parameter array.
Reorder the members of the bn_mont_ctx_st structure in crypto/bn/bn_local.h, moving ri and flags after the BIGNUM member and n0, reducing the structure size from 104 bytes to 96 bytes.
In crypto/rand/rand_lib.c and test/conf_include_test.c, change strings freed with OPENSSL_free() to be allocated with OPENSSL_strdup().
Refactor the by store method of X509_LOOKUP, optimize the cache data structure, and open the store early to report errors as soon as possible.
In providers/implementations/kdfs/tls1_prf.c.in, change the handling of multiple seed parameters to a single realloc call, replacing the previous approach of a separate realloc for each parameter.
Add FIPS 140-3 pairwise consistency test (PCT) for DH key import, and adjust related validation functions to support returning NULL. (architecture-related: public API)
Fix the issue in the x509 command where the -addreject option incorrectly adds trust instead of rejection, fixing CVE-2025-4575. (architecture-related: public API)
Change argument splitting to support spaces within quotes to avoid command injection, and use custom quoting to construct commands on Windows. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)
Force the permissions of the SSLKEYLOGFILE log file to 0600, ensuring only the owner can read and write. (architecture-related: public API)

Fix the race condition caused by not holding the read lock when obtaining the X509_STORE object, expose the internal read lock function, and call it correctly in related functions. (architecture-related: public API)
Fix the signed integer overflow in RAND_load_file caused by overly large files, exiting early before the iteration that could trigger the overflow. (architecture-related: public API)
Add a transient error state for OSSL_SELF_TEST_TYPE_PCT_IMPORT to avoid denial-of-service attacks. (architecture-related: public API)
Use constant-time modular inversion for the SM2 curve, fixing the CVE-2025-9231 security vulnerability. (architecture-related: SM2 curve behavior)

Harden the CRYPTO_aligned_alloc function by adding a check that the alignment parameter must be a power of 2, and fix the issue where size calculation could overflow, adding overflow checks and error reporting.
Fix multiple integer overflow vulnerabilities in BIO printing functions, limit format string width and precision to INT_MAX, and fix signed integer overflows in fmtstr and doapr_outch.

Fix the Minerva timing side-channel vulnerability for the P-384 curve on PPC platforms by switching to bn_mul_mont_int() for Montgomery multiplication, and add assembly implementations for P-384 field operations to reduce timing dependencies.
Use RAND_priv_bytes_ex instead of RAND_bytes_ex in QUIC port initialization to enhance key isolation, and use OPENSSL_clear_free instead of OPENSSL_free to erase sensitive data before freeing.
Change the shell command invocation method in the CA.pl script from string concatenation to array form, avoiding command execution through the shell to improve security.
Add a value barrier to the constant-time conditional swap function to prevent compiler optimization, fixing a potential timing security issue.
Switch to secure memory allocation for ML-KEM and ML-DSA private key storage areas to prevent sensitive data leakage.
Add an integer overflow check in ossl_param_buf_alloc, and improve the overflow detection logic of ossl_size_add; also replace realloc in txp_el_ensure_iovec with a safer array allocation function.
Uniformly replace memory allocation calls with array allocation routines to improve security and consistency.
Fix an integer overflow vulnerability in the BIO_f_reliable record parser to prevent out-of-bounds reads.

Fix an offset error in the unwrapped key size check in the kek_unwrap_key() function (CVE-2025-9230), preventing up to 8 bytes of out-of-bounds read and 4 bytes of out-of-bounds write caused by incorrect check conditions.
Fix the issue of a missing terminating NUL byte after the strncpy() call in the use_proxy() function, fixing CVE-2025-9232.
Fix a signed integer overflow issue in the indent_printf() function caused by adding the return values of two BIO_printf calls.
In crypto/store/store_result.c, add provider information for failed credential loading to the error queue, and suggest using the default provider.
