Added the --fake-stdin-is-console, --fake-stdout-is-console, and --fake-stderr-is-console command-line options to simulate a console during testing.
Added support for the advanced API so that the forceCopy/forceAttach features work correctly.

Fixed subtle compression differences in the btlazy2 parser caused by dependence on the numeric representation of sumtype, unifying the offBase representation. (architecture-related: core compression module)

Refactored the progress bar and summary line display logic, centralized display condition control, made the --progress option effective for non-zstd compressors, and fixed several edge cases. (architecture-related: public API)

Fixed the issue where the --auto-threads option was ignored when multithreading was not enabled; now the option is parsed normally even if ZSTD_MULTITHREAD is not defined. (architecture-related: build and installation methods)

Moved the HufLog macro definition from the public header file to the internal decompression header file, and fixed return type conversions in several parameter-setting functions. (architecture-related: public API)

Introduced the LitHufLog constant to correctly represent the maximum bit size of compressed literals (11), replaced the original default values in multiple places in the code, and fixed several type conversion warnings. (architecture-related: core compression module)
Fixed the handling logic for zero-value input in bit operation inline functions, and adjusted conditional compilation details. (architecture-related: public API)

Fix compilation warnings and C++ compatibility warnings in the Linux kernel Zstd compression module caused by the use of deprecated APIs, uniformly replacing them with the recommended APIs and ensuring functional consistency. (architecture-related: public API)

Refactor the bit operation inline functions in bits.h, unify the implementation, and fix the STATIC_BMI2 check and _BitScanReverse return value calculation error under MSVC. (architecture-related: public API)
Update zlibWrapper to be compatible with zlib 1.2.12, replace macros, and add backward-compatible definitions. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)
Fix the memory read byte order issue of the ZSTD_hash4Ptr function on big-endian systems. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)
Adjust the position of the ZSTD_DEPRECATED macro in function declarations, fixing compilation errors in C++14 and C++17 modes under the Clang compiler. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)

Optimize the ZSTD_getDictID_fromDDict function so it directly reads the dictionary ID from the DDict structure, avoiding re-parsing the dictionary buffer, improving efficiency, and returning the correct ID when memory is corrupted. (architecture-related: public API)
Fix the NULL + 0 pointer arithmetic issue in ZSTD_decompressStream, and improve the stream_decompress fuzzer to support empty buffer input. (architecture-related: public API)
Update the specification to require at least 6 literals to trigger 4-streams mode, and add the corresponding check in the decoder. (architecture-related: decoding behavior)
Adjust the position of the deprecated marker to be before the static API macros, resolving compatibility issues when compiling C++ code with clang. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)
Fix the include guard of zdict.h to ensure that static-link-only symbols are still correctly exposed when included multiple times. (architecture-related: public API)
Add a new invalid external sequence error code, and uniformly rename the related errors to externalSequences_invalid. (architecture-related: public API)

Fix a data corruption bug in literal compression caused by incorrect threshold judgment, by adding an actual byte consistency check to replace the heuristic judgment, and adjust the minimum literal compression threshold logic. (architecture-related: public API)

Fix multiple issues in the external matchfinder API: correct the memory space estimation, remove incorrect assertions, prohibit simultaneous use with multithreading, and support clearing the matchfinder by passing NULL. (architecture-related: public API)
Limit the upper bounds of hashLog and chainLog to ensure only 32-bit hashes are used, and adjust the window size judgment condition to use memory more precisely. (architecture-related: public API)
Fix the issue in the unbuffered API where the dictionary was not correctly invalidated when appending a dictionary due to undetected non-contiguous segments. (architecture-related: public API)
Fix C89 compatibility warnings introduced by parallel merging. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)
Fix the build error of the zstd seekable format on 32-bit platforms by adding an explicit size_t type cast in the ZSTD_seekable_decompress function. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)
Fix the long offset parsing issue by allocating extra space for long offsets in the memory estimation. (architecture-related: public API)
Fix the long offset handling logic on 32-bit systems, covering multiple scenarios in compression and decompression, to avoid data corruption. (architecture-related: core compression behavior)
Fix buffer overflow and boundary check issues in multiple legacy format decoders, enhancing security and stability. (architecture-related: backward compatibility)

Improve the behavior and error handling of the benchmark mode, restrict it to run only via the zstd format, and return a non-zero error code and more accurate error messages on failure. (Architecture-related: benchmark behavior)
Fix potential buffer overflow and error propagation issues caused by invalid sequences generated by the external matchfinder. (Architecture-related: external matchfinder security)
Fix the issue where the DiB_shuffle function triggers an assertion when the input count is 0, changing it to return directly.
Remove the new Huffman depth heuristic so that compression results are consistent with those before the PR, while adjusting the function declaration format.
Fix the issue of insufficient compression boundary when using Explicit Block Delimiters, and allocate a larger buffer for this mode in fuzz testing.
Add a non-zero input check in bit manipulation functions on the Win32 platform to avoid static analysis warnings.
Fix the zstreamtest segfault under the MALLOC_PERTURB_ environment by changing thread pool memory allocation from malloc to calloc.
Fix the evaluation order of the loop condition in ZSTD_copySequencesToSeqStoreExplicitBlockDelim to avoid accessing sequence data after an index out-of-bounds.
Fix the boundary condition of window overflow correction when loading large dictionaries to avoid triggering assertion failures.
Fix the segfault caused by createCompressInstructions being called when only performing decompression benchmarks.
Fix off-by-one errors for long literals and match lengths in superblock mode, and add golden compression tests.
Fix the issue where windowLog is not correctly set to the default value when the --long parameter is not provided with a value.
Fix multiple null pointer and undefined behavior issues in the ZSTD_decompressStream function.
Fix the boundary error in the buffer overflow check in the UTIL_mergeFileNamesTable function, correcting the assertion condition from <= to <.
Support decompression of compressed blocks whose size is exactly ZSTD_BLOCKSIZE_MAX, relaxing the compressed block size check condition.
Fix missing parentheses in macro definitions and correct the BIT_highbit32 call to ZSTD_highbit32.
Fix the issue of unparenthesized parameters in macro definitions and correct a wrong assertion in the ZSTD_fracWeight function.
Fixed a type conversion warning by changing the parameter type of the ZSTD_fCost function from U32 to int, and adjusted the related assertions.
Fixed the parsing issue of the maxBlockSize parameter in the estimation function.
Fixed the boundary check for sequence indices in ZSTD_copySequencesToSeqStoreNoBlockDelim, now incrementing the index only for non-final split sequences.
Fixed the redzone poisoning removal bug, now only unpoisoning the expected buffer and no longer unpoisoning the subsequent redzone.
Fixed the bug where the --row-match-finder and --no-row-match-finder command-line options had reversed behavior; now the options correctly enable or disable the row match finder.
Fixed the input boundary check bug in the fast C decoder by changing the break in the inner loop to goto _out to correctly exit the outer loop.
Fixed the incorrect return value of ZSTD_getOffsetInfo() when nbSeq is 0 due to the uninitialized offset table.

Replaced multiple boolean parameters of Huffman functions with a unified flags bitfield, added a flag to disable the assembly decoder, and removed unused functions and old suffix functions. (Architectural event: Core_Compression module change)
Unified the use of memcpy for unaligned memory access in the legacy codebase, removing other non-memcpy methods. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)
Unified the visibility macro naming to *_VISIBLE while maintaining backward compatibility; added the ZDICTLIB_STATIC_API macro for the zdict library. (architecture-related: public API)
Removed all unused FSE functions, eliminating dead code and avoiding stack usage confusion. (architecture-related: public API)
Renamed External Matchfinder to Block-Level Sequence Producer, and updated all related function names, type names, parameter names, error codes, and test cases. (architecture-related: public API)
Added basic functional tests for the maxBlockSize parameter and corrected related macro definitions and comments. (architecture-related: public API)

Changed the implementation of unaligned memory access from packed attribute to aligned attribute, improving code generation on ARMv6, ARMv7, and aarch64, and cleaned up duplicate implementations in legacy code. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)

Replaced the bit operations in BIT_addBits with the BIT_getLowerBits helper function, and added conditional compilation protection for BMI2 instruction support to improve code clarity and reduce data cache pressure. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)
Fixed the asynchronous IO performance regression for small files by dynamically enabling or disabling asynchronous IO based on file size. (Architecture-related: asynchronous IO behavior)
Improved the heuristic for Huffman tree depth selection to avoid excessive adjustments in specific corner cases, thereby improving the compression ratio.
Changed the threshold for automatic tree depth adjustment from the maximum value to the default value to improve the compression ratio in specific cases.
Removed expensive assertions in the --rsyncable hot loop to improve performance, and added equivalent assertions at the beginning and end of the loop to maintain coverage.

Fixed an out-of-bounds access issue in the FSE decompression function caused by improper offset calculation, and changed assertions to conditional checks in the dictionary training function to eliminate false null pointer positives. (architecture-related: public API)

Fixed the issue where the match length check in the sequence validation logic was inconsistent with the context, and corrected the seqStore boundary check to prevent out-of-bounds writes. (architecture-related: public API)

Rewrote the old v0.7 boundary check logic to no longer rely on address space overflow, fixing a potential security issue found by oss-fuzz. (architecture-related: legacy format backward compatibility)

Fixed documentation errors in ZSTD_estimate* and ZSTD_initCStream(), removed the erroneous warning that the legacy streaming API is incompatible with advanced parameters and dictionary compression, added a note that ZSTD_initCStream() clears the dictionary, and noted that ZSTD_estimate* functions do not support the external matchfinder API and multithreading. (architecture-related: public API documentation correction)
Added the missing util.h header reference in fileio.h to fix compilation order issues. (architecture-related: public API)
Updated the CircleCI base image to focal and re-enabled aarch64 builds. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)
Comprehensively refactored the Windows CI, upgraded to Visual Studio 2022, updated msys2 configuration, and optimized the test matrix. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)
Disabled custom ASAN/MSAN poisoning for MinGW builds. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)
Added C89 build testing in CI and fixed compilation warnings in the code that are incompatible with C89. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)
Upgraded the version number to v1.5.4 and began preparing for the release. (architecture-related: version and compatibility)
Fixed build errors caused by incompatible test compilation options under MSVC.
Fixed the return type check error in the Meson build script, resolving the issue where zstd could not be built.

Initialized the compression level field in static CDict, fixed the issue where user-defined MOREFLAGS and FUZZER_FLAGS in the Makefile were overwritten, and added a new MSAN fuzz no-optimization CI workflow. (architecture-related: build and installation methods)
Corrected the assert macro definition, changing WARN_ON((x)) to WARN_ON(!(x)) so that the assertion triggers correctly. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)

Fixed a potential over-read issue that could occur when decompressing certain invalid frames without a magic number or when requesting invalid skippable frame properties. (architecture-related: decompression behavior)
Fixed the issue where the window size was not considering the full dictionary content when loading a dictionary, and adjusted the dictionary truncation threshold to support larger index tables.
Added a check for the validity of the target buffer during decompression, and added fuzz testing to randomize the target pointer when the buffer size is zero.

Simplified the benchmark API by changing the return type of BMK_syntheticTest, BMK_benchFilesAdvanced, and BMK_benchFiles from BMK_benchOutcome_t to int, directly returning integer error codes. (Architectural event: HighResTimer module change)
Optimized the performance of forward seeking during decompression of seekable format, avoiding repeated reading of frame data when performing multiple small interval seeks within the same frame.
Marked the BIT_reloadDStream function as forced inline to improve decompression speed under PGO-optimized compilation.
Removed the Clang-only branch prediction hint in ZSTD_decodeSequence to improve decompression performance when PGO is enabled.
Clarified the requirement for dstCapacity in the single-shot compression function, ensuring that compression succeeds when sufficient space is provided. (architecture-related: public API)

Added documentation for ZSTD_CCtx_loadDictionary and ZSTD_CCtx_refPrefix, explaining the compatibility differences between LDM (long-distance mode) and dictionaries. (architecture-related: public API)
Added a GitHub Actions workflow to generate release artifacts on Windows 64-bit environments. (Architecture-related: Build and release: Windows 64-bit artifacts)

Pinned third-party action dependencies in the GitHub Actions workflow from version tags to specific commit hashes to improve supply chain security. (Architecture-related: Build security: Pinned third-party action dependencies)
Pinned the dependency hashes of the base image in the Dockerfile. (Architecture-related: Build reproducibility: Pinned base image dependencies)

In the build configuration of contrib/pzstd, added logic to automatically detect and select the latest C++ standard supported by the compiler (minimum C++11). (Architecture-related: Build requirements: C++11 minimum standard)

Modified the build configuration of pzstd to explicitly set -std=c++11 only when the default C++ standard is lower than C++11; otherwise, use the compiler's default standard. (Architecture-related: Build requirements: C++11 conditional setting)

Adjusted the naming and directory structure of Windows release artifacts to align with the v1.5.0 version specification, and updated the CI workflow to automatically execute on release events. (architecture-related: release artifact structure)

bug: Fix and deprecate ZSTD_generateSequences (#3981)
Added the ZSTD_CCtxParams_registerSequenceProducer public API, allowing an external sequence producer to be used with a static CCtx. (architectural event: Zstd_Core_Module module change)

The long decoder adapts to the new decodeSequences interface, removes the old implementation, and optimizes the loop logic to detect corruption earlier. (architecture-related: core decompression module)
Fixed typos and added a workspace size query function. (architecture-related: public API)
Enabled utimensat support on FreeBSD, using more precise timestamp setting. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)
Implemented single-shot decompression fallback for the magicless format, adding a private function to support magicless frames. (architecture-related: public API)
The internal benchmark supports generating lorem ipsum samples and allows selecting sample size via -B#.
Removed the flexible array mode of Buffer Pool and CCtx Pool in ZSTDMT, changed to external allocation, solving compatibility issues with the new ubsan. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)
Fixed a null pointer dereference issue in ZSTD_createCDict_advanced2() caused by unchecked memory allocation failure. (architecture-related: public API)
Fixed an issue of adding to a null pointer when output is empty, by returning early to avoid null pointer arithmetic.
Optimized type safety of memory copies in the thread pool, and fixed a type conversion issue in job count calculation in async IO reading.
Fixed an incorrect assertion in the compression optimization code.
Fixed an assertion error by introducing the ZSTD_OPT_SIZE macro to uniformly manage the size of the optimal parser table.
Fixed a memory sanitizer (msan) warning by initializing uninitialized fields in the optimal parser and adjusting condition checks.
Fixed an assertion failure caused by insufficient backward search space, by adding an extra space to avoid triggering the assertion.
Fixed an out-of-bounds read issue found in fuzz testing.
Fixed a boundary condition issue in sub-block division when handling incompressible data blocks, and optimized the performance of the target block size parameter.
Fixed a pointer arithmetic issue that could occur when processing long sequences exceeding 64KB.
Fixed the issue where some sub-blocks were not compressed in target compressed block size mode, and optimized the related processing logic.
Fixed the issue of insufficient seed queue filling during AsyncIO reads, ensuring the loop continues enqueueing until the number of available tasks is zero.

Support compile-time exclusion of individual compression strategies, set the excluded strategy entries in the block compressor table to NULL, and adjust the strategy selection logic in CParams to avoid using excluded block compressors, while adding NULL checks and assertions to ensure safety. (architecture-related: compile-time strategy exclusion)
Refactored the ZSTD_sequenceProducer_F type from a function type to a function pointer type, and updated all related usages. (architecture-related: public API type change)

Migrated the external sequence producer (ESP) parameters from the compression context to the ZSTD_CCtx_params structure, and added the helper function ZSTD_hasExtSeqProd. (architecture-related: public API parameter migration)
Replaced memcpy with ZSTD_memcpy to support redirection in Linux kernel mode. (architecture-related: platform compatibility: Linux kernel mode)
Removed the old variant in the splitLitBuffer decoding path, simplified the decoding loop, and updated the related function signatures.

Refactored the access method for flexible array members in the FSE decompression workspace to obtain the dtable via pointer offset calculation, and added several type casts and assertions to mitigate UBSan warnings.
Refactor the optimal parser to change internal storage from sequence to stretch, enabling linking of predecessor solutions, and adjust memory allocation and conditional compilation accordingly.

Upgraded the xxHash library to v0.8.2, including performance optimizations and SVE vectorization support, and disabled automatic vectorization of XXH64 by default to avoid performance degradation. (architecture-related: public API)
In the btultra2 block compressor, optimized the literal update logic at position pos+1 to achieve better compression when litlen==1.

Optimized the superblock processing performance of the compression engine, including improving the sequence encoding format, optimizing the target compressed block size parameter, early exit for incompressible data, and improving the sub-block boundary judgment logic.

Modified the bitstream implementation to always return 0 after overflow, and introduced internal overloaded functions to enhance cross-platform behavior consistency and improve safety. (architecture-related: public API behavior)
Modified the sequence decoding flow, added parameter detection for overflow events without requiring checksums, to enhance safety. (architecture-related: core decompression behavior)

Stop globally suppressing UBSAN pointer overflow, change to local suppression, and introduce helper functions to safely handle pointer arithmetic, fixing fuzzer issues. (Architecture-related: public API macro definitions)

Convert the invalid case of offset 0 to a very large positive number so that it is detected as data corruption in distance checks, no longer relying on checksums. (architecture-related: core decompression behavior)
Remove unsafe sprintf calls in zstdcli.c, use safe initialization instead, and adjust error message formatting.

In the format specification, explicitly define the case where the offset calculation result is 0 as data corruption, and add a note that the decompressor should treat it as offset 1 in this case. Also, add to the ZSTD_decompressStream API documentation: after an operation returns an error, the DCtx state is undefined, and calling this function at that time is undefined behavior; the state must be reset first. (Architecture-related: public API and format specification)
The Windows build workflow adds win32 architecture support and changes to a strategy matrix to build both win32 and win64 architecture artifacts. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)

Add compile-time macro guards to allow excluding specific compression strategies at build time, and add build options ZSTD_LIB_EXCLUDE_COMPRESSORS_DFAST_AND_UP and ZSTD_LIB_EXCLUDE_COMPRESSORS_GREEDY_AND_UP to reduce library size. (Architecture-related: build options)
Fix assembly file compilation failure in Intel Xcode builds; only force the source file language to C when the assembler differs from the C compiler. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)
The pzstd build configuration removes conditional checks and directly uses the C++14 standard to resolve portability issues. (architecture-related: build requirements)

Add public header include directories to the library target via the CMake BUILD_INTERFACE generator expression, so other projects can correctly reference zstd headers via FetchContent or ExternalProject_Add. (architecture-related: build and installation methods)
Improve CMake configuration to export a unified zstd::libzstd target when only static or dynamic linking is specified. (architecture-related: build and installation methods)

Change zstd::libzstd from an alias target to an imported interface target to dynamically select static or dynamic linking when using find_package. (architecture-related: build and installation methods)
Improve CMake build tests to be compatible with earlier CMake versions (<3.13), and fix compilation issues when building pzstd with CMake on macOS. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)
Unify and export the zstd::libzstd target in the CMake project to avoid duplicate definitions. (architecture-related: build and installation methods)
Stop hardcoding the POSIX version on BSD systems and rely on the system's unistd.h instead. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)

Fix CMake build to always create the libzstd target when both shared and static libraries are enabled, and determine its type based on BUILD_SHARED_LIBS. (architecture-related: build and installation methods)
Fix CMake build: manage public headers uniformly, expose only the library directory's include path, and set the include directory as INTERFACE. (architecture-related: public API)
Fix datagen missing lorem-related source files in Meson and CMake builds.
Unified the Windows platform detection macro to only check the compiler-defined _WIN32, to unify the Windows detection method. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)
Removed the custom type definition of intptr_t, because the Linux kernel's <linux/types.h> already provides this type. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)
Updated the version number to v1.5.6. (architecture-related: version and compatibility)

Exposed the ZSTD_compressSequencesAndLiterals() and ZSTD_CCtx_setParameter() functions in the kernel, and updated the build process and header file references. (architecture-related: public API)

Fixed a build issue on Windows x86 with clang 16 and above, by adjusting the condition for CPUID detection. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)

Fixed compilation warnings in the zstd.h header file in C++ environments, by adding conditional compilation guards to be compatible with the -Wzero-as-null-pointer-constant option. (architecture-related: public API)
Throw an error during FSE decompression when the initial state of the Huffman weights is truncated. (architecture-related: external behavior)
Fixed a memory leak caused by parameter checking in ZSTD_generateSequences on early return, by moving the destination buffer allocation after parameter validation. (architecture-related: public API)

Fixed an issue in 32-bit mode with clang due to the unavailability of register %rbx, by adding a check for 64-bit mode to disable the relevant code path in 32-bit mode. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)
Added a null pointer check before creating the seek table to avoid a segmentation fault. (architecture-related: public API)

Removed the difference in row matcher selection based on SSE2/Neon availability, and unified the use of the same window log threshold to enhance reproducibility. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)
Fixed the error checking macro issue in MSVC 64-bit builds, and adjusted the return type of two bit operation functions to BitContainerType. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)
Added CI testing for the x86 32-bit + AVX2 combination, and fixed the type conversion in the BIT_closeCStream function. (architecture-related: public API)

Fixed BMI2 intrinsic compatibility issues on 32-bit platforms, including selecting the correct intrinsic based on size_t size, adjusting parameter types, fixing conditional compilation format, and enabling DYNAMIC_BMI2 support by default. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)
Fixed ISO C incompatibility by replacing empty initializer lists for structs with member-by-member assignment.
Decompression error messages now always display the full original file name without truncation.
Fixed the zlibWrapper build error by changing the type conversion in the gz_write function from z_uInt to uInt.
Fixed multiple memory leak issues and initialized variables to avoid undefined behavior.
Fixed a null pointer dereference in legacy/zstd_v06 caused by missing checks for ZSTDv06_createDCtx allocation failure, adding memory release and null pointer return handling on failure.
Fixed an issue in pzstd where threads could hang when decompressing corrupted files due to the work queue not ending properly.
Fixed the formatString_u function so it correctly displays numbers greater than 100, allowing the benchmark to handle more than 100 files without the -S option.
Fixed an issue in the BMK_loadFiles function where files were not closed.
Fixed the issue of the benchmark module repeatedly displaying the load summary in --quiet mode; now source files are loaded only once and tested uniformly across all compression levels.
Fixed a type conversion warning in DEBUGLOG by changing the format specifier from %lli to %i and explicitly casting the argument type.
Fixed an issue where file sizes exceeding 4GB were displayed incorrectly.

Fixed a bug where the optimal parser could generate overly short matches when long-distance matching was enabled, and changed the match length check from the hardcoded MINMATCH to the dynamic minMatch parameter.
Fixed an array index out-of-bounds access issue by adding a boundary check before access.
Fixed a potential array out-of-bounds access issue when a block separator is not found, adding an appropriate error return.

The COVER algorithm dictionary training function is now fully reentrant, using platform-specific qsort_r/qsort_s instead of global variables to pass context, and providing a C90-compatible stable sort fallback implementation for BSD systems. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)

Renamed the block splitter control parameter enum constant ZSTD_c_blockSplitter_level to ZSTD_c_blockSplitterLevel, and synchronously updated related code and tests. (architecture-related: public API)
Replaced C11's alignas with the _Alignas keyword to eliminate dependency on header files. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)

Changed the preprocessor condition from DYNAMIC_BMI2 != 0 to DYNAMIC_BMI2, and migrated the STATIC_BMI2 macro definition to portability_macros.h, uniformly using the STATIC_BMI2 macro check instead of ==1 comparisons.
Adjusted the condition evaluation order of the STATIC_BMI2 macro definition, checking the __BMI2__ macro first, with MSVC and __AVX2__ as alternatives.

The documentation clearly states that ZSTD_decompress() supports decompressing multiple consecutive compressed frames in one call, and the results will be concatenated with all decompressed data. (architecture-related: public API)
Adjusted the header file inclusion positions and the extern "C" block structure in debug.h and huf.h, fixing C++ compilation compatibility issues. (architecture-related: public API)
Re-added the extern "C" block in xxhash.h to support C++ compilation. (architecture-related: public API)

Fixed the issue in the CMake build script where the resource compiler include directory path was not quoted, ensuring correct quoting when the path contains spaces. (architecture-related: build and installation methods)
Provided variant pkg-config files for the multithreaded static library, so that it correctly includes the -pthread link and compile flags. (architecture-related: pkg-config configuration)
Fixed the issue of incorrect $filter parameter order, and improved the detection of MSYS/Cygwin environments. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)

Adjusted libzstd dependency management in the Meson build, separating internal dependencies from public dependencies to avoid name conflicts caused by private header exports, and fixed the builds of contrib and tests. (architecture-related: build and installation methods)
Added compile-time macro support for old libc that does not support fseeko/ftello. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)
Added noexecstack compile and link flags for GCC/Clang, and added alignment attribute macro detection for the ClangCL compiler. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)
Removed the x32 ABI test task, and updated the ARM64 test configuration, including QEMU system packages and CFLAGS parameters. (architecture-related: platform compatibility)
Fixed failures in Meson and CMake Linux build tests caused by missing liblzma dependency, explicitly installing the liblzma-dev package in CI.
Use the system-provided md5sum on FreeBSD instead of gmd5sum.
Fixed the issue of the resource compiler missing the include directory in the CMake build, setting the correct include path for rc.
Updated the man page installation directory for FreeBSD.

Adjusted the position and scope of extern "C" blocks in multiple header files to improve C++ compatibility; removed extern "C" blocks from bitstream.h and fse.h to simplify header file structure. (architecture-related: C++ compatibility)
